name: Christmas Run To Tree
description: The Christmas Run To Tree is an atmospheric forest run in Klövensteen Forest near Hamburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km or 12 km. The run combines sporting activity with the special experience of buying a Christmas tree. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Forest run through scenic Klövensteen Forest
Choice of 6 km or 12 km distance
Race bib in the shape of a Christmas tree
additional: Race packet pickup on event day from 09:00 to 11:15. The race bib is in the shape of a Christmas tree and must be worn visibly on the chest. Bag drop-off is available with the coupon on the race bib. Late entries are not possible. Participant transfers are possible for a fee until November 25. Awards ceremony for the 6 km at 11:15 and for the 12 km at 13:00. The event includes race bib pickup, certificates, Christmas activities, and a festive atmosphere.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Schiffenberger Wald, Gießen, is a flat race held annually in November. It offers 5 km and 10 km races for adults, as well as events for children and teenagers. The event is ideal for runners looking for a fast, flat course in a natural setting. The start and finish are at the same location; exact details are available via RUNME Premium. The race takes place on Sunday, November 29, 2026, and starts at 10:15 a.m.
course_highlights: Flat course in Schiffenberger Wald
5 km and 10 km distances for adults
Events for children and teenagers
additional: The start and finish are the same for all events. The exact start and finish locations are visible only with RUNME Premium. There are also 5 km walking and Nordic walking events. Results are usually published shortly after runners finish on the RUNME results page. The race is for adults, children, and teenagers, with start times in the morning.

name: Bertlicher Straßenläufe
description: The Bertlich Road Races in Herten are a traditional running event taking place on November 29, 2026. The event offers distances from 850 meters up to the marathon on flat, paved routes around Bertlich, ideal for runners of all ability levels. Participants can register in person on race day and benefit from refreshment stations, certificates, and medals. The event is family-friendly and features a pleasant supporting program in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: Distances from 850 meters to 30 kilometers
Flat, paved routes through a local recreation area
Varied supporting program with refreshments and certificates
additional: Registration is open until September 27, 2024; late registration is available online until race day. Start and finish near the sports field on Heinrich-Obenhaus-Straße. Parking is available at Marktkauf Herten. Changing and shower facilities are available on site. Finishers receive certificates and medals.

name: Friedeholz Cross
description: The Friedeholz Cross is a traditional forest cross-country race in Syke, Lower Saxony, and part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series. On November 29, 2026, races will be held over various distances, from a 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race to the 10.3 km main race, for children, young people, and adults. The course runs mostly on forest trails, with a short asphalt section before the finish at Waldstadion Syke. The event offers a varied cross-country running experience in an autumn setting and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Mostly forest trails with only approx. 100 m of asphalt
Start and finish at Waldstadion Syke
Part of the Syke-Weyher Cross Series, with several distances
additional: Four distances on race day: 1.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 3.6 km middle distance for U16 and older, and 10.3 km main race for U20 and older. The event is part of a series of three races, with series scoring for those who register before the first race. Switching between the middle and long distances is possible, but does not count as a series switch. Forest trails, cross-country running, series scoring, registration required for series scoring, limited shower and changing facilities at Waldstadion Syke

name: Ratzeburger Adventslauf
description: The Ratzeburg Advent Run is a traditional race around Lake Ratzeburg, taking place on 29 November 2026. The main course is 26 km long and runs mostly along hiking trails, with scenic sections and historic points of interest. There is also a 7.5 km run around Küchensee and a 1.5 km children’s run, offering an accessible introduction to running. The event combines a sporting challenge with a nature experience and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 26 km around Lake Ratzeburg, with approximately 80% hiking trails and 20% asphalt
5 refreshment stations along the course at km 5, 10, 15, 20 and 22.5
A scenic, hilly 7.5 km route around Küchensee, plus a 1.5 km children’s run with crowd support
additional: New since 2022, intermediate timing on the 26 km course allows spectators and athletes to follow split times. The races start simultaneously, with runners arranged at the start on the right-hand side of Königsdamm. The children’s run is supported by Dein-Holzpferd.de.

name: Schmachtendorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Schmachtendorf St. Nicholas Run is a traditional running event held in late November in Oberhausen-Schmachtendorf, organized by Spvgg. Sterkrade-Nord 1920/25 e.V. The event offers races for all age groups, from a 300-meter Bambini run to a 10 km run for adults. The course runs mostly along forest trails in Dunkelschlag and around the Buchenweg sports ground. Every participant receives a Stutenkerl, and awards are presented promptly after each race, with prizes for the top runners in each category.
course_highlights: 300-meter loop around the artificial-turf pitch on Buchenweg (Bambini run)
10 km run mostly along forest trails in Dunkelschlag
Start and finish at the Buchenweg sports ground; no traditional city-center course
additional: Electronic chip timing using the chip in the race bib, provided by TAF-TIMING. Certificates are available on the event day or online later. Parking is signposted at Heinrich Böll Comprehensive School and at the Schmachtendorfer Straße market square. Distances: 300 m Bambini run and 10 km for adults; course on forest trails and sports grounds; children’s and adult categories; November weather may be rainy.

name: Uplengener Adventslauf
description: The Uplengen Advent Run is a traditional cross-country race taking place for the 54th time. The races run through the Hollsand Nature Reserve and offer challenging courses depending on the weather. The event is one of the oldest running events in the region and is often used to prepare for cross-country championships. Various course distances give young people and adults the opportunity to achieve personal bests or improve their endurance. The Remels Primary School Friends’ Association will provide coffee and cake.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Hollsand Nature Reserve
Challenging courses depending on the weather
Various course distances for different age groups
additional: U14 runners can choose between 1450 m and 3100 m; U16 runners can take part in the 4450 m middle-distance race. The red loop is approximately 3000 m plus a 100 m start chute. The course uses a checkpoint system for route guidance. Cross-country race in the Hollsand Nature Reserve; course distances vary; registration and results online; coffee and cake from the Remels Primary School Friends’ Association.

name: Überruhrer Adventscrosslauf
description: The Überruhrer Advent Cross-Country Run takes place on November 29, 2026, in Essen-Überruhr. Its cross-country course takes runners through wintry nature in keeping with the Advent season. The event is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, and is held in accordance with the German Athletics Regulations (DLO). The awards ceremony and certificate distribution take place right next to the course, creating a friendly, sporting atmosphere. A catering stand in the finish area serves hot and cold drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through the natural surroundings of Essen-Überruhr
Age-group categories from U8 through seniors M/W 80
Awards ceremony and certificate distribution right next to the course
additional: Parking is available in the adjacent residential area; the recommended parking location is Marktplatz Überruhr (approx. 500 m on foot). Public transport is available via bus routes SB15, 144, 166, and 177. Catering in the finish area includes hot and cold drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The race office is located in the park. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. The race takes place on the first Sunday of Advent, in typical November weather, with temperatures around 2–7°C and frequent rain. The event is open to everyone who enjoys cross-country running and offers a friendly atmosphere, with the awards ceremony held on site.

name: Oriëntatieloop Soest
distance_verbose: 8 km, 7 km, 5.5 km, 5 km, 4.5 km, 4 km, 3000 meter
description: The Soest Orienteering Run takes place on Sunday, 24 November 2024, in and around the Soesterduinen. This is a challenging sport in which you run while

name: Pietenloop Bemmel
location: Sportpark De Heister, Bemmel, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: The Pietenloop is a small, friendly recreational run in Bemmel, suitable for the whole family. Children can choose from three distances (400, 800 and 1,200 metres), starting on the athletics track, while adults take part in a 5 km run through the countryside around Bemmel. The Pieten are there to lead the warm-up and run alongside the children, giving the event a festive atmosphere. The start is at De Heister sports park, where changing rooms and showers are also available. After the run, there is a treat for everyone, and young participants receive a lovely Pieten medal.
course_highlights: Children’s races of 400, 800 and 1,200 metres on the athletics track
Recreational 5 km run through Haalderen and along the Waal dike, free of traffic
Start and finish at De Heister sports park, with facilities including changing rooms and showers
additional: The Pieten lead the warm-up for children at 9:45. There is no electronic timekeeping; a central clock is used. The first-, second- and third-place finishers in the children’s races and the 5 km will be listed on the website. Food and drinks can be paid for by QR code in the clubhouse. The venue opens at 9:00 for race-number collection. A family-friendly event for children with Pieten, held at De Heister sports park in Bemmel.

name: Run Rondje Rhenoy
description: Run Rondje Rhenoy is an autumn classic being held for the 20th time this year in Beesd. The race takes place on Sunday 29 November 2026 at 13:00 and features a beautiful course through the villages of Beesd, Rumpt and Rhenoy. After the race, there will be a friendly get-together and a prize draw, with great prizes to be won, including a voucher for running shoes. The race is suitable for runners aged 12 and over for the 5 km, and aged 16 and over for the 10.8 km. The event is known for its sporting atmosphere and beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Course through Beesd, Rumpt and Rhenoy
Start and finish at rvv BRC, Sportstraat 7, Beesd
Autumn classic with a friendly get-together and prize draw after the race
additional: Registration desk open from 11:30 to 12:50. Briefing at 13:00. Prize-giving and prize draw around 14:30. Event closes at 15:30. Entry for the 5 km is open to participants aged 12 and over; the 10.8 km is open to participants aged 16 and over. Participation is at your own risk. After the race, there will be an opportunity to chat over a drink and a snack in the sports club canteen. The main prize in the draw is a €150 voucher for running shoes at Sporthuis De Jager. The race starts and finishes at RVV BRC, Sportstraat 7, with the start at 13:02 and prize-giving around 14:30. Registration opens at 11:30, and the event closes at 15:30. A cycling event is also being organized on the same day by BBB Bike Boys.

name: Sint Nicolaasloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: kidsrun 1,5km (4 t/m 9 jr en 10 t/m 12 jr): € 5,00 (2026)

description: The Sint Nicolaasloop in Zwolle is an annual running event held on one of the last Sundays before 5 December, Sinterklaas. The event offers four distances: a 1.5 km kids’ run, and the 5 km, 8 km and 10 English miles for adults. The course runs through the scenic countryside north of Zwolle, past the Berkum and AA-landen neighbourhoods, and is suitable for runners of all ages and abilities. The event is organised by an enthusiastic group of volunteers from running group SNL, who ensure a welcoming and well-organised race experience.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside north of Zwolle
Route past the Berkum and AA-landen neighbourhoods
Clear yellow route arrows and guidance for the fastest runners
additional: Race bibs with chips are not sent to participants’ homes and can be collected on Friday evening and Sunday morning at SV HTC. All participants receive a running shirt; participants who register before 1 October can specify their size. Parking near the start is limited, so cycling is recommended. There is no on-the-day registration. G-runners may take part in the kids’ run regardless of age. The course is not closed to traffic; traffic marshals provide guidance where needed. Maximum of 1,000 participants; the course is marked with yellow arrows; traffic marshals are present; race bibs and shirts can be collected at the venue.

name: Tis voor niks
description: ’T is voor niks is a friendly running and walking event in Geldrop, held annually since 1999. Participation is free thanks to the efforts of many volunteers and sponsors. Five distances are available, ranging from 6 to 25 kilometres, with the start and finish at Café Brabants Bont and Winkelcentrum Coevering. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and good on-course support.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Café Brabants Bont, next to the sports hall and Winkelcentrum Coevering
Refreshment stations with water, gingerbread, coffee and tea at two locations for the longer distances
Clearly marked routes with arrows; walkers do not receive route sheets
additional: Walkers start individually or in groups from the event office at Wijkgebouw De Dreef. Timekeeping stops at 14:30, and all participants must have finished by then. If participants are running late, the organisers may direct them onto a shorter route. Changing and freshening up are available at Sporthal De Coevering from 9:30. Personal drinks can be dropped off at the information stand before 9:30 for transport to the refreshment station. Multiple distances, organised annually, succeeded by Lucas Klamer Half Marathon.

name: UHUT100 Winter - Doorn
location: Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin, Leersum, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: UHUT100 Winter is a unique ultra trail that takes you across the beautiful Utrechtse Heuvelrug. The race consists of two laps, each more than 50 km, run on Saturday and Sunday, with the start and finish at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin in Leersum. Participants can choose one of the 50+ km ultras or run the full 109 km over two days. The route follows varied single tracks through several nature reserves and is continually coordinated with the managers of these areas. Thanks to live tracking, friends and family can follow the runners during the event.
course_highlights: Two 50+ km laps across the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Varied single tracks through several nature reserves
Start and finish at the wooded Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin
additional: UHUT100 Winter is split over two days because of the short daylight hours in November. Participants receive a live tracker when collecting their race bib. The route is navigated entirely via GPX, and refreshments are provided every 10–15 km. Finish both days before 17:00. Parking is available at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin; follow the instructions of the parking attendants. Route split over 2 days, start at 09:00, finish before 17:00, navigation via GPX, no cups at aid stations, parking at Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin.

name: JulekalenderLØBET
description: JulekalenderLØBET er et spændende løb, der finder sted i Frederikshavn. Deltagerne kan se frem til en festlig atmosfære, hvor de kan løbe i

name: Sinterklaasloop Bolsward
description: The Sinterklaas Run in Bolsward is a friendly, traditional running race held annually on the last Monday before Sinterklaas. The route runs through and around Bolsward and covers 7.2 kilometres. The race starts at 19:00 at Sporthal De Middelzee. Electronic timing is used, and approximately 25 traffic marshals are on hand to ensure safety. Participants are asked to wear reflective clothing and/or lights for their own safety.
course_highlights: Route through and around Bolsward
Distance of 7.2 kilometres
Starts at Sporthal De Middelzee at 19:00
additional: Registration on the day is not possible. Participants are electronically timed. Sponsor Sporthuis AP van der Feer makes it possible to win prizes in a draw using your race number as your lottery number. Approximately 25 traffic marshals help ensure a safe race. Reflective clothing and/or lights are recommended. The race starts at Sporthal De Middelzee. Registration is online only, with no same-day registration. Participants are advised to wear reflective clothing. There are no official performance prizes, but there are prize draws for participants.

name: Bjørgene Løpskarusell 3. Løp
description: The athletics group welcomes you to a new running series in Bjørgene on 4 February! The snow is gone and the trails in Bjørgene are in great condition. We hope to see you at the starting line!

images.alt_text: Løpere i løp i Bjørgene.
Løper i løp med startnummer. Vinterlandskap.
Løper i Bjørgene løpskarusell.
Løpere på gangvei under et løp. Flere løpere i blå og svart drakt.

name: Kolding Light Run 2026 powered by Andelskassen
Track & Glow 2026
description: Track & Glow 10K takes place at Gjesdal Idrettspark, one of Norway’s few running tracks with Wavelight technology. The race offers a separate elite field and several recreational fields, with automatic lap counting displayed on a big screen. All participants receive a finisher’s medal, and prizes are awarded to the winners of each wave in the women’s and men’s categories. The event is open to the public with free admission, and facilities such as kiosks and toilets are available on site.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a running track with Wavelight technology
Automatic lap counting displayed on a big screen
Warm-up options on walking and cycling paths, as well as a gravel road to Flassavatnet
additional: Bib distribution starts at 16:00 inside the Gjesdal IL Clubhouse. Runners in the elite heat must follow World Athletics shoe rules (maximum 20 mm sole thickness). There are 6 toilets in the clubhouse and more beneath the grandstand. The winner of each wave receives a prize. Photos from the race will be posted on social media. The kiosk is open in the clubhouse. Listed as cancelled.

name: Night Shift Trail - Växjö
location: Shooting range parking area, Notteryd, Växjö, Sweden
description: Night.Shift Trailrun Växjö is a trail running event held in scenic surroundings by the shooting range car park in Notteryd, Växjö. The event focuses on a unique experience in technical and challenging terrain rather than competition and prizes. The organisers place great emphasis on community and purpose, with a large part of the entry fee going to charity. The event is part of the Mossarun events, run by a group of friends with a passion for trails and nature.
course_highlights: Technical and challenging trails in scenic surroundings
Running across varied terrain, including forest and hilly sections
Focus on the experience and community rather than competition
additional: The event is run on a non-profit basis, and a large part of the proceeds goes to the Sangter Foundation, which helps people in Sikkim, India. The focus is on small events with few participants to create a personal and meaningful experience. Previous Mossarun events have included various distances and formats, including ultra and Backyard Ultra. The organisers are open to collaborations and innovative event ideas. The start and finish are near the shooting range car park in Notteryd. Start waves are listed as 17.30–18.00 and 19.00–19.30. Participants receive a start chip and check out and back in to record their lap time. Food and non-alcoholic beer are served after the race.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 2. løp
description: Samnanger Winter Series is an inclusive running series organised by the Samnanger IL Running Group. It takes place approximately every other Friday during winter at Nesodden. Participants can choose between 2 km and 5 km routes, with the 5 km route officially measured by NFIF. The races suit all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and focus on competition, training and socialising. Wearing a reflective vest is important during the dark winter months. The running group is informal, free and open to everyone.
course_highlights: The races take place at Nesodden, with the start and finish in the same place
Choose between 2 km and 5 km routes; the 5 km route is officially measured by NFIF
The races take place in winter darkness, so a reflective vest is required
additional: The races are held approximately every other Friday at 18:30. The running group also offers group training every Monday at 18:10 in Hagabotnane. The event is informal and free, with a focus on the joy of running and community. Wearing a reflective vest is recommended because of the darkness. The races take place approximately every other Friday from November to March at 19:00. Wear a reflective vest.

name: Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf
description: The Wiedenbrück Christkindl Run is a popular race around the Christkindlmarkt in Wiedenbrück’s old town, illuminated for Christmas. The course is a five-lap circuit covering approximately 10.2 km and is not officially measured. Traditionally held in December, the race offers a festive atmosphere in the town centre. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück and attracts many runners from the region.
course_highlights: Five-lap circuit around the Christkindlmarkt
Wiedenbrück’s old town illuminated for Christmas
Course length approximately 10.2 km; run clockwise
additional: Start and finish on Lange Straße in Wiedenbrück. No race-day registrations. Time limit: 75 minutes. Wearing headsets or earphones is prohibited and will result in disqualification. Participants are asked to keep as far to the right as possible and not to run in groups, as runners may be lapped. Participant limit: 1,100. Online registration only. Medals can be reordered. Start on 04.12.2026.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is an exceptional trail race taking place on 5 December 2026 in the picturesque Tricity Landscape Park. The course combines a seaside atmosphere with varied, mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging climbs, valleys, ravines and gorges. It is a great opportunity to end the season amid sporting competition and close contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Tricity Landscape Park, close to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, ravines and gorges
Challenging elevation gains and natural climbs characteristic of trail running
additional: Race packs can be collected on 4–5 December 2026 at the race office. Starts are held in waves: the 6 km night race starts at 19:00 on 4 December; on 5 December, the 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30) and 12 km (13:30) races start, along with Garmin Junior races for children. Time limits for completing the distances range from 2 to 15 hours, depending on course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The participant card is available 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Distances from 12 km to 86 km, time limits, qualifying points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and young people.

name: Grønbroløbet - Julespecial
description: Grønbroløbet - Julespecial finder sted den 2. december 2023, med start kl. 9 fra Grønbrovej 1, 4262 Sandved (Grønbrohallen). Ruten er en bla

name: Vinterkarusellen 3. løp
description: Vinterkarusellen 3rd race takes place in Fana, and all times achieved in this year’s series will be recognized in the statistics for both 5 km and 10 km. This means that a personal record set in Vinterkarusellen will always be recognized. Ålesund Vinterkarusell has a long history dating back to the mid-1980s, and since winter 2023, Ålesundløpene has been the organizer.

Løpere i Vinterkarusellen, Løvenstad. Snø og skog.
Løpere i Vinterkarusellen Løvenstad.  Nattløp.

name: Bergen Advents Maraton
description: Join the Bergen Advent Marathon on Saturday, December 6, where you can choose between the half marathon (21,097 meters) or the marathon (42,195 meters). The course is an out-and-back route on paved roads that are completely traffic-free or have very little traffic, and a large part of the route follows a disused railway line through idyllic rural surroundings. Marathon runners complete the same loop twice. The course is gently undulating, except for a hilltop at Fana Stadium that runners must go up and down from both sides.

name: Vinterkarusellen (Romerike) – 3. løp, Løvenstad
description: Vinterkarusellen Romerike - 3rd race takes place on Saturday, December 5, 2026, on Løvenstadvegen in Løvenstad, Rælingen, Akershus. This race is part of Vinterkarusellen, a popular race series that attracts runners of all ages and abilities. The event offers a great opportunity to test your fitness during the winter months in a scenic area. Registration is easy through the WODira platform, and everyone can choose their category and register directly on the website.
course_highlights: The race takes place on Løvenstadvegen in Løvenstad, Rælingen
Held during the winter months, with fresh, crisp air
Part of an established race series in the Romerike region
additional: Registration is through the WODira event page.

name: Borredalen Rundt – Juleløpet
description: Borredalen Rundt is the Fredrikstad district’s most longstanding recreational race, held since 1962. The race takes place on Tuesday evenings during the April-to-October season. Its approximately 5.5 km course winds around Borredalsdammen through scenic surroundings, along forest trails, rocky terrain and sandy paths. This is an informal weekly event with no entry fee, built on volunteer effort and a sense of community among women and men who enjoy running. Participants register at the start and set off together, keeping their own time.
course_highlights: The course follows forest trails, rocky terrain and sandy paths around Borredalsdammen
An approximately 5.5 km route with varied terrain: trails, rocky terrain, forest paths and gravel roads
Scenic surroundings in the Fredrikstad forest
additional: The race is held every Tuesday during the summer season, with a mass start. Participants register their names at the start and must keep track of their own time and report it to the official recording the times. Volunteers run the event, with a six-week rotation in the race office. The Borredalen Rundt tradition began in 1962.

name: Berliner Nikolauslauf 2026
price_range: 5,00 Euro bis 30,00 Euro (je nach Kategorie und Anmeldungstermin)
description: The 2026 Berlin St. Nicholas Run is a traditional race around the picturesque Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke lakes in Berlin’s Grunewald forest. The course follows a measured 5.3-kilometre lakeside path that is popular with both recreational visitors and competitive athletes. The event offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the Bambini Marathon to the Big 5 Marathon, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings. It takes place on December 6, 2026, and is organised by DIE LAUFPARTNER e.V.
course_highlights: A loop around Schlachtensee, 5.3 km per lap
A nature-rich route through Berlin’s Grunewald forest
A popular training route with top athletes and recreational visitors
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:00 a.m. at Fischerhüttenstraße 137, 14163 Berlin, near the turning circle between Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke. Race-day late entries are available online, subject to an additional fee. The event offers a range of distances for runners and Nordic walkers, as well as relay races. Distances range from 330 m to 26.8 km. Registration is available online or in writing; race-day late entries are online only and subject to a fee. Race bibs can be collected in Berlin.

name: Glücksburger Nikolaus-Crosslauf
location: Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2, 24960 Glücksburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Glücksburg St Nicholas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country event held in December in Glücksburg on the Baltic Sea, organised by TSV Glücksburg 09. The races start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2. Adults and older teenagers can choose between a medium 4.1 km cross-country run and a long 8.2 km run, while younger children take part in shorter, fun runs. The event has a St Nicholas theme, with a piggyback run for parents carrying babies and various races for toddlers and young people. Every participant receives a chocolate Santa Claus as a gift.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on varied terrain by the Baltic Sea
Start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2
A range of distances from 100 m to 8.2 km for all age groups
additional: The youngest participants’ races are not timed, to preserve their fun, playful character. The event takes place in typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. It also includes volunteer duties at the start, finish and along the course, as well as refreshments including coffee, tea and cake. Registration is online, and the event takes place at Schwennau Arena in Glücksburg.

name: Nikolauslauf und 131. Straßenlauf
description: Der Nikolauslauf in Dülmen findet am 5. Dezember 2026 zum 40. Mal im Nuhaj-Stadion am Grenzweg statt. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Laufdistanzen für alle Altersklassen, von Bambini bis Erwachsene, und unterstützt die Kinderkrebshilfe Münster e.V. Mit einer familiären Atmosphäre und der Verteilung von Stutenkerlen durch den Nikolaus ist der Lauf ein beliebtes Event für Jung und Alt. Urkunden können auf Anfrage für alle Teilnehmer gedruckt werden.
course_highlights: Läufe für alle Altersklassen von 600 m bis 10 km
Start und Ziel im Nuhaj-Stadion am Grenzweg
Familiäre Atmosphäre mit Nikolaus und Stutenkerl-Verteilung
additional: Startzeiten der Läufe gestaffelt von 13:00 Uhr (Bambini) bis 15:00 Uhr (10 km). Der Erlös aus Startgeldern und Spenden geht an die Kinderkrebshilfe Münster e.V. Der Lauf findet bei winterlichem Wetter statt, mit Temperaturen um 3°C und möglichem Schnee. Teilnahme ab 14 Jahren, mit Einzel- und Mannschaftswertungen.

name: Steinfurter Nikolauslauf 10 km
description: The Steinfurter Nikolauslauf 10 km is an annual pre-Christmas road race in Steinfurt, Germany, held as part of the Nikolausmarkt. The race starts at the historic market square in Burgsteinfurt and finishes at the Nikolausmarkt. The course first passes through the historic old town, then follows natural forest trails around the Bagno recreation area before returning to the market. Since its founding in 1975, the race has become a fixture in the local running calendar, attracting both club and recreational runners from the region.
course_highlights: Start at the historic market square in Burgsteinfurt
Route through the historic old town
Loop on natural forest trails around the Bagno recreation area
additional: Typical December weather: approx. 3 °C, usually snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. 10 km race, typical December weather with possible snowfall; participants are usually local club members and recreational runners.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn forest parking, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE is a winter running series consisting of four events held over half-marathon and marathon distances, as well as Nordic Walking events. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River area near Biedrusko, offering an intimate atmosphere for both recreational and professional runners. The course passes through picturesque areas along the Warta River, with varied surfaces and terrain. The start and race office are located at the Łysy Młyn forest car park by Lake Łyse, and the gun start is scheduled for 10:00.

The course follows mainly the blue cycling trail along the Warta River, as well as forest tracks and trails.
The course surface is slippery and uneven, with leaves, puddles, and mud, requiring care and preparation.

The race headquarters are at the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko, by Lake Łyse. The venue can be reached by car or by local and suburban buses; free parking is available. The start is scheduled for 10:00. Nordic Walking takes place over the half-marathon distance.

It offers a half marathon and an 11.4 km race, starting at the Tussenboerslanden sports complex. Participants can make use of facilities including medical care, hot showers, changing rooms and refreshment stations every 5 km. The event is known for its sporting atmosphere, and every participant receives a keepsake.

Start and finish at the Tussenboerslanden sports complex in Nijeveen

name: Sinterklaasloop Katwijk
description: The Sinterklaasloop Katwijk is part of the Duinloopcircuit, a unique running series along the most beautiful parts of the Dutch coast. The race offers a varied course with challenging dune trails and fast beach sections, suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The atmosphere is always great, and the event is open to all ages. Join in and experience running at its best in a beautiful setting.

Unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all ages and levels

Rankings are kept for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men, based on the best four results in the circuit. The event offers various distances and categories, with GPX routes and results available.

The start and finish are at the athletics track at Quo Vadis. The 10 and 15 km courses run counterclockwise, with 15 km runners completing an extra loop on Gasthuisweg. Younger runners up to age 12 can take part in a 1.2 km kids’ run. The first, second and third place finishers in each distance receive a prize, for both women and men.

Participants are encouraged to read the general information page; prizes are awarded to the top three in each distance and category.

name: Advent Pop up Run Halleberg
location: Parking near Kungens kök, Halleberg, Vänersborg Municipality, Sweden

price_tiers.distance: Advent Pop up Run Halleberg 12-15 km

description: Celebrate the second Sunday of Advent with a unique running experience on Halleberg, one of western Sweden’s most magnificent plateau mountains. The run follows a varied, nature-filled route through enchanting forests, past lakes and along beautiful trails, with terrain ranging from soft forest paths to technical sections and more open plateau tracks. Along the way, enjoy impressive views over Lake Vänern and fascinating geology that tells a story stretching back hundreds of millions of years. After the run, participants gather for a festive Advent coffee break—a cosy and well-deserved way to round off the second Sunday of Advent.
course_highlights: Impressive views over Lake Vänern
Run through enchanting forests and past lakes
Varied terrain, including soft forest paths and technical sections
additional: The run is divided into 2–3 pace groups. A festive Advent coffee break is served after the run. Meet at the car park near Kungens kök. Start at 10:00. Advent coffee is included.

name: Lierløpet 13
description: Lierløpet is an exciting race series offering different distances for both men and women of all ages. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21.1 km, with age categories for everyone aged 11 and up. The race takes place in scenic surroundings and follows the well-known Linnesrunden, an easy-to-run route suitable for everyone. Prizes are awarded to the top runners, and there are opportunities to set personal records.

name: 47. Mühlenberger Nikolauslauf
location: Bezirkssportanlage am Ossietzkyring, Ossietzkyring, Hannover, Germany
description: Der 47. Mühlenberger Nikolauslauf ist ein familienfreundliches Laufevent in Hannover am 6. Dezember 2026. Es bietet Strecken über 2,5 km, 5 km und 10 km auf einer flachen, schnellen Strecke, ideal für Läufer aller Altersklassen und Erfahrungsstufen. Das Event findet auf der Bezirkssportanlage am Ossietzkyring statt und zeichnet sich durch eine angenehme, gemeinschaftliche Atmosphäre aus. Für Kinder und Jugendliche gibt es spezielle Läufe, bei denen alle Schüler eine Nikolaus-Überraschung erhalten, und die besten in den jeweiligen Altersklassen werden mit Urkunden und Ehrenpreisen belohnt. Das Rennen ist Teil der Lauf(s)pass-Serie der Region Hannover und lädt alle Laufbegeisterten ein, die festliche Jahreszeit sportlich zu feiern.
course_highlights: Flache, schnelle Strecke auf der Bezirkssportanlage
Familien- und kinderfreundliche Veranstaltung mit speziellen Läufen für Jugendliche
Teilnahme an der Lauf(s)pass-Serie der Region Hannover
additional: Online-Anmeldung möglich; Rennen in Mühlenberg, Hannover; Teilnahme für alle Altersgruppen; Ehrungen für Sieger und Altersklassen

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Lage is a traditional running event organized by the running division of TG Lage. The course runs through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park and features well-maintained forest trails, partly along the famous Hermann Trail. The run is suitable for runners of all ability levels and takes place annually in December. The event is part of TG Lage’s varied running and walking program, which also offers beginner courses and training opportunities.
course_highlights: Course through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park
Well-maintained, easy-to-run forest trails
Sections along the famous Hermann Trail
additional: TG Lage’s running division also offers a Nordic walking beginner course that covers the basics in 4 sessions of 60 minutes each. Walking poles are available to borrow. There is also a 10-session pass for time-limited training participation, valid for 6 months and 10 training sessions. The office is open on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Run on forest and field paths in the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park, on the 2nd Sunday of Advent; easy to reach, with a festive atmosphere in the gym.

name: Fischteiche Cross
description: The Fischteiche Cross is a traditional cross-country race in the Langenberger Forst near Leck, organised by SV Enge-Sande. It marks the end of the Cross-Cup series and offers races for different age groups and distances, from 0.8 km for the youngest children to 9.6 km for adults and seniors. The event features a varied woodland course and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments on site.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Langenberger Forst
Distances from 0.8 km to 9.6 km, depending on age group
Varied woodland course with typical December weather
additional: Starts are organised by age group and suitable distance; registration and results via myraceresult; coffee, cake and other refreshments available on site; awards ceremony after the race. Cross-country race in the Langenberger Forst, with distances for all age groups and registration via myraceresult. Weather-dependent, with possible winter conditions, and refreshments including coffee and cake.

name: Heeslinger Nikolauscross
description: The Heeslingen Nikolaus Cross-Country Run is a popular cross-country race held annually in Heeslingen, Lower Saxony. The event attracts athletes and families from the region and is known for its high-level sporting challenges. The races also determine the district champions of Rotenburg/W. The organizer, Heeslinger SC, is an established point of contact for sports enthusiasts and volunteers from the surrounding communities.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through varied terrain
Determination of the district champions of Rotenburg/W.
Event in the Heeslingen region with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Courses and participation conditions are available in the relevant event announcement; no entry fee is required. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children, young people, adults and masters.

name: Klausdorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Klausdorf St. Nicholas Run is a longstanding running event on the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord, taking place on December 6, 2026, in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district. This will be the 41st edition of the event, attracting runners from the region. The event offers a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere and is a sporting highlight for all age groups. Official registration is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays.

Traditional running event with a festive atmosphere
Event in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district

description: The Cologne St. Nicholas Run is a traditional fun run, taking place for the 29th time on December 6, 2026. The event offers three different races: the competitive 10 km TopRun, the FunRun with a variable distance of 3.4 km to 10 km for all running enthusiasts, and the KidsRun, a 3.4 km race for children. The races follow a course through the beautiful Cologne City Forest on a DLV-measured loop, creating a festive, athletic atmosphere for the whole family. The event is organized by the athletics team of the German Sport University Cologne and emphasizes community and the joy of running.

name: Melsunger Adventslauf Rund um die Koppe
description: The Melsungen Advent Run is a traditional running event held every year on the second Sunday of Advent in Melsungen. Various distances are offered: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km. The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course. The event attracts runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with special appreciation for children and recreational runners. It is organised by the running group of Melsunger Turngemeinde 1861 e.V. and is a fixture in the North Hesse popular running calendar.
course_highlights: Various distances: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course

With four different running distances and a Nordic walking and walking distance recognized as a performance distance for the German Sports Badge, the event offers a suitable challenge for every age and ability level. The routes pass through the stadium and the surrounding countryside, including challenging climbs in Limberger Forest. The event is a popular St. Nicholas Day tradition and promotes recreational sport in the region.

name: Saalfelder Winterlauf
description: The Winter Run Around the Katze in Saalfeld an der Saale is a traditional 15 km road race held in winter since 1982. The course starts at the Langenschader Straße sports field, loops around the local landmark “Katze,” passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm, and returns to the start. The race is officially measured and scored in DLV age groups, making it especially appealing to club runners of all ages. The event is small, usually attracting fewer than 100 participants, and offers straightforward organization with online registration, changing rooms, and showers on site.
course_highlights: Officially measured 15 km road-race course
Loop around the “Katze” landmark in Saalfeld
Course passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm

name: Festiwal Biegów Świętych Mikołajów – XXIV Półmaraton Świętych Mikołajów
description: The Festival of St. Nicholas Runs in Toruń is Poland’s largest St. Nicholas-themed running event, attracting more than 2,000 participants each year. The event takes place in a festive atmosphere on Toruń’s charming streets, offering a range of distances from a half marathon to a Nordic walking event. The start and finish of the main races are at the Old Town Market Square and the Municipal Stadium, respectively. Participants can expect a generous race package and numerous accompanying attractions.

The race package includes a long-sleeved technical shirt, a Santa hat, a sports bag, a race bib with a chip, energy bars, gifts from sponsors, a commemorative medal, and a hot recovery meal. Participants receive an SMS with their race bib number before the race. The Polish Santa Claus Half Marathon Team Championships are also held, with at least one woman required on each team. The race package includes, among other items, a long-sleeved technical shirt, a bag, and a Santa hat; at the finish, participants receive a medal, soup, and drinks. The event is accompanied by the “Santa Clauses for Children” charity campaign.

name: Nijverdalsebergcross

description: The Nijverdalsebergcross is a challenging cross-country race held at Manege 't Oale Spoor, right next to Sallandse Heuvelrug. The race is part of the Dutch Athletics Federation’s national Cross Country Series and offers various laps that are entirely off-road, ideal for runners who enjoy a demanding course. Race numbers can be collected from 8:30 a.m. The event attracts both recreational runners and licensed competitive athletes. The atmosphere is sporting, and the event is supported by many volunteers.

The Snertloop offers challenging and varied routes through the hilly, wooded Twente countryside, with distances for both competitive and recreational runners. Young runners can also take part in special youth races on safe courses. After the event, all participants receive a traditional bowl of snert at the atmospheric event grounds.

description: Advent Run in Tønsbergmarka is an inclusive and enjoyable event held to spread joy during the run-up to Christmas and support the Church City Mission’s project “Brighten Christmas for Someone Who Dreads It.” The event is suitable for everyone, regardless of age or pace, and focuses on community and activity rather than competition. Participants can run, jog, or walk at their own pace on a course of approximately 2.8 km, which can be completed once or twice. After the run, hot drinks and something tasty to eat will be served, and 25% of the proceeds will go to a good cause.

After the race, hot drinks and a little something to eat will be served, and prizes will be drawn among the participants instead of awarding medals.

name: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night
description: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night is a unique trail-running competition taking place in Dalby on December 12. The race features a 1 km light trail course with a substantial hill at the start. Participants run as many laps as they can within time limits that gradually decrease. It is a challenge combining speed and running strategy in dark, cold conditions, with the possibility of running up to 20 km. Water, cola and some food are available at the lap area, and prizes are awarded to many participants. The competition is open to all levels and ambitions, with a focus on enjoying the forest.

name: Bunkersen jule-3km
description: Bunkersen Christmas 3 km is a race held at Bislett Stadium in Oslo on Saturday, December 12, 2026. This event offers a fast and atmospheric 3-kilometer distance in mid-December, perfect for runners looking for a challenge in the winter darkness. The event is open to everyone and provides a great opportunity to test your fitness before Christmas at a classic running venue.
course_highlights: 3 km distance at Bislett Stadium
Fast and atmospheric winter course
Central location in Oslo
additional: Tickets are sold via EQ Timing through the Aett platform. The event runs from December 12 to 13, 2026. The start time is early Saturday morning at 01:00.

name: Andersens Adventløp
description: Andersens Adventløp is a traditional pre-Christmas race in Bergen, offering a scenic loop starting and finishing by the Fløibanen station on Fjellveien. The race follows Fjellveien, climbs Ole Irgens vei, descends Skansemyrsveien and returns to Mulesvingen. It is known for its great atmosphere and challenging course, which has given runners the chance to set course records in previous editions. The event brings together a great group of runners and makes for a refreshing, invigorating pre-Christmas experience.
course_highlights: Loop via Fjellveien, Ole Irgens vei and Skansemyrsveien
Start and finish by the Fløibanen station on Fjellveien
Varied terrain with flat sections and hills
additional: The race has previously faced challenging weather conditions, including hail showers. Results from previous years are available via links on the website. Contributions from organizers Arvid Berge and Rolf Hansen have been highlighted for their thoroughness and experience. The race has been held for several years. Previous reviews describe firm footing and a course marshal by the Fløibanen station.

name: Adventscrosslauf
description: The Wilscher Advent Cross-Country Run Gifhorn is a traditional cross-country race held during Advent in Gifhorn, Lower Saxony. The main distance is 7.5 km and runs through the winter landscape of the Wilsche district. The race starts at 14:00 at the meeting point at An der Masch 4. The event is organised by VfR Wilsche/Neubokel, and the entry fee is 7 euros.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the winter landscape of Gifhorn-Wilsche
Main distance: 7.5 km
Start and meeting point at An der Masch 4
additional: The meeting point and start are at An der Masch 4 in the Wilsche district of Gifhorn. Typical December weather includes temperatures around 3 °C and snow cover on most days. The race starts at 14:00, with the meeting point at An der Masch 4 in Gifhorn. Registration is via the club website. The event is a lovely opportunity to enjoy the Advent season in an active and sociable way.

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 2. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a traditional running event organised by TSG Alten-Buseck. It includes several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and the half marathon (21.1 km). The races take place during the colder months and offer a great opportunity to enjoy the winter landscape around Alten-Buseck together with other runners. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, with special races for children and young people. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy refreshments, followed by an awards ceremony for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km
Start and finish at Harbig Halle in Alten-Buseck
Winter running routes; the course may be changed because of construction work
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, with awards for the three fastest participants of the day (men/women) and age-group winners. Certificates, results and photos are available online. After crossing the finish line, participants receive a free refreshing drink; coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Harbig Halle. Parking at Harbig Halle is limited. The Bambini run starts at approximately 14:15 (December only). Distance options: 700 m and 15 km; the event is expected to take place in winter conditions; start location: Alten-Buseck, Buseck.

name: Ellewicker Adventslauf
price_range: 4 Euro für Kinder- und Schülerlauf, Nachmeldegebühr 2 Euro
description: The Ellewick Advent Run is a traditional running event in Vreden-Ellewick, held annually in December. It offers a 1.5 km children’s and students’ race and a 5 km race, both run over two laps. The event is family-friendly and supported by a dedicated organizing team. It gives runners of all ages the opportunity to get active and enjoy the Advent season together.
course_highlights: 1.5 km children’s/students’ race over 2 laps
5 km race over 2 laps
Route through the built-up area of Ellewick
additional: Photos and videos are taken during the event and used for press coverage and social media. Participant data is used to evaluate the race and can be deleted on request.

name: Jahresendlauf
location: Bad Berka, Weimarer Land, Thuringia, Germany
price_range: bis 16 Jahren: 4,00 EUR, ab 17 Jahren: 8,00 EUR, zusätzliche Servicegebühr bei Anmeldung am Tag vor Ort

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: bis 16 Jahren: 4,00 Euro bei Vor-Anmeldung im Portal

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: ab 17 Jahren: 8,00 EUR bei Vor-Anmeldung im Portal

description: The year-end run in Bad Berka is a traditional running event held every December. The routes pass through the scenic Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas on paved, gravel and forest roads. The event offers various distances, including a free 400 m mini-run for children and longer distances for young people and adults. It is open to all running enthusiasts and is organized by the sports club Spielvereinigung Bad Berka e.V.
course_highlights: Routes through the Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas
Paved, gravel and forest roads
Start and finish at Ilmtalstadion Bad Berka
additional: The 400 m mini-run is free. On-site registration is available on race day, with an additional service fee (€1.00 up to age 16, €2.00 from age 17) and cash payment only. Changing rooms and showers are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße (approx. 500 m walk). The race office opens at 9:00 a.m. The routes have a rolling profile. Online registration is available. Showers and changing rooms are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße.

name: 6 Wigilijny Bieg Charytatywny
price_range: 45–90 zł, zależnie od konkurencji i terminu zapisów
description: The 6th Christmas Eve Charity Run is a cross-country race on a forest course in Lasek Majoński in Luboń, taking place on December 12, 2026. Participants can choose between a 5 km run and a Nordic Walking event on the same course. The event is charitable and supports the Dobro się niesie Foundation, which helps people experiencing homelessness. Shorter distances are available for children, with separate categories for girls and boys. The organizers provide a race pack, a commemorative wooden medal, a meal, and gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: 5 km run and Nordic Walking on a 100% forest trail course
Babki Forest District grounds — Lasek Majoński in Luboń
Cross-country race with a 50-minute time limit
additional: The race office opens at 9:45 near the cemetery in Luboń, ul. Armii Poznań 51B. The race pack includes a race bib, a wooden medal, a meal (sweet yeast bun and tea), and gifts from sponsors. Timing is provided by reusable chips attached to shoes. Age categories and OPEN, Luboń residents, ZSM Poznań, and four-person team classifications are available. The limit for children's races is 100 participants. An additional race-pack pickup is available on December 10, 2026, in the afternoon (location to be announced by the organizer). The 5 km run and Nordic Walking start at 12:30. The time limit is 50 minutes, and the combined participant limit for these events is 200. The entry fee includes a charitable contribution of 10 or 20 zł.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Sątopy, Nowy Tomyśl County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of races organized by the Nowy Tomyśl Chyży Running Club, held off-road in autumn and winter. The event has a social and sporting character and is intended for both experienced and beginner runners. The minimum distance is 10.5 km, while the full marathon distance is 42.2 km, which can be completed by running multiple 10.5 km loops. The event takes place in Sątopy and aims to help participants stay active outdoors during the challenging autumn and winter months.
course_highlights: Off-road course with a 10.5 km loop
Option to complete a full marathon or multiple loops
Races take place in autumn and winter conditions
additional: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of races held one weekend per month from October to March, each in a different town. The race office opens at 09:00, and the first race starts at 10:00. The time limit for the first race is 16:00. The second race starts at 09:00 the following day, with a time limit of 15:00. The event is co-funded by Nowy Tomyśl County and is held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. Information for the 2026/2027 edition gives the date as December 12, 2026; the December 13 date provided by the user may refer to another event day or to the weekend.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: The Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Bydgoszcz. The race is recreational and competitive, aimed at people aged 16 and over, and promotes outdoor physical activity. The course runs through the forested areas of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District, offering beautiful natural surroundings. Races take place regularly, giving participants the opportunity to test themselves on the same course throughout the season.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the forests of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
A cross-country route through forests and urban parks
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:45 before the race. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; participants are advised to use parking areas approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The event schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Register via the participant portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day.

description: On Saturday, December 13, 2025, the 44th edition of the OVM-DEOloop will take place, a true cross-country race with a challenging and largely unpaved

name: Mas Montagne Trail
description: The Mas Montagne Trail running event offers a unique experience around Amerongse Berg, with challenging loops passing the Eenzame Eik, single t

name: Ameland Adventurerun
description: The Ameland Adventurerun is an adventurous running event held in December on the Wadden Sea island of Ameland. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, as well as special children’s distances of 1 and 2 kilometres. The event combines a sporting challenge with the island’s unique natural surroundings and winter elements. It is a welcoming event with a finish party and a warm reception for runners and supporters.
course_highlights: Run between the Wadden Sea and the North Sea amid unspoilt nature
Distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, plus children’s distances
Winter elements and a lively finish party with Christmas tunes
additional: After the finish, participants in the 5, 10 and 21.1 km races receive a medal and a special Ameland Adventurerun bandana. The race office is at Sporthal Nes, where participants can collect their race pack. The organisers promote sustainability by minimising the use of cups at aid stations and offering ECO cups. Participants must book their own ferry crossing through Wagenborg Passenger Services. First aid is provided by professionals. A shirt for the Kidsrun is available through Eilandverhuur Ameland. Distances: 5, 10 and 21 km, plus children’s distances; registration opens on 1 April; winter conditions are possible; location: Nes, Ameland.

name: Spaarnwoude Park Ultra
location: Speelvijver Peddelpoel, Velsen, North Holland, Netherlands
description: Spaarnwoude Park Ultra is a unique running event in Velsen-Zuid where participants run laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve. Each lap must be completed within 30 minutes to continue to the next lap. Participants can choose on the day which distance they run. The event takes place at the Peddelpoel recreational lake and is limited to 150 participants. It is organised by volunteers from Loopmeesters and RunX Haarlem. The start and rest area has facilities including toilets and picnic tables. After the event, all runners receive hot chocolate as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve
30-minute time limit per lap
Start and finish at the Peddelpoel recreational lake, with facilities
additional: A maximum of 150 participants per edition. Participants bring their own food and drinks. There are transition cups for the fastest runners in the final lap, one per distance. The start and rest area has space for tents, chairs and support crews. All participants receive a keepsake and hot chocolate before they leave. Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km, a 30-minute time limit per lap, participants bring their own food and drinks, keepsake and hot chocolate after the event.

name: Bootsgym RUN TEGEN KANKER
description: Bootsgym RUN TEGEN KANKER is a running race taking place in Tuitjenhorn on 12 December 2026. The race is listed on Inschrijven.nl, where participants can register and find more details. The event is presented on the WeTri platform, which supports a wide range of triathlon and running events in the Netherlands. The race invites runners to take on a sporting challenge while also raising awareness of cancer.
course_highlights: Supporting cancer research
Location in Tuitjenhorn
Registration via Inschrijven.nl
additional: The event focuses on charity and running, with an emphasis on supporting cancer research. No specific distance or course information is available.

name: KNRM West Coast Challenge
location: Hoek van Holland, Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands

price_tiers.distance: Duo - hele of halve challenge (halve prijs + sponsoractie)

description: The KNRM West Coast Challenge is a unique one-day endurance event in which teams of two take turns running and cycling over 130 kilometres from Hoek van Holland to Den Helder, almost entirely along the beach. There is also a 62-kilometre Half Challenge for pairs and solo entrants; solo entrants may be accompanied by a cyclist. The event raises funds for the KNRM, with all proceeds going towards its rescue work. The Full Challenge starts on 12 December 2026 at 04:30 and the Half Challenge at 11:00. The atmosphere is friendly, and participants are encouraged to strengthen their connection with the KNRM.
course_highlights: 130 kilometres, almost entirely along the beach, passing twelve KNRM coastal stations
The course is unmarked, so participants find their own way
The crossing at IJmuiden on KNRM lifeboats and the changing tides are important
additional: Participants must find their own route because the course is unmarked. Front and rear bicycle lights are mandatory in the dark (04:30–08:00 and from 17:00). If beach conditions are poor, the cyclist may ride through the dunes. There is a reserve date of 16 January 2027 in case of bad weather. The Half Challenge starts at 11:00 at restaurant Sea You in Velsen-Noord. Teams can choose to pay the full fee or pay half price by organising a fundraising campaign through samenvoorknrm.nl. Registration is confirmed after payment or after reaching the fundraising target. The event follows a run-bike-run format and has a strong focus on fundraising for the KNRM. Details about registration and participation fees are not specified.

name: Rotary Santa Run Bussum
description: The Rotary Santa Run in Bussum takes place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, and is a fun running event for the whole family, teams, friends, and neighbors. The event starts at 15:30 and combines sport with fun and support for a good cause, Stichting Hulphond. After the run, there is an awards ceremony and a get-together in Kapelstraat. The Santa Run is a festive event that brings people together in the center of Bussum.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the center of Bussum
Festive atmosphere with a warm-up and medal ceremony
Drinks in Kapelstraat after the event
additional: Schedule: 15:00 gathering, 15:15 warm-up, 15:30 run starts, 16:00–16:45 medal ceremony, 16:15–17:00 drinks for runners in Kapelstraat. On the day, organizers can be reached through identifiable Rotary members wearing yellow vests. The event includes fun runs for families, classmates, teams, friends, and neighborhoods; several Rotary Clubs in the Netherlands organize similar events; in 2026, participation will expand to include extensive nationwide involvement.

name: De Uithof-cross
location: Sportcentrum De Uithof, The Hague, Netherlands

name: Juleløbet Skamling - Et anderledes Juleeventyr
description: Afviklet siden 2012 i historiske og kuperede omgivelser på og omkring Skamlingsbanken, med ruter for hele familien. Lige fra familieruten ti

name: AURA Nytårsløbene 2026
location: Banken FoodHall, Kannikegade 4, Aarhus C, Aarhus, Danmark
description: AURA Nytårsløbene 2026 byder på en smuk løbetur i de gyldne efterårsfarver i Aarhus. Deltagerne kan vælge mellem 5 km og 10 km distancer, som løbes på en afspærret rute i Marselisborg Skovene. Løbet er velegnet til både hurtige tider og hyggelige oplevelser med familie, kolleger og venner. Efter løbet modtages deltagerne med kakao og godt humør ved målområdet.
course_highlights: Løb i Marselisborg Skovene med smukke efterårsfarver
Afspærret rute for sikkerhed og gode løbebetingelser
Mulighed for at løbe 5 km eller 10 km (én eller to omgange på samme rute)
additional: Start og mål ved Aarhus Atletik- og Løbeakademi, Havreballe Skovvej 11, Aarhus C. Efter løbet serveres kakao til deltagerne. Start og mål er ved Banken FoodHall, Kannikegade 4, Aarhus C. Der er ingen tidtagning. Børn under 4 år deltager gratis, og grupper på mindst 10 deltagere får 15 % rabat ved samlet tilmelding.

name: Sørlandstesten
description: Sørlandstesten is an accessible fun run for anyone looking for a positive running experience, whatever their ambitions. Whether you’re training for a bigger goal, want to experience the thrill of competition, or simply want a social and active day, this is the race for you! There’s room for both beginners and experienced runners, and the most important thing is that you show up in good spirits and ready to run. We cheer just as loudly for the first person across the finish line as we do for someone completing their very first race.

name: Adventslauf
price_range: 10,00 € bis 16,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Advent Run in Hamm is a traditional winter race on officially measured out-and-back courses through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the Kurpark in Bad Hamm. The start and finish are on the tartan track at Jahnstadion, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with chip-based net and gun timekeeping. Alongside the sporting challenge, charity is also a key focus, with a donation collected for the support association of the hospice in Hamm.
course_highlights: Officially measured out-and-back courses
Lippeaue nature conservation area
Kurpark in Bad Hamm
additional: Young people and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). An additional €3.00 deposit is charged for the race bib (refunded when returned), along with a €1.00 donation for the support association of the hospice in Hamm. Timing is provided using Race Result systems via a chip in the race bib. The timing is eligible for best-list results and is forwarded to the DLV federation. Headphones, dogs and jogging strollers are prohibited during the race. The awards ceremony takes place approximately 45 minutes after the first runner finishes. Discounted admission is available at the neighboring Maximare adventure swimming pool. Courses are timed using Race Result; race bibs contain a chip; the awards ceremony is approximately 45 minutes after the finish; admission to Maximare is available.

name: Flensburger Adventslauf
description: Der Flensburger Adventslauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die jährlich im Dezember in Flensburg stattfindet. Der Lauf wird vom 1. Flensburger Lauftreff organisiert, einem Verein mit ausgezeichneter Anerkennung durch den Deutschen Leichtathletikverband. Die Veranstaltung fördert Gemeinschaft und Laufbegeisterung in der Region und bietet Läufern aller Leistungsstufen eine attraktive Gelegenheit, sich sportlich zu betätigen. Die Strecke führt durch die winterliche Stadt und bietet eine festliche Atmosphäre kurz vor Weihnachten.
course_highlights: Verschiedene Laufdistanzen (1,8 km bis 14 km)
Hügeliges Streckenprofil
Geeignet für alle Altersgruppen und Nordic-Walking
additional: Laufveranstaltung im Dezember mit winterlichem Wetter, Streckenverlauf und Altersklassen, Chip-Zeitnahme, Sicherheitsregeln, keine Rückerstattung bei Nichtteilnahme

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series associated with the traditional Rund um Wellen. The event is organized by the local running community, which also organizes the Wellen Marathon, and offers a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere away from large city events. The course includes several distances and runs through the rural surroundings, supported by local volunteers, sponsors, and the fire brigade. The series preserves its traditional character and offers runners a challenging, authentic winter running experience.
course_highlights: Rural course with a traditional character
Event with a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere
Support from local volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather conditions: around 7 °C, mostly rainy; start location: Beverstedt-Wellen; the event is part of a series with several distances (3 km and 11 km). Distances: 3 km, 11 km; traditional, community-oriented; December weather is usually cool and rainy.

name: Sparkassen Advents-Cross der LG Nordheide
location: Jahnplatz, Schützengehölz, Winsen (Luhe), Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: U10-U16 2,50 Euro, U18-U20 3,00 Euro, Erwachsene 5,00 Euro
description: The Sparkassen Advent Cross-Country Run hosted by LG Nordheide takes place on December 13, 2026, in Winsen (Luhe), at Schützengehölz by Jahnplatz. The event is open to participants from across the state and offers races for all age groups from U10 to seniors, including age groups up to M/W 95. The races cover various distances of approximately 1,400 meters to 9 kilometers. Team rankings are held separately for male and female participants. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available, as well as signposted parking nearby.
course_highlights: Various distances from approx. 1,400 m to 9 km
Races from U10 through senior age groups, including M/W 95
Venue in Schützengehölz, with a signposted walking route
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a 50% surcharge. Entries submitted by email incur a surcharge of EUR 1.00 per start. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available. Parking is available behind the Stadthalle and at the Stadthalle car park; the venue is about a 300-meter walk through Schützengehölz along a signposted route. Registration constitutes consent to the publication of the participant’s name, year of birth, club, and photo and video material in results lists and the media. Distances range from approximately 1,400 m to longer distances; registration is open until December 6, 2026. Late entries are possible for an additional fee. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available; parking is behind the Stadthalle.

name: Int. Weihnachts-Crosslauf
description: The Int. Christmas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country race held shortly before Christmas at Ravensberger Stadium in Borgholzhausen. The event is organized by LCS Olbä and offers several distances, including 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a 7.5 km walking/Nordic walking course. The 16 km course consists of two laps over partly hilly terrain around Borgholzhausen and a loop around Barenberg, which is run twice. It is a true cross-country challenge with climbs and descents. The start and finish sections are on paved paths, where spikes are not allowed. The race attracts a diverse field, from top runners to recreational and older runners, as well as walkers.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: ul. Spokojna, Mały Kack, Gdynia, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity area in the Gdańsk Forest District and around Mały Kack in Gdynia. The races take place in natural settings among forests and urban parks, promoting outdoor physical activity. The series consists of four races in each location, and participants can compete in both local and overall rankings. The races are open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part with a guardian’s consent. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and urban parks
The Tricity location includes the Gdańsk Forest District and the area around Mały Kack in Gdynia
The race takes place in a natural setting and promotes outdoor activity
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race numbers and timing chips are collected on race day. The schedule is the same at all locations. Participants can buy a pass for the entire series or enter individual races. The entry fee is higher on race day. There is no participant limit. Participants under 16 may take part with a guardian’s consent. Pass holders can race for free in another city by registering in advance. Online registration is available through the Participant Portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. A pass for four races at one location is available.
