name: Bieg Noworoczny
organizer: Fundacja Duet – Rozwój z Pasją; Stowarzyszenie Wroniecki Klub Biegacza
description: The New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Wronki Runners Club, held on scenic routes in the Wronki municipality. Participants can choose distances of approximately 5 km or 10 km for runners, or approximately 5 km for walkers. The start and finish are on Rzecińska Street in Wronki, and times are recorded using a chip timing system. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle and brings together local residents and running enthusiasts in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5.5 km for runners and Nordic walking participants
Scenic forests and landscapes of the Wronki municipality
Start and finish on Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: The race office is open on race day from 9:45 to 10:45 by the start line on Rzecińska Street. Chip timing is provided by PLUS TIMING. Participants under 18 must submit written consent from a parent or guardian. The organizer does not allow participants under 15 to take part. Hot tea and coffee will be available in the catering area after the race. The winners’ awards ceremony will take place at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. The start is at 11:00. Participation is open from age 15; minors need written consent from a parent or guardian. Paying the entry fee on race day does not guarantee a medal.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

name: Meerhorstloop
description: The Meerhorstloop takes place on 5 January 2025 in Stompwijk, municipality of Leidschendam-Voorburg. This running event, which is holding its 39th edition

name: Genneper Parkenloop
description: The Genneper Parken Loop traditionally takes place on the first Sunday of the new year and is all about health and g

name: De Nieuwjaarsloop
location: Leiden Atletiek, Leiden, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Nieuwjaarsloop in Leiden is an accessible running race and a sporty way to start the new year. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with the start and finish on the athletics track. The race is organised by Leiden Atletiek in collaboration with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. The race focuses above all on the enjoyment of taking part, with prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the athletics track
Choose from 5, 10 or 15 kilometres
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The Nieuwjaarsloop is organised by Leiden Atletiek together with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. The race is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners. You can register using the registration form on the race page. The race is traditionally held on 3 January, with registration available on the day. The event is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and is supported by local sports clubs.

name: Douwe Kleefstra
description: The Douwe Kleefstraloop is a recreational running event starting from the Lionitas athletics track in Leeuwarden. It offers several distances: a 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 English miles), with the routes measured exactly. The 10 km route runs through Goutum and Zuidlanden, while the 16 km route follows the same course with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel under the railway and a section of the Elfstedentocht route. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. The Douwe Kleefstra and Sietske Rijpstra trophies are awarded to the fastest man and woman, respectively, in the 10 English miles.
course_highlights: Starts from the Lionitas athletics track
10 km route through Goutum and Zuidlanden
16.1 km route with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel and the Elfstedentocht route
additional: Electronic chip timing using a chip in the race bib. Participation is entirely at your own risk and responsibility. A discounted combination entry is available for the Douwe Kleefstraloop, Leeuwarden-Marsum-Leeuward and Rondje Goutum, including a special Gouden Leeuw race bib and a prize draw. The distance selected when registering in advance for the Douwe Kleefstraloop determines the distance for the other races in the combination. Distances range from 1 km to 16.1 km; advance registration is required; special combination and youth prices; starts at the Nijlân athletics track.

name: Oliebollen omloop
location: Sportpark Pelzer, Boxmeer, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Olympia's Oliebollen Omloop is an annual running event held on the first Sunday of the new year at Sportpark Pelzer in Boxmeer. The race is intended for members, interested participants, and entrants in the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. With several distances to choose from, it’s a great opportunity to end the Christmas holidays actively, start the new year in a sporty way, and enjoy team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. The route runs through the sports park and the adjacent Brestbos. There are prizes for the winners—and, of course, eternal glory.
course_highlights: Run through Sportpark Pelzer
Route through the adjacent Brestbos
Several distances available
additional: The run is part of the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. Prizes are awarded to the winners, and the event promotes team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. Running race over several distances, through the sports park and Brestbos, with prizes for the winners.

description: The Snertloop is a friendly running race organized by TAV80, held in 't Veld with the start and finish at JT Bloembollen on Koggeweg. The race takes place on public roads and offers several distances: 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus a 16 km walking route. After finishing, participants receive a bucket of snert, a traditional treat. Prizes are awarded to the top runners in each distance and age category, and race bib numbers also serve as lottery numbers. Registration is online only and closes a few days before the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at JT Bloembollen on Koggeweg in ’t Veld
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus 16 km walking
Coffee stop for walkers at the Cultuurhuis in Lutjewinkel
additional: Race bibs can be collected on the Saturday evening before the race or on race day. Timing is done using a MyLaps chip in the race bib; personal chips are not allowed. Volunteer traffic controllers will accompany the race. Participation is at your own risk, and traffic rules must be followed. Walkers can stop for coffee at the Cultuurhuis in Lutjewinkel. The race takes place on public roads near Sportcomplex de Kogge, with the course and registration online, and starts and finishes at JT Bloembollen.

name: Mijl van de Weere
location: De Weere, Opmeer, North Holland, Netherlands

name: Midwintercross Heeten
location: Sportpark SV Heeten, Heeten, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Midwintercross in Heeten is a regional cross-country race that is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit and is organised by SV Heeten. The 54th edition takes place on Sunday, 3 January 2027, at Sportpark SV Heeten. The course runs through the sports park and the woods around Schoonheten, with approximately 70 per cent unpaved terrain and gentle elevation changes. The routes offer green landscapes and wooded sections, and the prize winners are honoured in an annual ceremony after the race. The Midwintercross has a long history and has become a regular cross-country race in the region.
course_highlights: Course through the sports park and woods around Schoonheten
Approximately 70% unpaved terrain with gentle elevation changes
Green landscapes and wooded sections along the route
additional: The Midwintercross offers several distances. The 6 km and 10 km routes were revised in 2024. There is an annual prize-giving ceremony after the race. After the race, there is a prize-giving ceremony and a friendly atmosphere, with registration open to participants.

name: Bjørgene Løpskarusell 4. Løp
description: The athletics group welcomes you to a new running series in Bjørgene on February 4! The snow is gone and the trails in Bjørgene are in good condition. We hope to see you at the starting line!

Løpere på podiet med pokaler.

name: Vinterkarusellen 5. løp
description: The 5th race of Vinterkarusellen was held at Fana Stadium, where the venue was crowded and 515 runners finished the 5 km, while 247 finished the 10 km. Participation increased considerably after the previous winter race, and conditions were good despite brisk winds in some places. Markus Galleberg and Eli Anne Dvergsdal were the fastest in the 5 km, while Andre Lenningsvik and Renate Galleberg won the 10 km. This race is part of Ålesund Vinterkarusell, which consists of 5 races suited to both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Grand Prix Trójmiasta 1/3
location: Brzeźno Pier (Molo w Gdańsku-Brzeźnie), Gdańsk, Poland
description: The 3 Kings Run is the first event in the 2027 Grand Prix of the Tri-City series, held on a 100% sandy beach course in Gdańsk-Brzeźno. The event includes a 6 km cross-country run and 6 km Nordic walking, with age categories and three-person team competitions requiring at least one woman. The event is small-scale, with a participant limit of 500, offering an intimate atmosphere and sporting competition on the scenic coast. The run starts at 9:00, and the winners’ awards ceremony will take place at around 11:30.
course_highlights: 100% beach course
6 km cross-country run
6 km Nordic walking
additional: The event office opens at 07:30. Three-person teams (for both the run and Nordic walking), with at least one woman, must register at the event office. Participant limit: 500. Participants can choose the 6 km cross-country run or Nordic walking. Three-person team competition is also available, with at least one woman on each team.

name: Esbjerg Night Trail 2026/2027
description: Esbjerg Night Trail er en serie af natløb arrangeret af Orienteringsklubben Esbjerg i samarbejde med lokale partnere. Løbene foregår i skovområder omkring Esbjerg og Fanø, hvor deltagerne løber med pandelampe i efterårs- og vintersæsonen. Serien består af otte løb, hvor man kan vælge mellem ca. 5 km eller 10 km, fordelt på en eller to omgange. Løbet byder på udfordrende trailterræn med mulighed for mudder og vådt underlag, og der er fokus på godt samvær og løbeoplevelser i mørket. Efter løbet er der forfriskninger og mulighed for at vinde sponsorgaver.
course_highlights: Løb i mørke skove med pandelampe
Trailterræn med mudder og vådt underlag
Løb på ca. 5 km eller 10 km ruter i skovområder omkring Esbjerg og Fanø
additional: Løbene afholdes typisk kl. 19.00 med startsteder annonceret på Facebook kort før løbet. Deltagere under 15 år skal følges med en voksen. Efter løbet serveres der lidt at drikke, evt. varmt, og der er mulighed for at vinde sponsorgaver fra Eventyrsport. Serien består af 8 løb fordelt over efterår og vinter, med startsteder i Esbjerg, Fanø og skovområder nær Varde/Ribe. Pandelampe er nødvendig, og trailsko, der kan tåle mudder, anbefales. Løbere under 15 år skal følges med en voksen. Tilmelding foregår via Sportstiming.

name: Sylvesterloppet Göteborg
description: The Sylvester Race in Gothenburg is a spectator-friendly 10 km race held on New Year’s Eve, starting and finishing at Heden. The course is flat and runs over two laps through central Gothenburg, including Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda and around the Swedish Exhibition & Congress Centre. The race is suitable for all runners who want to end the year with a fast and festive running experience. All participants who finish the race receive a medal and have the chance to win prizes in a draw.
course_highlights: Flat, two-lap 10 km course through central Gothenburg
Passes Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda and the Swedish Exhibition & Congress Centre
Spectator-friendly, festive atmosphere, with cheering firefighters at Gårda fire station
additional: Starting groups are assigned according to expected finish time: elite, starting group 1 and starting group 2. The warm-up begins 15 minutes before the start. Race bibs can be collected on 29–30 December and on race day from 09:00 to 11:30 at Excersishuset at Heden. Electronic chip timing using the chip on the race bib is used, and net times are shown in the results list. The race starts at 12:00 on 31 December. Registration via MittLopp is open until one hour before the start, unless the race is full.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 3. løp
description: Samnanger Winter Race Series is a social and inclusive running series organised by Samnanger IL Athletics. The races take place at Nesodden, with the start and finish in the same place, and participants can choose between 2 km and 5 km distances. The Winter Race Series is suitable for all levels, whether you want to compete, set a new personal best, stay in shape or simply enjoy a pleasant run with others. The races are held approximately every other Friday throughout the winter, and runners are encouraged to wear reflective gear because of the darkness.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Nesodden
Choice of 2 km and 5 km distances
The 5 km course is officially measured by the Norwegian Athletics Federation (NFIF)
additional: The running group is informal, free and open to all levels. Wearing a reflective vest is recommended because of the darkness. Samnanger IL Running Group also offers group training every Monday at 18:10 at Hagabotnane. The event calendar lists the start time as 18:30. The Winter Race Series is free; remember your reflective vest.

name: SOUL TRAIL CUP 2027 - Tilmeld ALLE 5 afdelinger

name: 17 Chrustowski Bieg Zimowy
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. Bronisława Malinowskiego, Chrustowo, Gmina Oborniki, Poland
description: The Chrustowo Winter Run is the oldest running event in the Oborniki municipality, held since 2007. The 12 km main race passes through the picturesque villages of Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka and Ślepuchowo, while accompanying races for primary school pupils take place on courses suited to their age. The event promotes physical activity and brings the local community together. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. Prizes are also awarded to the top finishers in the OPEN and age categories.
course_highlights: The 12 km main race passes through Chrustowo, Żukowo, Górka and Ślepuchowo
Accompanying races for children and young people on courses suited to their age categories
Picturesque surroundings and a wintry atmosphere make for an active start to the year
additional: The main race is limited to 200 participants. The race package includes a commemorative medal, a recovery meal, a doughnut and water. The top finishers receive statuettes or trophies. The children’s accompanying races start at 11:05, immediately after the main race begins. In the 2026 edition, the main race was scheduled to start at the Bronisław Malinowski Primary School in Chrustowo; the limit was 200 participants. This information refers to the previous edition.

name: Run in Sopot - 1 etap
location: Sopot Beach, Entrance No. 23 by Sopot Pier, Sopot, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie
description: Run in Sopot is a series of running events held on Sopot’s beach and around the Forest Opera. The first stage is a unique opportunity to test yourself on sandy coastal terrain. The race is open to runners of different ages and ability levels, and participants also compete in the overall standings for cash prizes. This sporting event combines physical activity with the beauty of Sopot’s coastline, creating a welcoming atmosphere for families and running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Beach run at entrance no. 23 by the Sopot Pier
Coastal route with views of the Baltic Sea
Sandy terrain and seaside atmosphere
additional: The #RUNinSOPOT 2026 series includes three beach-running events and an additional round around the Forest Opera. Participants can use the Sopot Card, which reduces the entry fee. The event is open to all and family-friendly, with cash prizes in the overall standings. The limit was 250 participants. Sopot Card holders paid 40 zł, the standard fee was 49 zł, and participants aged 65+ were exempt from the fee. A medal, hot drinks, and a hot meal were provided at the finish.

name: WOŚPowa 5
description: WOŚPowa 5 is a 5 km race held in the picturesque town of Dąbki during the Grand Finale of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The start and finish are located at the Water Sports Centre. The event combines sporting competition with a worthy cause, encouraging participants to support WOŚP with voluntary donations. Shorter races of 200, 400 and 800 metres are also planned for children, making the event appealing to the whole family. Join us to celebrate sport and helping others together.
course_highlights: The main 5 km race starts and finishes at the Water Sports Centre
Children’s races over 200 m, 400 m and 800 m
A scenic route in the spa town of Dąbki
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary donation to the WOŚP collection box. The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale, combining sport with charitable support. The start and finish are located at the Water Sports Centre in Dąbki. Donations collected at the previous edition were given to the 33rd WOŚP Grand Finale.

name: 3 Meren Gieten Cross
description: The 3 Meren Gieten Cross is a cross-country race taking place on Saturday, 16 January 2027, in Gieten, near Eext. The race is part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos. The course follows unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos, including forest trails, sandy paths and steep hills. There are 5 km and 9 km distances, suitable for different age categories, with chip-free timing. The race is limited to 300 participants, and no showers or changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos
Forest trails, sandy paths and steep hills
Part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit
additional: Maximum of 300 participants per race. Juniors run approximately 5 km; seniors and masters run 9 km. Results and photos are published after the race. The course follows unpaved paths. No showers or changing rooms are available. Maximum of 300 participants.

description: The Stadtmüller-Udikloop is a forest race in Klijndijk, organised from the Udik village hall. The event offers two distances, 10 km and 4 English miles, and runs mostly along forest trails and quiet roads. The route passes several hunebeds, making for a unique and atmospheric running experience. A cash prize is offered for breaking the course record, providing an extra challenge for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes several hunebeds
Mostly along forest trails and quiet roads
A forest race in the Klijndijk area
additional: There is a €100 cash prize for breaking the course record. The official 10 km course records are 30.59 for men and 35.43 for women. The event lasts approximately 2 hours and 30 minutes. The route passes hunebeds and includes forest and road sections. Registration is available in advance and on the day. Prizes are offered for breaking the course record.

name: Zuurbergcross
description: The Zuurbergcross is a challenging cross-country race organised by Athletics Club Holten and part of the SNS CrossCircuit of the East. The start and finish are at the MAC Stuurhuus, Beusebergerweg 37 in Holten. The course is varied, with a few sections on paved roads and a short stretch of brick paving, which can be avoided by running along the verge. There is ample parking, first aid on site, and a speaker to create atmosphere during the event.
course_highlights: Course with a few sections on paved roads
Approximately 500 metres of brick paving, which can be avoided by running along the verge
Start and finish at the MAC Stuurhuus, Beusebergerweg 37
additional: Participation is entirely at your own risk. The course is suitable for spikes and includes a few sections on paved roads and brick paving, which can be avoided. The race takes place in Beuseberg, Holten, and offers practical facilities including registration at the MAC Stuurhuus, parking, first aid and sound equipment.

name: Sørlandstesten 5
description: Sørlandstesten is an accessible fun run for everyone looking for a positive running experience, whatever their level of ambition. Whether you’re training for a bigger goal, want to experience the excitement of competition, or simply want a social and active day, this is the race for you! There’s room for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are on the opposite side of the road from Gumpens Auto, along Setesdalsveien in Kristiansand. Participants follow a flat, fast route up Setesdalsveien to Strai, then turn around and run back.

name: Gneist 3000 Indoor
description: Gneist 3000 Indoor is an indoor 3 km road race held at Gneist Arena in Bergen. The race consists of 15 laps on a soft, high-quality blue athletics track, and participants may wear running shoes or spikes with blunt tips no longer than 6 mm. The event emphasizes evenly matched heats based on estimated finish times to ensure good competition, with pacers in several heats. A separate 400-meter race for children aged 6–12 is also held alongside the main race. Race numbers must be collected at Gneist Arena at least one hour before the start. There will be an open café and spectator seating in the stands during the event.
course_highlights: Indoor 3 km race on a blue athletics track
15 laps at Gneist Arena
Choice of running shoes or spikes with blunt tips (maximum 6 mm)
additional: The race uses eq-timing’s timing system with lap times. Warm-ups are not permitted inside the arena and must take place outdoors. Race numbers must be collected at least one hour before the start. There will be a call in the Call Room 10–15 minutes before each heat, where shoes will be checked. Participants will be allowed into the arena when it is ready for the next heat. Each heat has approximately 15–20 participants, with those whose estimated times are longest starting first. Warm-ups take place outdoors. Race numbers must be collected at Gneist Arena at least one hour before the start, and the call in the call room is 10–15 minutes before the heat starts. Gneist 400 Kids is held alongside the main race for children aged 6–12.

description: The Bosmarathon & Minder is a running event in Assen with a full marathon and several shorter distances. The routes mainly follow unpaved paths through the Asserbos, a woodland area of approximately 100 hectares. The start, refreshments and finish are at the AAC'61 athletics track. The loop is just over 7 km, with six loops making up the full marathon. Refreshments are available on the course and at the finish, including water, tea, bouillon and sports drink, and changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: The route mainly follows unpaved paths through the Asserbos
Start, refreshments and finish at the AAC'61 athletics track
Loop of just over 7 km; six loops for the marathon
additional: You can register in advance via inschrijven.nl until and including 15 January, or on the day in the clubhouse, with payment by debit card. Changing rooms are available at the venue at Achterpad 1, 9405 BN Assen. Participation is at your own risk. Results and photos will be published on the club page afterwards. Unpaved paths, registration in advance and on the day, changing rooms available

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplasgebied, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a series of three running races held in November, January and February around the beautiful locations of Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. The races offer running distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, as well as special youth distances of 400 and 1,000 metres on the athletics track. There are also walking distances of 5 and 10 km, starting at the same time as the 20 km running race. The start and finish are always on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers and a canteen are also available. The race features official timing and a nearly traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas.
course_highlights: Nearly traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with changing rooms and showers
A range of distances for beginner and experienced runners, including youth races on the track
additional: There is a 2-hour time limit for the walking distances. There is a drinks station on the track for participants in the 15 and 20 km races on their second lap. A free massage is available afterwards in the AAV'36 massage room (bring your own towel). Youth race keepsakes are free; other keepsakes and stamp cards for taking part in all three races are available for a fee. First aid is available on the track and course. The canteen is open and a limited number of lockers are available. Distances for runners and walkers; course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas; traffic-free course; start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track; changing rooms and showers available; free leg massage by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn.

name: Goedhart Drechtloop
location: Leimuiden, Kaag en Braassem, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Goedhart Drechtloop has been organized annually since 1969 by Vereniging S.V. Kickers ‘69 on the third Sunday in January. The event offers several distances: a 1.4 km children’s run, 4 km, 10 km and 10 English miles. The route passes through the villages of Leimuiden and Rijnsaterwoude and along the Drecht, offering a scenic and varied running experience in the Groene Hart.
course_highlights: Run through the villages of Leimuiden and Rijnsaterwoude
Route along the Drecht river
Varied course in the rural Groene Hart
additional: The start and finish are on Beukenlaan in Leimuiden. The event runs from 11:00 to 14:00. Several distances are available, including a 1.4 km children’s run. The event is organized by S.V. Kickers ‘69. It takes place on 17 January 2027 from 11:00 to 14:00, with several running options and a convivial atmosphere for participants of all ages.

name: Leemkuilcross
location: Berg en Dal, Nijmegen, Gelderland, Netherlands
price_range: Kind- en jeugdcross: € 3,5; Korte- en lange cross: € 7; Na-inschrijving: € 5 en € 10
description: The Leemkuilcross is one of the most beautiful cross-country races in the Netherlands, organised by NSAV ’t Haasje and AV Cifla. It takes place on a hilly, unpaved woodland course in Berg en Dal and is known for its challenging nature, particularly the notorious staircase. The race offers several distances for children, young people and adults, and attracts athletes who enjoy a tough cross-country race. Race bibs can be collected at the Berg en Dal tennis club, and parking is limited. The Leemkuilcross takes place annually on the third Sunday in January.
course_highlights: Hilly, unpaved woodland course in Berg en Dal
Laps around the Leemkuil, with the notorious staircase as a challenge
Distances ranging from 1200m to 8400m
additional: Race bibs can be collected in the canteen of the Berg en Dal tennis club, Molenbosweg 10. Parking is limited. Late registration is possible until just over half an hour before the start of the relevant race, at a higher cost. Prize ceremonies take place immediately after each event. Cancellations are possible up to one week before the event, subject to an administration fee. The course is a hilly, unpaved woodland route with the notorious staircase; registration is possible until one week before the event; prices include registration fees and late registration is available.

name: Watermolenloop
description: The Watermolenloop in Haaksbergen is a popular running event that attracts many sports enthusiasts each year. The race takes place in a welcoming setting, with a varied course through nature and past distinctive places in Haaksbergen. The 2026 edition brought out enthusiastic runners early in the morning, despite the chilly weather, which only added to the sporting atmosphere. The event is organised by Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH) and is a great opportunity for both recreational and dedicated runners.
course_highlights: A varied course through nature and past distinctive places in Haaksbergen
Atmospheric start at Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH)
A traditional event with a sporting and friendly atmosphere
additional: The event takes place in January and attracts a wide range of runners. It has a sporting and friendly atmosphere, even in cold weather. The race is part of Haaksbergen’s local sporting activities. The Watermolenloop draws sports enthusiasts to Haaksbergen and is known for a route past the Oostendorper Watermolen and through the Lankheterbos, with support from volunteers and emergency services.

name: Vinterkarusellen Løp 4
description: Vinterkarusellen is an annual running series featuring several distances, with courses officially measured and certified. This means that times achieved in the races will be recognized in statistics for both 5 km and 10 km. Participants have the opportunity to set personal records that will be recognized forever. The series has a rich history dating back to the mid-1980s, and since winter 2023, Ålesundløpene has once again been the organizer.

name: Hamarkarusellen Vinter Løp 4
description: Hamarkarusellen Winter is the winter edition of the new Hamarkarusellen. All races follow the same 5-kilometer course along illuminated walking and cycling paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar. Everyone is welcome, whatever their ambitions—whether you walk or run, with or without a time. There is no registration at the start, and the race offers an excellent opportunity to test your fitness, with 6 races during the winter.

name: Sandsjöbacka Trail 180
description: Sandsjöbacka Trail is one of western Sweden’s most exciting and challenging winter trail races, offering distances of 30k, 60k, 90k and 180k. The races feature varied terrain, from easy-to-run trails to technical trail running in a magical setting. Whether you’re an ultrarunner or a recreational runner, there’s a challenge to suit you. Welcome to experience the community, challenge and joy of Sandsjöbacka!
course_highlights: Terrain ranging from easy-to-run trails to technical trail running
Elevation gain from approx. 1,000 m (30k) up to approx. 5,000 m (180k)
Magical winter scenery in the Gothenburg area
additional: The 180k race is an out-and-back race starting in Skatås and turning around at Tjolöholm. The Friday start time can be chosen freely between 11:00 and 20:00, but all 90k and 180k runners must start together at 06:00 on Saturday morning. Drop bags and a place to rest are available in Tjolöholm. Self-support applies on the Skatås–Tjolöholm section, according to Fastest Known Time rules. A headlamp is recommended for dark sections. There are time limits and several aid stations with closing times along the courses. The event is known for its scenic course and challenging terrain, making it a popular choice for trail runners in the region.

name: Becksvart
description: Becksvart is a unique night race held in complete darkness, with a headlamp and reflective markers as your only guides. Choose between two challenging, varied courses of 6 km or 12 km, taking you over logs and rocks, along narrow trails and across rocky outcrops around Gunnebo Castle, Kallebäck and Lackarebäcksfjället. The races make for a perfect Friday evening, with the focus on adventure and the experience. AfterRun with food, drinks and music awaits in the finish area. There is also a secret competition within the race for anyone looking for an extra challenge.
course_highlights: Run in the dark, with a headlamp and reflective markers as your only guides
The course follows unique trails around Norra Långevattnet, Lackarebäcksfjället and Kallebäck
Gothenburg’s most legendary hill: Hobo Hill, with 80 metres of elevation gain over approximately 200 metres (12 km course)
additional: Start and finish at Gunnebo Castle & Gardens. The courses are marked with reflectors attached to clothespins and course tape. Race numbers and chips can be collected at Nordic Wellness Krokslätt the day before and on race day. Bag drop is available but unattended. There is one water station halfway around the course, and energy is available after the finish. Medical staff will be on site. Bus 754 goes to Gunnebo Park. Parking is available below the castle, but not at the start/finish. Trail shoes with a sturdy sole are recommended. A headlamp is mandatory. A headlamp is strongly recommended and described as mandatory on the race information page; trail shoes are recommended. There is a water station approximately halfway around the course. AfterRun with music, food and drinks awaits after the finish.

Vinterkarusellen Sørlandet
description: Vinterkarusellen Sørlandet is an exciting running race held in Kristiansand. The race covers a distance of 10 kilometres and gives participants the opportunity to experience the beautiful winter landscape of Sørlandet. It is perfect for both recreational and experienced runners who want to challenge themselves in a wintry setting.

name: Bergen Vintermaraton
description: Bergen Winter Marathon will be held for the 5th time on Saturday, January 18, 2025. The start and finish area will be at Fana Stadium. The course is an out-and-back route on paved roads that are either completely free of cars or have very little traffic, and a large part of the route follows a disused railway line through idyllic rural surroundings. Each loop is exactly one half marathon, and the same loop is run twice for the full marathon. The half marathon is one loop, while the marathon is two loops.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Winter Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of its routes, offering picturesque and attractive terrain for runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during the winter edition of the race. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy some sporting fun together.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque routes
Scenic locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The organizers particularly promote cross-country running and the scenic appeal of their routes. In summer 2026, they celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka.

name: Duin Strandloop
description: The Duinloopcircuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, with varied courses combining challenging dune trails and fast beach sections. The Duin/Strandloop on 23 January 2027 offers a great atmosphere for both competitive runners and recreational runners who want to enjoy running outdoors. The races are suitable for all ages, with distances ranging from kids’ runs to 10 km. The series encourages participation with a ranking based on each runner’s best four results.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune trails and beach sections
Kids’ runs and longer distances up to 10 km
Unique coastal setting with beautiful nature and challenging terrain
additional: Start times by distance: 500m Kids’ Run at 09:30, 1 km Kids’ Run at 09:35, 2 km Kids’ Run at 09:45, 5 km and 10 km at 10:00. Rankings are kept for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men, based on the best four results in the series. Courses, rankings, start times, results

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of running events organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club and held in a friendly, social-sporting spirit. The event is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to stay active on trails during the challenging autumn and winter months. Participants run a marathon or a multiple of the 10.5 km loop. Races take place in different towns from October to March. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and invite all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of a 10.5 km loop
Trail running in autumn and winter conditions
Choose to run a marathon or a multiple of the loop
additional: Dwumaraton Olęderski takes place over a series of weekends from October to March, each in a different town. Races start at 10:00, and the race office opens an hour earlier. The time limit for the first race is 16:00 and for the second race, 15:00. The minimum distance is 10.5 km. The events are co-funded by Nowy Tomyśl County and held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. The date of January 17, 2027, is taken from the running calendar.

description: The Postomino Run “Count Yourself in the Fight Against Diabetes” is an annual running event organized by the Culture and Sports Center in Postomino. The race is charitable and is part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity, promoting awareness and support for people with diabetes. The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino, bringing together the local community and runners from various regions. The event combines sporting competition with an important health and social message.
course_highlights: The course runs through the scenic area around Postomino
A charity event supporting people with diabetes
Organized as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity
additional: The race is organized by the Culture and Sports Center in Postomino and takes place as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event involves local running clubs and the community. The available websites provide no details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. The race takes place as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity.

description: The 18th Run for Diabetes is an annual running event organized by Maratończyk Team in Szczecin. The race takes place on Łasztownia near the Old Slaughterhouse, giving participants a chance to spend time actively and support the fight against diabetes. The event brings people together and promotes a healthy lifestyle among runners and city residents.
course_highlights: The route runs through scenic Szczecin Łasztownia
The start and finish are located near the Old Slaughterhouse
The race takes place in the afternoon, helping create a great atmosphere
additional: Newsletter sign-up is available. No details are provided about distances, fees, or start waves. Information about the route, fees, and location comes from the regulations for the 18th edition in 2026.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Szczecin by Lake Szmaragdowe. The races take place from October to April, promoting physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. Each location has its own final standings, and participants can test their abilities in sporting competition. The race is open to people aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event follows a regular schedule and offers a friendly atmosphere, encouraging both adults and children to take part.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and city parks
Szczecin: the race takes place by Lake Szmaragdowe
The races take place in natural surroundings, bringing together the city and nature
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. The main race starts at 11:00. The program also includes CITY TRAIL Junior races for children over distances from 200 m to 1 km. In Szczecin, a joint warm-up is held with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The races follow a regular schedule, and the race office remains at the same location throughout the season.

name: III Urodzinowy Maraton Grzegorza Pawła N...
XI Bieg z Puszką dla WOŚP
description: The 11th Run with a Can for WOŚP is an annual charity running event held in the Kleszczewo municipality. Participants start in Komorniki and run through several localities, finishing in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce. The run brings people together and supports the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP), while the route offers a chance to explore nearby towns and villages. The event also features children’s races and a play zone, where children receive medals and gifts. The main race is scheduled to start at 14:30.
course_highlights: The route passes through Komorniki, Nagradowice, Kleszczewo, Gowarzewo and Tulce
The finish is in the GOKiS sports hall in Tulce
The run is a charity event supporting WOŚP
additional: Children’s races and a play zone are available, with age categories and distances ranging from 200 m to 2,000 m. In the youngest children’s category, a parent or guardian may accompany the child during the race. Every child who finishes receives a commemorative medal and gifts from the organizers and sponsors. The date in the source calendar is approximate and indicates 25 January 2027; the event date provided is 24 January 2027.

name: XII Biegu Pobij Dystans z Sercem!
description: The 12th Run Beat the Distance with Heart is an annual race held in Piła as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP). The event takes place during the WOŚP Grand Finale and combines sporting competition with a charitable purpose, supporting children and seniors by raising funds for medical equipment. The race attracts people from the city and surrounding areas, bringing together a community of kind-hearted people who join forces to help those in need. It is a special opportunity to take an active part in Poland’s largest charitable campaign.
course_highlights: The race will take place in Piła, in the Greater Poland Voivodeship.
The running calendar lists the distance as 10 km, although route details are unavailable.
The event takes place on the day of the WOŚP Grand Finale.

name: Gewoon CooP Crossloop Luttenberg
description: The Gewoon COOP Crossloop in Luttenberg is a popular, traditional cross-country race and part of the Sallands Cross Circuit. Since 1976, participants have run through the forests and hills of Luttenberg on a challenging course that is largely unpaved and includes steep climbs, including the famous climb to the bench. Combining a unique atmosphere, a demanding course and a rich history, the race offers an unforgettable experience for all ages.
course_highlights: Course is 70% unpaved
Notorious climb to the famous bench
Route through forests and over hills, with views of the Sallandse Heuvelrug
additional: Race bibs are personal for the entire season and must be brought to every race. Spikes are not allowed because they could damage the timing mats. Participants receive a unique Sallands Cross Circuit running shirt when they register. The cross-country race features several distances, with start times between 10:45 and 12:40. The start and finish are at Gemeenschapscentrum Elckerlyc, Butzelaarstraat 22. The event offers various distances for all ages, including a final stretch past the Lourdes grotto. The event is sponsored by Charlot Jalink of Gewoon Coop and has a strong community atmosphere.

name: Halve Marathon Zoetermeer
description: The Halve Marathon Zoetermeer is a welcoming running event taking place on Sunday, 24 January 2027. The 14th edition offers four distances: the 1.5 km Kids Run, 5 km, 10 km, and the 21.1 km half marathon. The routes pass through Burgemeester Hoekstrapark, Balijbos, and the municipalities of Zoetermeer and Pijnacker, on a fast, straightforward course. The event is suitable for all ages, with a special focus on school competitions and a business run for teams.
course_highlights: Routes through Burgemeester Hoekstrapark and Balijbos
Course through the municipalities of Zoetermeer and Pijnacker
Clear, colour-coded kilometre markers for each distance
additional: Running shirts can be ordered for €12.50 each and collected on Saturday, 23 January, between 15:00 and 17:00, or on Sunday, 24 January, from 10:00. There is a school competition for the 1.5 km Kids Run and a business run for teams in the 5 km. The half marathon has mandatory time cut-offs at certain points on the course to allow roads to be reopened to traffic. Parking arrangements are in place, and volunteers are being sought for the event. Multiple distances, registration details, running shirts available to order, a colour-coded course, and timing and pace limits for the half marathon.

Dry RANuary Run

additional:

description: Frikarusellen is a race organized by Idrettslaget Fri at Espeland sports ground in Arna, Bergen. The race features a certified 5 km course that starts north of Londalskrysset, runs to Gamle Haukeland station and returns along the same route, with the finish inside the sports ground. The event is part of a race series with several dates throughout the winter and early spring. It is a popular recreational race with a friendly atmosphere and enthusiastic participants of all ages.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Start north of Londalskrysset – Gamle Haukeland station – return along the same route
Finish inside Espeland sports ground
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A license fee is additional for participants over 13 who do not have an annual license. There is a fee of 50 kr for a forgotten race bib for those registered for all the races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. The race takes place at Espeland sports ground in Arna. Registration is stated to be via EQ Timing.

name: Søknad Frikarusellen løp nr.4 2027
description: The Frikarusellen is a winter running series organized by Idrettslaget Fri in Arna, with six races throughout the winter and spring. The course is certified as 5 km and runs mainly along a pedestrian and cycle path between Espeland and Gamle Haukeland station, with the start and finish at Espeland sports grounds. The race is suitable for both young people and adults, with separate prices for members and age groups. It is a social and inclusive running series that encourages people to enjoy running together through the winter months.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course between Espeland and Gamle Haukeland station
The course runs mostly along a pedestrian and cycle path or a lightly trafficked road
Start and finish at Espeland sports grounds
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A license fee is added for participants over 13 years old who do not have an annual license. A fee of 50 kr applies if participants who registered for all the races forget their race number. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no.

name: Götas ungdomsspel
location: Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, Karlstad, Sweden
price_range: 110–120 kr per gren; efteranmälan i mån av plats mot dubbel avgift
description: Götas Youth Indoor Games is an athletics competition for young people, held at the modern Eva Lisa Holtz Arena in Karlstad. The event provides a welcoming and supportive environment for young athletes to compete and develop in various athletics disciplines. The arena is a multifunctional indoor facility with seating for 1,700 spectators, creating a great atmosphere for both participants and spectators. The event is organised by IF Göta Karlstad, one of Sweden’s most successful athletics clubs, and offers a safe and inspiring competition environment.
course_highlights: The competition is held indoors at Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, a modern venue with seating for 1,700 spectators
Multifunctional facility for both competitions and training
Organised by IF Göta Karlstad, a club with a long tradition and a strong record in athletics
additional: The competition takes place at Eva Lisa Holtz Arena, which opened in 2022 and is a modern indoor venue for athletics and physical training. The multifunctional arena is also used for meetings and training courses. IF Göta Karlstad covers the entry fees for a maximum of three events per competition for its members. Entries for children and young people under 14 should be sent to the relevant group email address, or to tavlingsanmalan@ifgota.se if no group email address is available. Enter by 24 January via EasyRecord or gus@ifgota.se. Participants compete in their age category or the senior category.

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Winterrun Oslo 2027 is the big winter running festival, taking place on Saturday, 30 January at Rådhusplassen in Oslo. The race offers a unique atmosphere, with fire baskets, torches and music along the course, as thousands of participants gather for a magical running experience through Oslo’s streets. All participants receive a medal and Vitamin Well at the finish, and great prizes are drawn after the race. This is a feel-good race for anyone who wants to test their fitness or simply have fun in the winter cold.
course_highlights: Run through Oslo’s streets with atmospheric lighting from fire baskets and torches
Start and finish at the beautiful Rådhusplassen
A unique atmosphere with music and marshals providing an extra boost
additional: Race bibs are distributed a few days before the race in the city, but can also be collected in the start area on race day. Bag storage is outdoors and requires a luggage tag. There is a dedicated women’s tent for warming up and changing. Public transport to the start area is recommended due to limited parking. Race bibs can be transferred for a fee of NOK 150 via My Page. The race takes place on winter surfaces. Costumes are encouraged, and prizes are awarded for eye-catching outfits. All participants receive a medal and Vitamin Well at the finish.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland settings of urban parks. In Poznań, the course runs around Lake Rusałka, with the start and finish located by the city beach. The races are open to runners of all levels, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly track their results on the same course. Races are held throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete in both local and national rankings.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start on Św. Wawrzyńca Street; finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event also includes races for children in various age groups. The event is co-funded by the City of Poznań budget. The race on 17 January 2027 is one of four Poznań dates in the 2026/2027 season; the others are scheduled for 11 October and 22 November 2026, and 21 March 2027. The CITY TRAIL program also includes races for children.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz
location: Ogród Botaniczny, Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of the Botanical Garden in Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation, adding to the scenic appeal of the course. The race is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, which is popular and combines sport with the beauty of nature. The organizers place particular emphasis on attractive courses and the event atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden and Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation
Picturesque, scenic surroundings ideal for running
Races organized since 2014, with a focus on natural scenery
additional: The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las from Poznań. In summer 2026, the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka was celebrated. The event is part of a cross-country race series held in various locations across Wielkopolska and the surrounding area. The organizers encourage people to sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date with events.

name: Przybij Piątkę
description: Przybij Piątkę is a winter 5 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Klub Biegacza Chyży in the Municipal Park in Nowy Tomyśl. The course is 90% on unpaved surfaces and is not officially certified. The race is free, and every participant who finishes will receive a commemorative medal. Trophies will be awarded to the top finishers. The participant limit is 200.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
90% unpaved surface
Start and finish in the Municipal Park in Nowy Tomyśl
additional: The results are scheduled to be announced at 10:00 on the same day. The race is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Nowy Tomyśl County. The race is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Nowy Tomyśl County.

name: Rondje Roege Baarg
description: Rondje Roege Baarg is an atmospheric cross-country run and walking event organised by Hardloopclub Onstwedde in collaboration with Stichting Wandelen in Westerwolde. The running routes range from 6.4 to 22.8 kilometres and pass through the beautiful Westerwolde countryside, including Ter Wupping, Veele and Wessinghuizen. Walkers can enjoy a marked 10-kilometre route with a refreshment station. The start and finish are at MFA de Bast in Onstwedde, which also has changing and shower facilities. After the event, participants can enjoy delicious snert from slagerij Hemmen.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the beautiful Westerwolde countryside, with routes of 6.4, 11.3, 18.9 and 22.8 km
Three refreshment stations along the route for runners
10 km walking route marked with yellow arrows, with one refreshment station
additional: Start and finish at MFA de Bast, with changing and shower facilities. Manual timekeeping; results available via uitslagen.nl. Dogs are not allowed. Snert is served to all participants after the event. Walkers can start between 10:30 and 11:30. Walkers can get their walking book stamped. An emergency phone number is available for walkers. Walking route of 10 km; running distances from 6.4 km to 22.8 km; start and finish at MFA De Bast; changing and shower facilities; advance registration open until 24 January; participation at your own risk; dogs are not allowed.

name: 19e Rhoonse Griendentocht
description: The 19th Rhoonse Grienden Tour is a beautiful walking tour that takes place in Rhoon on Saturday, January 30. Organized by the Royal Dutch Walking Association (KWbN), it gives walkers the opportunity to enjoy a healthy and rewarding walking experience in beautiful surroundings. The tour is suitable for both beginners and experienced walkers and promotes physical activity and well-being.
course_highlights: Walk through the Rhoon nature reserve and surrounding area
Options to take part on two days
Discover local landscapes and historic surroundings
additional: Participants who want to take part on both days can register for both days using the form: first register for Saturday, then use “+ add participant” to register for Sunday as well. Wandel.nl is an initiative of KWbN, the Netherlands’ largest walking organization, which inspires and supports walkers. Two-day participation, registration forms, membership discounts

name: Winterlaufserie (10 km)
location: Sportzentrum Hamm-Ost, Hamm, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Winter Running Series in Hamm is a traditional running event held at the Hamm-Ost sports centre by Jahnstadion. The officially measured out-and-back course runs through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the spa gardens in Bad Hamm. The series includes several races over different distances, including 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon, with individual-race and series rankings. Timing is provided by the Race Result system, and awards are presented to the fastest runners as well as age-group prize winners.
course_highlights: Officially measured out-and-back course in accordance with international competition rules
The course runs through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and Bad Hamm spa gardens
Start and finish on the tartan track at Jahnstadion
additional: Timing is provided by the Race Result system using a chip in the race bib. A €3.00 deposit is charged for the race bib with chip (refunded upon return), and a €1.00 donation goes to the support association for the hospice in Hamm. Youths and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). Awards ceremonies take place approximately 45 minutes after the finish in the marquee at Jahnstadion. The event comprises a series of three 10 km races held in Hamm’s natural landscape and spa gardens. Registration is online, timing is provided by Race Result, and awards are given to the top participants and series winners.

name: Winterlaufserie der Hildener AT
price_range: ab 7 EUR bis 47 EUR je nach Serie
description: The Hilden Winter Running Series is an annual running event that has attracted runners from the region since 2012. The series takes place on three dates in January and February and offers various series for different ability and age groups, including 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and half marathon, as well as walking and children’s races. The races run through the wintry Hilden City Forest and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the TC Stadtwald Hilden club grounds. Race numbers can be collected in advance at the HAT fit fitness studio, and on-site late entries are possible.
course_highlights: Races through the wintry Hilden City Forest
Start and finish at the TC Stadtwald Hilden club grounds
Various series with distances from approx. 500 m to the half marathon
additional: Race numbers can be collected in advance at the HAT fit fitness studio, Holterhöfchen 22, in Hilden. Late entries are possible on race day on site for a fee. The walking series does not allow Nordic walking poles. Parking at the Waldbad is signposted. Public transport via bus route 784 (Waldschenke stop) is recommended. Various distances, online registration, race in the city forest, suitable for families and performance-focused runners.

name: Bieg 3 Jezior
description: Bieg 3 Jezior is a series of races held in Chodzież, comprising three events over 5 km and 10 km distances, taking place by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie. The event has an intimate feel, with a limit of 130 participants. Participants can purchase a pass for the entire series, which includes all three races and a commemorative T-shirt. A permanent race number with a timing chip makes participation convenient, without needing to collect a number separately for each event. The race takes place on Sundays at 10:00, making it a great way to spend an active weekend in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Race routes by three lakes: Karczewnik, Miejskie and Strzeleckie
5 km and 10 km distances
Scenic areas of Chodzież
additional: The participant limit is 130. Pass holders receive a permanent race number with a timing chip, used for all three races, so they only need to visit the race office once. In the 2026 edition, the limit was 130 participants; the pass included a commemorative T-shirt and a permanent race number with a chip.

name: IV Cross Smolarza
description: The 4th Cross Smolarza is a cross-country race held in the scenic area around Krzyżowiec. The event takes place on natural forest and off-road trails, offering a challenge for runners who enjoy being close to nature. The participant limit is 170, divided among three categories: two running distances and Nordic walking. Entries are accepted online only until January 23, helping ensure the event is well organized.
course_highlights: Forest and off-road trails in the area around Krzyżowiec
Natural terrain suited to cross-country running
Limit of 70 participants for each running distance and 30 for Nordic walking
additional: The participant limit is 170: 70 for each running distance and 30 for Nordic walking. Entries are accepted online only. The event runs from 11:00 to 16:00. Participants are offered grilled sausage, bread, and tea.

name: Marceliński Bieg Zimowy
description: The Marcelin Winter Run is a trail race in Poznań’s Marcelin Forest, opening a year-round series of runs in the area. Participants can choose a 5 km or 10 km route and run along forest paths. It’s an option for both experienced runners and anyone looking to start the season actively over a shorter distance.
course_highlights: Forest route in Marcelin Forest
Choose between a 5 km or 10 km distance
The race opens a series of events held in the area
additional: In the edition described by the city, the start was at 100 Ptasia Street. The series includes four races, and the medals from the individual events fit together like a puzzle.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdrojska Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented running and Nordic walking league held on the scenic routes of the Międzyzdroje Municipality. In the 2026/2027 season, participants compete over distances of approximately 5 and 10 km running, and 5 and 7 km Nordic walking. The league is known for healthy competition and fun, welcoming both regular participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. Participation is free, and the overall standings require taking part in at least four races or walks over the specified distances.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors may take part with written permission from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be included in the league standings, participants must finish at least four events over the required distances. This is a series of events for the 2026/2027 season. Participants must be at least 14; minors need written permission from a parent or guardian and must compete under their supervision. Participation in at least four events is required for the overall standings.

name: Rondje Oeken
location: De Vroolijke Frans, Brummen, Gelderland, Netherlands
price_range: geen grote inschrijfgelden, mogelijk kleine kosten voor inschrijving
description: Rondje Oeken is a welcoming, small-scale running event held in the beautiful countryside around Oeken and Brummen. The route passes along rural roads, woodland edges and quiet paths, and is fully marked and largely traffic-free. The event is open to all levels, from beginners to keen runners, and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. The start and finish are at De Vroolijke Frans in Brummen, where ample parking is also available.
course_highlights: Beautiful scenery with rural roads, woodland edges and quiet paths
Fully marked and largely traffic-free course
Start and finish at De Vroolijke Frans, Knoevenoordstraat 51, Brummen
additional: There are two start times: 10:00 for the 21.1 km and 10:30 for the 12 km. Parking is available at De Vroolijke Frans and on the field behind it. You can register using the registration form on the website, either in advance or on the day. The event is welcoming and focused on a friendly atmosphere, sportsmanship and safety, with experienced volunteers and first aid on site. The course varies from unpaved paths to trail; there is a children's run, and registration is available on the day. The start is at De Vroolijke Frans.

name: Uithoorns Mooiste De Loop
description: Uithoorns Mooiste De Loop is a welcoming and well-organized running race in Uithoorn, known for its varied and safe course. The race attracts many participants each year, including long-distance runners and children, and is supported by a large group of volunteers and traffic marshals. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and offers a festive day of sport, with a focus on participants and a special anniversary atmosphere.
course_highlights: Varied and safe course
Special atmosphere and good organization
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The race is supported by around 125 volunteers and more than 50 traffic marshals. Participants are catered for with water stations along the course, fruit and a memento at the finish. At the 40th anniversary, special treats were handed out, including cream cakes and flower bulbs. There are multiple distances, including a children’s race and special categories, with registration via www.inschrijven.nl; the course runs through Uithoorn and the surrounding area, with traffic marshals and measures to minimize disruption.

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organized by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held during the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometers. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer a friendly, sporting atmosphere for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes
Distances ranging from 1.4 to 15 kilometers
additional: Pre-registration closes on 3 January 2027; late registration is available on race day from 9:00 a.m. until half an hour before the start at Semmelweisstraat 46, IKC De Wooldermarke. Race numbers can be collected on the preceding Saturday between 3:00 and 5:00 p.m. or on race day. The race number includes a timing chip and is valid for all four races. Shower and changing facilities are available in the small sports hall on Woolderesweg, which closes at 1:15 p.m. A running shirt and medal can optionally be ordered during pre-registration and collected with the race number or after the finish. The standings are based on at least 3 of the 4 races. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. Bringing pets, strollers, etc. is not allowed. Participants can register for different distances, with the start and finish at Woolderes. The event offers prizes such as cash and gift vouchers. The race takes place on 31 January 2027 and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Hoessenboschcross
location: Openluchttheater Hoessenbosch, Berghem, North Brabant, Netherlands
price_range: 7 euro voor korte en lange cross, 3 euro voor jeugdcross

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kosten – korte en lange cross 7 euro

description: The Hoessenbosch Cross is part of the AV Oss '78 Cross Competition and takes place near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre in Berghem. The event offers a challenging course with a short cross of approximately 5 km, a long cross of approximately 10 km, and several junior cross distances. The short and long cross start at 10:00, followed by the junior cross at 11:10. The event is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is part of a series of cross-country races in the Oss region.
course_highlights: Off-road course near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre
Short cross of approximately 5 km and long cross of approximately 10 km
Junior cross with several shorter distances
additional: Registration is open until 30 minutes before the event at the latest. The event is part of a cross-country competition featuring several races in the Oss region. The location is near the car park of the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre in Berghem. Start times: 10:00 and 11:10; location near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre in Berghem

name: Amersfoortse Bergcross
description: The Amersfoortse Bergcross is a challenging cross-country race through hilly woodland on winding sandy trails. The course is unpaved, and one lap is 2.5 kilometres. Participants can choose from several distances by running 1 to 4 laps, making it suitable for both recreational and advanced runners. The start and finish are at the same location, and chip timing is used for accurate times. The event is exclusively for employees and family members of companies affiliated with Railsport.

name: Necon Vinterkarusellen Bergen - løp 5
description: Necon Vinterkarusellen in Bergen is a winter running series with eight races, where participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The races start and finish at Fana Stadium, with a start time of 18:45. The series takes place on several Mondays from October to April and offers discounts for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and free participation is available for members of the athletics groups who pay a training fee.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km race distances
Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Evening races with a start time of 18:45
additional: Discounts are available for IL Gneist members, with different codes for free or reduced entry fees. An annual licence is required for participants over 13 and can be selected during registration. Registration is via individual sign-up in EQ-timing. Participants are responsible for using the correct discount code and paying the correct fee. The series takes place on several Mondays during the winter months. A licence fee of NOK 50 may apply if you do not have an annual licence.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 5 (1. jan)
description: Necon Winter Series is a winter running series comprising 8 races, held on Mondays throughout the winter, with the start and finish at Fana Stadium in Bergen. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances. The races start at 18:45, and discounts are available for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, with options for both annual licence holders and those without a licence.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Choice of 5 km or 10 km distances
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts for IL Gneist members: free for athletics members who pay the main club membership fee and training fee (code Gneist00), 50% off for Gneist trim members (code Gneist50), and 25% off for other Gneist members (code Gneist25). The annual licence must be selected during registration, and a licence fee of NOK 50 applies to those without a licence. Registration is individual via EQ-timing. The annual licence costs NOK 50 if it has not already been paid.

name: Bjørgene løpskarusell - 5. løp
description: Bjørgene Running Series is a long-standing series of races organized by the Athletics Group of Torvastad Sports Club. The 2026/2027 season will be the 19th in the series, with races held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of Bjørgene, Karmøy, and attract many local runners of all ages. The start is usually at 19:00, and the atmosphere is social and inclusive, with biscuits, squash and fruit served after the race.
course_highlights: Races in the scenic surroundings of Bjørgene, Karmøy
Held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March
Race numbers can be collected from 18:00, with the start at 19:00
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 18:00. Biscuits, squash and fruit are served to participants after the race. The running series relies on voluntary efforts by coaches, team leaders and parents to take place.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 4. løp
description: Samnanger Winter Series is an inclusive running series organized by Samnanger IL Running Group, held approximately every other Friday at Nesodden. Participants can choose between 2 km and 5 km courses, with the 5 km course officially measured by NFIF. The races are suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and focus on competition, training, and socializing. The event takes place in the evening during the winter darkness, and participants are encouraged to wear reflective vests for safety. Samnanger IL Running Group also offers group training sessions and other running events throughout the year.
course_highlights: Run at Nesodden, with the start and finish in the same place
Choose between 2 km and 5 km courses; the 5 km course is officially measured by NFIF
Races are held approximately every other Friday in the evening during the winter darkness
additional: The running group is informal, free, and open to all levels. Group training sessions are held every Monday at 18:10 in Hagabotnane. Participants are encouraged to wear reflective vests because of the darkness. The races are social and inclusive, with a focus on the joy of running and community. Reflective vests are recommended.

name: Midwinter Marathon
distance_verbose: Marathon, 25 km, Halve marathon, 8 km, 4 km, 1 km, 0.5 km

tiers.description: De inschrijfkosten bedragen € 45,- inclusief arrangement en medaille
