description: The Midwinter Marathon in Apeldoorn is a three-day running event held on the first weekend of February. It offers various distances, including a marathon with a unique route through the Natura 2000 area and the Kootwijkerzand, a 10-mile race through wooded and hilly terrain, and shorter events such as the Night Run and Kidsrun. The marathon route is partly off-road and passes iconic places such as Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk. The Midwinter Marathon is known for its welcoming organisation, beautiful nature and broad mix of recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Marathon route with 900 metres off-road across the Kootwijkerzand
Route through the Natura 2000 area, passing Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk
10-mile route through wooded and hilly terrain, with its highest point at 100 metres above sea level
additional: The marathon starts and finishes at AV’34 in the Orderbos. Participants are welcomed with coffee or tea and a treat; after the race, pea soup with rye bread and bacon, or a vegetarian alternative, is served. The 10-mile race starts and finishes on the Loolaan, with changing rooms and showers in nearby gymnasiums. Start corrals for the 10-mile race are assigned according to expected finish time. The marathon is limited to 700 participants, and registration closes once this limit is reached. There is no on-the-day registration. The 10-mile race has a maximum of 4,200 participants. There are several refreshment stations and medical support. The Midwinter Marathon also offers an app for live runner tracking. Several distances are available, including the Kidsrun, 8 km and marathon; the event takes place in February 2027.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Hammer Bakker Trail
BTR Winter 12 km
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter is a winter trail race offering runners a unique opportunity to experience the Åkulla beech forests in their winter dress. With distances of 5, 12 and 24 km, the race features magical trails and a wonderful atmosphere in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and finish are at Öströö Fårfarm, and the event is characterised by community, commitment and respect for nature. Only 600 exclusive starting places are available, making this an intimate and special experience for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Winter trail in the Åkulla beech forests
Start and finish at Öströö Fårfarm
A magical winter landscape experience
additional: A total of 600 starting places are available: 5 km (150 places), 12 km (300 places) and 24 km (150 places). You must help other runners if needed. The start list is available online. Startklar and Startklar Plus insurance are offered for refunds in case of illness or injury. Traffic rules apply at road crossings. Littering will result in disqualification. For urgent assistance, call 076-8159678 or 112. The race starts at 10:00 from Öströö Fårfarm. There is one refreshment station with energy supplies along the course. The final registration date is 2 February 2027.

name: Sormlands Winter Trail
location: Nävekvarns IP, Nävekvarn, Nyköping Municipality, Sweden
description: Sörmlands Winter Trail is a winter race offering three distances: 43 km, 22 km and 10 km, all starting and finishing at Nävekvarns IP in Nävekvarn. The routes pass through varied terrain, including forest trails, hilly landscapes and scenic coastal sections, providing a challenging and picturesque experience. The race uses electronic timing and has several aid stations with food and drinks along the course. After the finish, all participants are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic recovery beer. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment and access to showers and changing rooms at the start.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest trails, hilly slopes and coastal paths
Several aid stations with food, hot drinks and Umara Energy
Electronic chip timing and clear cut-off times for each distance
additional: Start times: 43 km at 09:00, 22 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00. Maximum cut-off times: 8 hours for 43 km, 5 hours for 22 km, 2 hours for 10 km. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a mobile phone, windproof jacket, thermal base layer, hat, gloves, water bottle (at least 500 ml), whistle, emergency blanket and headlamp when running in the dark. Showers, changing rooms and toilets are available at Nävekvarns IP. Parking is available for a fee at the start/finish area. After the race, runners are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic Mineral Brewing Recovery Lager. The distances are 10, 22 and 43 km. Race numbers can be collected at the start area at Nävekvarns IP. Aid stations offer food and hot drinks, and a hot meal is served at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a charged phone, wind jacket, water and trail shoes with good grip. Parking is available for a small fee.

name: Brooks Winterrun Bergen

tiers.description: Meld deg på før 1. januar 2027 og få 20 % rabatt!

description: Winterrun Bergen is the big winter running festival in Bergen city centre, taking place on Saturday, 6 February 2027. The race offers a unique atmosphere with fire baskets, torches and music along the course, and participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances. All participants receive a medal and a drink at the finish, and the race is known for its great atmosphere and fantastic prizes. Race numbers can be collected in advance at Løplabbet Bergen or in the start area on race day.
course_highlights: Run in Bergen city centre in an atmospheric winter setting
Fire baskets, torches and music along the course
Everyone receives a medal and Vitamin Well at the finish
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Løplabbet Bergen, Strandkaien 6, from 4 to 6 February, 10:00–19:00, or in the start area from 2 hours before the start. Start waves are approximately 45 seconds apart, with pacers from 4:00 to 6:30 min/km. Outdoor baggage storage is available; bring your own baggage tag. There are no shower or changing facilities in the start and finish area. Public transport is recommended due to limited parking. Start time: 18:00. Participants are encouraged to wear luminous costumes.

description: The Grand Prix of Dziewicza Góra Mountain Running is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and environmental protection. The course follows forest paths around Dziewicza Góra, the park’s highest hill, offering challenging climbs and scenic views. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic walking event, and children’s races over shorter distances. The organizers foster a welcoming sporting atmosphere that brings participants and families together.
course_highlights: A fully forested 5.15 km loop
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The course passes through the event center, where spectators can cheer on runners
additional: Children’s races are held over 200m, 500m, 1000m, and 1500m. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participants in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. After emerging from the forest at the finish, runners head to the left or right side of the balloon marked “Finish,” depending on their race distance. The participant limit is 500. People who have purchased a pass for the entire series are automatically added to the start list.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Parking leśny Łysy Młyn, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic walking events, offering half-marathon and marathon distances on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests. The event is open to both amateur and professional athletes, who can compete in small cross-country races. Each race has its own theme, and the start and race office are located by the Łysy Młyn forest car park in Biedrusko. Additional races and walks are held over 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a summer night edition, WARTA CHALLENGE Night Express.
course_highlights: The course follows forest tracks and trails along the Warta River, with sections of asphalt and natural surfaces featuring leaves, mud and puddles.
The half marathon is one 21.3 km loop with 110 m of elevation gain; the marathon is two loops, for a total distance of 42.6 km.
The route is marked with red-and-white tape and signs for the “Łysy Młyn” running trail. The largest climb is 35 m over a 1 km section.
additional: Race packets can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and accessories are recommended for the individual races. The race centre is by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, Biedrusko. The course is not officially certified; it is measured using bike computers and a Garmin device. The race centre is by Lake Łyse, next to the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and race packets can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The venue can be reached by car or public and suburban transport; free parking is available.

name: 2 Bieg Zwycięskiego Powstania
description: The Victorious Uprising Run is an annual running event held by Lake Strzeszyńskie in Poznań, commemorating the victory of the Greater Poland Uprising. The event offers three competitions: a 5 km run, a 10 km run and 5 km Nordic walking, all held in an atmosphere of patriotism and sporting camaraderie. Participants can look forward to a commemorative cast medal and a hot meal after the events. It is a great opportunity to celebrate an important anniversary through physical activity and enjoy the outdoors in the picturesque surroundings of Lake Strzeszyńskie.
course_highlights: Running routes by Lake Strzeszyńskie in Poznań
Distances of 5 km and 10 km, plus 5 km Nordic walking
A patriotic atmosphere commemorating the Greater Poland Uprising
additional: All events start at around 11:00 (the 5 km and 10 km runs at 11:00, and the 5 km Nordic walk at 11:01). Participants will receive a cast medal and a hot meal at the finish. Places are limited, and registration on the day of the event is possible only if places are still available.

name: XXIII Zimowy Bieg Trzech Jezior
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Trzemesznie
description: The XXIII Winter Three Lakes Run is a winter running event held in Trzemeszno. The 23rd edition took place. The event includes classifications for residents of the Trzemeszno municipality, employees of the State Forests, and PAROC company employees.
additional: For the 2026 edition, race packs could be collected on race day at the OSiR Sports Hall at ul. Piastowska 11 in Trzemeszno, from 7:30 to 9:45.

name: Centraal Beheer Marathon
distance_verbose: Marathon, 25 km, 16.1 km, 8 km, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Blaauwbek Marathon
description: The Blaauwbek Marathon is an atmospheric winter marathon around Oldambtmeer in Blauwestad. The half and full marathons start in Bad Nieuweschans and finish at De Rietkraag, with bus transport from the finish to the start. There are also 5 km and 10 km distances that start and finish at De Rietkraag, featuring a unique course across the airfield. In addition to running events, there are 10 km and 20 km walking routes and special distances for children. The organizers provide warm refreshments along the way and a warm welcome at the finish.
course_highlights: Course around Oldambtmeer, with beautiful scenery and trails
Separate start and finish locations, with bus transport for marathon runners
Unique course across the airfield for the 5 km and 10 km distances
additional: The half marathon starts at 11:15 with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The full marathon starts at 9:45 with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The finish closes at 16:30 for both marathon distances. Children start the 5 km at 15:30. Walkers can start independently after receiving their route. The event offers various distances, including youth and walking routes, and bus transport for marathon runners. The event returns after several years’ absence and is marked by a winter theme and a convivial atmosphere.

name: Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross
organizer: Loopgroep SGO, Vomos UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug
description: The Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross is a challenging cross-country race set in the unique landscape of the Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark. The race takes place in Ees and offers two distances: a short route of approximately 5 km and a long route of approximately 9 km, both along unpaved paths through woodland and heathland. The route passes along narrow paths, several glacial pits and the storm-damaged forest with fallen trees, making for an adventurous run surrounded by nature. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos.
course_highlights: Entirely unpaved course, except for two crossings of cycle paths
Route through narrow heathland paths and several challenging glacial pits
Passage through the mysterious storm-damaged forest with fallen trees
additional: The cross is run without chip timing. No shower or changing facilities are available. The start location is Land van Bartje, Buinerweg 8, 9536 PG Ees. Public transport is available via Belbus line 59 from Borger. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is the 5th race in the circuit. Course through a nature reserve, starts at 11:00 and 11:10, registration via inschrijven.nl, no changing or shower facilities.

name: Kruikenloop
description: The Kruikenloop in Tilburg is an energetic and sociable race that traditionally marks the start of carnival in Kruikenstad. The course runs partly through the nearby Stadsbos 013 and offers distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres, with the 5-kilometre loop available to run multiple times. There is a special 1,111-metre race for children, with fun and sportsmanship at its heart. After the finish, there is a festive afterparty in the Sarto canteen, and prizes are awarded for the best carnival outfits.
course_highlights: Course partly through Stadsbos 013
5 km loop that can be run 1, 2 or 3 times (5, 10 or 15 km)
1,111-metre race for children
additional: Bib number changes are possible until 8 February at 18:00 via the personal dashboard. Bib numbers may be transferred and resold via the official platform. Prizes for creatively dressed participants and a costume prize for the children's race. Timing via a chip in the bib number, with times available online shortly after the race. Registration via the website; course partly through Stadsbos 013; festive atmosphere with music and costumes; held during carnival in Tilburg.

name: Eventyrsport VinterTrail Mols Bjerge 2027 - powered by HOKA
Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Polana Różopole, Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in scenic woodland and parkland. In Bydgoszcz, the route passes through the Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, with the start and finish at Różopole Clearing. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can compete on the same course year after year. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Races take place throughout the 2026/2027 season, and participants can compete for overall standings and prizes.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the woodland scenery of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Różopole Clearing
The route is suitable for both run-walkers and fast runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. Before the main race at 11:00, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. Parking is not available at Różopole Clearing; participants are advised to use car parks approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The race schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The main race starts at 11:00. Registration is available online through the Competitor Panel or at the race office on race day.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz Orienteering is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz Orienteering Foundation, aimed at people of all ages and skill levels. Participants use a map and compass to explore varied woodland and urban areas around Bydgoszcz. The event promotes outdoor activity, family participation, and the development of navigation skills, offering courses suited to both beginners and advanced runners. The Foundation is also committed to creating courses for blind and visually impaired people, making the event accessible to everyone.
course_highlights: Varied woodland and urban areas around Bydgoszcz
Courses for beginners, advanced participants, and blind and visually impaired people
A series of several races during the season, with an overall series classification
additional: The Autumn-Winter Series consists of six orienteering rounds in various forests around Bydgoszcz and nearby areas, with courses of varying difficulty. For each completed round, participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for a collectible coupon. Completing the entire series is rewarded with a special final badge and discounts on the Bydgoszcz and Surrounding Areas Championships. The project is supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism and the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Government.

name: Bieg Urodzinowy z Portem Gdynia Bieg 1926
location: Aleja Jana Pawła II, Gdynia, Poland
description: The Birthday Run with the Port of Gdynia is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the Gdynia Grand Prix. The race takes place on city streets, offering participants the chance to compete over routes of varying lengths. It is open and welcoming to runners of different ability levels, and promotes physical activity and a sense of community.
course_highlights: A street route in central Gdynia
Views of the port and coastal surroundings
A range of distances suited to different age groups and ability levels
additional: Information about the distance and route is from the 2026 edition.

name: Leeuwarden Marsum Leeuwarden
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km
price_range: Jeugd t/m 15 jaar: € 5,00; 16 Jaar en ouder: € 7,50; meerprijs medaille € 3,50
description: Leeuwarden Marsum Leeuwarden is a classic running race starting on the Lionitas track in Leeuwarden. The 21.1 km half-marathon course runs through the cold fields northwest of the city, where the wind has free rein. Alongside the half marathon, there are also 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km distances, all measured exactly. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. Participation is at your own risk and responsibility.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course through cold fields northwest of Leeuwarden
Precisely measured distances of 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km
Start and finish on the Lionitas athletics track
additional: Start times by distance: 1 km kids’ run at 11:00, 21.1 km at 11:10, 10 km at 11:20, 5 km at 11:35, 2 km at 11:40. Participants can check the route in advance via afstandmeten.nl and download GPX files for sports watches. The Gouden Leeuw race number is valid for this race and Rondje Goutum, includes entry into prize draws and offers the option to purchase a special medal. Terrain: farmland and athletics track; Online registration via afstandmeten.nl; Race on 7 February 2027; Start and finish location at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, Leeuwarden

description: The Twentse Ven’n Loop is a small-scale running event held in Twente’s beautiful natural surroundings. It is known for its relaxed atmosphere and unique running experience. In 2027, the event will be held for the eleventh time, offering participants not only a sporting challenge but also the opportunity to support a good cause. The start and finish are at Camping de Meene in Buurse, and the event is known for Twentish hospitality.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful Twentse countryside
Start and finish at Camping de Meene in Buurse
Small-scale event with a maximum of 250 participants
additional: The maximum number of participants is 250. After costs are deducted, proceeds from entry fees go to a sponsored cause. Participants must follow the rules and the organizers’ instructions. Pets, strollers, and similar items are not allowed. The organizers reserve the right to change the route or cancel the event in extreme weather conditions. The Road Traffic Act remains in force during the run. Distances: 4.8 km, 10.3 km, 16.2 km; course through nature, wet terrain, facilities at the start/finish, charity initiative

location: Schipborg, Aa en Hunze, Drenthe, Netherlands

name: Silgan Ćwierćmaraton
location: SILGAN Metal Packaging, ul. Rokicka 13, Tczew, Poland
description: The Silgan Quarter Marathon is a 10.54 km race taking place in Tczew County. The start and finish are located at the SILGAN Metal Packaging premises in Tczew at 13 Rokicka Street. The route runs through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny, with its final course to be announced two weeks before the event. The surface varies, with asphalt and gravel sections, and the race takes place with restricted vehicular traffic. The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s pistol, and the route is marked with road markings every 1 km.
course_highlights: A 10.54 km route through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny
A mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces
The route is marked with road markings every 1 km
additional: The participant limit is 200 entrants who have paid their entry fee. The start and finish are at the premises of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. The race route takes place with restricted vehicular traffic. Previous editions were held in May.

name: Snøkuten - Glestadrunden
description: Snøkuten is a traditional series of running races held in Veldre, starting from Kirkekretsen School in Byflaten. The races cover varying distances, including the 9.5 km Nordhagarunden. The event is social and includes both competitive classes and the option to participate without timing. Prizes are awarded to everyone who completes at least four of the six races in the season.
course_highlights: Start from Kirkekretsen School in Byflaten
Nordhagarunden, one of the race routes, is 9.5 km
Both timed and untimed participation options
additional: Untimed start at 17:00; competitive class start at 18:30. A prize is awarded to everyone who completes 4 of the 6 races in the season.

name: Åsane løpskarusell 2027 | Løp 2
description: Åsane Running Series is a recreational running series with weekly 5 km races that start and finish on the south side of the IKEA Åsane building. The course is nationally measured and suitable for all levels, with an inclusive atmosphere and qualified coaches. The series is organized by I.L. Norna-Salhus and has a long tradition of focusing on community and the joy of running. Race numbers are collected in the IKEA garage before the race, and participants can take part in individual races or the entire series.
course_highlights: 5 km course measured and certified by NFIF
Start and finish on the south side of IKEA Åsane
The course is nationally measured, with certification valid until 31.12.2026
additional: Race numbers are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45. Race numbers must be worn visibly and must not be folded or damaged. A replacement race number costs 100 kr. The race is organized by I.L. Norna-Salhus. Training sessions and races are suitable for all levels and are led by qualified coaches.

name: Vinterkarusellen (Romerike) 7. løp Nes arena
description: Vinterkarusellen på Romerike is a running series organized by Lørenskog Friidrettslag, offering competitions for all age groups, from children to veterans. The races take place at Nes arena and are part of a traditional winter series that brings together runners of all ages and abilities. Participants must have an athletics license to compete, except for children under 13, who are covered by the children’s sports insurance. The event promotes versatility and includes both sprints and longer distances.
course_highlights: Races at Nes arena in Akershus
Suitable for all age groups, from 6-year-olds to veterans
Part of a long-standing winter running series in Romerike
additional: Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics license, which must be purchased separately. Children under 13 are covered by the children’s sports insurance and do not need their own license.

name: Åsane Løpskarusell 2027 Løp 2
description: Åsane Running Series is a recreational running series with weekly 5 km races in Åsane, starting and finishing at IKEA. The course is officially measured and suitable for all levels, with experienced coaches leading the way. The series has a social and inclusive atmosphere and also offers training sessions for anyone who wants to join the running group. Race bibs are collected at the venue before the race, and you can take part in individual races or the whole series.
course_highlights: 5 km officially measured course with national certification
Start and finish inside IKEA, at the back on the south side
The course was measured by a certified course measurer on 19.11.2022
additional: Race bibs are collected in the IKEA car park between 18:00 and 18:45. Race bibs must be worn visibly and must not be folded or damaged. A replacement race bib costs NOK 100. The race is organised by I.L. Norna-Salhus. The races take place on Thursday evenings.

name: Bislett Indoor Marathon
location: Bislett Stadion, Sofies gate 38, Oslo, Norway
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maraton, Halvmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter
description: Bislett Indoor Marathon 2027 takes place from 12 to 14 February on the heated indoor track beneath the stands at Bislett Stadium in Oslo. The race offers distances from 3 km to 50 km, all run on an AIMS-certified course measuring 546.5 metres per lap. The event offers a unique opportunity to run indoors at a historic venue that has hosted the Winter Olympics and the Bislett Games. Runners of all ages and abilities can find a suitable distance in a weather-free environment.
course_highlights: Heated indoor running track measuring 546.5 metres per lap
Historic venue used during the 1952 Winter Olympics and for the Bislett Games
Distances range from 3 km to 50 km, with a joint start for the marathon and 50 km
additional: Everyone runs the same lap, but no two runners run the same race. The event is indoors and heated, so weather conditions such as wind, ice or rain have no effect. The finish line is at the entrance to the track. The marathon and 50 km start together and have a time limit of 5 hours. Shorter distances have several start times, with time limits ranging from 15 minutes to 2 hours and 30 minutes. Enter via the Training Entrance at Sofies gate 38. Participants must have an NFIF licence or purchase a one-time licence when registering.

name: 14th Dutch Coast Ultra Run by Night 50km
Bocksten TrailRun Winter
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter is a winter trail race held at Öströö Sheep Farm, featuring magical trails in the Åkulla beech forests. The race offers three distances: 5 km, 12 km and 24 km, with the 24 km distance consisting of two laps of the 12 km course. With a total limit of 600 starting places, the organizers aim to give runners a unique experience of the beauty and challenge of the winter landscape. The course offers varied terrain, including trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads in a scenic setting. Safety and respect for nature are key principles of the event.
course_highlights: Magical trails in the Åkulla beech forests amid winter scenery
Varied terrain with trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads
The 24 km distance consists of two laps of the 12 km course, making it spectator-friendly and safe
additional: Start and finish at Öströö Sheep Farm. Maximum of 600 starting places in total. Start times: 12 km at 10:00 (300 places), 5 km at 10:15 (150 places), 24 km at 10:30 (150 places). The option to purchase Startklar insurance for reimbursement in case of illness or injury. The lap course allows runners to change equipment and is spectator-friendly. The event is environmentally friendly, with a focus on not littering. In case of an accident, call 076-8159678 or 112 in an emergency. The lap section allows runners to change equipment and makes the course more spectator-friendly.

name: Snapphane Race
location: Hjortakrokskolans idrottshall, Sölvesborg, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Snapphaneracet is a challenging trail race that follows in the footsteps of the Snapphanar through the beautiful Ryssberget in Sölvesborg. The race offers several distances from 13 km to 50 km, with plenty of elevation and varied terrain, including beech forests and mossy coniferous forest trails. The winter edition offers an extra-tough challenge, with icy and muddy sections. The organizers look forward to welcoming runners for a tough and scenic experience in February.
course_highlights: Ryssberget, home to one of Sweden’s largest beech forests
Moss-covered, winding coniferous forest trails
Challenging hills and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available. Sweden Runners members and members of FysKompaniet Träningscenter receive a 15% discount on the entry fee. Startklar insurance can be purchased to receive a refund in the event of illness or injury. Name changes are possible for a fee up to 8 days before the race. Trail race in Ryssberget with distances from 13 km to 50 km, a winter challenge, course updates via GPX, headlamp required for some distances, start and finish at Hjortakrokskolans sports hall, no cups at aid stations.

name: AKVA Robust-løpet 2027
organizer: Robust Trening og Fysioterapi og Undheim IL
description: AKVA Robust-løpet 2027 is a city-centre race in Bryne offering several distances, including 5 km, 10 km in two waves, a half marathon, a relay, a children’s race and a wheelchair race. The event takes place on 13 February, with most distances starting and finishing at Bryne torg. The children’s race is an informal, untimed 800-metre run for children up to 12 years old. Facilities include toilets, changing rooms and bag drop, and good parking and transport options are available in the area.
course_highlights: City-centre race starting and finishing at Bryne torg
10 km race split into two waves based on expected finish time
Relay with 4 legs of 2.5 km each
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day, no later than 30 minutes before the start. Parking is recommended at Bryne Torg, Time rådhus and Kiwi. Facilities include toilets, changing rooms and bag drop. Children must register for the children’s race, but there is no timing. Den Robuste is a separate registration option that includes the 5 km, 10 km and half marathon. The wheelchair race is approximately 200 metres, but the distance is somewhat uncertain. The children’s race is for children aged 0–12 and is untimed. The 10 km starts in Storgata and finishes at Bryne torg. Registration is through the organiser.

name: Vinterkarusellen Nes Arena 3000m
description: Vinterkarusellen 3000m at Nes Arena is an indoor race held as part of Lørenskog’s Vinterkarusellen. The race takes place on a 200-metre athletics track at Nes Arena and is suitable for runners looking for a fast, controlled 3000-metre distance. The event is organised by Hvam IL athletics and offers a great opportunity to test your fitness early in the year in a welcoming running community.
course_highlights: Indoor 200-metre athletics track
Part of Lørenskog’s Vinterkarusellen
Held at Nes Arena in Neskollen
additional: The race is held at Nes Arena, which has a 200m indoor track. It is part of a series of races throughout the winter months. The organiser is Hvam IL athletics, which also offers group training sessions and a running community in Romerike.

name: Bieg Walentynkowy
description: The Poznań Valentine’s Day Run is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka, bringing together couples, singles, and families to celebrate Valentine’s Day through physical activity. Traditionally, it features 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as Nordic walking, with individual and pairs categories. The event is inclusive and family-friendly, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the joy of exercising outdoors.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Rusałka in Poznań
5 km and 10 km running distances, plus Nordic walking
Option to participate individually or in pairs
additional: The event also includes runs for children. It is family-friendly and inclusive, and takes place annually around Valentine’s Day by Lake Rusałka. The 12th edition has been announced for 13 February 2027 at 12:00. Prices from the 2026 edition may not apply in 2027.

name: Walentynkowo Szwungiem przez Przyłęk
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Karnawałowy
description: The Carnival Run is a 10-kilometer running event held in Puszczykowo. It combines sporting competition with running together in a carnival atmosphere and is part of the local running calendar. It’s an option for people who want to spend their time actively and take on a 10 km course.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
The race takes place in Puszczykowo
The event has a carnival theme

name: Bieg Walentynkowy Run in Sopot II
description: Valentine’s Day Run - Grand Prix of the Tri-City 2/3 - Run in Sopot II is a cross-country race held on Sopot beach, starting near the pier. Participants run towards Gdańsk and back, enjoying scenic coastal views. The event is part of the Winter Grand Prix of Cross-Country Races in Sopot series and includes age categories for runners and Nordic walkers. The race office is located in the concert shell at Skwer Kuracyjny, and the race starts at 10:00.
course_highlights: Cross-country route along the beach with sea views
Start and finish near the pier in Sopot
Run towards Gdańsk and back
additional: The participant limit is 600. The race office is located in the concert shell at Skwer Kuracyjny, before the entrance to the pier. The Nordic walking start is 5 minutes after the race start.

name: XVI Bieg Górski
description: The 16th Leszno–Grzybowo Mountain Run is a forest trail race organised by the „Aktywna Trz” Physical Culture Association. The event takes place in the scenic area around Leszno and Grzybowo, offering participants a challenging route through forest terrain. It is held regularly and is popular with mountain runners. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities on natural trails and enjoy some time outdoors.
course_highlights: A forest route with a mountain-running character
Scenic areas around Leszno and Grzybowo
A challenging run on natural terrain
additional: The edition scheduled for 13 February 2027 is listed as the 17th Leszno–Grzybowo Mountain Run.

name: AVT Valentijnscross
description: The AVT Valentine Cross in Wierden is a challenging cross-country race held at Het Lageveld. The course runs over a sandy beach, grass, hills and through the woods of Het Lageveld recreational park. The terrain is mostly unpaved and varied, making for a surprising and diverse running experience. The race is part of the MD Stoffering CrossCircuit van het Oosten and attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Course over a sandy beach, grass, hills and through the woods
Mostly unpaved, varied terrain
Changing surfaces make for a challenging cross-country race
additional: Pre-registered participants can collect their race number with timing chip at the pickup desk. Circuit participants may keep their race number with timing chip for subsequent races. On-the-day registration is possible until half an hour before the start. Spikes are not permitted because of the timing mats. The race number must be worn visibly on the front. Dogs and unregistered companions may not take part. In extreme weather conditions, the organisers may decide to cancel the race without refunding the entry fee. Cross-country race held at Het Lageveld recreational park in Wierden, with distances of 10 km and youth distances of 1.5 km and 2.5 km, usually in February.

name: Krokusloop
description: The Duinloop Circuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, featuring varied courses that combine challenging dune trails with fast beach sections. The Krokusloop, part of this series, offers a great atmosphere for both dedicated runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. With distances for different ages and ability levels, the event is open to everyone who wants to enjoy running at its best.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune trails and beach sections
Unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all ages and ability levels
additional: Start times by distance: 500m Kids Run at 09:30, 1 km Kids Run at 09:35, 2 km Kids Run at 09:45, 5 km and 10 km at 10:00. Rankings are maintained for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men, based on the four best results in the circuit. Varied course with dune trails and beach sections, part of a series of running events along the coast.

name: Polderrun
description: The Polderrun is a sporting running event in the heart of Bleskensgraaf, bringing together participants from the region and beyond. The race offers several distances, including 3.5, 7, and 10 English miles, on a fast, fully paved course through the open polder. The Polderrun is known for its atmospheric start and finish in the middle of the village, and for the combination of nostalgia and renewal in the course. The event also supports a good cause, Stichting Moz Kids, making a meaningful contribution to vulnerable children in Mozambique.
course_highlights: Fast, fully paved course through the open polder
Long straight roads and sturdy drainage canal embankments
Start and finish in the middle of Bleskensgraaf
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 08:30 at the meeting area, De Spil. The meeting area also has a cloakroom, toilets, and limited shower facilities. Timing is provided by an Ipico chip in the race number, which measures net running time. There is a drink station at kilometer 8.1 of the 10 English Miles. Parking is available at three locations in Bleskensgraaf, with Melkwegplein and Weideweg preferred. Race-day registration is not possible. Registration for 2027 has not yet been announced, but the event is popular and sells out quickly. Facilities include parking, first aid, and Ipico timing. There is also an option to donate to a good cause.

name: Nacht van Groningen
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16.1 km, 16 km, 10 km, 5 km

name: Bertlicher Straßenläufe
description: Die Bertlicher Straßenläufe in Herten sind eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die verschiedene Distanzen von 850 Metern bis zum Marathon anbietet. Die Rennen finden auf flachen, asphaltierten Strecken rund um Bertlich statt und sind sowohl für Hobbyläufer als auch für ambitionierte Athleten geeignet. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch ihre familienfreundliche Atmosphäre, die Möglichkeit zur Online-Anmeldung und die vielfältigen Laufangebote aus. Veranstaltet wird das Event vom SuS Bertlich 1945 e.V. und bietet eine schöne Gelegenheit, die Laufgemeinschaft in einer malerischen Umgebung zu erleben.
course_highlights: Vielfältige Distanzen von 850 Metern bis zum Marathon
Flache, asphaltierte Strecken durch das Naherholungsgebiet Bertlich
Familien- und hobbyfreundliche Veranstaltung mit Kinderaktivitäten
additional: Das Event findet am 14. Februar 2027 statt, mit Anmeldung vor Ort möglich, und bietet eine freundliche Laufatmosphäre für alle Altersklassen.

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice is the winter edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska. The event takes place in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden, where participants can enjoy the beauty of nature and the scenic course. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running and exceptional locations, offering runners unforgettable sporting experiences. The event attracts both recreational and more experienced runners who want to spend time actively in a winter setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Przelewice Dendrological Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings
Winter race edition with a unique atmosphere
additional: Registration for the main distance and children’s race has closed. The organizers emphasize the scenic appeal of the locations they choose and the promotion of cross-country running. The 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka is planned for summer 2026. The previous edition featured a main distance and children’s races.

name: Dinkelcross
price_range: Inschrijving via inschrijven.nl, geen expliciete prijs vermeld
description: The Dinkelcross is a beautiful cross-country race organised by Iphitos in the De Zandbergen woodland and nature area in Losser. The race is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie and offers challenging, entirely unpaved courses featuring sandy stretches, short, steep hills and a route along a branch of the River Dinkel. Various distances are available for both young people and adults, ranging from 1 km to 10 km. The Dinkelcross is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants and embraces the Olympic ideal that taking part is more important than winning. After the race, participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and homemade cake at the Zaandhoes, the start and finish location.
course_highlights: Entirely unpaved course through the De Zandbergen woodland and nature area
Crossing a sandy stretch and tackling a few short, steep hills
Running alongside a branch of the River Dinkel
additional: A maximum of 150 runners can enter on the day; late registration is not possible. The start and finish are at the Zaandhoes, accessible from Grensweg. Changing facilities and showers are available. Start times for the various distances and age categories are scheduled between 10:30 and 12:45. Unpaved course, various distances, start and finish at the Zaandhoes, changing facilities and showers available, suitable for all levels

name: Noord-Aa Polderloop
location: Road Runners clubhuis, Zoetermeer, South Holland, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname kost 4 euro voor de 1,5 kilometer

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname kost 7,50 euro voor de 5 kilometer

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname kost 10 euro voor de 10 kilometer

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname kost 15 euro voor de 15 kilometer

description: The Noord-Aa Polder Run takes place on Sunday, 14 February 2027, at the Road Runners clubhouse in Zoetermeer. The course runs through the polder landscape around the Noord-Aa and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. There are several distances: a 1.5 km kids’ run and 5, 10 and 15 km races, so everyone can choose a suitable goal. Proceeds from the event go to IKC Het Zwanenbos to support the education and well-being of children in the region.
course_highlights: Course through the polder landscape around the Noord-Aa
Route past water, open polder landscape and paved paths
A range of distances from 1.5 km to 15 km
additional: Each distance starts at a different time to keep the course clear: 1.5 km at 12:30, 5 km at 13:00, 10 km at 13:10 and 15 km at 13:20. Registering in advance is recommended to guarantee a starting spot. The event is made possible in part by sponsors; prospective partners can get in touch via the email address provided. The course runs through the polder around Zoetermeerse Plas, not on an athletics track, and is suitable for different ability levels, with a focus on having fun and supporting good causes.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held annually at RCN camping Zeewolde. The event has grown in recent years and attracts runners from the region. It offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere for participants of different levels. Photos and results from previous editions are available via the official Facebook page and website.
course_highlights: Run in the area around RCN camping Zeewolde
Distances of 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
Start time of 11:00 for the 5 km and 10 km
additional: The 5 km and 10 km start at 11:00. In previous editions, the 5 km and 10 km filled up quickly, with open registration for the 1 km and 2 km until 12:00 on race day. Held on the second Sunday of each month in November, December, January and February at RCN camping Zeewolde. Four distances: 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. Medals for kids and participants who take part in multiple races. Minimum ages vary by distance.

name: Hamarkarusellen vinter Løp 5
price_range: 100 kr for ett løp; 360 kr for alle 6 løp

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Kr 360,- for alle 6 løp i karusellen, betales ved påmelding

description: Hamarkarusellen Vinter is a winter running series in Hamar consisting of six races on a certified 5-kilometre course in the Prestrud area. The course follows illuminated pedestrian and cycle paths and is suitable for all levels, whether you walk, jog or run. Everyone is welcome, from recreational runners to competitive athletes, with a focus on the joy of running, personal achievement and socialising throughout the winter. The start and finish are at Prestrudhallen, where simple refreshments and facilities are also available. Gun time is used for rankings, but net time is shown in the results list.
course_highlights: Certified 5-kilometre course on illuminated pedestrian and cycle paths in the Prestrud area
The course mainly follows a separated pedestrian and cycle path, with some pavement along low-traffic streets
Start and finish at Prestrudhallen, with access to toilets and a common area for bib collection and refreshments
additional: A unique mug is awarded to participants who take part in all six races. Juice and often cake are served at the finish area. Prestrudhallen has basic indoor changing facilities and toilets, but participants are advised to shower at home. Results include live split times via EQ Timing. Registration via EQ Timing is open until the start. The course is cleared of snow and gritted as needed; a reflective vest is recommended, but a headlamp is not necessary.

description: Frikarusellen is a race series organised by IL Fri, with the start and finish at Espeland sports ground in Arna, Bergen. The course is 5 km long and was officially measured in 2000 and again in 2018. It runs from north of the Londalskrysset junction to Gamle Haukeland station and back along the same route. The series consists of several races throughout winter and early spring, and is suitable for both young people and adults. It is a long-standing event with good opportunities to compare your performance with previous records.
course_highlights: 5 km officially measured course starting and finishing at Espeland sports ground
The route passes Gamle Haukeland station and returns along the same route
The race takes place in Arna, Bergen, with several dates in winter and spring
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A licence fee is charged in addition for participants over 13 without an annual licence. A fee of NOK 50 applies if you forget your race number, for those registered for all races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. Registration via EQ Timing is open until 18:55 on race day.

description: Frikarusellen is a race series organized by Idrettslaget Fri, with the start and finish at Espeland sports ground in Arna. The course is 5 km long, first officially measured in 2000 and remeasured in 2018. It runs from north of the Londalskrysset intersection to Gamle Haukeland station and back along the same route. The race is suitable for both young people and adults, and several races are held in the series throughout winter and spring. Registration is via EQ Timing, and race numbers are collected on race day at Espelandshallen. The series has a welcoming atmosphere and enthusiastic members, and offers high-quality races in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km officially measured course
Starts north of the Londalskrysset intersection and returns along the same route
Finish inside Espeland sports ground
additional: Race numbers are assigned when you register online and can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A license fee applies for participants over 13 who do not have an annual license. There is a fee of 50 kr for those who forget their race number after registering for all races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. The stated distance is 5 km.

name: Bislett Distanseserie s3r2 - 5000m/10000m 2027
description: Bislett Distance Series s3r2 is a race held at Bislett Stadium in Oslo, with distances of 5,000 meters and 10,000 meters. It is part of a popular distance series that attracts both recreational and competitive runners. The race takes place on a classic athletics track and offers a great opportunity to test your fitness early in the year in a welcoming environment. The event is well organized and suited to anyone looking for a fast and enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Bislett Stadium, an iconic athletics track in Oslo
The distances are 5,000 meters and 10,000 meters on the track
Well suited to both recreational and competitive runners

name: Botaniczna Piątka
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu Zielonogórskiego, Zielona Góra, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by running enthusiasts who focus on the aesthetic qualities of their routes. The event takes place in scenic locations, such as the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden in Zielona Góra. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a unique atmosphere and the chance to spend time actively outdoors. The organizers promote running and make cross-country routes appealing.
course_highlights: Cross-country route through the University of Zielona Góra Botanical Garden
Scenic, attractive surroundings along the route
The autumn route follows a two-lap course
additional: The race takes place on a two-lap course. The organizers celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka in 2026. The event is part of a series of cross-country races held at various locations in Wielkopolska and beyond.

name: TRB Nighttrail
description: A running adventure under the stars! Trailrunners Brabant is organising the second edition of the TRB Nighttrail: an enjoyable and challenging run across Luchense Heide and the Gulbergen estate. With your headlamp on, run through dark woods, along beautiful paths and singletracks, over sand and grass, beside the water, and uphill to 't Dak van Brabant, with views of the surrounding area. Choose between approximately 12 km (start: 20:00) and approximately 18 km (start: 19:30).
additional:
Start and finish are at the De Arendshorst cabin of the Neil Armstrong Scout Group in Geldrop. You can change in a warm space, there are bathroom facilities, and we’ll provide soup after the finish. The route is marked with reflective arrows, and there is an aid station along the way.

Entry costs 14 euros; tickets are limited! For information and registration, visit:
https://www.trailrunnersbrabant.nl/nighttrail

(photos: Connie Sinteur / Ron / Maurik)

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
description: The Olęder Double Marathon is a recurring race organized by the Nowy Tomyśl Chyży Running Club, held on scenic routes around Jastrzębsko Stare. The event is part of an autumn-winter race series that passes through various towns, offering participants varied and challenging courses. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners looking to test their endurance over the marathon distance. The organizers foster a welcoming atmosphere and support runners at every stage of preparation and competition.
course_highlights: Scenic routes around Jastrzębsko Stare
Varied and challenging running sections
Part of a regional autumn-winter race series
additional: The Olęder Double Marathon is co-financed by the Nowy Tomyśl County. Registration for the races usually opens several months before the event. The event takes place on weekends, and the routes change as the series moves to different locations. It is part of a series held in the autumn-winter period; the available information about the format comes from the 2025/2026 edition.

name: XI Bieg Zaślubinowy
description: The 11th Betrothal Run “From Haller to Haller” is a much-loved race linking the two monuments to Józef Haller in Władysławowo and Puck, and kicking off the running season in the region. Set against a picturesque seaside backdrop, the event offers participants a unique atmosphere and professional organization. It’s a race for everyone who wants to start the season actively, without unnecessary pressure, in a friendly atmosphere. The course is well prepared and accurately measured, as confirmed by numerous positive participant reviews.
course_highlights: A course linking the two monuments to Józef Haller in Władysławowo and Puck
Picturesque seaside scenery
Accurately measured and professionally prepared courses
additional: The event is part of the Puck Running Triad and the STONE TRI & RUN series. Enjoy a relaxed, pressure-free atmosphere, with prizes and additional attractions such as massages and refreshments. This event is for runners of all abilities.

name: Sztafeta Pomocy
description: The Sztafeta Pomocy is a charity running event organized by the Sportplus Foundation to support children’s rehabilitation. The race takes place in the scenic Marcelin Forest in Poznań, on a forest route approximately 3.3 km long. Participants compete in teams of four, and the event promotes physical activity and social integration. It is a unique opportunity to combine sport with helping those in need.
course_highlights: A route approximately 3.3 km long along the paths of Marcelin Forest
100% forest surface
Start and finish on the clearing on the side of Strzegomska Street
additional: The limit is 125 teams of four. Participants must be at least 15 years old; those under 18 need parental consent. The time limit for completing the route is 2 hours. The route remains open to pedestrians, and medical staff are on hand to ensure safety. The fundraiser supports the rehabilitation of Oliwier Jabłoński. The route map is available on AllTrails.

name: XI Bieg Zaślubin Polski z Morzem
description: The 11th Run to Commemorate Poland’s Wedding to the Sea is a historic race linking two monuments to Józef Haller, from Władysławowo to Puck. The route is inspired by the events of 1920 and marks the opening of the Puck Running Trilogy. Organized by STONE TRI & RUN, the race is a signature event that kicks off the running season in the Pomeranian region. Participants can expect professional organization and a rich program of accompanying events.
course_highlights: Historic route from Władysławowo to Puck
Route linking two monuments to Józef Haller
Opening event of the Puck Running Trilogy
additional: Participants receive a race guide containing the current route, a site map, rules and tips for runners, information about bus departures and parking, the event schedule, and start lists. In the 2026 edition, the race distance was 11.5 km; a Nordic Walking event over the same distance was also held.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplas, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a running series consisting of three races in November, January and February, held around the beautiful locations of Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, with special youth distances of 400 and 1000 metres on the athletics track. The course is almost entirely traffic-free and runs through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas, making it suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The start and finish are always on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers and a cafeteria are also available. Official timing is provided by MyLaps. Refreshment stations are available on the longer distances, with water at the finish.
course_highlights: Almost entirely traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with changing rooms and showers
Official timing by MyLaps and refreshment stations on the longer distances
additional: There is a time limit of 2 hours for the 5 and 10 km walking distances. Walkers start at the same time as the 20 km running race. Youth runners have special distances of 400 m and 1000 m on the track, with a free commemorative item. A massage room offers free massages from Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn (bring your own towel). The cafeteria is open, and a limited number of lockers are available. Runners in the 15 and 20 km races pass a refreshment station on the track at the start of their second lap. On race day, registration is available in the cafeteria from 9:30 a.m. The races take place in winter conditions and offer options for walkers and young participants, with a maximum time limit of two hours for the walking distances.

name: WoolderEsloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voor-inschrijving is alleen mogelijk via de website en sluit op 3 januari 2027.

description: The Wooldereslopen is a traditional running competition organised by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held during the first months of the year. Distances range from 1.4 to 15 kilometres, and the course runs through the countryside around Hengelo. The start and finish are at the same location in the Woolderes, creating a clear and friendly atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres
Start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes
additional: Electronic timing. Race numbers can be collected from 9:00 a.m. on race day or on the preceding Saturday. T-shirts can be ordered as an optional extra. Shower facilities are available at Gymzaal Woolderesweg. Participation is at your own risk. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. The Wooldereslopen consists of four races held every three weeks during the first months of the year. Participants can enter the 1.4 km, 5.1 km, 10 km and 15 km distances. The organisers emphasise the friendly atmosphere and the course through the countryside around Hengelo.

name: Engbergenloop 2027
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 1.2 km

name: Necon Vinterkarusellen Bergen - løp 6
description: Necon Winter Series Bergen is a winter running series with eight races throughout the winter. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances. The start and finish are at Fana Stadium, with races starting at 18:45. The races are held on Mondays from October to April, and discounts are available for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and discount codes are available for different membership groups.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Choice of 5 km or 10 km distances
Races are held on winter evenings, starting at 18:45
additional: IL Gneist members can use the codes Gneist00 for a free race, Gneist50 for 50% off, and Gneist25 for 25% off. Participants over 13 years old are required to have an annual licence, which can be selected during registration. Registration and payment are handled via EQ-timing. Participants can register for the full series or for individual races. IL Gneist members are eligible for discounts. Participants over 13 may need an annual licence; without one, an additional fee of NOK 50 is stated.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 6 (22. feb)
description: Necon Winter Series is a winter running series with 8 races, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 km. The races start and finish at Fana Stadium in Bergen, with a start time of 18:45. The series takes place on several Mondays from October to April and offers discounts for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and members of the athletics groups with a valid licence can participate for free.
course_highlights: 5 km or 10 km race distances
Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts are available to members of IL Gneist Athletics (free with a valid licence), Gneist Trim (50% discount), and other Gneist groups (25% discount). Discount codes must be used when registering. An annual licence costs 50 kr if not already paid. Registration is individual via EQ-timing. Starts at 18:45. An annual licence costs 50 kr if not already paid.

name: Poznań Malta #62
description: Poznań Malta is a recurring running event organized by Kiprun Poznań Runners, held in the picturesque area around Lake Malta in Poznań. The event brings together runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts, offering a friendly atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time outdoors. The route runs along the lake, providing beautiful views and comfortable conditions for both competition and recreation. It is a great opportunity to connect the local running community and promote a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Malta
Picturesque views of the lake and greenery
Friendly atmosphere for runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts
additional: The event is organized by Kiprun Poznań Runners, a group that holds regular running and Nordic walking meetups in Poznań. The event is recurring and community-oriented, promoting physical activity and having fun.

name: Esbjerg Night Trail 2026/2027
description: Esbjerg Night Trail er en serie af natløb arrangeret af Orienteringsklubben Esbjerg i samarbejde med lokale partnere. Løbene foregår i mørke skove omkring Esbjerg og Fanø, hvor deltagerne løber med pandelampe på varierede trailruter på cirka 5 eller 10 km. Serien består af otte løb fordelt over efterår og vinter, og løbene byder på udfordrende terræn med mulighed for mudder og snavs. Efter løbene er der hyggeligt samvær med drikkevarer og sponsorgaver fra Eventyrsport. Løbet er åbent for alle, der ønsker en løbeudfordring i nattemørket, og børn under 15 år skal følges med en voksen.
course_highlights: Løb i mørke skove omkring Esbjerg og Fanø
Trailruter på ca. 5 eller 10 km med mulighed for mudder og snavs
Løb med pandelampe i efterår og vintermørke
additional: Løbene afholdes typisk kl. 19.00 med startsteder annonceret på Facebook kort før løbet. Der løbes 1 eller 2 omgange på ca. 5 km hver. Efter løbet serveres der lidt at drikke, evt. varmt, og der er mulighed for at vinde sponsorgaver. Deltagere under 15 år skal være ledsaget af en voksen. Første afdeling starter fra Eventyrsport med gode rabatter og mulighed for at prøve trailsko. Startsted: Orienteringsklubben Esbjergs klubhus, Grådybparken 19, 6700 Esbjerg. Starttidspunktet er typisk kl. 19.00. Deltagere under 15 år skal følges med en voksen.

name: Vinterkarusellen (Romerike) 8. løp Lillestrøm
description: Vinterkarusellen på Romerike is a running series organized by Lørenskog Friidrettslag, offering races for all age groups, from children to veterans. The races take place in Lillestrøm and the surrounding area and are part of a traditional winter series that brings together runners of all ages and abilities. Participants must have an athletics license to compete, ensuring insurance coverage and medical assistance if needed. The event promotes versatility and combines training and competition in a social setting.
additional: Participants aged 13 to 80 must purchase an athletics license individually. Children under 13 are covered by the child sports insurance and do not need their own license. Lørenskog Friidrettslag has training groups for different age groups and ability levels, and organizes several running and athletics events in the area. Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics license; children under 13 are covered by the Child Sports Insurance.

description: The Bergen Marathon Series consists of six races throughout the year, with participants able to run either the half marathon or the full marathon. Bergen is considered Norway’s number one marathon city, and the series places great emphasis on quality and runner enjoyment, even though the races present tough challenges. Complete five of the six races in the series and you will receive a commemorative plaque. The February Marathon is the second race in the series and takes place during the winter months, offering a great opportunity to test your fitness early in the year.
course_highlights: The races take place in Bergen, known as Norway’s number one marathon city
The series consists of six races, with both half marathon and full marathon distances
The courses are quality-assured with a national course certificate and an IAU label
additional: Kondis members receive a NOK 50 discount. You can provide your year-round licence from the Norwegian Athletics Federation to avoid paying for a one-time licence. The minimum age for the marathon is 18. The Bergen Marathon Series is organised in collaboration with BFG Bergen Running Club. It is possible to rent function rooms at Fana Stadium. Complete five of the Bergen Marathon Series races and you will receive a plaque.

name: Egersund Halvmaraton
description: Egersund Half Marathon is a long-standing race in Egersund, with a half marathon and 10 km on the programme. The half-marathon course is an out-and-back route from Espelandshallen to Krossmoen, while the 10 km follows the same route for the first five kilometres before runners turn back. The race is suitable both for those who want to try a shorter distance and for those seeking a half-marathon challenge.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course starting and finishing at Espelandshallen, with a turnaround at Krossmoen.
The 10 km goes five kilometres out and back along the same route.
Water stations on the half-marathon course at 5 km, 10.5 km and 16 km.
additional: Start at the old railway walking path. Registration is only available at the start, no later than 30 minutes before the race begins. Earlier information lists awards for completing 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 races.

name: Maratonkarusellen 2027 Løp 2 Februar Maraton
organizer: Maratonkarusellen i samarbeid med BFG Bergen Løpeklubb
description: Maratonkarusellen organizes several races in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb, focusing on quality and a great experience for participants. The races include both half and full marathons, as well as other distances such as 10 km and ultramarathons. The February Marathon, held in Bergen, offers a challenging and beautiful course, starting and finishing at Fana Stadium. This race is part of a series of six races held throughout the year and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: Course starts and finishes at Fana Stadium in Bergen
Includes both half-marathon and marathon distances
Organized in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb, with a focus on quality
additional: Maratonkarusellen organizes three races in the spring and three in the fall each year. The races also include Bergen Skogsmaraton, with a 10 km distance, and Bergen Ultra, with 63.3 km and 100 km distances. Maratonkarusellen has hosted the Norwegian 100 km Championships six times. The focus is on making sure all participants enjoy themselves despite the tough challenges. Available distances are half marathon (21,097 meters) and marathon (42,195 meters).

name: 11 Bieg Pamięci Żołnierzy Wyklętych
description: The 11th Captain Witold Pilecki Memorial Run for the Cursed Soldiers is an annual running event held in Oborniki. Runners start on Droga Leśna–Przylesie Street and complete laps of approximately 2 km, running as many laps as they wish, with a minimum of two. The run lasts a maximum of 1.5 hours, and a fire siren signals its end. The evening setting gives the event a distinctive atmosphere of remembrance and reflection.
course_highlights: Start on Droga Leśna–Przylesie Street
Approximately 2 km lap with a turnaround at Juliana Kubiaka Street
1.5-hour time limit; a fire siren signals the finish
additional: Runners may complete as many laps as they wish, with a minimum of 2. The run has a time limit of 1.5 hours. A fire siren signals the end of the run. The 1.5-hour time limit is signaled by a fire siren when it ends. Information about the 2027 edition is marked as provisional in the calendar.

description: The Grand Prix Dziewicza Góra Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic route in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The course follows a 5.15 km loop entirely through the forest, with two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra. The races attract both recreational and experienced runners, bringing together a unique running community known as the “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
Passes through the event center, where spectators can cheer on runners
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted CHIP. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The event takes place as a series of six stages. Runners in the 10 km race complete two laps of the course. Children’s and youth races are held over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m, and 1,500 m. Registration at the race office is available until 10:00 only for adult races and the Nordic Walking event. The 2026–2027 edition program also includes children’s races. The organizer’s website states that registration for individual stages opens successively; a limited number of passes for the whole series are also available.

name: Mistrzowski Bieg
description: The Mistrzowski Bieg in Toruń is a 10 km race taking place on Sunday, February 28, 2027. It’s an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using personalized training plans tailored to their running level, with expert support and detailed instructions. The event is open to runners of varying experience levels who want to take on the classic 10 km distance in the picturesque city of Toruń.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging asphalt course
10 km distance in central Toruń
Option to prepare with a personalized training plan
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including daily expert support. The organizer offers a platform for managing the race listing and marketing collaboration. Runners can also work with a personal online running coach, with daily support and progress monitoring.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide cross-country running series over a distance of 5 km, held in picturesque forests and city parks. In Bydgoszcz, the course runs through Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District, giving participants the chance to compete on a permanent, proven route. The races are open to people aged 16 and over, and aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity. The start and finish are at Polana Różopole, and the organizers provide professional event support and a regular schedule.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the wooded setting of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
The route is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; parking lots approximately 1–1.5 km from the start are recommended. In the 2026/2027 season, races in Bydgoszcz take place in Myślęcinek Forest Park of Culture and Recreation and the Żołędowo Forest District. Registration is available online through the Competitor Portal or at the race office on race day.

name: Tropem Wilczym
description: The Tropem Wilczym Run in Zalesie is an annual running event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers, Polish heroes of the anti-communist underground from 1944 to 1963. Organized by the Ryki Municipality, the World Association of Home Army Soldiers, and the biegusiem.pl group, the run offers two distances: 1963 meters and 5 kilometers. The run starts at 11:00, and participants can honor the soldiers by running along a scenic route near Zalesie. The event is open and welcoming to runners of different ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Two distances to choose from: 1963 m and 5 km
Route near Zalesie, close to Ryki
A commemorative run honoring the Cursed Soldiers, with historical significance
additional: The run is organized by the Ryki Municipality, the Ryki branch of the World Association of Home Army Soldiers, named after Marian Bernaciak “Orlik,” and the biegusiem.pl group. The event is commemorative and patriotic in nature. A sample consent form for minors is available. Information about the run is published on its Facebook event page. Start and finish in Zalesie, close to Ryki.

name: Bieg Niezłomnych
description: The Bieg Niezłomnych in memory of Major Zenon Wechmann is an annual running event held in the Babki Forest District in Luboń, in the so-called Lasek Majoński. The event is open to different age groups, from young children to adults, with distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest participants to 5 km for older runners, as well as a Nordic walking event. It has a family-friendly, inclusive atmosphere and promotes physical activity and remembrance of heroes. Participant numbers are limited to ensure comfort and safety during the event.
course_highlights: Routes run through the scenic Babki Forest District (Lasek Majoński)
Distances for different age groups range from 250 m to 5 km
Separate children’s races, as well as races and a Nordic walking event for adults
additional: Participant limits: 100 children in the children’s races and 200 participants in total across the 1963 m race, 5 km race and Nordic walking event. Starts are scheduled from 10:30 to 12:30, divided by age category and distance. The minimum age for the 1963 m race is 14; for the 5 km race and Nordic walking event, it is 16. Fees depend on the distance and registration date.

name: Kołobrzeska Odysea
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Nadmorscy Biegacze oraz Seaside Park Hotel Kołobrzeg
description: Kołobrzeska Odysea is a new running series in Kołobrzeg, bringing together three races held by the Baltic Sea over the course of a year. Participants can take part in a half marathon, a marathon or a 10 km race, earning three unique medals that form a single design. The event offers not only sporting excitement, but also beautiful coastal views and a unique atmosphere. The organizers provide full sanitary facilities, professional timekeeping, attractive prizes and refreshments for finishers. Kołobrzeska Odysea is for runners who appreciate sport and the atmosphere of a seaside town.
course_highlights: Half marathon along the Baltic coast — 21.0975 km
Marathon or 10 km race — 42.195 km or 10 km
Beautiful coastal views of Kołobrzeg
additional: Participants receive three unique medals that form a single design. After the races, a finisher zone offers a hot meal, snacks, isotonic drinks and water. An awards gala with a quiz and prizes is held at Seaside Park Hotel. Full sanitary facilities are provided, including baggage storage, changing rooms, showers and toilets. Special discounts are available for stays at Seaside Park Hotel during the event. The organizers promise professional timekeeping, food and drinks in the finisher zone, prizes and a gala at Seaside Park Hotel.

name: Sopocki Bieg Inki
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie (MOSiR)
description: The Sopot “Inka” Run commemorates Danuta Siedzikówna, known as “Inka.” It is organized by the Sopot Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre under the patronage of the Mayor of Sopot. The event is held as part of the observances of the National Remembrance Day for the “Cursed Soldiers” and is symbolic, with no timekeeping. Participants complete a running distance of their choice, and each receives a commemorative medal. After the run, participants sing soldiers’ songs together and enjoy food from a field kitchen, creating a special atmosphere of remembrance and fellowship.
course_highlights: A run commemorating Danuta Siedzikówna, known as “Inka”
No timekeeping—the tribute is more important than the result
Group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen
additional: The run is not timed. Each participant receives a commemorative medal. After the run, there is group singing of soldiers’ songs and food served from a field kitchen. In previous editions, participants received a commemorative medal, followed by group singing of soldiers’ songs and food from a field kitchen.

name: Omloop van Noordwijkerhout
location: Sportpark De Boekhorst, Noordwijkerhout, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The HomeWizard Omloop van Noordwijkerhout is a welcoming running event held in the beautiful dune area and among the colourful bulb fields around Noordwijkerhout. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit and offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km, as well as a 1 km family run. The half marathon takes you through woodland and dunes and along paved roads, bringing nature and sport together. The venue is Sportpark De Boekhorst, which has facilities including changing rooms, showers and a bag drop. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes looking to enjoy a challenging and varied course.
course_highlights: Half marathon through dunes and flowering bulb fields
5 km and 10 km on fully paved roads alongside colourful bulb fields
Varied course through woodland, dunes and nature
additional: Start and finish at Sportpark De Boekhorst, Noordwijkerhout. Changing rooms, shower facilities and a bag drop are available. Parking is available at several nearby locations, but cycling is preferred. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit, with an attractive overall standings competition and prizes in every category. Course through dunes and bulb fields; registration via the website; start and finish at Sportpark De Boekhorst.
