description: The Rondje Strand TIEN Cross is the final race of the AV Oss ’78 Cross Competition 2025-2026, held on Sunday, 28 February 2027. The race offers a challenging course, with a short cross of approximately 5 km, a long cross of approximately 10 km, and several youth cross distances. The venue is Strand TIEN at Gielekespad 10 in Oss, where runners can enjoy an off-road course. The short and long cross start at 10:00, and the youth cross starts at 11:10. The race is open to both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Off-road course at Strand TIEN in Oss
Short cross of approximately 5 km and long cross of approximately 10 km
Youth cross with several shorter distances
additional: Registration is open until 30 minutes before the race via the registration link. The youth cross starts at 11:10. The race is part of a cross-country competition featuring multiple races in Oss and the surrounding area. There is an overall ranking for participants who take part in at least four races. Venue: Gielekespad 10 in Oss; registration closes 30 minutes before the race; courses of approximately 5 km and 10 km.

name: Berden Voorjaarsloop
description: The Berden Voorjaarsloop in Venlo is a sporting event taking place on Sunday, 28 February 2027. The race offers a wide range of distances, from 500 metres for the youngest participants to 15 kilometres for experienced runners. A special feature is that participants in the 7.5 km and 15 km races run on Scopias’s professional 400-metre athletics track, adding a unique experience. The event is suitable for all ages and abilities and offers a fresh, energetic start to spring.
course_highlights: The 7.5 km and 15 km routes run on Scopias’s professional 400-metre athletics track
Safe and clearly laid-out courses past College Den Hulster and along Hagerhofweg
Routes through green surroundings, including the petting zoo and Vrijenbroek sports park
additional: Start times range from 10:40 to 14:05, depending on the distance. There is ample bicycle parking at College Den Hulster and parking at Fontys. Parents may run alongside the youngest participants. Refreshment stations are available, and all finishers receive a medal. Distances range from 500 metres to 15 km, including youth races and a race on a professional athletics track; registration via inschrijven.nl; event in Venlo.

description: Bjørgene Running Series is a long-standing race series organized by the athletics group of Torvastad Sports Club. The 2026/2027 season will be the 19th in the series, with races held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March. The races take place in Bjørgene, Karmøy, and attract many runners of all ages. The event offers a friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with light refreshments after the finish.
course_highlights: Run through scenic surroundings in Bjørgene, Karmøy
Races are held on the first Tuesday of each month from October to March
Start at 19:00; race bibs can be collected from 18:00
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 18:00. Juice, biscuits and fruit are served after the finish. The running series is organized by the athletics group of Torvastad Sports Club and relies on volunteer efforts.

location: Bolechowo, Czerwonak, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

description: Bolechowo Na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night #73, is a free sporting event held in Bolechowo. It is an active gathering for the local community, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in a friendly atmosphere. The event takes place in the evening and is part of a series of gatherings organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. It’s a great opportunity to spend time together outdoors and connect with others.
course_highlights: Choose between 5 km and 10 km distances
An evening edition of the Active Czerwonak at Night series
Located in Bolechowo
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. This is the 73rd edition of the Active Czerwonak at Night gathering. The event is part of the Grand Prix of Czerwonak series. No information is available about participant limits, start waves, or fees.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 5. løp
description: Samnanger IL Running Group invites you to Vinterkarusellen, a friendly and sociable race starting and finishing at Nesodden. You can choose between 2 km and 5 km, with the 5 km course officially measured by NFIF. The race is suitable for all levels and paces, whether you want to compete, set a new personal best, maintain your fitness or simply enjoy a sociable run. Remember to wear reflective gear, as it is dark at this time of year.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Nesodden
Choice of 2 km or 5 km distances
The 5 km course is officially measured by the Norwegian Athletics Federation (NFIF)
additional: The race is held approximately every other Friday throughout the winter. It is a free, accessible event suitable for everyone. The running group focuses on the joy of running and community. Wearing a reflective vest is recommended because of the dark winter season. Start at 18:30. The organizer reminds participants to wear reflective gear in the dark.

name: Nes Arena 6 timers Ultra innendørs
location: Nes Arena, Årnes, Nes, Akershus, Norway
description: Nea Arena 6-hour race is an indoor ultramarathon held on a 200-meter athletics track at Nes Arena in Årnes. The race lasts six hours, and runners change direction on the track every hour for variety. This unique race offers an exciting challenge for ultrarunners looking to test their endurance in a controlled indoor environment. The event is organized by Hvam IL and is part of Hvam Runners’ races in Romerike.
course_highlights: Indoor 200-meter athletics track
The race lasts 6 hours
The direction on the track changes every hour
additional: The race takes place at Nes Arena, Melkeveien 1, 2165 Hvam. It is part of Hvam Runners’ events and training community in Romerike.

A new start every hour
You decide how many laps you run
additional: The race starts at 10:00.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running series takes place in the Puszcza Zielonka Landscape Park and promotes physical activity and environmental protection. The event is run on a 5.15 km loop, with 5 km and 10 km races and a Nordic Walking event. Children’s and youth races cover distances from 200 to 1,500 metres. The event brings together runners of different ages and abilities in a scenic forest setting, with two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra.
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop entirely through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the highest point in the Puszcza Zielonka Landscape Park
The route passes through the event village, where spectators can cheer on the runners
additional: The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30 in the building of the Łopuchówko Forest District Education Centre. The participant limit is 500. Races are held over various distances, including children’s races from 200 to 1,500 m. Participants in the 10 km race complete two laps. After runners emerge from the forest, the finish area is marked with a finish balloon, with separate lanes for runners finishing the race and those continuing for a second lap. Children’s race entries are online only. Adult race entries are also available at the race office until 10:00 on race day, subject to remaining race packs. The series also includes Nordic Walking and races for children and youth.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn forest parking, Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE is a winter running series consisting of four events, as well as Nordic Walking events, held on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests. The events offer half-marathon (21.3 km) and marathon (42.6 km) distances, along with a half-marathon-distance Nordic Walking event. The route mainly follows the blue cycling trail along the Warta River, with sections on forest paths and a short stretch of asphalt. It has a natural cross-country character, with potentially slippery and uneven sections. The start and race office are located by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, by Lake Łyse in Biedrusko. The race start is scheduled for 10:00.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route is one 21.3 km loop; the marathon is two loops.
The route mainly follows the blue cycling trail along the Warta River, as well as forest tracks and paths.
The route is cross-country, with potentially slippery and uneven sections due to leaves, puddles and mud.
additional: Race packs can be collected at the race office on race day from 7:45 to 9:30. The marathon and half-marathon routes are not officially certified. In the 2026/2027 winter season, each race has a theme, with suggested outfits and themed accents. Additional races and Nordic Walking events are also held over 5 km and 10 km distances. The start and finish are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park at 4 Poznańska Street in Biedrusko. The start is scheduled for 10:00. The race office and start/finish are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, beside Lake Łyse; free parking and bus access are available. Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30.

name: IX Chwaszczyńska 10
location: Szkoła Podstawowa im. A. Mickiewicza, Chwaszczyno, Poland
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej, Fundacja Aktywne Kaszuby oraz Sołectwo Chwaszczyno
description: The IX Chwaszczyńska 10 is a 10 km race and the prologue to the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event takes place in Chwaszczyno. In 2026, due to snowy conditions, the course was changed to a temporary 5 km loop with a hard surface of asphalt and jombo slabs. The event also includes shorter-distance races for children and young people, which are free and do not require advance registration. After the main races, the winners’ awards ceremony and a prize draw take place. The organizers prioritize participants’ safety and comfort, adapting the course to current conditions.
course_highlights: The 10 km course consists of two laps of a 5 km loop
Hard surface: asphalt and jombo slabs
Additional races for children and young people over 100 m, 300 m and 600 m
additional: The race office and baggage storage open at 08:30 in the sports hall. The children’s races start at the blue inflatable arch. A post-race recovery snack is provided after the 10 km race. The winners’ awards ceremony takes place at 12:40 in the sports hall. The prize draw is at 13:10; participants must be present with their race number. The limit for race packages for the main races has been reached, and registration is closed. Previous editions also included 5 km races and children’s races.

name: 3bergenLOOP
description: The 3bergenLOOP is an atmospheric running event in Driebergen, featuring three challenging courses: 6 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The routes follow unpaved forest trails, cycle paths and bridleways through the beautiful estates of Bornia, Heidestein and Hoog Moersbergen. The event is known for its scenic, challenging courses and its focus on sustainability, encouraging participants to bring their own reusable cups. The start and finish are at RCN Het Grote Bos, with refreshments available along the route and at the finish. The organizers ensure a well-run event with chip timing and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes along unpaved forest trails, cycle paths and bridleways
Half marathon through the estates of Bornia, Heidestein and Hoog Moersbergen
Refreshment stations with water and sports drink along the route and at the finish
additional: Race numbers are sent to the home address provided. Refreshments are available at 9 km, 15 km and after the finish for the half marathon; at 4 km and after the finish for the 10 km; and after the finish for the 6 km. No medals are awarded. Chip timing by Racetimer is included. Race numbers can be transferred via the registration website. Participants are encouraged to use their own reusable cups. Routes have been adapted due to area restrictions; registration opens in early December 2026; options are available for race number transfers and volunteering; the event takes an environmentally friendly approach with reusable cups and no medals; chip timing is included.

name: ACO van Elderen Crossloop
description: The ACO Van Elderen Crossloop is a challenging cross-country race organised by athletics club ACO Van Elderen in Ommen. The race is part of the Prins Sport-Vechtdalcrosscompetitie and takes place in the nature area around Ommen. The race starts on the athletics track, after which the course runs mostly off-road through the forest. There are three distances: 1.75 km, 5 km and 10 km, with participants running one or more laps through the forest. The cross-country race is known for its natural surroundings and varied course.
course_highlights: Start on the athletics track
Course runs mostly off-road through the forest
Three distances with different laps (blue and red)
additional: Registration is online only and open until 4 March 2027; no on-the-day registration is available. A lead cyclist will ride ahead of the runners during the race. For the 5 km and 10 km, day prizes are awarded to the first three women and men, provided by sponsors. For the youth distance (1.75 km), prizes are awarded to the first three in each category. Forest course, off-road terrain, online registration until 04-03-2027, prizes for the top three and course record

name: Halve Marathon van Haren
description: The RunX Haren Half Marathon is a spring classic, held for the 42nd time in Haren, Groningen, on Saturday, March 6, 2027. The event offers a sporty and sociable day, with distances of 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km recreational runs. The half marathon starts at 11:00 and the recreational runs at 11:20. By taking part, you support the Jeugdfonds Sport & Cultuur Groningen, which helps children from less affluent families join sports or cultural clubs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sporthal Scharlakenhof in Haren
Route through the Felland Zuid industrial estate, 1,000 meters from the finish
Strict 2.5-hour time limit for the half marathon
additional: The half marathon has a time limit of 150 minutes. The Road Traffic Act applies on the course.

name: Rondje Zwolle Marathon
description: Rondje Zwolle 2027 is the second edition of a small-scale marathon around the beautiful city of Zwolle, organised by Zwolselopers. The marathon is all about camaraderie, running together and enjoying the experience, without an emphasis on fast times or personal records. Participants can run the full marathon or sign up together and split the distance. Weekend long runs are organised to help participants train together. Fysiotherapie De Dobbe supports participants in getting fit for the start.
course_highlights: Marathon around the city of Zwolle
Small-scale event with a friendly atmosphere
Option to split the distance and take turns running together
additional: The marathon is intentionally small-scale, with a limited number of race entries. Friendly weekend long runs are organised in preparation. Fysiotherapie De Dobbe is a sponsor and provides support with injuries. The start is at Wijthmenerplas. The marathon is characterised by an informal atmosphere and training and running together with other participants.

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity, on Spokojna Street in Gdynia. The races take place in forests and urban parks, combining a city atmosphere with contact with nature. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in the overall and local standings. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and also offers races for children and young people.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests and urban parks
Location in the Gdańsk Forest District and around the Mały Kack estate in Gdynia
Races take place in the natural setting of the Tricity Landscape Park
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race bibs and chips can be collected on race day. The schedule includes the main race starting at 11:00 and CITY TRAIL Junior races for children in different age categories. A pass for the entire series also includes one free race in a city other than the main location, provided participants notify the organizers by email in advance. Register online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. The race starts at 11:00.

name: 12 Nocna Recordowa Piątka
description: Nocna Recordowa Piątka is a 5 km race held after dark in Poznań. The fast course encourages runners to chase a personal best, while the evening setting and city lights give the event a special atmosphere. It’s a great option for both ambitious recreational runners and experienced athletes.
course_highlights: 5 km distance
A fast course suited to achieving a good time
A race after dark amid Poznań’s illuminated cityscape
additional: The event takes place in the evening.

name: Bieg Kobiet
organizer: Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia w Szczecinie oraz RAZ Event
description: SANPROBI Women’s Run is an annual sporting event held in Szczecin, dedicated to active women and girls. The race follows a scenic route through Kasprowicza Park, with the start and finish on Jasne Błonia. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity and women’s strength, while bringing participants together in an atmosphere of joy and support. It includes a 5 km main race, a Nordic walking event and mini-races for younger participants. The organizers provide a varied program of activities, partner zones and attractions for the whole family.
course_highlights: The main race follows two 2.5 km loops along the paths of Kasprowicza Park
Start and finish on Jasne Błonia, a beautiful green area in Szczecin
No time limit for the 5 km distance; Nordic walking is also available
additional: Mini-races for girls up to 11 years old over 200 m and 1 km. The limit for mini-race participants is 300; once this limit is reached, registration is possible only at the race office (limit of 20 bib numbers). Official race shirts are available for both races. There is no time limit for the main race. The race and Nordic walking routes follow the paths of Kasprowicza Park. The 2026 edition offered a 5 km race, 5 km Nordic Walking and mini-races. The organizer announced that registration for the next edition would open on December 12, 2026, at 12:00.

name: Legendarna Piątka Legendarna Dycha
description: The Legendary Five and Legendary Ten are exciting races organized as part of the Toruń Legends Trilogy, held in the picturesque Old Town Market Square in Toruń. The events combine professional organization with a friendly, family atmosphere, offering participants fast courses with nationwide reach. They are an excellent opportunity to take on the 5 km and 10 km distances while enjoying the beauty of Toruń’s Old Town and local attractions.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Old Town Market Square in Toruń
Fast and exciting 5 km and 10 km distances
The race takes place in the historic city center, with views of UNESCO-listed monuments
additional: Children’s races take place at every edition; in March, they are held alongside the main race. After that date, registration is possible only at the race office. The organizer provides professional service and a friendly atmosphere.

description: The Fysio 0512 Run Drachten is a running event held in Drachten, starting and finishing on the athletics track at AV Impala. The 10 km race is the official Open Frisian Championship and takes place on a unique, certified course through the beautiful countryside around Drachten. There are also 5 km and 1.5 km kids’ run distances, making the event suitable for runners of all levels and ages. The race combines a sporting challenge with a friendly atmosphere and offers prizes for the top runners and club champions.
course_highlights: The 10 km is the official Open Frisian Championship
Certified, fast course through the countryside around Drachten
Start and finish on the athletics track at AV Impala
additional: Collect race bibs on 8 March from 9:30 at the AV Impala clubhouse. No on-the-day registration is possible; online registration is open until 1 hour before the start. Limited changing and shower facilities are available. Free parking in the immediate vicinity of Sportlaan. Prizes for the top men and women in the Open Frisian Championship 10 km and for club champions in the 10 km and 5 km (with an Impala race shirt). All participants in the 1.5 km kids’ run receive a reward. A running clinic for 5 km and 10 km runners takes place before the event, with five training sessions led by coaches. Certified course, open to recreational and competitive runners, advance registration required, no on-the-day registration.

name: Halve van Oostvoorne
location: Oostvoorne, Voorne aan Zee, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Halve van Oostvoorne is a welcoming running event taking place on Sunday, 7 March 2027, in the lively village centre and the scenic dunes of Oostvoorne. Participants can choose from a half marathon of 21.1 km, a fast 8 km, or youth races of 1 and 2 km. The paved course offers a lovely mix of nature and village scenery, with excellent facilities such as changing rooms, showers and parking close to the start. Organised by football club OVV and Voorne Atletiek, the event promises a safe, well-run day full of sporting fun.
course_highlights: Paved course through the scenic dunes and village centre
Music and activities for spectators create a festive atmosphere
Excellent facilities, including changing rooms, showers and parking close to the start
additional: The 1 km youth race starts at 11:00 (up to age 11); the 2 km race starts at 11:15 (up to age 14). The 8 km and half marathon start at 12:00. All participants receive a medal. Minimum age: 14 for the 8 km and 16 for the half marathon. Facilities: unguarded changing rooms and showers, parking, and a canteen serving drinks, sandwiches and snacks. Half-marathon course records: men 01:06.36; women 01:17.41. Parking is available close to the start, with several other parking options within walking distance. Paved course; facilities include changing rooms, showers and parking; registration is open.

It offers a wide range of distances, from a 1 km Kids Run to a challenging 30 km, making it ideal preparation for other races. The distances are measured exactly, and all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate afterwards. The start and finish are at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, where participants in every distance run one more lap of the track on their return.

Start and finish at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, with a lap of the track
Aid stations and first aid available, including on the 10 km route
additional: Start times by distance: 30 km at 10:30, 1 km Kids Run at 11:00, 16 km at 11:15, 10 km at 11:25, 5 km at 11:35, and 2 km at 11:40. name: Pomerania Winter Trail
description: Pomerania Winter Trail is a winter trail race held in the picturesque area of Szemud. The course follows varied forest paths and natural terrain, offering runners a challenge and a chance to connect with nature. The event is part of the Pomerania Sports series, known for its professional organization and friendly atmosphere. It is a great opportunity for trail running enthusiasts to test their endurance in winter conditions.
course_highlights: Forest paths and natural terrain
Winter running conditions
Picturesque area of Szemud

name: Snøkuten - Kaashagarunden
description: Snøkuten Kaashagarunden is a 6.9-kilometer cross-country race organized by Veldre Friidrett, marking the start of the 42nd season of the Vinterkarusellen Snøkuten. The race takes place in Ringsaker, Hedmark, and attracts around 100 participants despite varying weather conditions. Participants must wear a reflective vest and take care in traffic. Both timed and fitness classes are offered. The event is especially important this year, with many opportunities for exercise and competition having been cancelled.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Ringsaker, Hedmark
Distance of 6.9 kilometers
Reflective vest required; participants must take care in traffic
additional: Both timed and untimed fitness classes are available. The event attracts around 100 participants each time. The race marks the start of the 42nd season of the Vinterkarusellen Snøkuten. A reflective vest is required; a headlamp and good winter footwear may be useful.

name: Cytadela by Night # 112
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed runs held in Cytadela Park in Poznań. The runs cover a distance of approximately 5 km and attract both recreational and more experienced runners. The event combines recreation and sport, offering a great opportunity to spend an active evening in the park’s scenic surroundings. It is very popular and held regularly, creating a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: The run takes place in Cytadela Park in Poznań
Approximately 5 km with timekeeping
An evening route through scenic, green surroundings
additional: The runs are free and held regularly, with timekeeping. The event is recreational and open to everyone. Timed run.

description: The Frikarusellen is a winter running series organized by Idrettslaget Fri in Arna, Bergen. The races take place on a certified 5 km course that starts at Espeland sports ground and runs via Gamle Haukeland station, mainly on walking and cycling paths with little traffic. The series consists of six races throughout the winter and is suitable for both young people and adults, with a friendly atmosphere and a shared love of running. IL Fri has a long tradition as an organizer and also offers discounts for club members.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course between Espeland and Gamle Haukeland station
The course runs mostly on walking and cycling paths or roads with little traffic
Start and finish at Espeland sports ground
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A license fee applies in addition for participants over 13 without an annual license. A fee of NOK 50 applies for forgotten race numbers for those registered for all races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. Race-number distribution and changing facilities are available from 18:00.

description: The Frikarusellen is a race series organized by IL Fri, starting and finishing at Espeland sports ground in Arna. The course is 5 km long, first officially measured in 2000 and measured again in 2018. It runs from north of the Londalskrysset intersection via Gamle Haukeland station and back along the same route. The series consists of several races throughout the season and is suitable for both young people and adults. You can register easily via EQ Timing, and race numbers are collected on race day at Espelandshallen.

Starts north of the Londalskrysset intersection and returns along the same route
Finish inside Espeland sports ground

name: Vinterkarusellen (Romerike) 9. løp Lørenskoghallen
description: Vinterkarusellen på Romerike is a running series organized by Lørenskog Friidrettslag, offering an inclusive environment for active runners of all ages. The races take place at Lørenskoghallen and are suitable for both young people and adults, focusing on training and competition during the winter months. Participants must have an athletics license to compete, ensuring insurance coverage and medical support if needed. The series is part of the club’s broad range of athletics and road running activities, and is a great opportunity to stay in shape throughout the winter.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course
Start and finish area at Lørenskoghallen
Part of Vinterkarusellen Romerike
additional: Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics license, which can be purchased via an external link. Children under 13 are covered by the children’s sports insurance and do not need their own license. Timing with an Emit chip; a chip is not required if you do not want to be timed.

name: Bislett Distanseserie s3r3 - 3000m/5000m 2027
description: Bislett Distance Series is a welcoming running series that hosts monthly races at Bislett Stadium in Oslo. The races offer excellent conditions and a great atmosphere, and are suitable for runners of all levels. Participants enjoy a great indoor running experience at the historic Bislett Stadium, with nuts, bars and sports drink provided to everyone who registers. There is also an opportunity to run alongside others at your level, and pacers are available to help you reach your goals.
course_highlights: Indoor race at the historic Bislett Stadium
Welcoming and inclusive running series
Pacers available for different target times
additional: Everyone who registers receives nuts, bars and sports drink from Maxim. The races are held as a series, with one race per month. The focus is on making the races accessible and creating a great atmosphere.

description: Sandnesløpet is a recreational race for everyone who enjoys running, whether you want to challenge yourself, set a new personal best, or compete against friends and family. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Sandnes Idrettspark and nearby areas, with distances including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and a children’s race. The courses follow gravel roads, farm tracks, and cycle paths, offering varied terrain with moderate climbs. The event has a welcoming atmosphere and awards prizes to the top finishers in each class.

10 km course with 70 m of elevation gain via Soma and Folkvord
5 km course with 50 m of elevation gain via Vølstad camping
additional: Race bibs can be collected on the Thursday and Friday before the race between 15:00 and 19:00 at Sandnes stadion, or from 09:30 on race day. The children’s race requires registration and is untimed. Water and sports drink stations are available on the 10 km and 21 km courses. After finishing, participants in the 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races receive a banana, an apple, and a drink. Parking is recommended at the gravel field (Gymnasbanen) below Giskehallen or by the artificial turf pitch (TS Kunsten). Live results are updated continuously via EQ Timing. The registration fee and any one-time licence fee are additional.

description: Lunde Road Race is a traditional 8 km road race organized by the athletics group of IL Skade. The race follows the beautiful, flat route alongside the Telemark Canal, starting and finishing at the IL Skade clubhouse at Kåsa. The race has a long history and has been held more than 50 times, previously as part of Vinterkarusellen i Telemark. After the race, participants are invited to socialize over juice, coffee and waffles, followed by an informal prize-giving at the clubhouse, where changing rooms and showers are also available.

Start and finish at the IL Skade clubhouse at Kåsa
The race has a tradition spanning more than 50 years and is one of the oldest in the area

description: Edsvidsleden Trailrun is a classic trail race in Trollhättan, offering a beautiful and challenging 14 km course along the Edsvidsleden trail. The start and finish are at Forngården, and the course follows a marked hiking trail with some sections additionally flagged. The race is open to everyone who wants to experience trail running on lovely paths, with water available at two stations. It is a well-organised race with a long tradition and a friendly atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners.

The course follows a marked hiking trail, with some sections additionally flagged

All participation is at your own risk and permits the publication of photos and videos on social media. The event is a trail race on marked paths, with water stations, no chip timing and a prize ceremony for the top finishers. Participants are advised to bring their own cup and water.

name: Königsforst Marathon
description: One of Germany’s six oldest marathons. With 17 small start groups from 08:45 to 14:00. With prizes for course and age-group records. With a single entry fee for all three distances, so you can switch distances at any time at no extra cost. With a reforestation initiative to offset the environmental impact of travel. With a DLV-certified course through nature.
additional:
The course:
The loop through the Königsforst includes several sections of the original 1973 course. The website has a dynamic GPX map of the course and an option to download the GPX file.

The course has only two longer, steeper climbs:

From km 3 to km 4, the route climbs 28 m to “Monte Troodelöh” (Cologne’s highest point). It then descends to the first aid station at km 5.
After km 15, at the “Wassertretstelle” (water-treading pool), you climb 40 m over a distance of 630 m. The third aid station comes shortly afterwards.

You reach the highest point shortly after the third aid station. From here, the route is flat along the path of the former railway line back to Bensberg. In the final kilometre, it leaves the forest after the underpass. 400 m before the finish, turn right and head up Schloßfeldweg.

name: Cross Śrem Grand Prix

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – przy zapisie online na jeden bieg

description: Cross Śrem Grand Prix is a series of cross-country races held in woodland near the Orlik sports field in Psarskie, Śrem. The approximately 5.4 km course runs along forest paths and paved paths, offering runners a chance to enjoy nature and a unique atmosphere of sporting competition. The start and finish are in the same location, making it easier to organise the event and cheer on the runners. Participants receive a medal, a recovery meal and prizes in the age-group categories. The race is organised by Śremski Sport together with the Municipality of Śrem and the Konstantynowo Forest District.
course_highlights: An approximately 5.4 km course along forest paths and paved paths
Start and finish at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie—a single location for the convenience of runners and spectators
A race through woodland close to the centre of Śrem
additional: The race office, warm-up and official opening take place at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie. The warm-up and opening are scheduled for around 11:45. Participants have access to water, hot tea and coffee in the new building with changing rooms. The start and finish are at the Orlik sports field in Psarskie.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful forest setting beside Lake Szmaragdowe in Szczecin. The varied course includes several uphill and downhill sections, making the race appealing to both beginners and experienced runners. The races are part of a series that promotes outdoor physical activity and allows participants to compete on the same course throughout the season. The start and finish are by Zajazd Szmaragd, and the race office is located next to the start.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the forest setting beside Lake Szmaragdowe
Varied uphill and downhill sections, including the most difficult stretch about 1.7 km from the start
The start and finish are located behind Zajazd Szmaragd on Kopalniana Street
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and the main race starts at 11:00. Before the race, there is a group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors. The series consists of 7 locations, with 4 races at each, and includes overall and local standings. Participants must be at least 16 years old or, if younger, have parental consent. The organizer lists the Szczecin dates for the 2026/2027 season as October 18, November 15, January 10, and April 4; March 14 is listed on the calendar for Katowice. CITY TRAIL Junior races accompany the main race.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
location: Wapnica, Międzyzdroje, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, friendly, family-oriented sporting event that invites running and nordic walking enthusiasts to compete on courses of approximately 5 and 10 km for runners and 5 and 7 km for nordic walking participants. Participation is free, and participants can enjoy healthy competition in a fun atmosphere on the beautiful routes of the Międzyzdroje Municipality. To be included in the overall standings, participants must complete the required distances in at least four events. Both regulars and newcomers are welcome to run and walk together.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Beautiful routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors may participate with written consent from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be ranked in the league, participants must enter at least four events and complete the required distances: two 5 km and two 10 km races, or two 5 km and two 7 km nordic walking events. The league is known for healthy competition in a friendly, family atmosphere full of smiles and fun. The official schedule lists the March round in Wapnica on 21 March 2027, not 14 March. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete at least four events; the minimum age is 14.

name: Murowana Goślina Półmaraton
organizer: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Murowanej Goślinie
description: The Murowana Goślina Half Marathon is a historic race dating back to 1978. Initially organized for masters athletes, it is now open to everyone who wants to take on the half-marathon distance of 21.097 km. The race has a rich tradition and runs through the scenic surroundings of Murowana Goślina. After a break caused by the coronavirus pandemic, the race was revived in 2025 by the Centre for Culture and Sport in Murowana Goślina.
course_highlights: A classic half-marathon distance of 21.097 km
Scenic surroundings of Murowana Goślina
A tradition dating back to 1978, with a history of races for masters athletes
additional: The race is open to everyone, not just masters athletes. Entry fees increase across three registration periods, and registration is also available at the race office for a higher fee. The half-marathon has a long tradition and has been organized intermittently since 1978. The event is part of the Grand Prix series. The entry fees listed on the website are 99 zł, 119 zł, or 139 zł for the successive registration periods, and 200 zł at the race office.

name: Półmaraton i Piątka Raduni
location: Centrum Kultury i Sportu, ul. Chopina 34, Pruszcz Gdański, Poland
description: The Pruszcz Gdański Half Marathon and the Piątka nad Radunią are annual running events held in Pruszcz Gdański. Both race courses are certified by the PZLA, and the start and finish are located at the Centre for Culture and Sport. Runners start in time zones based on their declared finish time, making for a more comfortable race. After the races, there are award ceremonies and a prize draw, creating a friendly atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified half-marathon and 5 km courses
Start and finish at the Centre for Culture and Sport in Pruszcz Gdański
Start divided into time zones based on declared finish times
additional: The start takes place in front of the Centre for Culture and Sport building, with runners divided into time zones based on their declared finish time (red, blue and yellow). The race office is in the Centre for Culture and Sport’s glass-enclosed terrace; bag drop and changing rooms are inside the building. Parking is on the stadium grounds, with access from Bora-Komorowskiego Street. Award ceremonies and the prize draw take place after the races. In previous editions, the start, finish and race office were at the Centre for Culture and Sport, ul. Chopina 34. The courses were certified by the PZLA.

name: NN CPC Loop Den Haag
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organised by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. It consists of four races held during the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer cash prizes and gift vouchers. Electronic timing is provided, and race numbers can be collected in advance or on race day.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes
Distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 9:00 at IKC De Wooldermarke, Semmelweisstraat 46, 7555 NT Hengelo. The race number includes a timing chip and must be worn on the chest. A running shirt and medal are available as optional extras when registering in advance. Shower and changing facilities are available at Gymzaal Woolderesweg and close at 13:15. Race numbers can be collected on the preceding Saturday or on race day. Participants use the same race number for all four races. The standings are based on at least 3 of the 4 races. Bringing animals or pushchairs and using earbuds/headphones is discouraged or not permitted. Registration opens at 9:00, and the courses run through the countryside around Hengelo. Results from previous years are available, and the event has been organised for more than 45 years.

name: Necon Vinterkarusellen Bergen - løp 7
description: Necon Vinterkarusellen is a running series in Bergen, starting and finishing at Fana Stadium. In Race 7, you can choose between 5 and 10 kilometres, with a mass start and a course that heads from the stadium towards Sandsli and Kokstad. Join a winter race and choose the distance that suits you.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Choose between 5 and 10 kilometres
The course heads towards Sandsli and Kokstad
additional: The race starts at 19:00, with waves based on expected finish time. An extra wave starts at 18:45 for participants who expect to take over one hour to complete 10 km. Choose your distance at the turnaround after 2.5 km.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 7 (15. mar)
description: Necon Vinterkarusell is a winter race series consisting of 8 races, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 km. The races start and finish at Fana Stadium in Bergen, with a start time of 18:45. The series runs on several Mondays from October to April and offers discounts for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and members of the athletics groups who pay the training fee can participate free of charge.
course_highlights: 5 km or 10 km races
Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts for IL Gneist members are available with various discount codes. An annual licence fee of NOK 50 applies if it has not already been paid. Registration is via EQ-timing with individual registration. Member discounts are available for various IL Gneist memberships. The annual licence costs NOK 50 if it has not already been registered.

name: Hamarkarusellen vinter Løp 6
description: The Hamarkarusellen Winter Series is a running series for everyone, whether you are an experienced runner, a recreational runner, or simply looking to get outside for some fresh air. The series consists of six races over the winter months, all on the same 5 km course, starting and finishing at Prestrudhallen in Hamar. The races focus on activity, achievement, and socializing, and everyone is welcome regardless of pace—you can run, jog, walk, or combine them. Participants who take part in at least four of the six races receive a finisher’s prize. The event offers a friendly atmosphere, with gingerbread and cordial at the finish.
course_highlights: Six races on the same 5 km course, starting and finishing at Prestrudhallen in Hamar
The course is suitable for running, jogging, and walking
A social and motivating winter series focused on achievement and activity
additional: A finisher’s prize is awarded to everyone who takes part in at least four of the six races. Participants are encouraged to wear a Santa hat, and gingerbread and cordial are served at the finish. The member price applies to members of corporate sports clubs and individual members of the Innlandet Regional Corporate Sports Association. Everyone is welcome, with an accessible format and room for all levels. Registration is available for individual races or the entire series.

name: Åsane løpskarusell 2027 | Løp 4
description: Åsane running series is a recreational running series with weekly 5 km races in Åsane, Bergen, starting and finishing at IKEA. The course is nationally certified, suits all levels, and is led by experienced coaches. The series has a social and inclusive atmosphere and also offers training sessions for those who would like to join the running group. Race numbers are collected on site before the races, and family and individual registration are available.
course_highlights: 5 km course, measured and nationally certified
Start and finish inside IKEA, at the rear facing south
The course was measured and certified by Ivar Andreas Sandø
additional: Race numbers are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45. Race numbers must be worn visibly and must not be folded or damaged. A replacement race number costs 100 kr. The races take place on Thursdays. Start time: 19:00. Race numbers can be collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45. The start and finish are at the rear of the IKEA building, facing south.

name: Åsane Løpskarusell 2027 Løp 4
description: Åsane Løpskarusell is a recreational running series with weekly 5 km races in Åsane, starting and finishing at IKEA. The course is nationally certified and suitable for all levels, led by experienced coaches. The series has a social and inclusive atmosphere and also offers group training sessions for members. Race bibs are collected in the IKEA garage before the race, and participants can enter individual races or the whole series.
course_highlights: 5 km course measured and certified nationally
Start and finish inside IKEA, at the back facing south
The course was measured by a certified course measurer on 19.11.2022
additional: Race bibs are collected in the IKEA garage between 18:00 and 18:45. Race bibs must be worn visibly, and the timing tags must not be folded or damaged. The race is organised by I.L. Norna-Salhus. Runners use their race bib at every race. The prices listed on the information page apply to 2026 and are therefore not included as prices for 2027.

name: Equinox Adventure Ultra
description: Equinox Adventure Ultra is a unique trail-running race held during the spring equinox. The race is a long-distance experience in which teams of two runners navigate on their own and are self-sufficient through equal parts daylight and darkness. Participants can choose between a long distance of at least 100 km or a shorter distance of at least 50 km. The race starts on Saturday at 12:00 and runs until Sunday at 18:00, offering a challenging experience immersed in nature over a full day.
course_highlights: Long-distance trail running through forests and nature
Self-sufficient teams of two runners
Navigation through equal parts daylight and darkness during the spring equinox
additional: The race runs from Saturday at 12:00 until Sunday at 18:00. Each team consists of two self-sufficient runners who must navigate on their own during the race. The race is self-sufficient, with participants using a map and compass to navigate through forests, trails and open landscapes. The start location is secret, and the race takes place around the spring equinox in Nyköping, Sweden.

name: Vårtävlingarna
description: Vårtävlingarna is an annual running event held on the second Saturday in March in Skatås, Gothenburg. The classic race course is the “gravel eight,” a course just under 8 km long where participants can choose to run one, two or four laps. Since 2026, Vårtävlingarna Trail has also been held, a new trail race of approximately 16 km in the Skatås and Delsjö area. The event offers a well-organized and varied running experience, with water stations and prize ceremonies for the fastest runners in each category.
course_highlights: The “gravel eight” race course in Skatås, approximately 7.8 km per lap
Vårtävlingarna Trail: approximately 16 km of trail running in the Skatås and Delsjö area
Water stations with water and sports drink on the longer distances
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 08:30 on race day at Solvikingarna’s clubhouse. Timing is recorded using a disposable chip on the back of the race bib. Changing and shower facilities are available at Skatås Motionscentrum for a fee. Prize ceremonies take place in the finish area shortly after each category finishes. Live results are available during race day. Vårtävlingarna Trail premiered in 2026.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://vartavlingarna.solvikingarna.se/): 2027-03-13 — "Vårtävlingarna arrangeras andra lördagen i mars varje år." (was estimated 2027-03-06)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Vårtävlingarna arrangeras andra lördagen i mars varje år.

name: Frozen Lake Marathon
description: Frozen Lake Marathon is a unique running event held on the frozen surface of Lake Tisleifjorden in Norway, situated 819 meters above sea level. Participants run entirely on ice, on a course with the flattest elevation profile in the world, making it an unforgettable experience. The race is limited to 500 participants and offers both a half marathon and a full marathon. The entry includes an official long-sleeved race shirt and a medal, and warm soup with bread is served after the race. The course is carefully monitored and laid out just days before the race to ensure safety on the ice.
course_highlights: 100% ice surface on Lake Tisleifjorden, with ice about 80 cm thick
The flattest elevation profile in the world
Energy stations at several points, with sports drinks, water, energy bars, dried fruit, and chocolate
additional: Transfer is included only for participants staying at Oset Fjellhotell; a shuttle service is available at a cost from Storefjell Resort. Parking near the race area is very limited; studded tires are recommended for driving. Bag drop service is available with a bib tag. Basic changing tents and portaloo toilets are provided. Arrival by train to Gol is recommended; the official race hotel is Oset Fjellhotell. The event is limited to 500 participants. The race entry includes an official long-sleeved race shirt and a medal, and warm soup with bread is served after the race. Transfer is included for participants staying at Oset Fjellhotell; parking near the race area is very limited.

name: 6. Ekeberg Backyard Ultra
description: Ekeberg Backyard Ultra is a classic backyard ultra race held in Oslo’s “central park” at Ekeberg. The race takes place during the dark and cold time of year, giving participants the opportunity to run alongside the ultrarunning family in beautiful surroundings, with views of Oslo’s skyline and the Oslofjord. The event offers a unique atmosphere with live music, good vibes, and facilities including changing rooms and a tent. A maximum of 110 participants can take part, and everyone who completes at least one lap receives a medal.
course_highlights: Run through beautiful scenery with views of the Oslofjord and Oslo’s skyline
The event takes place at Bekkelagshøgda Tennis Club, with access to changing rooms and a tent
Live music and a great atmosphere with the ultrarunning family
additional: Participants receive a bib number and a tracker for automatic live recording of lap times. Drinks, snacks, and some hot food are served. Maximum 110 participants. The race starts at 09:00. Maximum 110 participants, and registration opens on 1 December 2026 at 00:01. Participants receive a lap-time tracker, access to the facilities and changing rooms, drinks, snacks, and hot food. A medal is awarded to everyone who completes at least one lap.

name: Piltevarden motbakkeløp
description: The Piltevarden uphill race takes place on Mjømna in Gulen municipality and has become an Easter tradition. Participants take on an uphill course towards Piltevarden in a local race that brings together both residents of Gulen and visitors. The race is held on Palm Saturday.
course_highlights: Uphill race towards Piltevarden
Start on Mjømna in Gulen municipality
The race is held on Palm Saturday
additional: The race is described as an Easter tradition, and previous editions have seen record participation and a new course record.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful woodland setting by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to advanced athletes, who can regularly test themselves on the same course. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish are near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, and the course runs through picturesque woodland and the city beach. The races are part of the Grand Prix CITY TRAIL 2026/2027 series, which includes four races in Poznań, with an overall classification and a separate classification for each city.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the woodland setting by Lake Rusałka
Start near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, with the finish by the city beach
The course is suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event follows a consistent schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. Participants can choose charity packages supporting the Siepomaga Foundation. The event receives funding from the budget of the City of Poznań. The series also includes races for children.

name: 10 KonstantyNOVA Dycha by Night
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 11th KonstantyNOVA DYCHA by NIGHT is a unique 10-kilometer race through the scenic areas of the Konstantynowo Forest District. In 2027, its night edition will be held for the second time, with runners taking on the 10 km distance after dark and required to wear headlamps or carry flashlights. Children’s and youth races take place during the day over shorter distances tailored to different age groups. The event is inclusive and charitable, with an opportunity to support a local association when collecting race packs.
course_highlights: The route passes through the scenic areas of the Konstantynowo Forest District
Night edition of the main 10 km race
Children’s and youth races over distances from 150 m to 1,000 m
additional: Children’s and youth races start at 16:30. Participants in the main race are required to have a headlamp or flashlight. When collecting race packs, participants can voluntarily support a local association by putting a donation in the collection box. The main race will take place on March 20, 2027; children’s and youth races are scheduled from 16:30. When collecting race packs, participants will be able to make a voluntary donation to support an association from the Municipality of Mosina.

name: 14 Luboń Track
location: Stadion Miejski w Luboniu, Luboń, Poland
description: The 15th Luboń Track is an athletics event held at the municipal stadium in Luboń. The event is scheduled to include races over 3000 m and 1609 m, as well as children’s races over shorter distances suited to participants’ ages. Races are divided into heats according to the times submitted at registration, with classifications by sex and age category. Timing is handled by PZLA judges, and each heat is limited to 15–20 participants. The detailed timetable will be published on the official Facebook fan page.
course_highlights: Races at the municipal stadium in Luboń
Starting heats divided according to times submitted at registration
Classifications by sex and age category
additional: Heats are assigned based on submitted times. Timing is handled by PZLA judges without photo-finish equipment. Children’s races are held in different age categories, with separate classifications by sex. The detailed timetable is published on the Facebook fan page two days before the event. Heats are assigned based on submitted times. The 1609 m and 3000 m races are for participants aged 13 and over.

name: 40 Kołobrzeska 15-stka Zaślubin
description: Kołobrzeska 15-stka Zaślubin is an annual 15 km race held in Kołobrzeg, commemorating Poland’s Wedding to the Sea and the end of the fighting for the city. Certified by the Polish Athletics Association, the course runs along scenic seaside promenades and city streets, offering participants beautiful views and sporting competition. The race has a rich tradition dating back to 1987 and attracts both experienced runners and those just starting out. The organizers provide a great atmosphere, support from partners and sponsors, and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Three laps: two longer laps of approximately 6.4 km each and one shorter lap of approximately 2.18 km
Scenic seaside promenades and Kołobrzeg streets with sea views
additional: The course consists of three laps: two longer laps and one shorter lap. The start and finish are by the IKAR and Perła Bałtyku sanatoriums. The race commemorates the 82nd anniversary of the end of the fighting for Kołobrzeg and Poland’s Wedding to the Sea. The organizers provide medical and recovery support for runners. The race is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The 41st edition is scheduled to start on 20 March 2027 at 11:30. Registration is open; the rules and course information are also available. Holders of the Kołobrzeska Resident Card can receive discounts.

name: Ultramaraton Zielonogórski
description: The Zielonogórski Nowe Granice Ultramarathon is a unique running event held in the picturesque Piast Hills in Zielona Góra. As part of the anniversary edition, participants can choose between two distances: 13 km and a new, demanding 23 km course featuring technical sections, significant elevation gain and beautiful views. It’s an excellent choice for trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience a mountain atmosphere without leaving the city. The event has a welcoming atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners, promising sporting excitement and unforgettable experiences.
course_highlights: The 13 km course features dynamic changes of pace, forest singletrack and challenging climbs
The new 23 km course has technical sections, numerous climbs and fast descents
Picturesque trails in the Piast Hills, with beautiful views and a natural trail-running character
additional: The Ultramarathon offers several running distances: 23 km, 48 km and 103 km, as well as a 103 km solo duathlon and a 103 km cycling race. The 48 km and 23 km courses start at checkpoints in Nowy Kisielin and Jarogniewice. The organizer provides professional catering during the event. GPX files of the routes are available to download.

name: VI Koleżeński Bieg Henryka Brauna
description: The 6th Henryk Braun Friendly Run is an annual running event held in Radzyny to commemorate Henryk Braun. It attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a welcoming atmosphere and the chance to compete on scenic routes. The event brings people together and promotes an active lifestyle among residents and visitors. The organizers ensure smooth event operations and participant safety.
course_highlights: The route passes through the scenic areas of Radzyny
An event that brings people together and commemorates Henryk Braun
A welcoming atmosphere for both recreational and experienced runners

name: Alfa Laval Stevensloop
description: The Alfa Laval Stevensloop is Nijmegen’s city run, taking place on 20 March 2027. The start is in the iconic Kronenburgerpark, and the finish is in the heart of the oldest city in the Netherlands. The different courses offer a varied route through the city centre, past the city island, Nijmegen’s skyline and the natural surroundings of the Ooijpolder. The event is organised by Stichting Zevenheuvelenloop, which is committed to getting as many people as possible moving and providing a great running experience.
course_highlights: Start in Kronenburgerpark and finish at the Grote Markt
Climb the Voerweg, with the Alfa Laval Cheering Zone
Varied routes through the city and nature, passing iconic landmarks such as the Stevenskerk and Ooijpolder
additional: A staffed cloakroom for small bags is available at the start in Kronenburgerpark. The Voerweg is a challenging climb near the end of the 5 km and half marathon, with a special Alfa Laval Cheering Zone where spectators and music provide extra encouragement. The Alfa Laval Hill Challenge rewards the fastest climb time on the Voerweg with a €100 gift voucher at Runnersworld.

name: Molenloop Vrouwenparochie
description: The Midseumer Molnkoier is a unique evening walk that invites walkers to enjoy nature and culture in and around Vrouwenparochie. This walking event is made possible in part by many volunteers and sponsors, with the proceeds going to a good cause. The route passes the old grain mill and winds through the beautiful Frisian countryside, offering a special experience for lovers of walking and cultural history.
course_highlights: Evening walk past the old grain mill, De Vrouwbuurtstermolen
Natural and cultural surroundings of Vrouwenparochie
Unique atmosphere during midwinter and a scenic route
additional: Entry tickets can also be purchased at the start desk. The walking event is held at the old grain mill, De Vrouwbuurtstermolen, in Vrouwenparochie. Registration is available for several distances, and participants can enjoy a course through the beautiful countryside and mill surroundings.

name: Monnikenloop
description: The Monnikenloop is an annual running race held on the beautiful island of Schiermonnikoog. The race offers several distances, including a kids’ run, 5 km, 10 km and 10 English Miles, and attracts both recreational and competitive runners. The event combines sport with a friendly atmosphere and invites participants to experience the island’s unique nature. The start and finish are centrally located, and the event places plenty of emphasis on an enjoyable weekend, with accommodation available on the island.
course_highlights: Routes across the island of Schiermonnikoog, through nature and dunes
Distances ranging from a 1 km kids’ run to 10 English Miles (16.1 km)
Start and finish in the village, in a welcoming setting
additional: Kids’ runs start from 11:20, the 5 km starts at 12:40, the 10 km at 12:50 and the 10 English Miles at 12:30. The race pack includes a race number with timing chip and a bus ticket for transport on the island. The ferry ticket must be booked separately. A running shirt can be ordered. Changes to registration are possible for a fee until the end of March. The start and finish are in the village, with changing and shower facilities.

name: Oldemeijercross
location: Recreatieplas De Oldemeijer, Hardenberg, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Oldemeijercross is one of the oldest running races in the region and is organized annually by AV Spurt'88. The race takes place around the De Oldemeijer recreational lake in Hardenberg and offers a challenging course with tough climbs, sand, and mud. This running event is for all ages, with the start and finish on the event hill at Oldemeijer. Spectators can cheer on the runners from several spots, adding to the lively, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Tough climbs along the course
Route around the De Oldemeijer recreational lake
Sandy and muddy terrain
additional: Race-day registration is possible. The start and finish are on the event hill at Oldemeijer. The course is suitable for all ages, and there are several places for spectators to cheer on the runners. The 3 km course around Oldemeijer is challenging, with climbs, sand, and mud; the start and finish are at the event hill; registration via inschrijven.nl; no showers available.

name: Reeuwijkse Plassenloop
description: The Vosplan Reeuwijkse Plassenloop is one of the oldest running events in the Netherlands and has been held for more than 70 years. Each year, the event attracts runners from the region and beyond, who enjoy an active and sociable day. The course is completely flat and has little traffic. It runs through Reeuwijkse Hout and along the distinctive Reeuwijkse Plassen, making it an appealing and fast course. There are distances for all ages, from kids’ runs to 15 kilometres, including supervised youth distances.
course_highlights: Completely flat course with little traffic
Runs through Reeuwijkse Hout and along the Reeuwijkse Plassen
Clear kilometre markers and one lap per distance (5, 10 and 15 km)
additional: MYLAPS BibTag timing is used. The chip is attached to the back of the race number and does not need to be returned. Late registration is available on race day from 10:30 until half an hour before the start. The start and finish area is at Reeuwijkse Houtwal in the De Reeuwijkse Hout recreation area. Ample parking and toilets are available. There are no changing or shower facilities. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Cash prizes are awarded for the 5, 10 and 15 km races for men and women, plus an additional prize for a course record. Registration opens on 1 January 2027 via Inschrijven.nl. The event offers prizes and keepsakes for the winners, and preparation training sessions are available. Participants can register for different distances and age groups.

name: Marathon Alblasserwaard 750
description: The Alblasserwaard 750 Marathon is a unique, one-time marathon taking place on 20 March 2027 to celebrate 750 years of Alblasserwaard history. The 42.195-kilometre route runs from the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Kinderdijk, through characteristic polders, windmills, historic waterways and villages, to the finish at AV Typhoon in Gorinchem. The marathon offers runners a special experience through the open peat-meadow landscape and past iconic windmills and duck decoys, with the region’s landscape and history at its heart.
course_highlights: Start at Kinderdijk’s 19 windmills, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Route along separated cycle paths and roads with limited traffic
Past historic waterways, polder windmills and characteristic villages
additional: Shuttle buses will run between Gorinchem and Kinderdijk for participants. Parking at the start is not possible and is discouraged. Bicycle parking is available at both the start and finish. The organisers aim to be sustainable by using biodegradable cups and cleaning the course after the event. Sweeper vehicles are available for runners who drop out. The minimum age to participate is 18. The marathon is a unique, one-time event celebrating the region’s history and beauty, with a maximum limit of 2,500 runners.

name: Dark Sky Trail Lauwersmeer
location: Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, Lauwersoog, Municipality Noardeast-Fryslân, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Dark Sky Trail Lauwersmeer is a unique nighttime running and walking event held in the official Dark Sky Park Lauwersmeer, one of the darkest areas in Europe. The race offers three events: canicross, trail running and a walking tour, all approximately 10 km long. Participants run in the dark, with headlamps permitted only in emergencies, creating a special experience. Registration raises awareness of light pollution through a donation for each participant.
course_highlights: Nighttime route in the official Dark Sky Park Lauwersmeer
Approximately 10 km for canicross, trail running and the walking tour
Headlamps permitted only in emergencies
additional: The start location and meeting point is Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, De Rug 1, 9976VT Lauwersoog. A drink is available at the finish. Estimated duration is approximately 1 hour 45 minutes for trail runners and canicross participants, and approximately 2 hours 45 minutes for walkers. night run, canicross, walking tour, 10 km, start location: Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, Lauwersoog

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Forest To The Bay Blokhus
Hamburger Halbmarathon durch das Alte Land
KÖZON21
location: Blackfoot Beach Köln / Burg Friedestrom Zons in Dormagen
description: On March 21, 2027, the inaugural Fühlingen–Zons Half Marathon gets underway. For the first time, a running event will connect Blackfoot Beach in Cologne-Fühlingen with the historic Zons customs fortress on a unique route along the Rhine.
additional: The start and finish are in different locations, and the route runs along the Rhine.
