name: Pyrzycka Szybka Dycha Bieg Smoka - Pyrzycki Bieg Dzieci
description: Pyrzycka Szybka Dycha is an annual road race held in Pyrzyce, offering two distances to choose from: 5 km and 10 km, both certified by PZLA. Participants can decide which distance to run even during the race. The event promotes an active lifestyle and encourages running, while also supporting the local community through a charity initiative. The accompanying Bieg Smoka (Dragon Run) is organized for the youngest participants over a short distance of approximately 100 m, with age categories and parental supervision.
course_highlights: Two distances: 5 km and 10 km, both certified by PZLA
Option to choose the distance during the race
Bieg Smoka for children over a distance of approximately 100 m
additional: There is no strict time limit for the 5 km distance (the limit is 1.5 hours). The race pack can be transferred to another person until 14 March 2027. Race bibs can be collected in Szczecin and Pyrzyce. New: live tracking for runners in the 5 km and 10 km races. Every participant receives a medal, including children in Bieg Smoka. Every child who finishes the race receives a commemorative medal. Bieg Smoka is part of the Pyrzycka Szybka Dycha event.

name: IV Bieg Konspiracji
location: Fort I, ul. Winna 19, Toruń, Poland
description: The 4th General Elżbieta Zawacka Conspiracy Run is a 10-kilometer race in Toruń, combining sporting competition with a tribute to its patron and the city’s history. The course runs through the grounds of Fort I and toward the General Zawacka Bridge, with the start and finish in the fort’s courtyard. Participants can look forward to a commemorative medal and a hot meal after the race. The historic setting of the Toruń Fortress gives the event a unique character.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometer course in Toruń
Runs through the grounds of Fort I
Heads toward the General Elżbieta Zawacka Bridge

name: Sztafeta Jednotë
description: The Jednotë Relay is an event held in Władysławowo that brings the Kashubian community together in a spirit of unity and tradition. It takes place as part of Kashubian Unity Day celebrations, commemorating the historical mention of the Kashubians in 1238. Participants can celebrate together, connect, and show their pride in Kashubian cultural heritage. The event includes a variety of activities, including artistic performances and traditional games that engage all generations.
additional: The race calendar lists 22 March 2027 as an approximate date, while the stated event date is 21 March 2027.

name: Szybka Piątka
description: Szybka Piątka - 5K FAST RUN is a 5 km race held in Chociule, in the Świebodzin municipality. The previous edition took place. It’s an event for people who want to test themselves over a short distance in a sporting atmosphere.

name: Kempen Run
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 6.5 km, 1 km, 0.7 km

name: Arrow Venloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: De VoorschotenLoop
description: The VoorschotenLoop is a running race organized by Voorschoten '97 Athletics, held in the beautiful village of Voorschoten. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit and is open to everyone, whatever their level. The course is fast and passes some of the village’s most beautiful spots, with various distances for children and adults. The longest distance runs through the scenic countryside, including Park Rosenburgh and Duivenvoorde Estate. There is also a special Voorschoten Championship for the fastest residents of Voorschoten.
course_highlights: Fast course passing some of Voorschoten’s most beautiful spots
5 km and GeZZinsloop through welcoming neighborhoods
10 km and 10 English miles through the countryside, including Park Rosenburgh and Duivenvoorde Estate
additional: The GeZZinsloop is free and starts at 10:15 for ages 6–9 and 10:35 for ages 10–12. The start and finish are at Sportpark Adegeest, Weddeloop 6, 2253ST Voorschoten. To take part in the Voorschoten Championship, you must live in Voorschoten and wear a green dot on your race bib, which can be collected beforehand in the canteen. There is no race-day registration. Distances range from 1.25 km to 10 English miles; registration is possible on 21 March; prizes for top participants; championship for Voorschoten residents; prepare with a beginners’ course organized by Voorschoten '97.

name: Moore DRV Halve Westland
description: The Moore DRV Half Westland is a popular half marathon in the Westland, Haaglanden and Rotterdam region, held in Naaldwijk. The race is a great way to round off the Olympus '70 Runners Project and is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The route passes through the polders and alongside greenhouses, with aid stations along the way and a lively start and finish area at the Olympus '70 athletics facility. The half marathon is part of the aaff Summer Run Circuit and offers a varied, fast and traffic-free course.
course_highlights: Route through the polders and alongside greenhouses in the Westland
Aid stations at 6.3, 12.7 and 17.5 km with water and sports drink
Start and finish at the Olympus '70 athletics facility, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Use of reusable SAW timing chips is compulsory. A chip can be ordered for €4,50 when registering. Race numbers can be collected on race day at the Van Dijk Flora indoor hall at Olympus '70. The facility has spacious changing rooms and showers. First aid is available at 17 km and at the finish. Prize-giving for various categories. Entries for the half marathon are completely sold out; the event also includes a 10 km, 5 km and a youth walk.

name: Emmy Run
description: The Emmy Run in Slagharen is a fun and accessible running event for all ages, with distances ranging from 1 to 10 kilometres. The race takes place around Cafetaria Lunchroom Emmy and offers something for everyone, from the Kids Run to a run for businesses and associations. The event is all about having fun and exercising together, with no prize money but with fun giveaways for all participants. Afterwards, there is a modest after-party in the special Emmy tent on the church square.

name: Vechtstreek in Beweging Lopen
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 20 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km

name: Löplabbets PåskeHareMaraton
description: Löplabbets Easter Hare Marathon is an annual race between the Löplabbet store at Ski Storsenter and Sandvika. Participants must bring their own nutrition and drinks, as there are no water stations along the route. Runners are responsible for their own safety and must take extra care in traffic. This race is suited to runners looking for a challenging, self-reliant marathon experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Run between the Löplabbet store at Ski Storsenter and Sandvika
No water stations along the route — bring your own nutrition and drinks
Runners must obey traffic rules and take extra care
additional: Runners must bring their own nutrition and drinks, as there are no water stations along the route. Runners are responsible for their own safety and must take extra care around both vulnerable and motorized road users. There are no water stations along the route. Participants must bring their own drinks and nutrition and obey traffic rules.

name: Poznań Malta #63
description: Poznań Malta #63 is a 10 km race in Poznań, held as part of the Kiprun Poznań Malta series. 27 runners took part, and the fastest was Robert Walczak, with a time of 37:57. This is an intimate edition of the running series organized in Poznań.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
Race in Poznań
Intimate edition with 27 participants
additional: Robert Walczak won with a time of 37:57.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo Active, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring sporting event organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. It brings together physical activity and local community engagement, taking place in the evening and offering free participation. The event is recreational in nature and promotes a healthy lifestyle among residents and supporters of the region.
course_highlights: An evening, nighttime format
Located in Bolechowo, in the municipality of Czerwonak
Previous editions featured a 5 km race
additional: The event takes place in the evening, usually between 19:30 and 22:00. Participation is free. This recurring gathering takes place several times a year, promoting physical activity and local community engagement. Editions are held in the evening; an earlier event was announced for 19:30–22:00.

name: Lillestrøms Høyeste Trappeløp
description: Lillestrøm’s Highest Stair Race takes place at Scandic Lillestrøm, with its 12 floors, and offers a real challenge for anyone who wants to test themselves, their friends, family, or colleagues. The race is suitable for all levels and is open to participants aged 13 and over. The event starts at 18:00, with race bibs and timing chips available for collection from 17:00. EMIT timing chips record start time, split time, and finish time, and results are displayed in real time on a large screen on the 2nd floor.
course_highlights: The race goes up 12 floors at Scandic Lillestrøm
EMIT timing chips record start, split, and finish times
Results are displayed in real time on a large screen on the 2nd floor
additional: Race bibs and timing chips can be collected from 17:00. Warm-up is self-directed, outdoors or indoors where space is available. Luggage can be left in a hotel meeting room at your own risk. Toilets are on the 1st and 2nd floors. Using public transport is recommended, as Scandic Lillestrøm is 50 metres from the train station and 150 metres from the bus station. Parking is limited, but commuter parking in the parking garage or at Varemessen (approx. 200 m away) is recommended if arriving by car. Group registration and a single invoice are available for corporate sports clubs and businesses. Timing is done using EMIT chips.

name: Cross Island Bornholm 2027 - ½ marathon og 10 km
Förslöv Trail
location: Förslövs idrottshall, Förslöv, Båstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Förslöv Trail 2027 is a scenic trail race held at the foot of Hallandsåsen, starting and finishing at Förslöv Sports Hall. Participants can choose between three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 24 km. Everyone runs the same first 2 km and final kilometre. The race features varied terrain, including forest trails and grass, with beautiful views of the small settlement and the natural landscape on the ridge. After finishing, participants can enjoy a medal, fruit, refreshments and the chance to socialise in the sports hall. Race bibs can be collected on race day or in advance in Båstad, where registered runners receive a discount on Sportshopen’s range.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Förslöv Sports Hall
Terrain with forest trails, grass and hills on Hallandsåsen
Sports drink and water available at several stations along the course
additional: Umara sports drink and water are served at several stations, depending on the distance. After the race, participants are offered a medal, fruit, refreshments and the chance to socialise in the sports hall. Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:30 a.m. or in advance at Sportshopen in Båstad, where registered runners receive a 20% discount. Changing rooms are available in the sports hall. Start times: 24 km at 10:00 a.m., 10 km at 10:30 a.m. and 5 km at 11:00 a.m. Race bibs must be collected on race day at least 20 minutes before the start. Changing rooms are available at the sports hall, and drinks and refreshments are provided along the course and after the finish.

name: Ekstremalna Droga Krzyżowa
description: The Extreme Way of the Cross is a spiritual, nighttime hike of approximately 40 km, undertaken in silence and contemplation. Participants follow the route alone or in small groups, focusing on prayer and reflection rather than sports competition. This unique event aims to inspire inner transformation and take participants beyond their comfort zones, offering a profound spiritual and personal experience. The route may be approximately 30 km if the elevation gain exceeds 500 m. EDK is a way of life and a path to changing yourself, not just covering the distance.
course_highlights: 40 km at night in silence and contemplation
A route of approximately 30 km when the elevation gain exceeds 500 m
The Way of the Cross with spiritual reflections, without sporting or social elements
additional: Participants set out at their own risk. It is recommended that they download the official EDK app, which includes route maps, GPS navigation, and the Way of the Cross reflections in text and audio, and also works offline. Silence and contemplation are observed along the route; picnics and social stops are not part of the event. Participants should be prepared for varying weather conditions and bring suitable clothing, food and drink, and a phone with a power bank. EDK takes place at participants’ own risk. Registration and route selection are available through the EDK service.

name: Osterlauf des LC- Marathon 80 e.V.
location: Rotenburg an der Fulda, Hesse, Germany

description: Lake Run is a unique trail race held on the shores of Lake Strzeszyńskie in Poznań. The approximately 5 km and 10 km routes, as well as the Nordic Walking course, follow natural paths around the lake, offering a light trail feel with uphill sections and a short off-road stretch. The start and finish are right by the water, providing beautiful views and an intimate atmosphere that’s ideal for both beginners and experienced runners. Organized by the EVsport Foundation, the race combines a passion for sport with closeness to nature and a welcoming community.
course_highlights: The routes loop around Lake Strzeszyńskie, with views of the lake
Natural paths and a light trail feel, including a short off-road stretch
Start and finish right by the water, with no streets or traffic jams
additional: One entry fee applies to all distances: 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. Souvenirs from the “Feel the Rhythm of the Lake” collection can be purchased separately (T-shirt, mug, bandana, premium bag or set). Participants under 18 must have a consent form signed by a parent or guardian. The routes have a light trail feel, with natural surfaces and gentle uphill sections. The organizer recommends shoes with good grip. The available options are 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. The organizer recommends shoes with good grip; a detailed route map will be published later. Participants under 18 need a consent form signed by a parent or guardian when collecting their race pack.

name: Ekstremalna Droga Krzyżowa
location: Kościół przy ul. Kościelnej 2, Bezrzecze, Poland
description: The Extreme Way of the Cross is a demanding route from the church at 2 Kościelna Street in Bezrzecze to the cross by the church in Bezrzecze. The route is interesting and varied, passing partly through woodland and partly through urban areas. Most of the route is on paved surfaces, so soft-soled footwear is recommended. It is a spiritual and physical challenge for participants, combining reflection with outdoor activity.
course_highlights: Partly woodland and partly urban route
Most of the route is paved
Start and finish by the church in Bezrzecze
additional: Soft-soled footwear is recommended because of the varied terrain. The route description recommends soft-soled footwear. The Extreme Way of the Cross takes place in silence and contemplation, with reflections on the Stations of the Cross.

name: Grand Prix Cross Polska cz.1
location: ReMi fish fry, ul. Lipowa 31, Stegna, Poland
organizer: Gmina Stegna i Valdano Organizacja Imprez Sportowych
description: Grand Prix Cross Polska Part 1 is a prestigious running event held in the picturesque seaside municipality of Stegna. The event launches the Grand Prix Cross Polska 2027 series and offers participants a unique sporting atmosphere combined with the beauty of the Amber Coast. The organizers look after runners’ comfort by providing a race office and a recovery meal at the Municipal Cultural Centre. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and fair play, bringing together the local community and athletes from across Poland.
course_highlights: A route through the seaside scenery of the Municipality of Stegna
Start and finish near the “ReMi” fish fry shop at 31 Lipowa Street
The event is organized and concludes at the Stegna Municipal Cultural Centre
additional: The race office, recovery meal, and award ceremony take place at the Stegna Municipal Cultural Centre. The event is held under the patronage of the Municipality of Stegna and the Polish Olympic Committee. The route passes near beach access No. 69 from Lipowa Street. The organizers provide comfortable conditions and opportunities for participants to connect.

name: Stęszewski Bieg Przełajowy
description: The Stęszew Cross-Country Run is an annual running event organized by the Municipality of Stęszew, bringing the local community together through active recreation. The races take place on scenic routes in Wielkopolska National Park, mainly along forest trails and dirt tracks. The main race offers 5 km and 10 km distances, alongside a 5 km Nordic Walking event and children’s races tailored to younger participants’ ages. The start and finish are on the beach by Lake Lipno, and the time limit is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: 95% of the route follows forest trails, dirt tracks, and unpaved roads
The 5 km race is one loop through the forest by Lake Lipno and the Trzebaw forest
The 10 km race consists of two loops of the same route
additional: The participant limit is 300. Net chip timing is used. The course is not certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The Nordic Walking event starts at 13:15. Parking is available by the Sports and Entertainment Hall and along Trzebawska Street. Previous editions have included children’s races over age-appropriate distances and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The official website lists the contact details: +48 698 050 150, bieg@steszew.pl.

name: Wiosenna Lwówecka 5
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Lwówku, Rozbiegany Lwówek, Powiatowe Centrum Sportu w Nowym Tomyślu
description: Wiosenna Lwówecka 5 is an annual race held in the picturesque town of Lwówek, attracting runners from various places. The course runs through the charming grounds of the Municipal Park, offering participants pleasant conditions for competition and recreation. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors in an atmosphere of sporting camaraderie.
course_highlights: The course runs through Municipal Park in Lwówek
Picturesque surroundings that are welcoming to runners
A 5 km distance suited to different ability levels
additional: The race office is open on event day from 7:30 to 8:30 at the start location, Parkowa 2, 64-310 Lwówek. For the 2025 edition, the address was listed as Parkowa 2, 64-310 Lwówek, with opening hours of 7:30–8:30.

name: XI Maraton Gocki
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Lokalna Grupa Działania Sandry Brdy
description: The 11th Gocki Marathon is a unique running event held in the picturesque village of Wojtal, in the heart of the Tuchola Forest, near the Stone Circles Nature Reserve in Odry. The marathon, half-marathon, and 10 km race courses pass through unique areas associated with the ancient Gothic culture, offering participants a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and beautiful scenery. The event is a regular fixture on the region’s sporting calendar, attracting running and outdoor recreation enthusiasts. The organizers warmly invite everyone to take part in this event, which combines sport with local history and nature.
course_highlights: The course runs through the heart of the Tuchola Forest
Close to the Stone Circles Nature Reserve in Odry
Picturesque landscapes and unique natural surroundings
additional: The event features three races: a marathon, a half-marathon, and a 10 km race. It is organized by the Sandry Brdy Local Action Group Association as part of the implementation of the Local Development Strategy (LDS) and is co-financed by the European Union. The Municipality of Czersk was a co-organizer of the event.

name: XVII Maraton Jastrowski
organizer: Gmina i Miasto Jastrowie; współorganizator: Dariusz Mańkowski
description: The 17th Jastrowie Marathon is an annual running event organized by the Municipality and Town of Jastrowie, held in late March. Competitors race over three distances: the marathon (42.195 km), the half marathon, and a 10.55 km Nordic walking event. The marathon course is cross-country in character and consists of four loops, taking runners along forest roads in the forest district and through a built-up area just after the start. Participants who finish receive a commemorative medal and a race pack. This is a small-scale event, limited to 50 starting places, giving it a distinctive character and local atmosphere.
course_highlights: A cross-country course along forest roads in the forest district
The marathon consists of four loops
The start and finish are near the Sports and Entertainment Hall and Jastrowie-Miasto railway stop
additional: The race office is located in the Sports and Entertainment Hall and will be open on race day from 7:00 to 9:45. The limit is 50 starting places, allocated in order of registration. Once the limit is reached, registration will close and any overpayments will be refunded. Every participant who finishes receives a commemorative medal and a race pack.

name: Drents Friese Woldmarathon
description: The Drents Friese Wold Marathon is a challenging marathon held in the beautiful Drents-Friese Wold National Park near Diever. The course consists of laps of just over 10 km on paved and semi-paved cycle paths and minor roads, mostly through the forest. The marathon has a rich history, with fast course records, and attracts many runners each year who enjoy its natural surroundings. The start and finish are in Diever, and the organizers provide professional chip timing. The marathon is suitable for runners aged 18 and over, with a shorter distance for young people aged 14 and over.
course_highlights: Laps of just over 10 km on paved and semi-paved cycle paths and minor roads
Mostly through the wooded surroundings of Drents-Friese Wold National Park
Start and finish in Diever
additional: Collect your race number on 27 March from 10:00 to 11:45 at the start location. Registration is also available on the day, during the same hours. Timing is by a chip attached to the race number; returning the race number after finishing is strongly requested. Age limits: 18 years for all distances except 10.1 km; 14 years for the 10.1 km. If you withdraw before 24 March, the entry fee will be refunded minus €1 in administration costs. Registration is open until 24 March; start times vary by distance; age limits follow KNAU guidelines; the event promotes sport and experiencing nature.

name: IX Cartusia Półmaraton
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. 3 Maja, Kartuzy, Poland
description: The IX Cartusia Half Marathon is a prestigious race in the heart of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the picturesque landscapes of Kashubian Switzerland and a rich historical heritage. Participants run a certified, fast course through the lakes, forests and post-glacial hills of the Kartuzy region. The start and finish are at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy. This event is a true celebration of running for the whole family, with a rich program and regional Kashubian cuisine. The organizers provide attractive prizes, a prize draw and a unique medal for every participant.
course_highlights: A certified, fast course through the picturesque areas of the Kartuzy region
Route through lakes, forests and post-glacial hills
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy
additional: The start and finish are at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy at ul. 3 Maja. Full facilities are available at Primary School No. 1 (race office, bag drop, changing rooms, showers and changing areas). Safety and medical support is provided by firefighters, police, municipal police, medical staff and volunteers. Race packs include commemorative items, and participants can access a recovery area at the finish. Regional Kashubian cuisine will be available for participants to sample. Prizes will be drawn among all participants in the main race. Start and finish: Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy at ul. 3 Maja. Event facilities are to be located at Primary School No. 1; accompanying races have also been announced, including a race for preschoolers.

name: Kibolska Dycha
description: Kibolska Dycha is the fourth edition of the Kolejorz fans’ race, taking place on 28 March 2027 at the Malta Regatta Course in Poznań. Runners will cover a 10-kilometre route that includes almost two laps of Lake Malta. The event is open to everyone, with a maximum time of 120 minutes to complete the course, making it accessible to less experienced runners too. The event also includes children’s races, which start earlier. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: The route includes almost two laps of Lake Malta
10-kilometre distance
Start and finish at the Malta Regatta Course
additional: The maximum time to complete the course is 120 minutes. Children’s races start at 10:00. Before the main race, participants take a commemorative photo, after which runners head to their starting corrals. The time limit for the main race is 120 minutes. Children’s races are also included in the programme.

name: Niebieska Fala
location: ENEA Stadion, ul. Bułgarska 17, Poznań, Poland
description: Niebieska Fala is a charity run held in Poznań, combining a passion for running with support for people in need. It focuses particularly on raising autism awareness and purchasing therapeutic equipment. The main race route follows scenic paths through Marceliński Forest and Węgorka Street, with distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The youngest participants can take part in the Niebieska miniFala family run, covering 1 km around ENEA Stadium. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting a healthy lifestyle and working to prevent the social exclusion of people with disabilities.
course_highlights: The main course is a 5 km loop in Marceliński Forest, with 30% paved and 70% forest surface
New on the course: a section along Węgorka Street, adding variety and making the run more comfortable
The Niebieska miniFala family run covers 1 km around ENEA Stadium on a paved, child-safe route
additional: The time limit for completing the main race (5, 10 or 15 km) is 120 minutes. The course is marked with blue-and-white tape, and volunteers assist participants along the route. There is a refreshment station on the course. The MiniFala family run starts at 11:30, the main race at 13:00, and Nordic Walking at 12:30. The start and finish are by Stand 2 at ENEA Stadium. In the 2026 edition, the start and finish were by Stand 2 at ENEA Stadium, at 17 Bułgarska Street. The time limit for the race was 120 minutes. Information about fees and the course refers to the previous edition.

name: VIII Półmaraton Świebody i Sulecha
organizer: OSiR „Sulechowianka” w Sulechowie, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Świebodzinie, Sulechowski Klub Sportowy oraz Wierzbicki Running Project
description: The VIII Świebodzin and Sulechów Half Marathon is a race connecting Sulechów and Świebodzin, organized to promote running and outdoor physical activity. The course passes through the picturesque streets of both towns and the villages of Kalsk and Rosin, giving participants the chance to test themselves in a sporting competition. The participant limit is 300. The organizers provide transport from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów. The race starts at 11:00 at Plac Ratuszowy in Sulechów.
course_highlights: The course runs from Sulechów to Świebodzin through town streets and along Route 276
Passes through the villages of Kalsk and Rosin
Start and finish at town squares: Plac Ratuszowy in Sulechów and Plac Jana Pawła II in Świebodzin
additional: The organizers provide bus transport for participants from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów. The bus departs at 9:40 from the parking lot by Primary School No. 2. The time limit is 2 hours 30 minutes; participants must finish by 13:30. The race office is open on race day from 7:30 to 9:30 at the Town Hall in Świebodzin. The participant limit was 300, and the time limit for finishing was 2 hours 30 minutes. The organizers provided bus transport for participants from the race office in Świebodzin to the start in Sulechów.

name: Hollen door de Bollen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijfkosten bedragen € 14,- per persoon (minimaal 5 personen per team).

description: Hollen door de Bollen is an annual running and walking event in the beautiful Bollenstreek area around Lisse, organised by Stichting Team Bollenstreek in collaboration with AV De Spartaan. All proceeds from the event go to Stichting Roparun, which supports palliative care for cancer patients. Routes range from short children’s runs to 30 km walks, with music and entertainment along the way and a convivial finish. The event puts taking part for charity ahead of competition, with no official timekeeping.
course_highlights: Walking routes of 6.5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 30 km through the Bollenstreek
Running distances of 5 km, 10 km and 10 English miles
Music and entertainment along the route and a festive finish
additional: The start location is AV De Spartaan, Spekkelaan 8, Lisse. There are various start times for walking and running distances, starting from 07:30. Entries are personal and include a personalised race number; no refunds are available in the event of cancellation. High-visibility vests are recommended on sections of the walking routes that use public roads. A special Shirt Action allows participants to earn a free anniversary shirt by finding sponsors. Routes range from 4.6 km to over 30 km. Advance registration is required; race numbers and shirts can be collected. Volunteers and sponsors are welcome.

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 5 km 12:30 300:-

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 10 km 12:30 300:-

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organized by Enhörna IF, starting and finishing at Enhörna Friluftsgård in Södertälje. The race offers several categories for children, youth and adults, with distances ranging from approximately 600 metres to 10 kilometres. This well-established event will be held for the 49th time in 2027 and offers an enjoyable and challenging running experience in scenic surroundings. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-site late registration available. Swedish Athletics Federation competition rules apply.
course_highlights: Classic road and cross-country race
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård
Several distances from 600 m to 10 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee (SEK 100 for adult categories, SEK 50 for youth categories). Start times for children’s and youth categories are between 11:00 and 11:35, while adult categories start at 12:30. Results and start lists will be published on the website. Participation constitutes consent to the publication of names and any photographs on the association’s website and social media. Regular registration closes on 27 March. On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start and costs extra. Everyone is welcome in the recreational category.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://eiflopning.se/arrangemang/pasksmallen/): 2027-03-29 — "Annandag Påsk den 29:e mars 2027 är det dags för den 49:e upplagan av Enhörna IF:s Påsksmällen." (was estimated 2026-10-18)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Annandag Påsk den 29:e mars 2027 är det dags för den 49:e upplagan av Enhörna IF:s Påsksmällen.

name: Hallarydsloppet
description: Hallarydsloppet is an annual race for all ages, from young children to older runners. There are several distances to choose from, ranging from a short 1.3 km children’s race to the 21 km main event, which takes place along the border between Skåne and Småland. The courses offer beautiful scenery, with gravel roads, winding stone walls, meadows and forests. The race starts and finishes at Hallaryd School and offers a well-organized race day with water stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The 21 km course passes an old stone arch bridge dating from 1870, with four arches
Much of the course follows gravel roads lined with stone walls, meadows and forests
The 21 km course has a challenging climb of approximately 25 metres over 500 metres
additional: Race bibs must be collected at the school no later than 30 minutes before the start. Late entries are accepted on race day until the start for an additional fee of 50 kr (not available for youth and walking classes). Timing is done using a barcode on the race bib. Water stations along the course provide sports drink and water. Changing facilities and showers are available in the school gym and HIF’s clubhouse. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers in each class, and everyone who finishes receives a medal. The start and finish are at Hallaryd School, Häradsvägen 3. Water stations offer water and sports drink. Register in advance by email no later than 23 March 2027; late entries are accepted on race day for an additional fee of 50 kr, except for the youth and walking classes.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.hallarydsloppet.se/): 2027-03-29 — "Hallarydsloppet 29 mars 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-05)

name: Halve van Hengelo
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 meter, 0.5 km

name: Culemborg City Run
description: The Culemborg City Run is an annual running event in Culemborg, with various distances for individual runners, schools, and businesses. The race offers a varied course with distances of 400 metres, 1, 3, 5, and 10 kilometres, suitable for all ages and levels. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the involvement of the local community. The City Run promotes sportsmanship and togetherness in a beautiful urban setting.
course_highlights: Course through the centre of Culemborg
Distances ranging from 400 metres to 10 kilometres
Specific routes for schools and businesses
additional: There are separate categories for schools and businesses. The Roll Run is a special 400-metre race. The event has a varied programme, with different start times for each distance. Attention is given to accessibility and facilities for participants. The event also includes a school run and a business run, along with historical results and sponsors. It is an annual event that brings the community together.

name: De Wielenloop
location: De Groote Wielen, Rosmalen, North Brabant, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld € 5,- betaal je contant of met pin.

description: The Wielenloop is an annual running event held on Easter Monday in De Groote Wielen, Rosmalen. The event is suitable for all ages, with various distances including a kids’ run, 5 km and 10 km. The routes offer varied terrain and are accessible to both beginner and experienced runners. The atmosphere is friendly, with space for family and supporters along the route.
course_highlights: The 10 km route consists of two laps of the 5 km route
Varied terrain suitable for experienced runners
Kids’ run for the youngest runners; participation is free
additional: You can register through the morning of the race, on Monday, at the start. The kids’ run is free. The 5 km and 10 km start at 10:30. There is a warm-up beforehand, and family members can join the kids’ run. On-site registration is possible; the start time is around 10:30; the routes will be announced soon.

name: Drie Molenloop Aarlanderveen
description: The Drie Molenloop Aarlanderveen is a traditional competitive and recreational race, held for the 60th time on Easter Monday, 29 March 2027. The race offers distances of 5, 10 and 15 km, suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. Participants run through the beautiful polder landscape around Aarlanderveen and receive a medal at the finish. Part of the proceeds go to a local good cause; this year, the playground.
course_highlights: All distances follow paved roads around and through the Aarlanderveen polder
Water stations halfway along the course and at the finish
Kilometre markers are displayed along the course, and a running clock is provided
additional: Race numbers will not be mailed out; they can be collected on 29 March at the Dorpshuis during late registration. Timing is provided using MYLAPS BibTag on the race numbers. Parking, changing facilities and showers are available at the sports hall on Aarlanderveenseweg. Parking is limited, so cycling is recommended. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 15 km; children's fun run; proceeds go to a good cause (playground); location: Aarlanderveen; organised by AAV'36

name: Klap tot Klaploop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgelden voorinschrijving Deelname 5 km en 10 km (vanaf 18 jaar): € 15,-

description: The Klap tot Klaploop is a unique running race with no laps. You travel by bus to the start in Musselkanaal, then run straight back to the centre of Stadskanaal. The flat, fast course is ideal for setting a personal best, while the enthusiastic crowds and friendly atmosphere along the route make for a special experience. The 35th edition takes place on Easter Monday, 29 March 2027—a day of sport, challenge and fun for everyone.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course from Musselkanaal to Stadskanaal
No laps—just one continuous route
The crowds and atmosphere along the route make for a unique experience
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the Saturday before Easter from 10:00 to 14:00 at De Jonge Sport in Stadskanaal, or on the day of the event until 11:30 at the organisers’ tent. Free bus transport is provided from Europalaan in Stadskanaal to the start locations in Musselkanaal for the 5 km and 10 km runners. Wheelchair racers and handcyclists arrange their own transport. Clothing trucks and portable toilets are available at the start locations. There are no showers. Start in Musselkanaal, finish in Stadskanaal; no transport is provided from Stadskanaal to the start locations. The event is supported by local businesses and has a long history, with the 32nd edition in 2027.

name: Paaspolderloop
description: The Paaspolderloop in Nieuwe Niedorp is a friendly running event held on Easter Monday. The race takes you through the beautiful polder, with several distances for all ages, including a 250-metre fun run for the youngest participants and challenging 2 km, 5 km and 10 km routes. The 10 km is open to participants aged 16 and over and offers a varied course through meadows and over bridges, including a nostalgic stretch along Dorpsstraat. The organisers create a festive atmosphere with a large prize fund and a quick prize-giving after the race.
course_highlights: Beautiful green meadow and sheep path
Several bridges along the course
Nostalgic Dorpsstraat in Nieuwe Niedorp
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Dorpshuis De Prins Maurits. Parking is available at the Winkelcentrum van Nieuwe Niedorp, a 900-metre walk away. There are no changing rooms or showers, but toilets are available in the Dorpshuis. First aid is available at the start/finish. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The event starts at 9:30 a.m. on Easter Monday, with registration opening in January and parking at Winkelhart. There are also fun activities for children alongside the race.

name: Let’s GO Groesbeek Run
location: Groesbeek, Berg en Dal, Gelderland, Netherlands

name: Cytadela by Night # 113
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed 5 km runs held in Poznań. The event takes place in the Citadel, offering participants a unique opportunity to run at night. The run is open to everyone who wants to spend time actively and take on the course in the scenic surroundings of the park.
course_highlights: 5 km course
The run takes place in the Citadel in Poznań
Night-time atmosphere
additional: The run is free and timed.

name: Halowe Mistrzostwa Europy Masters - 5 km
description: The European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships are an international athletics competition for masters athletes, held in Toruń. The event is a championship competition and brings together experienced athletes from across Europe. It is organized by the Polish Masters Athletics Association and takes place at the indoor athletics arena on Bema Street. It is an excellent opportunity for high-level competition and for bringing the masters community together.
course_highlights: 5 km race inside the indoor athletics arena
International championship-level competition
Organized by the Polish Masters Athletics Association in Toruń
additional: Masters competitions are intended for athletes born on March 27, 1991, or earlier.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
location: Nordens Ark, Hunnebostrand, Varberg Municipality, Sweden
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a family-friendly running event held in the Eco Park at Nordens Ark in Hunnebostrand. The race offers several distances, from 1 km for the youngest participants to 30 km for those looking for a serious challenge. The event combines nature experiences with health and outdoor activities in a scenic setting. It is organised by IK Granit and has a tradition of welcoming runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Scenic trails in the Eco Park
Distance options from 1 km to 30 km
Family-friendly, with activities for all ages
additional: The event is organised by IK Granit. Nordens Ark is a zoo and nature reserve that is open year-round. Parking is free, and there are good bus connections. Participants are encouraged to register well in advance, but current information about registration and prices is not available on the website. The race is cancelled in 2026 but is planned to return in 2027. The event is scheduled to take place on 8 April 2027, with distances from 1 km to 30 km. It is an opportunity for participants to enjoy the arrival of spring in a scenic, family-friendly setting.

name: Sandtangstafetten
description: Sandtangstafetten is a traditional relay held at Sandtangen in Bryne. The race has four legs on varied surfaces, including forest floor, gravel and grass, and offers both a short and a long course for different age groups, from age 7 to seniors. The event starts in the evening and lasts approximately one hour and fifteen minutes, with a focus on team spirit and a great atmosphere. It is a family-friendly race, with many mixed teams as well as all-girls and all-boys teams competing in different categories.
course_highlights: Short course for ages 7–10, with 110 m legs on forest floor, gravel and grass
Long course for ages 11 and older, with 370 m and 420 m legs on varied surfaces
Four legs per relay team, with changeovers at Sandtangen
additional: Start times for the different categories are from 18:00 to 18:36. Participants are advised to arrive 45 minutes before the start for a course and changeover briefing. Parking is available at Vianor Bryne (north) and Storstova (south). Registration is available via a link or by emailing pamelding@brynefriidrett.no. Parking at Vianor Bryne or Storstova.

name: Påskrundan 2026
description: Vänersborgs AIK warmly welcomes you to Påskrundan, a popular cross-country race suited to both elite runners and recreational runners. The race has quickly become a cherished Easter tradition and attracts participants of all ages. Starting and finishing at the ski lodge in Vänersborg, the course offers approximately 7 kilometres of varied running along gravel roads and trails. The first section is easy to run, while the final section is hillier and more challenging. Påskrundan is a running festival centred on community, with children’s and youth races making it a day for the whole family. Alongside the competition, enjoy a wonderful atmosphere with spectators, prizes for the top finishers in each class, and prize draws for all participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 7 kilometres of cross-country running on gravel roads and trails
The first section is easy to run and fast-paced
The final section is hilly and challenging
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. The race is a running festival focused on community and attracts both elite runners and recreational runners.

name: Ryssbergsloppet
description: Ryssbergsloppet is an annual running event in Sölvesborg organised by Ryssbergets IK. The event offers several distances of varying lengths and difficulty, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced runners. It is part of Skånes VeteranCup and features a scenic, challenging course through beautiful terrain. The organisers welcome runners of all ages and categories to a well-organised and enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: The course is marked with arrows, painted lines and ribbons at every kilometre
Water and sports drink are available at the lap point and finish
The terrain varies, with sections through woodland and hilly stretches
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Sparbankshallen, Bromölla, no later than 30 minutes before the start. All participants must wear their race number on the front of their chest. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish. Refreshments, including coffee and grilled sausages, are available. Marshals are stationed at junctions to show the way. There are several race distances, with start times between 10:30 and 11:10, and results are published on the club’s website. The event welcomes both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories over half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances. All races start at 13:00 from three different locations along National Road 34 between Linköping and Motala, and finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is organised by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna and Vreta SoMK, and welcomes runners of different ages and abilities. Buses transport participants from the finish area to the start locations before the race. Late registration is available at the start locations for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Mass start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Bus transport from the finish to the start locations before the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the respective start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30, with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are free for participants aged 16 and under; others can buy a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish area. The distances are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web, with payment by Swish or bank giro. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants each year.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: SäterMaran is an annual running event in Säter that includes the district championships in the half marathon. The event offers several distances, including the half marathon and 10 km, and welcomes runners of different levels. It is organized by Säters IF FIK and is known for its friendly atmosphere, focus on the joy of running, and sense of local community.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km distances
Low participation in the full marathon, with a focus on the half marathon and 10 km
Held in Säter amid scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration for the full marathon is closed due to low participation, but registration for the half marathon and 10 km remains open as usual.

name: Allstarsmilen
description: ALLSTARSMILEN is one of Sweden’s fastest 10 km races, run on a flat, officially measured and sanctioned course. It’s the perfect course for setting a personal best or using as a qualifying result for other races. Welcome to this fast, well-organized race in Skrea-Herting-Hjortsberg.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course
Officially measured and sanctioned
Suitable for setting a personal best and qualifying for other races

name: Vårruset (Malmö)
description: Vårruset in Malmö is a fun run for women, offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km in the lovely spring setting of Slottsparken. The event is all about the joy of running and community, and welcomes participants regardless of their fitness background or ambitions. You can register individually or as part of a team; teams receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset is an inclusive and inspiring fitness movement that has been going since 1989 and continues to promote women’s health and well-being.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Slottsparken
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Emporia in the days before the event. You can choose to opt out of timing. Changing at home is recommended, as there are no changing facilities at the venue. A clothing drop-off is available in a tent by the race bib collection area. The start and finish are on Kung Oscarsväg in Slottsparken. Teams consist of 5 people, and team members can run different distances. Registration is binding and is available until one hour before the start on race day.

name: Sletten Backyard Ultra
description: Sletten Backyard Ultra will be held for the first time in Bergen in spring 2027, with race day on 3 April. The race takes place near Nattlandsfjellet and offers a new backyard course for runners who want to challenge themselves. Welcome to a new ultra-running experience in Bergen!
course_highlights: Course near Nattlandsfjellet
Backyard Ultra format
First edition of the race

name: 10 KM Sport1 Glexe
description: The Sport 1 Series in Bø, Telemark, is a local race series organized by Skarphedin Athletics. The race is suitable for participants of all levels and offers a great opportunity to take part in a friendly and inclusive running community. The series concludes with the Kirkerunden, which offers glorious weather and a great atmosphere. This is a popular event that brings together runners from the area for an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Measured 10 km route on a pedestrian and cycle path
Fast, easy-to-run course from Bø towards Gvarv
Unstaffed water stations at around 3.4 km and 6.6 km, as well as at the finish
additional: Previous editions have started and finished at MSG Bilvask.

name: Holmestrand maraton
description: Holmestrand Marathon is a welcoming running event that has been a regular fixture on the race calendar since 2013. The race is held every year on the Saturday after Easter and offers beautiful, easy-to-run courses along the Holmestrand Fjord and through the charming streets of the town centre. Distances are available for all levels, from 5 km to the marathon, and the course is officially measured and internationally certified by World Athletics. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, and also includes a free children’s race called Miniton.
course_highlights: Easy-to-run, personal-best-friendly 5 km loop
Course along the Holmestrand Fjord and through the town centre streets
Officially measured and internationally certified by World Athletics
additional: All children can take part in the free Miniton children’s race. You can choose to run the race with or without a recorded time. There are food and drink stations, prizes, and opportunities to follow the race along the course. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon, and free Miniton for children. For the 5 km, you can choose to run with or without a recorded time. The event also offers the combinations marathon + 10 km and half marathon + 5 km.

name: Drammen 10K
description: Drammen10K is Norway’s fastest 10-kilometer race, taking runners through downtown Drammen on a fast course with only 22 meters of elevation gain. The race is for everyone looking for a fast and enjoyable running experience in an urban setting. The event has an inclusive atmosphere and also offers fun digital competitions beforehand. Welcome to a great race weekend in Drammen!
course_highlights: Norway’s fastest 10K race
Fast course with only 22 meters of elevation gain
The race takes place in downtown Drammen
additional: Green race bibs indicate that a medal was purchased in advance. Children’s races are also held on the same day, including Minimila. There is no telephone contact; all communication takes place via email and the contact form. A digital triathlon with prizes and a live announcement on social media is held beforehand. Transferring a race bib or changing the participant costs 100 NOK.

name: Bergen Ultra - Maratonkarusellen
organizer: Maratonkarusellen i samarbeid med BFG Bergen Løpeklubb

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Prisene øker med kr 50,- to uker før løpsdagen

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Prisene øker med kr 50,- to uker før løpsdagen

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Prisene øker med kr 50,- to uker før løpsdagen

description: Bergen Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon organised by Maratonkarusellen in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb. The race offers distances of 63.3 km and 100 km, as well as a half marathon and marathon, and takes place at Fana Stadium in Bergen. Maratonkarusellen places great emphasis on quality and participant enjoyment, despite the tough challenges of the race. The minimum age is 18, and the event is part of a series of long-distance races held in both spring and autumn.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon with distances of 63.3 km and 100 km
Organised in collaboration with BFG Bergen Løpeklubb
The races start and take place at Fana Stadium in Bergen
additional: Kondis members receive a NOK 50 discount. A year-round licence from the Norwegian Athletics Federation can be provided as a licence number, and a one-time licence does not need to be paid for. Prices increase by NOK 50 two weeks before race day, by a further NOK 50 four days before, and the price is NOK 650 on race day. The minimum age to participate in the marathon is 18. Start and finish are at Fana Stadium. The half marathon is one lap, the marathon two laps, and the 63 km race three laps. Listed start times are 09:00 for 63 km, 10:00 for the marathon, and 11:00 for the half marathon.

name: Solsiå sentrumsløp
description: Solsiå Sentrumsløp 2027 takes place in central Sandnes and features a loop course where participants choose how many laps to complete within six hours. There is also a separate children’s race of approximately 600 metres in Langgata. The race has an informal and inclusive character, with a focus on local runners and safe preparation. Registration and payment are handled directly by the organiser, not through Førstart.
course_highlights: Loop course in central Sandnes, with 3 km per lap
Choose how many laps to complete within six hours
Separate children’s race of approximately 600 metres in Langgata
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:30, and the loop race starts at 12:00. Limited practical information about the race is available on Førstart. Feel free to invite others to the starting line.

name: Backyard Thorsov ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Distanse: Backyard Deltakere kr 750,00 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3% transaksjonsgebyr)

description: Backyard Thorsov Ultra in Oslo is a unique backyard ultra race where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour on the hour, up to twelve times. The race starts and finishes at a gathering place with facilities such as a food station and toilets. Participants choose their own pace, and the goal is to complete as many loops as they can, with a maximum distance of 80.4 km. The event emphasizes community, accessibility, and personal achievement, and every participant is valued regardless of how far they get.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop run every hour on the hour
Gently undulating terrain with clear course markings (yellow arrow signs, red ground flags, white arrows on asphalt)
Start and finish at a gathering place with a food station and toilets
additional: Loops start every hour on the hour. Participants must bring their own cup, wear a reflective vest on the final loop, and use a headlamp if it is dark. Support is not allowed inside the venue or on the course, only outdoors in the start and finish area. Those who complete 12 loops receive a cup, and those who complete the ultra distance (at least 7 loops) receive a Norwegian-made wooden medal. Race bibs are collected at the clubhouse by the start. Using a race belt for the race bib is recommended.

name: GIF-Joggen Backyard Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Påmelding skjer ved at du Vippser kr 150 til #609846 med info om navn, klubb/lag.

description: GIF-Joggen Backyard Ultra takes place in Gressvikmarka, starting on Saturday, 3 April at 08:00. The race consists of up to 12 laps of a 6.7 km course through varied and challenging terrain. Participants run one lap every hour and continue for as long as they can, aiming to complete as many laps as possible or all 12. All participants receive a medal, and those who complete every lap can log over 80 km in their training diary. Facilities include a heated indoor area, toilets and changing rooms, as well as some fruit and baked goods.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km course through varied terrain
Up to 12 laps, totalling over 80 km for those who complete them all
The course is marked with red and white ribbons
additional: Check-in and registration from 07:00 on race day. To continue, you must be ready for the next lap at the start of each hour. A heated indoor area, toilets and changing rooms are available. Bring a change of clothes, drinks, food and, if needed, a headlamp. The course may be wet and muddy; a camping chair is recommended for the rest area. The previous edition had a maximum of 77 participants. The start was at 08:00, and runners had to be ready at the start at the beginning of each hour to continue. A heated indoor area, toilets and changing rooms were available.

name: Benrather Volkslauf 2027
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1.44 km, 0.4 km

name: Lauf Rund um das Schaubergwerk Röhrigschacht
distance_verbose: 14.7 km, 14 km, 5.1 km, 3000 Meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: 10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid
description: The 10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid is an annual running event with three distances: Kidsrun, 5 Mijl and 10 Mijl. The routes pass through the residential area of Zwolle-Zuid and the beautiful countryside near the IJssel, with the start and finish at Wijkcentrum SIO. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organisation, and attracts both recreational and competitive runners. The 10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid is a great challenge for runners who want to enjoy a varied course in a green setting.
course_highlights: Course through the residential area of Zwolle-Zuid and the countryside near the IJssel
5 Mijl route of 8047 metres, starting at 17:00
10 Mijl route of 16093 metres, passing Harculo
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Lopers Company, Gasthuisplein 2, from Wednesday 9 April through Friday 11 April during opening hours, and on Saturday 12 April from 12:00 to 16:30 at Wijkcentrum SIO at Thorbeckelaan 2. The 10 Mijl van Zwolle-Zuid is not an official Atletiek Unie race. Minimum age is 14 for the 5 Mijl and 17 for the 10 Mijl. Race numbers must be worn visibly. The course is not suitable for wheelchair users or wheeler users. Distances: Kidsrun, 5 Mijl, 10 Mijl; registration opens in January; supports charities; location in Zwolle-Zuid.

name: 2Bruggenloop
description: The Ned Air 2Bruggenloop in Kampen is a lively running event that starts and finishes in the heart of the city. The routes cross two iconic bridges, the Stadsbrug and the Molenbrug, and offer beautiful views of the historic city skyline and the waterside natural scenery along the IJssel. The certified half marathon and 10-kilometre race are challenging, including a climb over the Molenbrug. There is a special Kidsrun through the city centre for young runners. After the finish, participants can unwind in the welcoming city centre during the Nacht van Kampen.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the atmospheric Oudestraat in the heart of Kampen
Cross the impressive Stadsbrug with its golden wheels and the 600-metre-long Molenbrug, which stands 21 metres high
Beautiful views of the iconic city skyline and the waterside river scenery along the IJssel
additional: Starting corrals are assigned according to expected running time (Red, Purple, Yellow) to ensure a smooth flow. The start and finish area is at Van Heutszplein. Race numbers can be collected on the Friday evening before the race. Lockers are available for safely storing belongings. Merchandise is on sale, including hoodies, socks and shirts. The Kidsrun has separate start times: 13:00 for ages 4–9 and 13:15 for ages 10–12. After the finish, participants can unwind in the city centre during the Nacht van Kampen (band night). The event also offers a Kidsrun and Businessrun, and has a strong local reputation as one of the best running events in Kampen and the surrounding area.

name: Rondje Zegveld
description: Rondje Zegveld is a running event in the heart of Zegveld. Participants can choose from a 1.5 km Kids Run, a 5 km route or a 10 km route through the beautiful Groene Hart polder. Times are recorded electronically, and results are available online after the event. The event is open to all ages and offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere. Late registration is also possible on the day, up to half an hour before the race starts.
course_highlights: A loop through the Groene Hart polder
A 1.5 km Kids Run through the centre of Zegveld
Water station after approximately 5 km on the 10 km route
additional: Late registration is possible on the day until 30 minutes before the race starts, while places are available. The awards ceremony is expected to take place around 15:15–15:30. Traffic measures and temporary road closures will be in place in and around the village during the event. First-aid personnel will be present along the route and at the finish. Photos and videos will be taken for promotional purposes. The event on 3 April 2027 offers recreational and competitive runners alike a great opportunity to explore the area and take part in a local running event.

name: Woest Lochemsebergloop
description: The WOEST Lochemsebergloop is a friendly running event in Barchem, with distances for both children and adults. The kids’ run is for children up to 16 years old and covers 1,000 metres. Adults can choose between a 5 km run or power walk and a 10 km run. The event takes place in a beautiful natural setting, with care taken to preserve the environment. There is a drinks station and a litter zone along the route, and parking is well arranged at Bon Aparte. The organisers are available to answer questions by email and aim to create a sporty, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances for children (1,000 m) and adults (5 km and 10 km)
Drinks station and litter zone along the route to help keep nature clean
Start and finish near the Bon Aparte car park in Barchem
additional: Parking and bicycle parking at the Bon Aparte car park. Toilets available at Bon Aparte. No changing or shower facilities at the start/finish. Start times by distance: kids’ run at 13:00 and 13:01, 5 km at 13:30, 10 km at 14:30. Trail run with various distances, located in Barchem; parking at Bon Aparte; no changing facilities or showers available.

name: Hoka Torekov-Båstad Lördag
description: Hoka Torekov-Båstad is a scenic trail race offering 28 or 21 km of varied running between Torekov and Båstad. The race features beautiful views of mountains, forests and the sea, and is part of Trails of SWE c/o Dacia, which showcases Sweden’s diverse landscapes. After the race, you can join an After Run buffet with good food and live entertainment at Hotel Skansen. A perfect race for anyone who wants to enjoy the freedom of nature and challenge their limits.
course_highlights: Varied trail running over 28 or 21 km
Beautiful views of mountains, forests and the sea
Part of Trails of SWE, featuring four unique nature experiences
additional: An After Run buffet is available after the race at Hotel Skansen for SEK 445 per person, with food and live entertainment. Buses run from the Tourist Parking in Båstad to the start in Torekov; your race bib serves as your ticket. Shoes with metal studs are not allowed.

name: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT)
description: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT) is a technical trail race on the heights of Romeleåsen, offering three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 25 km. The races are open to all runners, from elite athletes to recreational runners, and participants in the 25 km race must be at least 17 years old. The courses include both classic routes and new trails, with plenty of elevation gain and beautiful views of nature. After the race, a classic Giffa burger is included for the 10 km and 25 km races, or a hot dog in a bun for the 5 km race, along with a drink. There is no time limit, and the 25 km race is part of the Skåne Trailcup.
course_highlights: A technical trail race on the heights of Romeleåsen
Courses with plenty of elevation gain and beautiful natural views
Three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 25 km, featuring both classic routes and new trails
additional: Showers and changing rooms are available after the race. Water and energy stations are located along the course and at the finish. The 25 km race is the first event in the Skåne Trailcup. There is no time limit; the race ends when all participants have reached the finish. Previous editions have had water and energy stations along the course and at the finish, as well as showers and changing rooms. Food and drink after the finish have been included in the entry fee.

name: GIFT 2027 - SM/VSM/JSM i trail
location: Ekevallen, Genarp, Lund Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
organizer: Genarps IF i samarbete med Björnstorps IF
description: Välkommen till GIFT 2027, ett tekniskt och utmanande traillopp på Romeleåsens höjder med start och mål på Ekevallen, Genarps idrottsplats. Loppet erbjuder tre distanser - 5 km, 10 km och 27 km - för barn, ungdomar, motionärer och elit. Årets upplaga är dessutom SM, VSM och JSM i kort trail, vilket gör tävlingen extra prestigefylld. Efter målgång serveras mat och dryck istället för medalj, och deltagarna kan förbeställa en exklusiv finishertröja i SM-utgåva. Alla löpare tävlar om totala placeringar oavsett klubb eller oorganiserad status.
course_highlights: Tekniskt och utmanande traillopp på Romeleåsens höjder
Start och mål på Ekevallen med omklädningsrum och duschar
Vätskekontroller med vatten, Coca-Cola, sportdryck och snacks längs banan
additional: Alla distanser startar i samma lopp och tävlar om totala placeringar. I mål erbjuds vatten, Coca-Cola och mat. Finishertröja kan förbeställas till priset 200 kr med sista beställningsdag 7 mars. Tävlingscenter har vätska, energi, omklädningsrum och duschar. Mat och dryck ingår efter målgång.

name: Fredrikstadløpet
description: The Fredrikstadløpet is held in Gamlebyen in Fredrikstad, with the start and finish at Kongstenhallen. The event offers distances of 3 km for children and youth, 5 km, and a 21 km half marathon. All courses are on asphalt and are flat, with no elevation changes. The half-marathon course consists of three identical laps of approximately 7 km each, and the courses have been officially measured by a nationally approved course measurer. The event has international status and is a quality race, with course marshals at every intersection for safety.
course_highlights: Asphalt surface, except for a little gravel in the start and finish area
Flat courses with no elevation changes or sharp turns
The half marathon is run as three identical 7 km laps, with two pedestrian underpasses
additional: The start and finish area is behind Kongstenhallen. The children’s race is approximately 500 m and takes place near the start/finish area for the other distances. The course crosses busy roads in a few places, but course marshals are stationed at every intersection. Kondis members receive a discount on the entry fee. Registration for 2027 opens in September. The start and finish area, race office, and changing rooms are at Installatøren Arena, Torsnesveien 12, Gamle Fredrikstad. The course crosses busy roads in some places, with course marshals at the intersections.

name: Norgestesten 2027 1
description: Norgestesten is an efficient and simple running event held in Jessheim, with a mass start for all distances. The course is a flat 3,146-meter loop, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Distances range from an 800-meter children’s race to a half marathon, with pacers to help participants maintain the right pace. The event is run by volunteers, and any surplus goes to sports for children and young people.
course_highlights: Flat 3,146-meter loop
Mass start for all distances
Pacers at several speeds, from 4:00 to 7:00 min/km
additional: The children’s race starts at 09:30 and is approximately 800 m long. Bib pickup is self-service from 09:00. Toilets are available at Jessheim Athletics Stadium and in the ice and multipurpose hall. A table for participants’ own drinks is available at the start, and water and sports drinks are provided along the course. The half marathon has a cut-off time of 2 hours and 30 minutes. The race is listed as WA-approved. Train services and parking are approximately 300 meters from the start area.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The course runs through beautiful woodland around Lake Szmaragdowe, with varied uphill and downhill sections, making the event appealing to both beginner and experienced runners. The races aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity, while providing an opportunity for friendly sporting competition. The start and finish are located at Zajazd Szmaragd, and races take place regularly during the season from October to April.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Szmaragdowe
Varied uphill and downhill sections, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
Start and finish behind Zajazd Szmaragd on Kopalniana Street
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start, at 10:45. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course is permanent, making it possible to compare results over the months and years. The race is scheduled for 4 April 2027, with the start at 11:00. CITY TRAIL Junior races are also held as part of the series.

name: Bredase Singelloop 2027
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1.9 km, 0.8 km

name: Drutenloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Drutenloop is a sporting event held in the atmospheric town centre and along the beautiful dikes of Druten. The event offers a range of events for all ages, including children’s races, shorter distances, a 10-kilometre race and a half marathon. Since 2026, new events have also been added, including the Crossfit fitness race and the Bendefit nature walk. The Drutenloop is known for bringing people together and for its convivial atmosphere.
course_highlights: A beautiful route along the Waalbandijk and through the centre of Druten
A range of distances, from a 500-metre children’s race to a half marathon (21.1 km)
New since 2026: Crossfit fitness race and Bendefit nature walk
additional: Race bibs are required and include a BIB tag for timekeeping. Race bibs can be collected on Saturday 11 April from 15:00 to 18:00 at the bondsgebouw, and on Sunday 12 April until half an hour before the race at the information point on the Markt. There is a first-aid station at the start/finish, and first-aid responders also ride along on bicycles. The first three boys and girls in each age category will receive awards. All 500 m and 1 km runners receive a medal at the finish. The event is actively promoted on social media, with updates and results on Facebook and Instagram.

name: Gemert City Run
location: Het centrum van Gemert, Noord-Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Gemert City Run is an atmospheric running event in the historic centre of Gemert, where runners of all levels come together for a day full of energy and fun. With distances ranging from Kids Runs to 15 km, as well as a relay, there is a suitable challenge for everyone. The route passes iconic places such as the castle and Ridderplein, with the start and finish in the lively town centre. After the finish, everyone raises a glass to celebrate their achievements, giving the day a festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the historic centre of Gemert
Past Gemert Castle and St. John’s Church
Start and finish at atmospheric Ridderplein
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 09:30 at the Town Hall. Late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the race starts; payment is accepted in cash or by debit card. There is a Business Run and a relay (4 x 700 m lap). The programme includes multiple start times for different distances and a festive ceremony afterwards. Participants can choose from various distances, including special Kids Runs for children. The event promotes sport, fun and community involvement.

name: Halve van Den Helder
description: The Halve van Den Helder is a unique event where you can experience the city of Den Helder in a special way, both walking and running. The course follows the coast, passes forts, the iconic De Lange Jaap lighthouse, the Marsdiep and the Helderse Zeedijk, and includes surprising locations that are normally closed to the public. The event combines sport with cultural heritage and nature, giving participants a varied experience. The walking event takes place on Saturday 3 April 2027, and the running races on Sunday 4 April 2027.
course_highlights: Along the coast and the Marsdiep
Past forts and the De Lange Jaap lighthouse
A visit to surprising locations that are normally closed to the public
additional: The walking event takes place on Saturday 3 April 2027, and the running races on Sunday 4 April 2027. Running distances: 21 km, 10 km and 4 km. There is also a corporate race and a kids’ run. Registration for the 15th edition in 2027 is currently closed and will reopen in September. Distances: 21 km, 10 km and 4 km; the course passes along the coast, forts, the lighthouse and cultural heritage sites; the event takes place on 3 and 4 April 2027.

name: Marathon Amersfoort
description: Marathon Amersfoort is a sporting and festive running event held in the city of Amersfoort. The event offers a range of distances for all levels, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, mini marathons and walking distances. The marathon is held in early spring to ensure favourable weather conditions. A varied music programme along the course supports and encourages runners and spectators.
course_highlights: A range of distances from a 1.1 km mini marathon to a 42.2 km marathon
Music along the course with 20 DJs, brass bands and samba bands
Start and finish in the centre of Amersfoort, with lively support
additional: On Saturday, there is a 42.2 km training marathon starting at 8:30. On Sunday, there are 5, 10 and 21 km runs, various walking distances and mini marathons for primary school pupils. The organisers ask participants and spectators to travel by bike or on foot wherever possible. Parking is available in the Eemplein and Oppidium car parks. Amersfoort Centraal station is about a 10-minute walk from the event. Participants can register from 1 November; the event also includes walking routes and a training run on 30 May. The race is organised in cooperation with the municipality of Amersfoort and includes various course options.

name: Stoomtramloop
description: The Stoomtramloop is a unique recreational running experience in which participants travel by historic steam tram from Medemblik to Opperdoes or Twisk. Participants then run 5 or 10 kilometres back to Medemblik. The focus is on fun and the experience. Because the start and finish locations vary, exact timekeeping is not possible, and every participant is a winner. The event takes place on the first Sunday of April and offers a special combination of sport and history.
course_highlights: 5 km route from Opperdoes station to Medemblik
10 km route from Twisk station via Opperdoes to Medemblik
Travel by historic steam tram from Medemblik to the start locations
additional: Maximum 500 participants, split equally between the 5 km and 10 km distances. Registration includes steam tram transport and a unique running shirt. Time limits: 45 minutes for 5 km and 90 minutes for 10 km. There is a drinks station at Opperdoes station. Traffic marshals are present at crossings. There is a small chance of waiting at railway crossings. Participation includes a running shirt and steam tram transport. The event is limited to 500 participants and is known for its friendly, non-competitive atmosphere.

name: Reakt-Brijderloop
location: Atletiekvereniging Hylas, Alkmaar, North Holland, Netherlands
price_range: Prestatieloop 5/10 km: € 10,00; Kidsrun: € 5,00; op de dag zelf: Prestatieloop € 15,00; Kidsrun € 10,00
description: The Reakt-Brijderloop is a recreational road race in Alkmaar, specially organized for people with a history of addiction, mental health vulnerabilities, and anyone who enjoys running. The event includes a 5- or 10-kilometer race and a kids’ run with three distances. The start and finish are at Atletiekvereniging Hylas. The run supports recovery through exercise and has a long tradition spanning 26 years.
course_highlights: 5- and 10-kilometer races
Kids’ run in three categories: 400m, 800m, and 1200m
Start and finish at AV Hylas in Alkmaar
additional: If you register in advance, you’ll receive a race number bearing your own name. The event welcomes participants with physical disabilities and para-athletes. Registration on the day is possible at a higher price. Participants can register until 15 March; the kids’ runs range from 400m to 1200m; the event promotes recovery and self-confidence among participants.

name: Amgen Singelloop Breda 2027
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1.9 km, 0.8 km

name: SpriT Frontyard - Genarp
description: SpriT Frontyard Genarp is a fast and fun trail-running race at Genarpsbadet, suitable for all levels and ambitions.
