The course is approximately 1 km long and consists of gravel road, forest trail and sand, with no asphalt, and two small hills at the beginning. The race is about running as many laps as you can within time limits that gradually decrease. Water, cola and other treats are available at the lap point and after the finish, and great prizes are awarded to many participants.
course_highlights: A mix of gravel road, forest trail and sand
Two small hills at the beginning of the course
A fast course with an exciting finish on the final straight
additional: You have 10 minutes for the first lap, 9 minutes and 40 seconds for the second lap, 9 minutes and 20 seconds for the third lap, and so on. Great prizes are awarded to many participants. Registration is binding once payment has been made. The organiser recommends insurance in case of injury or illness. The race details found apply to previous editions.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Halmstad is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances in the scenic Alet Nature Reserve. The event is all about the joy of movement and community, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ambition levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event is part of a long-standing tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and community.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Alet Nature Reserve and on Skepparegatan in Halmstad
Measured 5 km course
Scenic area, with the event area accessible on foot or by bicycle
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden in the days before the race. Teams of 5 receive a picnic after the finish. You can opt out of timed results. Recommended ages: 2.5 km from age 11 (age 7 when accompanied by an adult); 5 km from age 13 (age 11 when accompanied by an adult). Changing at home is recommended, as there are no changing facilities at the venue. Water stations and toilets are available at the event area. Parking is available, but environmentally friendly travel is encouraged. Participants can choose to have their 5 km time recorded, and the event features a festive atmosphere with opportunities for community and well-being.

name: Varvetmilen - Jönköping
description: Varvetmilen Jönköping is a 10 km race that starts and finishes in Knektaparken. The course consists of two clockwise laps around scenic Lake Rocksjon and offers a wonderful running experience. Your Varvetmilen result can be used for seeding at Göteborgsvarvet, giving runners the chance to secure a better starting group. The race is organised by Göteborgsvarvet in cooperation with IKHP Huskvarna Idrottsklubb and is part of the Varvetmilen tour of Sweden.
course_highlights: Two clockwise laps around Lake Rocksjön
Start and finish in scenic Knektaparken
Qualifies for seeding at Göteborgsvarvet
additional: Race bib collection and bag drop take place at Knektaparken on race day. Minivarvet also takes place alongside Varvetmilen: a 210-metre race for children aged 0–6, with a medal for every participant. Registration for Minivarvet is available on site via Swish (80 kr). The race starts in Knektaparken and covers two laps around Lake Rocksjön. Race bibs can be collected the day before and on race day. Showers, changing facilities, bag storage and a small café are available on site.

name: Fløibanen Opp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 650 kr for åpen gruppe eller seedet gruppe

description: Fløibanen Opp is Bergen’s most spectacular uphill race, held annually, where participants run up to Fløyen alongside the Fløibanen funicular tracks. The race is suitable for everyone, from children and recreational runners to elite athletes, and offers a unique experience with an 820-metre course and 310 metres of elevation gain. After the finish, a celebration awaits at the top, with music, medals, T-shirts, refreshments and an awards ceremony. The event brings the joy of sport to the heart of Bergen and offers a great opportunity to challenge yourself on a spectacular uphill course.
course_highlights: An 820-metre course with 310 metres of elevation gain
Steepest section with a 26-degree incline
Run alongside the Fløibanen funicular tracks up to Fløyen
additional: Race numbers are collected before the start at the entrance to the Fløibanen funicular. Participants receive an email with their exact start time and important information closer to race day. Businesses can get a discount code for free employee registration and take part in Afterrun at ToppFløyen with their own teams. In 2026, the open-class start was at 18:25; race numbers were collected at the entrance to the Fløibanen funicular, and everyone received a medal and a T-shirt.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 1
description: Voss Running Series is a running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00 in 2027. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at the sports grounds in Voss, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. You can sign up for individual races or all six races together, with a discount for early registration. This is a friendly recreational run that welcomes both joggers and runners aged 9 and up.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at the sports grounds
Route through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: The races take place on Mondays, starting at 19:00, except for the fifth race on 20 September, which starts at 18:30. Registration is online only via EQ Timing. A discount is available when registering for all six races by the second race. You can sign up for individual races or all six races in the series; the discount applies when registering for all six by the second race.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, alle løp
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is a running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00. The course is 5 km long and runs from Voss Sports Ground through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade back to the sports ground. The series welcomes recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up to enjoyable races throughout the season. Registration is online, and a discount is available when registering for all six races by the second race.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground
Route through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade
Races take place on Mondays, starting at 19:00, except for the final race, which starts at 18:30
additional: The fifth race on 20 September starts at 18:30 instead of 19:00. Races usually take place on Mondays, starting at 19:00. Registration is through EQ Timing. A discount is available when registering for all the races by the second race.

name: XII Bieg do Pustego Grobu
organizer: Parafia Rzymsko-Katolicka pw. Świętego Antoniego w Nowej Soli
description: The 12th Run to the Empty Tomb is a 10 km race held in Nowa Sól on Easter Monday at 14:00. The course passes important churches in the city, including St. Anthony’s, St. Barbara’s, St. Joseph’s, the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, and St. Michael’s, as well as the cemetery on Wandy Street. The race has a spiritual and symbolic character, recalling the footsteps of St. Peter and St. John as they ran to the Tomb of the Lord to confirm the Resurrection of Jesus.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through Nowa Sól’s churches: St. Anthony’s, St. Barbara’s, St. Joseph’s, the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary, and St. Michael’s
Passes through the cemetery on Wandy Street
The race takes place on Easter Monday at 14:00
additional: The organizer is the Roman Catholic Parish of St. Anthony in Nowa Sól. The race has a spiritual and symbolic dimension, referring to the Easter tradition. No information was found about entry fees or participant limits. The start is scheduled for Easter Monday at 14:00. The 12th edition took place in 2026.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg
description: Vårruset in Vänersborg is a recreational race for women offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances on a course that has been officially measured. The event is all about the joy of exercise and community, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ambition levels. After crossing the finish line, teams of five are treated to a picnic, making for a lovely spring evening together. The event starts and finishes at Sanden in Vänersborg and offers every participant a medal, a finish-line bag, optional timing, and a race bib.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Sanden, Vänersborg
Picnic after the race for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Överby in Trollhättan in the days before the race. Participants can opt out of timing when registering. Picnic collection is made using the team leader’s race bib. The recommended ages are 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part when accompanied by an adult. The event area is easy to reach by public transport, and free parking is available at Sanden. Teams consist of 5 people, and members can run different distances. The event is part of Sweden’s largest women’s recreational race series, with a focus on community, the joy of exercise, and health. Participants can choose to have their time recorded or run without timing, and there are marshals, music, and entertainment along the course.

name: Seabrokers Hålandsvannet Halvmaraton
description: Seabrokers Hålandsvannet Half Marathon is a social recreational race in scenic surroundings around Hålandsvannet in Randaberg. The race offers two distances, 7 km and the half marathon, with electronic timing, a medal for all finishers, and several water stations along the course. The start and finish are by the car park in Kvernevik / Viste Hageby, and the race runs clockwise on gravel. It is an inclusive running experience for all levels, with prizes awarded to the top three women and men in both distances.
course_highlights: Clockwise route around Hålandsvannet
Approx. 99% gravel surface
Water stations staffed by Seabrokers along the course
additional: Race bibs are distributed from 15:00. The 7 km starts at 17:40 and the half marathon at 18:00. Net timing with split times at 4 km, 7 km, 11 km, 14 km, and 18 km. SMS times are available for those who want them. Results are published live on eTiming.no. A medal is awarded to everyone who finishes. Previous editions have used electronic timing. Practical details and the date may vary from year to year.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a six-leg relay race that starts and finishes in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The course is flat and easy to run, with a varied gravel and asphalt surface, making it suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. The focus is on community and the joy of running, and all teams start at the same time. In the anniversary year, a Mini Race for children is also held, with a medal and certificate for every participant.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Start and finish in the heart of Bruksparken, Bromölla
Water station at approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Timing is provided by data chip, and both the total finish time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and prizes are also drawn for all participants. The Mini Race for children starts below Bruksparken, with a group warm-up at 10:20. After finishing, all children receive a medal, certificate, drink and fruit. The event includes a mini category for children and is open to both recreational and elite runners. Participants can expect chip timing to record total and individual times.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
price_range: 325 kronor (ordinarie), 195 kronor (kyrkundan), gratis för barnloppet, tillkommer 50 kronor för efteranmälan
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a popular running event featuring a scenic six-kilometre course through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course follows the Svartån and includes both challenging uphill sections and enjoyable downhills, with an almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also Kyrkundan, approximately 3 km, and a free children’s race, Bostadsbolaget Lilla Stadsparksloppet. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal as proof of their effort. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in cooperation with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Stadsparken, Mjölby
Runs along the Svartån for most of the route; 99% asphalt
Includes challenging uphill sections and enjoyable downhills
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May, 12:00–18:00, with a 25% discount coupon. Fitness4You will lead the warm-up before the start. The children’s race has four starts between 11:00 and 11:45, with age groups up to 12 years. The main race starts at 13:00 and Kyrkundan at 13:10. Late registration is possible until 8 May for an additional fee of SEK 50. Massage is available in the start and finish area. The race takes place in Stadsparken, with the option of a company tent; registration is via the website, race bibs are collected at Intersport Mjölby, and sponsorship is possible.

name: Springtime Mariestads stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis deltagande för barn upp till årskurs 6 och personer med funktionsvariation

description: Springtime Mariestads Stadslopp is an annual road race organized by Mariestads AIF and Korpen Mariestad since 1982. The race takes place in Mariestad in early May and offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including 10 km, 5 km, a children’s race and a race for people with disabilities. The event is part of the Västsvenska Löparcupen and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners in various categories. It is a traditional, well-attended running festival with strong involvement from volunteers and participants.
course_highlights: Two main distances: 10 km (2 x 5 km) and 5 km on city streets
Children’s race and race for people with disabilities, with shorter 500 m and 2,000 m routes
Part of the Västsvenska Löparcupen
additional: Start times: Funkisloppet at 10:30, Minimara at 11:15, 10 km and 5 km at 12:00. Participation in the senior and veteran categories requires membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation. Participants may run with a guide in Funkisloppet. Course maps are available via a link on the website. Multiple race distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and children’s and disability races; registration is required; medals and prizes for participants.

name: Terrengløpskarusellen 2027 løp 1
description: The cross-country running series is an annual event organised by Haugesund Idrettslag in Haraldsvang Nature Park. The races follow gravel and forest trails, starting and finishing by the stage/pavilion in Haraldsvang. The series is popular with both children and adults, with a focus on the joy of sport and achievement on varied terrain. Results are published continuously on EQ Timing, and prizes are awarded after the final race.
course_highlights: The routes are mostly on gravel paths, with approximately 200 metres of forest-surface terrain per lap
Start and finish by the stage/pavilion in Haraldsvang Nature Park
Varied terrain with both gravel and forest trails
additional: Race numbers are handed out by class at the stage in Haraldsvang and must be used for all three races in the series. A group warm-up for the youngest participants starts at 17:30. Results are published live on EQ Timing. Prizes are awarded immediately after the final race on the stage in Haraldsvang. The 2026 edition consisted of three races, and the same race number was used throughout the series.

name: Springtime 2026
description: Springtime in Helsingborg is a traditional running event with three distances: 10 km, 5 km and HD's MiniSpringtime for children. The 10 km race is the classic event and has been held since 1981, while the 5 km race is a shorter, more intense alternative. The races also offer team competitions in which men and women compete on equal terms through time adjustments. The courses are carefully measured, with the start and finish together at Stortorget, providing a scenic and spectator-friendly running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stortorget in Helsingborg
The course includes the entire climb up Pålsjöbacken, with no detour
Certified 5 km and 10 km courses measured by Swedish Athletics course measurers
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib, medal, water and fruit at the finish. Late registration is available through 3 May on the website for an additional fee, and thereafter at Löplabbet, subject to availability. Insurance can be purchased when registering. Team competitions are offered, with times adjusted for men and women.

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a trail race that welcomes everyone, from children and recreational participants to experienced runners and mountain bikers. The race follows a scenic route through the pine-covered esker between Alberga and Kungsör, along trails and gravel roads with moderate hills and technical sections. The event has an open, welcoming atmosphere created together by volunteers, spectators and participants, and is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis. Many return year after year, while new participants take part for the first time.
course_highlights: Trail running and cycling along a pine-covered esker
Trails and gravel roads with moderate hills
Technical sections in nature between Alberga and Kungsör
additional: Late registration opens on the Thursday before race week. Start lists for pre-registered participants are available. The race is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis, with a strong sense of community among participants, volunteers and spectators.

name: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt 1. løp
description: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt is a traditional fun run organized by Osterøy IL Friidrett. The race takes place in Valestrandsmarka over a distance of 4.4 km, starting at Furubakken sports ground in Valestrandsfossen. Several races are held during the season, with start times of 18:45 for walkers and 19:00 for the main field. Participants can enjoy a scenic course and a great atmosphere, and prizes and sveler are handed out after the race. The race has a long history, with extensive statistics and records available to participants.
course_highlights: 4.4 km course in Valestrandsmarka
Starts at Furubakken sports ground, Valestrandsfossen
Start times: 18:45 (walkers) and 19:00 (main field)
additional: Course records are rewarded with NOK 3,000 from HTB. Sveler from Toro and squash are served after the race. Registration is available at the venue, Furubakken sports ground, until the start. The race does not require a licence, and payment can be made via Vipps to 121337. Christmas and New Year's races are also held, with their own start times. Previous races have started at 18:45 and 19:00.

name: Craft ParadiseTrail 2027 - powered by Eventyrsport
distance_verbose: 29 km, 22 km, 14 km, 9 km, 5 km, 2.5 km

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset in Växjö is a fun run for women featuring 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö. The event is all about the joy of running and community, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ability levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event is part of a long-standing tradition dating back to 1989 and focuses on promoting women’s health and creating an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course around Lake Växjö
Start and finish at Strandbjörket
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in the days before the race. Bibs must be worn visibly throughout the race. You can opt out of timing. The event area has a water station, toilets, a café, and a sponsor village with activities. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Teams consist of 5 people and receive a picnic after the finish. The race is open to everyone, and participants can register individually or in teams of five. Women born in 1994–1999 can also receive free HPV vaccinations on site during Vårruset in Växjö.

name: Varvetmilen Göteborg
description: Varvetmilen Göteborg is a 10 km race that gives runners the chance to improve their starting group for Göteborgsvarvet 2027. The race starts at the entrance park at Slottsskogsvallen and passes through scenic areas such as Högsbotorp, Flatås and Järnbrott, with a water station at 5 km. The course finishes in Slottsskogen, with the finish line at the starting area. Varvetmilen is a qualifying race for Göteborgsvarvet and is organised by Göteborgsvarvet.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the entrance park at Slottsskogsvallen
Water station at 5 km with water and sports drink
The course passes through Högsbotorp, Flatås, Järnbrott and Slottsskogen
additional: Starts take place in several waves between 11:00 and 11:20. Race bibs can be collected at Friidrottens hus, near the start and finish area. The race is a qualifying race for Göteborgsvarvet 2027, meaning your result automatically improves your starting group for Göteborgsvarvet, with no additional registration required. Your result is automatically used to qualify for a better starting group in Göteborgsvarvet 2027; no additional registration is required. Registration opens later.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.goteborgsvarvet.se/ovriga-lopp/varvetmilen/varvetmilen-goteborg): 2027-04-10 — "Datum: 10 april 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-11)

name: Startmilen
price_range: 2026 års avgifter: 50–80 kr för KnatteStarten, 100–250 kr för 5 km och 200–300 kr för 10 km
description: Startmilen is a recreational race in Örebro that welcomes runners of all abilities and marks the start of the outdoor running season for many. The event offers a 1 km race for children, 5 km for juniors and veterans, and 10 km for competitive runners and recreational participants. The start and finish are at Tybblelundshallen, near Örebro University, and the course runs along streets in the Almby district. The 10 km race is the district championship for Södra Svealand and is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series. Official timing is provided for all races except the children’s race.
course_highlights: Start and finish outside Tybblelundshallen at Örebro University
The course runs along streets in the Almby district
The 5 km and 10 km courses are certified by a federation course measurer
additional: Race numbers are distributed at Tybblelundshallen from around 10:30 on race day. Timing uses a transponder, which is loaned out when race numbers are distributed and must be returned after finishing. A fee of SEK 800 applies for a lost transponder. All races except KnatteStarten are timed. Prize ceremonies take place at 13:40 for the 5 km and 15:30 for the 10 km. All finishers receive a medal. All finishers receive a medal. Information about distances and fees is from the 2026 edition and may change for 2027.

name: Tjust Trail Run
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organised by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging and sweaty competition on winding trails, over beautiful rocky outcrops and through the scenic nature of Småland. Participants get to experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running across varied terrain. Welcome to a wonderful running experience in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: Winding trails through the Småland forest
Sections over beautiful rocky outcrops
Beautiful and varied terrain
additional: Changes to the race distance are possible by email until 31 March. On the longest distance (The Long Run), runners must complete a lap by 11:45 to be allowed to continue for the second lap. Race bibs must be clearly visible. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. If withdrawing, participants must notify a race official or call the number provided. Transport can be arranged from aid stations if needed. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. Distance changes can be made until 31 March.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.tjusttrailrun.com/): 2027-04-10 — "10 april 2027 kommer Tjust Bike & Running Club anordna den elfte upplagan av TJUST TRAIL RUN." (was estimated 2027-04-17)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: 10 april 2027 kommer Tjust Bike & Running Club anordna den elfte upplagan av TJUST TRAIL RUN.

name: BLK Trailen (Bredared)
description: The BLK Trail in Bredared is a trail race organised by Borås Running Club, a club that welcomes all runners and offers a wide range of activities. The race takes place in scenic surroundings by Björkehovsgården and features varied trails and terrain suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. The club also organises other events and challenges throughout the year to promote the joy of running and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Trail running in scenic surroundings by Björkehovsgården
Varied trails with both shorter and longer distances
Running through woodland with natural features and hilly terrain
additional: Registration takes place at the start and is free for members of Borås Running Club. The club also organises monthly challenges and the BLK Cup, with a points system based on different trails and distances.

name: Kurts 300:e maraton - halvmaran
description: Kurt’s 300th Marathon is a special race organized by Hultsfreds Löparklubb to celebrate Kurt Gustavsson’s 300th marathon and his 80th birthday. The race follows a 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred, combining park paths and asphalt. The half marathon consists of two long laps and one shorter lap. The start and finish are at the entrance to Knektavallen, where changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available. After the race, participants are invited to a get-together with food and good company.
course_highlights: 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen
20% asphalt, the rest park paths
Two water stations offering water, sports drink, cola, and fruit
additional: The start and finish are at the entrance to Knektavallen, facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to take over 5 hours start at 09:00. After the race, a get-together with food and good company is offered at around 14:30, about 1 km from Knektavallen at the restaurant. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned. The start and finish are at Knektavallen; changing rooms, showers, toilets, and water stations are available according to the organizer’s information.

name: Tunnelløpet
organizer: BFG Bergen løpeklubb og Fyllingen Friidrett
description: Tunnelløpet is a fast 5 km road race that starts and finishes at the entrance to the tunnel on the Fyllingsdalen side in Bergen. The race runs partly on asphalt and partly on a royal-blue rubber surface inside the tunnel, providing stable, ideal running conditions without wind or rain, at a temperature of around 11–12 degrees year-round. The race is World Athletics-approved and attracts runners looking to set personal records. Children’s races are also held, with free entry and wave starts to ensure a good race experience for everyone.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the tunnel entrance on the Fyllingsdalen side
Run on asphalt on the way out and a royal-blue rubber surface on the way back through the tunnel
Stable conditions of around 11–12 degrees, with no wind or rain
additional: Wave starts are based on estimated finishing time, with around one minute between each wave. Children’s race distances are 400 metres for ages 3–5 and 1,500 metres for ages 6–10. Entry is free, but registration is mandatory. Race bibs are distributed the evening before the race at Oasen Senter. Race bib transfers are handled through Eq-timing for a fee. The main race has wave starts based on estimated finishing time. The children’s race is free but requires registration. Registration for the 2027 edition will open later in 2026.

name: TUNNELLØPET BERGEN 5 KM 2027
location: Fyllingsdalen tunnel entrance near Oasen, Bergen, Norway
organizer: BFG Bergen løpeklubb og Fyllingen Friidrett
description: Tunnelløpet 5 km is a fast road race that starts and finishes at the tunnel entrance on the Fyllingsdalen side in Bergen. The race runs partly on asphalt and partly on a royal-blue rubber surface inside a 3 km long pedestrian and cycling tunnel, providing stable, wind-free conditions and a temperature of around 11–12 degrees. With a drop of approximately 17 metres from the start to the turnaround, the course is ideal for fast times and personal records. The race is World Athletics-approved and has been held since 2023 in connection with the opening of the tunnel.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the tunnel entrance on the Fyllingsdalen side
Run on asphalt on the way out and a royal-blue rubber surface on the way back through the tunnel
Wind-free, stable temperatures of around 11–12 degrees
additional: Wave starts are used, with approximately one minute between each wave based on expected finishing time to ensure a good race experience. Race bibs are distributed the evening before the race at Oasen Senter. A children's race is held with free registration and a medal for everyone, with distances from 400 metres to 1500 metres. Registration for the 2027 edition is expected to open later in 2026. Race bibs are distributed at Oasen on Thursday and Friday evening before the race. There is also a free children's race with registration.

name: 23 Bieg Europejski Mistrzostwa Polski Ciepłowników
organizer: Klub Sportowy Altom Gniezno oraz Przedsiębiorstwo Energetyki Cieplnej w Gnieźnie Sp. z o.o.
description: The 23rd European Run is an annual running event held in Gniezno, commemorating Poland’s accession to the European Union. The 10 km main race runs through the city streets, with the start and finish on Gniezno’s Market Square. The course is certified by the PZLA and consists of one loop with asphalt and cobblestone surfaces. The event attracts runners from many countries, creating an international atmosphere for this sporting celebration. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal on the Market Square and attend the winners’ awards ceremony.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the streets of Gniezno, asphalt and cobblestones (5%)
Start and finish on Gniezno’s Market Square
PZLA-certified, single-loop course
additional: The race office is open on Friday, 10.04.2027, from 17:00 to 20:30, and on race day, 11.04.2027, from 11:00 to 15:00 (the location has changed to the sports hall at Primary School No. 2 in Gniezno). The time limit for completing the race is 1 hour 30 minutes. Timing is by chips in the race bibs. A recovery meal will be served after the race on the Market Square (available to runners only). The winners’ awards ceremony takes place at 18:00 on the stage on the Market Square. The event also includes a Preschoolers’ Run, divided into age groups, with wristbands and T-shirts required. The Polish Heating Professionals Championships are intended for employees of the district heating industry.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu im. Adama Mickiewicza, Poznań, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań is a spring edition of a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska. The event takes place in the picturesque Botanical Garden in Poznań, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. Since 2014, the organizers have emphasized the aesthetics of the courses and the promotion of running among different age groups. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and discover Poznań’s charming surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden in Poznań
Picturesque, aesthetically pleasing natural surroundings
Race organized by experienced running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska
additional: The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las, based in Poznań. The event is a cross-country race and emphasizes the aesthetic qualities of its proposed locations. In summer 2026, the organizers are celebrating the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka. The organizer provides a participant guide and separate information about children’s and youth races. Registration for the main distance and children’s races has closed.

name: Niebieska 5-ka
description: The Blue 5K is a race organized in Słupsk by the “Sub ventum” Foundation for Supporting Unconventional Initiatives. The event invites everyone to run together and spend time actively.

name: 4 Mijl van AvK
description: The 4 Mijl van AvK is a running event covering a distance of 6.4 kilometers in the unique peat-colony landscape of Annerveenschekanaal. The route runs alongside and through this distinctive landscape, giving the race a characteristic and atmospheric feel. The event attracts runners who enjoy a challenging and scenic running environment.
course_highlights: 6.4 km running route
Alongside and through the peat-colony landscape
Unique nature and scenery
additional: The event is popular with local runners and offers a great opportunity to run in a special setting. No specific information about registration fees is available.

name: Halve van Nijkerk
description: The Bouw Logistics Half Marathon of Nijkerk is a sporting event held in the centre of Nijkerk. Participants can choose from several distances, including the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, KidsRun, and walking routes of 10, 15, and 20 km. The course runs through and around the city, with a legendary finish at ’t Plein. The atmosphere is fantastic, with plenty of spectators along the route and a festive ambiance for all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the centre of Nijkerk, at Molenplein and ’t Plein
Walking routes of 10, 15, and 20 km through and around Nijkerk
Legendary finish at ’t Plein with plenty of spectators
additional: Start times: 15:00 walking (10, 15, 20 km), 16:30 KidsRun, 16:45 half marathon, 17:00 5 km, 18:45 10 km. The start and finish are approximately 300 metres apart. Changing rooms are available at the start area (Molenplein) and close at 20:15. Every finisher receives a unique medal. Registration is open until race day, unless the event sells out. BusinessRun is for company teams of 5 participants, competing in the 5 km, 10 km, or half marathon. The event includes a half marathon and attracts runners from the region and beyond.

name: 4 Mijl van Annerveenschekanaal
location: Annerveenschekanaal, Aa en Hunze, Drenthe, Netherlands

name: The Royal Copenhagen City Half
description:
Fladt halvmaraton på lukkede veje gennem København. Ruten går fra havnen i Nordhavn forbi Kastellet, Amalienborg, Nyhavn, Den Sorte Diamant og Lille Langebro til mål ved Royal Arena i Ørestad. Flad asfalt med under 16 højdemeter, lange lige stræk og få sving – passer både til dit første halvmaraton og til jagten på en ny PR.

Første udgave i april 2026 havde 2.758 gennemførende fra 66 nationer. I 2027 forventes ca. 10.000 løbere.
additional:
Start kl. 09:30, 2 min fra Orientkaj Metro. Fra mål er der 10 min med metro til lufthavnen.
Startgebyret dækker chiptid (RACE RESULT), medalje, digitalt diplom, depoter cirka hver 5. km og gratis bagagetransport fra start til mål.
Priser: 695 kr. til 16/1-2027 · 895 kr. fra 17/1 · 1.095 kr. fra 28/2. Aldersgrænse 15 år.
Bemærk: Det her er forårsløbet 11. april 2027, ikke Copenhagen Half Marathon i september.
