name: Vårruset Göteborg
description: Vårruset Göteborg is a popular spring running event held in Slottsskogen, starting and finishing by Björngårdsvillan. The event offers two distances, 2.5 km and 5 km, with the 5 km course officially measured. It is a social and inclusive event where participants can register individually or as part of a team. Teams that register are treated to a picnic after crossing the finish line. The event is open to all ages, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult. Participants receive a medal, a finish-line goodie bag, optional timekeeping and a race bib.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course in Slottsskogen
Start and finish below Björngårdsvillan
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
additional: Registration is binding and can be completed online until race day, no later than one hour before the first start. Participants can opt out of timekeeping when registering. Teams consist of 5 people, and team members can run different distances. The recommended minimum age is 7 when accompanied by an adult for the 2.5 km and 11 when accompanied by an adult for the 5 km. The event is part of Sweden’s largest women’s recreational running series, with online registration, the option to participate as a team, and timekeeping on the 5 km course. Participants are treated to a medal, a finish-line goodie bag, a picnic and entertainment.

name: Hässleholmsloppet
description: Hässleholmsloppet is a trail race held at the beautiful Hovdala Castle in Hässleholm. The race offers three distances: 21 km, 10 km and 5.4 km. All courses feature gentle, winding trails through varied woodland, with stretches alongside water. The longest course, 21 km, is part of Spring i Skåne’s Trail Cup and offers extra elevation and a scenic route. The race is open to both recreational runners and young people; the recommended minimum age for the longest distance is 17.
course_highlights: Gentle, winding trails through varied woodland
Sections alongside water along the courses
The 21 km course is a scenic route at Hovdala with extra elevation
additional: Start and finish at Hovdala Castle. Runners should arrive 10 minutes before the start. Bibs must be collected at the venue at least 30 minutes before the start and worn visibly at the front. Electronic timing is used. There are no shower or changing facilities, but toilets are available. Water and sports drink stations are available on all courses. The maximum number of participants is 400. Name changes are possible for a fee of 100 kr via the registration page. The race information specifies electronic timing, aid stations on all courses and a participant limit of 400. The prices and practical details apply to the published information for 2026.

name: Trioløpet
description: Trioløpet is being held for the first time on Saturday, April 11, 2027, by IL Trio Athletics. The race offers several categories to include as many participants as possible, including a timed 5 km course starting at Husnes Stadium, running through the town centre and around the church. There is also an untimed 3–4 km recreational category along Opsangervatnet, as well as children’s races and accessible options with adapted distances at or around Husnes Stadium. The event aims to become a community celebration on a par with the former Søralløpet.
course_highlights: Measured, flat 5 km course from Husnes Stadium through the town centre and around the church
3–4 km recreational category along Opsangervatnet
Children’s races and accessible options at or around Husnes Stadium
additional: The race takes place at Husnes Stadium and includes both competitive and recreational categories. The recreational course is suitable for walking or jogging. The event aims to create a community celebration and also includes children’s races and accessible options. In 2026, participants in the 5 km race category registered in advance via EQTiming, while the other categories had registration at the stadium on race day.

name: H3 Hamar Vårløp
description: H3 Hamar Spring Run is an inclusive running celebration in Hamar, inviting everyone, regardless of ability, to take part in the 5 km or 10 km race. The course is mainly on asphalt and gravel, and is almost flat, making it ideal for personal bests. The start and finish are at Skibladner Pier, and the event offers a great atmosphere along Lake Mjøsa. Prizes are also awarded to the fastest runners, with prize draws for participants.
course_highlights: A flat, fast race on asphalt and gravel
Start and finish at Skibladner Pier in Hamar
The course has approximately 44 metres of elevation gain and is ideal for personal bests
additional: Race number collection and late registration take place at Skibladner Pier before the start. Race numbers can also be collected at Sport1 CC-Stadion on the Saturday before the race. The race office and baggage drop are by the pier. Showers and changing rooms are available at Esper’n Activity Park, which also has parking. H3 Hamar lists 11 April 2027 as the event date. In previous years, the race has had one 5 km lap and two 10 km laps.

name: 40 Bieg Sokoła
description: Bieg Sokoła is an annual running event organized by the “Sokół” Gymnastics Society in Bukówiec Górny, promoting physical activity and the Włoszakowice Municipality region. The event includes several races, including a 15 km race and shorter distances, as well as the Polish Physicians’ 15 km Championships. The event is marked by a sporting spirit, professional organization, and electronic timing. The start and finish are located at the Village Cultural Centre in Bukówiec Górny.
course_highlights: 15 km main race course
Additional distances: 5 km, 2 km, and 1 km
Start and finish at the Village Cultural Centre in Bukówiec Górny
additional: Participant verification and race-bib collection take place on Saturday from 16:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 8:00 to 10:15. Timing is electronic and uses chips, which are mandatory for participants to be classified. Participants must bring an identity document for age verification. Those under 18 must have written consent from a parent or guardian. Runners must comply with safety rules and the regulations; taking a shortcut results in disqualification.

name: 42 Bieg Szpęgawski
location: Stadion Miejski im. Kazimierza Deyny, Starogard Gdański, Poland
organizer: Miasto Starogard oraz Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Starogardzie Gdańskim
description: The 42nd Bieg Szpęgawski with AQ is one of the oldest road races in Pomerania, held since 1983. The race is intended for amateurs, professionals, and young runners alike. The certified 5 km course is historic and symbolic, running from Szpęgawsk to Starogard Gdański. The organizers provide bus transport to the start and a bag drop for runners. This event has a rich tradition and attracts runners hungry for records and personal bests.
course_highlights: Certified, fast 5 km course
Historic and symbolic route from Szpęgawsk to Starogard Gdański
Organizer-provided bus transport to the start
additional: The organizer provides bus transport to the start from 10:40 to 11:20. Transport is not guaranteed after 11:20. Road traffic is completely stopped at 11:45. A mobile bag drop and a bag drop under a tent at the start are available. Bags can be collected after the race, at approximately 13:15, at the Deyna Center. The organizer provides free bus transport to the start. A mile race is also available.

name: Bieg Mestwina
description: Bieg Mestwina is a running event held in Przywidz and part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The race offers two main routes, 5 km and 10 km, through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia. It attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting an active lifestyle and local running culture. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and professional organization, continuing the tradition of the largest running event in northern Poland.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia
The race takes place in Przywidz, surrounded by Kashubian nature
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland
additional: Bieg Mestwina is one of many events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, which includes various distances and locations across Kashubia. The event promotes physical activity and brings the local community together. The series also features children’s and youth races, as well as other accompanying events. In the edition described in the sources, the children’s races are free and require no registration. Open, age-group, and Przywidz municipality resident classifications are listed.

name: Cross Śrem Grand Prix
location: Orlik w Psarskiem, Psarskie, Śrem County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Śremski Sport, Gmina Śrem i Nadleśnictwo Konstantynowo
price_range: 40 zł za jeden bieg online; 120 zł za pakiet czterech biegów; 50 zł w dniu startu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – przy zapisie online na jeden bieg

description: Cross Śrem Grand Prix is a series of trail races held in the scenic forests around Psarskie, near Śrem. The approximately 5.4 km course follows forest paths and paved cobblestones, giving runners a chance to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere. The start and finish are at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie, which also houses the race office and is the venue for the warm-up and official opening. Participants can expect a medal, a recovery meal, and prizes in the age-group classifications. The event is organized by Śremski Sport together with the Śrem Municipality and Konstantynowo Forest District.
course_highlights: Approximately 5.4 km over forest paths and paved cobblestones
Start and finish at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie, with a modern building and changing rooms
A run through scenic woodland close to the centre of Śrem
additional: The race office, warm-up, and official opening take place at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie at around 11:45. Participants have access to water, hot tea, and coffee in the new building with changing rooms. The event is funded from the Śrem Municipality budget as part of its programme for preventing and addressing alcohol-related problems and drug addiction. Information about fees and the series is from the 2025–2026 edition. In this edition, the start was scheduled for 12:00; participation in at least three of the four races was required for the final classification.

name: Ekonomiczna Piątka
description: Ekonomiczna Piątka is an annual race organized by the Poznań University of Economics and Business, held in the area around Lake Malta. The 5 km course runs on asphalt, making it appealing to both beginner and experienced runners. The event combines sport and socializing, offering a chance to spend time actively in a friendly atmosphere. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km course around Lake Malta
Asphalt surface
Scenic recreational areas of Poznań

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, friendly and family-oriented sporting competition held in Międzyzdroje. In the 2026/2027 season, participants can compete in runs of approximately 5 and 10 km and in nordic walking events of approximately 5 and 7 km. The league is known for its healthy competition and welcoming atmosphere, inviting both regular participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete the required distances in at least four events. Participation is free, and people aged 14 and over may take part.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: To qualify for the league’s overall standings, participants must enter at least four events and complete the required distances: two 5 km and two 10 km runs, or two 5 km and two 7 km nordic walking events. Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian and must be accompanied by them. The league final is scheduled for 11 April 2027. Registration is available at protiming24.pl.

name: Leśne Poruszenie
location: Skwer, ul. Pomorska 71, Dębogórze, gmina Kosakowo, Poland
description: Leśne Poruszenie - Dębogórze is a unique sporting event held on the forest trails of the Kosakowo municipality. The event is for everyone who enjoys an active lifestyle, offering cross-country races for children and adults, a Nordic Walking race, and a cycling ride. Its aim is to bring residents together, promote a healthy lifestyle, and spend time together in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and race office are located at the square in Dębogórze, at 71 Pomorska Street. Participants will receive race packs, commemorative medals, and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Forest trails of the Kosakowo municipality
Cross-country races for children and adults (1 km, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km)
Nordic Walking race and cycling ride
additional: The start and race office are at the square in Dębogórze, at 71 Pomorska Street. In the 2026 edition, the start and race office were at the square in Dębogórze, at 71 Pomorska Street. The previous edition’s program included children’s races of approximately 1 and 2 km, adult races of approximately 5 and 10 km, Nordic Walking over approximately 5 km, and a cycling ride of approximately 10 km.

name: Cruyff Legacy 14K
description: The Cruyff Legacy 14K is an annual running and walking event held at the Johan Cruyff ArenA in Amsterdam. The event brings thousands of participants together to take action for the Johan Cruyff Foundation, which creates opportunities for children with disabilities to participate in sport. The 2026 edition was a great success, with more than 8,000 participants and an impressive amount raised. The next edition takes place on Sunday, 11 April 2027, a special day putting sport and social engagement at the heart of the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Johan Cruyff ArenA in Amsterdam
Run and walk through the city
An event with a social mission to support children with disabilities
additional: The Cruyff Legacy 14K raises awareness of sport for children with disabilities. It is supported by main sponsors including AFC Ajax, OTTO Work Force, PWC and Basic-Fit. The 2026 edition raised €851,639. The organisers invite participants to join this socially minded sports day. Race in Amsterdam, scheduled for 11 April 2027; supports sport for children with disabilities; participants can choose between running and walking.

name: De Oude Weideloop
description: The Oude Weideloop is a running event in Wagenberg, suitable for young and old. There are four distances: a family run of 1 and 2 km, and the 5 km and 10 km, with the 10 km consisting of two 5 km laps. The start and finish are at Van Elsenplein, and the course runs through various streets of Wagenberg. Musical support and timekeeping are provided during the event, and prizes are awarded to the best men and women in all categories.
course_highlights: Family run of 1 and 2 km, suitable for all ages
5 km course through various streets of Wagenberg
10 km consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Changing rooms and a first-aider are available at the sports fields. First-aid stations are located along the route. The information point opens at 11:00 for picking up race numbers and T-shirts. Grandparents or parents may run for free with their child or grandchild during the family run. Timekeeping by Startnummerexpress. Musical support during the run. Prizes for the first three men and women in all categories. Registration is through the official website, and the event is aimed at residents of the municipality of Drimmelen.

name: Enschede Marathon
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Enschede Marathon, the oldest marathon in the Netherlands and Western Europe, takes place on 11 April 2027 in Enschede. The event offers a fast course, excellent support, plenty of music and tens of thousands of enthusiastic supporters. In addition to the full marathon, there are also a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and various kids’ races. The marathon supports KWF Dutch Cancer Society through the “Run Against Cancer” campaign, which encourages participants to collect donations.
course_highlights: Fast course in Enschede, starting and finishing on Boulevard 1945
Excellent support and plenty of music along the course
Tens of thousands of supporters create a vibrant atmosphere
additional: Race numbers can be collected on Saturday 10 April from 10:00 to 16:00 and on Sunday 11 April from 07:30 onwards at the Connect-U registration office in Enschede. Race numbers can also be sent by post within the Netherlands for an additional € 5,-. The marathon features a Club Challenge in which clubs and their members can compete for prizes. There are various categories for men and women, and a special “Run Against Cancer” campaign through which participants can receive a free race entry by raising at least € 500 in donations. Multiple distances, including the marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and kids’ race; registration discounts; charity support; electronic timing; race held since 1947

name: Halve van Helmond
description: De Halve van Helmond is a welcoming running and walking event held annually in Helmond and Stiphout. The main distance is the half marathon, consisting of two 10.55 km laps on a fully paved course, with the start and finish in the centre of Brandevoort. There are also shorter running distances of 10 km and 5 km, a corporate race, a kids’ run and a unique 2.5 km run, so there is a suitable distance for everyone. The event is known for its friendly organisation, scenic routes past sports parks and an enjoyable sporting experience for both competitive runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: The half marathon consists of two 10.55 km laps on a fully paved course
Start and finish in the Brandevoort shopping centre
Aid stations every 2.5 km and a route past the sports parks of local athletics clubs
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day at wijkhuis ’t BrandPunt in Helmond (Brandevoort). There is a staffed cloakroom and changing rooms. A limited number of race entries are available for on-the-day registration for the running events; places are limited. The half marathon has a maximum time limit of 3 hours. Participants who have not started their second lap after 1 hour and 30 minutes will be withdrawn from the race. Running shirts can be ordered free of charge when registering, while stocks last. Race numbers can be collected on 11 and 12 April. Route information and timings will be shared online. The event takes place in Helmond and Stiphout.

name: IJsselloop
price_range: € 35,00 voor het loopshirt, andere prijzen niet vermeld
description: The IJsselloop in Deventer is the city’s largest running event and takes place every year on the second Sunday in April. With more than 9,000 participants and a unique atmosphere along the IJssel, the event offers a suitable distance for everyone, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. The course passes iconic bridges and follows the river, with the finish on the beautiful Brink square. The organizers, supported by many volunteers and AV Daventria 1906, encourage people of all ages to take part, with participation more important than winning.
course_highlights: A unique course along the IJssel with views of the river
Crossing the Wilhelmina Bridge and railway bridge in Deventer
Finish on the Netherlands’ most beautiful square, the Brink
additional: Generous time limits for each distance: no time limit for the 5 km and kids’ run, 1.5 hours for the 10 km, and 2 hours for the 15 km. Late registration for the G-run and kids’ run is available on the day. Prize ceremonies: 5 km at 15:30 and 10 km at 14:45 in the barracks garden (Boreel, Houtmarkt). Race bib with timing and refreshments available en route and at the finish. Clinics and training opportunities through AV Daventria 1906.

name: Middelseeloop
price_range: Kidsrun gratis, 2,5 km € 3,50, 5 km € 5,00, 10 km € 7,50, medaille toeslag € 3,00
description: The Middelseeloop is a friendly running event in Leeuwarden, held in the Middelsee and De Zuidlanden neighbourhoods. The event offers five different distances, including a 1-kilometre kids’ run, as well as 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and 12.5 km walking routes. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys running or wants to get to know the neighbourhood better. Activities for children take place all day around the start and finish, and all participants are offered an ice cream afterwards.
course_highlights: Routes through the Middelsee and De Zuidlanden neighbourhoods
Five distances: 1 km kids’ run, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and 12.5 km walk
Start and finish at IKC Middelsee, Felling 2, 8912 CG Leeuwarden
additional: Register before 16 March to have your name printed on your race bib. Activities for children take place all day at the start-finish location, including a climbing wall, a football darts board, stilt walkers and Circus Saranti. Walkers will find a surprise along the way. After the event, all participants receive an ice cream from Diana’s IJspaleis, made possible by Zwanenburg. Distances for children, adults and walkers; registration until 11 April 2027; start and finish at IKC Middelsee; participants can enjoy an ice cream after the event.

name: LOOP Leeuwarden
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km
description: LOOP Leeuwarden is the largest running and walking event in Fryslân, attracting thousands of participants each year. The routes pass through Leeuwarden’s atmospheric city centre and surrounding natural areas, with the start and finish at the iconic Oldehove. The half marathon is the longest distance and offers a challenging mix of city and countryside running. With a wide range of distances, there’s a suitable challenge for every runner, from 5 km to 21.1 km.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 8 (12. apr)
description: Necon Winter Series is a winter running series with 8 races, where participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The races start and finish at Fana Stadium in Bergen, with a start time of 18:45. The series takes place on several Mondays from October to April and offers discounts for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual via EQ-timing, and participants can run the entire series or individual races.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Choice of 5 km or 10 km distances
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts for IL Gneist members: free for athletics members who pay the main club fee and training fee (code Gneist00), 50% off for Gneist trim (code Gneist50), and 25% off for members of other Gneist groups (code Gneist25). Participants over 13 must select an annual licence when registering; otherwise, a licence fee of 50 kr applies. Registration is individual via EQ-timing. The date has been moved from 5 April to 12 April.

name: Vestfold løpskarusell - 1. løp - Revetal
price_range: Sesongkort: 900–1 200 kr før 31.12.2026; 960–1 260 kr etter denne datoen

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 kr. for ikke medlemmer frem til 31.12.26.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1200 kr. for ikke medlemmer frem til 31.12.26.

description: Vestfold Running Series 2027 is a series of 8 races in the Tønsberg region, with a start time of 18:00 and two distances at each race. The series offers the joy of running, a sense of community and a great atmosphere for all levels, whether you want to set a personal best or simply be social and active. The races take place in beautiful surroundings, with electronic timing via EQ Timing. You can enter individual races or buy a season pass for all the races at a discounted price.
course_highlights: Two distances at each race, ranging from approximately 2.3 km to 6.9 km depending on the location
Races in beautiful surroundings in the Tønsberg region, including Essoskogen, Tønsbergmarka, Vear, Teieskogen and Revetal
Start and finish at central locations such as the Sport1 store in Revetal, the Essoskogen car park and the playground at Teie school
additional: Season-pass participants collect their race bib at the first race; participants entering individual races collect theirs from race administration 10 minutes before the start. The race bib must be kept throughout the series. Course descriptions and profiles are available in the Facebook group and are sent out with season registration. Season registration and entry to individual races are available. Season-pass participants collect their race bib at the first race and use it throughout the series; participants entering individual races collect and return their bib at each race.

name: Fristafetten
location: Arna idrettspark, Indre Arna, Bergen, Norway
description: Fristafetten is a traditional spring relay first held in 1983. Since 1984, it has been a regular opening event for the athletics relay season in Hordaland. The race starts and finishes at Arna Sports Park, with legs taking place in the area around Indre Arna. After moving from Espeland in 2015, the course has been adjusted to create a more compact, spectator-friendly relay, with flat legs and good opportunities to follow the race. The relay has a welcoming atmosphere and enthusiastic participants, and is an important event for the region’s athletics community.
course_highlights: A course with flat legs and sharp turns
Crossing of Indre Arnavegen and the railway line used by the heritage train
New routes along the edge of the throwing field and through the new neighbourhood park
additional: Automatic leg times for all categories except mixed junior recruitment teams since 2019. The girls’ and boys’ relays were reduced from 8 to 6 legs after the move to Arna Sports Park. Record participation of 121 teams in 2015. The course has been adapted for better visibility and to be more spectator-friendly. The 2027 edition has not been confirmed in the available event information. Registration, categories and prices may change from year to year.

name: Top Cross Torunia
description: Top Cross is a series of 12 cross-country races held in Rudelka Forest Park in Toruń. Each race consists of 5 laps plus a short run-in, for a total distance of approximately 6,666 metres. Participants earn points for taking part, and their 8 best results count towards the overall standings. Runners who take part in at least 8 editions receive a commemorative medal. It is also possible to complete a race individually without earning points.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Rudelka Forest Park
The course consists of 5 laps plus an approximately 200 m run-in
Course distance: approximately 6,666 metres
additional: Registration takes place at V LO Toruń, at ul. Sienkiewicza / Fałata. The race office opens one hour before the race. A runner can complete a race individually without earning points. The series consists of 12 races. The eight best results count towards the overall standings; a commemorative medal is awarded for taking part in at least eight editions.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly fun run in Stockholm, with races for all ages, including a Mini Race for the youngest participants, the Little Skärholms Race for children from preschool class through Year 6, a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over, and a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages. The event is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that supports young people in million-programme suburbs in their personal development through running. There will be music and entertainment, with DJs along the course, and all participants receive a medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, encouraging running experience that promotes physical activity and health equity.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over
Little Skärholms Race, approximately 1.6 km, for children from preschool class through Year 6
500-metre Mini Race for children aged 0–6, with the option to run together with parents
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Start times: Mini Race 10:30; Little Skärholms Race from 11:30, with different start groups by age; 1.6 km Fun Run 12:25; 5 km race 13:00. Registration is free and available until 17:00 on 14 May. Late registration may be available at bib collection and on race day, subject to availability. Music and DJs along the course provide extra encouragement. The race takes place at Puckelbollplanen in Stockholm, with music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a medal at the finish.

name: Ålgårdstafetten
description: The Ålgårdstafetten is an annual relay organized by Gjesdal Idrettslag, bringing together recreational and elite athletics in the sporting community of Gjesdal municipality. The race takes place at the athletics stadium in Ålgård, with relay exchanges at the stadium or in the immediate vicinity. The surfaces include Tartan track, asphalt and gravel. The relay has categories for children, youth and adults, including senior, veteran and corporate categories. The event promotes the joy of sport and community spirit, with a varied course network suited to different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: Relay exchanges take place at the athletics stadium or in nearby areas
Surfaces include Tartan track, asphalt and gravel
Several categories have 4 or 6 legs for different age groups and ability levels
additional: The entry fee is doubled for late registration. Participants aged 13 and older must have an annual licence or a one-time licence. Spiked shoes are not recommended because the course includes sections on asphalt. Categories include mixed ages 7–8, age-group categories for boys and girls, and senior, veteran and corporate categories for the 6-leg relay. The 2026 edition listed categories for children, youth, seniors, veterans and corporate teams.

name: Rondje Almkerk
distance_verbose: 10 km, 6 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Sandnes Ultratrail
description: Sandnes Ultratrail is a challenging trail race in the Sandnes Alps, with distances ranging from 10 km to 100 miles. The routes offer varied scenery, including mountains with beautiful fjord views and technically demanding trails. The longest distance climbs 28 mountains and peaks, and runners can enjoy several swimming spots along the way. After the finish, Jæder burgers are served in a welcoming, inclusive atmosphere with a bonfire and cheers.
course_highlights: Technically demanding routes, with 28 mountains and peaks on the 100-mile distance
Varied scenery featuring mountains, fjord views and quiet forest trails
Opportunities to swim in several of the lakes along the routes
additional: Mandatory equipment for the 50- and 100-mile distances includes two headlamps, a GPS file, a mobile phone, a power bank, drinking containers, an emergency blanket and a first-aid kit. The start and finish for the 100-mile race are at Alsvik Nature Centre. There are several aid stations along the route, staffed by experienced volunteers. A bus to the start is arranged for the 50-mile and shorter distances. In 2027, the 100-mile race starts on Friday, 16 April, from Alsvik Nature Centre; the other distances start on 17 or 18 April. The programme mentions, among other things, race number and tracker collection, drop bags and shuttle buses.

name: Singelloop Leiden
description: The Singelloop Leiden is an atmospheric running event held annually in the centre of Leiden. The race starts and finishes at Lammermarkt, near Molen de Valk, and takes participants along a challenging route beside Leiden’s canals. At approximately 6.5 kilometres, it is an accessible race for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. It is organised by Stichting Singelloop Leiden, which continues the city’s long tradition of sport and community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lammermarkt, next to Molen de Valk
Route of approximately 6.5 km along Leiden’s canals and historic bridges
Run counter-clockwise via Valkbrug, Rijnsburgersingel, Morspoort and Witte Singel
additional: Race numbers are available from various advance-sale outlets from 20 March to 15 April for 7.50 euros. On race day (16 April), a race number costs 8.50 euros and is available at petit-restaurant De Valk. After the race, participants receive a medal upon presenting their race number. The race is held over a route of approximately 6.5 to 7 km, with registration available via the website. The 2027 edition is scheduled for 16 April at 19:30.

name: Krogsereds Trail Run
location: Krogsereds, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn och ungdom (upp till 14 år): 50 kr

description: Krogsereds Trail Run is a scenic trail race organised by Krogsereds Idrottsklubb, offering a fantastic running experience with distances for all ages. The race follows the beautiful hiking trails around Lyngsjön and offers categories ranging from children’s races to the 10 km main race. It is a family-friendly event, with start times spread throughout the morning and prizes raffled among participants.
course_highlights: Scenic hiking trails around Lyngsjön
Several distances suited to children, young people and adults
Varied terrain in a forest setting
additional: Start times: Children 10:00, Youth 10:10, Junior 10:30, Recreational 10:30, Main race 10:30. There are no shower facilities at the venue. Participants are advised to arrive at least 30 minutes before their start. Trail running on natural terrain around Lyngsjön; registration via Google Forms; no shower facilities; the event is scheduled between 09:00 and 14:00 on 24 April 2027.

name: Premiärloppet
description: Premiärloppet is a running event organized by Sävedalens AIK Friidrott at Skatås Motionscentral in Gothenburg. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km; both courses offer gently rolling terrain with gravel surfaces and some trail sections. A water station with water and sports drink from Umara is available at 6 km. All participants receive a medal and great prizes from Löplabbet, and race bibs are collected on race day.
course_highlights: 10 km: gently rolling course on gravel
5 km: gently rolling course with a downhill trail section at Brudaremossen
Water at 6 km and at the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day between 10:00 and 13:15 at the start/finish in Skatås. Changing rooms for women and men are available next to the event area. Results are published at saik.nu and sent to Friidrottsstatistik. Water is provided along the 10 km course and at the finish.

name: Kalmar Backyard Ultra
description: Kalmar Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon in which participants run a 6,706-metre loop on the Stensö exercise trail. The race starts at 10:00, with a new start every hour on the hour. To continue, runners must complete a lap within one hour. The winner is the person who completes the most laps, making the race an exciting, tactical challenge for ultrarunners of all levels.
course_highlights: Flat, gravel-surfaced trail on the Stensö exercise trail
The course is clearly marked with red-and-white ribbons and arrows
In the evening and at night, the course follows only the floodlit trail
additional: The original Backyard Ultra format: each lap must be completed within one hour, with the next start on the hour. The 6,706 m loop is on the Stensö exercise trail (gravel-surfaced trail). 24 laps equal 100 miles. Organiser: Högby IF. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02.

images.alt_text: Kalmar Backyard Ultra-logotyp.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://irunkalmar.com/kalmar-backyard-ultra/): 2027-04-17 — "Kalmar Backyard Ultra 17 april 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-17)

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra
description: Kurt 300 Marathon in Hultsfred is a welcoming and inclusive race celebrating Kurt Gustavsson’s 300th marathon and his 80th birthday. The race offers both a marathon and a half marathon on a scenic 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen, combining park paths and asphalt. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned, with timing and water stations along the way. After the race, participants are invited to a social gathering with food and good company near the start and finish area.
course_highlights: 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen, with the final lap 3 km shorter
20% of the course is asphalt; the rest is park paths
Two refreshment stations with water, sports drink, cola and energy supplies at the lap point and at 4 km
additional: Start and finish at the entrance to Knektavallen facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to take more than 5 hours should start at 09:00. After the race, a social gathering with food and good company is planned for around 14:30, approximately 1 km from Knektavallen. Start and finish at Knektavallen.

name: Varvetmilen (Malmö)
description: Varvetmilen Malmö is a 10 km race organised by Göteborgsvarvet in cooperation with Heleneholms IF. The race starts and finishes at Heleneholms IP, and the course passes Nydalaparken and Almvik, among other places, with a water station at 5 km. The result from Varvetmilen counts towards seeding for Göteborgsvarvet 2027, giving runners the opportunity to improve their starting group ahead of the half marathon. Varvetmilen is part of a tour visiting several Swedish cities in spring 2027 and offers a challenging and enjoyable 10 km race for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Heleneholms IP in Malmö
The course passes through Nydalaparken and the Almvik area
Water station at 5 km
additional: Registration is personal and cannot be transferred. Registration is open until 30 minutes before the start, subject to the race not selling out earlier. Starting groups are automatically seeded for Göteborgsvarvet based on results in Varvetmilen. Bib collection and bag drop take place at Heleneholms IP on race day. Registration for the 2027 race will open at a later date. The result is automatically used to seed runners into a starting group for Göteborgsvarvet 2027.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.goteborgsvarvet.se/ovriga-lopp/varvetmilen): 2027-04-17 — "Varvetmilen besöker flera städer under våren 2027: Jönköping 4/4, Göteborg 10/4 och Malmö 17/4." (was estimated 2027-04-10)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Varvetmilen besöker flera städer under våren 2027: Jönköping 4/4, Göteborg 10/4 och Malmö 17/4.

name: Bergen 5000 Challenge
price_range: 5000 meter: 250 kr; 1000 meter kids: 100 kr; 300 meter mini: gratis
description: Bergen 5000 Challenge is a fast and social 5,000-metre race held at Fana Stadium in Bergen. The race consists of 12.5 laps on a track with no uphill sections, and is suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. There are several heats with pacers for different finish times, as well as children’s races for the youngest participants. Admission is free for spectators, and all participants receive a medal.
course_highlights: 12.5 laps at Fana Stadium with no uphill sections
Pacers in several heats for different finish times
Approved road race results with EQ timing
additional: Race bibs can be collected in the gym at Fana Stadium on race day. The recreational race is classified as a road race with approved results. Children’s races for ages 3–6 and 6–12.

name: Haugesund Backyard Ultra
description: Welcome to Haugesund Backyard Ultra 2027, a unique and social ultrarunning event held at Haraldsvang Arena in Haugesund. The race is not about running the fastest, but about lasting as long as possible, with a new lap of approximately 6.7 km starting every hour on the hour. Participants can rest between laps if they finish within the hour, and the winner is decided after the final lap. With new, modern facilities at Haraldsvang Arena, the experience will be even better for both runners and supporters.
course_highlights: The course is easy to run and gently rolling, with a mix of asphalt and gravel
Start and finish outside the new Haraldsvang Arena
Each lap is approximately 6.7 km and starts every hour on the hour
additional: All participants start at the same time. You must be ready at the starting line for each new start. There are improved facilities and more social gathering areas around the arena compared with previous years. The race sold out in 2026, so early registration is recommended. Participants can stop whenever they wish. Registering early gives you a lower price.

name: Bislett Distanseserie s3r4 - 3000m 2027
description: Bislett Distance Series is an accessible monthly running series held at the historic Bislett Stadium in Oslo. The races offer excellent conditions and a great atmosphere, with the opportunity to run alongside others at your level. Participants receive nuts, bars and sports drink, and pacers are often available to help you reach your goals. It’s a great way to kick-start the indoor running season.
course_highlights: Run at Bislett Stadium, a classic venue in Oslo
An accessible and inclusive running series
The opportunity to run with pacers at different times
additional: Registered participants receive nuts, bars and sports drink from Maxim. The races are held indoors at Bislett Stadium, with entrance at 1 Louises gate, 0168 Oslo.

name: II Półmaraton Karolewo - Pruszcz
description: The 2nd Karolewo–Pruszcz Half Marathon is a certified 21.0975 km race taking place on 17 April 2027. The course is entirely paved, flat and marked every kilometre, making it conducive to good results. The race office is open on race day, and participants receive race packs containing, among other things, a bib, a timing chip, a T-shirt and a voucher for a recovery meal. The event is organised by the Agro-Economic School Complex in Karolewo, and timing is provided by STS-Timing.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course
Entirely paved and flat
Course marked every 1 kilometre
additional: The race office is open on race day from 8:30 to 16:00. Race packs contain a bib, a timing chip, safety pins, a voucher for a recovery meal, running memorabilia and a T-shirt. Participants should indicate their T-shirt size in the registration form. Unclaimed race packs will not be mailed or made available at a later date.

name: III Mistrzostwa Polski Masters
organizer: Koszalińskie Towarzystwo Krzewienia Kultury Fizycznej i Polski Związek Lekkiej Atletyki Masters
description: The 3rd Polish Masters Championships is a race organized by the Koszalin Society for the Promotion of Physical Culture, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place on Góra Chełmska in Koszalin and is aimed at masters-category runners. It has a recreational and sporting character, with chip timing and overall classifications for women and men. The organizer provides third-party liability insurance, and participants can expect official award ceremonies.
course_highlights: A race on the natural terrain of Góra Chełmska
Chip timing using returnable chips attached to footwear
Overall classifications for women and men, with trophies for places 1–3
additional: No license was required for the 2026 edition.

name: Nocna Piątka po Głogowskiej Starówce
description: Nocna Piątka po Głogowskiej Starówce is an annual road race held in the picturesque Old Town of Głogów. The 5 km course winds through the charming streets of the Old Town, offering participants a unique nighttime running atmosphere. The event is organized by Klub Sportowy ZG RUN and attracts many local runners. It is a great opportunity for sporting competition and an active day out in the heart of the city.
course_highlights: The course passes through the historic Old Town of Głogów
The race takes place in the evening, creating a unique atmosphere
The course is 5 km long, ideal for runners of different ability levels
additional: Participants can purchase a race pack from another runner through the race-pack exchange. Organizer: Klub Sportowy ZG RUN. Start and finish location: Bulwar Nadodrzański/Zespół Szkół Ekonomicznych w Głogowie. The program also includes children's races.

name: Pobiegnij z Siódemką
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Siódemka, Niepubliczna Szkoła Podstawowa nr 7 im. Marii Skłodowskiej-Curie w Słupsku i Słupski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji
description: Pobiegnij z Siódemką is a charity cross-country run organized by the Maria Skłodowska-Curie Non-Public Primary School No. 7 in Słupsk. The event is held to support the treatment and rehabilitation of a child with a cleft palate, and taking part in the run is a real way to help Mateusz and his family. The run is community-focused and inclusive, combining sport with charitable activities. This is the fourth edition of the event, which enjoys strong support from the local community and sponsors.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Słupsk
Charity event supporting a child’s treatment
Organized by a local primary school
additional: The run is a charity event supporting Mateusz, who has a cleft palate. In previous editions, funds were raised and transferred to the Siepomaga foundation’s account. The event is supported by local sponsors and donors. The organizers thank everyone for their support and emphasize the importance of every step in the run. Proceeds from an earlier edition were donated to support Mateusz; one edition raised PLN 7,014.

name: Amerongse Koploop
distance_verbose: 25 km, 16 km, 10 km, 6 km, 1500 meter, 0.75 km
description: The Amerongse Koploop is a friendly and challenging trail run through the forests of Utrechtse Heuvelrug National Park, between Amerongen and Leersum. The event offers several distances for both children and adults, including kids’ runs, trail runs and hiking routes. A portion of the entry fee goes towards nature conservation, and participants receive a voucher for local refreshments. After the event, all participants receive a sustainable medal, and there is a lively square at the start and finish where they can relax and enjoy the atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail through the forests of Utrechtse Heuvelrug National Park
Distances ranging from 750 metres for children to a 25 km trail run
A lively square with local specialities and an included refreshment voucher
additional: Pre-registration closes on Thursday 16 April. On-the-day registration is possible, with an additional administration fee payable at the registration desk. Race numbers can be collected in advance on Friday evening. Timing is electronic; there is no rush at the start. Trail and walking distances vary; registration is available in advance and on the day. The location is Nuytgroep, Amerongen. Local refreshments include beer, coffee and fries. Medal and electronic timing.

name: Kamerikse Weteringloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1.7 km, 1 km, 0.7 km

name: Pop up Run Kinnekulle

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 300 kr, picknick på Öströö Fårfarm Café ingår

description: Pop up Run Kinnekulle is a trail-running adventure that takes you out into exciting natural surroundings and new experiences. The race offers a fairytale-like run through beech forests, past small lakes and historical sites such as Bexell’s Talking Stones. After the run, a locally produced picnic awaits to round things off. The event is open to runners of different paces and recommends carpooling for participants.
course_highlights: Run through the beech forests of Kinnekulle
Pass small, charming lakes and Bexell’s Talking Stones
Finish with a picnic at a locally producing farm
additional: Meet at 10:00 at Öströö Fårfarm. The distance is approximately 15–17 km, with 2–3 different pace groups. A picnic at Öströö Fårfarm Café is included in the price. Carpooling is recommended, and help coordinating rides is offered. The event is designed to provide a welcoming, nature-focused running experience centred on nature, views and local food.

name: Baksjøløpet
description: Baksjøløpet is a traditional race that has been held since 1981 in Åbogen, Eidskog. The main course is 11.3 km and runs partly on gravel and asphalt, starting and finishing in Åbogen. There is also an alternative shorter route of approximately 6.5 km for those walking without timekeeping. The race attracts both competitive runners and recreational participants, and it is a social event with shower and changing facilities available.
course_highlights: Main course of 11.3 km on gravel and asphalt roads
Alternative route of approximately 6.5 km for recreational walkers without timekeeping
Refreshment stations along the route at approximately 4 km and 6 km
additional: Registration is available until 10 minutes before the start on race day, with an increased entry fee. Race bibs can be collected at the stand the day before the race. Everyone who finishes and pays the regular fee receives an annual prize. Gift prizes are drawn by race bib number, and trophies are awarded to the best woman and man, as well as a prize to the team with the most participants. The race is a member of Norges Turmarsjforbund and offers IVV stamping for a small fee.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, 5'ern vår!

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 475,00 kr 332,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

description: Our 5K! is the first race in Oslo Running Festival and offers a fast, flat 5-kilometer course along the beautiful Oslofjord, from Frognerkilen to Bygdøylokket. You can complete the race at any time between April 9 and 18, or join the group start on Sunday, April 18 at 11:00, with pacers, music, and a great atmosphere. This race is a great way to kick off the running season in Oslo and is suitable for anyone looking to test their fitness on a fast, enjoyable course.
course_highlights: Fast, flat 5 km course along the Oslofjord
The course runs from Frognerkilen to Bygdøylokket
Option to join the group start with pacers and music
additional: Race bibs can be collected from Löplabbet Oslo sentrum from April 7. The same bib is used throughout the series. A new bib can be purchased for 75 kr. The courses are marked only for the group start. GPX files and course maps are available to download. The race can be completed at any time between April 9 and 18, 2027. Registration is offered as SOLO, DUO, and TRIO tickets; listed prices vary by ticket type and purchase date.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll starting at Ås school, Hammerås, offering a simple and efficient race format for achieving fast times. The race takes place on a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop, where runners can leave their own bottles and gels on their personal nutrition table, which they pass each lap. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. The race is known for producing many personal records and has a friendly atmosphere, with the option to ring the bell when setting a personal record.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Your own nutrition table, passed each lap
Free parking, changing rooms and toilets at the venue
additional: Race bibs are collected via self-service at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available inside the school. At selected races, ninth-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. The weather forecast is updated four times daily using satellite data for the area around Ås school. Race bibs can be collected via self-service at the school from approximately two hours before the start. Changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Registration is via RaceDays.

name: Baroniløpet
description: Baroniløpet is organized annually by Rosendal Turnlag and takes place in beautiful surroundings at Baroniet Rosendal in Kvinnherad. The race is part of the Kvinnherad cross-country running series and attracts both local and visiting runners looking for a challenging race in scenic surroundings. The terrain offers varied surfaces and beautiful nature, making the race a popular event for both recreational and competitive runners. The event has a long tradition and is well integrated into the local community.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in scenic surroundings at Baroniet Rosendal
Varied surfaces, including trails and wooded sections
Part of the Kvinnherad cross-country running series

name: Neskollen Backyard Ultra
description: Neskollen Backyard is a unique ultrarunning event held at Nes Arena in Neskollen. The race follows the classic backyard format, with a new start every hour on the hour. Participants must complete a 6.706 km loop within 60 minutes to continue. They can run up to 12 loops in total, equivalent to approximately 80.5 km. The race is a demanding test of both mental and physical strength, suitable for experienced ultrarunners and those looking to push their limits. Food and drink are provided during the event, and prizes are awarded to participants.
course_highlights: Relatively flat course around Nes Arena
Start and finish inside Nes Arena, with a short break between loops
A total of 12 loops of 6.706 km each, approximately 80.5 km for those who complete them
additional: A new start takes place every hour on the hour, with a maximum of 12 loops. Participants can take a break inside Nes Arena between loops to eat, rest and prepare. Pizza, cakes, drinks and potato chips are served during the event. Prizes are awarded. The maximum is 12 loops, equivalent to approximately 80.5 kilometres.

name: Skjold på tvers
description: Skjold på Tvers is a mountain marathon and the most beautiful spring adventure in Vindafjord, Rogaland. The race offers several route options, including the full Skjold på Tvers, with 7 peaks over approximately 21.2 km, as well as shorter options such as HalvTversen and a family route. Participants are transported from Skjold Arena to the start, and chip timing and prize money are offered in the elite class. The event combines challenging terrain with beautiful scenery and is suitable for both fit runners and families.
course_highlights: The full Skjold på Tvers, with 7 peaks, approximately 21.2 km
HalvTversen, with 4 peaks (11.4 km) or 3 peaks (9.6 km)
Family route at Vikaneset, with a trail and an alternative for strollers/wheelchairs
additional: You can also register on the day via EQ Timing at Skjold Arena, but advance registration is recommended. Bus transport from Skjold Arena to the start at Hodnafjellet is included in the price. It is possible to walk half the route, with a bus to or from Dalavik. Participants receive a T-shirt, fruit and drinks at designated stations. The elite class has a mass start at 13:00, with timing and prize money. The route page has a UT.no map and GPX file. The main route runs from Hodnafjellet to Skjold Arena.

name: Perseløpet
description: Perseløpet is a simple and effective running event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners achieve fast times. The race takes place on a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop, with the option to set up your own nutrition table, passed on every lap. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, and the event has a friendly atmosphere where runners can celebrate personal records by ringing the bell at the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Option to set up your own nutrition table along the course
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km
additional: Race bibs are collected self-service at Ås school from around two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Runners can set out their own bottles and gels on the nutrition table before the start. An official aid station staffed by 9th grade students from Feiring school is available at selected races. Timing and a lap-time calculator are available for planning. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area. Race bibs are collected self-service at the school from around two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Registration and current prices are available via RaceDays.

name: Hammer Charity Frühlingslauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 6.4 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 1 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: Ruhrseen Halbmarathon
description:
On April 18, 2027, a running event awaits you that perfectly combines nature, emotion, and a sporting challenge. Set off from the idyllic Hengsteysee, run alongside sparkling waters and the majestic Ruhrsteilhänge cliffs, and through peaceful woodland sections—a course that will challenge and inspire you at the same time.

Whether you choose the half marathon or 10 km, this run is your moment. Your experience. Your spring highlight. Secure your place at the starting line now and be part of an unforgettable day at Hagen’s Hengsteysee!
additional:
A great race pack awaits you:

Race materials sent by post

High-quality finisher’s medal

3 course refreshment stations

3 toilet stations along the course

A generous finish-line refreshment area

Showers at the outdoor swimming pool

Lockers on site

After-party immediately after the run
