description: ASICS Sentrumsløpet is one of Norway’s largest running events, with 10 km, 5 km and children’s races. The race is suitable for beginners, recreational runners and elite runners, and takes participants through central Oslo, starting and finishing on Karl Johan. Along the way, runners pass well-known landmarks including the Royal Palace, Frogner Park, Oslo City Hall, Akershus Fortress and the Storting. The event has an inclusive, welcoming atmosphere, with good facilities and water stations along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Karl Johan in central Oslo
The course passes the Royal Palace, Frogner Park, Oslo City Hall, Akershus Fortress and the Storting
Water stations at Frogner Stadium, Christiania Torv and Karl Johan
additional: Pace setters for the 10 km: 40, 45, 50, 55 and 60 minutes. Water stations on Karl Johan before the start and after the finish, at Christiania Torv, and at Frogner Stadium (approx. 3.5 km). The self-service bag storage facility in Universitetsgata opens at 13:30. Kiwi serves bananas and snacks after the finish. AfterRun at Kaffistova with food and drinks. Race bibs can be transferred to other participants before collection.

name: Siddisløpet
description: Siddisløpet is an annual running festival in Stavanger, organised by Idrettslaget Skjalg. The race goes around Store Stokkavannet and covers a distance of 8.1 km, making it suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The event also includes shorter distances, such as Siddisspretten at 500 metres and Siddismarsjen at 8.1 km. It is an inclusive, social event that brings together people of all ages who love running.
course_highlights: The race goes around Store Stokkavannet
8.1 km distance for Siddisløpet and Siddismarsjen
Short 500 m distance for Siddisspretten
additional: Three start times: Siddisspretten (500 m) at 10:30, Siddismarsjen (8.1 km) at 11:30, Siddisløpet (8.1 km) at 12:00.

name: Vinstra Byløp
price_range: 200 kr for 5 km og 10 km; gratis for barneløp og bamseløp (2026-utgaven)
description: Vinstra City Run is an inclusive running event in Vinstra Park that welcomes participants of all ages, from 2 years and up. The event focuses on public health, diversity and the joy of running, offering a children’s park run, a recreational run without timing, and timed 5 km and 10 km races. The start and finish are in Vinstra Park, and participants are encouraged to take part in teams with family, friends or work colleagues. There are prizes and bib-number prize draws, and the aim is to establish an annual running event for all levels.
course_highlights: Children’s park run and teddy-bear run in the park for the youngest participants
5 km and 10 km races with electronic timing
Untimed recreational category where you can walk or run
additional: Participants are advised to arrive 1 hour before the start. Prize-giving at approximately 13:00. Group warm-up for the 5 km and 10 km at 11:30. Start of the timed 5 km and 10 km races and the recreational category at 12:00. Previous editions have offered an untimed 5 km recreational category and timed 5 km and 10 km races.

name: Aron Opp
description: Aron Opp is an uphill race organised by Bedriftsidretten Buskerud og Vestfold in collaboration with Skimore Drammen, Arontunet Lodge and LaSportiva. The course is 1.75 km long with 269 metres of elevation gain. It follows a winding gravel road from the bottom of the ski slope to the top, with the finish at the lift station. The race is suitable for both fast runners and those who would like to walk briskly up the hill. There is also a children’s race for the youngest participants, and activities such as face painting for children during the event.
course_highlights: The course is 1.75 km long with 269 metres of elevation gain
Follows a winding gravel road alongside the ski slope from the bottom to the top
Finish at the lift station at the top of the hill
additional: The children’s race for children up to 12 years old is free, with support from Sparebank1 stiftelsen Buskerud & Vestfold. Race numbers can be collected between 16:00 and 17:40. Face painting for children from 16:45 to 18:15. Arontunet Lodge is open for changing facilities and toilets during the event. The course is marked with red and white ribbons. Participants are encouraged to carpool or use public transport (bus no. 4 from Strømsø Torg to the mountain lift, with a stop 50 metres from the venue). Prizes for the top three in the women’s and men’s categories.

name: Glommaløpet
description: Glommaløpet is an annual race on a gravel path along the final kilometres of the Glomma, from Sarpefossen to Gamlebyen in Fredrikstad. The course starts in the square in Sarpsborg and passes through Kulåsparken, over Sannesund Bridge, along the eastern bank of the Glomma and under Fredrikstad Bridge, finishing in the historic fortress town of Gamlebyen. The event offers several distances and categories, including 10 miles, a relay, a recreational run and a children's race, and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The course is flat and easy to run, with scenic surroundings and water stations along the way.
course_highlights: Run on a gravel path along the Glomma's final kilometres, from Sarpefossen to the sea at Gamlebyen
Start in the square in Sarpsborg and finish in Gamlebyen, the best-preserved fortress town in the Nordic countries
Flat course profile with water stations at 4.5, 5, 9.5 and 14.5 km
additional: Glommaløpet has one start group per event, with no wave starts. The maximum number of participants is limited to ensure smooth flow and sufficient capacity at the water stations. Race numbers can be collected in the square in Sarpsborg on race day from 11:00 to 13:30, or earlier at selected locations in Fredrikstad and Sarpsborg. Bus transport is available for participants and must be booked by 18 April at the latest. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and prizes are awarded to category winners and relay teams. A technical running shirt with the Glommaløpet print can be purchased when registering by 24 March. The 10-mile distance is 16 km. The relay consists of ten legs ranging from 800 metres to 3 kilometres. There are three water stations, and bus transport must be booked in advance. Changing rooms and showers are available at Kongstenhallen and Sarpsborghallen.

name: Sparebank1 Østlandet-mila Moelv 2027 - 10000 meter/3000 meter på bane
description: Sparebank1 Østlandet Mile is a 10,000-metre track race held at Skarpsno Arena in Moelv. In 2027, participants can also choose to run 3,000 metres on the track. Races are organized into heats based on pace, so everyone runs alongside competitors of a similar level. There will be separate heats for women and men, with approved starting procedures and shoe checks. The event offers a great day of running focused on community, with the opportunity to qualify for championships using official times. Race bibs are distributed at Limtrehallen by the stadium, just a five-minute walk from Moelv train station.
course_highlights: 10,000 metres and 3,000 metres on the track
Heats divided by pace for optimal competition
Skarpsno Arena, near Moelv train station
additional: Toilets are available in Limtrehallen and the clubhouse next to the stadium. Everyone who has registered will receive an SMS the day before the race with information about their race bib and start time. Maximum of 400 runners in the 10,000-metre race.

name: Larviksløpet 2027
description: Larviksløpet is an annual race organized by Larvik Turn og Idrettsforening, starting at Indre Havn, Larvik. The event includes several distances, including the main race, a 5-kilometer race starting from Jordet school, a relay, and a recruitment race. It brings together both recreational and competitive runners in a friendly atmosphere, with the relay and main race starting at the same time. Registration is via EQ Timing, and information is updated regularly on the official website.
course_highlights: Start at Indre Havn, Larvik
Several distances, including a relay and recruitment race
The relay and main race start at the same time
additional: Registration for competitions is through www.isonen.no. To take part in competitions organized by the Norwegian Athletics Association, participants must purchase a license from the year they turn 13 until age 80. There are basic and extended licenses; the basic license is recommended for athletes. The relay starts at the same time as the main race.

name: Glessen läuft
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 Meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Lauf Zum Alten vom Müssenberg – VB Sauerland Lauf Cup
7 Bieg Korczaka
organizer: Specjalny Ośrodek Szkolno-Wychowawczy nr 1 dla Dzieci Niepełnosprawnych Ruchowo w Policach im. Marii Grzegorzewskiej
description: The 7th Korczak Run is an annual running event organized by Special Education Center No. 1 for Children with Physical Disabilities in Police. The event includes a 5 km main race, Nordic walking, and children’s races over various distances, including races for children in wheelchairs. The main race route consists of two loops with an additional section, making for an interesting and varied course. The event promotes inclusion and physical activity among people of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The main race route consists of 2 loops with an extra section
The event includes children’s races over distances from 200 to 600 meters
Nordic walking is available over a distance of 5 km
additional: Medals for race participants. Forms are available to download: transfer of a race entry, guardian’s statement/consent, and authorization to collect a race pack. Recommended parking areas are listed on the website. Numerous photo galleries and videos from previous editions are available. The event website provides registration, regulations, and a course map. Electronic timing by B4SPORT is available.

name: XXXVI Biegi im. Tomasza Hopfera
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janowcu Wielkopolskim
description: The 36th Tomasz Hopfer Runs is an annual running event held in Janowiec Wielkopolski. The main event is a 10 km race that attracts runners from various regions. The organizers also offer races for children, promoting physical activity among the youngest participants. The course is certified, ensuring it has been accurately measured and professionally prepared.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km race course
Children’s races tailored to different age groups
Scenic areas of Janowiec Wielkopolski
additional: The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Janowiec Wielkopolski. Phone: +48 452 469 185. The program includes races for children and the main 10 km race. The website includes regulations and results from previous years.

name: PKO Gdynia Półmaraton 35. PZLA Mistrzostwa Polski w Półmaraton
description: PKO Gdynia Half Marathon is one of the largest running events in Poland and will take place on April 24, 2027. The half-marathon course runs through the modern city of Gdynia, showcasing its unique modernist character. The race starts in the evening at 19:30, so runners finish after dark, creating a special atmosphere. The event attracts individual runners, relay teams, and participants in accompanying 5 km and children’s races.
course_highlights: A half-marathon course of over 21 km through Gdynia
Evening start at 19:30, with the finish at City Beach after dark
A PZLA-certified 5 km course, as well as children’s races and relays
additional: The half-marathon participant limit is 15,000. The time limit for completing the half-marathon is 4 hours. The entry fee can be transferred to the next edition up to 14 days before the event. Refunds are available up to 45 days before the race if registration took place within the first 30 days after entries opened. Half-marathon relays consist of teams of 3. The 5 km course is PZLA-certified. The children’s race (Kids Run) takes place on Saturday at midday, with a unique medal at the finish. The event will also include 5 km races, relays, and Kids Run. Early registrants can receive a full refund if they withdraw up to 45 days before the race; the fee can be transferred free of charge to the next edition up to 14 days before the event.

name: Backyard Ultra TRICITY
description: Backyard Ultra TriCity is a unique ultra race in a format that originated in the USA. Runners start every hour and have to complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they can rest until the next full hour, when they begin another lap. The race continues until only one runner remains at the start and completes the final loop within the hour limit. It is a demanding and exciting race in which only one winner is crowned.
course_highlights: A 6.706 km (4.167 mile) loop
Starts every full hour
A 1-hour limit to complete each loop
additional: Runners have 15 minutes to rest after completing a loop if they finish it in less than 60 minutes. The race takes place in Gdańsk. The organizer provides downloadable rules. The race is for adults. The available registration page is for the 2026 edition.

name: Pelplin Forest Run
description: Pelplin Forest Run is a running and Nordic walking event held at Rajkowski Mill since 2024. The start, finish, and race office are located at the kayak marina, and the routes pass through the scenic Bukowiec Forest District. The event is co-organized by the Kociewie Sports and Cultural Association and the Pelplin Municipality Sprint Kulice Sports Club, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature and compete in a beautiful forest setting.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Bukowiec Forest District
Start and finish at the kayak marina in Rajkowski Mill
Running and Nordic walking in a natural forest setting
additional: The distances and location provided are from previous editions.

name: XVIII Złotowski Bieg Zawilca
description: The 18th Złotów Anemone Run is an annual running event held in Złotów, aimed at people who enjoy running, active recreation and a sporting atmosphere. The race takes place on courses suited to different groups of participants, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The event is open and welcoming to runners of varying experience levels. The organizers provide professional event management and attractive conditions for starting and competing.
additional: The event is co-organized by the Złotów Municipal Office, Granqvists Manufacturing Sp. z o.o. and the Alfred Sokołowski District Hospital in Złotów.

name: Night Run Wageningen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld van € 85 is inclusief 11 groepstrainingen, loopshirt, startbewijs voor deze wedstrijd en een herinnering bij de finish

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Natuurlijk is het ook mogelijk om zonder Start to run cursus deel te nemen aan deze wedstrijd

description: The Night Run Wageningen is an atmospheric running event held in the centre of Wageningen, with the start and finish on the Markt. Participants run in the dark under atmospheric lighting and take on the challenging Wageningse Berg via the Holleweg. There are several distances, including a kids’ run, a 5 km run and an adventurous 10 km run. Beginners can take a Start to Run course that culminates in taking part in the 5 km. The event is open to all ages and levels and offers a fun, sporty evening in Wageningen.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Markt in the centre of Wageningen
Climb the Wageningse Berg via the Holleweg
Atmospheric lighting while running in the dark
additional: Kids’ run start times: 500 m at 19:15 (ages 3–7), 1,000 m at 19:30 (up to and including age 12). The 5K starts at 20:00, and the 10K starts at 21:00. Limited race-day registration may be available at the Grote Kerk on the Markt; participants will not receive a personalised race number. Awards ceremonies for all distances take place after the event. Registration usually opens around December for the following year, with options for early registration and late registration on site at the Grote Kerk.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Bålsta Stadslopp is a fast and enjoyable spring race held in central Bålsta, starting and finishing at Gröna Dalens IP. The race has grown steadily since it began in 2019 and is known as a PB course, where many runners beat their previous records. The course is a 5 km loop that can be run once or twice, with 99% asphalt and a finish on an athletics track. The event is marked by speed, joy and community, and welcomes runners of all ages and categories.
course_highlights: 5 km loop in central Bålsta, finishing at Gröna Dalens IP
99% asphalt, with a finish on an athletics track
Fast course with a small incline removed to make even faster times possible
additional: Bib collection starts at 08:00 outside Gröna Dalens IP. Start times are 09:30 for 5 km and 10:45 for 10 km. Runners self-seed at the start to reduce congestion. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the start, subject to availability. There is a bag drop and limited changing facilities. Take the commuter train to Bålsta station, within walking distance of the start/finish. Several parking areas are nearby. Badhusvägen is closed to traffic on race day. Registration is open. The sports drink served in the cups is Umara U Sport Lemon.

name: Landsjön runt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pojke/Flicka Vista FUN RUN ca 1 km GRATIS

description: Landsjön Runt is a traditional road race organized by IK Vista since 1982 in Kaxholmen, outside Huskvarna. The event offers several distances for the whole family, from a children’s race and obstacle course to 5.5 km and 12.5 km in scenic surroundings around the lake. The start and finish are at Vistavallen, and the course runs clockwise around the lake, with the climbs in the first half. Participants can enjoy music and refreshments along the way for a great running experience. There are also team competitions and awards for youth and Fun Run participants.
course_highlights: The course runs clockwise around Landsjön, with climbs in the first half
The start is on the grass field and the finish is on the running track at Vistavallen
Scenic surroundings, with the course running beside the waters of Landsjön
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Vistavallen on the Saturday before the event, between 14:00 and 16:00. IK Vista members can participate for free if they register by 18/4. A team competition for teams of four is available for the 5.5 km and 12.5 km races. Each team’s total time is recorded, and teams receive a bag of treats. The children’s race for ages 0–6, approximately 500 m, starts at 12:00. The Vista FUN RUN obstacle course, approximately 1 km, starts at 12:20, with an awards ceremony afterward. Recommended parking is at Vistavallen or Hunnerydsbadet; use of public transport is encouraged. The race has been held annually since 1982.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://landsjonrunt.se/): 2027-04-25 — "25 April 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-25)

name: Kvantumloppet (Kvantumloppet med Trail 7+17km)
description: Kvantumloppet Trail arrangeras av Huddinge AIS vid Källbrinks IP och bjuder på 7 och 17 km löpning i Gömmarskogen. Banorna går huvudsakligen på mindre skogsstigar och följer Gömmarens gula spår på 7 km respektive svartvita spår på 17 km. Här väntar bitvis teknisk terräng med stenar, rötter och branta backar, blandat med natursköna partier. Loppet passar dig som vill utmana dig på stigarna, oavsett om du springer, joggar eller tar dig fram i eget tempo.
course_highlights: 7 km följer Gömmarens gula spår, kallat Sparven.
17 km följer Gömmarens svartvita spår, kallat Skatan.
Mestadels små skogsstigar med tekniska inslag, stenar, rötter och branta backar.
additional: Start och mål vid Källbrinks IP. Banorna anges vara cirka 5 % längre eller kortare än den angivna distansen.

name: Orion Trail
description: Orion Trail is a beautiful running race in the scenic Ådalen valley in Jämjö, outside Karlskrona, where participants run along trails beside a winding stream. The course offers varied terrain, including trails, off-road sections, gravel roads and asphalt, as well as a waterfall and a sea of wood anemones. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km; the 10 km race consists of two laps of the course. The youngest participants can take part in a 500- or 1,000-metre children’s race. All participants receive a medal, a drink and a bun, and showers and refreshments are available at the finish. Orion Trail is part of Oriondagen, a family-friendly day with activities in nature.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5,000 metres long, including 3,700 metres of trails and off-road terrain
The route follows the scenic Ådalen valley beside a winding stream and a waterfall
The children’s race is 500 or 1,000 metres, with the option of running one or two laps
additional: The start and finish are at Orionstugan in Jämjö, with parking in the designated area. Race numbers can be collected from 09:00 on race day. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, a drink and a bun. Showers and changing facilities are available. Refreshments, including grilled sausages, hamburgers, cakes and coffee, are on offer. Entries can be made on site up to 30 minutes before the start. Oriondagen runs from 10:00 to 13:00 and includes several family activities, with drop-in participation. Start times: 5 km and 10 km at 10:30; children’s race at 12:00. The race can be completed by running or walking.

name: Strömsnäs Trailrun
description: Strömsnäs Trailrun is a wonderful trail race held in the forests around Strömsnäsbruk and Traryd. The races mainly follow trails and forest roads, with some sections of rough terrain, offering a nature-filled and challenging running experience. The event is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation and welcomes runners in various categories, with honorary prizes and medals for everyone who finishes. The start and finish are at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk, and the organiser SK Graal looks forward to welcoming participants for a great day in their running shoes.
course_highlights: Run on trails, forest roads and rough terrain
Scenic forests around Strömsnäsbruk and Traryd
Start and finish at Graalstugan
additional: Timing is electronic, using a chip attached to the race bib, which must be returned at the finish. The prize-giving ceremony is at approximately 12:30, with honorary prizes for places 1–3 in each category and prizes awarded by draw. All finishers receive a medal. Changing facilities and showers are available, with limited space. A cafeteria is located by the finish area. Late registration is available on race day from 09:30 until 30 minutes before the start, with an additional fee of 60 kr. Clubs can be invoiced when registering more than three participants. Timing is electronic, and participants who finish receive a medal, according to the 2026 information.

name: Trollhättan 5k
description: Welcome to Trollhättan 5K, a fast, officially measured race being held for the fifth time. The course is designed to attract runners looking to run a fast 5K, either as preparation for longer races or to beat their personal best. The course record is already impressive, and it will be exciting to see if it can be broken this year. The race offers a fast course in Trollhättan with great opportunities for good times.
course_highlights: Officially measured, fast 5K course
Suitable as preparation for longer races
Opportunity to break the course record

name: Tveide Rundt
price_range: 200 kr for 10 km; barneløpet er gratis
description: Tveide Rundt is a recreational race starting and finishing in Birkenesparken. The course is officially measured and certified at 10 km, and the race is held on the last Sunday in April. It is a great event for everyone aged 13 and over, with exciting draw prizes and gift cards for podium finishers. Birkenesparken Rundt is also held: a free 1 km children’s race for children aged 6 to 12, with a medal for every participant.
course_highlights: Officially measured and certified 10 km course
Start and finish in scenic Birkenesparken
1 km children’s race for ages 6–12, with a medal for everyone
additional: Schedule: The kiosk opens at 11:00. Tveide Rundt 10 km starts at 12:00. Birkenesparken Rundt 1 km starts at 12:10. The children’s race is free, and every child receives a medal. Birkenesparken Rundt is a free 1 km children’s race for ages 6–12, with a medal for everyone. The stated schedule lists the kiosk opening at 11:00, the 10 km start at 12:00, and the children’s race at 12:10.

name: Wolfsburg Run powered by VfL Wolfsburg e.V.
42 Memoriał Winanda Osińskiego
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Szczecinku
description: The Winand Osiński Memorial Street Run in Szczecinek is an annual running event with a long tradition, organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Szczecinek. The main 10 km street race runs through the city on roads closed to vehicle traffic. The course is marked every kilometre and has a refreshment point. The event also includes youth races over various distances to promote physical activity among children and young people. The main race is scheduled to start at 13:00, and participants can expect professional timing and a unique sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through the streets of Szczecinek, closed to vehicle traffic
Course markings every kilometre and a water refreshment point
Electronic timing using chips in race bibs
additional: The time limit for the main race is 2 hours. The start and finish are on Piłsudskiego Street (the start is near “Mała Poczta”; the finish is at the Czesław Kazimierz Lis Municipal Stadium). Race bibs must be attached to the front of the shirt and remain visible throughout the race, or the runner may be disqualified. Youth races start at 8:55, with age groups and distances ranging from 400 m to 1,000 m. The organizer also invites organizations to set up stands during the event. Registration is through the Datasport service. The time limit for the main race is 2 hours.

name: II Charytatywny Bieg
description: The 2nd St. Ursula Ledóchowska Charity Run at Góra Chełmska near Koszalin is an event bringing together runners and enthusiasts of physical activity. Organized by the Sport, Recreation and Volunteering “SFX” Association, the run is charitable and promotes sporting activity accessible to everyone, regardless of age or fitness level. The course takes participants through the scenic areas of the Chełm Hills, offering a chance to connect with nature and spend time together outdoors. The event is part of the local running calendar and aims to build Koszalin’s sporting community.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Chełm Hills
Scenic views and contact with nature
Accessible to runners of different ability levels
additional: The organizer is the Sport, Recreation and Volunteering “SFX” Association, based in Koszalin. The event is charitable and brings people together. There is no entry fee; participation is free. Organizer contact by phone: Michał Bieliński +48 696 137 257 (does not respond to SMS). Proceeds were intended to support the establishment of the Zakład Aktywności Zawodowej z Miłością in Koszalin.

name: VI Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 6th Charity Run in Kartuzy is a sporting event held as part of the “Fields of Hope” campaign, aimed at supporting the Kartuzy DOM NADZIEI Hospice. The run takes place on April 26 and is part of a family fair packed with attractions for participants of all ages. Proceeds from the run will go toward the hospice’s operations, underscoring the charitable nature of the event. It brings together sport, fun, and support for those in need, engaging the local community.
course_highlights: A charity run supporting the Kartuzy DOM NADZIEI Hospice
A family fair with attractions for all age groups
The event takes place on the sports field at ZSO No. 2 in Kartuzy
additional: The run is part of the larger “Fields of Hope” event, which also includes a concert by the band GIS, a raffle, activities for children, a bicycle rally, and a motorcycle gathering with a blessing. An NFZ mammobus offering mammography screenings and an NFZ educational stand will be available on site. Proceeds from the run will support the Kartuzy DOM NADZIEI Hospice. Running calendars list April 26, 2027, as an approximate date, one day later than the date in the metadata.

name: XX Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy
location: Stadion Gminny, ul. Sportowa 37, Linia, Poland
description: The 20th Voivodeship Cross-Country Race through the Kashubian Landscape Park in Linia is a jubilee edition of the event, held at the municipal stadium at 37 Sportowa Street. The program includes races for children and young people, a local government officials’ race, a competition for people with disabilities, and an open 10 km race. Participants can also take part in the “Na Szlaku Kaszëb” Nordic Walking march.
course_highlights: A cross-country race through the Kashubian Landscape Park
An open race over 10 km
Various distances for children and young people, from 200 m to 3,200 m
additional: The event takes place at the municipal stadium at 37 Sportowa Street in Linia.

name: Vechtstreek in Beweging Lopen
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 20 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km

name: Jæren Sparebank Sentrumsløp
price_range: 125 kr for barneløp; 275 kr for 5 km
description: The Jæren Sparebank Sentrumsløp is an annual race held in Kanalparken, Ålgård, Gjesdal. The race features a 5 km loop starting outside Amfi Ålgård and passing through Torgveien, along the Figgjo River and over the Liv Godin Bridge. The scenic course combines an urban setting with beautiful natural surroundings. There is also a 700-metre children’s race. Separate start times are provided for fast runners and everyone else. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women’s and men’s categories, and all participants receive a finisher’s prize.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting outside Amfi Ålgård
The course runs along the Figgjo River and over the Liv Godin Bridge
700-metre children’s race
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 16:30 at Ålgård Sentrum by Kanalparken. Schedule: 18:00 Children’s race, 700 m; 18:15 5 km SUPER (for runners under 18 minutes); 18:40 5 km for everyone else. Prizes for the top three in the women’s and men’s categories in the 5 km, and a finisher’s prize for everyone. Course records from 2025: Men 15:42.8, Women 18:54.1. Race bibs can be collected from 16:30 at Kanalparken. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women’s and men’s categories in the 5 km, and all participants receive a finisher’s prize.

name: Cytadela by Night # 114
description: Cytadela by Night 2.0 is a series of free, timed 5 km runs held in Cytadela Park in Poznań. The event attracts runners who want to enjoy the outdoors and the charm of the park in the evening. The run is recreational and open to a wide range of participants, promoting a healthy lifestyle and friendly sporting competition. It is well known in the local community and popular with Poznań residents.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km distance
The route runs through scenic Cytadela Park
An evening run in a friendly atmosphere
additional: The run is free and takes place regularly. Timing is provided during the run.

name: Koningsloop Beilen
price_range: Minirun, Kidsrun en Jeugdloop gratis; 5 km en 10 km € 12,50 voorinschrijving, € 15,00 op de dag

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgeld Minirun, 700 m en 1350 m: gratis (zowel bij voorinschrijving als bij na-inschrijving)

description: The Koningsloop Beilen is a friendly running event organized by Loopgroep Beilen, suitable for all ages, with distances ranging from a Minirun for the youngest participants to 5 km and 10 km for adults. The event takes place in Beilen and offers a sporty, festive atmosphere, with medals for younger participants and trophies and prize packages for the top runners. Timekeeping is automatic using a chip attached to the race bib. Changing rooms and showers are available at Vitesse. Parking is available near the start, and registration is open until 15 minutes before the start of each distance.
course_highlights: Distances from a 200 m Minirun to 10 km for adults
Chip-based timekeeping using the race bib
Start and facilities near Drenthehal and Vitesse sports park
additional: Participants in the Minirun, Kidsrun and Youth Run receive a commemorative medal. The first three men and women in the 5 km and 10 km races receive a trophy and a prize package. Race bibs have a chip and do not need to be returned. Safety pins are available at registration. Showers and changing facilities are available at Vitesse. Parking is available at Drenthehal and Sportpark Noord-West. The organizers accept no liability for lost clothing. Course: urban route with the start and finish in Beilen; registration until 25 April 2025; timekeeping by RaceResult; parking at Drenthehal and Sportpark Noord-West

name: Koningsloop Hasselt
description: The Koningsloop Hasselt is an annual running event held in the centre of Hasselt. The event offers various distances, including 5 and 10 km for adults and juniors, a Bambino Run for the very youngest, a Kids Run and a Heroes Run. The course passes through picturesque central Hasselt, with lovely views, including along the mill and across the Stenendijk. The Koningsloop is known as a sporting orange-themed celebration where people of all ages come together for an enjoyable and challenging running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the centre of Hasselt
Course passes the mill and crosses the Stenendijk, with beautiful views
Fast 10 km with a second lap on the same course
additional: Adults and juniors run the same course and start at the same time. All participants receive a memento, and participants in the Heroes Run receive a trophy. Changing rooms and bag drop-off are available. The finish is at Burgemeester Royerplein via Justitie Bastion. Young people train on Thursday evenings; adults train on Wednesday evenings. Event photos are available and can be removed on request by email. Registration is via inschrijven.nl; the course starts and finishes in central Hasselt; parking is available at Gemeentehuis Zwartewaterland.

name: Värmlandsstafetten

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälningsavgift fram till och med 27/4 1 500:-/lag.

late_fee.price: 2000:- plus stafettpinne 750:- vid start första gången

description: The Värmland Relay in Karlstad is a relay race where teams of 5–15 participants compete together on a flat circuit around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 metres long. All teams start and finish at the same time and have two hours to carry the relay baton as far as possible, changing runners after each lap. The relay is open to everyone, and teams can be mixed freely, creating a fun, social competition that promotes community and health. There is an awards ceremony after the race, and light refreshments are available on site. First-time participants buy a team baton featuring their team logo, which is used at every competition.
course_highlights: Flat circuit around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 metres per lap
Asphalt surface
Runners change over with the relay baton in the exchange zone by the arena
additional: Each team must buy a baton featuring its team logo in its first year, for 500:-. After the race, results can be engraved on the baton for a fee. Team leaders collect race bibs, chips and the baton at the arena. Paid parking is available at Sundstabadet. Changing rooms and showers are available at Idrottshuset. The card-payment refreshments stand opens at 16:30. Medical services and toilets are available at the arena. Teams may bring their own tents and beach flags to decorate the arena. Teams consist of 5–15 participants. Runners change after each lap, and the same person may not run multiple laps in a row. The baton costs 500 kr in the first year (750 kr for late registration).

name: Vestfold løpskarusell - 2. løp - Teieskogen

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 kr. for ikke medlemmer frem til 31.12.26.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1200 kr. for ikke medlemmer frem til 31.12.26.

description: Vestfold Running Series is a series of eight races in the Tønsberg region, offering running enjoyment, community, and a great atmosphere for all levels. Each race has two distances, and participants can choose to enter individual races or buy a season pass for all the races at a discounted price. The races start at 18:00 and use electronic timing via EQ Timing. The courses run through beautiful surroundings in different areas, such as Teieskogen, with the start and finish at the play area by Teie School.
course_highlights: Two distances per race, with varying lengths from 2.3 km to 6.9 km in Teieskogen
Start and finish at the play area by Teie School
Electronic timing via EQ Timing
additional: Season-pass participants collect their race number at the first race, while single-race participants can collect theirs at the race office 10 minutes before the start. The season pass must be kept throughout the series. Course descriptions and profiles are available in the Facebook group. Everyone can take part, regardless of level, and participants are encouraged to bring friends, colleagues, or family.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Kringsjåløpet
description: Kringsjåløpet is a traditional race that has been held since 1984 and marks the start of Sørdalskarusellen. The race takes place in Lillehammer on a measured 3 km course featuring varied terrain through residential areas, footpaths and wooded sections. The event offers both a mass start and virtual participation, attracting recreational and competitive runners of all ages. It is a relaxed and enjoyable fitness event with a great atmosphere and many participants and spectators. The start is at the intersection of Gamle Kringsjåvei and Håkon Håkonsensveg, and the finish is at Nordre Ål school.
course_highlights: Measured 3 km course with 25 metres of elevation gain
The course passes through residential areas, footpaths and wooded sections
Start and finish at Nordre Ål school in Lillehammer
additional: Race bibs can be collected the day before at Sport1 Lillehammer, Kirkegata 55, from 12:00 to 18:00, and on race day at Nordre Ål Barneskole from 18:45. There is limited parking near the race area, so walking is recommended. Sport1 Lillehammer offers Sørdalskarusellen participants a 15% discount and will also hold a Hoka shoe demo during the event. Sport1 will provide Fuel sports drink at the finish. The prize-giving takes place after everyone has finished. The race offers both a mass start and virtual participation.

name: Bølerstafetten
description: Bølerstafetten is a traditional relay organized by the Athletics Group of Bøler IF, starting and finishing at Haraløkka sports facility in Oslo. The relay is held for various age groups, with teams of girls, boys, and mixed participants, and the legs run on park paths and asphalt. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with a cafeteria and prizes for all participants. It is a great opportunity for young people and children to take part in a social and athletic relay in their local area.
course_highlights: The legs run on park paths and asphalt
Short course for ages 6–9, with 5 legs between 200 and 350 meters
Long course for ages 10–19, with 6 legs between 210 and 630 meters
additional: Race-number pickup is in the clubhouse cafeteria from 17:00 on race day. Changing rooms are available in the clubhouse at Haraløkka. The cafeteria and kiosk sell waffles, cakes, coffee, and soft drinks; payment by Vipps. Prizes include a team award for the winning teams in the 10–13, 14–16, and 15–19 age groups, and participant medals for everyone. Team lineups must be submitted at race-number pickup or emailed by 17:00 on race day. Age rules apply to the teams’ combined ages in the youngest categories. Mixed teams must include at least two participants of each gender. In 2026, the entry fee was NOK 600 per team for ages 6–9 and NOK 850 for the older categories; late entry cost an additional NOK 200.

name: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden

price_tiers.distance: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar 15-17 km

description: Pop up Run Åkulla Beech Forests is a magical spring trail run in Åkulla, where the greenery has burst into life and nature is full of life. The race offers a fairytale-like run past small, charming lakes, Bexell’s Talking Stones, and through the beautiful beech forest. With a distance of 15–17 km and several pace groups, it suits both experienced and recreational runners looking to create memories for life. After the race, there is an opportunity to have lunch together at Öströö Sheep Farm.
course_highlights: Run through Åkulla’s beech forest
Pass small, charming lakes
Pass Bexell’s Talking Stones
additional: Gather at 10:00 at Öströö Sheep Farm. There are 2–3 different pace groups. Carpooling is recommended, and help coordinating it is offered. After the race, there is an opportunity to have lunch together at Öströö Sheep Farm, at the participants’ own expense. Lunch afterward is optional and paid for by participants. The organizer recommends carpooling and can help coordinate it.

name: Risenloppet
location: Ekevallens idrottsplats, Genarp, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: RISEN-loppet is an annual running race organized by Genarps IF, starting and finishing at Ekevallen sports ground in Genarp. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10.7 km. The 5 km route runs mostly on asphalt through the village, while the 10.7 km route splits between the village and Risen Nature Reserve. The course is challenging, with tough elevation changes, and the race is part of Skånes VeteranCup. Participants receive a RISEN-loppet mug at the finish. There are water stations along the course, and an awards ceremony takes place after the race.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is 95% asphalt and 5% nature trail through the village
The 10.7 km course runs 50% through the village and 50% in Risen Nature Reserve
Tough elevation changes on both distances
additional: Electronic timing with gun time from the start signal. Bibs must be collected on race day no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn visibly on the chest. Water and energy (water and cordial) are available at 3 and 8 km. At the finish, water, cordial, recovery drink (Gatorade), and bananas are available. Rådjursloppet, a 700 m race for children up to age 9, starts at 12:15. All participants receive a medal, and registration is on site at no charge. On-site late registration is available for an additional fee of 100 SEK via Swish. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30 after the children's race. All participants receive a RISEN-loppet mug; gold mugs go to approximately the first 25% of finishers in each distance, and silver mugs to the others. A children's race of approximately 700 metres is also offered. Previous editions have started and finished at Ekevallen sports ground.

name: 12 Półmaraton Grudziądz-Rulewo
organizer: Gmina Miasto Grudziądz, Miejski Ośrodek Rekreacji i Wypoczynku w Grudziądzu
description: The 12th Grudziądz-Rulewo Half Marathon in the Footsteps of Bronisław Malinowski is a race with a unique character, deeply rooted in the history of the city and the life of its namesake, Olympic champion Bronisław Malinowski. The course passes places connected with Bronisław’s life and training, starting at the Olimpia Grudziądz stadium, crossing the Bronisław Malinowski Bridge, and finishing at Hanza Pałac Hotel in Rulewo. The race combines a passion for sport with the memory of an outstanding athlete, offering participants an exciting experience and a sporting spirit that unites generations. The event takes place on the first weekend of May, and participants can look forward to a varied accompanying program and organizational support.
course_highlights: The course passes historic places connected with Bronisław Malinowski, including the Bronisław Malinowski Bridge in Grudziądz
Start at the Olimpia Grudziądz stadium; finish at Hanza Pałac Hotel in Rulewo
A course with varied surfaces, aid stations every 5 km, and markers every 1 km
additional: The race office is open on April 30 (16:00–20:00) at Marina Grudziądz and on May 1 (8:00–10:30) at the Olimpia stadium. The time limit for completing the course is 3 hours; the course closes at 14:00. There are at least 3 aid stations on the course (water, isotonic drink, fruit). After the race, participants receive a medal and diploma and can enjoy a recovery meal, massages from physiotherapists, and free MZK bus transport for runners. On race day, warm-ups are led by Fit House instructors. Children can take part in the accompanying “Be Like Bronek” races. Information for the 12th edition lists the race office at Marina Grudziądz and at the GKS Olimpia Stadium.

name: Sianowska Dyszka
organizer: Fundacja Zastopuj Sportowiec.info oraz Gmina i Miasto Sianów

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Wpisowe to wśród dorosłych 40 zł do 02.12.2026 r.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Wpisowe wśród dzieci to 20 zł do 02.12.2026 r.

description: Sianowska Dyszka is a 10-kilometre race and part of a series of five races held in Sianów. The event promotes running as a natural form of physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the scenic running routes of the Sianów municipality. The races count towards the overall RUNking of Runners standings, which are summed up at the Runners’ Gala. The event is open to adults and children, with separate children’s races over shorter distances.
course_highlights: A 10 km race as part of the Sianowska Dyszka series
Scenic running routes in the Sianów municipality
Children’s races over distances from 100 to 1,000 metres
additional: Race packs can be collected from 9:30 to 10:45. Children’s races start between 11:00 and 11:30 over distances from 100 to 1,000 metres. A total of 120 medals have been prepared for participants. Prizes will be awarded to the three fastest women and men. Participants must register and verify their identity at the Race Office by presenting an identity document, and sign a declaration confirming that they are familiar with the regulations. Results from the Sianowska race series count towards the overall standings, which are summed up at the RUNking Runners’ Gala.

name: XI Bieg o Strzałę Widanta
location: Park Miejski w Resku, Resko, Poland
description: The 11th Widant’s Arrow Run is an annual running event held in Resko Municipal Park. The competition includes 5 km and 10 km races, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event. The course runs through the park and nearby forests along the Rega River, on natural, gravel, and paved surfaces. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and outdoor recreation for runners and enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Course through Resko Municipal Park and nearby forests along the Rega River
Natural, gravel, and paved surfaces
Two laps for the 10 km race and one lap for the 5 km race and Nordic walking event
additional: Children’s and youth races take place from 10:00 in the Municipal Park area by Górka Borków. A professional warm-up is held by the park stage at 11:45, before the races. Participants over 70 are entitled to free entry after registering. In the previous edition, the start and finish were in Resko Municipal Park; the programme also included children’s and youth races. Wierzbicki Running Project was a co-organizer.

name: XIII Bieg Borków
location: Osieczna, Leszno County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Bieg Borków is an annual running event held in Osieczna, offering a great opportunity to enjoy an active May holiday weekend. The event includes main races over 5 km and 10 km, as well as a free 1 km children’s race held on race day. Every participant receives a race pack and a medal, and the top runners are awarded trophies. The atmosphere encourages families and the local community to enjoy sport together.
course_highlights: Main races over 5 km and 10 km
1 km children’s race with age categories ranging from preschoolers to grades 7–8
Start and finish at the Centre for Culture and Library in Osieczna
additional: The 1 km children’s race is free. Registration takes place on race day at the Centre for Culture and Library in Osieczna, from 8:00 to 9:45. The children’s race is limited to 250 participants. Every child receives a medal and a race pack; trophies and a prize draw are planned for the age categories. In 2026, participants received a race pack and a medal, and the top runners received prizes.

name: XIII Dycha po Piachu
description: Dycha po Piachu is a race held in Czołpino, in the Smołdzino municipality. The 13th edition is scheduled for April 30, 2027. The event’s name refers to the sandy nature of the course and the local landscape. It is an option for runners looking to race in a coastal area.
course_highlights: Start in Czołpino, in the Smołdzino municipality
The event’s name suggests the race has a sandy character
Course in a coastal area

name: XXII Półmaraton Chełmżyński Chełmżyńska Dziesiątka
description: The 22nd Chełmża Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Chełmża, attracting runners from various regions. The half-marathon course runs through scenic areas of the town and its surroundings, offering participants attractive views and sporting challenges. The event is open to all and promotes an active lifestyle and integration within the local community. The organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere suited to both competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course passes through central Chełmża and the surrounding areas
Scenic views and varied terrain
A well-marked and secured course

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: Winter Bay Backyard Ultra in Trosa is a unique ultrarunning event where participants run laps on a 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River. Each lap must be completed within one hour to continue, and the race goes on until only one runner remains. The course is easy and flat, making it suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and enthusiasts. Sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches and food are available during the race. There is also a team competition and a children’s race, Mini-TUB. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary with especially fine medals and prizes for the top three in the men’s and women’s categories.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to ultrarunning
Mini-TUB children’s race with its own course and medals
additional: Each participant in the main race receives a free silicone cup from Umara at bib collection. Umara sports drinks, fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen, and food from Trosa Stadshotell are served during the race. Sandwiches and sweets are offered at every lap. There is a team competition where the three best results from each club count, with prize money for the winning team. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 and is open to children born in 2017 or later. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with the race officials. The race is fully booked. There is also a team competition and Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later. Tent spaces are arranged in consultation with the race officials; a small number of motorhome spaces are available, but they do not have electricity.

name: Hallandsloppet Trail
location: Gurkbänken, Vessigebro, Falkenberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Hallandsloppet Trail is a scenic trail running race that takes you on a unique journey through the Ätran Valley, with views of the River Ätran, birdsong and lush deciduous woodland. The race is held in central Vessigebro at Gurkbänken and offers 5 km and 10 km classes, both for runners with and without dogs. It’s the perfect race for anyone who wants to experience Halland’s beautiful nature in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: A unique journey through the Ätran Valley
Views of the River Ätran and birdsong
Runs through lush deciduous woodland
additional: The race is held at Gurkbänken in central Vessigebro. The start and finish are listed as being at Gurkbänken in central Vessigebro.

name: Sevede Trail Run
location: Mariannelund, Eksjö Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Sevede Trail Run is organized by Hässleby Ski and Orienteering Club in Mariannelund and offers a challenging, scenic trail run. The race attracts runners of all ages and levels and takes place in beautiful woodland with varied terrain. It is a much-loved tradition that brings together participants and spectators for a wonderful day outdoors.
course_highlights: Trail running in woodland
Varied terrain with trails and forest roads
Scenic views around Mariannelund

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a unique ultramarathon held in central Trosa on an easy, flat 6.7 km course, mostly along the Trosaån river. The goal is to complete as many laps as possible, with one hour per lap. Participants who complete a lap can start again at the beginning of the next hour. It is a festive, social competition with prize money, a team competition and prize draws during the race. Children can take part in Mini-TUB, with its own course and lovely medals. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches and food from local sponsors are served during the race.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosaån river
An easy, flat course suited to completing many laps
A 700 m Mini-TUB children’s course that follows the main course
additional: Start time: 10:00 on 1 May 2027. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 the same day. Umara sports drink and fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen are served during the race. Participants receive a free silicone cup from Umara when collecting their race numbers. Food from Trosa Stadshotell, as well as sandwiches and sweets, is served at every lap turnaround. The team competition counts the three best results from each club. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with race officials. No plastic cups are used, for environmental reasons. The 2027 race starts on 1 May at 10:00 and is fully booked. The team competition counts the three best results per club. Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later starts at 14:15.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
location: Ekoparken vid Nordens Ark, Hunnebostrand, Sweden
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a scenic trail race that winds through the Eco Park at Nordens Ark in Hunnebostrand. The race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the arrival of spring in a beautiful setting rich in wildlife. The event welcomes both families with children and adults who want to combine running with nature experiences. Nordens Ark is a non-profit foundation that works to protect endangered animals and their habitats, giving the race an especially meaningful purpose.
course_highlights: The courses run through the Eco Park and its scenic surroundings
Run in a beautiful, wildlife-rich setting by Åbyfjorden
Trail running suitable for families with children and adults
additional: The 2026 edition of Nordens Ark TrailRun has been cancelled. The park is cashless; payment is by card or Swish. The park has a café and food outlets during the peak season. The park is open daily, with opening hours varying by season.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://nordensark.se/besok-oss/trailrun/): 2026-05-02 — "Lördagen den 2 maj går den femte upplagan av Nordens Ark Trailrun" (was estimated 2026-05-09)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Lördagen den 2 maj går den femte upplagan av Nordens Ark Trailrun

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on 1 May 2027 in Strandbjörket, Växjö. This is a running festival for the whole family, with distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21.1 km), as well as Lilla Växjöloppet for younger runners. The courses offer a scenic running experience featuring asphalt, forest roads and beautiful views around Lake Växjö and the Bokhultet Nature Reserve. Växjöloppet is a traditional, friendly race that puts the joy of exercise and community at its heart.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Strandbjörket, with the first kilometre on asphalt
A scenic route through the Bokhultet Nature Reserve, mostly among deciduous trees
The final 3.5 km on asphalt around Lake Växjö, with a shared finish on Lagunvallen
additional: There are water stations on the 10 km course (4 stations) and the 21.1 km course (8 stations). Lilla Växjöloppet offers four different distances for younger runners, with no timing. Participants receive a race bib, medal and fruit, or a T-shirt and certificate, depending on the distance. The finish line is on Lagunvallen, approximately 300–400 metres from the finish at Strandbjörket. Lilla Växjöloppet is not timed. Registration and payment for the children’s races take place on site at Lagunen in Strandbjörket.
