pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Välkommen till Växjöloppet den första maj 2027.

name: Sundvolden Challenge
description: Sundvolden Challenge is a spectacular uphill race held on Saturday, 1 May 2027, in Hole, Buskerud. The race follows the historic Dronningveien road up to Kleivstua, covering 338 metres of elevation gain over 5 kilometres, and offers a challenge for all levels, from beginners to elite athletes. The event also includes an expo, a mini-concert, an after-run at Sundvolden Hotel, and the option of a race banquet and concert after the finish. Participants can choose between competitive and recreational classes, and the race has a unique heat and superfinal format.
course_highlights: 5 kilometres with 338 metres of elevation gain up Dronningveien
Spectacular views of Tyrifjorden
Historic course from Dronningveien to Kleivstua
additional: Participants can choose a competitive or recreational class. All heats are assigned randomly, regardless of expected finish time. The first heat starts at 14:30, with subsequent heats following the prologue. The finalists are presented at 17:00, and the superfinal starts shortly afterward. The minimum age is 12 in the year of the event. Bib number collection takes place on Saturday at Sundvolden Hotel. Parking is available at the start, and bus and train transport to Sundvolden Hotel is available.

name: Steinsland Bygdemaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startkontingent er 400 kr. (350 kr for kondismedlem)

description: Steinsland Village Marathon is a long-standing race that starts in the farmyard of Odd Gunnar Tveit in Steinsland. The course passes through the scenic municipalities of Vennesla, Iveland and Birkenes, with a choice of distances: marathon, half marathon and 10 km. The race offers a wonderful experience in nature, with several refreshment stations along the way and kiosk sales in the start and finish area. An earlier start is available for those who wish to walk the course, and transport and accommodation can be arranged if needed.
course_highlights: The marathon course passes through Vennesla, Iveland and Birkenes
10 refreshment stations along the course
Start and finish in the farmyard of Odd Gunnar Tveit in Steinsland
additional: Start times: 08:00 marathon for walkers; 09:00 marathon for those who expect to take more than 4.5 hours; 11:00 half marathon for walkers; 12:00 start for the half marathon and 10 km. Kiosk sales are available in the start/finish area. Transport and accommodation can be arranged by contacting the organizer. Distances are marathon, half marathon and 10 km. The start and finish are in the farmyard of Odd Gunnar Tveit, with kiosk sales in the start/finish area.

name: Skifjelløpet
description: Skifjelløpet is held annually on May 16, starting at 18:00 from Lillesand IL’s clubhouse. The race is approximately 6 km long and runs through varied terrain with natural trails and mountain sections. The course is well marked and offers a challenging route with steep hills and a mountain section, finishing in front of the clubhouse. Participants can register in advance or on site from 16:30.
course_highlights: Start outside the clubhouse, with an uphill section to the right of the garage
The course crosses the Skifjell mountain section on natural trails
Finish in front of the clubhouse after running around the stadium
additional: Registration is available in advance via Webscorer or on site from 16:30. The course is marked, and a GPX file is available for mobile apps. Participants must run around the stadium before finishing. The organizer’s page lists advance registration via Webscorer and on-site registration from 16:30. Previous editions have been held in May.

name: Hagemanns Backyard Festival 2027
description: Hagemanns Backyard Festival 2027 is a unique race in Drammen where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour on the hour, with the first start at 10:00 on May 1. It is an endurance challenge: runners must complete each loop within an hour to continue, and the last person standing wins. Children’s races are also held on both days, along with an additional race on Sunday where participants run one loop as fast as possible. The festival offers facilities including changing rooms, showers and a kiosk. Reflective vests and headlamps are mandatory for runs after 21:00.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop starting every hour on the hour
Children’s race of approximately 400–500 metres around the school building
Running in the dark, with reflective vests and headlamps required after 21:00
additional: Reflective vests and headlamps are mandatory from 21:00 to 06:00. Changing rooms, toilets and showers are available at Ebbestadhallen. The kiosk opens at 08:00 and is run by Svelvik Cycling Club. Pizza will be served to participants at 19:30. Start numbers can be bought and sold through Racetracker. Children’s races are held on both Saturday and Sunday. Contact: Einar Hagemann (einarhagemann@msn.com).

name: Askstafetten
description: Askstafetten is a traditional relay race organized by Ask Friidrett in the beautiful surroundings of Askøy in Vestland. The race brings together both local and visiting teams for a social and athletic challenge. The event is part of Ask Friidrett’s activity calendar and offers a great opportunity to experience the athletics community in the region. It is an inclusive race suitable for different age groups and ability levels.

name: Tyn_deg 5K
description: Tyn_deg 5K is an inclusive trail race in Kristiansand that combines challenging natural terrain with team spirit and community. The race runs from the seafront to Odderøya’s highest point and is suitable for all levels. Free interval training for women is also held in Mandal and Kristiansand, focusing on the joy of running and social exercise. Tyn_deg aims to create a fun and motivating experience for both individual runners and teams.
course_highlights: Trail race from the seafront to Odderøya’s highest point
A 3.4–4.7 km course on varied terrain
Focus on team spirit and community, with a team competition
additional: The team competition is based on the average time of the team’s five fastest runners, with time deductions for additional participants. The individual winner is determined by the fastest individual time. Free weekly interval training for women in Mandal and Kristiansand starts at 19:30. Outdoor toilets are available at the start locations. The race is listed for 1 May 2027. Previous editions have been held in Kristiansand.

name: Råskinnet
description: Råskinnet is a challenging trail race around Sognsvann in Oslo, featuring bogs, trails, steep hills and two water crossings. The race is known for being tough, wet and muddy, and is suitable for the whole family, with separate distances for children and young people. Everyone who finishes can call themselves a true Råskinn. The event has a long tradition and is met with great enthusiasm by participants and volunteers.
course_highlights: Two crossings of Sognsvann, with water reaching thigh or chest height
Steep hills in old ski jumps from 1942 (Kollbakkene)
The course’s most beautiful section, with old-growth forest and bogs by Godbekken
additional: Race bibs are sent by SMS and must be collected at the start area no later than one hour before the start. Showers and changing rooms are available in the basement at NIH; bring your own padlock. There is free parking at Sognsvann and paid parking at NIH. Bags and luggage can be stored in an unattended tent at the venue. Råskinnet’s 10 km race starts in waves according to expected finish time (from 13:30 to 13:50). The children’s races, Knøttetassen and Råtassen, have separate start times at 11:45 and 12:20–12:35. Distances: 900 m for ages 6–9, 3 km for ages 10–15 and 9 km from age 15. Starts are divided into waves. Sognsvann is accessible by metro line 5.

name: Esefjorden Rundt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 13-16 år for medlemmar i BIL med heilårslisens

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 13-16 år for medlemmar i BIL med eingongslisens ( kr.30)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startpengar konkurranse stafett kr 100,- Stafett 11-12 år (f. 2015 og 2014)

description: Esefjorden Rundt is a beautiful 8.5 km road race on asphalt, with no major elevation changes, around Esefjorden, part of the National Tourist Routes. The race starts at Tjugum Church and finishes at the Balahaugen festival grounds, near the centre of Balestrand. The event has a long tradition and attracts recreational runners and competitive runners of all ages, with a festive atmosphere and beautiful scenery, including the mountains Tjugatoten and Keipen around the fjord. Participants can take a shuttle boat from the centre of Balestrand to the start area, making for a unique experience.
course_highlights: 8.5 km asphalt course with no major elevation changes
Starts at Tjugum Church and finishes at the Balahaugen festival grounds
The course goes around Esefjorden, part of the National Tourist Routes, with beautiful mountain views
additional: Shuttle boats run between Holmen (Balestrand town centre) and Tjugum (the start area) from 09:00 to 16:00. Boat transport ends at 16:00. Shuttle boat tickets cost NOK 80 for adults, NOK 40 for children under 15, and NOK 200 for a family. Parking is available at the finish area, in the town centre, at Tjugum Church and at Bygdahuset. The relay competition has three legs, with a map available. Race numbers must be collected at Tjugum Church within the specified times. A licence is required for participants aged 13 to 80, with a one-time licence available when registering. Recreational and competitive categories. A shuttle boat from Holmen in Balestrand town centre to Tjugum is an option; the finish area at Balahaugen is about 1 km from the town centre.

name: SA-løpet
description: SA-løpet is an open and inclusive running event in the beautiful Kulåsparken in Sarpsborg, suitable for all ages and levels. The event offers several distances, both timed and untimed, and focuses on community, personal achievement, and the joy of running. It is well organized, with dedicated volunteers, good safety measures, and accessibility, and aims to give all participants a positive experience. Welcome to an active day filled with smiles and the true joy of running!
course_highlights: Course in the beautiful Kulåsparken, Sarpsborg
Several distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Safe, well-organized event with a clear course
additional: The start and finish are in Kulåsparken. The children's race starts at 10:00, the 10 km starts at 10:30, and the 2.5 km and 5 km start at 10:35. Race numbers are handed out only on race day from 08:00. Toilets are available in the Service House in Kulåsparken. Bag storage is provided during the race. Participants must be 11 years or older to take part in the timed races; younger participants may take part without timing. Registration is listed as open from 1 February to 29 April 2027, with late registration on 30 April and until the race starts on 1 May. Timed categories have an age limit of 11; younger participants may take part without timing or in the children's race.

name: Backyard Lampeland Ultra
description: Backyard Lampeland is a unique ultrarun held in Lampeland, Flesberg. The race consists of a gently undulating 6.7 km loop run every hour on the hour, with a maximum of twelve laps in total. Participants must start each lap to continue, and the last runner to start wins the race. The event has a social focus and a low barrier to entry, with a rest area, refreshments and changing rooms available. Everyone who completes 12 laps receives a cup, and those who run the ultra distance receive a Norwegian-made wooden medal.
course_highlights: Gently undulating 6.7 km loop per lap
Maximum of 12 laps, 80.4 km in total
The race starts every hour on the hour
additional: You must bring your own cup. A reflective vest and headlamp are required if visibility is poor on the final lap. Baked goods, snacks, coffee, water and sausages are available after the seventh lap. A rest area and changing rooms are available in the hall. Maximum 500 participants. Bib collection is Friday 15:00–20:00 and Saturday 08:00–09:15 at Friluftsbua by Lampeland Hotel, or in the hall by the start from 09:30. Use of a race belt for your bib is recommended. The start and finish are at Skattekista, the school and multipurpose hall in Lampeland. Maximum 500 participants.

name: Grue Halvmaraton - inkl. NM 10 km
description: Grue Half Marathon is held in Kirkenær in Grue and offers a half marathon and a 10 km race. The course is described as flat and fast, and both distances have previously been AIMS-certified at A level. In 2027, the Norwegian Championships in the 10 km are part of the event.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Half marathon and 10 km at the same event
The 10 km race will host the Norwegian Championships in 2027
additional: Previous editions have started and finished in Kirkenær. The information about course certification refers to a previous edition.

name: Perseløpet 50 km, 100 km, maraton
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll, starting and finishing at Ås school, Hammerås. The race features a flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop that offers good opportunities for fast times. Participants can choose from seven distances ranging from 3 km to 100 km, including 50 km and the marathon. The race has a unique concept, with a dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap, and a friendly atmosphere where personal records are celebrated by ringing a bell at the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop
Dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap
Distances from 3 km to 100 km, with opportunities to set personal records
additional: Race bibs are collected via self-service at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing facilities and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, ninth-graders from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan lap times. Race bib collection, changing facilities and toilets are at Ås school, less than 100 metres from the start.

name: Bruvollenstafetten
description: Bruvollenstafetten is a traditional relay race that has been held for over 60 years, always on May 1. The race takes place at Bruvollen in Blaker, with legs on a 400-metre track with red artificial turf, as well as on gravel and the trotting track. There are separate categories for children, young people and recreational runners, and the relay is suitable for teams from clubs, businesses and groups of friends. The event offers a great atmosphere, prizes for each category and the option of an organised warm-up before the start. There is ample parking, and spikes are not permitted on the track.
course_highlights: Legs on a 400 m track with red artificial turf
Sections on gravel and the trotting track, with two exchange points
Several categories for children, young people and recreational runners/recreational teams
additional: The race office opens at 10:00 on event day. Parking by the trotting track costs 50 kr per car. Prizes are awarded after each category. An organised warm-up is offered before category 1. All cars receive a raffle ticket for a chance to win fruit baskets and gift cards. Bruvollenstafetten is held every year on May 1. Practical information for 2026 states that spikes are not permitted.

name: Jentejoggen & Herresprinten Lillestrøm
description: Jentejoggen & Herresprinten is a running event in Lillestrøm, with events for both women and men. Jentejoggen welcomes runners of all ages and fitness levels, while Herresprinten is a social and sporty race for men of all ages. The event brings together a range of runners for an active day in Lillestrøm.

name: Biri Backyard ultra 50
price_range: 450–550 kr; engangslisens på 40 kr kommer i tillegg
description: Biri Backyard Ultra 50 is a unique 12-hour race organised by Biri IL in cooperation with its athletics group. The race follows the Backyard format, with a 6,706-metre course to be completed within each hour and a start every hour on the hour from 08:00 to 19:00. The total distance is 50 miles (just over 80 km), half the distance of the original 24-hour Backyard Ultra. The race combines socialising with an athletic challenge, and participants must be at the start each hour to continue. The winner is determined by the number of laps completed, with the time on the final lap deciding a tie.
course_highlights: A 6,706-metre (4.167-mile) course in Biri Idrettspark
Starts every hour on the hour; each lap must be completed before the next start
A total of 12 hours and 50 miles (just over 80 km)
additional: Participant information is provided at 07:50 at the start line, and race administration is on site from 07:00 on race day. The race starts every hour from 08:00 to 19:00, and participants must be at the start each time to continue. If multiple participants complete the final start, the winner is determined by the fastest time on the final lap. Registration for 2027 is listed as open from 1 February to 14 April, with a maximum of 150 places. Participants must bring their own supplies. The main race has an age limit of 18; the youth race is 6.7 km for ages 13–17, and the children’s race is 1 km for ages 6–12.

name: SI stafetten
description: The SI Relay is organized by Sandnes Idrettslag and is a long-standing relay race that brings together runners of all ages and abilities. The race takes place at Sandnes Stadium and offers both recreational and competitive runners a great opportunity to take part in a social and engaging event. Sandnes Idrettslag has a long tradition in athletics and emphasizes the joy of sport, personal achievement, and community. The club offers an inclusive environment focused on development for all athletes.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Sandnes Stadium
Suitable for runners of all ages, from children and young people to adults
Organized by one of Norway’s leading athletics clubs, with excellent training facilities

name: Strandamilå
location: Jørpeland Flerbrukshall, Jørpeland, Strand, Rogaland, Norway
description: Strandamilå is a long-standing race being held for the 47th time in 2027. The race runs from Jørpeland to Tau and offers 10-kilometre and half-marathon distances. It is a popular event starting at Jørpeland Flerbrukshall and finishing at Tau Stadion, with detailed course maps and elevation profiles available. Participants can collect their race numbers the day before or on race day, and all finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: The course runs from Jørpeland to Tau over a certified distance
Water station on the 10 km course at Nagabrunå, after approximately 4 km
Shower facilities in the finish area at Tau Aktivitetshus
additional: Untimed participation is available, with a 10:30 start. Race numbers can be collected on Thursday 30 April from 10:00 to 14:00 at Sparebanken Norge in Tau, or on race day from 11:30. Pacers are available for finish times of 40, 45, 50, 55 and 60 minutes. Transport for bags from Jørpeland to Tau is provided. Parking is available near the start area, and local buses can be used to return from the finish area. The 10 km race starts at 13:00 from Jørpeland Flerbrukshall. Bag transport to Tau is arranged, and participants receive a medal.

name: Grenland Hinderløp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1,5km KIDS (6-10år), uten tid kr. 190,-. (Voksen må følge med rundt og bistå der det trengs).

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 4km TWEENS (11-14år), uten tid og påkrevd følge med voksen kr. 290,-

description: Grenland Obstacle Run is an obstacle race held at Skien Leisure Park, where participants can challenge themselves on a course of approximately 4 km with around 20 varied obstacles. You can choose to run one lap (4 km) or two laps (8 km). The course is designed so that everyone can get through the obstacles, with alternative tasks available for obstacles that are too difficult. The event is suitable for both individual participants and teams of 4–5 people, and encourages achievement, cooperation and team building. The start and finish are at the ice rink outside the indoor ice arena. The event has an inclusive, fun focus, with challenges involving mud, water and heavy lifting.
course_highlights: Approximately 4 km course with around 20 obstacles of varying size and difficulty
Choose one or two laps (4 km or 8 km); obstacles are repeated on the longer course
Start and finish at the ice rink outside the indoor ice arena at Skien Leisure Park
additional: The start and finish are at the ice rink outside the indoor ice arena at Skien Leisure Park. The course has around 20 obstacles of varying difficulty. Participants can compete individually or in teams of 4–5 people. Teams have the opportunity to build teamwork and cooperate. Participants can complete alternative tasks if an obstacle is too difficult. The event is held at the same time as an athletics meet and other activities in the area, attracting a good number of spectators. Previous editions have included a separate 1.5 km KIDS class.

name: Meldorfer Brückenlauf/ Westküstenhalbmarathon
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 9 km, 6 km, 3000 Meter, 2.7 km, 0.4 km

name: 42 Chojnickie Biegi Strażackie
description: The Chojnice Firefighters’ Run is a traditional 10 km road race held in Chojnice since 1985. The event is open to all running enthusiasts, not just firefighters. It takes place annually in early May and attracts runners from a variety of backgrounds. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and the event’s atmosphere highlights sporting competition and local community spirit.
course_highlights: A 10 km road race
A tradition dating back to 1985
Open to everyone, not just firefighters
additional: More than 200 people took part in the race in 2026.

name: Hunebedloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijfgeld is € 13,00 voor 7,5 kilometer en de 7.5 kilometer Canicross

description: The AH Abe Hunebedloop is an atmospheric running race organised by AV de Sprinter, held in the beautiful surroundings of Havelte. The course runs mostly along paved paths and passes special sights such as the hunebeds, burial mounds and sheepfold. The start and finish are at Toegangspoort Holtingerveld, which also has facilities including changing rooms and toilets. The race offers several distances and categories, suitable for a range of ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Mostly paved paths through the Havelte nature area
Past the hunebeds and burial mounds
Start and finish at the sheepfold (Toegangspoort Holtingerveld)
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 10:00 at the start/finish. Water and fruit are available after the race. Changing facilities are in the Lammerenkooi of the sheepfold. Registration is open until one hour before the start or until the maximum of 750 participants is reached. Late registration opens on 11 January 2027 and costs an additional € 2,00. Registration via inschrijven.nl; start and finish at Toegangspoort Holtingerveld; maximum 750 participants; part of the Univéloopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe.

name: 8 Petranpad Ultra Trail 112km
location: Meerlo, Horst aan de Maas, Limburg, Netherlands

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a popular running event that welcomes competitive runners, recreational runners and families to run through beautiful Swedish countryside along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 10 km race and a 5 km recreational race. It is marked by a strong sense of community and scenic views along the canal. Kanallöpet is organised by Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna, and is a tradition that returns every spring.
course_highlights: Run along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Half marathon, 10 km and 5 km recreational races
Beautiful Swedish countryside and scenic views
additional: The event has competitive and recreational categories, as well as family-friendly distances. The organising clubs are Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna. Participants receive medals, although medal deliveries may sometimes be delayed. For the 2025 race, buses are reported to be arranged from Borensberg to the starting locations. Competitive categories require membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: SäterMaran (inkl. DM i halvmaraton)
description: SäterMaran is a running event organized by Säters IF FIK, offering half-marathon and 10 km distances. A full marathon was previously held, but is currently closed to late entries due to low participation. The event is a welcome opportunity for runners of different levels to challenge themselves in a beautiful setting in Säter. Säters IF FIK is an active athletics club with dedicated coaches and a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10 km distances are offered
The event takes place in Säter amid scenic surroundings
Organized by Säters IF FIK, a club with a long tradition in athletics
additional: Registration for the half-marathon and 10 km is open as usual. The organizer publishes the invitation, course route, race information, schedule, start list, and results on the club’s website.

name: Sparkassenlauf und Wandertag TuS Bergen von 1867 e.V.
Ultra Wysoczyzna
description: Ultra Wysoczyzna is a unique trail race held in the scenic Elbląg Upland, featuring five distances of varying difficulty. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the natural attractions of the region. The start and finish for most distances are in Elbląg, except for the 54 km distance, which starts in Tolkmicko. The event takes place on April 16–18, 2027, and attracts runners from across Poland.
course_highlights: Deer’s Roar — 103 km, elevation gain/loss +/- 2,300 m, 17-hour time limit
Wolf’s Howl — 54 km, elevation gain/loss +/- 1,160 m, 10-hour time limit, starts in Tolkmicko
Boar’s Squeal — 22 km, elevation gain/loss +/- 800 m, 5-hour time limit
additional: The start and finish for Deer’s Roar (103 km), Boar’s Squeal (22 km), Fox’s Squeak (13 km) and Owl’s Hoot (6 km) are in Elbląg at 6 Marymoncka Street (Bażantarnia Municipal Park). The 54 km Wolf’s Howl starts in Tolkmicko and finishes in Elbląg. Time limits range from 1.5 hours (6 km) to 17 hours (103 km). The technical briefing is held online on Facebook the day before the start. Bus transport to the 54 km start is available for registered participants who have paid their entry fee. Award ceremonies take place after each distance. The races are held on April 16–18, 2027; the event programme also includes junior races. The 54 km race starts in Tolkmicko.

name: 10 Bieg Króla Eryka
description: The 10th King Eric Run is an annual running event organized by the Darłowskie Charty Running Club in Darłowo. The event features a variety of distances, including races for children and a main race, attracting both recreational and more experienced runners. The participant limit is 300 for the main race and 250 for the children’s races. Registration is available online until the end of April or until places are filled. The event has a family-friendly character and promotes physical activity among residents and visitors.
course_highlights: The course includes different distances suited to participants’ ages and categories
Children’s races range from 200 to 1,200 meters and are divided by birth year and gender
Participant limits: 300 for the main race and 250 for the children’s races
additional: The children’s races are divided into age categories, with distances ranging from 200 m to 1,200 m. In the 2026 edition, the children’s and youth races took place on May 2, and the main race took place on May 3. Entry fees from the children’s races were allocated to charity.

name: 10 Transgraniczny Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 10th Gryfino Cross-Border Running Festival is an annual event held in Gryfino to commemorate the anniversary of the Constitution of 3 May. Participants can choose from three options: a 10 km race, a half marathon, or 10 km Nordic walking. Participants check in at the Tavern on the Quay of the Polak spod znaku Rodła, and everyone must collect their race packet in person. The festival combines sporting competition with local tradition and the atmosphere of a national holiday.
course_highlights: Three options: 10 km race, half marathon, and 10 km Nordic walking
Start and check-in at the Tavern on the Quay of the Polak spod znaku Rodła
Event commemorating the anniversary of the Constitution of 3 May
additional: Participants check in in person at the Tavern on the Quay of the Polak spod znaku Rodła, 5 Energetyków Street, Gryfino. Race packets can be collected on the day before the event or on race day. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration stating that they are running at their own risk. For the edition described, participants checked in in person at the Tavern at 5 Energetyków Street, Gryfino.

name: Poznański Bieg Konstytucji
location: Polana Harcerza, POSiR Malta, Poznań, Poland
description: The Poznań Constitution Run is a race held in Poznań to celebrate Constitution Day on May 3. In the 2026 edition, participants could choose between 5 km and 10 km, with the start scheduled at Polana Harcerza near POSiR Malta.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in the 2026 edition
Start and finish at Polana Harcerza
Race in the area around POSiR Malta in Poznań

name: XXXIII Bieg im. Jana Kilińskiego
location: Stadion Miejski w Trzemesznie, Trzemeszno, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Trzemesznie
description: The 33rd Jan Kiliński National Run is a half marathon held with the participation of Trzemeszno and Mogilno. The course is 21.097 km long, with the start and race-pack collection scheduled at the Municipal Stadium in Trzemeszno. The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Trzemeszno.
course_highlights: Half marathon covering 21.097 km
The course connects Trzemeszno and Mogilno
Start in Trzemeszno, at the Municipal Stadium
additional: Race packs can be collected at the Municipal Stadium in Trzemeszno on event day, from 7:30 to 9:15. A race-pack exchange is available.

name: XXXIII Sztumski Bieg Solidarności 3 maja
description: The 33rd International Sztum Solidarity Run is an annual running event held on May 3 in Sztum at the Municipal Beach. The event includes races for children, a 10 km run, and a Nordic Walking march, welcoming both recreational and more experienced runners. This sporting celebration combines tradition with outdoor recreation, promoting solidarity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The route runs along the scenic Municipal Beach in Sztum
A range of distances is available: races for children, 10 km, and Nordic Walking
The event is international in nature, attracting participants from various countries
additional: The event includes races for children and a Nordic Walking march. The start and finish are at the Municipal Beach in Sztum. The event is held annually on May 3, promoting physical activity and solidarity. The program also includes races for children.

name: XXXV Bieg Orłów
location: Kompleks sportowo-rekreacyjny, ul. Słupska 26a, Czarna Dąbrówka, Poland
description: The 35th National Eagles Run is an annual running event held at the sports and recreation complex in Czarna Dąbrówka. The event attracts runners of all ages, starting with children’s and youth races as part of the Cross Festival. The race office opens at 8:30, and the first races are scheduled to start at 10:00. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
5 km race and 5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s and youth races, including distances from 150 to 1,200 m
additional: The race office is open from 8:30. Children’s and youth races are held as part of the Cross Festival. The start and finish are at the sports and recreation complex in Czarna Dąbrówka, at 26a Słupska Street. For the 2026 edition, the event venue was listed as the sports and recreation complex at 26a Słupska Street; the race office was scheduled to open at 8:30.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2
description: Voss Running Series is a running series for everyone, with 5 km races held on Mondays in 2027. The course starts and finishes at Idrettsplassen in Voss, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. The event welcomes recreational participants and runners aged 9 and up to enjoyable fun runs in scenic surroundings. Registration is online, and a discount is offered for registering for all six races before the second race. The races start at 19:00, except for the final race, which starts at 18:30.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Idrettsplassen
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Race along the waterfront promenade
additional: The races are held on Mondays, starting at 19:00, except for the final race on 20 September, which starts at 18:30. You can register for individual races or for all six together, with a discount for early registration. The course can be viewed virtually in a video on the website. Registration is via EQ Timing. A discount is available for registering for all six races by the second race.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 2
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is a running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Idrettsplass, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. The event welcomes recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up to enjoyable fun runs in scenic surroundings. Registration is online, with a discount for registering for all six races by the second race.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Idrettsplass
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: Registration is online only via EQ Timing. You can register for all six races at a discount by the second race. The fifth race starts at 18:30 instead of 19:00. Registration is online via EQ Timing. There is a discount for registering for all six races by race 2; otherwise, you register for each race individually.

name: Tinestafetten Gjesdal IL Friidrettsbane 2027
location: Gjesdal IL Friidrettsbane, Ålgård, Gjesdal, Norway
description: TINEstafetten is a long-standing relay event for school teams, held in Ålgård at Gjesdal IL Athletics Track. This inclusive and fun relay brings students together for physical activity and team spirit. The event offers enjoyable experiences in a safe, social environment, with a focus on cooperation and the joy of sport.
course_highlights: Relay on an athletics track
Team competition for school students
Organized by Gjesdal IL
additional: Registration is completed by teams and classes managed through a profile on the website. Organizers can also register teams through the same system.

name: Stomperudkarusellen 2027. Bare løp 2 (Aasgaardrunden)
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a long-standing race series organised by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races over varying distances. Race 2, Aasgaardrunden, is 9 km, with a shorter option for the youngest participants. The races take place in beautiful surroundings around Sørum, with Race 2 starting from Stomperud Stadion. Participants use the same bib number for all the races in the series, creating continuity and a sense of community throughout the season.
course_highlights: Aasgaardrunden: 9 km with 600 metres of elevation gain
Short option for children and young people
Start and finish at Stomperud Stadion, Lørenfallet
additional: Participants use the same bib number for all the races in the series. Children who are members of Sørum IL can take part for free by registering using a separate form no later than one week before race day. The distance information is inconsistent: 6 km is listed under distances, while the race description describes a 12 km route.

name: Charity-Lauf des PSV Grün-Weiß Kassel e. V.
Vårruset (Halmstad)
location: Civila flygfältet vid Aleskogen, Halmstad, Sweden
organizer: Marathongruppen i samarbete med Halmstad OK och andra idrottsklubbar
description: Vårruset in Halmstad is a spring-inspired fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances in the scenic Alet Nature Reserve, at the Civil Airfield by Aleskogen. The event is open to everyone. The recommended minimum age is 7 for the shorter distance when accompanied by an adult, and 11 for the 5 km. Participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib, and can choose to have their time recorded on the 5 km course. Teams that register can enjoy a group picnic after finishing, making for a pleasant social occasion. Race bibs are distributed in advance at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden to help avoid queues on race day.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Alet Nature Reserve/Skepparegatan
Measured 5 km course
Event area at the Civil Airfield by Aleskogen
additional: Race bibs are distributed at Intersport Halmstad Flygstaden in the days before the race. Teams of 5 are offered a picnic after finishing. There is a water station and toilets at the event area. Participants are encouraged to change at home, as there are no changing facilities on site. Valuables can be handed in in an A4 envelope. Parking is available at Kattegattskolan and Skepparegatan, but environmentally friendly modes of transport are encouraged. Teams of five receive a picnic after finishing.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Maihaugenløpet
description: Maihaugenløpet is a long-standing race taking place for the 43rd time in 2027 at Maihaugen in Lillehammer. The race offers a beautiful 2.3 km course that starts outside Prestegården and finishes at Telthusplassen, with a route through historic surroundings and scenic natural areas. The event includes both a mass start and a virtual race option, and is suitable for the whole family. The atmosphere is always great, and the race is part of Sørdalskarusellen, which is known for being inclusive and family-friendly.
course_highlights: 2.3 km course starting outside Prestegården and finishing at Telthusplassen
The course passes historic buildings such as Garmo Stave Church and runs through the 20th-century collection
The course’s highest point is at Lundesetra, after 1.3 km
additional: The mass start has three waves, starting at 19:00 (men M12-35), 19:02 (men in other categories), and 19:04 (all women). Registration closes at 18:00 on race day. Race numbers can be collected from approximately 17:45 at Telthusplassen. Toilets are open by the gate below Garmokirka. The race is organized in collaboration with SI Aktiv Lillehammer (the hospital) and Litrim. It is possible to take part virtually from 3–6 May, with times recorded via Min Side and Self timing. The race sponsor is Andreassen Blomster, which also awards raffle prizes.

name: Hansastafetten
description: Hansastafetten is a traditional corporate sports event held in Bergen, starting at the Kokstad light rail stop by Aibel. The race consists of eight legs of varying lengths and terrain, including flat sections, rolling segments and climbs. Teams compete in men’s, women’s and mixed categories. The event concludes with an awards ceremony and social gathering in the canteen at Hansa. Race bibs are handed out from 17:00, and the race starts at 18:00.
course_highlights: Eight legs ranging in length from 210 m to 1,300 m
Terrain featuring flat sections, rolling segments and steep climbs
Start and finish at the Kokstad light rail stop by Aibel
additional: Race bibs are handed out from the Gneist trailer at the start/finish from 17:00. Parking is available in Hansa’s employee car park at Kokstad. Changing rooms and limited shower facilities are available at Hansa after the relay. The awards ceremony, food and drinks, and social gathering take place in the canteen at Hansa from 18:30 to 22:30. Only participants and team leaders may attend the awards ceremony. Mixed teams must have at least two women.

name: Lisia Dycha # 59
description: Lisia Dycha #59 is a 10 km race in Gdańsk. It is another edition of the Lisia Dycha series, intended for people who want to take on the ten-kilometre distance. The results of this edition were recorded online; 12 runners took part.
additional: The race results are available online.

name: Top Cross Torunia
description: Top Cross is a series of 12 cross-country races held in Rudelka Forest Park in Toruń. Each race consists of five laps plus a short run-in, for a total distance of approximately 6,666 metres. Participants earn points for taking part, and their eight best results count toward the overall standings. To receive a commemorative medal, participants must take part in at least eight races. It is also possible to complete a race individually without earning points.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Rudelka Forest Park
The course consists of five laps plus an approximately 200 m run-in
Course length: approximately 6,666 metres
additional: Registration takes place at V LO Toruń, at ul. Sienkiewicza / Fałata. The race office opens one hour before the race. Participants can complete a race individually without earning points. In the series, points are awarded for the eight best results out of 12 races. Points from individual races contribute to the overall standings, which are based on the eight best results. The commemorative medal is awarded for taking part in at least eight races.

name: 6. Pallas 67 Ultrameerdaagse
price_range: tot 450 euro voor 5 dagen, 35 euro voor eerste dag, 15 euro voor volgende dagen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Vooruitbetaling 35 euro voor de eerste dag

description: The Pallas '67 Ultrameerdaagse celebrates its fifth edition with a challenging multi-day ultrarun around Wageningen and Bennekom. The event consists of five days, with four routes of approximately 55 km and one route of over 70 km. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas such as the Veluwe, the Betuwe, the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and the mystical Prattenburgsebos. The base is the grounds of Hoekelum Castle, where luxury accommodation is available. The event starts on Wednesday morning, 13 May, at the Pallas '67 clubhouse in Wageningen, with the remaining starts at the castle grounds in Bennekom.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 55 km and one route of over 70 km
Natural areas: the Veluwe, the Betuwe, the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and the Prattenburgsebos
Start at the Pallas '67 clubhouse, with Hoekelum Castle as the base
additional: The base is Hoekelum Castle, with luxury accommodation at 'de Schuur' for 4 nights. Participants can also take part for one or more days. People from Wageningen can stay at home overnight. The total cost for 5 days, including 4 nights' accommodation, is expected to be no more than 450 euros. Routes through the Veluwe, the Betuwe, the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and the Prattenburgsebos; starts in Wageningen and Bennekom; 4 routes of approximately 55 km and 1 of over 70 km; 4 nights at Hoekelum Castle.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg
description: Vårruset in Vänersborg is a spring-inspired recreational race offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km along the Vassbottenleden, starting and finishing at Sanden. The race is open to everyone and welcomes both individual runners and teams of five. After the finish, teams are treated to a picnic, creating a wonderful sense of community and a springtime atmosphere. The event is family-friendly, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult. Timing is available for the 5 km course, but you can also choose not to be timed. Race bibs are distributed in advance to avoid queues on race day.
course_highlights: 2.5 km and 5 km distances along the Vassbottenleden
Start and finish at Sanden in Vänersborg
Measured 5 km course with timing
additional: Race bibs are distributed at Intersport Överby in Trollhättan in the days before the race. Teams that register receive a picnic after finishing, and the team leader’s race bib serves as the picnic voucher. The event area is easy to reach on foot, by bicycle, bus, or train. There is an option to leave warm-up clothes at the venue. Race details are emailed approximately two weeks before the event. Registration is binding and is open until one hour before the start. Teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing.

name: Bankvarvet
price_range: 125 kr för vuxna; gratis för barn och ungdomar upp till 16 år

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgift: 125 kr/vuxen Barn och ungdom upp till 16 år deltar gratis

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn och ungdom upp till 16 år deltar gratis

description: Bankvarvet is a popular fun run in Kullaparken, Kisa, focused on the joy of being active rather than on achieving a personal best or running the fastest lap. The race offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a 900-metre Minivarv for children born in 2016 or later. The event is a community celebration with entertainment, activities and food, perfect for families, groups of friends and companies looking to strengthen team spirit. Bankvarvet attracts many participants and is known for its warm and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
A 900-metre Minivarv for children
5 km and 10 km routes for adults and young people
additional: Kullaparken opens at 16:00, with activities such as basketball, football, table tennis and boules, as well as food and drinks. Bankvarvet is a popular company activity for strengthening team spirit. The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00, with the 5 km and 10 km races starting at 18:30.

name: Revetal Halvmaraton
description: Revetal Half Marathon is a race offering a fast, officially measured 21.1-kilometer half-marathon course that is almost completely flat, with only 24 meters of elevation gain. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners, with a focus on even pacing and negative splits. The start and finish are at Re-torvet, a short distance from changing facilities, parking, and refreshments, making for a compact and pleasant race experience. A 5 km race and a children’s race are also held, giving people of all ages and abilities the opportunity to participate.
course_highlights: An officially measured 21.1 km course that is almost completely flat
Two turnarounds, with a total of 24 meters of elevation gain
Start and finish at the same location, a short distance from facilities
additional: Bib distribution from 09:00 at Sport 1 Revetal and Re-torvet. Children’s race at 10:45, with free entry and a medal for everyone. Maximum of 600 places in total. Early registration is recommended to avoid stress. The course follows Bispeveien to Real Våle and back. Events include a half marathon, 5 km, and free children’s race. Pacers are available for the half marathon and 5 km. Stated capacity is 600 participants, with registration closing one hour before the start.

name: Tjomsevannet Rundt + Backyard 12 timers
description: Tjomsevannet Rundt is held annually on Ascension Day and is a popular race for all ages and ability levels, starting and finishing at Søgne Old Rectory. The event offers a friendly, social day with several distances, including a children’s race, a youth race and a 6.5 km fun run. New this year is registration via EQtiming.com with live timing. The popular Backyard 12-hour race is also back, with the option to run around Tjomsevannet for up to 12 hours. Group training sessions are held every Monday at Søgne Stadium for all ability levels.
course_highlights: Run around Tjomsevannet, starting and finishing at Søgne Old Rectory
Off-road races for children and youth over short distances
Backyard 12-hour race, with the option to run every hour for 12 hours
additional: Group training takes place every Monday at 18:00 at Søgne Stadium and is open to all ability levels. Registration for the children’s race, youth race and untimed race is available on-site on the day, with payment via Vipps. Start and finish at Søgne Old Rectory. Prices vary by race, and a licence fee may be added.

name: Ekebergstafetten og Ekebergløpet 2027
description: Ekebergløpet and Ekebergstafetten are an annual running celebration held at Ekebergsletta in Oslo, with a long tradition and an inclusive atmosphere for runners of all ages and levels. The event takes place on Ascension Day and offers several distances, including relays for children and youth, a children’s race, 5 km and 10 km. The event is more than just a race, with activities for children and young people, food and drinks from local vendors, as well as music and entertainment that create a great atmosphere. Bækkelagets Sportsklub is the organizer and welcomes everyone to a day filled with activity, achievement and joy.
course_highlights: Scenic surroundings around Ekebergsletta
Several distances: relays for children and youth, a children’s race, 5 km and 10 km
Recreational race with national age categories for adults
additional: Start times: 11:30 Children’s relay, 12:00 Youth relay, 14:00 Children’s race for ages up to 10, 15:00 5 km, 15:10 10 km. Previous editions have featured a children’s race of around 700 metres. Ekebergstafetten has been held as a mixed relay for 7–16-year-olds, with five legs.

name: Knartamarsjen
description: Knartamarsjen is a traditional walking event held annually at Furumoen Idrettsarena in Galterud, Sør-Odal. The event has a friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with prizes for children, first-time participants and long-time participants. It offers wonderful experiences in nature and a great opportunity to be active in a social setting. Welcome to an enjoyable day of walking and exercise in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Traditional walking event in scenic surroundings
Prizes for children, first-time participants and long-time participants
Held at Furumoen Idrettsarena in Galterud
additional: Registration takes place at Furumoen on the day of the walk. Gift prizes are drawn using the participants’ bib numbers. Prizes are also awarded for 5, 10, 15 years of participation, and so on. Registration takes place at Furumoen on the day of the walk. Children and first-time participants receive prizes, and gift prizes are drawn using the bib numbers. Prizes are also awarded for multiple years of participation.

name: Landsstafetten
location: Hov i Land, Søndre Land, Innlandet, Norway
description: The Landsstafetten is an athletics relay held in Hov i Land. The relay brings teams together to compete in various categories, and local teams have previously battled for victory and the perpetual trophy. The event has been part of the athletics community in Land for several years.

name: Storehaugen Opp
description: Storehaugen Opp is a traditional uphill race held in Lærdal, starting at the junction of Skulevegen and Sjukehusvegen. The route follows the old summer-farm road up to Hognåsen, a historic and scenic trail covering 3.7 km with an average gradient of nearly 25%. Along the way, there are several beautiful viewpoints over the fjord and mountains, as well as challenging steep sections leading to the summit at 908 metres above sea level. The race is known as one of the steepest uphill races of spring and attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: A 3.7 km route with an average gradient of nearly 25%
Beautiful viewpoints such as Harasiglet and Kattuglegalden, overlooking the fjord and mountains
The route follows an old summer-farm road with historic names and cultural heritage sites
additional: Registration is by printing and filling out a form, which participants bring on race day; payment is made at the secretary’s desk on arrival. There is a drinks station halfway along the route at Skirset. There is no water at the summit or along the route, so participants are encouraged to bring their own drinks. The route has several steep, rocky sections, especially the final 150 metres up the mountain pass. In 2026, the recreational class started between 09:30 and 12:00, while the competitive class had a mass start at 13:00. Registration and payment were on arrival; the competition entry fee could include an additional fee for a one-day licence. Dates and prices for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Fisterløpet
location: Fister skole og idrettsplass, Fister, Hjelmeland, Rogaland, Norway
description: Fisterløpet is held annually on Ascension Day and offers races for both recreational walkers and competitive runners in various age groups. The event includes recreational classes over 3 km and 8 km, as well as competitive classes for children, juniors, women, men, and relay teams. Participants in the recreational class can earn awards for taking part multiple times, and perpetual trophies are awarded for men, women, and older juniors. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with a kiosk and prize draws among all participants.
course_highlights: Recreational class for walkers of all ages, with 3 km or 8 km distances
Competitive classes with distances from 600 m to 7.5 km, including a 5×1.5 km relay
Perpetual trophies for men, women, and older juniors
additional: Registration gives access to both the recreational and competitive classes. The kiosk is open throughout the event, and cash is the only accepted payment method at the kiosk and for the entry fee. Awards and the prize draw take place after the race. Registration deadlines: 12:30 for the recreational class and 12:45 for the competitive class. There are separate recreational and competitive classes. The kiosk is open during the event; the organizer's information states that payment is by cash.

name: Kjoseløpet
description: Kjoseløpet is a popular, informal 6.5 km fun run through the beautiful countryside of Omsland in Kjose. The race is suitable for the whole family, with a separate 2 km children’s race held before the main race. The event is marked by a strong community volunteer effort and has received plenty of praise for both the course and the organisation. Kjoseløpet is traditionally held on Ascension Day, with participation increasing each year.
course_highlights: 6.5 km fun run through scenic surroundings in Omsland, Kjose
2 km children’s race before the main race
Family-friendly, informal event supported by a strong community volunteer effort
additional: The race is usually held on Ascension Day. A kiosk is open at Langevannstua before the race. The event includes a 2 km children’s race in addition to the 6.5 km main race. Historical race information describes the short course as suitable for children and families with strollers.

name: Lauf um den Allendorfer Bahnhof – Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup
Tinfosløpet
description: Tinfosløpet is an annual road race held in Notodden, Telemark. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, and attracts both sports clubs and corporate teams. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and inclusive environment, with prize draws for participating teams. The race is suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners looking for an enjoyable race in an urban setting.
course_highlights: Two courses: 5 km and 10 km
Road race in central Notodden
Prize draws for sports clubs and corporate teams
additional: Previous editions have been held on Friday evenings.

name: VR-Bank Abendlauf
location: Neuenkirchen bei Bramsche, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: Sangerhäuser Citylauf
distance_verbose: 12 km, 6 km, 3000 Meter, 1500 Meter, 1.2 km, 0.6 km

description: The 7th Szczecin Night Run is an exciting sporting event held at night on the streets of Szczecin. Participants can choose between 5- and 10-kilometre routes through the city centre. The event offers a unique atmosphere with striking light displays and numerous attractions in the race village. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal, and the course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA).
course_highlights: The course runs through the heart of Szczecin.
Course length: approximately 5 km (one loop) or 10 km (two loops).
The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA).
additional: The race pack includes a race number with a timing chip and 4 safety pins, a commemorative medal, photographers along the course, water at the refreshment point for the 10 km distance, and access to a baggage deposit. The race office is open on 7 May (14:00–20:00) at GALAXY Shopping and Entertainment Centre and on 8 May (16:00–23:00) at the Race Village on Jasne Błonia. The participant limit was 2,000. The 5 km and 10 km distances listed for the 2026 edition were certified by the PZLA.

name: Putten Power Run
description: The Putten Power Run is the annual running event that makes the vibrant heart of Putten beat. On the Friday after Ascension Day, the town centre turns into a sporting arena, with an atmospheric course through the centre and Putterbos. Participants can choose from various distances, from kids’ runs to a challenging 10 km, and enjoy a fun-filled day with music, food stalls and activities for the whole family. The event celebrates sporting spirit and togetherness, and supports local charities.
course_highlights: An atmospheric course through the town centre and Putterbos
Start and finish on the lively square in the heart of Putten
Water stations along the course and at the finish
additional: Race numbers are available for collection from 15:00 at the race office on Kerkplein. The IPICO timing tag must be attached to your shoelace and returned after the finish; otherwise, a €7.50 charge will apply. Free parking is available at the car park on Brinkstraat. Changing rooms with toilets are available, but there are no showers. Medical support is available along the course and at the finish. Enjoy a lively atmosphere with a DJ, food stalls, a business plaza and children’s activities. The event offers water stations, medical support and parking. Showers are not available in the changing rooms. Registration is available on the day at Kerkplein.

name: Gotaleden Stafett & Ultra
description: Gotaleden Relay & Ultra is a brand-new running and relay event. Four races are offered along the scenic Gotaleden trail between Gothenburg and Alingsås: individual distances (35 km and 75 km) and team relays (35/75 km), with legs ranging from approximately 4.5 to 12 km. The races feature varied terrain and beautiful scenery, and the finish in Nolhaga Park becomes a celebration with an awards ceremony, food trucks, showers and an After Run. The event welcomes everyone from recreational runners to experienced ultrarunners.
course_highlights: The course follows the Gotaleden trail between Gothenburg and Alingsås, through beautiful scenery and historic industrial environments
Varied terrain: trails, gravel and asphalt
The ultra has a significant total elevation gain (approx. 1,403 m) and reaches a high point of ~185 m above sea level
additional: Age limits: Relay (35/75) from age 14; Ultra 75 and Sprint 35 from age 17. Relay 75 consists of 9 legs (2–9 people per team), with legs of 4.5–12 km; Relay 35 has 4 legs (2–4 people). Ultra 75: 75 km, asphalt/gravel/trail terrain, 16 aid stations and a food station in Floda; Sprint 35: 35 km, 7 aid stations. Leg start points are located near public transport, and the organizer offers the option to book a bus to the start when registering. The finish in Nolhaga Park offers an awards ceremony, food, showers and an After Run. The races start in Gothenburg (Valhalla IP) and, for the sprint, in Floda (Garveriet), with different start points along the Gotaleden trail.

name: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun
description: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun is a trail race held in Gothenburg’s beautiful Änggårdsbergen nature reserve. The race offers two distances, 7.5 km and 12.5 km, where participants can experience technical trails, hilly terrain and magical viewpoints in the city’s wilderness. The course passes through varied environments such as Vitsippsdalen, Ljungheden and Västerberget, with coniferous forest, heaths and rocky outcrops. It’s an adventure for both beginners and experienced trail runners who want to enjoy nature and challenge themselves.
course_highlights: Technical trails and hilly terrain in Gothenburg’s nature reserve
Fantastic viewpoints overlooking the sea and central Gothenburg
The course passes through varied natural landscapes, including a wood anemone valley, heathland and coniferous forest
additional: Three start waves with friend seeding: the 12.5 km race starts at 11:00, 11:03 and 11:06. There is an aid station only on the 12.5 km course, after approximately 7.5 km. Start and finish at Karlsrofältet, near Linnéplatsen/Botanical Garden. Race bibs can be collected at the venue from 09:30 or at Icebug in Gothenburg. Spiked shoes are prohibited. Everyone who completes the race receives an exclusive wooden medal inspired by Ljungheden. Public transport is recommended; parking is limited. Children aged 8 and up can run with a parent or guardian. Choose between 7.5 and 12.5 km. The organizer recommends trail shoes with a sturdy sole; spiked shoes are not permitted. Public transport is recommended.

name: Koster Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kostnad för deltagande: 1 250kr inkl. moms. I deltagaravgiften ingår startplats, mat och en god öl/glas vin/alkoholfritt.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Platser utan mat och dryck kostar 950kr inkl. moms.

description: Koster Trail is a challenging trail race through Kosterhavet National Park on Nordkoster. The race features a technically demanding course of approximately 15 kilometres, with stones, cliffs and many beautiful viewpoints along the coastline. After finishing, participants can enjoy craft beer, homemade food and a refreshing dip in the sea. The race is organised by Kosterhavets Ekobod, with a focus on sustainability and care for nature.
course_highlights: Technically demanding course with stones and cliffs
Sections along the coastline and sandy beaches
Many magical viewpoints on Nordkoster
additional: Start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod near Västra Bryggan on Nordkoster. Two aid stations provide Koster water and U Sport sports drink from Umara. Race bibs can be collected on Friday from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 10:00. After the race, pizza from Artisan Bread Karlstad and fine beer from Qvänum Brewery will be served. Bag storage is available at the start/finish. There are no shower facilities at the finish. Participants are advised to have accident and liability insurance. Travel to Koster can be planned via Västtrafik. A cable ferry runs between Nordkoster and Sydkoster. In 2026, food and a drink of choice were included in the standard entry fee; an option without food and drink cost 950 kr. The race information states a maximum of 200 entries, two aid stations and an age limit of 18.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
description: Kolmårdstrailen is one of Sweden’s finest trail races, offering challenging, hilly courses in the scenic Kolmården terrain. Runners can choose between distances of 21 km, 11 km and 6 km, as well as a 500-metre children’s course for the youngest participants. The courses run through forests, over rocky outcrops and along hiking trails, with beautiful views and sections of technical terrain. The focus is on the experience, with a course that combines the beauty of nature with a physical challenge.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with rocky-outcrop running and forest trails
Passage through Rödgölen Nature Reserve, with soft singletrack
Views from Kolmården’s highest peak, 171 metres above sea level
additional: Race bib collection and late registration take place on race day between 9.00 and 11.00. Payment is by cash or Swish. All courses pass the race centre approximately 1 km before the finish, where the final kilometre is tough and partly off-trail through the forest. There are water stations along the course, including one at 7.5 km by the Scout Hut at Gransjön. Volunteers are needed for race bib collection, serving and water stations.

name: Hoby backyard Ultra 12H
description: The first edition of Hoby Backyard Ultra 12h! The course is 6,706 m, with approximately 50% trail/gravel road and 50% asphalt. 57 meters of elevation gain per lap.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Ölands Kyrkstafett is a classic long-distance relay, held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on Öland in spring. The start and finish are at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden. There are two options: a longer course with eleven legs and a shorter one with six, allowing both experienced runners and beginners to take part. Teammates and spectators cheer the participants on, while organisers Högby IF and Ölands idrottskrets provide the best possible service, with marshals, a race announcer and timing. The race starts at 10:00, with a group warm-up beforehand.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, 67.5 km in total, leg distances from 2.7 km to 8.5 km
Short course: 6 legs, 23.5 km in total, leg distances from 2.7 km to 5.4 km
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden, with spectators and teammates cheering runners on
additional: Race bib collection is on 8 May from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day, 9 May, from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing rooms and showers are available in the sports hall, 200 m north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio will lead a group warm-up before the start. Marshals are stationed along the course, at the changeovers, and at the start and finish. Individual leg times, split times and team finish times are provided. The long course has women’s and open categories, while the short course has an open category. Start at 10:00. Changing rooms and showers are available in the sports hall, about 200 metres north of Ölands Köpstad. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a barbecue meal voucher.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen är en återkommande löpartävling arrangerad av Hultsfreds Löparklubb. Tävlingen bjuder på en fin löpupplevelse i Hultsfred med en bana som går nära strandmiljöer. Det är en välkomnande tävling för löpare som vill utmana sig själva i en naturskön miljö. Resultat från tidigare år finns tillgängliga för att följa utvecklingen och prestationen.
course_highlights: Löpning nära strandmiljö
Naturskön bana i Hultsfred
Återkommande årlig tävling
additional: Startplatsen anges vid Folkparksvägen 3 i Hultsfred. Evenemanget är planerat till kl. 10.00 - 13.00.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://visithultsfred.se/evenemang/strandmilen/): 2027-05-08 — "Strandmilen — 8 maj, 2027 kl.10:00 - 13:00" (was estimated 2027-04-08)

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
organizer: Norrköpings Löparklubb i samarbete med IK Akele och Mjölby Cykelklubb
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a popular running event featuring six enjoyable kilometres through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course follows the Svartån and includes both challenging climbs and pleasant downhill stretches, with an almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also the approximately 3 km Kyrkundan and a children’s race, which is completely free thanks to Bostadsbolaget. All participants receive a medal after finishing. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Mjölby Stadspark
Course follows the Svartån and has a 99% asphalt surface
Challenging climbs and pleasant downhill stretches
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May from 12:00 to 18:00, with a 25% discount coupon, or on race day from 09:00 in Stadsparken. Fitness4You will lead a warm-up before the start. The children’s race has four starts, with timing in eight categories for children up to 12 years old. Companies can book a tent in Stadsparken for their team and promotional exposure.

name: SHE Silverlöpet
organizer: IFK Sala i samarbete med Sala-Heby Energi
description: SHE Silverlöpet is a revived running tradition in Sala, organized together with IFK Sala. The race offers a beautiful, officially measured 10 km course through central Sala, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. There are three categories: the children’s race, 5 km and 10 km. The event is a celebration for everyone, whether you run, walk or compete. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three women and men in the 10 km race, with prize draws for the 5 km race.
course_highlights: Officially measured and sanctioned 10 km course through central Sala
Start and finish in Stadsparken
Running through Sala’s beautiful surroundings
additional: Nordic Wellness leads a warm-up for all participants before each start. Start times are 9:30 for the children’s race, 10:00 for 5 km and 10:20 for 10 km. SHE customers get a 50 kr discount on the entry fee via the “Mitt SHE” mobile app or customer service. All participants receive a medal, and it’s a celebration for everyone, including those with a stroller or who prefer to walk. Categories are available for children, 5 km and 10 km. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men in the 10 km race; prizes are drawn for the 5 km race.

name: Vellinge Beer Run
description: Vellinge Beer Run är Vellinges första öllopp och erbjuder en social, rolig och avslappnad löpupplevelse där gemenskapen står i fokus. Loppet är ett festligt evenemang som avslutas med festligheter vid målgången. Det är en perfekt kombination av löpning och social samvaro för deltagare i alla åldrar och nivåer.
course_highlights: Loppet går i Vellinge med start och mål vid Vellinge Bryggeri
Social och avslappnad atmosfär med fokus på gemenskap
Festligheter och fest väntar i målområdet

name: Älmhult Fights Cancer
description: Älmhult Fights Cancer is a charity race that brings participants together in Älmhult to support the fight against cancer. The race offers several distances, with both runners and dogs welcome and special start times for dog owners. The event includes inspiring talks by prominent doctors and researchers, as well as a festive after-run at Grillen. It is a community where participants come together to support an important cause and enjoy a great running experience in Älmhult.
course_highlights: Choice of distances, with special start times for dogs in the 2.5 km and 5 km races
After-run party with a barbecue and music at Grillen after the race
Inspiring talks by experts from Lund University
additional: Online registration is open until 8 May at 20:00, with on-site late registration available from 08:00 on race day. No refunds for cancellations, as this is a charity race. Group registration is available. Dogs are welcome during special start times and must be kept on a leash. Älmhult Brukshundsklubb will be on site. The after-run party with a barbecue and music starts at 14:00 at Grillen. Accommodation and breakfast are available at IKEA Hotell during race weekend. Previous editions have offered on-site late registration subject to availability. Dog registration has cost 50 kr and included a scarf.

name: Sommarro Snabbare
description: Sommarro Snabbare is a unique running race held in the beautiful Sommarro cultural reserve in Örebro. The race involves running several laps of a 2.6 km course in a woodland park setting, with each lap to be run faster than the one before. It’s a challenge for everyone, focused on running farther and faster, with a clear time limit for each lap. Lilla Sommarro Snabbare also offers a child-friendly version where the youngest participants can run one untimed lap and feel like winners.
course_highlights: A 2.6 km course through hilly woodland park terrain, with gravel paths, fitness trails and a little off-road running
Start and finish on the lawn by Sommarro Värdshus
A timed challenge with progressively faster laps, focused on endurance and speed
additional: Lilla Sommarro Snabbare is for children born in 2014 or later. The children run one untimed lap and receive a medal at the finish.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race with six legs that starts and finishes in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The course is flat and easy to run, with a varied mix of gravel and asphalt, making it suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. The focus is on community and the joy of running, with prizes for the top three finishers in each category and prize draws. A Mini Race is also held for children, featuring a fun course of approximately 650 metres. All participants receive a medal and a diploma.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Six relay legs, with exchanges at the portal
Water station at the start/finish and after approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Timing is done using data chips, and both total time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. There is a group warm-up before the start. The children’s Mini Race starts below Bruksparken, with a group warm-up at 10:20. After finishing the Mini Race, all children receive a medal, diploma, drink and fruit. Late registration for the Mini Race is available on site between 09:00 and 10:00. Proceeds go to Rotary’s international relief work and Ryssberget IK’s activities.

name: Lundaloppet
description: Lundaloppet is a popular fun run in central Lund, offering several distances for all ages and levels, including 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the children’s Little Lundaloppet. The race is a festive run through the city’s parks and city centre, with a welcoming atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners. The event has a long tradition and finishes inside Centrala Idrottsplatsen, where participants can enjoy food and drinks from food trucks. Lundaloppet is a community celebration that brings runners and spectators together in a friendly, energetic atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km of running enjoyment through springtime Lund
5 km route through parks and the city centre
Child-friendly Little Lundaloppet, approximately 500 metres around Centrala Idrottsplatsen
additional: Bib collection takes place at IFK-hallen at Centrala Idrottsplatsen on the day before and on race day. The warm-up takes place at the start on Svanevägen, led by a running coach on raised platforms. Timing is done with a chip on the bib, and the finish is filmed. The official T-shirt can be purchased when registering or at the event. Meal packages and food trucks are available after the finish. It is also possible to add training sessions with a running coach before the race. The official information lists water stations at 5, 10 and 15 km; the 2.5 km course has no water station.

name: Sunnhordland løpsfest
description: Sunnhordland Running Festival takes place in the centre of Leirvik on Stord and offers a wide range of distances for all runners, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, a children’s race and a Super Race for people with disabilities. The event is a community celebration that brings together runners of all ages and abilities for a day of running and camaraderie. The race starts on Borggata and is organised by Stord Athletics, which welcomes everyone to a great running experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Run in the centre of Leirvik, with the start on Borggata
A great choice of distances from 5 km to half marathon
An adapted Super Race for people with disabilities
additional: The children’s race is approximately 450 metres. Registration for the standard distances and the Super Race is via EQ Timing; the children’s race has its own registration form.

name: Vitusapotek Holmenkollstafetten 2027

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2
