description: Vitusapotek Holmenkollstafetten is the world’s largest relay race and Norway’s largest sporting event, with 15 stages and around 75,000 participants. The race runs through Oslo’s streets over varied terrain, including hilly sections and steep climbs, offering a unique relay experience for companies, associations and groups of friends. The event has a long tradition and attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes, with a great atmosphere and broad participation. Holmenkollstafetten is one of spring’s most beautiful adventures, bringing people together through the joy of running and a sense of community.
course_highlights: 15 stages of varying lengths, from 350 m to 2,860 m
Hilly terrain with steep climbs and descents
Starts at Knud Knudsens plass and finishes at Bislett Stadium
additional: The race has 15 stages, ranging from 350 m to 2,860 m, starting at Knud Knudsens plass and finishing at Bislett Stadium. The stages have varied profiles, with hilly sections, steep climbs and descents. Teams in classes A1 and A2 can be seeded based on their 2026 results if they register by 1 April. All teams are insured through the Norwegian Athletics Federation. No refunds are available for withdrawals after 1 March 2027. The race is broadcast on NRK1 from 12:15 on race day.

name: Skogvokteren Ultra
description: Skogvokteren Ultra is a demanding 88 km trail ultramarathon with 3,500 metres of elevation gain, passing through varied forest areas in Grenland. The race starts and finishes at the steps of Porsgrunn City Hall and offers a mix of trails, gravel roads and asphalt in scenic, hilly terrain. The event has an accessible, authentic profile, with a focus on personal achievement and the joy of trail running. A six-stage relay is also held, offering teams and companies a great opportunity to take part together. The race includes electronic timing, tracking via intermediate timing points, five aid stations and a Skogvokteren medal.
course_highlights: 88 km with 3,500 metres of elevation gain across varied terrain
80% trail and 20% gravel/asphalt through three municipalities and two cities
The course links Grenland’s two largest cities in a green, winding loop
additional: The race has electronic timing and tracking via approximately 15 intermediate timing points. There are five aid stations along the route. Mandatory equipment includes a GPS device with the route loaded, hydration containers holding at least 1.5 litres, a wool or technical base layer, a reflective vest for running in the dark, a phone with the race director’s number saved, first-aid supplies and an emergency blanket. Accommodation is available with a 20% discount at Comfort Hotel Porsgrunn when booked before 9 April 2027. A pasta party will be held on Friday 7 May from 17:00 to 19:00, alongside race-number collection. The relay class has six stages with handovers in marked areas, and the baton is a timing chip passed between runners. Start at 05:00 from the steps of Porsgrunn City Hall. The course is not marked and must be followed using GPX; there are five aid stations. Mandatory equipment and an age limit of 18 apply. The relay has 25 team places.

name: Fløyen - Knarvik
location: Fløyen, Bergen to AMFI Knarvik, Knarvik, Norway
description: Fløyen-Knarvik is a hiking and running event of approximately 26 km, starting at Fløyen in Bergen and finishing at AMFI Knarvik. The route follows much of the old postal road and crosses the Nordhordland Bridge, Flatøy and the Hagelsund Bridge. There is also a shorter starting option from IKEA in Åsane, covering approximately 13 km. The event is suitable both for families looking for a scenic outing and for runners seeking a challenging distance, with timing and prizes for the top finishers. The route is approximately 50% asphalt, 30% gravel and 20% trail, with a total elevation gain of 800 metres from Fløyen.
course_highlights: The route follows the old postal road and crosses the Nordhordland Bridge, Flatøy and the Hagelsund Bridge
Approximately 26 km with 800 metres of total elevation gain from Fløyen
Varied terrain: asphalt, gravel and trail
additional: The Fløibanen funicular ride up to Fløyen is included in the registration fee. It is not possible to register on the day at the start. The running class starts at 11:00 from Fløyen with a mass start, and at 11:30 from IKEA Åsane. Free buses from Knarvik bus station to Bergen depart at 08:20 and 09:30. Return by regular scheduled bus from AMFI Knarvik. The route is staffed by course marshals and has Red Cross stations. Water and bananas are available at aid stations along the way. The finish area at AMFI Knarvik offers baguettes, bananas, water and coffee. Toilets are available at the start, IKEA Åsane and the finish area. Race numbers can be collected at the lower Fløibanen station or IKEA Åsane before the start. The route is marked with kilometre markers, arrows and tape. Good running shoes that have been worn a few times and weather-appropriate clothing are recommended. The Fløibanen ride up to Fløyen is included in the registration fee. The Fløyen route is approximately 50% asphalt, 30% gravel and 20% trail. It is not possible to register on the day at the start.

name: CC-løpet Hamar 2027
description: The CC-løpet Hamar is organized by Ottestad Idrettslag and is part of the HA Ottestad running festival. The race offers wonderful nature experiences along Ottestadstien, a beautiful hiking trail that winds through a cultural landscape of woodland, fields and views of Mjøsa. The event starts and finishes at Ottestad Idrettspark, which has excellent facilities including a café, refreshments, changing rooms and showers. The race is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners of all ages.
course_highlights: The race follows Ottestadstien, a scenic hiking trail through a cultural landscape
Fantastic views of Mjøsa along the way
Start and finish at Ottestad Idrettspark, with excellent facilities
additional: The race follows a hiking trail with varied terrain, including woodland, fields and beautiful views of Mjøsa. Children’s races are also held over several distances.

name: Fløyen - Knarvik
description: Fløyen-Knarvik is a hiking and running event covering approximately 26 km, from Fløyen in Bergen to AMFI Knarvik. The route follows the old post road and includes crossings over the Nordhordland Bridge, Flatøy and the Hagelsund Bridge. There is also a shorter starting option from IKEA in Åsane, covering approximately 13 km. The event is suitable both for families looking for a hike and for runners seeking a challenging race experience with timing and prizes. Free buses are available from Knarvik to Bergen, and the Fløibanen funicular ride up to Fløyen is included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Approximately 26 km with 800 m of total elevation gain
The route follows the old post road and crosses the Nordhordland Bridge, Flatøy and the Hagelsund Bridge
The surface is approximately 50% asphalt, 30% gravel and 20% trail
additional: Times are recorded, and prizes are awarded to the top 3 women and men in the running category. Race numbers can be collected at the lower Fløibanen station and at IKEA Åsane. Free buses from Knarvik to Bergen depart at 08:20 and 09:30. Return travel is by regular bus from AMFI Knarvik. The route is well marked with kilometre markers, arrows, and red and white tape. Water and bananas are available at refreshment stations along the route and at the finish. Toilets are available at the start, at IKEA Åsane and at AMFI Knarvik. Course marshals and Red Cross stations are located along the route. We recommend wearing running shoes that have been worn a few times and dressing for the weather, with layers that can be taken off or put on along the way. The main course has approximately 800 metres of elevation gain and is about 50% asphalt, 30% gravel and 20% trail. The entry fee for the Fløyen start includes a ride on the Fløibanen funicular. There are six food and drink stations along the route, and free buses from Knarvik to Bergen.

name: Mistberget Ultra
description: Mistberget Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon held in Eidsvoll, Akershus. The race offers a spectacular experience in nature, with demanding terrain and beautiful views of the area. It is suited to experienced ultrarunners looking for a challenging and scenic race in May.
course_highlights: Challenging terrain in mountainous areas
Spectacular views of Mistberget and the surrounding area
Scenic course in Eidsvoll, Akershus

name: CC-Løpet Gjøvik
description: CC-Løpet Gjøvik is a fun run for everyone, whether you want to run or walk, with or without timing. Previous editions have featured a 3 km course along Lake Mjøsa, with the start and finish in Gjøvik. Join an inclusive race open to both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: 3 km course
Route along Lake Mjøsa
Open to both runners and walkers
additional: Previous editions have offered participation with and without timing.

name: Hörster Waldlauf im Naturpark Teutoburger Wald
Niedermeiserer Dorflauf
distance_verbose: 18 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.4 km

name: Blue Power Run
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organised for people on the autism spectrum, their families and friends. The event aims to support social inclusion through a shared sporting event, raise awareness of autism and enable everyone to participate on equal terms. The race takes place on a paved path by Arkonka Swimming Complex in Szczecin. It is an opportunity to have fun and connect, with additional activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers. Finishing position is not what matters; the satisfaction of taking part and overcoming your own challenges is.
course_highlights: The race route follows a paved path by Arkonka Swimming Complex.
The start and race office are located by the Szyszka restaurant.
After the race, therapists and volunteers will coordinate activities for everyone to enjoy together.
additional: The event is limited to 300 participants. Race packs can be collected from the race office the day before the race and on event day. The start schedule includes races for different age groups, from 0 to 118 years old, with distances from 200 to 600 metres. After the races, activities for everyone to enjoy together will be coordinated by therapists and volunteers.

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: The Red Nordic Walking Route in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie is a scenic and challenging 8.2 km route and the first stop of the 14th edition of the Nordic Walking Grand Prix. Participants can compete and visit local attractions, such as the communal feast table, the largest wooden shoe, and the snuffbox. The event takes place in the municipality of Nowa Wieś Lęborska, which offers certified Nordic walking routes for pre-race training. The event starts on May 9 at 11:00.
course_highlights: Red route, 8.2 km long
Scenic but challenging terrain with plenty of sporting challenges
Local attractions: the communal feast table, the largest wooden shoe, and the snuffbox
additional: The event in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie opens the Nordic Walking Grand Prix series. Participants are encouraged to use the certified Nordic walking routes in the municipality of Nowa Wieś Lęborska.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: Płużnicka Piątka is an annual 5-kilometer race held in the picturesque village of Płużnica. The course runs through the village center and features varied surfaces, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. The event attracts participants of all ages and also offers races for children. The atmosphere is friendly and full of positive energy, and the organization is highly regarded by participants.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the center of Płużnica
Surface: 71% asphalt, 23% dirt road, 6% cobblestones
A scenic, varied course that appeals to runners of different abilities
additional: Schedule: 10:40 official opening, 10:50 warm-up, 10:55 lining up at the start, 11:00 race start, 11:50 children's races, 12:15 awards ceremony, 12:45 official closing. The course starts and finishes in the village center.

name: Bieg Borków
description: Bieg Borków is an annual running event held in the scenic Spa Park in Połczyn-Zdrój. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering an appealing course surrounded by greenery and a spa-town atmosphere. The race is scheduled to start at 13:00, and participants can expect professional organization and the opportunity to discover the charms of the region. Registration and the rules are available on the race’s dedicated website, making it easier to prepare for the start.
course_highlights: The course runs through Spa Park in Połczyn-Zdrój
Scenic surroundings in a spa park
A course map file is available to download
additional: Registration and the race rules are available at biegnijmy.pl. The race course is available to download in JPG format. Public toilets in Spa Park are open 24 hours a day, cost 2 zł, and have facilities for people with disabilities. Information about registration, the rules, and the course for the 2026 edition is available at biegnijmy.pl.

name: Pazur Gryfa
organizer: Słupskie Towarzystwo Osób Pozytywnie Aktywnych STOPA Słupsk
description: The Pazur Gryfa Orienteering Rally is a sports and tourism event held in the Słupsk region, known for its vast forests, hills, valleys, and rich flora and fauna. The route passes through scenic areas full of natural obstacles and historic landmarks, offering participants a unique orienteering experience. The event brings people together and attracts both beginners and experienced competitors. The organizers ensure that the routes are professionally prepared and that participants are safe.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the vast forests, hills, and valleys of the Słupsk region
Rich flora and fauna, along with numerous natural obstacles
Historic landmarks along the rally route
additional: The rally takes place at the Culture and Recreation Park and the Kayak Marina in Słupsk. The organizers professionally prepare the cycling and walking routes. The event is a sports and tourism rally with orienteering elements.

name: Silgan Ćwierćmaraton
location: SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A., ul. Rokicka 13, Tczew, Poland
description: The Silgan Quarter Marathon is a 10.54 km race held in Tczew County. The start and finish are located at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. in Tczew. The route passes through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny and has a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic, and the route is marked every kilometre. The event is small-scale, with a limit of 200 paid participants.
course_highlights: A 10.54 km route through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny
Mixed asphalt and gravel surfaces
The route is marked with road markings every 1 km
additional: The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. The number of participants is limited to 200 paid entrants. The start and finish are at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. The race route runs with restricted vehicle traffic. Information about the route and organization is confirmed by the 2025 and 2026 editions; details of the 2027 edition were not available in the sources.

name: KaaienLoop
location: Stadspark en centrum van Oosterhout, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Kaaienloop is a lively running event in Oosterhout, starting and finishing at the Heuvel. The 24th edition takes place on Saturday, 8 May 2027, and offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the 550-metre Bambino Run to the challenging 10 kilometres through the city park and town centre. The varied routes are accompanied by live music from bands along the course, creating a festive atmosphere. The Kaaienloop is open to all ages and ability levels, with chip timing and a strong focus on sociability and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: Course through the city park and the atmospheric centre of Oosterhout
Live music from various bands along the course
A range of distances, including a dedicated course for the Bambino Run in the city park
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day from 15:30 until 15 minutes before the start at the stand in front of Heuvel 7. The Bambino Run is 550 metres through the city park and can be run with a parent accompanying the child. The 5 km consists of 2 laps of 2.5 km, and the 10 km consists of 4 laps of 2.5 km. Timing is recorded via a chip in the race number and start and finish mats. Results will be published on uitslagen.nl. Participants can register for various distances, and the event also includes youth and company races. Photos and results from previous editions are available online.

name: Run van Gieten
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5.3 km, 2.05 km, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km
description: The Run van Gieten is a running and walking event held on the Hondsrug in Drenthe. The 19th edition takes place on Saturday, 8 May 2027, and offers a wide range of distances, from 250 metres for the youngest participants to a half marathon. The event includes various races, such as the Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe 10-kilometre race, the Magnesium half marathon and the Magnesium 5.3-kilometre race. There are also youth and wheelchair runs, walking tours and special races for children. Everyone is warmly welcome to join this sporty day full of challenge and fun.
course_highlights: Running and walking event on the Hondsrug in Drenthe
Distances ranging from 250 metres to a half marathon
Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe 10-kilometre race with chip timing
additional: Participants in the 10-kilometre race can use the changing and shower facilities at De Goorns sports hall. Valuables can be handed in at the Impuls office on Brink. There are plenty of parking spaces nearby. All participants run with a Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe chip. Cash prizes are awarded to the fastest men and women in various age categories, with an additional bonus for breaking the course record. Registration is via QR code and includes the youth and school championships, walks and special runs.

name: SilvercityRUN
description: SilvercityRUN is an annual running event in Schoonhoven, known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting challenge. The race passes through the historic streets of the Silver City and attracts both recreational runners and dedicated athletes. With 5- and 10-kilometer distances and a special Kidsrun, there is a suitable race for everyone. The event is marked by a festive atmosphere, with music and enthusiastic supporters along the course.
course_highlights: Historic streets of Schoonhoven
5- and 10-kilometer distances
Friendly, festive atmosphere with music
additional: SilvercityRUN 2026 sold out, with 1000 participants. A special training group and a running shirt are available. Each year, an amount is raised for the charity 'Het Huis van Noord'. The annual race celebrated its anniversary edition in 2026 and featured various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a kids’ run, with many volunteers and a lively atmosphere.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, Bygdøyrunden

description: Bygdøyrunden is one of eight races in Oslo Running Festival, which follows the capital’s lovely trails and beautiful roads. The race has a mass start on Sunday, May 9 at 11:00 from Frognerkilen skatepark in Oslo. Participants can run solo or as part of a team, and can take part in several races to earn an overall medal. The course is marked only during the mass start, and timing is recorded by a chip on the race bib.
course_highlights: The race follows lovely trails and beautiful roads in Oslo
Mass start on Sunday, May 9 at 11:00
The course is marked only during the mass start
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Löplabbet Oslo sentrum at Pilestredet 7 from April 7. Timing is recorded by a chip on the race bib, and participants must pass within five metres of the sensors. Participants can run solo (SOLO) or in teams (DUO, TRIO), with women’s, men’s and mixed categories. Participants who take part in at least five races can compete in the overall series. Start and finish at Frognerkilen skatepark. The race can be completed between April 30 and May 9, 2027; the mass start is on Sunday, May 9 at 11:00. SOLO, DUO and TRIO tickets are available, and the festival pass covers all eight races.

name: Strailøpet
description: Strailøpet is an inclusive spring trail race on the lit trails at Strai, Torridal, Kristiansand, organized by Torridal IL and secondary school students. The race offers four distances: a children’s race, 5 km, 10 km trail, and half marathon, all starting and finishing in the same area at Storemyråsen. The event combines competition with socializing, offers timing for those who want it, and also allows participants to walk in the recreational class. Proceeds go toward the students’ class trip and the Norwegian Cancer Society, and the whole village pitches in to create an enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 22.2 km with 474 metres of elevation gain, consisting of one 5 km loop and two 10 km loops
5 km and 10 km trail courses on the lit trails at Strai
Children’s race of approximately 1 km, untimed, with a medal and ice cream at the finish
additional: All distances start and finish at Storemyråsen, allowing family and supporters to follow runners across the different distances. The start order is half marathon first, followed by the children’s race, 10 km, and 5 km. There is a group warm-up and an announcer before each start. Race bibs and timing chips are collected on race day in the start and finish area. The children’s race is untimed, but all children receive a medal and ice cream at the finish. NOK 20 of each participant’s entry fee goes to the Norwegian Cancer Society. It is possible to participate in the recreational class without being ranked. The race is organized by volunteers, with support from parents, young people, and sponsors.

name: Krystallmarsjen
description: Krystallmarsjen is a long-standing spring event organised by Magnor UL cross-country skiing, with the start and finish at Magnor Glassverk. The race offers several distances to suit active skiers, joggers and recreational participants, including an 8.5 km timed course, a 5 km course with and without timing, and a 2.5 km junior walk for children. Prizes are awarded in several classes, all participants receive a prize, and there are intermediate sprint prizes, with a perpetual trophy for the best woman and man. The course includes a section over the roof of The Plus, offering a unique experience. Krystallmarsjen has been held since 1982 and is a popular event in Magnor.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Magnor Glassverk
The course goes over the roof of The Plus
Several distances: 8.5 km, 5 km with and without timing, and a 2.5 km junior walk
additional: Prizes are awarded to 50% of participants in each class in the timed 8.5 km and 5 km races. All participants receive a prize. The junior walk has its own prize for everyone who finishes. Registration is via EQTiming. The registration deadline is the day before the race.

name: Ilsengløpet 2027
description: Ilsengløpet is held at Ilseng sports ground and offers running through forests and cultural landscapes around Ilseng. You can choose between 5 and 10 kilometres. The race takes place in the beautiful area around the Ilsengstiene trails, which were named Norway’s best hiking route in 2019.
course_highlights: Trail running through forests and cultural landscapes
Course in the area around the Ilsengstiene trails
Choose between 5 and 10 kilometres
additional: Registration for 2027 opens in January 2027.

name: GVG Volkslauf Rund um den Otto-Maigler-See
Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race that takes place simultaneously around the world. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the runners and gradually increases its speed until it catches the last participant. In Gdańsk Południe, the race will start at 13:00 near the Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie finish area. The course is a loop of approximately 3 km on a paved surface, with a slight uphill on the connector path. All entry fees support spinal cord research.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: Wings for Life World Run is a global race held simultaneously around the world. Participants start with the mobile app and run from the virtual Catcher Car. The race is unique because 100% of entry fees and donations go toward research into treatments for spinal cord injuries. The event is open to everyone, wherever they are, and promotes community and support for people with mobility impairments. The race is scheduled to start on May 9, 2027, at 11:00 local time.
course_highlights: Run with the Wings for Life World Run app—start anywhere in the world
Run from the virtual Catcher Car
Run, use a wheelchair, or walk together—also for those who cannot run
additional: 100% of entry fees go toward spinal cord research. Take part using the mobile app, which tracks distance and simulates the Catcher Car chase. An event-related running apparel collection is available.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz, with an emphasis on the visual appeal of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during a spring race.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz
Routes with visual appeal and a natural character
Organized with passion and experience since 2014

name: 41 Półmaraton Solan im. Romana Terlikowskiego
description: The 41st Solan Half Marathon in memory of Roman Terlikowski is an annual running event held in Nowa Sól. The half-marathon course consists of two loops through the city streets, with the start and finish located on al. Wolności next to Park Krasnala. Participants can expect professional race organization, including race-pack collection, bag drop, showers, and post-race catering. The event also features races for children, numerous attractions, and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A circular course consisting of two loops through the streets of Nowa Sól
Start and finish on al. Wolności next to Park Krasnala
The route passes along Portowa, Korzeniowskiego, Żwirki i Wigury, Bohaterów Getta, and other streets
additional: Race packs can be collected on 9 May (13:00–16:00) and 10 May (7:30–9:15). Free parking, changing rooms, a bag drop, and showers are available near the start/finish. After the race, participants receive a recovery meal and drinks using vouchers included in their race packs. The program also includes the 25th Mini Solan Run for children, an awards ceremony, and a prize draw.

name: Wings for life world run App
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique race in which all participants start simultaneously around the world. The goal is to cover as much distance as possible before being caught by the virtual Catcher Car. The race takes place via a mobile app, allowing participants to join from anywhere, including Mądrzechowo. All entry fees go toward research into spinal cord injuries, and the race atmosphere is enhanced by a unique audio experience and motivational messages. It’s a race for everyone—from beginners to experienced runners, wheelchair users, and walkers.
course_highlights: A race with no traditional finish line—the virtual Catcher Car determines when you finish
Join from anywhere in the world using the mobile app
A unique audio experience to keep you motivated during the race
additional: The 2027 race is scheduled to start at 11:00 UTC. Participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually catches up with them. Participants can use the mobile app to connect with other runners around the world and receive motivational messages as part of a unique audio experience.

name: XXXIII Biegi Żnińskie
description: The 33rd Żnińskie Runs is an annual running event held in Żnin, scheduled for May 10, 2026. The event includes road races over 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are located at Freedom Square. The 10 km race counts toward the Pałuki Grand Prix. Participants receive a race pack containing a commemorative medal from the “Great People of Żnin” series, a recovery meal, and souvenirs from Pałuki. The race office is open on race day from 9:00 to 11:45 at Primary School No. 1 in Żnin.

name: II Bieg Europejski Puck - Prolog
description: Energa II European Run Puck is an original sporting event organized by STONE TRI & RUN, bringing runners together to celebrate Europe Day. The event takes place at the Old Market Square in Puck and offers a range of distances, including a certified 10 km main race and a shorter 1,348 m Prologue. The event has a unique atmosphere and is supported by ambassador Jerzy Kowol, a legend of Polish long-distance running. In addition to adult races, children’s races and a Nordic walking event are also held.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km main race
1,348 m Prologue
The routes pass through the Old Market Square in Puck
additional: The event programme includes race-pack collection at Stary Rynek 2 at two times (15:00–20:00 and 7:00–9:00), bag drop in the Expo Zone tent, race and walk starts between 10:00 and 11:40, and the awards ceremony and event summary at 12:00. The event also includes children’s races in two age categories: Mini Kids Run (ages 3–7) and Mega Kids Run (ages 8–15). The distance and location information comes from the 2026 edition.

name: Poligon na Start
location: Żółta Trybuna, Pas Ćwiczeń Taktycznych Bucierz, Centrum Szkolenia Bojowego Drawsko, Drawsko Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 3rd Charity Poligon na Start Run takes place at the Drawsko Combat Training Centre, under the honorary patronage of the Centre’s Commandant. The event is charitable, and proceeds from entry fees and the public collection will go towards supporting a child’s medical treatment. The event also features accompanying demonstrations and performances. Four distances are available, suited to runners of different ability levels.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Drawsko training ground at the Drawsko Combat Training Centre
Four distances: 42 km, 21 km, 13 km and 7 km
Accompanying events include demonstrations and performances organised by the Drawsko Combat Training Centre and the Drawsko Pomorskie Cultural Centre
additional: The participant limit is 200. Payment must be made online via the Przelewy24 platform: click the link next to your name on the start list and enter the participant’s details. The start schedule includes four race waves from 9:30 to 13:30, with the awards ceremony at 15:00. The 2026 edition had a limit of 200 participants and was a charity event. The previously stated fees apply only to the 2026 edition.

name: Dikke Tien Runn

description: De Dikke Tien Runn is a running event held in the beautiful natural area of Middag Humsterland, starting and finishing at the sports park on Valgeweg in Feerwerd. The run is a spin-off of Sportpark De Dikke Tien, an initiative by local residents to make exercise fun, sociable and healthy. There are three routes: 10 kilometres, 5 kilometres and a special 1-kilometre kids’ run. The organisers work with Univé Verzekeringen and support the UMCG Beatrix Children’s Hospital with part of the entry fees.
course_highlights: Run through the natural area of Middag Humsterland
Start and finish at Sportpark De Dikke Tien on Valgeweg
Three routes: 10 km, 5 km and a 1 km kids’ run
additional: €2.50 from each ticket sold goes to the UMCG Beatrix Children’s Hospital. The run is an initiative of local village associations and residents of Feerwerd and surrounding villages. Routes of 1 km, 5 km and 10 km; start and finish at the Valgeweg sports park; support for the UMCG Beatrix Children’s Hospital.

name: Leiden Marathon
description: The Leiden Marathon is an atmospheric running event held in the historic city centre of Leiden and the surrounding area. The course passes the beautiful canals, cheering crowds, and the green polders and villages around the city. The start is on Koninginnelaan, and the finish is beneath the iconic finish arch at Vismarkt. Marathon weekend offers several distances, including 42 km, 21 km, 10 km, and a 5 km Nightrun, and is an experience for both runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Start on Koninginnelaan
Finish beneath the finish arch at Vismarkt
Course through the historic city centre, along the canals, and across green polders
additional: The 10 km, 21 km, and 42 km walking distances start on Saturday. The 5 km Nightrun takes place on Saturday evening. The 10 km, 21 km, and 42 km running distances start on Sunday. Race numbers can be collected on Saturday and Sunday at Johnson & Johnson Park (Garenmarktplein). There is a supervised bag drop and a tent village with a help desk. The finish is a festive place, with large crowds along the course. Registration opens on 1 October 2023; the event includes several distances and activities, with the start and finish at Garenmarktplein and Johnson & Johnson Park.

name: Rondehoeploop
location: Ouderkerk aan de Amstel, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Rondehoeploop is a friendly and popular running race in Ouderkerk aan de Amstel, celebrating its 40th anniversary edition in 2027. The race offers challenging courses of 17.2 km and 5 km, plus a 2 km children’s race, with a welcoming start and finish at De Bindelwijk sports hall. The event attracts many participants and spectators each year, thanks in part to the enthusiastic volunteers and the crowds along the course. Every participant receives a medal, and various prizes are awarded across different age categories.
course_highlights: 17.2 km Rondehoeploop course with challenging wind conditions
2 km children’s race, with a dedicated training schedule available
Start and finish at De Bindelwijk sports hall in Ouderkerk aan de Amstel
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day from 9:30 to 11:00 at De Bindelwijk sports hall. Same-day registration is no longer available for the running distances; it is available only for walking and the children’s race. Timing uses the MYLAPS Bibtag system, with the chip incorporated into the race number. Net time is recorded. The starting gun for the children’s race goes off at 11:42. All participants receive a medal, and various prizes and trophies are awarded across different age categories. The fastest Ouderkerkers receive a dinner/lunch voucher, and a perpetual trophy after three consecutive wins. Anniversary edition; advance registration required; includes route directions and refreshment stations along the course.

name: Schagen City Run
location: Het centrum van Schagen, Schagen, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Schagen City Run is an annual running event in the centre of Schagen, with the start and finish at the Markt. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a Business Run and a Kids Run, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. The City Run is inclusive and accessible to athletes using handbikes or blades. Participants can collect their race numbers in advance at Sport2000 Sportshop Bouwes or on race day at Hotel Marktstad.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Markt in the centre of Schagen
Several distances: 5 km, 10 km, Business Run and Kids Run
Inclusive of athletes using handbikes and blades
additional: Race numbers can be collected in the week before the race at Sport2000 Sportshop Bouwes in Schagen. On race day, race numbers can also be collected at Hotel Marktstad. Participation with handbikes and blades is possible. A voluntary donation is requested for Stichting ALS, the event’s chosen charity. The race takes place on 9 May 2027 in the centre of Schagen. In addition to the main distances, there are other activities and a great atmosphere focused on inclusion and sportsmanship.

name: Kastelenloop
location: Diepenheim, Hof van Twente, Overijssel, Netherlands

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset in Växjö is a popular spring running event offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö, with the start and finish at Strandbjörket. The event is open to everyone and offers both individual and team registration. Teams consist of five people and receive a shared picnic after finishing. The event has a wonderful spring atmosphere, with a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and prizes for participants. It is a fun run with timing on the 5 km course, but participants can choose to run without timing if they wish. Vårruset is organized by IFK Växjö in collaboration with Marathongruppen and several athletics clubs.
course_highlights: The course goes around Lake Växjö through beautiful natural surroundings
Start and finish at Strandbjörket, near Strandbjörkshallen
A water station and toilets are available at the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in Växjö a few days before the event. Team leaders receive a picnic voucher on their race bib to collect the picnic after the event. The event area opens at 17:00 with a sponsor village, and light refreshments are served. Participants are encouraged to arrive dressed for the race and to travel to the event area in an environmentally friendly way. The race bib must be clearly visible throughout the race. Participants can run, jog or walk. Individual registration includes a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and race bib; team registration also includes a picnic. Timing is available for the 5 km distance and can be opted out of. Published local information applies to the 2026 event.

name: Blodomloppet (Uddevalla)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 2000kr fr.o.m. 28 april fram till och med 4:e maj

description: Blodomloppet in Uddevalla is a recreational race that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old. Participants can register individually or as a team, and the event ends with a picnic together. Blodomloppet is a popular workplace wellness activity that brings together companies and individuals in a social, healthy setting while supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km races start north of the grassy area in Museiparken and follow Kungsgatan eastward
Lilla Blodomloppet starts in the tree-lined avenue north of Museiparken and heads west
The course is suitable for both walking and running, with timing for the 5 km and 10 km races
additional: You can register individually or as a team of 3–5 participants. Team registration includes a picnic bag. Teams can fill vacant places until 1 May. Late registration is available on site from 16:00 on race day. You can pay using your workplace wellness allowance through Epassi, Wellnet, or Benify. T-shirt sizes may sell out, with priority given to those who registered in advance. Blood donors receive a 40 kr discount, and the workplace wellness allowance can be used.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/uddevalla/): 2027-05-10 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! 10 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-10)

name: Vårruset Göteborg
organizer: Marathongruppen tillsammans med Hässelby SK, Spårvägens FK och lokala arrangören IK Vikingen
description: Vårruset Göteborg is a wonderful fun run for women, held in Slottsskogen, with the start and finish by Björngårdsvillan. Participants can choose between 2.5 km and 5 km on a course that has been officially measured. The event is all about the joy of movement, community and a fantastic atmosphere, with entertainment and encouragement along the course. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and a finish-line bag, and teams that register also get a picnic after the finish. Vårruset is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fun run tour and welcomes participants of all ages, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course
Start and finish by Björngårdsvillan in Slottsskogen
Entertainment and encouragement along the course and in the event area
additional: Registration is binding and can be completed online until race day, no later than one hour before the start. You can opt out of timekeeping when registering, in which case your result will not be published in the results list. Teams consist of five people, and team members can run different distances. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km (11 when accompanied by an adult) and 11 for the 2.5 km (7 when accompanied by an adult). Race numbers are sent out approximately two weeks before the event. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish. Timekeeping is available for the 5 km and can be opted out of.

name: Chalmersloppet 2026
description: Chalmersloppet is an annual running festival on the Johanneberg campus in Gothenburg, welcoming students, employees, alumni and companies to take part in a community focused on health and wellbeing. The event offers several distances and a walk, so everyone can participate on their own terms, from experienced runners to those who prefer walking. It is a meeting place for networking and exercise in a relaxed, inspiring atmosphere, with a focus on health for all. Students can participate for free, and company participation creates valuable opportunities for future employers and students to meet. Chalmersloppet is organized by Chalmers Student Union’s Teknologbolag and celebrates balance, wellbeing and community.
course_highlights: The race starts and takes place on the Johanneberg campus, with several distances: 9.82 km, 6.28 km, 3.14 km, and a 3.14 km walk
Start groups of runners and walking groups set off one after another from Chalmersplatsen
Runner Zone at Geniknölen features activities, networking and an awards ceremony
additional: Fysiken offers free changing rooms at Mossen. A bag drop is available for runners’ belongings. Bib numbers and T-shirts can be collected from a tent at Teknologgården the day before and on race day. Fysiken leads a group warm-up. The awards ceremony takes place at Chalmersplatsen. Runner Zone is a central meeting place featuring companies and activities. Students participate free of charge. The event includes activities in a Runner Zone.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.chalmersloppet.se/): 2027-05-11 — "See you on the 11th of May 2027!" (was estimated 2027-05-11)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: See you on the 11th of May 2027!

name: Kanada Rundt
description: Kanada Rundt is a traditional annual road race in Sylling that has been held since 1981. The race offers 3 km, 6 km, and 12 km distances, with the start and finish at Syllinghallen. The classic 12 km course runs around Kanada and is officially measured by the Norwegian Athletics Association. The event also includes Syllingløpet for children, with no timing, and prizes are awarded for course records, sprints, and youth categories.
course_highlights: Classic 12 km course around Kanada, officially measured at 12,040 metres
The 6 km course follows the main route to Kyllerudsvingen before returning to Syllinghallen
Route: Syllinghallen, Kyllerud, Trolldalen, Kanada, Tronstad, Skjeggerud, Syllinghallen
additional: Start and finish at Syllinghallen, with changing rooms available. Participants in the recreational category can walk or run without timing, with starts between 17:00 and 18:00. Syllingløpet for children aged 0–11 starts at 18:00 without timing; all participants receive a medal. There is a sprint prize at the Learn sprint point, approximately 3 km into the course, as well as course-record prizes and youth prizes. Participants who finish multiple times receive anniversary prizes and mugs. The Lier double prize is for taking part in both Kanada Rundt/Syllingløpet and Lierskogen 6-timers. Previous editions have offered registration through EQ Timing. The start, finish, and changing rooms have been at Syllinghallen.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Strandtorgetløpet
location: Strandpromenaden, south of Strandtorget, Lillehammer, Norway
description: Strandtorgetløpet is part of Sørdalskarusellen and takes place on the open area south of Strandtorget in Lillehammer, by the red artwork. The race offers an inclusive, accessible atmosphere where both elite runners and recreational runners can take part. The event focuses on the joy of running and togetherness, and is suitable for anyone looking for an enjoyable race experience in scenic surroundings. Race bibs can be collected at the Litrim tent by the art installation, and facilities include toilets on Strandpromenaden.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the open area south of Strandtorget by the red artwork
Race bibs can be collected at the Litrim tent on Strandpromenaden from 17:45
Toilets are available on Strandpromenaden
additional: Registration closes at 18:00 on race day, one hour before the start. Prices increase from 13:00 on race day. Parking at Strandtorget is limited to 2 hours, or 3 hours for shopping centre members. An SMS with information about race bibs and start times will be sent at approximately 16:00. Remember to bring your race bib if you have registered for the whole series. Listed with a start time of 20:00 on 12 May 2027. Virtual participation is listed for 8–11 May.

name: Søreideløpet
description: Søreideløpet is being held for the first time and promises a running festival in Søreide, Bergen. The race takes place on the pavement, with a course guide on a bicycle and course marshals at crossings with vehicle traffic. Participants will receive a race bib, and a race medal will be awarded at the finish. Children and young people will also receive a buff from Fjordkraft, and gift cards for Puma products will be drawn among the participants. The team with the highest percentage of participation will receive NOK 5,000 for its team fund.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the pavement in Søreide, marked with white arrows
A course guide on a bicycle and course marshals at crossings with vehicle traffic
Start and finish at Rema 1000 Søreide
additional: Race bibs will be handed out from 18:00. The registration deadline is 18:15 on race day. Rema 1000 Søreide will provide bottled water at the finish. A race medal for all participants. A buff for all children and young people. A prize for the team with the highest percentage of participation: NOK 5,000 for its team fund. Previous editions have awarded medals to all participants.

name: Medåkersloppet
location: Parkuddens IP, Medåker, Arboga Municipality, Sweden
description: Medåkersloppet is a classic trail race held annually since 1979 in the beautiful forests around Parkuddens IP in Medåker. The event offers several distances, including a new 14 km race, as well as a children’s race and a mini race for the youngest participants. It is a festival welcoming both runners and walkers, with refreshments and activities in the start and finish area. The mini race and children’s race are untimed and open to all children; participants in the mini race receive a medal.
course_highlights: A trail race through forest terrain, with both wide and narrow paths
The route runs along gravel roads and through the forest
The children’s race follows the exercise trail and is suitable for strollers
additional: The mini race is untimed and requires no registration. The children’s race is also untimed. Refreshments are available in the start and finish area.

name: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami
description: The 5th Night Run in Pairs with Fireflies is a unique nighttime running event held in Reda by the retention reservoir. The runners’ headlamps and the illuminated course create a spectacular visual effect. Participants run in pairs, highlighting the event’s inclusive spirit and setting it apart from other sporting events in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The run takes place after dark, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and adding to the excitement.

name: Luilakpolderloop
location: Jisp, Wormer- en Jisperveld, North Holland, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 Euro, te betalen tijdens inschrijving, consumptie en bedankje inclusief

description: The Luilakpolderloop is a friendly running race held annually in the beautiful polder landscape of the Wormer and Jisperveld. With distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 English miles), it offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. Children can take part in a special free 1.1 km youth race. The start and finish are at VV Jisp football club, with a welcoming atmosphere, medals for children, trophies for the winners and a raffle after the race.
course_highlights: Beautiful course through the Wormer and Jisperveld
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 miles)
Free 1.1 km youth race for children
additional: Youth race bibs can be collected on 13 May 2027 from 14:00 to 14:30 at OBS De Harpoen, or on 14 May 2027 at 18:00 at Restaurant De Lepelaar. The youth race starts at 18:30 at Restaurant De Lepelaar and finishes at VV Jisp. Adult race bibs are available from 18:30 at VV Jisp; the adult fun runs start at 19:30. VV Jisp has 4 changing rooms with showers. Bag storage is at your own risk. Parking is limited, and a traffic marshal will be present. Live results are available during the race. The raffle and prize presentation take place after the race, at around 21:15. Registration for 2027 opens in early March, with 350 race bibs available. The event supports charities and offers digital timing with live results. Medals and trophies are available for participants, and registration is mandatory. No refunds are available in the event of cancellation.

name: Skärholmsloppet
price_range: Gratis enligt information om tidigare upplagor

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan på hemsidan stänger torsdag den 14 maj kl 17

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan på hemsidan stänger torsdag den 14 maj kl 17

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan på hemsidan stänger torsdag den 14 maj kl 17

description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Skärholmen, offering races for all ages, from a Mini Race for the youngest participants to a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over. The race is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works with young people in Sweden’s Million Programme suburbs. There is music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive and encouraging community event that promotes exercise and togetherness.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for ages 13 and over
Lilla Skärholmsloppet, approximately 1.6 km, for children from preschool class to year 6
Mini Skärholmsloppet, 500 metres, for children aged 0–6
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Music and DJs along the course. A medal for everyone who completes the race. Race bib, medal, fruit and a drink are included in the registration. Lilla Skärholmsloppet has start times split by school year, with colour-coded starting groups. The Mini Race is 500 metres and can be run together with a parent. Late registration is possible at bib collection on 15 May and on race day, subject to availability. The race centre at SKHLM offers bib collection and bag storage; late registration may be available subject to availability. The recommended route is metro red line 13 to Skärholmen.

name: Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka
description: Kilsbergen Out and Back is a unique, friendly trail run in Ånnaboda, near Örebro, where participants choose their own distance by running one, two or all three out-and-back sections. The race offers hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections and beautiful trails. Everyone starts at the same time from the same place, creating a sociable, relaxed atmosphere throughout the day. After finishing, participants are served a simple hot meal, with a vegetarian option.
course_highlights: Three out-and-back sections, with distances of 10 km, 26 km and 54 km
Hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections
The Bergslagsleden Trail, with the turnaround point at the Rusakulan viewpoint
additional: The maximum number of participants is 100. Race bibs can be collected from 08:00 at the event centre. The start, finish and event centre are at the warming hut by the artificial snow trail in Ånnaboda. Toilets are available in the area; changing facilities and showers are at the SM hut by the lower car park. Trail shoes with good grip are recommended. Runners must carry all their own equipment and energy; no support is available along the course. The refreshment table at the event centre offers water, sports drink, bananas, sweets, crisps, buns and more. Runners may leave their own drop bags there. Parking is recommended at the lower car park, with signs directing you to the event centre. The organiser’s information lists the start time as 09:00, the maximum number of participants as 100, and the final registration date as 15 May. Runners are responsible for their own equipment and energy; support is permitted only at the event centre.

name: TIF Terrängen 2026
description: TIF-terrängen is a traditional cross-country race organized by Trollhättans IF Friidrott. The race has a long history and attracts runners who appreciate challenging terrain and the beautiful natural surroundings of Skidstugan in Trollhättan. After the 2026 race was cancelled, the event is planned to return in 2027, with more information to come later.
course_highlights: The courses start at Skidstugan in Trollhättan.
Distances are 800 metres, 2.3 kilometres, 5.2 kilometres and 10.4 kilometres.
The 10.4-kilometre distance consists of two laps of the 5.2-kilometre course.
additional: The 800-metre race is for children up to 9 years old.

name: Hälleforsterrängen
description: Hälleforsterrängen is a running race organized by Hällefors Running Club and held in Hällefors. The race is part of the club’s annual competition program and welcomes runners of different age groups and ability levels. The club provides financial support to members taking part in running races and encourages carpooling and wearing club clothing. Hälleforsterrängen offers a great opportunity to run in scenic surroundings and take part in a well-organized local running event.
additional: The club reimburses entry fees and mileage expenses for children, young people and juniors at running races, as well as 50% of the entry fee for seniors and veterans in races in Närkes Långloppscup. Wearing club clothing is required to receive reimbursement. Carpooling is recommended. The club also reimburses the entry fee, accommodation, mileage expenses and food for participation in Vasastafetten. Previous editions have included 5 km, 10 km and children’s races. This information applies to 2026 and does not confirm the format for 2027.

name: Tveitevannet Rundt
description: Tveitevannet Rundt is a running event by Tveitevannet in Bergen. In 2026, the event was described as featuring a children’s race as well as 5 km and 10 km distances. The race takes place in the area around the lake in Årstad, with Tveitevannet as its gathering point.
course_highlights: Run in the local area around Tveitevannet in Bergen
Area with a path by the lake and even terrain
Described as featuring 5 km and 10 km distances in 2026
additional: A children’s race was also listed in the description of the 2026 edition.

name: Ølmedal Rundt
location: Bygdahuset i Ølmedal, Imsland, Vindafjord, Norway
description: Ølmedal Rundt is a traditional race that started in 1984 and attracts 500–600 participants each year. The race goes around Ølmedalsvatnet on an approximately 7 km paved course through gently undulating terrain, suitable for runners, recreational participants, wheelchair users and strollers. The event also includes a children’s race, recreational and family classes, and age-group competition classes. The start and finish are at Bygdahuset in Ølmedal, where food, a drinks station, showers and changing rooms are available. Ølmedal Rundt is a community celebration with broad appeal and good facilities.
course_highlights: Approximately 7 km around Ølmedalsvatnet on a paved road
Gently undulating terrain suitable for everyone, including wheelchair users and strollers
Children’s course of approximately 400 metres near Bygdahuset
additional: Drinks station after approximately 4 km. Medals for all children’s race participants. Prizes for the top three in the competition classes. Showers and changing rooms available. A large food stall at Bygdahuset serves grilled food, sveler, cakes and coffee. There is a drinks station after approximately 4 km, and food, showers and changing rooms are available. The race is traditionally held on the second day of Pentecost.

name: Vestmarkaløpet
description: Vestmarkaløpet takes place on 15 May 2027 in Vestmarka, Bærum, and offers trail running in beautiful natural surroundings. There are two distances, 10 km and 21 km, on trails and forest roads with varied terrain and elevation changes. This race is suitable both for those seeking an experience in nature and for those looking to test their fitness early in the running season. The start and finish are at Vestmarksetra outdoor parking area, with ample parking and public transport nearby.
course_highlights: 10 km course with 219 metres of elevation gain and 1 drink station
21 km course with 413 metres of elevation gain and 2 drink stations
Trail race on paths and forest roads in Vestmarka
additional: Parking is available at the venue, and bus 245 goes to Kattås, about 1.5 km from the venue. Drink stations with water, sports drink and bananas along the course. Live results will be available on race day. Information about race bib collection, bag storage and awards will be published closer to race day. Parking at the venue, or bus 245 to Kattås, about 1.5 km away. Poles and listening to audio are not allowed.

name: Bislettmila / Bislett Distanseserie - 5000m/10000m
description: Bislett Distance Series is an accessible running series that holds monthly races at Bislett Stadium in Oslo. The series offers excellent conditions and a great atmosphere, with the chance to run alongside others at your level. Participants receive nuts, bars and sports drink, and pacers are often available to help you reach your goals. It’s a great way to kick-start the running season at the historic Bislett Stadium.
course_highlights: Run at the iconic Bislett Stadium
An accessible and inclusive running series
The option to run with pacers targeting different times
additional: All registered participants receive nuts, bars and sports drink from Maxim. The races are held indoors at Bislett Stadium, with the entrance at 1 Louises gate, 0168 Oslo.

name: Grunnlovsmila
description: Grunnlovsmila is a 10 km recreational road race from Heradsbygd to Elverum. The race is held annually before 17 May and is open to all participants with no entry fee. It is a friendly event that brings together runners of all ages for a great run in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 10 km recreational road race
From Heradsbygd to Elverum
Held annually before 17 May
additional: The race is free for all participants. Timing and the unofficial results list have been based on a GPS watch or mobile phone connected to Strava. Runners must arrange their own transport back from the finish area; in previous editions, transport for warm-up clothes and valuables to the finish has been offered.

name: Den stygge andungen ultraløp
organizer: Anders Alvaro Nydal, Sondre Andrè Ødegaard Torve og Oddmund Varem Aardal
description: The Ugly Duckling ultrarun is a challenging ultrarun in Sunnfjord that goes around Bekkjavatnet and up and down Hafstadfjellet. The race consists of 10 stages, with a mass start every hour on the hour from 08:00. Participants must be ready for each new start to continue. The total distance is 65 km with 780 metres of elevation gain, and the final stage determines the winners in the men’s and women’s categories. The race has a social and inclusive atmosphere, with opportunities to recover between laps, and is held annually, with a history dating back to 2019.
course_highlights: 10 stages with a mass start every hour on the hour
8 laps around Bekkjavatnet, each 6.75 km
A challenging stage up Hafstadfjellet with 420 metres of elevation gain
additional: Start and finish at Hunsrasta by Bekkjavatnet. A new mass start every hour on the hour for 10 hours. Participants must be present for the next start to continue. There is an opportunity to eat, drink and recover between laps. Bags and luggage can be transported to the start area. Basic party tents, an outhouse and a fire pan are available, but participants must bring their own food and drink. There is no electricity or heated indoor shelter at the venue. The first start is at 08:00, with a new mass start every hour on the hour. Participants who are not ready for the next start cannot continue. The entry fee and any sponsor donations go towards developing the race.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton Piastowski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half marathon held in Inowrocław as part of the Piast Running Festival. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and compete over the 21 km distance. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: 12 Ćwierćmaraton Komandosa
description: The Commando Quarter Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Sub ventum” Foundation in Słupsk, promoting physical activity among residents of the city and surrounding areas. The race is both a sporting and community event, open to runners of varying ability levels. The organizers provide professional support and a way to get in touch quickly via the registration form. The event takes place in the scenic areas of Słupsk, encouraging a healthy lifestyle.
additional: You can contact the organizers and register using the online form. The race director is Dariusz Kloskowski, available at 602 759 892. Participants are encouraged to log in during registration to speed up the processing of their entries.

name: 8 Okonińska Pętla
location: Okoniny Nadjeziorne, Tuchola County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Join the 8th edition of Okonińska Pętla, taking place on May 16 at 16:00 in Okoniny Nadjeziorne. This running event, organized by the Śliwice Municipal Office, attracts enthusiasts of physical activity and the beautiful landscapes of the Tuchola Forest. The scenic route lets participants enjoy the natural beauty and local scenery. More information and registration are available on the dedicated registration website.
course_highlights: Scenic route in the Tuchola Forest
Route through Okoniny Nadjeziorne
Race organized by the Śliwice Municipal Office

name: Bieg Krokodyla
description: Bieg Krokodyla is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The event includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. The main races and the walk are scheduled to start at 12:00, while the children’s races begin at 9:00. Participants can choose a basic package or an extended package with a technical T-shirt. The course follows a scenic route around the lake, offering attractive views and a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Rusałka in Poznań
Distances: 10 km, 5 km, and a 5 km Nordic Walking event
Children’s and youth races over shorter distances from 100 m to 1,000 m
additional: The main races and the walk start at 12:00. The children’s and youth races start from 9:00. Start location by Lake Rusałka (GPS: 52.423071, 16.884526). Participants aged 16–18 may choose the 5 km or 10 km distance with a guardian’s consent.

name: Mariuszowa 5-tka
description: Mariuszowa 5-tka is a race held in Leszno on unpaved roads and forest tracks in the Nowy Świat Forest District, near the Dr. Jan Jonston Provincial Multispecialist Hospital. The event offers distances of 5.3 km (one lap) and 10.3 km (two laps), as well as a 4 km Nordic walking event. It also includes youth and children’s races over shorter distances suited to participants’ ages. The race office is located in the hospital’s administrative building, and the start and finish are on Jana Kiepury Street. Entries are accepted online only.
course_highlights: The route follows unpaved roads and forest tracks in the Nowy Świat Forest District
Distances of 5.3 km (1 lap) and 10.3 km (2 laps)
Start and finish by the Dr. Jan Jonston Provincial Multispecialist Hospital in Leszno
additional: Participant limits: 5 km and 10 km races — 250 people; Nordic walking — 100 people; children’s races — 100 people. The race office is in the administrative building of the Provincial Multispecialist Hospital, with the entrance from Szpitalna Street. The start and finish are on Jana Kiepury Street, on the access road to the hospital beyond the ambulance entrance.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton z Kruszwicy
Bieg Urodzinowy Miasta Skórcz
description: The Skórcz City Birthday Run is an annual running event organized by the Skórcz Municipal Office and held within the city. The event combines sport and recreation and offers an opportunity to celebrate the city’s birthday together. It attracts both residents and visitors, promoting an active lifestyle and a sense of community.
course_highlights: A road race through the streets of Skórcz
The historic route ran along, among others, Parkowa, Hallera, 3 Maja, Główna, and Sobieskiego streets
In 2011, the main race was approximately 1.5 km long
additional: Previous editions also included a Preschoolers’ Run. The race regulations and consent form for participation by minors are available.

name: XV Ćwierćmaraton Bielika
location: Siadło Dolne, Gmina Kołbaskowo, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 15th Bielik Quarter Marathon is the largest sporting event organized by the Municipality of Kołbaskowo. The race starts by the Oder River in Siadło Dolne, and the finish is located about 11 km away, at the sports field in Pargowo. The route follows the Bielik Trail and features a beautiful, varied profile with both large and small hills, making it appealing to outdoor enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Start by the Oder River in Siadło Dolne
Finish at the sports field in Pargowo, about 11 km from the start
Route follows the Bielik Trail, with a varied profile and hills

name: Rundje um ut Hundje
description: Rundje um ut Hundje is an annual running event in Horst aan de Maas, celebrating its 11th edition in 2027. The event offers a wide range of distances for all ages, from the Parent/Child Run to the 10 km race. The routes pass through the centre of Horst, creating a sporty and sociable atmosphere, made possible in part by the local community and sponsors. The organisers aim to provide a well-organised and accessible event for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes ranging from 350 metres to 10 kilometres through the centre of Horst
Start and finish at Lambertusplein, near the statue of ’t Hundje van Hôrs
Various youth and adult races with age-specific distances
additional: Free parking around Lambertusplein. Public transport: the 'Horst Centrum' bus stop is a 2-minute walk away. Prize ceremonies take place at Wilhelminaplein after the youth and adult races. Shirts can be ordered optionally for an additional fee. Multiple race categories, including kids, urban, 5 km and 10 km; location at Lambertusplein; anniversary year with special festivities

name: Adelsö ultra
description: A new ultratrail race on Adelsö on 16 May 2027. Adelsö is one of the Mälaren islands on the outskirts of Stockholm. We have worked hard on the course and are proud to present a scenic marathon-distance XL that combines coastline and technical forest trails with 600 metres of climbing. Beyond the natural experience, the race offers a journey through historically significant landscapes, which we have made an effort to highlight along the route. One of the most exciting ultraraces in Stockholm in spring 2027 for those who love trail running.

name: Perseløpet ¤2 - 2027
description: Perseløpet is a simple, fast race event at Ås School in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners set new personal records. The race takes place on a flat, measured 2,633-metre loop, with seven distances to choose from, ranging from 3 km to 100 km. Participants have their own nutrition table, which they pass each lap, making race nutrition simple and personal. The event offers good facilities, including changing rooms, toilets and free parking, and has a friendly atmosphere where everyone who sets a personal record gets to ring the bell at the finish.
course_highlights: Flat, measured 2,633-metre loop
Your own personal nutrition table along the course
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km
additional: Race numbers are collected on a self-service basis at Ås School approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. At selected races, 9th-grade students from Feiring School staff an official aid station, which also raises money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area around Ås School. The venue is close to public transport, with live bus departure information and train connections via Entur. The start and finish are at Ås School, Hammerås. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Runners can have their own nutrition table.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Spring Edition is a recurring race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice, an ideal place for nature lovers and those seeking active recreation. The event aims to promote running and physical activity, and participation is open to all ages. Participants can look forward to a unique atmosphere and commemorative medals, awarded after completing the main race or the children’s races. The event is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and is held under the honorary patronage of the Voivodeship Marshal.

name: Ekiden Pragmatiq
description: Ekiden PragmatIQ is a team marathon relay held in Poznań by Lake Malta. Teams of six cover the marathon distance (42.195 km), with each runner completing a designated leg. The course is paved and follows a 5.4 km loop, except for the first leg. The event combines sporting competition with teamwork and support for local charitable organizations. Ekiden Junior is also held as part of the event for the youngest runners.

name: III Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku
organizer: Kołobrzeskie Stowarzyszenie Biegów Ulicznych Nadmorscy Biegacze
description: The 3rd Kołobrzeg Baltic Coast Half Marathon is a flat road race set in the picturesque seaside surroundings of Kołobrzeg. The course follows a granite-paved promenade, a cycle path and asphalt roads, with five refreshment stations along the route. The start and finish are located at Seaside Park Hotel. The race is part of the Kołobrzeg Odyssey series, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the running community together. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours, and timing is electronic, using disposable chips.

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Run is the second edition of a trail race held in Modrze, Poland. Participants can choose from a 5 km run, a 10 km run, or a 5 km Nordic walking event. The course runs through fields and forests between the towns of Modrze and Drożdżyce, offering a chance to enjoy nature and spend time actively outdoors. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.

name: Run Toruń Plaza
description: The May edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy - Run Toruń Plaza features two distances: 5 km and 10 km. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness in the spring edition of the series and experience the unique atmosphere of running in Toruń. The organizers provide professional, nationwide event organization while ensuring a friendly, family atmosphere. The event is part of a running series promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity.

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka is an annual race held in Sierakowice as part of the Northern Poland Running Festival. The event takes place at the sports stadium at 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street and attracts runners of all ages, offering a 15 km main race as well as numerous children’s and youth races. The event features electronic timekeeping, an extensive program and prizes for the top competitors. Participants can expect professional organization, including medical and police support, as well as amenities such as a bag drop, showers and a café.

name: IV Bieg Dycha z Pompą
description: The 4th Tapflo Run – Dycha z Pompą is a 10-kilometer road race held in Tczew and organized by PCS Tczew, with Tapflo Sp. z o.o. as the main sponsor. The start and finish are at the company’s headquarters at 4b Czatkowska Street. The race takes place on a Sunday, and the starting line closes 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. Participants can register online, and places are limited to 200 runners.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometer course in Tczew
Start and finish at Tapflo’s headquarters at 4b Czatkowska Street
The starting line closes 15 minutes after the start
additional: The participant limit is 200. Applications without the entry fee paid within 7 days will be removed from the list. The start and finish are at the same location. The starting line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. For the 2026 edition, the limit is 200 OPEN participants and the start time is 10:00; prices and registration information apply to this edition.

name: Sezon Ogórkowy/Monte Cassino
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Nobel Run
description: The Nobel Run is a friendly, accessible running event held in the beautiful Almere Hout. The various routes pass through the area’s green, sustainable natural surroundings, giving the event a unique feel. The event aims to make a sustainable and sporting contribution to Almere Hout and is intended as a festive occasion for participants, spectators, and residents of Nobelhorst. The Nobel Run promotes social cohesion and gives the city of Almere a sporting boost.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful natural surroundings of Almere Hout
The course has a green and sustainable character
Distances range from a Kids Run to a 15 km run
additional: Race number with a built-in MyLaps timing chip. First name printed on the race number for registrations made before 1 May 2027. Race numbers and shirts can be collected on Saturday 15 May 2027 between 10:00 and 14:00 at the Nobelhorst community hall. Participants may hand in one bag with a numbered label. Entertainment, post-run massage, refreshment stations along the route and at the finish, official results, and personal photos are included. The official Nobel Run shirt, limited-edition socks, and BibBits magnets can be ordered optionally during registration. The event offers merchandise and registration options and emphasizes an environmentally conscious, community-focused approach.

description: Blodomloppet is Sweden’s largest recreational running event, held in 24 locations across the country, including Malmö on May 17, 2027. The event aims to raise awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog, or run 5 or 10 kilometers with friends and coworkers. The event is open to everyone and ends with a group picnic for participants.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes in an urban setting
Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old
A shared picnic bag for all registered teams
additional: Teams of 3–5 participants can register and receive a picnic bag. Blood donors receive a registration discount. Late registration is available on site on the day of the event for an additional fee. The start and finish are in Museiparken in Malmö. You can use your wellness allowance to pay the registration fee.
