The courses have local nautical names that reflect Warnemünde’s coastal identity, including the 5 Seemeilen-Lauf (9 km) and the 3 Seemeilen-Lauf (6 km). Results are managed via my.race|result, and the event is listed in the laufen.de calendar.

name: Victorialoppet 2026
description: Victorialoppet is a traditional running festival in Borgholm, held annually on July 15. The event offers several distances for all ages and levels, from Mini for the youngest runners to the 9 km main race. The course is fast and easy to run, with beautiful coastal views and an enthusiastic crowd. The event has a long history, dating back to its first edition in 1981, and donates part of its surplus to Crown Princess Victoria’s Fund.
course_highlights: Fast and easy-to-run course
Beautiful coastal views
Live music at several locations along the course
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 10:00 to 18:00 at Borgholm Sports Hall. Changing rooms and showers are available for men and boys at Borgholm Sports Hall, and for women and girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Water is provided along the 9 km course, and there is live music at several locations. Prizes are awarded in different categories, and participants receive a medal or commemorative plaque, depending on the race. Most races use disposable timing chips; timing is optional for Victoriajoggen and the para-sport categories.

name: BUM Borås Ultramaraton
description: BUM Borås Ultramaraton är ett ultratraillopp i Borås, arrangerat av SOK Knallen. Start och mål är vid Kypegården, med distanserna 50 km, 21 km och 10 km. Välj den sträcka som passar dig och upplev löpning i och omkring Borås.
course_highlights: Start och mål vid Kypegården i Borås
Tre distanser: 50 km, 21 km och 10 km
Ultratraillöpning i och omkring Borås

name: Osterøy på tvers 2027
organizer: Osterøy IL, Mjøsdalen IL, Fotlandsvåg IL og Bruvik IL
description: Osterøy på tvers is an annual running event from Bruvik to Hosanger on Osterøy. The race is organised in collaboration between several local sports clubs and offers a great opportunity to experience the island’s varied nature and terrain. Participants can choose between the competitive and recreational classes, and the race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners. The event has a long tradition and is well established in the local community.
course_highlights: The race crosses Osterøy from Bruvik to Hosanger
Varied terrain with both asphalt and gravel
Scenic surroundings on the island
additional: The race has both a competitive class and a recreational class. Results from previous years are published on eqtiming.com. The course map is available via Strava. The event is organised in collaboration between Osterøy IL, Mjøsdalen IL, Fotlandsvåg IL and Bruvik IL. The organiser’s website has a link to the registered participants and participant overview.

name: Hagebyløpet
location: Tennisbanen i Bergsalléen, Ullevål, Oslo, Norway

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deltakeravgift: 200 kr. for voksne over 20 år

description: Hagebyløpet is an inclusive running festival in the heart of Ullevål, Oslo, with races for all ages and abilities. The event offers three distances: a 500-metre children’s race in Halsparken, the Engelskmila (English Mile), a 1609-metre race open to everyone, and a timed 5 km race for teenagers and adults. The courses run across grass, trails and quiet streets. It’s a lively event with a great atmosphere, entertainment and activities for the whole family. All participants receive a medal, and refreshments and various activities are available at Damplassen.
course_highlights: 500 m children’s race on grass in Halsparken, with some hills
Engelskmila (English Mile), 1609 m on trails and quiet streets, open to everyone
Timed 5 km race on trails and quiet streets with pavements
additional: Refreshments including sausages, cake, waffles and drinks will be available at Damplassen. Entertainment and activities include a bouncy castle, a balloon clown, face painting and a shot-speed radar. There will be stands from partners. Public transport: Metro and bus 23 to Ullevål stadion, bus 25 to Eventyrveien, trams 17 and 18 to John Colletts plass. Toilets are available by the start area and at the Seniorsenteret at Damplassen. The start and finish are by the tennis court in Bergsalléen. Food and drinks can be purchased at Damplass, where there will also be activities and stands. Teams of at least four participants can enter the 5 km race.

name: Bystrandløpet Bergen3000
location: Amalie Skram videregående skole, Bergen, Norway
description: Bystrandløpet Bergen3000 is a fast 3,000-metre race that takes place around Bergen’s upcoming city beach. The course follows walking and cycling paths around Store Lungegårdsvannet and is suitable for all levels, from children to elite athletes and people with reduced physical function. The event is family-friendly, with professional timing, medals for children and an awards ceremony. Organised by Sædalen IL, the race features a flat, fast course that is perfect for testing your fitness or setting personal records.
course_highlights: The course follows walking and cycling paths around Store Lungegårdsvannet
Flat, fast course, ideal for setting records and recreational running
AIMS-approved 3,000 metres off the track, with timing at several intermediate points
additional: Starts are staggered at one-minute intervals, with heats of 10–15 runners based on expected finish time. There are children’s races, para races, recreational races, a relay and elite classes, each with separate start times. Results are published on the website, and finish times are sent by SMS. The event includes entertainment, sales stalls, a kiosk and an awards ceremony. Participants are encouraged to join the Bystrandløpet X Torshov running group. The race is inclusive of everyone, including people with reduced physical function. A 300-metre children’s race, BERGEN300, is offered. Timing is provided by EQ Timing, and 3,000-metre runners start in groups based on their expected finish times. Children receive medals, and prizes are awarded for podium places.

name: Sommerløpet
description: Sommerløpet is Southern Norway’s largest running festival, held in Kristiansand with the start and finish at Øvre Torv. The event offers distances for everyone, from a children’s race to a half marathon, and welcomes participants of all ages and fitness levels. The courses pass through some of the city’s most attractive areas, including cultural venues, the city beach and historic Posebyen, creating a festive atmosphere with plenty of participants and spectators. Pacers are available for several distances, and there are well-stocked water stations along the way, making it an inclusive and motivating experience for everyone.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Øvre Torv in central Kristiansand
The course passes Kilden Performing Arts Centre, Kunstsilo, Kanalbyen, Odderøya and the city beach
Water stations by the pedestrian bridge over the Otra and in the finish area
additional: Pacers carrying balloons are available for various finish times in the 3 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon. Race bibs can be collected at Løplabbet and Clarion Ernst Hotel. T-shirts can be purchased during registration and collected at the hotel. Maximum of 5,000 participants in total; some distances may sell out. Companions can run for free using a code. The Red Cross provides first aid in the finish area. Distances include the Children’s Race (600 m), 3 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon (21 km).

name: Byløpet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser tom 4. april 2027 (50 kr billigere før 5. april)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alle barn 0-10 år kan delta gratis

description: Byløpet is Grenland’s largest city race and half marathon, held in central Skien, starting by Arkaden. The 5 km, 10 km and 21 km courses run through scenic surroundings around Hjellevannet and offer a varied paved route with both hills and beautiful viewpoints. The event is open to everyone, from professional runners to families and school classes, and also includes a free children’s race for children up to 10 years old. Byløpet emphasizes the joy of running and public health, and provides accessibility for para-athletes. Race numbers are collected outside Sport 1, and there is plenty of nearby parking.
course_highlights: The course runs along the shore of Hjellevannet, with views of Skien city and Bakkestranda
Paved surface with challenging hills, including after the Falkum River and up towards Klosterøya
Water stations at Herkules and in the pedestrian street, as well as refreshments at the finish
additional: Start times: Half marathon at 11:00, 5 km at 13:00, 10 km at 13:30, Ibsen’s Children’s Race at 10:30. Race numbers are collected outside Sport 1. Free parking at Bygarasjen on race day. Accessibility for para-athletes with a guide or bicycle. Photos are taken during the race and may be published with consent. Ibsen’s Children’s Race is free for children aged 0 to 10. All participants receive a medal. Registration is through EQ Timing.

name: Oppegårdmila
location: Oppegård IL Clubhouse and Stadium, Oppegård, Norway
description: Oppegårdmila is an annual race organized by Oppegård IL, with distances of 500 m, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The race follows varied routes, including the Installatørrunden and The Well course, and is suitable for children, teenagers and adults. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with a warm-up at the stadium, race-number pickup at the clubhouse and prize-giving for different age groups. After the race, participants over 18 can enter The Well for free, making for a pleasant end to the day.
course_highlights: Micromila 500 m course for the youngest participants
Minimila 2 km course
Installatørrunden 5 km and The Well 10 km course (5 km x 2)
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the clubhouse on Friday, June 5, from 19:00 to 19:30, and on race day from 09:00 to 11:30. There is a warm-up at the stadium before the start. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men, as well as to the 1st, 2nd and 3rd-place girls and boys in the 12–15 and 16–19 age groups. All participants receive a participation prize. Participants over 18 can enter The Well for free after the race, but must register for this by Thursday, June 4, at 12:00. Previous editions have offered participants the option to run or walk against the clock, with a medal at the finish.

name: Tanangerløpet
description: Tanangerløpet is an annual race organized by Havørn Friidrett, aiming to promote the joy of sport and public health. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels, whether you are experienced or a beginner. The course starts at Tananger Indre Havn and follows Tananger Ring counterclockwise, on a scenic route that includes a footpath and an underpass. The start and finish are at the same location, and the event offers a great experience focused on community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: The course starts and finishes at Tananger Indre Havn by Hummeren Hotell
Runs counterclockwise around Tananger Ring, with a footpath on the left
Underpass beneath the roundabout at Myklebust for safe crossing
additional: Please arrive approximately 30–45 minutes before the start. There will be drinks and music at the 4 km point. Timing is recorded using a chip in the race bib, and net time is used. Toilets are available at Hummeren Hotell. Changing rooms and showers are not available after the race. Bags can be left in a designated room at Hummeren Hotell, but the organizer accepts no responsibility for them. The race will go ahead in all weather unless conditions are unsafe. The race bib must be attached visibly to your chest and contains a timing chip that must not be folded or bent.

name: Skredløpet
description: Skredløpet is a trail race that started in 2007 and has grown into a popular annual event with around 370 participants. The race is 8.5 km long with 444 metres of elevation gain, and follows a scenic route from the avalanche barrier at Aga via Svartetjødn, Rogdatjødn and Rogdo, up to Kvestadstølane, Måkestadstølane and Herseter, before descending to the finish at Reisæter. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys walking or running in nature, and includes adult competition classes, a short-legged race for children and a recreational class for those who want to enjoy nature at their own pace. Activities and social events are also held during Skredløpshelga, including an activity day and dancing.
course_highlights: 8.5 km course with 444 metres of elevation gain
Starts at the avalanche barrier at Aga and passes through scenic areas such as Svartetjødn and Rogdo
Highest point at Herseter, with great views, before descending to the finish at Reisæter
additional: The Kortbeintløpet has a bus from the car park at Aga to the start area at Rogdo at 12:00, and a return bus from Reisæter after the event. The recreational class can walk the course at their own pace, with a nature trail along the way. Freshly made waffles, coffee and squash are served at Rogdo and Reisæter. A team competition is held, with a minimum of 5 and a maximum of 10 participants per team. All participants in the Kortbeintløpet receive a participation prize, and prizes are drawn among the children. Participation earns 500 extra exercise points in the Solnuttrimmen app. The Kortbeintløpet is about 5 km and is for ages 7–15. It has not been confirmed that the stated details for the 2026 edition apply to the date 5 June 2027.

name: Graabeinløpet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Påmelding koster kr. 300,- for både 10km og 5km.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Påmelding koster kr. 300,- for både 10km og 5km.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Prisen for 10km økes med 100,- til 400,- 14 dager før løpsdagen.

description: Graabeinløpet is a family-friendly race held at Sletta sports ground in Sætre. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a free children’s race, and is suitable for children and adults of all ages. The courses are officially measured and approved by the Norwegian Athletics Association, and run on both gravel and asphalt roads through scenic surroundings. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to class winners and the fastest boys and girls under 13. The event also has a kiosk, toilets and medical personnel on site to ensure a safe and enjoyable race experience.
course_highlights: The course runs on gravel and asphalt roads through Sætre town centre and the Chemring Nobel factory area
Start and finish at Sletta sports ground, with one 5 km lap and two laps for the 10 km
The course is officially measured and approved by the Norwegian Athletics Association
additional: The children’s race starts at 11:30, the 10 km starts at 13:00 and the 5 km starts at 13:25. There is a kiosk and indoor toilets at the stadium. The Red Cross is on site with medical personnel. An announcer makes announcements before the start, and course marshals are stationed along the entire course. Parking is available about 150 metres from the start area, with space for over 100 cars. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to class winners in classes with at least 3 participants. The children’s race is free, and all participants receive a medal. The organiser states that it will be set after summer 2026.

name: Lysefjorden Inn Ultramaraton
description: Lysefjorden Inn is a 62-kilometre ultrarun through the dramatic landscape around the Lysefjord. The race starts at Oanes quay and passes Preikestolen Basecamp, Bratteli and Bakken farm before reaching Songesand, then continues through Daladalen and Fylljesdalen. Along the way, runners face challenging terrain and significant elevation changes, accompanied by fjord and mountain scenery. Welcome to a long and memorable challenge in Rogaland.
course_highlights: 62 km from Oanes quay to Songesand quay and onwards into the mountain terrain
Passes Preikestolen Basecamp, Bratteli and Bakken farm
Challenging climbs and varied terrain through Daladalen and Fylljesdalen
additional: The 2027 race date is 5 June. The course includes, among other things, the steep climb to Nordrestølstjern.

name: Skurdalen Trail 2027
description: Skurdalen Trail is a trail race in scenic surroundings near Fagerli Leirskole in Skurdalen. The course offers challenging mountain terrain with spectacular views of Hallingskarvet and Hardangervidda, including the well-known Hovdetrappa. The event offers distances for the whole family, from a fun Kids Trail to a challenging 18 km course with demanding trails and mountain scenery. After the race, participants can enjoy a social gathering with a barbecue buffet, sauna and concert, making it a complete experience for runners and spectators alike.
course_highlights: The course passes via Hovdetrappa, with great views of Hallingskarvet and Hardangervidda
Trail running in challenging mountain terrain with bogs, climbs and mountain farms
Shared start and finish at Fagerli Leirskole, followed by a social get-together and After Trail
additional: Shared start and finish area at Fagerli Leirskole. Soup is served at the finish. GPS tracking of the races is available. After Trail includes a sauna at Bygdebadstua and a barbecue buffet at Fagerli, with a concert and social gathering. Mandatory equipment for the 12 km and 18 km includes a downloaded GPX course file and first-aid equipment. Participants must bring a mobile phone with the organizer’s number. Pacing and outside assistance are not permitted. Participation is at your own risk. The start and finish are at Fagerli Leirskole. Accommodation is available at Fagerli for race weekend. The race distances listed are 18 km, 12 km, 5 km and Kids Trail.

name: Haugesunds Avis halvmaraton 2027
description: Haugesunds Avis Half Marathon and Fun Run is a traditional recreational running event held in Haugesund, starting and finishing at Haugesund Athletics Stadium. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, relay, 5 km fun run, and a children’s marathon for the youngest participants. The course runs partly along sidewalks and inside the stadium, offering both recreational and more experienced runners the chance to take part in a well-organized race in scenic surroundings. The event is inclusive, with options for all ages and levels.
course_highlights: The half marathon and relay start at Haugesund Athletics Stadium
The 5 km fun run follows a certified measured loop, starting and finishing inside the athletics track
Children’s marathon of approximately 750 metres for children aged 0 to 12, starting at the stadium
additional: The children’s marathon starts at 11:30, the 5 km fun run at 12:00, and the half marathon and relay at 13:00. The 5 km course is a loop on the same course as the half marathon, adjusted to the correct distance inside the stadium. Previous editions have also included a 5 km, relay, and children’s race.

name: Stomperudløpet 2027
description: Stomperudløpet is an annual race held at Sørum Stadium in Akershus. The race offers two distances, 6 km and 15 km. The longer course was recently adjusted from 16.5 km to 15 km following positive feedback. The route passes through varied terrain, including gravel roads, trails and sections of old routes, and offers scenic surroundings such as Flaenhytta and the lean-to shelter on Jultonåsen. The race is suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners looking for a challenging and enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: The route runs from Lørenfallet via Aasgaardveien (gravel road) to Bølerteiet
Trail up to Tømtekoia and on to Svartputtveien
Up to Flaenhytta and the lean-to shelter on Jultonåsen before returning to Lørenfallet

name: Søndre Nordstrandsløpet
description: Søndre Nordstrandsløpet is an inclusive community race held at Holmlia Square in Oslo. The race offers several distances, from 500 metres for the youngest participants in the Løveløpet to a new, challenging 16 km course. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas along the Ljanselva river and at Hvervenbukta, and suit all levels, with both timed and accessible options. All distances share the same start and finish, and the event concludes with an awards ceremony and medals for all participants.
course_highlights: The routes pass through some of Søndre Nordstrand’s most beautiful natural areas, including the Ljanselva river and Hvervenbukta
Several distances, with a shared start and finish at Holmlia Square outside MENY
New 16 km distance combining 10 km and 6 km laps, with timing
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day: Løveløpet from 08:45 to 09:30, and the other distances from 09:45 to 10:45. There is a group warm-up before all distances, led by an instructor from Lia Trening. Toilets are available on the second floor of Holmlia Shopping Centre from 09:00. Bag storage is available at the race office/OBOS tent, at your own risk. All participants receive a medal. MENY provides prizes for the fastest runners. Coloured markers along the course indicate which distance to follow: blue (500 m), yellow (3.3 km), red (6 km), green (10 km), green/red (16 km). The latest available race information is for 2026 and lists distances from 500 metres to 16 km. Holmlia station is about a five-minute walk from the start area.

name: 19. Lauf zwischen den Meeren
description: The Lauf zwischen den Meeren is a unique relay race that takes participants as a team along a 92.2-kilometre route from Husum on the North Sea to Damp on the Baltic Sea. The route crosses Schleswig-Holstein and connects the coasts of the two seas, with up to ten athletes per team running together. The race promotes both individual performance and camaraderie, attracting up to 800 teams from recreational and elite running. The fastest relays take about 5 hours and 10 minutes and reach the finish at around 14:15.
course_highlights: 92.2-kilometre route from Husum to Damp
10 varied stages ranging from 6.9 to 11.5 kilometres
The route passes through flat North Frisia, historic towns, along the Schlei and through the terminal moraine landscape of Schwansen
additional: The entry fee is per team (5–10 runners). Teams registering for the corporate category pay an additional 19% VAT. The race starts at the harbour point in Husum and is organised by LAV Husum. The route has 10 changeover points and is temporarily closed at railway crossings.

name: 3. Abend-Kanallauf Rethmar
location: Sportgelände des MTV Rethmar, Sehnde, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: MTV Rethmar von 1900 e.V. - Sparte Laufen
description: The 3rd Evening Canal Run Rethmar 2026 is a versatile running event at the MTV Rethmar sports grounds in Sehnde. Distances range from 400 m for the Bambini to the Kalimandscharo Half Marathon over 21.1 km. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured and eligible for rankings, with a light cross-country character. The event takes place in all weather and is open to runners of all age groups, whether or not they belong to a club.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km and 10 km courses with a light cross-country character
Kalimandscharo Half Marathon course over 21.1 km
A range of distances from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon
additional: The late entry fee of EUR 3.00 is waived for the 400 m and 1,500 m races for all U18 age groups. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured and eligible for rankings. Age-group classification is in accordance with the DLO. Measured courses, cross-country character, online registration, results published after the race, event held in all weather, various age groups

name: Lingelbacher Windmühlenlauf
description: The Lingelbach Windmill Run is a long-standing running event in Lingelbach near Alsfeld, taking place for the 21st time in 2026. The run is organized by TSV Lingelbach 1925 e.V. and offers various race distances for children, school students, and adults. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and scenic course around Lingelbach. Entry fees are paid in cash at the race-number collection.
course_highlights: Various distances (700 m, 5.3 km, 10 km)
Hilly routes offering a sporting challenge
Suitable for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers
additional: The entry fee must be paid in cash at race-number collection. The event takes place in June, with typical temperatures of around 23°C; there are various categories, including children’s races and walking. Cash payment is available on site.

name: Silberberglauf
price_range: regulärer Preis bis 01.06.2026, Last Minute bis 05.06.2026, vor Ort ab 08:30 Uhr
description: The 41st Silberberglauf offers runners and walkers varied courses around the Silberberg near Ilmenau. With distances of 21.1 km, 11 km and 6 km, as well as children’s races over 2.5 km and 0.6 km, there is something for all age groups and ability levels. The event is part of the Sparkassencup Saalfeld-Rudolstadt and the TLV-Cup, and promises a sporting atmosphere with refreshments, medals and awards ceremonies. The children’s sports festival in the afternoon rounds off the event in a family-friendly way.
course_highlights: Half marathon with approx. 600 m of elevation gain
11 km course with approx. 250 m of elevation gain and a Nordic walking category
Children’s races and a children’s sports festival in the afternoon
additional: Race number collection on race day from 07:30 to 08:45 for the main races; children’s races start at 14:00. Last-minute registration on site until 08:30 for the main races and until 14:40 for the children’s races. Refreshments along the courses and at the sports ground, changing facilities, toilets, finisher medals and certificates. Poles are mandatory for the 11 km course; running is prohibited. Baby joggers, dogs and bicycle escorts are not permitted for safety reasons. The finish closes for all courses at 13:00. Trail terrain, online registration via Race Result, equipment-related safety rules, participation in multiple cups

name: Wolfhager Volkslauf Rund um den Graner Berg
2. Jenaer Backyard Ultra
description: The 2nd Jena Backyard Ultra is a unique “Last Human Standing” race in Jena-Cospeda, Thuringia. All participants start together every hour on a 6.7 km loop, which they must complete within one hour. Anyone who fails to complete the loop or gives up is eliminated. The race ends when only one runner remains who completes the loop within the time limit. In addition to the individual competition, there is a team competition for teams of up to three participants, with the team that completes the most loops over the course of the event winning.

name: 41. Internationaler Sollinglauf
organizer: Laufgruppe des Dasseler Sport-Clubs von 1920 e.V.
description: The 41st International Solling Run takes place in the Solling area near Dassel. The event offers various race distances, from 400 m to the Leaders Akademie Solling Marathon over 42.5 km. The routes pass through the diverse landscape of the Solling and offer suitable options for ambitious runners, recreational runners, and walkers. The event is organized by Dasseler Sport-Club von 1920 e.V. and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and attractive prize money.

name: Below- Gedenk- und Heidelauf
description: The Below Memorial and Heath Run is a traditional race through the Wittstock Heath and forest, held annually by LC Dosse Wittstock e.V. The 8.5 km course is open to women, men and young people and offers varied natural scenery. In addition to the main race, there are classifications for young people and schoolchildren, as well as a school cup classification. The event is part of the Brandenburg Cup and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with trophies for the overall winners and certificates for all participants.

name: Finkenwerder Insellauf (mit HH-Meisterschaften 5 km)
description: The Finkenwerder Island Run takes place in Finkenwerder, Hamburg, and offers a varied range of races for all age groups. The main races follow an accurately measured, flat 5 km loop through green spaces and along the Elbe, ideal for fast times and the Hamburg 5 km Championships. In addition to the main distances, there are age-appropriate races for children and young people, as well as relay and walking events. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish right at Finkenwerder Market Square, and its sustainable approach, including reusable cups and recycled medals.

name: Oranienburger Stundenlauf
description: The Oranienburg Hour Run is a varied track running competition behind Oranienburg Palace. The event offers various races with time limits of 15, 30 and 60 minutes, as well as a 400-metre children’s race and Nordic walking. Races are divided by age group and gender, and all laps completed within the time limit count. Every finisher receives a medal, and certificates and awards ceremonies are provided for the top runners.

name: Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow LC/NLC
description: The Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow is a traditional running event held in Güstrow, Germany. The event is organized by Tri Fun Güstrow e. V. and offers various distances for different age groups. The main event is a 10 km race for runners aged U20 and above, complemented by shorter races for young people and children. The 48th edition of this local event takes place at the InselseeHeidberg beach and promises a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany’s first beach marathon and takes place on the island of Usedom. The races run exclusively over sand along the Baltic Sea beach, with no asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique natural running experience right by the sea. Participants can choose from the marathon, half marathon, 10 km short-distance race, or marathon relay. The event combines a sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional program in the finish area in Ahlbeck.

name: Volkslauf des MTV Soltau powered by Stadtwerke Soltau
description: Der Volkslauf des MTV Soltau powered by Stadtwerke Soltau ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf in Soltau, der Läufer aller Altersklassen willkommen heißt. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine sportliche Herausforderung in einer freundlichen und familiären Atmosphäre. Der Lauf fördert die Gemeinschaft und den Breitensport in der Region und wird von engagierten lokalen Partnern unterstützt.

name: Wremer Deichlauf
description: Der Wremer Deichlauf ist das traditionelle Highlight der Sportsaison des TuS Wremen 09 und lädt alle Laufsportfreund*innen herzlich ein. Angeboten werden zwei Strecken: eine kurze Runde über 5.300 Meter und eine lange Strecke über 15.900 Meter durch die grüne Marsch. Die Strecken verlaufen überwiegend auf asphaltierten Rad- und Wirtschaftswegen und führen auch außendeichs direkt an der Wasser- und Wattkante entlang. Auf der kurzen Runde gibt es zudem einen gesonderten Walkingwettbewerb.
course_highlights: Streckenführung überwiegend auf asphaltierten Rad- und Wirtschaftswegen
Lauf direkt an der Wasser- und Wattkante auf dem Treibselräumweg
Zwei Streckenlängen: 5,3 km und 15,9 km durch die grüne Marsch
additional: Walkingwettbewerb auf der 5.300 Meter Runde

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
location: Fort Poznań Event Place, Poznań, Poland
description: Poznańska Piwna Mila to cykl biegów na dystansie mili, które łączą rywalizację sportową z pasją biegania oraz propagowaniem aktywnego stylu życia. Impreza odbywa się w Fort Poznań Event Place w Poznaniu i przyciąga biegaczy chcących zmierzyć się na krótkim, dynamicznym dystansie. Atmosfera wydarzenia sprzyja zarówno sportowej rywalizacji, jak i integracji uczestników.
course_highlights: Bieg na dystansie jednej mili
Organizacja w Fort Poznań Event Place
Cykl biegów łączący sport i pasję biegania

name: MnO Jaszczur i Czerwony Most
description: Maraton na Orientację "Jaszczur i Czerwony Most" to impreza organizowana przez Zgromadzenie Wędrownicze w Koszalinie. Jest to wydarzenie dla miłośników biegania na orientację, łączące sportową rywalizację z eksploracją terenów. Uczestnicy mogą liczyć na wymagające trasy i atmosferę przygody. Impreza ma charakter kameralny i odbywa się w malowniczych okolicach.
course_highlights: Trasy biegnące przez zróżnicowany teren
Elementy biegu na orientację wymagające nawigacji
Malownicze okolice Koszalina

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique street race held in the magical setting of Toruń, the city of Nicolaus Copernicus. Participants can choose between the 10 km and 5 km distances, and can also take part in Nordic Walking. The race starts in the evening, offering an unforgettable experience of the city’s nighttime atmosphere. The finish is at the Municipal Stadium, and the organizers provide a bag drop and support from volunteers.
course_highlights: The 10 km course starts at Galeria Copernicus, 15 Żółkiewskiego Street
The 5 km and Nordic Walking start at Józef Piłsudski Bridge, Camping Tramp, Dybowska Street
Finish at the Municipal Stadium, 23/29 Bema Street
additional: The time limit for the 10 km is 1 hour 20 minutes. The time limit for the 5 km is 50 minutes, and for Nordic Walking it is 60 minutes. The race office is located at Galeria Copernicus next to the Decathlon store and is open on June 6 from 15:00 to 21:00. The organizer provides a bag drop at the start and transports belongings to the finish. Volunteers hand out bag-drop bags marked with the race number; participants must tie them themselves and hand them in before the race.

name: Hollen in Heesch
description: Hollen in Heesch is a running event for all ages and abilities, from beginners to advanced runners, held in the heart of Heesch. Participants can choose from several distances and enjoy a beautiful course through the village, with the start and finish in the atmospheric courtyard of the Eijnderic. The event concludes with a lively afterparty at the same location, making it a sporting and festive highlight for everyone. The run is open to individuals, groups, friends, and colleagues, and offers a warm and enthusiastic atmosphere.
course_highlights: A beautiful 2.5 km course through the heart of Heesch
Depending on the distance, run 2 or 4 laps through the streets of Heesch
Start and finish in the atmospheric courtyard of the Eijnderic
additional: There is a 1- or 2-kilometer Kids Run for children. A 10-week start-to-run training course is offered in collaboration with Fruntrunners to prepare beginner runners. The event ends with an afterparty in the courtyard of the Eijnderic. Volunteers are welcome to help with various tasks, such as monitoring barriers and handing out water. The event is aimed at all ages, with an emphasis on community spirit, fun, and an afterparty.

name: Västerås Stadslopp
price_range: 2026: 120–400 kr beroende på lopp och anmälningstid
description: Västerås Stadslopp is a community festival in Vasaparken, inviting runners of all ages to take part in different races, including children’s races and team races. The event is organised by Västerås Friidrottsklubb and offers a great atmosphere, activities for children, mascots, and opportunities to participate regardless of disability. Race bibs are collected at the venue, and services include bag drop and water stations. Teams that register receive a food hamper after crossing the finish line, making it a fun and sociable running experience.
course_highlights: Children’s races with three different distances to choose from
Children’s activity area with an obstacle course, high jump and shot put
Start and finish in Vasaparken, with toilets and water refill points
additional: Race bibs are collected at Vasaparken on 7 June from 09:00, with a separate collection time for the 2.5 km race and longer distances after 11:00. Teams of four receive a food hamper after crossing the finish line. Toilets and water refill points are available at Rådhuset near the start. Bag drop is available, but there is no cover. The children’s races are limited to 400 participants and are fully booked for 2026. Mascots and a children’s activity area will be on site. The date for 2027 will be announced later. Teams of four can receive a food hamper/picnic after the race.

name: 17. Klingenthal Salzkotten Marathon
description: The 17th Klingenthal Salzkotten Marathon offers a unique running weekend with an exhilarating atmosphere in the heart of Salzkotten. The routes pass through the town and the district of Verne, are officially measured, and offer a top-level sporting experience. In the shade of the Salzkotten saltworks, runners can enjoy a first-class refreshment area and a relaxed chill-out area. All event proceeds go directly to youth programs run by local clubs, supporting sport in the region.
course_highlights: Attractive loop course of approximately 10.55 km through Salzkotten and Verne
Marathon and half-marathon courses officially measured and compliant with IWR/DLO rules
Loop course with around 25 metres of elevation gain; flat 10 km course ideal for personal bests
additional: Start times vary by distance: the marathon and half marathon start at 08:30, the 10 km race at 10:30, the 5 km race at 11:30, and the Bambini races from 15:30, with different start times for each age group. The courses are officially measured and comply with international competition rules. On event day, roads through the town and side streets will be closed from approximately 06:30 to 16:00. A supervised bicycle parking area is available at the Sälzerhalle car park in exchange for a voluntary donation. The NUNAV app is recommended for a stress-free journey and parking search. The marathon places particular emphasis on community and team spirit, with company teams able to take part in the team competition. The event also offers parking, pacemaker teams, and a family program.

name: Harzgeröder Klippenlauf
description: The Harzgeröder Klippenlauf is a varied popular and cross-country race in the Lower Harz, suitable for runners of all ability levels. Distances range from 1 km for children to a challenging half marathon of 21.1 km with 450 metres of elevation gain. The routes run through the Selke Valley along the Selketalstieg, past the districts of Mägdesprung and Alexisbad, with rocky sections, narrow trail paths and a rock tunnel. Alongside the sporting challenge, the Klippenlauf offers fun for the whole family, including a raffle and other events. The start and finish are at the dog training ground in Harzgerode.
course_highlights: Rocky sections and challenging climbs
Narrow trail paths along the Selketalstieg
Rock tunnel on the 15 km and half-marathon courses
additional: The start and finish are at the dog training ground in Harzgerode, where the race office and race-number distribution are located. Safety pins may not be used to attach race numbers; race belts are available for 5 EUR. Separate starts are held for the taster run (1 km), schoolchildren’s race (2.5 km), everyone’s race (5 km), main race (15 km) and half marathon (21.1 km). A raffle offers great prizes for participants. The event is one of the region’s major running and sporting events. Participants can pre-order a running shirt, registration is available online, and running with dogs is prohibited. The event is limited to 600 participants.

name: Benrather Schlosslauf 2026
location: Schlosspark Schloss Benrath, Düsseldorf-Benrath, Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 14 EUR (5 km), 16 EUR (10 km), 3 EUR (Bambinilauf), 7 EUR (Schülerlauf), 0 EUR (Inklusionslauf), 15 EUR (Staffel)
description: The Benrather Schlosslauf takes place in the grounds of Benrath Palace in Düsseldorf-Benrath. The event offers 5 km and 10 km races, both run on flat, shaded paths through the park. There are also shorter races for children, school groups, and people with disabilities, making it a family-friendly and inclusive event. The course starts and finishes on the palace’s north terrace and is easily accessible by public transport.
course_highlights: Flat, shaded paths through Benrath Palace Park
One 5 km loop or two loops for 10 km
Start and finish on the north terrace of Benrath Palace
additional: The program also includes a 1.44 km schoolchildren’s race, a free PAULI inclusion run, a Bambini race, and a primary school relay. The U72 tram stops right by Benrath Palace, and Benrath station is a 10-minute walk away. In June, expect an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny weather. Medals for all participants, trophies for winners, cash prizes for kindergartens, late registration available for a fee, dogs and jogging strollers are not permitted, start and finish at Benrath Palace, easily accessible by public transport

name: Deichlauf
organizer: TSV Winsen (Luhe) von 1850 e.V. und SV Greven
description: The Deichlauf in Hohnstorf/Elbe offers a varied running program, with races for children and teenagers, an Olympic school relay, and 5 km and 10 km races. The event is sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The scenic route follows the dike and offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, family atmosphere. Special and team categories add to the excitement of the competition.
course_highlights: Running routes along the Elbe dike
A variety of distances from 1000 m to 10 km
An Olympic school relay as a special highlight
additional: Showers are not available. Medical staff are on hand at the finish and along the route. Photos and videos will be taken by an appointed service provider and may be published. The event is a community gathering with a particular focus on families and nature lovers.

name: Lingener Citylauf
description: The Lingener City Run is a long-standing event held each year on and around Lingener Market Square. For the 35th time, the city centre will become a sporting stage full of energy and community spirit. The event offers various distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 10-kilometre relay with up to 100 teams. The course runs through the city centre and is part of the EL Cup. The event is a highlight for runners and spectators from the region and beyond.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Lingener Market Square
Route through the city centre of Lingen
Part of the EL Cup, with 5 km and 10 km runs
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the start for a fee of €3.00. Bib number distribution begins at 10:00 on race day. Changing facilities and restrooms are available in the Bäumerstraße gym, about 500 m from the market square. Timing is recorded using transponders attached to the bib numbers, which must be handed in after the race. Parking is available, among other places, in the Marktplatz underground car park and at the Alter Pferdemarkt car park. Due to road closures, access to parking in the city centre will be restricted on the event day. Start and finish on Lingener Market Square, parking in the city centre, changing facilities at the Bäumerstraße gym, no timing for the children's race

name: Neustädter Stadtlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany

name: 14. Stadtlauf des TSV Neustadt
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: Der 14. Stadtlauf des TSV Neustadt am Rübenberge ist ein barrierearmer Volkslauf, der Gemeinschaft und soziale Verbundenheit fördert. Die Veranstaltung steht für ein inklusives Miteinander und richtet sich an Läufer aller Altersgruppen und Leistungsniveaus. Der Lauf findet in der Stadt Neustadt am Rübenberge statt und bietet eine sportliche Plattform für Jung und Alt, um gemeinsam aktiv zu sein.
course_highlights: Barrierearmer Lauf für inklusive Teilhabe
Gemeinschaftliches Miteinander und soziale Verbundenheit
Veranstaltung in Neustadt am Rübenberge

name: 21. ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf
description: The ProPotsdam Schlösserlauf in Potsdam is a unique running event that combines tradition, culture, and sporting challenge. The course passes through the historic palaces, gardens, and landmarks of the state capital of Brandenburg, offering runners an unforgettable experience in a UNESCO World Heritage Site. With more than 4,500 participants, the race is a popular event for runners of all abilities. Experience the special atmosphere and the diverse sights along the route through the city’s history.

name: 45. Wehlheider Volkslauf
description: The Wehlheider Volkslauf is a traditional recreational running event in Schönfeld Park in Kassel-Wehlheiden and is part of the Nordhessencup. The course runs mainly along paved paths and through wooded areas, with various distances for all age groups. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. Changing and shower facilities are available, and runners are provided with refreshments along the course.

name: Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf
organizer: Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. und Freunde des Vogelberglaufes
description: The Bleicheröder Vogelberglauf is a traditional race held in Bleicherode. The event offers four distances (2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 20 km) on road and trail courses, starting at the former Schneckenhengst youth hostel building. The race is organized by Ski- und Wanderverein 1954 Bleicherode e.V. and Freunde des Vogelberglaufes. Results are scored according to the age-group system of the German Athletics Association, with specific age restrictions for younger participants. Trophies and certificates are awarded to the top runners in various categories.

name: Norderstedter Stadtlauf
description: The Norderstedt City Run is a popular running event held annually by Norderstedter Sportverein e.V. Runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in various races, including the 5-kilometer race, 10-kilometer race, fun run and children’s run. The event offers a sporting atmosphere on closed, traffic-free routes and is supported by the police, the THW and volunteers. The run promotes community, fun and health and is a highlight of the regional sports calendar.

name: Everstener Brunnenlauf 2026
description: The Everstener Brunnenlauf is a long-standing running event in Oldenburg. Various races are offered, including races for schoolchildren, a 6.3 km corporate and taster run, and a 10 km fun run. The route passes through the Eversten district, starting on Wienstraße and finishing in Eversten Holz. The event is known for its large number of participants and family-friendly atmosphere, appealing to both recreational and competitive runners.

name: FLVW Halbmarathonmeisterschaften
description: Die FLVW Halbmarathonmeisterschaften finden am 6. Juni 2027 in Salzkotten statt und werden vom Fußball- und Leichtathletik-Verband Westfalen (FLVW) ausgerichtet. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Läuferinnen und Läufer, die sich für die westfälische Halbmarathonmeisterschaft qualifizieren möchten. Die Meisterschaft bietet eine sportliche Herausforderung auf einer Halbmarathonstrecke und fördert den regionalen Laufsport. Interessierte werden gebeten, sich zeitnah anzumelden, um an diesem traditionsreichen Wettbewerb teilzunehmen.

name: Haster Volkslauf
description: The Haster Volkslauf 2026 takes place on June 7 in Osnabrück-Haste and offers races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini races, an inclusive fun run, and short- and long-distance races. The course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Haste and is recognized as an officially sanctioned race by the German Athletics Association. Participants receive medals and trophies, with the awards ceremony held immediately afterward at the sports field. The entry fee also supports a fundraising campaign for “Jede Oma zählt.”

name: Hopfengarten-Pokallauf - Landescup 9
description: The Hopfengarten Cup Race is part of the Novo Nordisk State Cup Saxony-Anhalt and takes place in Magdeburg. The event is organized by the Saxony-Anhalt Athletics Association (Leichtathletik-Verband Sachsen-Anhalt e.V.) and is open to runners of all age groups. The State Cup provides a sporting platform for ambitious runners and promotes running in the region. Runners must register through the LADV registration portal, and the association’s age-group and course recommendations apply.

name: Lauf um die Himmelsschaukel Bründersen 2026
description: The Run around the Sky Swing in Bründersen is a traditional scoring race in the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup. Various distances are offered, from 400 meters to 20 kilometers, suitable for all age groups, from Bambini to seniors. The event takes place at the Bründersen sports field and offers a varied course through the beautiful surrounding area. The race is part of TSV Bründersen 1967 e.V. and combines sporting competition with community and regional ties.

name: ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau
description: The ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau is being held for the 36th time and offers races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 400 m Bambini run. The courses are officially measured and suitable for record attempts, with the start and finish at the TSV Ratekau sports field. There are suitable races for all ability levels, including a schoolchildren’s cup that runs throughout the calendar year. The event places great emphasis on safety, with road closures, and provides refreshments along the course and in the finish area.

name: La Sportiva Sauerland Trailrun powered by Sport Schneider
X Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Akt...
location: Boisko przy ul. Leśnej, Wdzydze Kiszewskie, Poland
description: The Northern Poland Running and Physical Activity Festival in Wdzydze is the tenth anniversary edition of an event promoting running and physical activity in the picturesque landscapes of Kashubia. The event takes place June 5–7 and features five main races in the Hard Runner series, with distances ranging from 1.6 km to a half marathon. Participants compete for an overall ranking based on the total points earned across all races. The festival brings together the running community of Northern Poland while also promoting local culture and nature.
course_highlights: Routes of 1.6 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and a half marathon (21 km)
Picturesque landscapes of Kashubia and the forests of the Kościerzyna Forest District
Routes available to view on the Traseo platform
additional: Race number with a timing chip (returnable). The race office is open during the festival. The overall ranking is based on the total points earned across five races. Recognition for the top competitors from the Municipality of Kościerzyna.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
location: Opalenie, Gmina Gniew, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The XIII DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon in Memory of Barbara Karaczyńska is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie to coincide with the anniversary of the founding of the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Center. The marathon course is entirely paved, runs through the picturesque fields and forests of Kociewie, is certified by the Polish Athletics Association, and features numerous fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race is demanding due to the terrain and thermal conditions, but offers beautiful views and an unforgettable atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal, and everyone receives a commemorative medal, diploma, and T-shirt.
course_highlights: An entirely paved course through the fields and forests of Kociewie
646 m of total elevation gain with numerous steep climbs
The course is marked every 1 km, with refreshment stations every 5 km and mobile refreshment stations
additional: A recovery meal is served after the race. The 10 km “Olka” course is paved and partially follows the half-marathon course. The entry fee is donated in full to the DASZRADE Foundation, which supports people recovering from addiction.

name: XXX Bieg Łagowskiego Lata
location: Łagów, Świebodzin County, Lubusz Voivodeship, Poland

name: De Loop van Leidsche Rijn
distance_verbose: 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Eiberrun
description: The Eiberrun is a friendly and sporty running event in Eibergen, taking place on Sunday 6 June 2027. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a corporate run, kids’ runs and a spectacular Urban Fun Run for young people. The event starts and finishes at the welcoming De Brink sports square, which is transformed into a lively venue especially for the occasion. The routes pass through the village and the Mallum countryside, with challenging and enjoyable courses for all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The 10 km distance covers the 5 km loop through the village and Mallum countryside twice
Start and finish at the welcoming De Brink sports square
Urban Fun Run route through shops and over obstacles in the village
additional: Race numbers with timing chips will be ready for collection at the registration desk on De Brink. They can be collected on Saturday 5 June (time to be confirmed) and on Sunday 6 June from 09:00 until half an hour before the start. For registrations received before 12:00 on 31 May, the participant’s name will appear on the race number. Late registration is available on race day from 09:00 at a higher price. Prize ceremonies will take place at around 12:00 and 13:00. ASV Eibergen also offers clinics and training sessions to help participants prepare. Registration for the event on 6 June 2027 is open, with clinics and volunteer opportunities also available. The event starts and finishes at De Brink sports square, where participants can also enjoy the friendly atmosphere.

name: MÕSA Challenge
distance_verbose: Marathon, 20 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1.2 km, 0.7 km

name: Voss Løpskarusell 3
description: Voss Running Series is a running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00 in 2027. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at the sports ground, and passes through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. You can enter individual races or all six races together, with a discount for early registration. The event welcomes recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up to an enjoyable fun run in Voss.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at the sports ground
Route through Prestegardsmoen
Race along the waterfront promenade
additional: Registration is online via EQ Timing. There is a discount for registering for all six races before the second race. The fifth race, on 20 September, starts at 18:30, earlier than the other races.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 3
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is a friendly running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up, and a discount is available when registering for all six races in the series. This is a great recreational race in the beautiful surroundings of Voss.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: All races start at 19:00, except the fifth race on 20 September, which starts at 18:30. Registration is online only via EQ Timing. A discount is available when registering for all six races before the second race.

name: 37. Campuslauf Technische Universität Clausthal
description: The 37th Campus Run at Clausthal University of Technology is taking place, offering runners a sporting challenge on campus. The event includes several race distances, including one lap, three laps, and a children’s run. The run is a popular university sports event that welcomes students, staff, and guests alike. There is also a Campus Open Air, creating a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Gallaberget Trailrun
description: Gallaberget Trailrun is a trail race organized by Vretstorps IF Löpning. The race features a more challenging course with plenty of trails and forest terrain, offering a demanding and scenic running experience. After the race, participants can enjoy some social time with hot dogs in buns and a swim in the evening sunshine. The event attracts runners of different ages and abilities and is appreciated for its great atmosphere and well-organized arrangements.
course_highlights: A more challenging course with plenty of trails
Forest terrain and scenic surroundings
Hot dogs in buns and a swim in the evening sunshine after the race
additional: After the race, hot dogs in buns are served, and participants can swim in the evening sunshine. Previous races have had around 65 registered runners and included great prizes from sponsors such as Vitamin Well and Nocco. The 2026 edition had a 10 km race category. After the race, hot dogs in buns were served, and participants could go for a swim.

name: Avesta Night Sky Run Knattelopp
description: Avesta Night Sky Run is an evening trail race held at Dalahästens ski centre in Avesta. The race offers two distances, 3.33 km and 10 km, which mostly follow the trails on the esker around the ski slope. It is an enjoyable and challenging off-road course suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is part of Dalaportens OL’s competition programme and offers a unique running experience in the evening.
course_highlights: Trail race over 3.33 km or 10 km
The course mostly follows trails on the esker
Runs around the ski slope at Dalahästens ski centre
additional: Participants receive a medal and Festis.

name: Vestfold løpskarusell - 5. løp - Tønsbergmarka

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 kr. for ikke medlemmer frem til 31.12.26.

description: Vestfold Running Series 2027 is a series of 8 great races in the Tønsberg region, offering the joy of running, community and a great atmosphere for all levels. Each race has two distances, and starts at 18:00. Participants can choose to enter individual races or buy a season pass for all races at a discounted price. The races take place in varied and beautiful surroundings, with electronic timing provided by EQ Timing. Course descriptions are shared in a Facebook group.
course_highlights: Two distances per race, ranging from approximately 2.3 km to 6.9 km depending on the location
Races in beautiful natural areas such as Essoskogen, Tønsbergmarka, Vear, Teieskogen and Revetal
Start and finish at central, accessible locations such as car parks, lifebuoys and sports halls
additional: Season-pass participants collect their race number at the first race. Participants entering individual races collect theirs at race headquarters 10 minutes before the start. The season pass must be kept throughout the series. Course descriptions and profiles are shared in the Facebook group.

name: Borgenløpet
description: Borgenløpet is organized by Borgen IL and offers an inclusive running experience for all ages and ability levels. The event features a 7 km trail course called Åsmarkarunden, as well as a shorter 4 km route for those who prefer it. There is also a children’s race, held as the final event in the sports school’s running series. The event includes an open kiosk, a commentator, and a great atmosphere, and invites everyone to enjoy a fun community celebration at Borgen.
course_highlights: 7 km trail course called Åsmarkarunden
Shorter 4 km route for those who prefer it
Children’s race for the youngest participants, held as the final event
additional: The event features an open kiosk, a commentator, and plenty of activity. The race is open to everyone, from recreational runners to elite athletes. The event concludes the sports school’s running series with a children’s race.

name: Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The 19th MittSommerNachtsLauf is an open race for everyone, with a steady pace of approx. 6 min/km, or 6 km/h for walking. The race starts at 7 p.m. in the village center of Marklohe and finishes at the heated outdoor pool in Wietzen, where the swimming pool will remain open until 10 p.m. and the support association will provide refreshments. The running route is up to 18 km, with additional starting points at 13, 10 and 5 km. The walking route is up to 10 km or 5 km. The event promises a sporting evening in beautiful surroundings and is open to everyone who enjoys running or walking.

name: 42. Bugasee-Marathon
description: The 42nd Bugasee Marathon takes place in Kassel and is organized by Laufwerk Kassel under the direction of Sylke Kuhn. The course is 42.3 km long and runs on flat, paved park paths around Bugasee in the Fuldaaue. The marathon consists of a 1.7 km opening section followed by 10 laps of 4.06 km each. The event is designed as a birthday marathon and offers a personal atmosphere without an entry fee, as this is covered by the birthday celebrant.

name: 41. AZ-Abendvolkslauf
description: The 41st AZ Evening Fun Run takes place in Uelzen and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. From short introductory runs for children to the 5 km and 10 km main races, as well as walking, Nordic walking and recreational hiking, there is something for everyone. The course passes through Uelzen’s historic city center and along the Ilmenau meadows, among other places. The race is an established event supported by dedicated volunteers and numerous sponsors from the region.
course_highlights: The course passes through Uelzen’s historic city center
The 10 km loop is run twice
Sections along the Ilmenau meadows and over the Katzenbuckel Bridge
additional: Late registration is possible on race day until approximately 1 hour before each event; the late registration fee is €3.00 (except for the introductory run and hiking). All children’s and school-age races up to 2.0 km award medals at the finish. Certificates can be printed online after the event. The start for all events is on Albertstraße, in front of the turning area.

name: Citylauf Grevenbroich
description: The Citylauf Grevenbroich is a family-friendly running event featuring nine different races for sports enthusiasts of all ages. The event offers ideal courses, great entertainment and top-notch organization, supported by the entire city. Alongside the sporting competition, there is an attractive entertainment program and coveted prizes for the top finishers. The races range from short Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to open and city championship races over 5 km and 10 km.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 700 m to 10 km
City championship race in the Sparkassen-Lauf over 10 km
Family-friendly event with nine races and a great entertainment program
additional: Nine races with start times from 17:30 to 20:40, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s and relay races. Certificates for all participants, plus medals and prizes for the top finishers. Timing provided by TAF-Timing. The event is a major city event with plenty of support and an entertainment program. Multiple race distances, online registration, chip timing, results since 2015, anniversary event in 2026

name: Holstenköstenlauf
organizer: SVT Neumünster in Kooperation mit BMS Die Laufgesellschaft mbH
price_range: 10 km Lauf: 23,00 Euro bis 26,00 Euro, 5 km Lauf: 13,00 Euro bis 16,00 Euro, Holstenkösten-Becher: 12,00 Euro
description: The Holstenköstenlauf in Neumünster is a traditional city race held as part of Schleswig-Holstein’s largest city festival, the Holstenköste. The event offers races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, and takes runners through various parts of Neumünster. The 10 km course is officially measured according to DLV rules and offers an attractive route through the city center, Tungendorf, and Brachenfeld. All finishers receive a coveted festival medal as a memento of the event.
course_highlights: Attractive course through the city center, Tungendorf, and Brachenfeld
10 km course officially measured according to DLV rules
Start and finish at Kleinflecken, with the same start and finish line
additional: Participation available for various age groups; registration online or on site; bib number collection in the foyer of the Stadthalle; refreshments on the course and at the finish; award ceremonies in the evening

name: Oesterweger Feuerwehrlauf
description: The Oesterweg Fun Run and Fire Brigade Run in Versmold offers a varied running program for all ages and ability levels. From short Bambini and school runs with no entry fee to an officially measured 10 km road race and a 6 km team and fire brigade run, there is something for everyone. The flat, asphalted routes pass through the town center, with spectators providing plenty of encouragement. Walkers can also enjoy a scenic 6 km tour through the rural countryside alongside the event.
course_highlights: Flat, asphalted routes through the center of Oesterweg
10 km loop course with four identical laps plus an introductory lap
6 km loops for the team and fire brigade runs, as well as walking
additional: The Bambini run (450 m) and school run (1.2 km) have no entry fee. Participants up to age 11 are eligible for the school run standings; the taster run is for participants up to age 15. The team and fire brigade run consists of teams of four participants each. Walkers start alongside the fire brigade run from the rear rows so they do not interfere with the runners. Various distances, online registration, downloadable race brochures, special categories for fire brigades and teams, results on TimeTeamJung.

name: Schwerter Ruhrstadtlauf
description: The Schwerter Ruhrstadtlauf takes place at the GWG-Schwerte-Arena and welcomes numerous runners in its established format. The afternoon is dedicated to younger participants with shorter distances, while the longer races are the main attraction in the evening. Particularly popular are the relay races for Bambini and youth, as well as the Nordic walking event along the scenic Ruhr Valley Cycle Path. The 10 km course is measured in accordance with DLV criteria and follows a loop over paved and surfaced paths through a wooded area, finishing in the stadium.
course_highlights: 10 km course measured in accordance with DLV criteria
Loop course along the paved Ruhr Valley Cycle Path and surfaced forest paths
Finish in the stadium at the GWG Schwerte Arena
additional: Late entries are possible up to 60 minutes before the start of the relevant race for a fee of €3 (Bambini entries are free). The entry fee includes timing via a single-use transponder, a personalized certificate, shower facilities at the VfB Westhofen clubhouse, baggage storage (no liability accepted), water stations for the 5 km and 10 km races, and drinks in the finish area. The event takes place in all weather. The event offers a variety of running opportunities for all age groups and supports community sports. Registration is through the official website, and the event takes place on a Friday in June.

name: Voxtruper Volkslauf
description: The 13th Voxtrup Fun Run in Osnabrück offers a varied selection of races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes distances from 0.4 km for Bambinis to the 9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain. The races take runners through very scenic countryside, with several refreshment stations to support participants. Late entries are possible on the day of the event, and the event prioritises a safe and smooth race experience. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed.
course_highlights: Very scenic countryside run with a range of distances
9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain
Several refreshment stations depending on the distance (up to four for 9.8 km)
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event, up to 45 minutes before the respective race. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. Certificates can be printed online, and results are available at www.laufen-os.de. Refreshment stations: 1 at 3.9 km, 2 at 5.5 km, and 4 at 9.8 km. Participants can register on site; dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. The courses are designed to take runners through scenic countryside.

name: 14. Garbsener Citylauf
description: The 14th Garbsen City Run is Garbsen’s largest sporting event and offers races for all age groups and ability levels. There are six different races, from a 500-meter parent-child run to the 10,000-meter Agon Tax Run. The courses pass through Rathausplatz, the IGS grounds, along Meyenfelder Straße, and by Berenbosteler See. The event is family-friendly and emphasizes fun and community, supported by a dedicated organizing team and numerous volunteers.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2026 Lauf 1: 36. Donoper Volkslauf
description: The first race, the 36th Donoper Volkslauf, is organized by SC Donop 1948 e.V. and offers a varied 7,777-meter route around the Donop sports field in Blomberg-Donop. The series combines a sporting challenge with nature and community, and is open to runners, walkers, and hikers.

name: Derentaler Löwenlauf
description: The Derental Lion Run is a traditional race in the Weser Uplands, designed as a family-friendly sporting event for all ages. The event offers various distances through the beautiful Derental countryside and the Steinbach Valley. It places particular emphasis on diversity, tolerance, and working together, supported by a donation to the “augen auf!” Foundation for every participant. The race is organized with great care by the Weserbergland Runners Derental and promises an unforgettable day for children, young people, adults, and seniors.

name: Kleinbahn-Lauf
description: The Kleinbahn Run in Rhauderfehn is a fun run without timekeeping, welcoming runners and walkers on 5- and 10-kilometer routes. There are also children’s races for kindergarten and primary school children, enthusiastically cheered on by parents and grandparents. The 10 km loop starts at the marketplace and runs along the Hauptfehn Canal, through the villages of Holtermoor and Rhaude, and back to the finish via the Ostfriesland hiking trail. The 5 km route also starts at the marketplace and follows the Ostfriesland hiking trail back to the finish. The race offers a lovely opportunity to experience the region along varied routes.

name: Mittsommerlauf
distance_verbose: 10.2 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5.2 km, 3000 Meter, 1 km

name: Loop door Houten
description: Loop door Houten is an atmospheric running event held annually in the centre of Houten. It offers a range of distances, from the Kidsrun and Jeugdloop for primary school children to the 5 and 10 kilometres, the SAMSAMLOOP for pairs, and a team race for teams of four runners. The course passes through Oude Dorp and Castellum, with the finish at Het Plein, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and enthusiastic participants. Volunteers play an important role in the event’s success, which is also a celebration of running and having fun together.
course_highlights: Kidsrun and Jeugdloop through Oude Dorp, with several passes over Het Plein
5 and 10 km course with water stations in Castellum and a pass over Het Plein
Team race in which four runners finish together after relay handovers at various points
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day of the event from 16:00 to 19:15 in the hall of Roskam in Oude Dorp. Digital late registration is available until 18:00 on the day of the event, as long as the maximum number of participants has not been reached. Pre-registration opens on 15 March. The schedule includes a warm-up for the Kidsrun/Jeugdloop and a walking event at 17:45, with the walks starting at 18:00, the Kidsrun at 18:10, the Jeugdloop at 18:25, the SAMSAMLOOP at 19:10, and the 5 km, 10 km and Team Race at 19:40. Awards are presented in various categories after the event. Training opportunities and course familiarisation sessions are offered beforehand. The organisers ask participants to prepare properly, including by following advice on running in high temperatures. Distances range from the Kidsrun (1 km) to 10 km, including the Jeugdloop and SAMSAMLOOP. Registration is open and volunteers are wanted. The event takes place in Houten.

name: The Alpaca Race
description: The Alpaca Race is a trail race held in Gothenburg’s beautiful Hisingsparken. It is a technically demanding race, and only a few runners have completed the full distance. The race offers a unique nature experience and a challenge for both recreational runners and experienced trail runners. Preparations include course test runs and group training sessions that foster community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: Technically demanding trail course in Hisingsparken
Running on forest trails with varied elevation changes
Scenic natural setting in Gothenburg
additional: Test runs are usually held three times a year, with no advance registration required. The start and meeting point is at IF Kville’s clubhouse, which has toilets, changing rooms and showers. Participants are encouraged to travel to the event sustainably. A GPX file is available to download for personal training on the course. All participants receive a medal.

name: Öland Ultra Trail
description: Öland Ultra Trail is a fantastic trail adventure through the beautiful natural surroundings of northern Öland. The race offers two distances, 50 km and 25 km, starting from Böda Sand and Byxelkrok respectively, with both distances finishing at Böda Sand. The course offers scenic views and passes places such as Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, and pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Passes Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen
50 km starts at Böda Sand; 25 km starts at Byxelkrok
Both distances finish at Böda Sand
additional: Late registration is available until 11 June, as well as during bib collection on Friday 12 June from 19:00 to 20:00 and on race day, 13 June, from 07:30 to 09:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Aid stations are located along the course. A T-shirt is included in the entry fee for participants who register by 6 June and specify their shirt size. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal. Pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt if they register by 6 June. The 50 km race starts at 09:00 and the 25 km race at 10:00.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/oland-ultra/): 2027-06-12 — "Tid & datum 12 juni 2027 50 km kl. 09:00" (was estimated 2027-06-12)

name: Flosjön-Edstjärn
location: Flosjön–Edstjärn, Gagnef Municipality, Dalarna County, Sweden
description: Flosjön-Edstjärn is a half marathon organized annually by Edstjärns Idrottsklubb in Gagnef. The race is open to everyone and runs through scenic areas around Flosjön and Edstjärn. It is a well-established event that promotes sport and community, especially among young people. The club encourages participation in various sports and offers a great opportunity to experience beautiful scenery while running.
course_highlights: Half marathon around Flosjön and Edstjärn
Scenic views and varied terrain
Organized by the volunteer-run Edstjärns IK, with a focus on youth sports
additional: All registrations are binding, and participation is at your own risk. Personal data is handled by Edstjärns IK and Mitt Lopp. Names and results are published at www.eik.one. The organizer may stop the race if necessary to protect participants’ health and safety.

name: Öllsjö Löpfest 2026
description: Öllsjö Running Festival is a family-friendly and welcoming recreational race for participants of all ages and a range of physical abilities. The event offers several distances, including children’s races and longer routes, and focuses on the joy of movement and community. It features music and activities for the whole family, as well as a team competition with chip timing. This recurring running festival creates a wonderful atmosphere in Öllsjö every June.
course_highlights: Children’s races of 450 m and 1,700 m
5 km and 7.5 km trail-mix races
Automatic chip timing and a team competition
additional: The event area is open from 10:00 to 14:00. Bib pickup starts at 10:00. STC Härlöv leads warm-ups before the children’s races and the longer races. A candy shower for children takes place at 12:20. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:10 on the event area’s stage. Showers, changing facilities, and bag drop are available. The event has offered several different races and chip timing.

name: Bèrghem Ultra Trail 2027
description: Bèrghem Ultra Trail 2027 is a demanding ultramarathon set in the scenic surroundings of Ringsaker, Innlandet. The race features a long and challenging 135-kilometre course suited to experienced ultrarunners. Starting early in the morning, participants will experience varied terrain and beautiful scenery throughout the race. It is a great opportunity for runners looking for a real challenge in a spectacular landscape.
course_highlights: 135 km ultramarathon across varied terrain
Scenic surroundings in Ringsaker, Innlandet
Early morning start at 08:00
additional: There are currently 13 places available. Participants must have been born in 2007 or earlier.

name: Birkebeinerløpet
description: Birkebeinerløpet is Norway’s largest trail race and will be held on Saturday, 12 June 2027, for the 29th time. The race starts at Birkebeineren Ski Stadium in Lillehammer and finishes at Håkons Hall, taking runners through varied forest terrain with trails, cart roads and ski tracks from the Olympics. The course is 20.2 km long, with 337 metres of ascent and 569 metres of descent, offering participants a wonderful experience of nature and the true joy of running. Anyone who is 16 or older in 2027 can participate, and the race is part of the Birkebeinertrippelen.
course_highlights: Varied terrain including trails, grass, cart roads and ski tracks from the 1994 Olympics
The course is 20.2 km with 337 metres of ascent and 569 metres of descent
Finish at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer
additional: There are intermediate timing points at Sjøsetervegen (approx. 7.7 km) and Kroken (approx. 14 km). The course may have some wet sections and steep downhill slopes; take extra care in wet conditions. Participants must be at least 16 years old by 31 December 2027. Participants must be at least 16 years old by 31 December 2027.

name: LøpeBirken 12km
description: LøpeBirken 12 km is a trail race being held for the 20th time on Saturday, 12 June 2027. The race starts at Birkebeineren Ski Stadium and finishes at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer, offering varied terrain with trails, gravel roads and ski tracks from the Winter Olympics. Participants can enjoy the authentic Birken atmosphere, challenges and wonderful nature experiences in a race that combines the joy of running with a sense of achievement. The race is open to everyone aged 16 and over with timing, and 15-year-olds may participate without timing.
course_highlights: Start at Birkebeineren Ski Stadium (525 m above sea level), with varied surfaces including grass, trails and a wide ski track
First refreshment station at 4.14 km, with water and Maxim
The course includes rolling terrain, steep hills and marsh sections, and finishes at Håkons Hall
additional: There are two refreshment stations on the course. Participants are advised to be aware of wet conditions and traffic when crossing local roads. The race finishes at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer. Participants aged 16 and over can run with timing; 15-year-olds may participate without timing.
