Food and drinks along the course and at the finish are included in the entry fee. A free shuttle bus runs from Håkons Hall to Birkebeineren Ski Stadium.

name: Birken fjellmaraton
description: Birken Mountain Marathon is a 42 km trail race through varied and beautiful mountain terrain from Sjusjøen to Lillehammer, finishing at Håkons Hall. The race offers an authentic experience of nature and a tough running challenge through high mountain terrain, trails, and gravel roads. It is a popular race that is part of the Birkebeiner Triple and is suited to runners looking for a demanding, scenic mountain marathon.
course_highlights: The race starts at Sjusjøen Cross-Country Arena, with 2 km of gravel road before the trail heads through high mountain terrain over Sjusjøfjellet and Lunkefjell
Varied surfaces include trails, gravel roads, and some wet and boggy sections near Nevelvannet
The final section includes steeper, rocky terrain, followed by the last 2 km on gravel road to the finish at Håkons Hall
additional: The race takes place on Saturday, 12 June 2027, for the ninth time. Anyone who is 18 years old by 31 December 2027 may take part. The race is part of the Birkebeiner Triple. There are several aid stations along the course, including the last one at Kroken, 6 km from the finish. The terrain is also suitable for runners with limited trail-running experience. It is recommended to run carefully on steep, rocky descents.

name: UltraBirken løp
description: UltraBirken Run is a 60 km ultramarathon from Sjusjøen Cross-Country Arena to the finish at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer. The race offers a tough running challenge across varied and demanding terrain, and is suited to runners who want to test their limits. It is held annually and is part of the Birkebeiner Triple, is approved as a qualifier for the UTMB 50K, and awards 2 ITRA points. The race continues to attract more participants and has a rich tradition of achievement and community.
course_highlights: Starts at Sjusjøen Cross-Country Arena, with 2 km of gravel road before the trail crosses high-mountain terrain over Sjusjøfjellet and Lunkefjell
The route crosses Krigsfjell, Hitfjell, Pellestova and Nevelfjell, the course’s highest point at 1,072 metres above sea level
The course ends with demanding, rocky and steep sections before reaching the finish on a gravel road outside Håkons Hall in Lillehammer
additional: The race awards 2 ITRA points and qualifies for the UTMB 50K. Participants must be at least 18 years old as of 31 December 2027. The race is part of the Birkebeiner Triple. The route has a total of 1,258 metres of elevation gain and 1,873 metres of descent. There may be muddy and wet sections, as well as steep and rocky sections where reducing your pace is recommended. Start time: 08:00. Participants must be 18 years old by 31 December 2027. The race awards 2 ITRA points and is approved as a UTMB 50K qualifier. Food and drinks at the stations are included in the entry fee.

name: UngdomsBirken løp
description: The UngdomsBirken Run is an approximately 5 km race for young people aged 12 to 16, starting at Stampesletta and finishing at Håkons Hall in Lillehammer. The race gives participants the chance to experience the true Birken atmosphere and cross the same finish line as thousands of other participants. It will be held for the 22nd time in 2027 and focuses on achievement, community and the joy of running, whether it is your first time or you have taken part before. The course passes through varied terrain, including gravel paths, a floodlit trail and scenic surroundings near Maihaugen.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km from Stampesletta to Håkons Hall
The course follows gravel paths, crosses Finnabrua and runs alongside the Mesna River
Finish at Håkons Hall in the true Birken atmosphere
additional: There is a drinks station with squash and water after approximately 2.5 km, as well as a food and drinks station at the finish serving water, squash and sausages from Gilde. Participants with special dietary needs are advised to bring their own packed meal. Everyone is encouraged to drink plenty of fluids before and during the race. Elevation figures for the course vary depending on GPS equipment and map data. For participants who turn 12–16 by 31 December 2027. Drinks are available at approximately 2.5 km, with food and drinks at the finish.

name: Haslummila
description: Haslummila is a road race starting and finishing at Bekkestua in Bærum, offering distances of 400 metres for children, 5 km for ambitious runners and 10 km for avid runners. The event is an inclusive, energetic running festival that focuses on time, personal achievement and the local community. The course takes in a variety of streets and paths, with several underpasses and scenic areas, and there are drink stations along the way. All participants receive a medal, and children also get ice cream as a prize. The event encourages the use of public transport and offers good nearby parking.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Bekkestua, with a 400 m children’s race on Bærumsveien
The 5 km course passes through underpasses beneath Kirkeveien and Bærumsveien, and by Haslum Klubbhus and Nadderud VGS
The 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km route
additional: Drinks will be available at the finish and at one drink station along the course (5 km runners pass it once; 10 km runners pass it twice). Participants are encouraged to use public transport, with both a bus station and a metro station within walking distance of the start/finish. Several parking garages are located nearby. Information about race numbers, clothing storage, toilets and AfterRun will be provided later. Drinks are available at the finish and at one station along the way. All participants receive a medal, and children also get ice cream.

name: Fana Backyard
price_range: 600 kr individuelt; 1000 kr per lag på to
description: Fana Backyard Ultra is organized by Gneist Friidrett and follows the classic Backyard Ultra rules, with a start every hour on the hour. The course is 6.706 km long and consists of asphalt, trails and gravel, with a total of 12 laps run within a time window from 09:00 to 21:00. The event takes place at Gneist Arena in Bergen and offers a challenging, sociable ultra-running experience with both individual and team classes. All participants have access to a base camp with facilities such as snacks, drinks, changing rooms and toilets, and finishers receive T-shirts.
course_highlights: 6.706 km course with asphalt, trails and gravel
Starts every hour on the hour, following Backyard Ultra rules
12 laps in total, covering 80.472 km
additional: Teams consist of 2 runners who take turns running every other lap throughout the competition. All 12 laps must be completed for a valid overall time. The final lap must be completed by 21:00. Everyone who completes 1 to 11 laps receives an official participant T-shirt, while everyone who completes all 12 laps receives an exclusive black T-shirt. Spectators are welcome outside and inside Gneist Arena, but do not have access to the runners’ base camp. Pedestrian crossings must be used when crossing roads, and marshals direct traffic at some points. The start and base camp are at Gneist Arena. The base camp has snacks, drinks, toilets and changing rooms. Minimum age: 15 (born in 2011 or earlier).

name: Gjesdal Backyard
location: Gjesdal IL stadion, Ålgård, Gjesdal, Norway
price_range: 800 kr; stafett fra 1500 kr per lag

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 800,- kr. Dette inkluderer bevertning og pleie gjennom hele dagen.

description: Gjesdal Backyard is a unique and different kind of race where participants run a 6.7 km loop up to twelve times, starting and finishing at Gjesdal IL Stadium in Ålgård. The course features varied terrain, including asphalt, tractor tracks and flowing trails, and includes a challenging hill and scenic valleys. Loops start on the hour, and your pace determines how long your breaks between loops will be. The event also offers a relay option, where teams of 2–6 people can share the 12 loops. Refreshments, entertainment and good facilities are available at the stadium throughout the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the tartan track at Gjesdal IL Stadium
Varied terrain with asphalt, tractor tracks and flowing trails
The course’s toughest and longest hill comes early in the loop
additional: Bib pickup from 07:30. Race briefing and general information at 08:45. A new loop starts on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00. Personal chair in the “Storsalen,” with refreshments, entertainment and surprises. Good changing-room and toilet facilities. Medical staff on site. Food and drinks included: water, fruit, squash, crisps, jelly men, cola, sandwiches, hot food after loop 6 and a Jæder burger after loop 12. Minimum age: 16. Runners must bring suitable shoes, a headlamp and clothing appropriate for the conditions. Start and finish at Gjesdal IL Stadium in Ålgård. The race is limited to 12 loops (80.4 km) and has a minimum age of 16. Relay teams can consist of 2–6 people, and each participant must run at least two loops.

name: Hovlandsnuten Opp
description: Hovlandsnuten Opp is a traditional uphill race from Risvoll School to the summit of Hovlandsnuten, 931 metres above sea level. The approximately 6.7-kilometre course offers varied terrain, with Sherpa steps, beautiful views over the fjord and a challenging climb. The race is suitable for everyone, young and old, and family entertainment is provided at Trollplassen. The event also has a dedicated Sherpa/firefighter class with additional weight to carry. After the race, there is a social gathering with music, awards and activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: The course passes through Sherpa steps built by Sherpas from Nepal
Water stations at Skreivane, Hovlandsstølen and Hovlandsnuten
Panoramic views from the summit at 931 metres above sea level
additional: The recreational walk starts at 08:30 from Risvoll School, with the option to start from the alternative parking area in Nordstøldalen. The competition starts at 12:00. Race numbers (vests) are handed out before the start. Medals are presented by Mayor Håvard Handeland. There is a race announcer and several family activities at Trollplassen, including face painting, a pirate show and music. Participants in the Sherpa/firefighter class must carry at least 20 kg of additional weight. Competition participants must bring a wind jacket and trousers, and poles are not allowed on the Sherpa steps or in the open mountain terrain. The course is marked, and there are Norwegian Red Cross stations with defibrillators along the course. Water stations are listed at Skreivane, Hovlandsstølen and Hovlandsnuten. Competition participants must bring a wind jacket and windproof trousers; poles are not allowed in the competition class. The Sherpa/firefighter class requires at least 20 kg of additional weight, and all participants must have a licence.

name: 3 toppsløpet på Jeløya (3TL)
description: 3toppsløpet on Jeløya is a trail race held annually around Midsummer, starting and finishing at Sølystranda on Jeløya in Moss. The race offers four distances: Mini 1TL (1 km), 1TL (10 km), 2TL (20 km) and 3TL (30 km). Runners alternate between forest trails and scenic beaches. The course includes the three well-known peaks Rødsåsen, Bjørnåsen and Rambergtoppen, offering a technically challenging and varied terrain experience. The event is run by volunteers and has a low entry fee. Any surplus supports children affected by war and conflict through a partnership with Right To Play.
course_highlights: Trail race on paths, forest roads, beaches and some paved sections
Includes three well-known peaks: Rødsåsen, Bjørnåsen and Rambergtoppen
The course follows much of the shoreline around Jeløya
additional: Mass start for 1TL (10 km), 2TL (20 km) and 3TL (30 km) at 10:00 from Sølystranda. Mini 1TL (1 km) starts at approximately 09:30. An early start for 3TL and the marathon is available at 09:00 for runners expecting to take longer. 3TL requires runners to check in at all three peaks; 1TL requires a check-in only at Rødsåsen. There are no aid stations for 3TL, so participants must bring their own food and drink. 1TL has an aid station at Kasekilen. Carrying a charged mobile phone is mandatory, and running with a backpack is recommended. The 2027 edition will take place on Saturday, 12 June, with the regular start from 10:00 at Sørlystranda.

name: Trolljegerprøven Sandnes
description: Trolljegerprøven Sandnes is a Norwegian trail obstacle race that combines endurance, strength and fun on a nature-based obstacle course. The race is suitable for all levels and offers an adrenaline-filled experience in the wilderness. The event takes place in Sandnes and is part of Trolljeger’s many exciting events for both adults and children. Prepare well with training at Trolljegerhallen or outdoor sessions before the race.
course_highlights: Norwegian trail obstacle course
Combines endurance and strength
Nature-based obstacles in the wilderness
additional: Trolljegerhallen at Foss-Eikeland offers training and preparation for obstacle races. Outdoor sessions focused on obstacle racing are also held to help participants get into the right mindset before the race. Tailored events are available for groups, adapted to their wishes and needs.

name: Soknaløpet
description: Soknaløpet is held in Sokna, Buskerud, and organized by Soknedalen Idrettslag. The race offers a 5 km for adults and a separate children’s race, welcoming both recreational runners and younger participants.
course_highlights: 5 km race
Separate children’s race
Held in Sokna in Soknedalen

name: Backyard Larvik Ultra
description: Backyard Larvik is a unique ultrarun where participants run a 6.7 km loop at the start of every hour, for a maximum of twelve laps. The race combines strategy and endurance, with the last runner to start a lap winning. The event has a social focus and a low barrier to entry, and offers break facilities with food and drink in a warm indoor space. Those who complete twelve laps receive a cup, and those who complete seven laps receive a wooden medal. The race takes place at Fagerli School in Larvik, with bib collection and a race briefing on the day before and on race day.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop run at the start of every hour
Maximum 12 laps, for a total of 80.4 km
Break facilities with food and drink in a warm indoor space
additional: Bib numbers and ankle chips can be collected at Fagerli School on Friday 12 June from 18:00 to 20:00 and Saturday 13 June from 07:45 to 08:30. The race briefing starts at approximately 08:30 in the gym at Fagerli School. Bringing your own cup is mandatory. The ankle chip and Velcro strap must be returned after the race; a fee applies if they are not returned. The Red Cross will be present with an ATV to provide assistance. The maximum number of participants is 350. Bib numbers can be attached with a race belt to make changing clothes during breaks easier. The organiser’s information about the race format and price reflects the published details and may change before the 2027 edition.

name: Sommernattsløpet Bergen
description: Sommernattsløpet Bergen is a summer street race held in beautiful surroundings around Bergen city centre. The course offers fast and relatively flat laps around Lungegårdsvann, with the start and finish in Nygårdsparken. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km; the 10 km consists of two laps of the same course. The race is suitable for all levels and offers a festive atmosphere with music, cheering and the chance to set a new personal best.
course_highlights: Course around beautiful Bergen city centre and Lungegårdsvann
Minimal elevation, with a fast and flat course
Start and finish in Nygårdsparken with music and cheering
additional: Pacers are available in several pace groups from 4:00 to 6:30 min/km. Race bibs can be collected at Löplabbet Bergen or on race day for participants travelling from far away. All participants receive a drink and a medal at the finish. Prizes from partners will be drawn after the race. The start time for the 5 km is listed as 19:00. The 10 km has wave starts at 20:00 for expected times under 50 minutes and at 21:30 for expected times over 50 minutes.

name: Bergsdalen Halvmaraton
description: Bergsdalen Half Marathon is held annually, starting at Bergsdalen Church, and brings runners together for a wonderful half-marathon experience in scenic surroundings. The race has a reputation for being well organized and welcomes both recreational and more experienced runners. The event is organized in collaboration with Stanghelle IL, which also offers several activities for children and adults in the local community. Bergsdalen Half Marathon 2027 is planned for June 12, and runners can look forward to a day with a great atmosphere and a challenging course.
course_highlights: Measured and well-marked courses
Reported to have around 90 meters of elevation gain
Start and finish at the church in Bergsdalen
additional: Previous editions have featured a half marathon, a 10 km race, and a relay. The 2027 edition is planned for June 12.

name: Kvammen halvmaraton 2027
description: Kvammen Half Marathon is organized by Kvammen Sports Club and takes place on Saturday, June 12, 2027. This is a challenging and exclusive half marathon that gives participants the opportunity to experience much of Kvammen. The course passes through scenic areas such as Høgda, Hegreneset, the school, Løvika and Leknes, before finishing back at Høgda. This race is suited to runners looking for a challenging distance in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The course passes through Høgda, Hegreneset, the school, Løvika and Leknes
Scenic surroundings in the Kvammen area
A challenging and exclusive half marathon with varied terrain
additional: The course information is for the 2026 edition; a detailed course map and video were announced but have not been confirmed for 2027.

name: 55. Bartenwetzer Volkslauf
description: The Bartenwetzer Volkslauf is the oldest fun run in North Hesse and takes place at Waldstadion Melsungen. The event includes children’s and schoolchildren’s races over 400 m and 1000 m, as well as 5 km, 10 km and 19 km races on paved paths through Melsungen city forest. As the 10th scoring race in the Nordhessencup, it offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, award ceremonies and a buffet. The start and finish areas are centrally located at Waldstadion, which also has changing facilities.
course_highlights: Races on paved paths through the beautiful Melsungen city forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Melsungen, on the edge of the city forest
Distances: 5 km, 10 km and 19 km, plus children’s races on the track
additional: Race-pack pickup from 14:30 at the MT clubhouse at Waldstadion. Race-day entries are not possible. Changing facilities are available at the MT clubhouse. Refreshments include water on the longer courses, hot tea at the finish, and a buffet with coffee, cake and bratwurst from 15:30. Medical support is provided by the German Red Cross. Certificates and medals for the Bambini and 1000 m races; certificates can be printed on site or accessed online. The event is subject to the applicable regulations for road and off-stadium running events. Register online via RaceResult. The event at Waldstadion Melsungen includes award ceremonies, refreshments and medical support.

name: SV Greven Deichlauf
description: The SV Greven Deichlauf offers an unforgettable running experience along the picturesque Ems dike and through the town forest. The route, surrounded by nature, is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes, and is lined by numerous spectators. Around 1,000 runners take part, seeking both an athletic challenge and an experience in nature.
course_highlights: Circuit from Stadion Emsaue along the Ems dike
The route runs through the town forest
Nature-filled running route with many spectators
additional: Running event, circuit, experience in nature, approx. 1,000 participants, official timing, medals for children and age groups

name: Hohenlimburger Lennelauf
description: The 3rd Hohenlimburg Lennelauf takes place around Lennepark in Hohenlimburg. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ages and offers a suitable distance for every age group. It is organised by Elseyer Turnverein 1881 e.V., known for its wide range of sports activities for the whole family. The event promises a friendly, active atmosphere in a beautiful park setting.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lennepark in Hohenlimburg
Suitable for runners and walkers of all ages
Family-friendly event
additional: The event offers various running and walking distances suitable for all age groups. Registration is through Elseyer Turnverein. Telephone enquiries are possible at certain times on Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays. The course is on asphalt; spikes are not allowed. Places are limited. Refreshments are available on site. Transponders are used for timekeeping.

name: Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf
location: Kurpark Bad Nenndorf, Bad Nenndorf, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf is a long-standing, DLV-approved public race and part of the Schaumburg Running Series. It takes place in the beautiful Kurpark in Bad Nenndorf and offers distances for different age and ability groups, including 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5 km, 10 km, and 5 km walking and Nordic walking. The event is family-friendly and attracts many participants, who run on paved paths through the park. In addition to the sporting competition, there is an attractive supporting program and good facilities, including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through the Kurpark
Start and finish on Kurpromenade by the Wandelhalle
A range of distances from 1,000 m to 10 km, plus walking options
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports center, which can be reached by bus shuttle. Insurance coverage is provided through an LSB contract. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Medical support is provided. A maximum of 300 participants in the 1,000 m and 2.5 km races. The 5 km Nordic walking and walking events are timed, with no placings. First race for the Samtgemeinde Cup. Scoring race in the Schaumburg Running Series. The race takes place as part of the State Garden Show, with various distances and a family-friendly atmosphere. Early registration is possible, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: Mut-Lauf
description: The MUT-LAUF Kiel is an annual running event that promotes greater openness and courage in dealing with mental illness. Its aim is to take a stand against stigma and raise awareness of mental health. The run celebrates moving together without pressure to perform and is open to everyone, regardless of age, fitness level, or physical limitations. Alongside the run, there is a varied program featuring music, interviews, food and drink, and a marketplace with information about mental health and prevention.
course_highlights: A run open to everyone, with no pressure to perform, including wheelchair users
Event held at the Moorteichwiesen in Kiel
Program featuring music, interviews, and a marketplace
additional: Registration is available online through the Davengo portal or in person at KIELER FENSTER, Ambulantes Zentrum. The event takes place every year on the Saturday before Kiel Week begins. The program includes activities for the whole family and a marketplace featuring self-help groups and social organizations. Entry fees are €10 for adults and €5 for children. Information about self-help groups and a sociable program are provided.

name: Oelder Citylauf
description: The Oelde City Run is a traditional running classic in the heart of Oelde that has delighted runners of all ages for over 45 years. The event offers a varied programme featuring Bambini, schoolchildren’s and inclusive races, as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The races take place before a large crowd in a festival-like atmosphere and are part of the Volksbank Cup race series. The course is measured to international standards and runs through Oelde city centre, with the start and finish at the Market Square.
course_highlights: An internationally measured 2.5 km lap, repeated as required for each distance
The course runs through Oelde city centre, with the start and finish at the Market Square
A variety of races for all ages, including Bambini and inclusive races
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a late-entry fee of EUR 3.00. Race packets can be collected at the event centre on the Market Square. Certificates for the schoolchildren’s and Bambini races are available on site; certificates for the other races are available online. Showers are available at the Oelde Comprehensive School sports hall, approximately 300 m from the finish. Registration is via Raceresult; the event is known for its diverse categories and friendly atmosphere.

name: Steinfurter Altstadt - Abendlauf
description: The Steinfurt Old Town Evening Run is a long-standing race competition, now being held for the 38th time. Organized by Turnerbund Burgsteinfurt, the event offers various age categories and race distances through the historic old town of Steinfurt. It is particularly family-friendly and is known for its lively atmosphere and large fields of starters. Young runners receive medals and trophies, making the race a popular event for all ages.
course_highlights: Races through the historic old town of Steinfurt
Age categories from Bambini to masters athletes
A medal and water bottle for every young runner at the finish
additional: Race packets can be collected at the old town hall on the market square from 1 p.m. on the day of the event. Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Every young runner receives a medal and a water bottle; the first three in each age category are awarded trophies. Races for different age groups, on-site registration, medals, trophies, reusable race bibs, entry fee payable by SEPA direct debit mandate, no refunds possible

name: Söltjerlauf
description: The Söltjerlauf in Bad Münder is a charity run in the beautiful Süntel hills, where every lap counts. The event welcomes all age groups and fitness levels, from children to marathon runners, and features a shaded forest loop of approximately 3.8 km with a refreshment point. Participants have four hours to run as many laps as possible, with the proceeds going to a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health, and invites participants to stay after the run for catering and the awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Shaded forest loop of approximately 3.8 km
Refreshment point along the course
Atmosphere at the Bergschmiede restaurant, with catering
additional: A shuttle service is available from 09:30 to help participants arrive in time for the 11:00 start. Every participant receives a certificate stating the distance covered. The top individual runners and the top 10 teams receive prizes. Parking is limited, so using the overflow parking areas and bus shuttle is recommended. Dogs must be kept on a short leash and are not allowed to participate as team members. Competition open to all age groups; sponsors donate for each lap to local projects. The event takes place on the Bergschmiede grounds, with support from local sponsors such as Sparkasse Hameln-Weserbergland and Ardagh Group.

name: Volksbank Haren Citylauf
description: The 27th Volksbank Haren City Run takes place on an attractive, fast course through Haren city centre. The 5 km and 10 km races are measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings, making them ideal for competitive athletes and recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in special races over 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km. There is also a team competition in the 5 km race for teams from companies, clubs or groups.
course_highlights: Attractive, fast course through Haren city centre
The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings
Special races for children and young people over 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km
additional: All participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive finisher shirts. Entry fees are paid by direct debit. The 5 km race includes a team competition for teams of at least 3 people. Children from Haren daycare centres and schools can take part for free if their institution participates. Large trophies and certificates are awarded for school competitions.

name: Werner Volksbank Stadtlauf 20. Team- / Firmenlauf
description: The 24th Werner Volksbank City Run 20th Team / Company Run takes place in Werne. This running event offers the opportunity to get active with colleagues or friends and strengthen team spirit. The event includes two distances, 1 km and 10 km, and is aimed especially at teams and companies who want to run together.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km and 10 km
Starting point in Werne
Typical June weather, with an average of 23 °C and mostly sunny days
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event promotes physical activity and team spirit, with registration via Raceresult. June weather is expected to be warm and sunny, at around 23°C.

name: Zechenlauf - Neue Zeche Westerholt
organizer: „Jecken vom Pütt“ in Kooperation mit dem SuS Bertlich
description: Der Zechenlauf führt über das Gelände der Neuen Zeche Westerholt in Gelsenkirchen und verbindet Laufspaß mit der besonderen Kulisse des ehemaligen Zechenstandorts. Angeboten werden eine kurze Kinderstrecke und eine 5-Kilometer-Runde. Die Veranstaltung findet im Rahmen eines Familienfests statt und lädt Laufbegeisterte verschiedener Altersgruppen zum Mitmachen ein.
course_highlights: Kurze Kinderstrecke von etwa 750 bis 800 Metern
5-Kilometer-Runde auf und um das Zechengelände
Die Strecke führt auch durch den Stadtteilpark Hassel

name: Enni Donkenlauf
description: The ENNI-Donkenlauf in Neukirchen-Vluyn offers a variety of running events for all ages and ability levels. The routes run mostly along flat, paved, low-traffic country roads and side streets, making them ideal for fast times. Alongside competitive races, there are also non-competitive runs and walking events open to everyone. The event is family-friendly and includes special scoring for schools and youth groups.
course_highlights: Flat, mostly paved, low-traffic country roads and side streets
Officially measured 5 km and 10 km routes
Minis-Run and Donki@school on the sports centre’s synthetic track
additional: Late entries are possible on event day from 11:30 a.m. in Building “G”. The Minis-Run and Donki@school take place on the sports centre’s synthetic track. For safety reasons, dogs, jogging strollers and bicycle escorts are not permitted. Parking is limited; travel by bicycle or public transport is recommended. Smoking is prohibited throughout the school grounds, and dogs are prohibited on the sports grounds. Various distances (500 m to 10 km); registration possible on site or online; no age-group scoring in some races.

name: Gellershäuser Abendlauf
location: Sportplatz in Gellershausen, Edertal, Hesse, Germany
organizer: Turn und Sportverein Hessen 1848 Frankenberg Eder e.V.
description: The Gellershausen Evening Run takes place at the sports ground in Gellershausen, Edertal, and offers races for children and school students, as well as a 10-kilometer race and a half marathon. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup and attracts runners of various age groups. The course runs through scenic surroundings and offers a pleasant running atmosphere in June. Information about registration, the course, results, and photos is available.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10-kilometer courses starting at Gellershausen Sports Ground
Children’s and school students’ races included
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup
additional: Typical June weather: around 23 °C during the day and 13 °C at night, mostly sunny, with an average of 65 mm of precipitation. Children’s and youth races with distances of around 400 m and 1,000 m; the event promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.

name: 12. Heilwald Marathon
description: The 12th Heilwald Marathon takes place in Bad Lippspringe. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and runs through the unique Heilwald, whose soothing low-mountain climate and species-rich forest offer a special running experience. The event is a private, self-supported race, with times recorded by hand; a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participation is at your own risk, and a voluntary donation for tree planting is requested.

name: 13. Himmelswegelauf
description: Der Himmelswegelauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf rund um die Himmelsscheibe von Nebra, der jährlich im Juni stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Disziplinen wie Marathon, Halbmarathon, den 10 Kilometer langen Himmelsscheibenlauf, Walking, Radtour und geführte Wanderungen zum Fundort der Himmelsscheibe. Die Strecken führen durch historische und archäologische Stätten wie das Sonnenobservatorium Goseck, die Dolmengöttin von Langeneichstädt und das Besucherzentrum Arche Nebra. Start- und Zielort ist meist die Arche Nebra, unweit des Fundortes der Himmelsscheibe, die als älteste konkrete Abbildung des Kosmos gilt. Der Lauf verbindet sportliche Herausforderung mit kulturellem Erleben in einer einzigartigen Landschaft.
course_highlights: Start und Ziel an der Arche Nebra, nahe dem Fundort der Himmelsscheibe
Marathonstart am 7.000 Jahre alten Sonnenobservatorium Goseck
Streckenführung durch den Ziegelrodaer Forst und vorbei an archäologischen Kultstätten
additional: Die Veranstaltung umfasst neben den Läufen auch Walking, Radtouren und geführte Wanderungen zum Fundort der Himmelsscheibe. Alle Strecken sind vorbehaltlich behördlicher Genehmigung. Die Medaille wird in einem exklusiven Design vergeben.

name: 15. Fullestrand-Ultramarathon
description: The Fullestrand Ultramarathon takes place in Kassel and features a challenging 46.5 km route along the Fulda, with around 350 metres of elevation gain. The route heads upstream from Kassel, follows the Fuldahöhenweg and returns along the Fuldaradweg, passing through varied landscapes and natural areas. The event is organised by Laufwerk Kassel, led by Sylke Kuhn, and combines a sporting challenge with the beauty of northern Hesse’s nature and culture.

name: 18. Edeka Ladage-Lauf
description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen is a long-standing community race with a variety of events for all age groups. The event takes place at the Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School sports facility and offers varied loop courses for everyone from kindergarten children to experienced runners. The longer races follow a slightly modified 2.5 km loop, with the start and finish close to the event area, creating a special atmosphere. Alongside the competition, the event also emphasizes a sense of community, supported by a prize draw and a dedicated team of volunteers.

name: 23. Sudenburg-Lauf - Der Lauf mit dem Lächeln
description: The Sudenburg Run is an event with the motto “By runners, for runners” and takes place at Heinrich Germer Stadium in Magdeburg. The event is distinguished by enthusiasm for running and for the Sudenburg district. There are various race routes for children, teenagers, and adults, which lead through the city and the stadium. The focus is on getting as many people as possible running and putting a smile on their faces.

name: Ottermeerlauf
description: The Ottermeer Run in Wiesmoor is a long-standing event. It offers a varied course and a motivating atmosphere, and is open to both individual runners and relay teams. A particular highlight is the 6-hour ultramarathon, which is part of the Nordcup and open to runners aged 18 and over. Every finisher receives a custom medal shaped like the outline of the Ottermeer, featuring the mascot Otti.

name: 24h Lauf Halberstadt
description: The 24-hour run at Friedensstadion Halberstadt starts at 18:00 and is organized by VfB Germania Halberstadt in collaboration with the Halberstadt Leisure and Sports Center. The goal is to keep runners on the tartan track continuously throughout the 24 hours. The event is part of VfB Germania’s club festival, where various sports departments introduce themselves and invite visitors to join in. In addition to the run, traditional activities include pulling a coach on the track. The event offers a sporting challenge and a sociable program for participants and spectators.

name: Fischland-Darss-Zingst-Ultramarathon (FDZU)
description: The Fischland-Darss-Zingst Ultramarathon (FDZU) is the longest nature-experience run in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and is being held for the 10th time. The route passes through the unique Baltic Sea coastal landscape from Rostock to Stralsund, offering runners a special experience of nature along the region’s peninsulas and islands. The race is defined by its tradition and distinctive atmosphere, created by the combination of nature, challenge and community.

name: Harsefelder Lauf- und Musikfestival
organizer: Lauftreff Harsefeld, LSC Harsefeld, Stadtmarketing Harsefeld
description: The 20th Running and Music Festival takes place in Harsefeld, combining sporting challenges with musical entertainment. Runners of all ages can take part in a range of distances, from children’s and Bambini runs to short and long-distance races and relays. In the evening, Marktstraße becomes a lively party strip with an open-air disco and live music. The festival is a regular fixture on Harsefeld’s event calendar and, alongside the sporting events, offers a varied children’s program and food stalls.

name: Himmelgeister Brückenlauf
description: The Himmelgeister Brückenlauf is a traditional half marathon that has been held annually in Düsseldorf-Himmelgeist since 2004. The route follows the Rhine almost to the heart of Düsseldorf and offers a scenic running course. The race starts early in the morning, at around 8 a.m., at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the after-run party in the beer garden at Haus Krevet. The 2026 race will be the last, as the organizing team is stepping down after the anniversary.

name: Kalimandscharolauf 2026
description: The event is organized by K+S Minerals and Agriculture GmbH, Zielitz plant. The race takes place away from the stadium and offers runners an attractive course in the Magdeburg/Börde region. Registration is open.

name: Lauf um den Senftenberger See
description: The 49th Run Around Lake Senftenberg offers runners a choice of distances around picturesque Lake Senftenberg. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, from the Bambini race to the challenging 17.7 km lake loop. Races start at 09:00 in front of the Seesporthalle Großkoschen, with a friendly atmosphere, ample refreshments, and changing and washing facilities. Register online via myRacePartner; late registration is available until race day for a small fee.

name: Luckenwalder Turmfestlauf
description: Das 35. Luckenwalder Turmfest findet vom 11. bis 13. Juni 2027 rund um den Marktturm statt. Die Innenstadt verwandelt sich mit modernen Fahrgeschäften, zahlreichen Marktständen und einem abwechslungsreichen Bühnenprogramm in eine der größten Festmeilen der Region Teltow-Fläming. Das Fest ist offen für alle Besucherinnen und Besucher, unabhängig vom Geldbeutel, da 2027 auf einen regulären Kulturbeitrag verzichtet wird. Unterstützer können freiwillig spenden oder ein Unterstützerarmband erwerben, um die Tradition des Stadtfestes zu erhalten und weiterzuentwickeln.
additional: Das Turmfest beginnt an allen drei Tagen jeweils ab 12:00 Uhr. Der Festbetrieb endet freitags und samstags um 01:00 Uhr, sonntags um 22:00 Uhr. Es gibt keine reguläre Eintrittsgebühr, stattdessen wird um freiwillige Spenden gebeten. Unterstützerarmbänder sind für 10 Euro in der Touristinformation erhältlich. Die Touristinformation hat montags bis freitags zu unterschiedlichen Zeiten geöffnet, ist aber vom 24.12.2026 bis 01.01.2027 geschlossen.

name: OSTSEE Run
description: The OSTSEE Run by ROTEC is a sporting highlight as part of the OSTSEE Sports Games in Cottbus. The race offers an attractive course for runners and walkers and is part of a varied sports and leisure program featuring numerous other competitions and activities. The event welcomes sports enthusiasts of all ages and, in addition to the sporting competition, offers a lively program of activities and a large OSTSEE party with free admission. This combination of sporting event and celebration makes the OSTSEE Run a special experience in the region.

name: OSTSEE Sparkassen Halbmarathon
description: The SPARKASSEN Half Marathon takes place in Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee. The 21-kilometer course starts at 10:00 a.m. from the Möbel Höffner grounds. Race materials can be collected from 7:00 a.m. in the start and finish area. The race is open to participants aged 18 and over and offers an attractive route along the Baltic Sea coast. On-site registration is not available; participants must register in advance.

name: Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg
description: The Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg is a challenging running event held in Altenburg. Participants can choose from various distances, including the marathon, two-person marathon relay, half marathon, 13.3 km run, fitness run, children’s and students’ races, and walking events. The course takes runners through the historic city of Altenburg, with varied sections that include climbs in the city forest and along the Großer Teich. In addition to the sporting challenge, the supporting program offers a wide range of entertainment, including music, a children’s festival, and a talk by running legend Uta Pippig.

name: Tollenseseelauf
description: The Neubrandenburg Tollensesee Run is a scenic race around Lake Tollensesee that attracts more than 2,000 runners each year. With distances for young and old, the event offers a varied running festival in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is challenging, with several climbs, which is why the race is also known as “The Toughest in the North.” More than 300 volunteers help create an unforgettable running experience, with certificates, technical T-shirts, and trophies for the top finishers.

name: Waaker Bystopen-Attacke
description: The Waaker Bystopen Attack is an obstacle race in Lower Saxony, held around the Waaker Büsteppe in the Göttingen Forest. The event offers distances of 2.5 km (family run), 5 km and 10 km, with more than 30 natural and artificial obstacles. You can participate individually or as part of a team; team scoring requires at least 4 runners. Alongside the main race, there is also a Bambini Attack for the youngest participants, which does not require registration. The event focuses on fun, team spirit and exercise in nature.

name: Bürgerlauf Visbek
description: The 1st Visbek Community Run takes place in Visbek Park (Pastors Wisk) and offers a varied program for runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, as well as intermediate and main races over 5 km and 10 km, complemented by a walking or hiking route. Race bibs can be collected on the day of the event from 15:00, and all races are professionally measured. Proceeds benefit the Visbek Community Foundation, making the run a sporting event with a charitable purpose.

name: Drebber-Marathon
description: The Drebber Run offers a wide range of competitions for all ages and ability levels. The course follows an officially measured 2.34 km loop through the Jacobidrebber district, with the start and finish at the sports field. In addition to individual and relay events ranging from a children’s run to a marathon, there is an attractive supporting program for spectators and participants. Emergency services personnel are especially invited to take part in the Blue Light Cup as a relay team and showcase their performance.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4th Skolwińska Mile is an annual road race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event is taking place and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the registration form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile distance (1,609 meters) on scenic recreational grounds
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes
additional: Children’s races of approximately 200 meters are also held as part of the event. Participants can use the registration form available on the website to quickly contact the organizer and system administrator. Participants can use training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks. The event is supported by a local building supply store, and the participant limit is 60.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level and achieve officially recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime character. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing refreshments after the race and awards for the winners.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Night race starting at 21:55
Urban course through the streets of Szamotuły
additional: Temporary traffic changes apply on race day, with parking restrictions and designated detours. Race packet collection is available from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments for participants and awards for the winners are planned after the race. There are 26 free race packets available for people with disabilities in the family race, accompanied by a caregiver; apply by email.

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka is a 10 km race in Kwidzyn, in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is scheduled for Saturday, 12 June 2027. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging paved course. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels to help participants prepare optimally for race day.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging paved course
10 km distance
Road race in scenic Kwidzyn
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to a runner’s VDOT level, with detailed instructions and expert support.

name: 200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
XVI Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku
location: Morzyczyn, Stargard County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: TBB Gilze Run
location: Gilze, Gilze en Rijen, North Brabant, Netherlands

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, Trolltrail
description: TrollTrail is a short, technical and fun trail race in beautiful surroundings by Trollvann in Oslo. The race covers 6.3 kilometres of hilly terrain, including gravel, trails, off-road sections and asphalt. The course combines fast sections with challenging trails and flowing forest paths, and is suitable both for experienced trail runners and for those looking to try something new off-road. The final race has a mass start on 13 June at 11:00, offering a tough running experience in the forest.
course_highlights: 6.3 km of hilly, technical running on gravel, trails, off-road sections and asphalt
The course runs alongside Trollvann, Svartputten, Linderudkollen ski centre and Langevann
A combination of fast sections and challenging trails, with flowing forest paths
additional: Race bibs can be collected from Löplabbet Oslo sentrum from 7 April. The same race bib is used throughout the series. A new race bib can be purchased for 75 kr. The courses will only be marked for the mass start. GPX files and course maps are available to download. When crossing an asphalt road, runners must run along the side between the road and the water.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a simple and efficient running event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners achieve fast times. The race takes place on a flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop, with the option to set up your own nutrition table along the way. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. Race bibs are collected at a self-service station at the venue, which also has free parking, changing rooms and toilets. Perseløpet has a friendly atmosphere, and runners who set a personal best get to ring the bell by the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop
Personal nutrition table passed on every lap
Venue at Ås school with free parking, changing rooms and toilets
additional: Race bibs are collected at a self-service station about two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Runners can place their own bottles and gels on the nutrition table before the start. At selected races, ninth-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station and raise money for their school trip. A countdown feature and lap-time calculator are available for planning. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets at the venue. Registration is via RaceDays, and half-marathon runners can arrange their own drinks and nutrition.

name: Perseløpet
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll starting at Ås school, offering a simple and efficient setup for achieving fast times. The race takes place on a flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop, with the option of having your own nutrition table along the course. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, so both beginners and experienced runners can find a suitable challenge. The event emphasizes personal-record attempts and community, with the option to celebrate personal records near the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop
Your own nutrition table, passed on every lap
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km
additional: Race bibs are collected by self-service at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms, and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, 9th-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. The weather forecast is updated four times daily using satellite data for the area around Ås school. Race bibs are collected by self-service at the school from approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms, and toilets are available at the venue. Registration and current prices are available from RaceDays.

name: EVL-HalbMarathon Leverkusen
description: The EVL Half Marathon in Leverkusen is a traditional and challenging half marathon, taking place for the 24th time. The 21.1-kilometre course runs through the sports city of Leverkusen and includes a special highlight: passing through the BayArena, home ground of Bayer 04 Leverkusen. The hill climb on Sauerberg is another challenge. The race is open to all abilities, from beginners to elite runners, and offers a unique running experience with plenty of atmosphere and a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: The course passes right through the BayArena
Hill climb on Sauerberg
A varied 21.1-kilometre route through Leverkusen
additional: Start and finish on Bismarckstraße, between the Ostermann-Arena and the BayArena. Runners born in 2010 or earlier may enter the half marathon, those born in 2016 or earlier may enter the 10-km race, and those born in 2018 or earlier may enter the 5-km race. Race bibs are non-transferable and must be worn clearly visible. Places are still available in the Bambini runs. The 2026 event shirt is available. The organiser recommends a good training structure, including recovery and nutrition tips from running coach Andrea von Horn. The event takes place in all weather conditions. The course runs through Leverkusen, including the BayArena; registration for the Bambini runs; event shirt and merchandise; podcast with tips and stories.

name: Sauerland-Höhenflug-Trailrun
description: The Sauerland Höhenflug Trail Run is a popular running event in the Sauerland region. It offers a range of distances from 0.4 km to a half marathon, winding through the varied landscape of the Sauerland Höhenflug. The trail run is open to runners of all ages and ability levels and is organized by Skiclub Hagen-Wildewiese e.V. in cooperation with Sauerland Tourism and Sauerland-Rothaargebirge Nature Park. The event is part of the Volksbank Sauerland Running Cup and features a special sprint classification over the final 200 meters of the longer distances.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.4 km to a half marathon through the Sauerland region
Sprint classification over the final 200 meters of the 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon races
Various age groups and classifications, including school races
additional: The trail run includes several age groups and distances, including a Bambini race, school races and main races. Timing is provided by RaceResult through Time and Voice. The half-marathon cutoff time is 3:15 hours. The event is part of the 2025 Volksbank Sauerland Running Cup. Late registration is available on site for an additional fee of €3. Distances: 5 km, 10 km and half marathon; online registration; a nature experience in the Sauerland region; annual event in June.

name: Barmstedter Stadtlauf
description: The 22nd Barmstedt City Run takes place in Barmstedt. The event offers measured 5 km and 10 km circuits that are eligible for rankings. In addition to the main races, there are Nordic walking, walking, children’s and toddlers’ races. The start and finish are at the market square in Barmstedt, and the route runs through the town centre and around Lake Rantzau, on a variety of surfaces including cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km and 10 km circuits, eligible for rankings
Route through Barmstedt’s town centre and around Lake Rantzau
Varied surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths
additional: Timing is done with a loan chip worn around the ankle (except for the children’s races), which is collected at the finish. Unreturned chips will be charged at 40 euros. Jogging strollers and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. The races have different age categories and minimum ages. The route may vary slightly due to construction work; updates will be posted on the website. Routes are measured; surfaces vary; online registration is available; no late registrations; refreshments and medals are included.

name: Donatus-Lauf
location: Sportgelände SC Fortuna Liblar, Hamburg-Rissen, Hamburg, Germany
description: The Donatuslauf takes place around Lake Donatus on the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds in Hamburg-Rissen. The event offers a range of race distances, from a 400 m toddlers’ run and 1,200 m schoolchildren’s races to a half marathon and a 10 km main race. The races are designed for different age groups and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with additional walking and family races. The course is varied and clearly marked, with the start and finish area close to Erftstadt railway station. Awards ceremonies take place shortly after the races, and certificates can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400 m to a half marathon
Start and finish area near Erftstadt railway station, with easy access
Family race and Nordic walking as additional offerings
additional: Late entries are accepted only until the participant limit is reached and incur a €3 late-entry fee. Awards ceremonies take place on the sports grounds immediately after the respective races. Parking is available only at Erftstadt railway station, just 100 m from the start and finish area. Certificates can be downloaded online as PDFs and printed. Courses around Lake Donatus, online registration, parking at Erftstadt railway station, start and finish area at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds

name: Kirschlauf
description: The Kirschlauf in Kleinfahner, organized by USV Erfurt, is a traditional race with a history spanning more than 20 years. The 24th edition takes runners along scenic routes with challenging highland trails. The event offers various distances, including a 14-kilometer main race, a 4.5-kilometer fun run, and races for schoolchildren and young children. The awards ceremony is traditionally conducted by the Thuringian Cherry Queen, and the race is part of the TLV Running Cup.
course_highlights: 14-kilometer main race along a scenic highland trail with views across the northern Thuringian Basin
4.5 km fun run with challenging terrain in the Imtal valley
Finish through a cherry orchard above Kleinfahner with magnificent views
additional: Race packet pickup from 8:00 a.m. at the event tent by the mill. Late entries are possible online from June 13 at 2:00 a.m. and on race day until 30 minutes before the race, with a €5 late entry fee. Awards ceremonies take place from approximately 9:45 a.m. for the schoolchildren’s races and from approximately 11:30 a.m. for the other races.

name: Handewitter Sommerlauf
description: Der Handewitter Sommerlauf am 27. Juni 2027 bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern aller Leistungsstufen passende Strecken mit wenigen Höhenmetern. Von Bambini über 2,5 km, 5 km, 10 km, Nordic Walking, Halbmarathon bis hin zu Staffel- und Rollstuhlrennen ist für jeden etwas dabei. Die Veranstaltung findet rund um die Wikinghalle in Handewitt statt und besticht durch eine top organisierte Atmosphäre, starke Stimmung und ein unvergessliches Zielerlebnis. Die DLV vermessenen Strecken laden sowohl Einsteiger als auch ambitionierte Läufer ein, ihren sportlichen Tag individuell zu gestalten.
course_highlights: Strecken mit wenigen Höhenmetern rund um die Wikinghalle und durch Handewitt
Vielfältige DLV vermessene Strecken von 400 m Bambini bis Halbmarathon
Versorgungsstationen mit Wasser, Äpfeln und Bananen auf den längeren Strecken
additional: Start- und Zielbereich an der Wikinghalle in Handewitt. Startnummernausgabe am Samstag von 12:00 bis 16:00 Uhr und Sonntag ab 08:30 Uhr. Medaillen aus Holz, Verzicht auf Pappbecher, Nutzung eines Mehrwegsystems. Versorgung mit Getränken und Obst im Zielbereich und auf den Strecken. Online-Urkunden zum Download nach dem Lauf. Parkmöglichkeiten fußläufig zum Veranstaltungsort und Anreise mit ÖPNV möglich. Ummeldung bis Meldeschluss gegen Gebühr möglich.

name: Drei-Länder-Lauf
description: The Three-Country Run takes place in Arenshausen and connects the regions of Thuringia, Lower Saxony and Hesse. The event offers various race distances, including 1.2 km, 2 km, 5 km and 13 km, some of which are loop courses and others out-and-back races. In addition to the main races, there is a fun run for preschool children with no timing, as well as Nordic walking as a non-competitive event. The run has a long tradition as a symbol of the region growing together after German reunification.

name: Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf
description: Der Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung in Schackensleben, etwa 25 km westlich von Magdeburg. Angeboten werden Strecken über 400 m, 1,4 km, 6,0 km und 10,8 km, die durch den Ort und die umliegende Landschaft mit bördetypischem welligem Profil führen. Die Läufe finden auf Straßen und befestigten Feldwegen statt und bieten mehrere Getränkestellen. Für die Teilnehmer gibt es gute Umkleide- und Duschmöglichkeiten sowie eine umfassende Verpflegung mit Kaffee, Kuchen, Getränken und Gegrilltem. Nach dem Zieleinlauf können sich die Läufer mit Getränken und Obst stärken, und es gibt eine traditionelle Tombola mit attraktiven Preisen.
course_highlights: Streckenführung durch den Ort Schackensleben und die umliegende Landschaft mit welligem Profil
Laufen auf Straßen und befestigten Feldwegen
Mehrere Getränkestellen entlang der Strecke
additional: Start und Ziel aller Strecken ist der Sportplatz mit Umkleide- und Duschmöglichkeiten im Vereinshaus. Die Verpflegung umfasst Kaffee, Kuchen, Schmalzstullen, Getränke und Gegrilltes. Nach dem Zieleinlauf gibt es Getränke und Obst für die Teilnehmer. Parallel zur Siegerehrung findet eine Tombola mit attraktiven Preisen statt. Der Hopfenlauf ist Teil des Novo Nordisk Landescups und des Elbe-Ohre-Cups.

name: REWE Women´s Run Hamburg
description: The REWE Women’s Run Hamburg is a road race for beginners and ambitious runners in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg. The event offers a measured 10 km loop course starting and finishing at Ballindamm. In addition to the main race, there is also the REWE Girl’s Run for girls aged 5 to 10 over 1 kilometer. Participants receive a finisher medal and can use showers and changing facilities after the race.

name: NEW-Citylauf
description: The 25th NEW-Citylauf in Erkelenz is a popular running event that takes runners of all ability levels through the city center. The event offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere that appeals to both beginners and ambitious athletes. With a varied course and an exciting atmosphere, the NEW-Citylauf is a highlight of the regional events calendar. Taking part is an opportunity to enjoy the fun of running together with family and friends.

name: Sparkassenlauf
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a long-established running event with DLV-certified courses over 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. The races take runners through Wittringer Wald on a flat, fast loop course featuring paved walking paths, asphalt and a tartan track. All participants receive a personalised race number bearing their name and a finisher’s medal. The event also hosts the district road running championships and offers net times and live timing.

name: Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund
description: Der Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf in der Stadt Kappeln, der jährlich vom TSV Kappeln veranstaltet wird. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern verschiedener Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus die Möglichkeit, auf einer abwechslungsreichen Strecke durch die Stadt und ihre Umgebung zu laufen. Der Lauf fördert den Breitensport und das Gemeinschaftsgefühl in der Region. Teilnehmer können sich auf eine gut organisierte Veranstaltung mit familiärer Atmosphäre freuen.
course_highlights: Strecke führt durch die Innenstadt von Kappeln
Abwechslungsreiche Laufroute mit Stadt- und Naturabschnitten
Geeignet für Läufer aller Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus
additional: Die Veranstaltung wird vom TSV Kappeln organisiert, einem Sportverein mit vielfältigem Sportangebot. Es gibt keine expliziten Angaben zu Startzeiten, Wellen, oder besonderen Ausstattungen auf der Webseite. Die Anmeldung erfolgt online über die Startgeld-Seite. Die Veranstaltung ist Teil des Vereinsprogramms und wird regelmäßig in den News des TSV Kappeln kommuniziert.

name: Alfelder Bernd Meyer Staffelmarathon
description: The Alfelder Bernd Meyer Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay marathon held in Alfeld (Leine). The event is open to runners from across the region and is organized jointly by several local running clubs and the town of Alfeld. The course is an approximately 3 km loop, run twice, with the start and finish on the market square. Each team consists of 7 runners, who must be registered by name. Timing is electronic, using disposable transponders. There is also a children’s race of approximately 700 m.

name: Barsbütteler Volkslauf
description: The Barsbüttel Fun Run is a long-standing running event held every June at the sports field in the Barsbüttel Sports Center. It offers a range of distances from 400 m to 10 km, which are mostly flat and run along paved or firm, sandy farm tracks. Most of the routes pass through the traffic-free Barsbüttel countryside and offer scenic views, particularly the longer 5 km and 10 km routes. Times are measured electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterward. Food and refreshments are also available for runners and spectators.

name: BORNE TO RUN (48-Stunden-Lauf)
description: BORNE TO RUN is a 48-hour charity run in Unna that presents an extreme challenge to endurance and willpower. Participants are pushed to their limits over long, demanding hours. This race is for runners ready to take on a true test while supporting a good cause.

name: Famberglauf
description: The Famberglauf is a running event held in June in Fambach, organized by SV Schwarz-Weiß Fambach 09 e.V. The program offers four distances: a half marathon of 21.1 km, the 10.9 km Famberglauf, the 5 km Famberg Sprint, and a 1000 m children’s race. The event is aimed at runners of all ages and abilities and has more of the feel of a family-friendly club run than a major competition.

name: Ludwigsluster Schlossgartenlauf
description: The Ludwigslust Palace Garden Run takes place in Ludwigslust Palace Park and offers runners of all ages a varied choice of distances. The routes range from 2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, with additional walking events over 5 and 10 km. New to the program is a fun run for the youngest children, with no registration or timing, who receive an official medal at the finish. This traditional event warmly welcomes beginners and professionals alike to enjoy the beautiful park landscape.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: XVII Elbląski Bieg Piekarczyka Mini Bieg Piekarczyka
description: The Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is one of the largest and best-known running events in Elbląg, held every year in June. The two-day event combines sporting competition with numerous side attractions, including races at various distances and activities for children. The route runs through the streets of the city centre and features a flat asphalt-and-cobblestone surface with one hill, making it suitable for fast times. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, as well as many spectators cheering participants along the route.
course_highlights: Flat route with one hill on Teatralna Street
Asphalt (80%) and cobblestones (20%)
Route certified by the Polish Athletics Association
additional: The time limit for completing the race is 1 hour and 30 minutes. The Mini Piekarczyk Run takes place on loops of Teatralna Street ranging from 50 to 600 metres, adjusted to the children's ages. Race packs are distributed at two locations: Ogrody Shopping Centre (13 June) and the “Helena” MOSiR ice rink (14 June). Participants over the age of 70 are exempt from the entry fee after registering.

name: Omloop van Empel
description: The Omloop van Empel is a popular running race held annually in Empel. The anniversary edition attracts around 1,000 participants each year and is known for its sporty, friendly atmosphere. The organizers work hard to make it a wonderful day filled with socializing and sport. Participants and spectators are invited to enjoy this special running experience together.
course_highlights: Various distances for all levels
Friendly atmosphere with music and drinks
Includes children’s races and family activities
additional: Registration for the 10th edition is closed, and all race entries have been allocated. Around 1,000 participants are expected. The organizers encourage people to come cheer on the participants and experience the event’s atmosphere. Running and walking event; registration via inschrijven.nl; start location: Asmunt 3, Empel

name: Meine Nacht - Kirche laufend erleben
description: Der Lauf "Meine Nacht - Kirche laufend erleben" findet voraussichtlich am 11. Juni 2027 in 38527 Meine statt. Es handelt sich um einen 10 km Lauf mit flachem Profil, der auch als 5er-Staffel mit Teilstrecken von jeweils 2 km angeboten wird. Der Start erfolgt um 20:00 Uhr, und es gibt zudem Wettbewerbe für Kinder und Jugendliche. Die Strecke ist flach und eignet sich für Läufer aller Leistungsstufen.
course_highlights: Flache Strecke
10 km Distanz mit 5er-Staffel (Teilstrecken je 2 km)
Startzeit am Abend um 20:00 Uhr
additional: Start und Ziel sind für alle Wettbewerbe gleich. Für die genaue Ortsanzeige wird RUNME Premium benötigt. Es werden auch Wettbewerbe für Kinder und Jugendliche angeboten.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
organizer: VIF Gute Friidrott och Blodcentralen i Visby
description: Blodomloppet in Visby is a fun run organised to raise awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km on scenic routes that include Visby’s city wall, old town, promenade, Almedalen and harbour. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, with shorter distances. The event is open to individuals and teams, and ends with a group picnic for participants.
course_highlights: The 5 km route follows Visby’s city wall and passes through the historic old town
The 10 km route includes the city wall, promenade, Almedalen and Visby harbour
Lilla Blodomloppet takes place in an urban setting and starts behind the main stage
additional: Late registration is available on site from 16:00 on 16 June at the Information Tent. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib, medal and gift for blood donors. Team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing or use a picnic card (valid only for Blodomloppet at a distance). The scenic routes pass through historic and central parts of Visby. Water stations and medical assistance are available. Changing facilities and toilets are provided. Parking information and directions are available on the website. Participants can register individually or in teams of up to five. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib and medal; team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing. Lilla Blodomloppet has distances of 300 m and 1.6 km.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/visby/): 2027-06-15 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 15 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-15)

name: 95. Terrainkurweg Marathon
description: The 95th Terrainkurweg Marathon in Salzgitter is a challenging run on a hilly course with about 150 meters of elevation gain and loss. The route passes through Vöppstedter Forest, by the Liebenburg forester’s lodge, and along the Salzgitter golf course. The event is not an official DLV event and is intended for well-trained runners. Refreshments, including drinks and snacks, are available in a covered room.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Center for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors in a sporting atmosphere. The event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix and is held regularly, promoting a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Bolechowo, in the Czerwonak municipality.
The previous recorded edition covered a distance of 5 km.
The event is part of the Active Czerwonak at Night series.
additional: The event is free and takes place in the evening, usually between 19:30 and 22:00. This recurring sporting event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees, or required equipment.

name: Midsommarjoggen 2026
description: Midsommarjoggen is a running festival in Rynningeviken Nature Reserve in Örebro, inviting runners, families and colleagues to kick off Midsummer week together. The race is 7.2 km long and follows easy-to-run gravel paths with beautiful views and two wooden bridges over Lillån. For the youngest runners, there is an action-packed 600-metre Kidsrun without timing. After the finish, the evening continues with a pleasant after-run gathering with food, drinks and good company at Stora Hjortstorps Gård.
course_highlights: 7.2 km through Rynningeviken Nature Reserve on easy-to-run gravel paths
Two wooden bridges over Lillån
Two longer hills by Venastugan
additional: The Kidsrun starts at 17:45, with runners gathering at 17:40. Race numbers can be collected from 16:00 to 18:00 on race day. Timing uses a transponder lent out when race numbers are collected; it must be returned after the race. Water and sports drinks are available at 3 and 5 km. Toilets are available near the race area and at the aid stations. No changing facilities or showers are available on site. An after-run gathering with food and drinks is offered after the race (not included in the entry fee). Young people born in 2008 or later receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Members of certain running clubs may receive a discount through the member pages. Group registration is available by contacting info@epictrail.se.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Mesnaelva opp

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: For klassene 0-11 år, 12-15 og 16-19 år kr 80,-

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Familie koster kr 250,- pr løp pr familie

description: Mesnaelva Uphill is a challenging uphill race held in scenic surroundings along the Mesna River in Lillehammer. The course climbs 360 metres over approximately 4 km, starting at Strandtorget and finishing at Kanten kro. It is the first uphill race in the Sørdalskarusellen and has been held since 2008. In addition to the main course, there is a shorter 2.3 km course for younger participants with 241 metres of elevation gain. The event offers both virtual participation and evening mass starts in waves.
course_highlights: 4 km course with 360 metres of elevation gain, from 123 metres above sea level to 483 metres above sea level
The course follows the Mesna River through scenic areas of Lillehammer
Short course for younger participants: 2.3 km with 241 metres of elevation gain and a 10.2% gradient
additional: Mass start in waves: Wave 1 starts at 19:00 for men aged 12–39; Wave 2 starts at 19:01 for women aged 12–39 and men aged 40–49; Wave 3 starts at 19:02 for the remaining categories; and Wave 4 starts at 19:00 for the youngest participants on the short course. There is a drinks station in the finish area, clothing transport from the start to the finish, and medical services at the finish area. Results are sent to participants' mobile phones immediately after they finish. Participants can also take part virtually from 15–17 June and record their time via My Page under the self timing tab. There is also a short course for children, starting at Badedammen.

name: 4. Stadtwald-Firmenlauf
description: Der 4. Stadtwald-Firmenlauf in Oberhain (Königsee) ist ein gemeinschaftliches Laufevent, das Firmen und Teams aus der Region zusammenbringt. Die Veranstaltung fördert den Teamgeist und die Freude an Bewegung in einer naturnahen Umgebung. Der Lauf findet im Stadtwald statt und bietet eine angenehme Strecke für alle Teilnehmer. Es ist eine tolle Gelegenheit, Sport, Spaß und Gemeinschaft zu verbinden.
course_highlights: Lauf durch den malerischen Stadtwald von Oberhain
Naturnahe und abwechslungsreiche Strecke
Ideal für Firmen-Teams und gemeinschaftliches Laufen

name: Volksbank Stadtlauf Selm 2026
location: Campus Selm, Selm, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Volksbank Stadtlauf Selm is taking place for the fourth time as part of the popular town festival weekend. The officially measured course runs through the beautiful Auenpark and is popular with athletes from Selm and the surrounding region. The event offers races for various age groups, from Bambini races to fun runs over 5 and 10 kilometres. Mayor Thomas Orlowski will take part in the 10-kilometre race himself, highlighting the event’s friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Officially measured course through the Auenpark
Various races for children, teenagers and adults
Start and finish at Campus Selm
additional: The Stadtlauf begins with the Bambini race at 16:00 in the stadium (400 m). This is followed by school races over 1 km and 2.5 km, as well as fun runs over 5 km (18:00) and 10 km (19:00). Award ceremonies take place between the races. Volksbank Selm-Bork eG is the event’s main sponsor. Several race distances, start in the Auenpark, children’s and youth races, registration now open

name: Borejoggen
price_range: 300–350 kr för Borejoggen och Lagjoggen enligt 2026 års prisuppgifter; Minijoggen 150 kr
description: Borejoggen is a long-established running race held in Torsby every Midsummer’s Eve, with a 42-year history. The race follows an 8.5-kilometre asphalt course through central Torsby and welcomes runners of all levels, from elite athletes to recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in the 1.5-kilometre Minijoggen. There is also a popular team race, Lagjoggen, where three participants compete together and the team’s combined time is counted.
course_highlights: 8.5 km asphalt course through central Torsby
Minijoggen for children and young people, 1.5 km
Water stations at 2 km, 4 km, 5.8 km and the finish
additional: Mass start for Minijoggen at 9:30 on Östmarksvägen. Mass start for Borejoggen and Lagjoggen at 11:00 on Östmarksvägen. Changing facilities and showers are available at Torsby Ski Tunnel and Valbergsstugan. Prizes are awarded for the sprint prize at 2 km, the hill prize at Kollsberg after 5 km, and the top three finishers in the women’s and men’s classes and the team class. Traffic marshals and course guides are stationed at road crossings with traffic. Medical assistance is available at the finish and ready to respond on the course. Previous editions have started and finished at Herrgårdsparken. Borejoggen and Lagjoggen have started at 11:00 and Minijoggen at 9:30.

name: Orsakajtn
