description: Orsakajt'n and Orsabajk'n are MTB and running races held every Midsummer’s Eve in Orsa. The course follows the Ore River valley, with forest trails, gravel roads and a little asphalt, and gently to moderately rolling terrain over sand ridges. Race numbers are sent digitally the day before and can be picked up at the venue or at Karl Hedin in Orsa. The MTB race requires a licence and membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation.
course_highlights: The course follows the Ore River valley on forest trails, gravel roads and asphalt
Gently to moderately rolling terrain over beautiful sand ridges
The course is marked with orange enduro arrows and kilometre signs
additional: Race numbers are sent digitally to your mobile phone the day before the race. Bibs can be collected at Karl Hedin in Orsa on Thursday from 16:00 to 20:00 or at the start location on race day. No on-site entries; registration closes one hour before the start. No refunds in case of injury or illness. Parking is available at Lillåvallen. Registration is online and closes one hour before the start; on-site registration is not available. Bibs can be collected at Karl Hedin in Orsa or at the respective start location on race day.

name: Vikersundbakken Trappeløp. Vegard Hjelmesæths minneløp 2027
description: Vikersundbakken Stair Run. Vegard Hjelmesæth Memorial Run 2027 takes place on Friday, June 18, 2027, in Modum. This unique race offers 6-, 12- and 24-hour events, where participants run up the stairs in the ski jump and down the road on a loop of approximately 2.3 km with 200 metres of elevation gain per lap. The goal is to complete as many laps as possible within the chosen time limit. There is also an option for a children's race and a single lap for those who wish to take part.
course_highlights: Run up the stairs at the Vikersundbakken ski jump
A loop of approximately 2.3 km with 200 metres of elevation gain per lap
Run down the road after the ski jump
additional: Tickets are sold via racetracker.one. The event includes 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as a children's race and the option to run a single lap. The loop has 200 metres of elevation gain and goes both up the stairs in the ski jump and down the road. Registration via racetracker.one. There is also a single-lap competition and a children's race.

name: Skagerrakmila
description: Skagerrakmila is a summer race in Arendal that passes through the city centre and along the waterfront. The course offers varied terrain, with both flat sections and challenging climbs, including a tough hill by the kayak club. The start and finish are in Pollen, and the race is suitable for recreational runners looking for a challenging 10 km in beautiful surroundings. The event is organised by IK Grane Arendal Friidrett and has a pleasant summer atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Pollen, in central Arendal
The course runs along the waterfront with lovely views and passes several landmarks, including Barbu Church and Arendal Old Town Hall
A challenging climb up to Vollenetoppen and a steep hill by the kayak club
additional: The children's race starts in Pollen and follows a shorter route through the city centre. The start and finish have been moved approximately 100 metres to improve flow in the finish area. There is a key point on the course with crossing traffic between 5.5 and 6.5 km, where runners must keep to the right. A children's race is also held. The course information is based on the 2025 map, so the route for 2027 may be different.

name: 44. Heiligenröder Abendlauf
price_range: modest registration fees, free for Bambinis
description: The 44th Heiligenröder Evening Run is a traditional night road race in Niestetal, Germany, and part of the Nordhessencup running series. The event offers distances for all ages and ability levels, from 400 m for Bambinis to 20.35 km for experienced runners. It combines competitive racing with more casual running options: Bambinis, walkers, and Nordic walkers are timed but not ranked. Bambinis can take part for free, while children, teenagers, and adults pay moderate entry fees.
course_highlights: Night road race in Niestetal-Heiligenrode
Distances from 400 m to 20.35 km
Part of the Nordhessencup running series
additional: Bambinis run for free; entry fees for children, teenagers, and adults are moderate. The event is listed on laufen.de. Typical June weather: approx. 23 °C, mostly sunny. Night race, multiple distances, events for all ages, part of the Nordhessencup running series.

name: Gänseliesellauf
location: Krischerstraße, Monheim am Rhein, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Stadt Monheim am Rhein, Sportgemeinschaft Monheim 1894/1968 e.V.
description: The 40th Gänseliesellauf takes place in Monheim am Rhein and traditionally kicks off the town festival. Five different races are offered for various age groups, ranging from a 900-metre race for kindergarten children to a 10-kilometre race for adults. The event is organised by the City of Monheim am Rhein together with Sportgemeinschaft Monheim 1894/1968 e. V. Alongside the sporting competition, it offers a varied programme of food and festival activities. The races start and finish on Krischerstraße, and all participants receive certificates that can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Krischerstraße, at number 10
Five races for different age groups and distances
Event held as part of the Monheim town festival, with a festival programme
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before each race. Certificates can be downloaded after the race via my.raceresult.com. Refreshing drinks and food are available nearby during the races. The event is supported by MEGA Monheimer Elektrizitäts- und Gasversorgung GmbH. Various race distances, registration by email, certificates available online, town festival programme

name: Erftflitzer Lauf
description: The Erftflitzerlauf in Neuss-Holzheim is a family-friendly running event with a long tradition dating back to 1993. It offers various races for children, young people and adults, from short Bambini races to 5.5 km races for adults and young people. The event is known for its fun-focused spirit, with community and the joy of running at its heart. The course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Holzheim and offers suitable challenges for all age groups.
course_highlights: Various distances from approximately 400 m to 5.5 km
Relay races of 3 x approximately 400 m for different age groups
Family-friendly atmosphere with an emphasis on fun and community
additional: The Erftflitzerlauf includes several races, with start times from 17:30, beginning with Bambini and children’s races, followed by youth and adult races and relay races. The event is designed as a fun run without prizes for winners; instead, there is a raffle. Age categories are clearly defined, and races are available for children born in 2019 through to adults. The event takes place at the sports facility in Holzheim. Races for all age groups, family-friendly, central location, known as the Erftflitzerlauf since the 1990s.

name: Legdener Volkslauf / Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The Legden Midsummer Night Run is a popular fun run through the centre of Legden. The event has a relaxed atmosphere without much emphasis on performance, as only the times of the first three female and male runners are recorded. Events include children’s races, a kids’ race for older children, 5 km and 10 km runs for teenagers and adults, and a 5 km course for walkers and Nordic walkers. Wheelchair users are warmly invited to take part in the 5 km walk. Due to a road closure, the course has been slightly adjusted and now follows Windmühlenweg, Osterwicker Straße and Melroseweg.
course_highlights: Run through the centre of Legden with cheering spectators
5 km and 10 km courses with a revised route via Osterwicker Straße and Melroseweg
Children’s races in two age groups (400 m for those born in 2022 or later, and for those born in 2020 and 2021)
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective start. Non-cash prizes will be drawn by bib number. Courses for children, teenagers, adults, walkers and wheelchair users; course changes due to a road closure

name: 21. Laatzen Leinelauf
description: The 21st Laatzen Leinelauf is taking place, offering runners routes of 3.5 km, 6.5 km, and 10 km through the idyllic Leine floodplain, with nature, water, and wide-open meadows. The event also includes a 1.2 km Bambini run and a 6.5 km walking category. The 10 km route includes a team classification for mixed teams. The traditional Laatzen Wine Festival takes place alongside the race, rounding off the evening with culinary and musical highlights.

name: 40. Braunschweiger Nachtlauf
description: The 40th Braunschweig Night Run offers a wide range of sporting events for all age groups, from Bambini races to recreational runs. The races pass through Braunschweig city center, with the start and finish on Bohlweg; the Bambini races start at Burgplatz. The event is known for its special atmosphere and for the support of the Braunschweigische Sparkassenstiftung, which makes the event possible and helps it grow. The race bib serves as a ticket for public transport in Braunschweig on the day of the event. All finishers can download certificates, and baggage drop-off is open until 23:30.

name: SportScheck RUN Hamburg
description: The SportScheck RUN Hamburg is a traditional night run around the Outer Alster, held in a lively evening atmosphere. Depending on the distance, runners can complete one or two laps of the 7.5 km route around the Alster. There are special 1 km and 1.8 km races for children. The start and finish area in Alsterpark offers a special atmosphere, with a cheering zone, photo point and a large medal wall bringing the Hanseatic flair to life at dusk.

name: Brunsbüttler Citylauf
description: The Brunsbüttel City Run is an urban running event in Brunsbüttel, Schleswig-Holstein, featuring 5 km and 10 km races, as well as a short stadium run for children. The start and finish are at the Bildungszentrum stadium on Ziegelweg. The event is open to adults, young people, school groups, corporate teams, and children—not just club athletes. The 5 km course is a loop, while the 10 km course is run twice. The youngest participants can take part in an approximately 400 m children’s run in the stadium, making it easy for families to follow all the action.

name: Jemgumer Dörploop
description: Der Jemgumer Dörploop ist ein vielseitiger Laufwettbewerb in Jemgum, der verschiedene Distanzen für alle Altersgruppen anbietet. Die Strecke besteht aus Runden von 5,3 km, die je nach Wettbewerb mehrfach gelaufen werden. Neben Einzelwettbewerben gibt es auch einen Staffelwettbewerb mit vier Läufern. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine elektronische Zeitmessung mit Mehrwegtranspondern aus und bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit Urkunden, Medaillen und Sachpreisen für die Teilnehmer.
course_highlights: Rundkurs von 5,3 km Länge
Staffellauf mit 4 × 5,3 km Runden
Wasserstellen auf der Strecke und Verpflegung im Ziel
additional: Nachmeldungen sind bis 60 Minuten vor dem jeweiligen Start möglich, mit einer Nachmeldegebühr von 3,00 € für alle Wettbewerbe außer Bambini und Schüler. Die Zeitmessung erfolgt elektronisch über Mehrwegtransponder am Fuß, die nach dem Lauf zurückzugeben sind (10,00 € Gebühr bei Nicht-Rückgabe). Im Ziel werden Getränke und Obst vom EDEKA Blank angeboten.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2025 Lauf 2: 34. Wöbbeler Volkslauf "Rund um den Hahnenberg"
description: The course runs around Hahnenberg and offers runners a varied challenge. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and promises a pleasant atmosphere in typical June weather, usually with sunny conditions.

name: Challenge Gdańsk 2026
description: Challenge Gdańsk is a triathlon held in a beautiful location on the Baltic Sea, in the city of freedom and Solidarity. The event includes the T100 distance, consisting of a 2 km swim in the Gulf of Gdańsk, an 80 km fast bike course through the Vistula River delta, and an 18 km run along Gdańsk’s beach and Ronald Reagan Park. The finish line is at the Gdańsk pier in Brzeźno, making for a unique finish experience. The event is an official qualifying race and attracts athletes from various categories, including Challenge Women by Brooks.
course_highlights: 2 km swim in the Gulf of Gdańsk, starting and finishing on Gdańsk Brzeźno beach
80 km fast bike course through the Vistula River delta, passing through Kiezmark, Cedry Małe, and Koszwały
18 km run over 4 laps along Gdańsk’s beach and Ronald Reagan Park, with aid stations along the course
additional: The Sprint distance starts at 8:00 from Gdańsk Brzeźno beach. The race office is open from 10:00 to 20:00. The option to purchase a start fee refund is available if withdrawing by 31 May 2027. The bike course consists of two fast laps through the Vistula River delta. The run course consists of 4 laps of 4.5 km, with aid stations on each lap. The finish line is at the pier in Gdańsk Brzeźno. Athletes must collect their race packs and attend the race briefing. The organizer reserves the right to change the course and race format in the event of adverse weather conditions.

name: Nocny Bieg Świętojański
description: The Świętojański Night Run is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the 2026 Grand Prix of Gdynia. The main 10 km race takes place amid the city’s picturesque scenery, accompanied by races for children and youth. The event attracts runners of different age groups, offering sporting competition and a chance to connect in a nighttime atmosphere. The organizers provide professional event support as well as photo and video coverage.

name: Grachtenloop
description: The Zorgspecialist Grachtenloop is an atmospheric evening run through Haarlem’s beautiful old town, with participants running along the canals and waterways. The course passes various cultural and tourist attractions and is supported by enthusiastic spectators, bands and DJs. The 10 km distance consists of two laps of the 5 km course. There is also a Hero KidsRun for children aged 4 and up, and a BusinessRun with extra facilities. The event offers a unique combination of sport and conviviality in a historic city setting.
course_highlights: Course through Haarlem’s old town, along canals and waterways
Passes various cultural and tourist attractions
Musical support from bands and DJs along the course
additional: Registration includes a first name on the race bib, official results on the website, a safe, closed course, refreshment stations along the course and at the finish, medical care, a personal finish video, a unique medal, entertainment, timekeeping by ChronoRace, and home delivery of the race bib via PostNL for registrations before 1 June. The BusinessRun includes a VIP location, food, drinks and massage. Group registration is also available, with separate invoicing and race bib delivery. The event provides race bibs, a course, refreshment stations, a medal, entertainment, timekeeping and medical support. Race bibs are delivered to the homes of participants in the Netherlands.

name: Run Malmö
description: RUN MALMÖ is a city race offering two distances, a 21 km half marathon and 10 km, with a shared start and finish in the heart of Malmö. The course combines the city’s industrial charm with green stretches and beautiful waterfront views, creating an energetic and varied running experience. Crowd support and a fresh sea breeze help runners all the way to the finish. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, fruit and drinks, and services include water stations and medical assistance along the course.
course_highlights: Measured and certified 10 km and 21.0975 km courses
A course with industrial charm, green stretches and leafy trails
Beautiful waterfront views and a fresh sea breeze
additional: Water stations provide water and sports drinks. A measured, closed course with race marshals. Medical assistance in the finish area and at several points along the course. A medal, fruit, a bar and drinks for everyone who completes the race. Toilets at the event area and water stations. Distance changes are possible for an administration fee. Folksam’s recreational race insurance is available to purchase. Strollers and wheelchair participants are permitted, but the course is not adapted for wheelchair racing.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://runmalmo.se/nyhetsbrev/): 2027-06-19 — "Lördag den 19 juni 2027 smäller det – Efter den fantastiska stämningen under årets lopp ser vi fram emot att välkomna di" (was estimated 2027-06-13)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Lördag den 19 juni 2027 smäller det – Efter den fantastiska stämningen under årets lopp ser vi fram emot att välkomna dig till ännu en oförglömlig löparfest.

name: Sentrumsgateløpet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km kr 50,- (Under 12 år) + 10 kroner i adm.gebyr

description: Sentrumsgateløpet in Kongsvinger is an annual city festival and running event offering officially measured distances of 5 km and 10 km, as well as a children’s race. The course runs on both sides of the Glomma, with the start and finish at Rådhusplassen by the library. The event combines the joy of sport with activities and a lively atmosphere in the town centre, and is suitable for all ages and ability levels. All finishers receive a participation medal, and prizes are awarded to the top runners in various categories.
course_highlights: The course runs on both sides of the Glomma
The 10 km is run as two laps of the same course
Officially measured distances, measured by an authorised course measurer
additional: Race bibs are distributed on the day of the event, with distribution monitored. Water stations are available during the race. Toilets and changing rooms/showers are available near the start/finish area. Results are published on EQ Timing, the local newspaper Glåmdalen, kondis.no and the race website. A children’s race is held in Byparken, with distances of up to 500 metres.

name: Sommernattsløpet Oslo
price_range: Fra 490 kr per distanse, pluss gebyrer
description: Sommernattsløpet Oslo is the most fun street race of the summer, with fast courses and beautiful surroundings at Filipstadkaia. Choose between 5 km and 10 km, both with minimal elevation gain and good opportunities to set a new personal best. The race takes place at sunset, with music and cheering, and all participants receive a drink and a great medal at the finish. It is a social and inclusive event for both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is a single lap at full speed
The 10 km course passes Filipstadkaia and includes an extra loop
The courses have minimal elevation gain and fast sections
additional: Start and finish at Filipstadkaia by Skur 13. Race bibs can be collected the day before or on race day from 17:00. Pacers are available for various finish times in the 5 km and 10 km races. Corporate registration is available, with dedicated administration and a VIP package for over 100 participants. The listed start times are 5 km at 19:00, 10 km under 50 minutes at 20:00, and 10 km over 50 minutes at 21:30. Start times may change depending on the number of registrations. Runner’s World will provide pacers in Oslo.

name: HOKA Norefjell Trail
description: HOKA Norefjell Trail is a spectacular trail race held at Norefjell Ski & Spa. The event offers three distances: 12 km, 22 km and 42 km, all featuring varied terrain with trails, gravel roads and mountain areas. Participants can expect challenging climbs, technical sections and beautiful views, especially on the 22 km and marathon distances, which reach the summit of Høgevarde at 1,450 metres. The event also includes a free children’s event with games and running around a small lake, making it a family-friendly experience.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with gravel roads, technical trails and open mountain areas
Challenging climb to Høgevarde at 1,450 metres (22K and 42K)
Beautiful mountain views and a downhill stretch towards the finish area
additional: Free parking at Norefjell Ski & Spa. Bus transport is offered from Oslo and Gardermoen and can be booked when registering. Aid stations are available on all distances with snacks, sports drinks and water, but participants must bring their own cup or bottle (at least 0.5 L). Age limits apply, and gear checks may take place. The children’s event is free and requires no registration. After the race, there will be a social gathering with an awards ceremony and an evening party. The race takes place on 19 June 2027 at Norefjell Ski & Spa. A free children’s race is also planned, and the participant limit is 1,200. The race weekend programme includes social runs, including a 5 km run.

name: Kristinaløpet og Kristinastafetten
description: Kristinaløpet and Kristinastafetten are traditional races held on the streets of Tønsberg, starting and finishing at Bystranda on Kaldnes. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances, an untimed fitness class, a relay with five short legs, and the 500-metre Children’s Kristinaløpet. The courses feature a scenic loop that includes a full circuit out to Ilene, and the relay route passes through Slottsfjelltunnelen, among other places. Runners start in waves based on their expected finish time, and electronic chip timing begins when they cross the start line.
course_highlights: The 10 km course includes a full loop out to Ilene
The relay consists of five legs, covering 5 km in total, and passes through Slottsfjelltunnelen, among other places
Start and finish at Bystranda on Kaldnes, with wave starts to prevent runners from mixing together
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the Olympia Sport store at Jarlsberg from 15 to 18 June and on race day from 10:00. The pedestrian bridge between central Tønsberg and Kaldnes closes shortly before the start. Runners start in waves based on their expected finish time to prevent them from mixing together. Timing begins only when the chip on the race number crosses the start line. The 500-metre Children’s Kristinaløpet is open for registration on the day. Children’s Kristinaløpet is approximately 500 metres, with registration on race day. A 40% discount on the main race is offered to participants taking part in both Kristinaløpet and Kristinastafetten, subject to further terms.

name: Trysil-løpet
description: Trysil-løpet is an inclusive race in central Trysil, with fast, flat courses suitable for all ages. Distances are 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 600 m and 300 m; the shortest races are untimed. The start and finish are at the north end of Trysilsenteret, and the courses are officially measured and designed to be fast, with little elevation gain. Places are limited for the 5 km and 10 km. All finishers receive a medal, with prizes for the top finishers in the longer distances.
course_highlights: Fast, flat course with little elevation gain
Start and finish at the north end of Trysilsenteret in central Trysil
Officially measured courses with few turns and good opportunities for fast times
additional: Race numbers can be collected from the event office in the foyer of Trysil cinema. There is a total limit of 400 places for the 5 km and 10 km. All finishers receive medals. Prizes go to the first three women and men in the 5 km and 10 km. A one-time licence is required for participants aged 13 and over who do not have an annual licence. Kondis members receive a discount of 40 kr. Timing and registration are handled by EQ Timing.

name: Besseggløpet
description: Besseggløpet is a spectacular skyrace that crosses the iconic Besseggen ridge in Jotunheimen, one of Norway’s most beautiful hiking destinations. The race follows the regular T-marked route over the ridge, starting at Memurubu and finishing at Gjendesheim Tourist Lodge. The terrain is rugged, with gravel and rocks, and the highest point is approximately 1,743 metres above sea level. The course is approximately 14 km long and offers a challenging, scenic experience for both competitive and recreational runners. A mini version is also held for children aged 3 to 10, and parents and grandparents are welcome to take part.
course_highlights: The course follows the T-marked route over Besseggen, starting at Memurubu and finishing at Gjendesheim
Gravel and rocky terrain, with the highest point at approximately 1,743 metres above sea level
Drinking stations at the Glitterheim trail junction and before the summit of Besseggen
additional: Boat transport to the start at Memurubu is included and arranged by the organiser. The recreational class has reserved places on the 07:45 boat and the additional boat at 08:30. The competitive class takes the 11:00 boat, with the race starting at 12:00. Timing is by chip and race number, and split times are published continuously. Participant packs containing the race number and timing chip can be collected on Friday evening and Saturday morning outside Gjendesheim Tourist Lodge. Shuttle buses run from the car park at Reinsvangen to the start and finish area. There are drinking stations along the route and refreshments at the finish.

name: Nøsen Hundreds Ultramarathon
description: Nøsen Hundreds is an ultramarathon offering distances of 21 km, 50 km, and 100 km through beautiful and challenging mountain terrain in Valdres, Norway. The race follows historic trails in Stølsvidda, an area with a rich cultural heritage dating back to the Stone Age. Participants experience spectacular landscapes of mountains, rolling hills, and traditional trails that have been a lifeline for people for centuries. The race combines a physical challenge with experiences in nature and a sense of being part of a long tradition. In 2025, Nøsen Hundreds celebrates its fifth anniversary and promises an unforgettable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Historic trails in Stølsvidda with cultural heritage dating back to the Stone Age
Varied terrain with mountains, rolling hills, and gravel roads
Challenging climbs and mountain crossings, especially on the 50 km and 100 km distances
additional: All races start and finish at Nøsen Yoga and Mountain Hotel. Mandatory equipment is required for the 50 km and 100 km distances, including a backpack/vest, windproof and waterproof jacket and trousers, a GPS device with a GPX file, a mobile phone with the emergency number saved, and first-aid supplies. Participants in the 100 km race receive drop bags. An optional Salomon Shakeout Session and an introduction to sports psychology are also offered on the evening before the race. Several accommodation options are available at a discount for participants, including the option to camp at the hotel. For the 100 km course, information from 2026 states that runners must navigate using a GPS device and a physical compass, and download the official GPX file before the start.

name: Solnedgangen
description: Solnedgangen is a fast 5 km race held annually in June, starting and finishing at Sola Strand Hotel. The race is open to everyone over 10, whether you are a beginner or an experienced recreational runner. The course is flat and follows the cycle path by the beach, with a short gravel section at the turnaround. Participants can follow pacers at different target times, and everyone who finishes receives a medal and an official time via electronic timing.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km course along the cycle path by the beach
Runs on pavement, with a gravel section at the turnaround
Start and finish at Sola Strand Hotel, with views of the beach
additional: Race bibs can be collected in advance at Anton Sport Forus or at the start area from 20:30 on race day. Parking is recommended at Regestranden, about 1 km from the start/finish. Toilets are available at the hotel and the car park. Pacers are available for 20, 25, 30 and 35 minutes. There are refreshments, a great atmosphere and an awards ceremony at the finish. The listed race arrangements include electronic timing, pacers for 20, 25, 30 and 35 minutes, a medal for everyone who finishes, refreshments and a prize-giving ceremony.

name: Nordmarka Skogsmaraton 2027
price_range: Halvmaraton: 590–1 090 kr; maraton: 690–1 090 kr; ultra: 790–1 200 kr
description: Nordmarka Forest Marathon is a traditional race being held for the 34th time in 2027. The race takes place in the beautiful Nordmarka, starting and finishing at Sognsvann Snow Park in Oslo. The courses are mainly on gravel roads with some trails, offering a hilly, scenic route that is gentle on the legs. The event offers three distances: marathon, half marathon, and ultra. The ultra combines the marathon and half-marathon courses. The race is known for good refreshments and a friendly atmosphere in the forest.
course_highlights: The course is mostly on gravel roads, with approximately 1.5 km of trail on the marathon course
The marathon course has approximately 770 metres of elevation gain; the ultra has approximately 1,195 metres
Beautiful natural surroundings in Nordmarka, with fresh air and good refreshments along the way
additional: Start and finish at Sognsvann Snow Park, with easy public transport access via the metro to Kringsjå station. Bag storage with staff on hand. Self-seeding, with wave starts based on expected finish time. A race shirt can be ordered during registration until 8 March. Ultra runners have a separate turnaround point, with the option to access their own food and drink and receive a medical check. There is no time limit for the marathon, but ultra runners must pass the turnaround by 13:30. The minimum age is 15 for the half marathon and 18 for the marathon. Race-day registration is possible if places are available.

name: Chicken Race / Bootcamp Survivor
description: Chicken Race is Norway’s largest obstacle race for the whole family, held at a former military camp at Helgelandsmoen near Hønefoss. The course is approximately 2 km long, with over 40 different obstacles suitable for both adults and children, including optional challenges and shortcuts for younger participants. Bootcamp Survivor also offers challenging obstacle races over 5 km, 8 km and 16 km, including elite classes that are official qualifying races for the OCR European Championships and OCR World Championship. The event is a celebration filled with excitement, fun and a sense of achievement for all levels and ages.
course_highlights: 2 km family course with over 40 different obstacles
5 km obstacle course with 70 challenging obstacles, including a military obstacle course and mud
8 km and 16 km courses with up to 90 obstacles, water, fire and challenging obstacles
additional: All obstacles are optional, with easier alternative exercises available. Children get free admission to Ringeriksbadet. The event includes wave starts, smoke effects, explosions and medals. Participants are advised to be able to swim for the water obstacles, and safety personnel are present. The event takes place at Helgelandsmoen Næringspark, 3512 Hønefoss. The 5 km course has a non-timed recreational class, and challenging obstacles have alternative exercises. The ability to swim is recommended for Bootcamp Survivor.

name: KRS Last One Standing
description: KRS Last One Standing is a unique ultrarun in Kristiansand where participants run a 6.7 km lap within one hour. The race is repeated every hour until only one runner remains. The event takes place in picturesque Jegersberg, with the start and base at Spicheren Fitness Centre. This race combines endurance and tactics in a social, challenging atmosphere, and 50% of the surplus goes to Mental Helse Ungdom.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km course to be completed within one hour
The race takes place in and around picturesque Jegersberg
Backyard format with repeated laps every hour until one runner remains
additional: Mandatory equipment includes a headlamp and reflective vest during dark hours. Snacks, fruit, water, cola and sports drinks are served, as well as hot food every 7th lap. Participants can set up a base indoors in the hall or outdoors, and must arrange their own accommodation. After the race, participants can lie down in the hall to rest. Prizes are awarded to the winners and record holders. Spicheren Fitness Centre is listed as the start and finish area. Previous editions have offered the possibility of resting indoors between laps.

name: RunwayK 2027
description: RunwayK is a unique race held on the active runway at Kjeller Airport, one of the world’s oldest active runways. The course is very fast and flat, with minimal elevation gain, making it perfect for both first-time runners and those looking to set a new personal record. Participants can run or roll 5 km or 10 km, and there are also dedicated para classes and a children’s race, Runway Mini. The event offers an exclusive opportunity to run on a runway, with air traffic closed during the race.
course_highlights: The course runs on the active runway at Kjeller Airport
The 5 km course is fast and flat, with just 4 metres of elevation gain
The 10 km course is among the flattest in the world, with just 7 metres of elevation gain, and includes both the runway and streets
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the airport on race day from 8 a.m. Pacers will be available for both the 5K and 10K. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and the top 3 women and men in each distance receive prize money. Outdoor baggage storage is available at the venue. The children’s race, Runway Mini, has distances of 200 and 900 metres, and adults can run for free alongside the children if they line up at the back of the field. The event is open to all ages and levels, including wheelchair users and para classes. Pacers will be available for the 5 km and 10 km. The 2027 course is under development, and details may be adjusted.

name: Lyngdal 5km
description: Welcome to the Lyngdal 5 km road race, a great and inclusive event held in the centre of Lyngdal in early summer. The race features a flat, fast, accurately measured course that starts in the town centre, heads down towards Kvavik, across towards Rosfjord, and back to the centre. The event is suitable for both experienced and new runners, and a children’s race of approximately 1 km is also held in the town centre. We follow the athletics federation’s age limits for road races and welcome everyone to a running celebration.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 5 km course
Start and finish in the centre of Lyngdal
The course passes through Kvavik and Rosfjord
additional: A children’s race of approximately 1 km is held in the town centre at 10:00 before the main race. Registration has been listed through EQ-timing.

name: Vohwinkeler Fuchslauf 2026
location: Sportplatz Waldkampfbahn, Wuppertal-Vohwinkel, Wuppertal, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 2,00 € Nachmeldegebühr ab 17. Juni 2026, sonst keine expliziten Preise genannt
description: The event offers various race distances for all age groups, from fun runs for young children and school races to 5 km and 10 km races for teenagers and adults. The courses run through Osterholz and along Eulenkopfweg, providing a varied running environment. The event places particular emphasis on participation by the youngest runners, who receive a finisher’s medal regardless of distance. Late registration is possible until shortly before each race, offering flexibility for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Waldkampfbahn sports field in Vohwinkel
Course runs through Osterholz and along Eulenkopfweg
Fun runs for young children and school races on the sports field’s track
additional: Late registration is available on 19.06. from 16:00-18:00 at Kaiserstraße 55, 42329 Wuppertal, and at the sports field until 60 minutes before each race. The event includes fun runs for young children (approx. 400 m), school races (800 m and 1600 m), and 3.2 km, 5 km, and 10 km races. Every Bambini-Fuchslauf finisher receives a medal. Races for children, teenagers, and adults; online registration; late registration available on site; start and finish at the Waldkampfbahn; medals for all child participants.

name: 19. Burgberglauf Gehrden
price_range: 3 € pro Kind für Bambini- und Kinderläufe, sonst keine Angaben
description: The Burgberglauf 2026 takes place on June 20 in Gehrden and offers runners a choice of distances on a challenging 3.3 km loop with around 50 metres of elevation gain. The course passes through woodland and open farmland and requires a good level of fitness. Children under 12 have a separate, flat out-and-back course, while the Bambini runners start on shorter loops around the sports field. The event is family-friendly and, in addition to the races, offers a raffle with attractive prizes as well as refreshments for spectators and participants.
course_highlights: Challenging 3.3 km loop with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain
Course passes through woodland and open farmland
Separate, flat out-and-back course for children under 12
additional: Start and finish at the sports field of Matthias-Claudius-Gymnasium, Knülweg 10, 30989 Gehrden. Changing rooms and showers are available in the sports hall. Parking is not available in the event area. Race bib collection from 11:00 a.m. in the sports hall. Fully electronic timing via a chip attached to the shoe; return the chip after finishing (a €10 fee applies if it is lost). Raffle with attractive prizes; the grand prize is a pizza oven. The Bambini races (300 m and 700 m) start from 2:00 p.m. Bambini entries are also accepted on site on race day (€3, cash only). Refreshments for spectators include bratwurst, drinks and ice cream. Course: challenging 3.3 km loop, woodland trails, paved; online registration only; race bibs collected in the sports hall; no parking in the event area; Bambini races have no placings and include a medal.

name: Abendlauf TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen
description: The TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen Evening Run takes place in Wolfhagen-Ippinghausen. The event offers 10 km, half marathon, and marathon races on firm, paved forest paths, starting and finishing at Weidelsburg Stadium. The course runs through the town forest, including scenic sections such as Stöcketeich, and has several aid stations. The event is open to all age groups and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with certificates for all participants.
course_highlights: 21 km loop for the half marathon; the marathon covers the loop twice
Start and finish at Weidelsburg Stadium, with a scenic loop through the town forest
Several aid stations (4 for the half marathon, 9 for the marathon); showers and changing rooms available
additional: Spikes are not allowed in any weather conditions. Start times are staggered by age group, from 16:30 (Bambini) to 17:00 (10 km/half marathon/marathon). Every participant receives a certificate. Parking is available at the sports ground, Waldecker Straße, and Vor dem Busche. HLV insurance covers all participants, including non-club members. Courses are on firm forest paths and the sports ground; spikes are not permitted. Registration via Raceresult; insurance provided by HLV.

name: Die 49. Nacht von Borgholzhausen
description: The Night of Borgholzhausen is a special running event held in the town centre of Borgholzhausen. From the Bambini Run and Schoolrunning to the atmospheric 10 km night run, there is something for all ages and ability levels. The event is known for its unique atmosphere, created by live music, cheerleaders, DJs and torches along the route. Teams, beginners and ambitious runners can enjoy an unforgettable evening filled with community spirit and a passion for running.
course_highlights: Paved streets through the town centre of Borgholzhausen
Cheerleaders, live music and DJs creating a lively atmosphere along the route
Torch-lit route and garden parties along the course
additional: The event starts with the Bambini Run at 18:00 (300 m, untimed, registration through kindergartens). This is followed by two Schoolrunning races: one for primary school pupils (approx. 1.6 km) and one for secondary school pupils (approx. 3 km). The company run (5 km) and the 5 km run are suitable for beginners and teams. The highlight is the 10 km night run, which is enlivened by a special atmosphere, with plenty of spectators and music. Individual registration is available online until shortly before the final start at 21:30. Various running distances, a running course for beginners, an atmosphere with music and torches, online registration

name: Europalauf 2026
location: Hennef, Siegtal, Allner See, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 20th Hennef Europalauf offers a wide range of races, from 1,000 metres to the half marathon (21.1 km). The routes run through the centre of Hennef, along Allner Lake and through the picturesque Sieg Valley. The event is for the whole family, with beginner-friendly races for children and beginners as well as challenging courses for ambitious runners. Particular emphasis is placed on inclusion, and special races are offered for people with disabilities. The event is organised by Hennefer Turnverein in cooperation with the City of Hennef and takes place in a friendly, volunteer-run atmosphere.
course_highlights: A range of courses from 1,000 m to 21.1 km through Hennef, Allner Lake and the Sieg Valley
Half marathon with more than 150 metres of elevation gain and five bridge crossings
Panoramic routes with views across the Sieg Valley to the Siebengebirge
additional: Late registration is available at the Town Hall on event day from 8 a.m. until 60 minutes before the respective start, with a late-registration fee of €2 per person per race. The start and finish are at the Historic Hennef Town Hall (Frankfurter Straße 97). Changing rooms and showers are available at the Kronos Aktivclub. Timing is provided professionally using disposable chips from runtiming. The awards ceremony takes place in front of the Town Hall at 1 p.m. There is a team challenge with cash prizes for the top teams in the HIT Panorama Run. The courses are not suitable for wheelchair users, and coaching from a bicycle will result in disqualification. The event offers a variety of courses, including accessible and panoramic routes, as well as a challenging half marathon with elevation gain and bridge crossings.

name: Nordholzer Windmühlenlauf
price_range: Kinder/Jugendliche/Wanderer/Walker 4,00 Euro; Erwachsene 8,00 Euro; Halbmarathon 12,00 Euro; Nachmeldung 2,00 Euro
description: The Nordholz Windmill Run is a long-standing running event in Wurster North Sea Coast offering various distances for children, young people and adults. The courses follow measured road routes officially recognised by the German Athletics Association (DLV). There are also hiking and walking options open to all age groups. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and every participant receives a medal and certificate.
course_highlights: Measured road courses with DLV certification
Distances from the 400 m Bambini run to the half marathon (21.0975 km)
Competition at Willi-Wicke Sports Ground, serving as the start and finish area
additional: Race-pack collection from 14:00 at the clubhouse at Willi-Wicke Sports Ground. Timing is by transponder, loaned with the race pack (20 euro fee if not returned). Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the start/finish area. The Bambini run is free, and accompaniment is permitted but not timed. The 5 km race counts as the district championship. Late entries are possible up to 1 hour before the start for an additional fee. Every participant receives a medal and certificate; walkers and hikers receive a certificate of participation. Courses are measured; timing is by transponder; changing rooms, showers and toilets are available; district championship on the 5 km course.

name: Samstagslauf Großenmeer
description: The Großenmeer Saturday Run is a long-standing grassroots running event, taking place for the 15th time. Organized by Großenmeerer Turnverein 1921 e.V., it offers a sporting opportunity for runners from the region and beyond. The event is open to various distances and welcomes all age groups. Registration is available via Laufmanager.net, and the organizers look forward to welcoming numerous participants.
course_highlights: A variety of routes for different ability levels
A run through the scenic region around Großenmeer and Ovelgönne
A traditional event with a friendly atmosphere and strong regional ties
additional: The run is organized by Großenmeerer Turnverein 1921 e.V., which also supports other sporting activities in the region. No start times or pricing tiers are explicitly listed on the website. The event is part of the Ovelgönne-Jade sports association. Routes, online registration, various running distances, regional sports activities

name: Stunden-Lauf Herne
location: Sportpark Eickel, Herne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 24-hour run in Herne takes place at Sportpark Eickel, a modern sporting venue with a paved 2 km loop. The challenge is to run as many kilometres as possible within 24 hours, either as an individual or as part of a relay team. Alongside the sporting competition, the event offers entertainment with mini golf and on-site refreshments. Timing is electronic, using a transponder attached to the race bib, and camping is possible right at the venue.
course_highlights: Paved 2 km loop at Sportpark Eickel
Electronic lap counting with a transponder attached to the race bib
Start and finish directly beside the mini golf course
additional: Race packs will be available on the event day from 08:00 to 11:00 at the mini golf course. Timing is electronic using a transponder, which is passed on like a relay baton during team changes. Refreshment stations serving drinks and food are available, and runners may store their own supplies. Camping is possible on site. The course is a paved 2 km loop at Sportpark Eickel. Course: loop around Sportpark Eickel; participate individually or as part of a relay team; fun and refreshments on site

name: Nottulner Stiftslauf - SV DJK GW Nottuln
41. Volkslauf in Baunatal
description: The 41st Baunatal Fun Run is a mass-participation sporting event with the motto “Baunatal Runs,” open to everyone regardless of club membership. The running routes are mostly on paved paths and largely through wooded areas. The 5 km route is an out-and-back course, while the shorter races, from 200 m to 1,000 m, take place in Parkstadion. The event is part of the Nordhessencup, a popular running series in the region.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 1
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian North Sea islands, attracting running enthusiasts from Germany and other countries for more than two decades. The first stage takes place on Borkum, the largest island, known for its unique natural surroundings, maritime charm and healthy offshore climate. The route follows the promenade, with the start and finish at the same location. The race combines a sporting challenge with the experience of the North Sea coast in a friendly and fair competitive atmosphere.

name: Hennigsdorfer Feuerwehr- und Bahnenlauf
description: Der Hennigsdorfer Feuerwehr- und Bahnenlauf ist ein sportliches Laufevent in Hennigsdorf, das jährlich im Juni auf dem OSZ-Sportplatz stattfindet. Verschiedene Läufe von 400 m bis 5 km, darunter Volkslauf, Bambinilauf, Nordic Walking und HandiCap-Race, bieten für alle Alters- und Leistungsklassen passende Wettbewerbe. Die Veranstaltung wird von den Stahl-Leichtathleten organisiert und zieht auch Läufer der Freiwilligen Feuerwehr und Berliner Feuerwehr an. Für Unterhaltung und Verpflegung ist mit einem Kinderparkour, Einsatzfahrzeugen, medizinischer Absicherung durch die DLRG und einem Informationsstand gesorgt.
course_highlights: Verschiedene Strecken von 400 m bis 5 km
Start und Ziel auf dem OSZ-Sportplatz in Hennigsdorf
Teilnahme von Feuerwehrläufern und vielfältiges Rahmenprogramm
additional: Medaillen und Urkunden für alle Finisher. Veranstaltungszeitraum ca. 8:30 bis 14:30 Uhr. Rahmenprogramm mit Kinderparkour, Einsatzfahrzeugen der Feuerwehr und medizinischer Absicherung durch die DLRG. Verpflegung für Aktive, Helfer und Zuschauer.

name: Suderburger Abendlauf
description: The Suderburg Evening Run is a recreational sporting event for the whole family, held annually in June in Suderburg since 2022. The races run through the heathland and surrounding forests of the Lüneburg Heath on sandy, all-weather forest and farm tracks. In addition to traditional individual races, there is also a 3 x 1.9 km relay. The start and finish are at the sports ground on Tannrähm, and the event is attracting growing numbers of participants.

name: Tiergartenlauf 2026
description: The Tiergartenlauf Velen is a family-friendly community race taking place for the 18th time. With a total of 11 races, it offers distances for all age groups and fitness levels, from the mini marathon and school races to the 5 km, 10 km and half marathon, as well as Nordic walking. A special highlight is the relay race for families, friends and colleagues, in which four people run 1,400 m each in succession. The event takes place at Gesamtschule Velen and offers an extensive supporting program with refreshments, music and showers. Proceeds will be donated to charitable organizations.

name: Fuffy Twister - From Dusk Till Dawn
description: The Fuffy Twister - From Dusk Till Dawn is a 50 km trail ultra in Langenhagen, Germany. It starts at night and has an 8-hour time limit. The race takes place in June and features straightforward organization, a low entry fee, an on-site finisher medal, and results and certificates published online. The small field makes it a more local and challenging test of endurance. The route runs along the northern edge of Hanover, near Hanover Airport, through the Bissendorfer Moor and Kananoher Forst, over varied terrain with moderate elevation gain.

name: Binner Abendlauf
description: The Binner Evening Run is a long-standing running event held as part of the sports festival of Sport- und Jugendbund Binnen e.V. The run offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, family atmosphere in Binnen. The event attracts runners of all ages and is a fixture on the regional sports calendar. Alongside the run, there is a varied sports festival with other activities and offerings for the whole family.

name: FORT FUN Westernlauf
description: The FORT FUN Western Run is a popular running event at FORT FUN Abenteuerland amusement park in Bestwig-Wasserfall. On the park grounds and in the surrounding forests, families and runners of all ages can choose from a total of 12 different races. The event is especially family-friendly and offers wonderful views, as well as the chance to enjoy the amusement park’s attractions afterward. The event is held in collaboration with TuS Valmetal and is ideal for active children, young people, and families.

name: GVG Horremer Abendlauf
description: Der GVG Horremer Abendlauf ist eine sportliche Laufveranstaltung des SCB Horrem und der Aktion Horrem, die nach den Richtlinien des Deutschen Leichtathletik-Verbandes (DLV) ausgerichtet wird. Angeboten werden verschiedene Läufe, darunter Schülerläufe über 400 m, 800 m und 1200 m sowie längere Strecken von 5 km und 10 km. Die Veranstaltung legt Wert auf Breitensport und Spaß, mit Wertungen und Siegerehrungen für verschiedene Altersklassen und Gesamtwertungen. Die Startunterlagen werden am Veranstaltungstag ausgegeben, und es gibt Verpflegung, Umkleide- und Duschmöglichkeiten sowie kostenlose Massagen für Läufer.
course_highlights: 5 km Laufstrecke, die beim 10 km Lauf zweimal durchlaufen wird
Schülerläufe mit Runden von 400 m, 800 m und 1200 m
Veranstaltung nach den Richtlinien des Deutschen Leichtathletik-Verbandes (DLV)
additional: Startunterlagen-Ausgabe am Veranstaltungstag ab 14 Uhr auf dem Friedrich-Ebert-Platz (Horremer Marktplatz). Verpflegung vor Ort. Umkleide- und Duschmöglichkeiten in der Horremer Halle. Kostenlose Massagen durch die Lehranstalt für Physiotherapie aus Kerpen-Horrem. Zeitmessung mittels Einmaltransponder. Wunschnummer bei Voranmeldung gegen Aufpreis möglich. Teilnahme auch mit Walkingstöcken, Gehhilfen, Rollator oder im Rollstuhl möglich.

name: km Staffellauf-100 jahre TSV Brokstedt
description: Der 100 km Staffellauf zum 100-jährigen Jubiläum des TSV Brokstedt ist ein besonderes Laufevent, bei dem Teams aus Jugendlichen und Erwachsenen in 2er Laufgespannen 50 Runden absolvieren, um die Gesamtstrecke von 100 km zu bewältigen. Für Kinder bis 13 Jahre gibt es eine verkürzte Variante mit 25 Runden über 50 km. Das Event fördert Teamgeist und Ausdauer und findet auf dem Sportplatz in Brokstedt statt. Die Teilnahme ist auf maximal 100 Teams begrenzt, und es wird Wert auf eine gemischte Teamzusammensetzung mit mindestens zwei Damen gelegt.
course_highlights: Staffellauf mit 2er Laufgespannen
50 Runden für 100 km (Erwachsene/Jugendliche), 25 Runden für 50 km (Kinder)
Veranstaltung auf dem Sportplatz in Brokstedt
additional: Die Anmeldung erfolgt per E-Mail an staffellauf@tsvbrokstedt.de mit Angabe der Teamleitung und der voraussichtlichen Anzahl der Läufer. Ein Rücktritt des gesamten Teams ist nicht möglich.

name: Never Give Up Hindernislauf
description: The Never Give Up Obstacle Run 2026 takes place on June 20 in Heinum near Gronau and offers a unique running experience for the whole family. Adults can take on a challenging main course of approx. 12 km with more than 30 varied obstacles along idyllic forest and field paths on the edge of the Sieben Berge hills. There is also a 5 km run with more than 25 obstacles for children and adults, as well as a Kids Run for ages 4 and up, covering approx. 2 km and packed with exciting obstacles. Fun, team spirit and crossing the finish line together are the focus, alongside professional timing, medals for all finishers and refreshments in the finish area.

name: Referees Run
description: The Referees Run is a 10-kilometer race held annually in Borgholzhausen since 2005 as part of the “Nacht von Borgholzhausen” fun run. The Gelsenkirchen Referees’ Association traditionally forms one of the largest groups at the race. The event promotes camaraderie among referees through sport and offers an athletic challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The race takes place and is managed by Stefan Tendyck.

name: Saucony Berlin 10K
description: The Saucony BLN 10K is a spectacular new race at Berlin’s historic Tempelhofer Feld. The event combines fast-paced urban running with a unique atmosphere at one of the city’s most historic sites. The start and finish are in the heritage-listed Hangar 6, alongside a cool-down zone with DJs, drinks, and street food. The course consists of two fast 5-kilometer laps, passing historic aircraft and running through the hangar, for an unforgettable experience combining urban lifestyle and music.

name: Sommerlauf Waren(Müritz) (LC/NLC)
description: The 4th Summer Run Waren (Müritz) is a running event organized by the SV Waren 09 e.V. running team. The race takes place at Müritzstadion in Waren (Müritz) and is open to children, young people, active runners and Masters. The event offers runners of all ages a sporting opportunity in beautiful surroundings. Registration is through the tollense-timing.de platform.

name: 54 Memoriał Żylewicza - Bieg Amatorów
description: The 54th Józef Żylewicz Memorial is a prestigious athletics meet organized annually since 1973 by the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club. The event commemorates Józef Żylewicz, an outstanding coach and sports official, one of the founders of KS LECHIA Gdańsk and a contributor to the Polish national athletics team’s successes. The Memorial takes place at the Athletics and Rugby Stadium in Gdańsk and combines sporting professionalism with a welcoming atmosphere for the local community, attracting athletes from Poland and abroad. The event also includes the amateur 3,000 m race “Fast Arrow of the North,” open to all running enthusiasts, with no age limits or athletic requirements.

name: 15 Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej
description: The Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej is a mountain race held in Koszalin on a course around Góra Chełmska. Participants can choose between 10.55 km (quarter marathon) and 21.1 km (half marathon), which consists of two loops. The start and finish are at plac Gościńcowy near the summit of Góra Chełmska, and the course runs through scenic forest areas with views. The race is organized by the Stowarzyszenie Sport, rekreacja i wolontariat „SFX” and is recreational and sporting in nature, promoting an active lifestyle and forest tourism.
course_highlights: Mountain course around Góra Chełmska, reaching an elevation of 136.2 m above sea level
Two distances to choose from: 10.55 km (one loop) and 21.1 km (two loops)
Start and finish at plac Gościńcowy, between the sanctuary and the observation tower
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30. The ceremonial start is from the square between the sanctuary and the observation tower. Awards will be presented at around 14:30. The course is well marked and measured. Participants can choose their distance during the race. Donations toward the statutory objectives of the SFX Association are required to participate and are non-refundable and non-transferable.

name: Bieg Dwie Wieże
description: Bieg Dwie Wieże is a race of approximately 15 km held in Kopalino. The course follows a dirt road, the beach, and a sidewalk, offering varied terrain and scenic views. The time limit is 2.5 hours, and participation is limited to 250 people. Runners receive a timing chip and a race bib. Water stations are available along the course, and a recovery meal is provided at the finish. The event has professional medical coverage and is photographed.
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km course
Race along a dirt road, the beach, and a sidewalk
Water stations at 4, 8, and 12 km, and at the finish
additional: Race office hours: 19.06, 13:00–19:00, and 20.06, 8:00–9:45 (verification closes at 9:45). Identity verification is mandatory (ID card/student ID). The timing chip is mandatory, collected at the race office and returned at the finish. Water and a recovery meal are available at the finish. Medical coverage is provided. Participation constitutes consent to the use of one’s image. Runners are asked to follow event rules and road traffic regulations.

name: Challenge Poland
description: Challenge Poland is a prestigious triathlon held in Gdańsk, offering a range of distances, including the popular T100 distance. The event takes place on the Baltic Sea, with a fast, flat cycling course and a scenic run along the beach and through Ronald Reagan Park. The start and finish are on the beautiful pier in Gdańsk, making it a unique attraction for athletes and spectators. The event is an official qualifier and is highly regarded by triathletes around the world.
course_highlights: 2.0 km swim at the city beach by Brzeźno Pier
80 km flat and fast cycling course through the Vistula Żuławy
18 km run along Gdańsk Beach and through Ronald Reagan Park, finishing with a scenic stretch on the pier
additional: Option to purchase registration cancellation coverage until 31 May 2027. Special discounts for teams of 10 or more. The cycling course passes, among other places, by Polsat Plus Arena stadium. Races are held in several categories and distances, including solo and relay. The race office and expo are located at Brzeźno Beach. Awards ceremonies take place on the pier in Gdańsk.

name: XIX Bieg O Błękitną Wstęgę
description: The 19th International Run for the Blue Ribbon is an annual event organized by the Stargard Athletics Club, which has been promoting health, fitness, and positive energy for 19 years. The main race takes place at night, giving it a unique atmosphere, and the route runs through the streets of Stargard, allowing participants to admire the city’s most beautiful historic landmarks in the moonlight. It’s an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and build physical and mental endurance. The organizers invite both amateurs and experienced athletes to celebrate exercise and a healthy lifestyle together.
course_highlights: An atmospheric night run at 9:00 p.m.
The route starts at the Amphitheatre and runs around the Jewel of Pomerania
Views of Stargard’s most beautiful historic landmarks in the moonlight
additional: The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere. The route is designed to let participants admire Stargard’s historic landmarks. The organizers encourage participants to build physical and mental endurance before the race. The event is international and organized by the Stargard Athletics Club.

name: Heuvelrugloop
description: The Heuvelrugloop is a popular forest run in Maarn, known as the most beautiful forest run in the Netherlands. The race is part of the Heuvelrug Loop Challenge, in which participants can also take part in the Uilentoren Loop Leersum and the Koploop in Amerongen for a combined ranking and a discount. The event offers challenging courses through the wooded area of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and attracts around 1,000 runners each year. A running clinic is also available to help participants prepare for the 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: Wooded setting in the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Distances of 4.2 km, 10 km and half marathon
Participants experience a challenging and varied course
additional: The Heuvelrugloop is part of the Heuvelrug Loop Challenge, offering additional recognition and a discount for taking part in multiple events. A running clinic is available through RunXperience to help participants prepare for the 5 km and 10 km. The event attracts around 1,000 participants each year and offers a challenging course through a wooded area. Terrain: forest; registration: not specified; part of a challenge featuring multiple runs; preparation through RunXperience.nl

name: Gorch-Fock-Lauf Wilhelmshaven
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 0.6 km
description: The Gorch-Fock-Lauf in Wilhelmshaven takes place every year in June and offers distances for all age groups, including children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. The course runs mostly along the coastline and the inner harbour, starting at Jade-Allee and finishing in Pumpwerk-Park. The course is measured by the DLV, ensuring fair competition. In addition to the sporting competition, there is also a club and school race with attractive prize money to promote youth sports in the region.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course with quality seal
Course along the coastline and inner harbour
Start at Jade-Allee, finish in Pumpwerk-Park
additional: Timing is provided by a chip integrated into the race number. There are several refreshment stations along the course. The club and school race offers prize money for the five clubs/schools with the most participants. Changes of registration can be made online via a self-service link; changes cannot be made on site. The event also includes a running service, club and school competitions, medals, shirts and prize money. Registration is online, with early-bird discounts available. The start is at Jade-Allee and the finish is in Pumpwerk-Park.

name: Mendener Citylauf mit Halbmarathon und Schülerläufen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km 10 € (Team Meldung ab 6 Starter/-innen erhalten 25% Nachlass)

description: The 10th Menden City Run offers an exciting sporting event with fast courses through the city center of Menden. The event includes children’s races, a 5 km race, a 10 km race, and a half marathon. Several event points along the course add to the atmosphere, and participants are enthusiastically welcomed at the finish on Rathausplatz. The Marathon-Club Menden e.V. warmly invites runners of all generations to take part in this traditional race.
course_highlights: Fast courses through the city center of Menden
Several event points along the course add to the atmosphere
Finish on Rathausplatz with an enthusiastic welcome
additional: Entry fees for participants from Menden kindergartens and schools are covered by Mendener Bank eG or Stadtsportverband Menden when registration is submitted centrally through the respective school(s). Teams with 6 or more starters receive a 25% discount on the 5 km race. Online pre-registration is available with direct debit or PayPal. Race-day registration is available. Course in Menden, online registration, race-day registration, parking at Neumarkt

name: RVB Harlingerland Volkslauf
description: The RVB Harlingerland Volkslauf will be held for the 43rd time in 2026 and is organized by Lauftreff Schafhauser Wald e.V. in Dunum, Lower Saxony. The event is supported by Raiffeisen-Volksbank eG, Aurich, and offers runners and walkers of all ability levels a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. The routes pass through the beautiful Harlinger landscape, with the start and finish in Dunum. In addition to the Volkslauf, walking and Nordic walking options are available, along with an extensive photo and results archive from previous years.
course_highlights: Start on Vorackkerweg, finish at Dunum School
10 km Volkslauf with 2 laps
Half marathon and other routes with interactive course maps
additional: The event includes various distances: 10 km Volkslauf (2 laps), half marathon, 5 km Volkslauf, 7.5 km walking, and Bambini and schoolchildren's races. The start and finish are in Dunum, and the routes are available as interactive maps. The running group's training sessions are on Mondays at 19:00 and Wednesdays at 18:00, meeting at the NIGE sports ground or, from September, at the stadium on Peldmühle. Everyone is welcome, from beginners to professionals. The event takes place in June, with officially homologated courses for official performance records. It supports the German solidarity system in sport and is aimed at runners of all ages, including children and young people.

name: Globus-Theißen-Lauf
description: The Globus-Theißen Run is a community running event in Theißen, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place for the sixth time. It offers distances for all age groups, from the Bambini race through 1.5 km, 3 km and 7 km to 14 km. The event takes place at the Bergarbeiter Stadium and is part of the Rangliste-Burgenland for adults and the Wiesen-Grundcup for children and young people. Refreshments include a cake buffet, coffee and savoury food, and children’s entertainment is provided during the awards ceremony. The event is a joint project by Globus-Theissen, local clubs and residents.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 m (Bambini) to 14 km
Start and finish at the Bergarbeiter Stadium in Theißen
Course routes available as GPS tracks and PDFs
additional: Refreshments include homemade cakes and coffee as well as savoury food; proceeds support the clubs’ youth programmes; children’s entertainment during the awards ceremony; start and finish at the Bergarbeiter Stadium; ample parking nearby; certificates for children at the finish; the event is part of the Rangliste-Burgenland and the Wiesen-Grundcup. Courses for children, young people, women, men and seniors; virtual routes available; a community event of regional significance.

name: Letter Vituslauf 2026
location: Heimathaus Letter Deele, Beelener Straße, Oelde-Lette, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: Der Letter Vituslauf ist eine traditionelle Laufveranstaltung in Oelde-Lette, die auf flachen, asphaltierten und befestigten Wegen stattfindet. Die Strecken sind vermessen und bieten Läufern aller Altersklassen eine faire und attraktive Wettkampfumgebung. Die Veranstaltung wird vom VfB Germania Lette e.V. und dem Leichtathletikverein Oelde e.V. organisiert und findet am Heimathaus Letter Deele statt. Neben den Läufen gibt es eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit Auszeichnungen und Gutscheinen für die schnellsten Läufer sowie für Kinder.
course_highlights: Flache Laufstrecke über Asphalt und befestigte Wege
Vermessene 5 km und 10 km Strecken
Start und Ziel am Heimathaus Letter Deele, Oelde-Lette
additional: Startnummernausgabe ab 12:30 Uhr im Wettkampfbüro am Heimathaus. Umkleide- und Duschmöglichkeiten in der Norbertschule und Turnhalle vorhanden. Nachmeldungen sind bis 30 Minuten vor dem jeweiligen Start möglich. Wertung erfolgt nach DLO-Klasseneinteilung. Urkunden für die ersten drei jeder Altersklasse sowie Gutscheine für die schnellsten Läufer und Kinder.

name: Reinhardswaldwalking
location: VfL Veckerhagen, Reinhardshagen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: VfL Veckerhagen 1897 e.V. warmly invites you to the 15th Reinhardswald Walking Day. Routes of 3 km, 6 km and 11 km are offered, passing through open countryside, along the edge of the forest and through the Reinhardswald. The start and finish are at VfL Veckerhagen’s Mittelpunkt sports facility. Refreshment stations are available along the way, and drinks, coffee, cake and bratwurst are offered at the finish. The three groups with the most participants will receive cash prizes.
course_highlights: Routes through open countryside, along the edge of the forest and through the Reinhardswald
Start and finish at VfL Veckerhagen’s Mittelpunkt sports facility
Refreshment stations along the way
additional: The three groups with the most participants will receive cash prizes. Participants are advised to bring the completed registration form to speed up registration on site. Participants can choose between 3 km, 6 km, 8 km and 11 km; the event promotes community and experiencing nature; refreshments and prizes are offered for the groups with the most participants.

name: Sachsenlauf Coswig
price_range: 2 € erste Stunde, danach 1,50 € (Parkgebühren im Parkhaus an der Moritzburger Straße)
description: The Sachsenlauf Coswig is a long-standing sporting event held annually in June since 1980. The races follow forest roads, woodland trails and field paths through the Friedewald and into the Moritzburg Hills. A special highlight on the 21.1 km route is running through the Moritzburg State Stud to the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel. In addition to running distances, walking and hiking options cater to different fitness levels and ambitions. The event is part of the Meißner Sparkassencup and the Niederlausitzcup, and also features dedicated races for children and Bambinis, with surprises at the finish.
course_highlights: Running routes on forest roads, woodland trails and field paths in the Friedewald and Moritzburg Hills
Route through the Moritzburg State Stud, past the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel (21.1 km route)
Hiking routes on the Karras circular trails, passing natural features such as Moselwiese and Seerosenteich
additional: Start and finish are at the corner of Friedewaldstraße and Sachsenlaufweg. Awards ceremonies take place in the schoolyard. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available in the neighboring Spitzgrund sports hall. The course closes for all distances at 14:00. Paid parking is available in the Moritzburger Straße car park. Travel by public transport (VVO bus routes 400, 401 and 405) is recommended. Children and Bambinis have their own out-and-back races (500 m and 800 m) with small surprises at the finish. Race bibs include a single-use timing transponder. Late registrations are possible on race day until 10:00; payment on site is cash only. Course adjustment due to the state championships, parking in the car park, travel by bus and train recommended, refreshments and awards ceremonies in the finish area, children’s and hiking routes

name: 10K Hamburg - Volkspark
description: Der 10K Hamburg Volkspark ist ein spannender 10-Kilometer-Lauf auf durchgängig abgesperrten und gesicherten Wendestrecken, die auf befestigten und asphaltierten Wegen verlaufen. Der Lauf bietet attraktive Streckenabschnitte in der Elbmetropole Hamburg und richtet sich an Läufer aller Leistungsansprüche. Die Veranstaltung ist Teil einer Cup-Wertung, bei der die schnellsten Teilnehmer tolle Preise gewinnen können. Die Teilnahme erfolgt ausschließlich online, und es gibt eine offizielle Anmeldebestätigung nach Anmeldeschluss.
course_highlights: Durchgängig abgesperrte und gesicherte Wendestrecken
Befestigte und asphaltierte Wege
Attraktive Spots der Elbmetropole Hamburg
additional: Kleiderbeuteldepot für persönliche Utensilien am Veranstaltungstag vorhanden. Anreise wird empfohlen mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Cup-Wertung über alle 10K Hamburg Veranstaltungen mit Punktevergabe an die 30 schnellsten Männer und Frauen pro Veranstaltung. Offizielle Vermessung nach IWB und AIMS, Zielzeiten sind Bestenlisten gültig.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 2
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands off the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. It takes place annually and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. Participants can run all seven stages or individual stages, each of which is about 10 kilometers long. The event places great importance on creating an enjoyable running experience and protecting the islands from overcrowding.

name: Barsinghäuser Fuchsbau Spendenlauf
description: The Barsinghausen Fuchsbau Charity Run is a running event in support of the “FUCHSBAU” association, which provides bereavement support for children and young people. Since 2010, the association has supported young people facing the death of people close to them. The charity run was launched in 2024 to fund Fuchsbau’s important work, as the association has relied entirely on donations since 2023. The event promotes community and social engagement in Barsinghausen and will take place again in 2026.

name: Bestenseer Seenlauf
organizer: Heimat&Kulturverein Bestensee e.V. und WSG 81 KWeV
description: The Bestensee Lakes Run is a traditional race held annually in Bestensee since 2002. It offers three different distances of 2 km, 7.5 km, and 16 km, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The race starts at the Landkost Arena, surrounded by the region’s idyllic lakes and woodland. The event is open to all age groups, and children and young people up to age 13 can take part for free.

name: Buchholzer Stadtlauf
location: Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Buchholz City Run is a long-standing race with cult status in the Nordheide. The course runs right through downtown Buchholz and is cheered on by numerous spectators, creating a special atmosphere and providing motivation. A range of distances offers suitable challenges for all age and ability groups, from the children’s race to the popular team relay. There is also running training with certified coaches, and all participants receive special medals and certificates.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Norderney (2. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian islands on Lower Saxony’s North Sea coast. It takes place and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. The individual stages follow varied routes with a maritime atmosphere, dune landscapes, and the Wadden Sea UNESCO World Heritage Site. The event offers a unique running experience, with each stage starting and finishing on the islands, as well as comprehensive facilities including race-number collection, sports bag storage, and on-site award ceremonies.

name: Lamspringer Klosterlauf
description: The Lamspringe Monastery Run is an annual running and walking event starting and finishing at Lamspringe Forest Stadium. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including children’s races, and is part of the South Lower Saxony Cup. Runners, Nordic walkers, and hiking enthusiasts are warmly invited to enjoy the varied routes through the countryside around Lamspringe. The event combines sporting ambition with fun and a sense of community in beautiful surroundings.

name: Sababurger Tierparklauf
description: Der Sababurger Tierparklauf ist ein beliebter Spendenlauf, der im malerischen Tierpark Sababurg und dem angrenzenden Reinhardswald stattfindet. Die sorgfältig ausgewählten Strecken führen durch eine unvergleichliche Naturkulisse und werden von begeisterten Zuschauern begleitet. Der Lauf ist Teil der Laufserie des Reinhardswald Lauf- und Walkingcups und unterstützt in diesem Jahr die geplante AmphibienWelt im Tierpark. Mit einer großen Teilnehmerzahl und einer familiären Atmosphäre bietet der Lauf ein unvergessliches Erlebnis für Läuferinnen und Läufer aller Altersklassen.
course_highlights: Streckenführung durch den Tierpark Sababurg und den angrenzenden Reinhardswald
Unvergleichliche Naturkulisse mit begeisterten Zuschauern an der Strecke
Teil der Laufserie des Reinhardswald Lauf- und Walkingcups
additional: Der Lauf unterstützt die geplante AmphibienWelt, ein neues Naturlernprojekt im Tierpark Sababurg, das das Erkunden und Erforschen des Lebensraums Wasser ermöglicht. Der Tierparklauf verzeichnet regelmäßig hohe Teilnehmerzahlen und ist ein fester Bestandteil der regionalen Laufserie.

name: Schlossinsellauf Lübben
description: The Schlossinsellauf Lübben is a traditional running event held on the idyllic Schlossinsel in the town of Lübben in the Spreewald. It offers races for children, teenagers, and adults, including Bambini races, children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, and a Run & Bike half marathon. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and varied course, which runs both on the Schlossinsel and through the surrounding Spreewald area. The race is part of the Spreewaldcup and attracts numerous runners every year.

name: Töpfermarktlauf Bürgel
description: The Töpfermarktlauf in Bürgel is a long-standing race that has been a sporting highlight in the Saale-Holzland district since the 1990s. The event offers various distances, including the challenging 12 km main race and the 6 km introductory race, which take runners through the varied landscape around Bürgel. All participants receive a handmade, ceramic medal as a memento. The event is family-friendly, with races for children and school students, and takes place on Sunday morning to make it possible for as many running enthusiasts as possible to take part.

name: Gryf Arena Run
description: Gryf Arena Run is an annual street race held in the town of Gryfice, attracting runners of different ages and abilities across various distances. The route runs through the town streets, offering participants a great atmosphere, sporting excitement, and positive energy. The event also includes races for children, making it a family-friendly and inclusive gathering. This is the ninth edition of the popular race, an important sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Gryfice
An atmosphere full of sporting excitement and positive energy
Children’s races are part of the program, making the event family-friendly

name: Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna
location: Centrum Rekreacji i Wypoczynku Deczno, Świecie, Poland
description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna is an annual running event held in the picturesque surroundings of the Deczno Recreation and Leisure Centre. The event includes a 10 km main race and free races for children, making it appealing to families and runners of different ability levels. The main race route follows the banks of the Deczna River, offering participants beautiful views and pleasant racing conditions.
