The organizers provide professional timing and race kits with T-shirts for early registrants. The main race is limited to 240 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km main race route along the banks of the Deczna River
Picturesque views and a natural setting around the Deczno Recreation and Leisure Centre
Additional free races for children, limited to 115 participants
additional: The main race is limited to 240 participants, and the children's races to 115 participants. The children's races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00. 23:59.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 2
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon that divides the classic distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The route follows loop courses through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the Harz foothills. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, and also offers a kids’ stage for younger participants. Organized by regional clubs, the event will take place for the 18th time in 2026.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 3
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a long-standing stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of around 10 km each, travelling from island to island. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere, dune landscapes and the Wadden Sea UNESCO World Heritage Site. Due to limited ferry capacity and infrastructure, the number of participants is limited, ensuring an exclusive and well-organised event.

name: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälan stänger söndag 13 juni kl 23.59. Ordinarie avgift: 325 kronor.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Från 14 juni tillkommer 50 kronor extra (totalt 375 kr). Efteranmälan via hemsidan till söndag 20 juni kl 16.00.

description: Modine Söderköping City Race is a festive fun run taking place on 22 June 2027, with the start and finish in Brunnsparken in Söderköping. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 kilometres through the city’s beautiful surroundings along the Storån and Göta Canal. The race features music, performances and plenty of encouragement along the course, creating a wonderful atmosphere for both runners and spectators. After crossing the finish line, all participants are treated to a hearty summer plate from ICA Supermarket. This annual running festival is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb and attracts many participants and spectators.
course_highlights: 5 kilometres through Söderköping, starting and finishing in Brunnsparken
The course is run in three laps: the first along the Storån and Göta Canal, the second through central Söderköping, and the third around Brunnsparken and the residential neighbourhoods
Music and performances along the entire course create a festive atmosphere
additional: Race bibs can be collected at ICA Supermarket Söderköping on Monday 21 June from 12:00 to 18:00, or on race day in Brunnsparken from 15:00 to 18:30. The top tear-off strip on the race bib is the timing chip. Late registration in person is available at ICA Supermarket on 21 June from 12:00 to 18:00 and on race day from 15:00 to 18:30. Swish is the only accepted payment method for late registration in person. The 2027 race takes place on Tuesday 22 June, with the start at 19:00. All participants receive a medal. Late registration costs an extra 50 kronor.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://soderkopingsstadslopp.se/): 2027-06-22 — "Tisdagen 22 juni 2027 är det dags för Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp!" (was estimated 2027-06-15)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Tisdagen 22 juni 2027 är det dags för Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp!

name: Bamford Frontyard
description: Bamford Frontyard is a unique race held in Asker at Vollen Sports Hall. The race consists of a relatively flat 3 km loop, with each loop required to be run faster than the previous one. Runners must complete all previous loops to continue. The race ends when only one runner completes the final loop, and everyone who completes the first loop receives a medal. This makes for an exciting, tactical competition suitable for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Relatively flat 3 km loop
The race starts with a 30-minute loop, after which each loop must be run 1 minute faster
The course runs through the area around Vollen Sports Hall and is clearly marked
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the start/finish from 15:00 to 16:30. Water, cola, potato chips, chocolate, oranges and bananas are available (bring your own cup). Toilets are available in the GUI hall, 50 metres from the start/finish. Participants are encouraged to bring their own chair, food and anything else they need between loops. Bib collection is listed as 15:00–16:30 at the start/finish. Refreshments are provided; bring your own cup, chair and food. Toilets are in the GUI hall, approximately 50 metres from the start/finish.

name: Karlstad Stadslopp
description: Karlstad Stadslopp is a community celebration and recreational race featuring a fast, scenic 10 km course through the most central parts of Karlstad. The race is marked by a sense of community and the joy of running, with many spectator spots along the course. In addition to the main race, there is also the Minilopp for children aged 7–12 and the Miniminilopp for the youngest children. Karlstad Stadslopp is a traditional summer event that brings together over 3,000 runners and is part of SM-veckan.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course through central Karlstad
Start on Tingvallabron at 18:35
Many spectator spots where runners pass several times
additional: Seeding for start corrals is based on the estimated running time provided at registration. Team competition for the 10 km, with 5–6 people per team; the five fastest times count. Bib pickup and late registration take place in Museiparken on race day. Concert with Dotter at Sandgrund after the finish. Gift cards are available to purchase as gifts. There is also the Karlstad Minilopp for children aged 7–12 and the Miniminilopp for children aged 0–6.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 4
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon held in seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each around Osterode am Harz. The fourth stage runs through the beautiful Beber nature reserve in Schwiegershausen, along varied paths of gravel, concrete and grass. The start and finish are at the Schwiegershausen sports hall, and the route offers a great view of the Harz as well as a mix of gentle and steep sections. The race is open to everyone physically able to run about 7 kilometres without stopping and promotes community among the regional clubs.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 4
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of about 10 km on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and a chance to enjoy nature. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and sells out quickly.

name: Erfurter Campuslauf
description: The Erfurt Campus Run is a sporting event organized by the University of Erfurt in cooperation with Universitätssportverein Erfurt e.V. Runners can take part in various events, including a 10-kilometer individual race, which also counts as the Thuringian University Championship in the 10-kilometer road race. There is also a 25 x 400-meter team relay and a Bambini run for children. The event features a varied course on the university campus and is open to all ages and ability levels.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Juist (4. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Stage 4 takes place on the island of Juist, the longest of the islands at 17 kilometers, and impresses with its dunes and Juist Water Tower. The start and finish are at Kurplatz, and the event offers runners and walkers a unique running experience surrounded by nature and the sea. The race number is valid for all stages and is issued with an integrated timing chip.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 5
organizer: TG LaPeKa, MTV Osterode, MTV Förste, TSV Schwiegershausen, TSC Dorste, MTV Freiheit, SFC Harz-Weser
description: The 18th Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven pleasant after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The runs follow circuits through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the foothills of the Harz Mountains. The start is on Sunday in Förste, with a new stage each day until Saturday. In addition to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers are also very welcome. There is also a 750-meter kids’ stage on June 27 in Schützenpark.

name: Bremer Firmenlauf zur Spätschicht
description: The Bremen Company Run for the Late Shift is a community running event covering approximately 5 km around the Weser weir in Bremen, with a focus on team spirit and togetherness. The event is for companies, groups of friends, and running clubs who want to run or walk together without the pressure to perform. New for 2026, official timing will be available for the first time for everyone who wants to test their athletic ambition. After the run, a lively after-run party with music, food, and drinks offers a relaxed end to the evening.

name: DAK FIRMENLAUF Nordhessen 2026
description: The DAK Nord Hesse Company Run has been organized by FTSV Heckershausen 1890 e.V. since 2011 and is held under the motto “Running together—for your health. A lifetime long.” The run promotes health and the enjoyment of exercise and is open to teams and individual runners. The course is about 5.3 km long and runs mostly along unpaved paths, with a short asphalt section. The event starts at 18:30 and offers refreshing drinks and changing facilities on site.

name: Firmenlauf Bremerhaven
description: The 9th Bremerhaven Company Run is open to employees and trainees from companies, public authorities, and other organizations. Participants run a 6 km loop from the Nordsee-Stadion through Speckenbüttler Park. With a limit of 500 participants, the event is a great opportunity for teams to compete athletically and have fun together. Groups receive a free-entry discount when at least 10 participants are registered by the end of May. The event is well established and very popular in the region.

name: De Ronde van Nieuwveen
location: W.P. Speelmanweg, Nieuwveen, South Holland, Netherlands
price_range: 7 euro voorinschrijving, 8 euro tijdens de wedstrijd
description: The Ronde van Nieuwveen is a running race held in and around the village of Nieuwveen, and is part of the Gemeente Nieuwkoop Circuit. The race takes place on the longest evening of the year and offers various distances for both children and adults. Children up to age 13 can take part in free kids’ runs of 400 m, 800 m and 1.7 km, while adults can choose from 5 km, 10 km and 15 km routes. The race features a varied course through the neighbourhood and village, with special attention paid to ensuring runners are well spread out along the course.
course_highlights: Course in and around Nieuwveen, starting and finishing at W.P. Speelmanweg
Kids’ runs of 400 m, 800 m and 1.7 km through the neighbourhood and village
5 km, 10 km and 15 km routes running through and around Nieuwveen
additional: Start and finish at W.P. Speelmanweg, with changing facilities, showers and supervised bag drop. There is a special G-run for participants with intellectual or physical disabilities, who can run with accompanying guides. Parking is available at the town hall, Teylersplein 1, and at De Hogendijk next to the football pitches. Children can participate for free, but advance registration is requested to keep things running smoothly. Course through and around Nieuwveen, various distances for children and adults, free participation for children and the G-run, changing facilities and supervised bag drop.

name: Trosa Stadslopp
description: Trosa Stadslopp is a traditional community celebration and running race held every year on the Friday after Midsummer in the beautiful summer town of Trosa. The race offers categories for all ages and ability levels, from young children to elite runners, on a varied course through the town centre and close to the water. Chip timing and several start groups create a welcoming, race-friendly atmosphere for both recreational and competitive runners. Trosa Stadslopp is known for its positive atmosphere, enthusiastic spectators and compact course, creating a unique running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs through summery Trosa, close to the water
Chip timing with two intermediate timing points in the 8.9 km race
Competitive and recreational categories for all ages and ability levels
additional: Race bibs with disposable chips are handed out from 10:00 on race day at Team Sportia Trosa. The cutoff time to reach the lap point in the 8.9 km race is 40 minutes. Start groups are available for elite runners, and runners in categories 1 and 2 can choose their start group. The jogging and Nordic walking events start shortly before the competitive categories. Parking is available, with a voluntary fee supporting youth activities. All runners receive 50 cl of Vitamin Well at the finish of the 8.9 km and 4 km races. Registration is available via the race’s registration portal; late and on-site registration have specific dates and fees.

name: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt 5. løp
description: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt is an annual recreational race organized by Osterøy IL/Athletics, with a 4.4 km course through the scenic surroundings of Valestrandsmarka. The race has a long tradition and is part of a race series with several events throughout the year. The start is at Furubakken sports ground, with two start times: one for walkers and one for the main field. Participants can look forward to a friendly and inclusive atmosphere, with prizes, cordial and sveler served after the race. Course records earn a cash prize from HTB.
course_highlights: 4.4 km course around Valestrandsmarka
Start and finish at Furubakken sports ground
Scenic surroundings and varied terrain
additional: There are two start times: 18:45 for walkers and 19:00 for the main field. Times in the walking group are recorded only if they are 30 minutes or more. After the race, sveler from Toro and cordial from Saftsuse are served. Course records earn a prize of NOK 3,000 from HTB. The race is part of a series with several races throughout the year, including a Christmas race and a New Year's race. Start for walkers at 18:45 and the main field at 19:00. No race licence required. Course records in regular races are awarded NOK 3,000 from HTB.

name: Preikestolen/Strand Backyard Ultra
description: Preikestolen/Strand Backyard Ultra is a backyard race held in June in Jørpeland, in the heart of Ryfylke. Here, you can challenge yourself in a grueling endurance race alongside other runners. The race is organized by Preikestolen Backyard and Midtbygdens Idrettslag.

name: Preikestolen Backyard Ultra 2027
description: Preikestolen Backyard Ultra 2027 is held at Jørpelands Brug in Jørpelandsvågen. Participants run a fixed 6.7 km loop at the start of every hour, with a maximum of 12 loops, corresponding to approximately 80 km in total. The course offers varied terrain, including asphalt, a pier, gravel road and easy-running trail, and is suitable for ultrarunners looking for a challenging, tactical competition. The event includes a practical briefing before the start, and food and drinks are available in the rest area. The start and finish are at Jørpelands Brug, with good parking and public transport options nearby.
course_highlights: The 6.7 km loop includes asphalt, a pier, gravel road and easy-running trail
Maximum of 12 loops, approximately 80 km in total
Start and finish at Jørpelands Brug, Jørpeland
additional: Bib numbers are collected at the specified location and time. Parking is available by the municipal building on Oldeidevegen in Jørpeland. Bus route 100 stops at the start area. The rest area offers water, squash, cola, sandwiches, fruit, crisps and hot food later on. Toilets and changing facilities are available. A loop starts at the beginning of every hour from 09:00 to 20:00, with the prize-giving at 21:15. The start and finish are at Jørpelands Brug, Sagholmen 4. Parking is available by the municipal building on Oldeidevegen, and bus route 100 stops at Jørpeland Brug. The rest area offers drinks, sandwiches, fruit and crisps, among other things, with hot food later on.

name: MidSummerRun 2026
description: The MidSummerRun 2026 takes place on June 19 in Hamburg and is being organized for the fifth time by Lauftreff Alstertal e.V. This sustainable running event offers three races: a children’s run of approx. 970 meters, a 5 km run, and a 10 km run along the wild upper course of the Alster, one of Hamburg’s most beautiful running areas. The start and finish are on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, where a sustainability fair featuring sustainable partners and a food truck will also be available. The MidSummerRun stands for environmental protection and sustainability and was awarded second place in the Hanse Environmental Prize.
course_highlights: Route along the wild upper course of the Alster
Start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel
A sustainably organized race focused on environmental protection and the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals
additional: The entry fee includes free travel to and from the event on the HVV. The participant limit is 200 for the children’s run and 600 in total across all races. The event provides first aid in the finish area. Picnic blankets made from recycled advertising banners and a food truck will be available for a relaxed get-together after the race. Children’s run approx. 970 m, 5 km, 10 km, sustainable organization, start and finish on the lawn in front of Torhaus Wellingsbüttel, eco-friendly medals, sustainable refreshments

name: Mittsommernachtslauf Hannover
location: Vereinsheim des HRC Hannover, Weddigenufer 23, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Midsummer Night Run Hannover is an urban running event held on the longest day of the year along the idyllic Leine meadows in Hannover. Several distances are offered: a 7.7 km individual race, a 21.1 km individual race, and a 23.1 km relay with three participants. The event is part of the Hannover Region Running Pass and offers a special atmosphere, with the start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse. There are two aid stations along the course, and timing is provided using rental chips. Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 17:00.
course_highlights: Route along the idyllic Leine meadows in Hannover
Two aid stations with water, isotonic drinks, and energy gels
Start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse
additional: Timing is provided using rental chips, which are worn on the foot and returned at the finish. Showers and changing rooms are available in limited numbers at the neighboring Angaria clubhouse and at the University Sports Center (100 m walk). Bags can be left at the tent opposite the clubhouse before the start. Travel by light rail to Königsworther Platz, followed by a walk of approx. 500 m; parking is available at the University Sports Center. Distances: 7.7 km, 21.1 km, 23.1 km relay; start and finish at the HRC Hannover clubhouse, Weddigenufer 23

name: Oberhausener Kleeblatt-Lauf
description: The 1st Oberhausen Kleeblatt Run is a new running event inviting runners of all ages to Niederrhein Stadium. Organized by the Rot-Weiß Oberhausen Endurance Team with support from the Oberhausen City Sports Association, the run aims to bring people from across the city together—from beginners to ambitious athletes. The route runs mostly along a lit, kilometre-marked running path beside the Rhine-Herne Canal, offering an appealing route that can be used year-round. After the run, the City Sports Association’s recreation area invites participants to relax, connect and enjoy the rest of the event together.
course_highlights: 7.8-kilometre loop along the Rhine-Herne Canal
Lit, kilometre-marked running path that can be used year-round
Starting point at Slinky Springs to Fame, with the route extending to Waghalsbrücke
additional: The event is open to all ability levels and aims to become a fixture in Oberhausen’s sporting calendar. After the run, there will be a programme of food and drinks at the City Sports Association’s recreation area, encouraging community and conversation.

name: Sommerabendlauf "Rund um den Sorpesee"
location: Sorpebrücke, Amecke, Sundern, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: Der Sommerabendlauf "Rund um den Sorpesee" ist eine jährlich im Sommer stattfindende Laufveranstaltung in Sundern-Amecke. Angeboten werden drei Strecken: 15,6 km, 6,4 km und 8,8 km Walking, die alle rund um das Sorpesee-Hauptbecken führen. Die Strecke ist überwiegend asphaltiert und etwa zur Hälfte schattig, was den Lauf besonders angenehm macht. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Läuferinnen und Läufer aller Altersklassen und bietet Pokale für die besten Platzierungen sowie eine lauftypische Erinnerung für alle Finisher.
course_highlights: 15,6 km Strecke rund um das Sorpesee-Hauptbecken, überwiegend asphaltiert und etwa 50 % im Schatten
6,4 km Wendepunktstrecke
8,8 km Walking-Strecke
additional: Start und Ziel an der Sorpebrücke zum Hauptbecken. Startzeiten: 15,6 km Lauf um 18:30 Uhr, 6,4 km Lauf um 18:45 Uhr, 8,8 km Walking um 18:30 Uhr. Drei Verpflegungsstationen auf der Strecke und eine im Zielbereich. Kostenfreie Duschen auf dem nahegelegenen Campingplatz. Urkunden vor Ort oder später über Race Result verfügbar. Für die Walking- und Nordic-Walking-Strecke werden Waldwege genutzt. Auf der Strecke des Hauptlaufs gibt es drei Verpflegungsstellen sowie eine weitere im Ziel; Duschen stehen auf dem benachbarten Campingplatz zur Verfügung.

name: Weezer Sommerabendlauf
description: The Weeze Summer Evening Run is a popular running event held annually since 2019 in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park in Weeze. After cancellations due to the pandemic in 2020 and 2021, the event has once again attracted large numbers of participants, with over 380 starters in 2025. The event offers various race distances, including children’s and youth races, and starts at 5 p.m. Timing is done using a chip attached to the race bib, and attractive prizes are awarded to clubs with the most finishers.
course_highlights: A loop around Weeze, crossing the new Niers Bridge and passing through the wildlife park
Children’s race of approximately 300 m, with a loop starting from Bahnstraße
Start and finish in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park
additional: Online registration is via raceresult, with payment by SEPA direct debit. Late registration is available on site by cash or card. Race bibs with chips must be returned on the day of the event; the €3 chip deposit is refunded. There are no changing rooms or showers; toilets are available in the Bürgerhaus. Eight tickets to the 1Live San Hejmo Festival will be awarded to the club with the most adult finishers (excluding TSV Weeze). The run takes place in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park. Online registration is available; late registration is possible on site until 45 minutes before the start. Start times are between 6:00 p.m. and 7:30 p.m.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 5
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Over eight days, participants run, walk, or Nordic walk approximately 10 km per stage on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog, and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and encounters with nature. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and sells out well in advance.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Langeoog (5. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. It takes place in 2026 from June 20 to 27 and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. Stage 5 takes runners to the car-free island of Langeoog, renowned for its 14 km-long sandy beach, dunes, tides and salt marshes in the Wadden Sea National Park. The start and finish are centrally located at the corner of Barkhausenstraße/Gartenstraße/Kurstraße, and the event offers a unique combination of athletic challenge and nature experience.

name: Osnabrücker Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The Charity Midsummer Night Run in Osnabrück-Sutthausen starts at 6:00 p.m. and offers a relaxed running event for all age groups in support of the nonprofit association Zusammen-Bewegen e.V. The route starts at the RW Sutthausen sports field and heads into the Hörner Bruch forest, where one lap is about 3 kilometers long. There are various distances, from 500 m for Bambinis to 10 km for adults, and no individual timing is provided. After the run, participants can wind down the evening over food and drinks.

name: Dr. Ernst van Aaken Gedächtnislauf 2026
description: The Dr. Ernst van Aaken Memorial Run takes place at the Dr. Ernst van Aaken Stadium in Schwalmtal and offers a varied running program on a late June evening. OSC Waldniel organizes ten races with more than 1,000 participants across different age and ability groups, from young people to seniors. The event combines track and road races, including a 5-kilometer road race and the 5000-meter “Race of Aces” for stronger runners. Participants can enter individually, as part of a team, or in the elite field, welcoming both beginners and experienced athletes. The race honors Ernst van Aaken, founder of OSC and a champion of the women’s marathon.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2025 Lauf 3: Sommerlauf um den SchiederSee
description: The event offers two distances, 1 km and 8.3 km, and is suitable for runners of all ability levels. The scenic route goes around SchiederSee, with pleasant summer weather averaging 23°C and mostly sunny days. Results may be included in official athletics rankings.

name: Wiesengrundlauf
description: The Wiesengrundlauf in Haselbachtal is a regional running event held every year on the Friday evening after the summer solstice. The municipality of Haselbachtal invites runners of all ages to take part in distances ranging from 600 m to 11.6 km. The event is part of the Sachsen Energie Läufer-Cup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for overall and age-group winners. The start and finish are at the “Wiesengrund” sports field in Bischheim. The 2025 premiere was a great success, with numerous participants and a varied supporting programme.

name: Osterrönfelder Moorlauf

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.description: Meldeschluss ist Sonntag, der 21. Juni 2026, 24:00 Uhr

description: Der Osterrönfelder Moorlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf in Osterrönfeld, der Läufer aller Altersklassen anspricht. Die Veranstaltung bietet einen Kinderlauf über 1,17 Kilometer, einen Jedermannlauf über 5 Kilometer und den Moorlauf über 10 Kilometer. Die Strecke startet am Sportplatz in der Straße Aukamp und führt durch die reizvolle Moorlandschaft. Die Zeitnahme erfolgt mit Transpondern, und für die Teilnehmer gibt es Urkunden, Medaillen und Pokale sowie eine Grillwurst als Verpflegung.
course_highlights: Start am Sportplatz in der Straße Aukamp
Lauf durch die Moorlandschaft
Drei Distanzen: 1,17 km Kinderlauf, 5 km Jedermannlauf, 10 km Moorlauf
additional: Startunterlagen werden am Veranstaltungstag ab 16:00 Uhr in der Sporthalle Fehmarnstraße 2 ausgegeben. Die Zeitnahme erfolgt mit Transpondern, die am Fußgelenk getragen werden müssen und nach dem Zieleinlauf zurückgegeben werden müssen (40 Euro Gebühr bei Verlust). Duschen und Parkplätze sind an der Sporthalle vorhanden. Das Startgeld für die 5 km und 10 km Läufe beinhaltet einen Gutschein für eine Grillwurst. Die Teilnehmerzahl beim Kinderlauf ist auf maximal 50 begrenzt.

name: GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way is a mountain race by the sea, held in Gdynia and the surrounding Kashubian region. Runners can choose from five distances, ranging from 14 km to 160 km, with varied elevation gains and scenic routes. The start and finish are at different locations, and the organizer provides transport to the start of the longest distance. It is a unique opportunity to take on a challenging course and enjoy the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: 160 km distance with +/- 2,502 m of elevation gain, starting in Puck at 10:00
100 km distance with +/- 2,267 m of elevation gain, starting in Gdynia at 21:00
Routes run through Kashubia and coastal areas, with checkpoints and time limits
additional: For the start of the longest distance (160 km), runners are transported by coach from outside the Gdynia Sports Centre – National Rugby Stadium (paid transport). The time limit for the 160 km distance is 31 hours. The course has checkpoints with time limits and drop bags. The event includes both summer and winter editions, with routes passing through various towns in the region and providing an unforgettable experience for runners of all ability levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences. The event is part of a series of races organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who focus on the beauty of the courses and promoting running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, making them worth collecting. It’s a special opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings and enjoy the atmosphere of the night.

name: Biegaj z Duchami
description: Run with the Ghosts is a unique night trail run held in Leśniów. Participants can choose between two routes, 15 km and 9 km long, full of dark corners and surprises that create an unforgettable atmosphere with a hint of suspense. Runners are encouraged to dress up as spectres, ghosts and other spooky characters, adding a touch of magic and atmosphere to the event. It’s not just a race, but also a test of endurance and courage in the dark, where participants face their own weaknesses and mysterious figures along the route.

name: Kustmaran (Kristianopel)
location: Kristianopel, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Kustmaran and Kristianopel Runt is a running festival for the whole family, with distances ranging from 0.9 km to the 42.2 km marathon. The race takes place in the idyllic summer landscape of Kristianopel and offers opportunities both to enjoy running and to set personal records. Team Blekinge provides enthusiastic support and cheerful encouragement along the course. The day can be combined with relaxing in the picturesque village, with swimming, restaurants and cafés. In 2027, the Swedish Veterans’ Marathon Championships will also be held in conjunction with the race.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.9 km to 42.2 km, including the marathon and half marathon
Courses through the idyllic summer landscape around Kristianopel
Children’s race and Sommarlunken, a 4 km untimed run
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 08:00, on a first-come, first-served basis. Regular registration can be paid for by card or Swish; late registration can be paid for by Swish or cash. Distances have bib number ranges and colour codes, but late registrants may receive a different colour code. Sommarlunken is a 4 km course with no timing or medal, and prizes are awarded by lottery. Kristianopel offers swimming, restaurants, cafés and accommodation for participants and their companions. Registration opens in January 2027; late registration on race day is available from 08:00, subject to availability. Electronic timing is provided by Racetimer.

name: Kalmar Malkars 21 km
description: Kalmar Malkars 21 km is a half-marathon offering a fast, single-lap course through many of Kalmar’s beautiful surroundings. Runners pass, among other places, the Tegelviken allotment gardens, Stensö fishing harbour, Kalmarsundsparken with Kalmar Castle in the foreground, and areas around Ängöleden and Skälby. The race is open to both men and women and is known for many runners setting personal records here. There is also a 5 km fun run, Malkars Femman, open to everyone whether they walk, run or roll. All finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: Single-lap course through Kalmar’s beautiful surroundings
Passes Kalmarsundsparken with Kalmar Castle in the foreground
Water stations at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 18 km and the finish
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Kalmar Malkars Västra, Torsåsgatan, on Friday, June 26, from 15:00 to 17:00 and on Saturday, June 27, from 12:00 to 15:00. Late registration is available through June 25 and thereafter at race-number collection. Everyone who registers for the 21.1 km race by June 20 receives a T-shirt with the Kalmar Malkars logo when collecting their race number. ICA MAXI provides a drink, fruit and a piece of chocolate after the race. Timing and prize-giving in the men’s and women’s categories. All finishers receive a medal. The 2026 start time is listed as 15:00. Water stations are located after 5, 10, 15 and 18 km, and at the finish. A T-shirt is included for half-marathon runners who register by the final regular registration day.

name: Jordgubbslunken
description: Jordgubbslunken is a popular fun run held every year on the first Saturday after Midsummer in Rudskoga. Participants can choose between 6 km and 10 km on winding village roads through a beautiful historic countryside, with gravel and grass surfaces. Children can take part in the 500-metre Minilunken. The race welcomes everyone from competitive recreational runners to families looking for a lovely walk. All participants receive a litre of strawberries at the finish and have a chance to win great prizes.
course_highlights: 6 km route on gravel roads
10 km route on gravel roads and well-mown grass
Beautiful winding village roads through the historic countryside
additional: Start and finish at Grunnebacka School. Categories for men, women and children. A generous prize table, with a major prize drawn using participants’ race numbers. All finishers receive strawberries and a medal; the major prize is drawn using participants’ race numbers. Listed prices are from previous races and may change for 2027.

name: Silverleden Ultra 100 Miles
location: Silvergruvan, Hällefors Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Silverleden Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon in Bergslagen, with several distances ranging from 9 km to 100 miles. The races follow the well-marked Silverleden, a hiking trail with hilly terrain and beautiful views. Silverleden Ultra 100M is known as one of Sweden’s toughest 100-mile races, with a high DNF rate, while the shorter distances offer tough but accessible challenges for different runners. The event includes transport to the start for some distances and nearby accommodation options. The race is marked by a love of running and a strong sense of community in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: Hilly, trail-filled terrain with steep climbs
Fantastic views from the hilltops along the trail
Well-marked hiking trail with bridges over marshes and waterways
additional: Bus transport is included in the entry fee for the 33 km and 100-mile races, departing at 13:00 on Friday for 100M and 11:30 on Saturday for 33K. Children and young people can take part in the 9 km race for free when accompanied by a registered adult. A limited number of caravan and motorhome pitches are available at the start and finish; book by email. To have a name and club/town printed on the race bib, register by 31 May. Silverleden Ultra’s program includes distances of 9 km, 33 km, 64 km and 100 miles. The official website lists the race weekend as 2–3 July 2027, which does not match the stated date of 26 June.

name: Kristianopel Runt 10 km
location: Kristianopel, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Kristianopel Runt is part of the running festival in Kristianopel, organised by Team Blekinge LF. The event offers several distances, from a children’s race to a marathon, with 10 km being a popular distance. The courses pass through idyllic summer scenery, with enthusiastic support and cheers from the race marshals. Participants can combine running with relaxing in picturesque Kristianopel, which offers swimming, restaurants and cafés. This year’s event also includes the Swedish Veterans’ Marathon Championships, adding to the competitive excitement.
course_highlights: Running through idyllic summer scenery on the east coast
Several distances from 0.9 km to 42.2 km, including the 10 km Kristianopel Runt
Courses with colour-coded number series and family-friendly races
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 08:00, on a first-come, first-served basis. Payment for regular registration can be made by card or Swish; late registration can be paid for by Swish or cash. Number series and colour codes are used for the different distances. Kristianopel offers swimming, restaurants, cafés and accommodation for participants and their companions. The organiser’s website lists the 10 km start time as 11:00 and says that electronic timing is provided by Racetimer. It also states that the 2027 race will take place on 3 July, which differs from the date in the race metadata.

name: Femundløpet 2027
description: Femundløpet is Norway’s most charming race, with distances for the whole family, including a 10 km competitive race, a 5 km competitive and recreational race, and Småtrolløpet for children, with games and entertainment. The courses run through flat, easy terrain on soft forest trails and gravel roads around Femund, with the start and finish at Femundsenden. Changing rooms and accommodation are available, as well as the chance to take a refreshing dip after the race. The event also offers refreshments, entertainment for children, and a prize ceremony with gift cards and cash prizes.
course_highlights: Flat, easy terrain around Femund, with soft forest trails and gravel roads
Start and finish at Femundsenden, with changing rooms and accommodation available
A chance to take the year’s most refreshing dip by the finish area
additional: Late registration is available on race day up to one hour before the start at the booth, at a higher price. Payment by Vipps only. Waffles, hot dogs, and drinks are available (Vipps only). Femund Brygge & Pub, by the start/finish area, is open on Saturday evening and is recommended for after-run enjoyment. A NOK 2,000 gift card will be drawn among all active participants, in addition to prize gifts awarded by lottery. Gift cards and cash prizes go to the fastest woman and man in the 10 km, with prizes also awarded to the top 3 in each class. An 8-week training program for beginners is also available.

name: Romeriksåsen på langs
description: Romeriksåsen på langs is a challenging and popular trail ultramarathon of approximately 50 km, held in the beautiful Romeriksåsen area of Viken. The race offers varied terrain with trails, gravel roads and asphalt, and gives runners lovely views of Oslo and the Oslofjord. The course can be challenging, with mud, snow and ice, so good preparation and the ability to adapt to changing conditions are required. The event has a strong tradition and attracts many participants each year, with a well-organized start and finish area at Øvre Bekkelaget Tennis Club.
course_highlights: Varied terrain: approximately 1/3 trail, 1/3 gravel road/path and 1/3 asphalt
Approximately 100 metres of elevation gain per lap
Lovely views of Oslo and the Oslofjord, and a route past sculptures in Ekebergparken
additional: The start/finish area has toilets, changing rooms and showers in the clubhouse, as well as space to warm up and spend time between laps. It is within walking distance of central Oslo, with several public transport options. Parking is available nearby, both at the tennis club and in Ekebergparken. First-aid equipment is available, and participants are encouraged not to take part if they are ill. Refreshments include water, hot water, coffee and drinks, while participants must bring their own nutrition. Conditions on the course can be challenging and variable, and studded shoes may be an option.

name: Ottaløpet
description: Ottaløpet is a local recreational race held in the centre of Otta in Gudbrandsdalen. The event offers 10 km, 5 km, an untimed 5 km recreational run, and a 10 km relay, with the start and finish in the park in central Otta. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with prizes for the top three finishers in the 5 km and 10 km, as well as class winners in the 10 km, and a challenge trophy for the male and female 10 km winners. There is also a children’s race for children aged 1 to 12, as well as a company competition to find the fittest company in Nord-Gudbrandsdalen. Ottaløpet has a long history: it began in 1993 and was revived in 2021 with great local enthusiasm.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel
Start and finish in the park in central Otta
The 10 km runners complete two laps of a 5 km course that includes a tartan running track and a riverside promenade
additional: There is a group warm-up in the park led by instructors from Spenst Otta. The relay can be divided into up to five legs. The children’s race is free, and every child receives a prize. The company competition awards a challenge trophy to the company with the most participants finishing. The course is clearly marked, and marshals ensure safety during the race. The 5 km course is one lap, while the 10 km is run over two laps. The relay can be divided into up to five legs of distances chosen by the team. The children’s race is free, and a group warm-up is offered in the park.

name: Ecotrail Bergen
description: EcoTrail Bergen is an environmentally conscious trail race offering four distances through beautiful scenery with spectacular views of the fjord and city. The courses range from 27 km to 91 km and feature challenging terrain, including trails, boggy sections, mountains and cultural landscapes. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to enjoy a sense of achievement and community in scenic surroundings. The event emphasizes the environment and sustainability, and participants receive, among other things, merino wool race shirts from Devold.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with trails, boggy sections and bare rock
Spectacular views of the fjord, city and cultural landscapes
Cultural heritage sites and historic areas along the course
additional: Aid stations provide water, sports drinks, salty and sweet snacks, but no hot food. Mandatory equipment includes a cup or soft flask, an emergency blanket, a mobile phone and a bank card/ID. There are cut-off times along the way on the longer distances. Bib pickup takes place before the race, including at Intersport at Thon Senter Bergen. The organizer states that the courses have drink and food stations. For the 27 km, a cup or soft flask, mobile phone and bank card or ID card are listed as mandatory equipment.

name: Synnfjell Skyrace
description: Synnfjell Skyrace is a mountain race held in Synnfjellet, Innlandet, Norway, on 26 June 2027. The race offers three distances of 9, 16 and 35 kilometres, with varied terrain including trails, marshland, gravel and asphalt in a high-mountain setting. Participants can experience rugged mountain terrain, long stretches of marshland and spectacular views, with Spåtind as the highest point on the longest course. The event also includes a non-timed 16 km recreational class and offers a sociable race weekend filled with nature experiences.
course_highlights: 9 km over rugged mountain terrain, with a downhill return to the start
16 km course over mountains, through forest and past long stretches of marshland
35 km with 1,300 metres of elevation gain and Spåtind as the highest point
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the reception of Spåtind Fjellhotel on Friday from 18:00 to 20:00 and on Saturday from 07:30 until the last runner finishes. All distances start at Spåtind Fjellhotel. After finishing, participants are served a hamburger and cola. Changing rooms and toilets are available at the hotel. Parking costs 20 kr and is paid via Vipps to 140396, Solheim forsamlingshus. Mandatory equipment is checked at the start, and weather conditions in the high mountains can change quickly. The timing chip must be attached to the left ankle, and the race bib worn on the front of the chest or stomach. A lost or unreturned chip will incur a charge of 1000 kr.

name: 3000m sommerfest 2027
description: 3000m Summer Festival 2027 is held at Bislett Stadium in Oslo, a venue known for its athletics tradition and excellent facilities. The event is for anyone who wants to take part in a short, intense running experience in the middle of summer. Sportsklubben Vidar, a club offering athletics activities for all ages and levels, is the organiser and welcomes everyone to an inclusive and engaging running festival.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Bislett Stadium, a classic athletics venue in Oslo
A short distance of 3,000 metres, suitable for both recreational and competitive runners
A summer event with a great atmosphere and opportunities to socialise

name: Hardanger Sidermaraton
description: Hardanger Cider Marathon is a unique race combining culture, experiences and flavours along a beautiful 22 km route from Grimo to Vikebygd on the western side of the Sørfjord in Hardanger. The race takes place on a mix of asphalt, gravel roads and trails. Along the way, participants visit ten stops hosted by local producers offering cider, local food, music and cultural performances. The event concludes with a banquet where participants can gather to celebrate and share their experiences. This race is a wonderful opportunity to experience Hardanger’s nature and culture in a flavourful and social way.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 22 km from Grimo to Vikebygd along the western side of the Sørfjord
A mix of asphalt, gravel roads and trails
Ten stops featuring local cider producers, food, music and cultural performances
additional: There is only one distance in 2027, approximately 22 km. Registration is not open yet, but interested participants can register their interest to be contacted when it opens. The race time limit will be published on 1 December 2026 and will be generous. It is possible to register up to 5 people at the same time. Vegetarian and gluten-free options will be available at the food stations and banquet. Costumes are permitted within reasonable limits. A banquet with food and drink will be held after the race for all participants. Registration is not open yet; you can register your interest via the website. Route details and practical information are scheduled to be published on 1 December 2026. The post-race banquet is open to everyone.

name: Besenbinder Lauf - Rund um Hainrode
description: The 1st Besenbinder Run – Around Hainrode is a running event in the South Harz, organized by ASV 1902 Sangerhausen. The event takes place in Hainrode and offers runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs around Hainrode and promises a varied running environment in nature. The event is open to children, teenagers, active runners, and masters.
course_highlights: Run around Hainrode in the South Harz
Event in a natural setting
Suitable for different age and ability groups
additional: The event venue is Hainröder Hauptstraße 60A, Hainrode; no specific terrain details are available.

name: Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon
description: The Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon in Löningen is an established running event in northern Germany, taking place for the 24th time. The flat, scenic course follows a loop through the Hasetal, half of it along the Hasetal cycle path, and is officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for inclusion in record lists. Alongside the marathon, the event also offers a half marathon, marathon relay, corporate relay, Nordic walking, walking and school races. The event is known for its great atmosphere, support from spectators and volunteers, and the Marathon Night afterwards, featuring a live band on the market square.
course_highlights: Flat course through the scenic Hasetal
Loop course with 2 laps for the marathon, half of it along the Hasetal cycle path
Start and finish on Löningen's market square, followed by the Marathon Night party
additional: Start and finish on Löningen's market square, with information and sales stands and an event stage. The course passes through the Werwer Fuhren forest and varied Geest landscapes. There is a Marathon Night party in the evening with a TOP-40 live band. The Bambini run starts separately from the Gelbrink parking lot. Refreshments are organized by the altar servers of St. Vitus Löningen. The event is certified as a “Three-Star Run.” It also includes the charity initiative “Laufend helfen in Löningen” (Helping Through Running in Löningen) and a marathon brochure, and usually takes place in June.

name: Glückstädter City-Lauf
description: The Glückstadt City Run warmly invites runners of all ages to experience the picturesque town of Glückstadt. The event offers a range of distances from 250 m to 10 km, running through the beautiful town center and along the harbor. Participation is at your own risk. Age-group rankings are provided, with trophies for the top runners in the 5 km and 10 km races. Race packets can be collected on race day from 9:00 a.m., and late entries are possible up to 60 minutes before the respective race.
course_highlights: Routes through the picturesque town center of Glückstadt
Races along the harbor head and past Legendenpark
A range of distances from 250 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible up to 60 minutes before the respective race, with a €5 late-entry fee. Changing facilities and tents are available; showers are provided at Fortunabad. For safety reasons, headphones and bringing animals or baby joggers during the race are not permitted. The event provides shower and changing facilities, safety and data-protection policies, and medals and trophies for the winners.

name: Isselhorster Nacht
description: The Isselhorster Nacht is a long-standing running event in Gütersloh-Isselhorst, taking place for the 26th time. It offers races for different age groups and ability levels, including the Bambini Run, Schoolrunning, Fun Run, Corporate Run, Speed Skating and Main Race. The event combines sporting commitment with social engagement by supporting the German Stroke Foundation. A special preparation program, “Fit in 100 Days,” motivates and supports participants on their way to the event. The races take place in the center of Isselhorst and offer a lively atmosphere with many spectators and a varied supporting program.
course_highlights: Various distances from 500 m to 9,200 m for all age groups
Route through the center of Isselhorst, consisting of several laps
Popular Corporate Run with team scoring and inventive costumes
additional: Late entries are possible up to 2 weeks before the event, subject to a late entry fee, except for the Bambini Run and student races. On the day of the event, on-site registration is available from 16:00. The event supports the German Stroke Foundation, with the option to donate money based on kilometers run. There is an extensive preparation program, “Fit in 100 Days,” featuring weekly training sessions and individual support. The races take place in the center of Isselhorst, spectators line the course, and there is a warm-up for children before the first races. A running event with a fundraising campaign against stroke, a varied program, music and a party.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 1
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The first stage starts in Förste and runs through the beautiful Söse Valley, with views of Lichtenstein and a route past the famous Lichtenstein Cave. The event is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, and also features a 750-meter kids’ stage in Schützenpark. Stages take place daily and are organized by regional clubs.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Spiekeroog (7. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian North Sea islands, attracting running enthusiasts from Germany and other countries for more than two decades. The 7th stage takes place on the car-free island of Spiekeroog, renowned for its pristine nature, endless beaches, and relaxed atmosphere. The stage starts and finishes on Gartenweg, level with the Kurpark. The event offers a unique running experience in a distinctive island landscape, combining a sporting challenge with the enjoyment of nature.

name: Fischerhuder Sommerlauf
description: The Fischerhude Summer Run, organised by Sportfreunde Fischerhude e.V., starts at 18:00. Distances include 1 km for children and 5 km and 10 km for young people and adults, run on an officially measured 5 km loop. There is also a 2x5 km relay for friends, families and colleagues. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with free hot and cold drinks in the finish area and changing and shower facilities available after the race. A DJ provides entertainment, and an after-run party with a barbecue, cocktails and drinks begins after the races.

name: Berglauf 2026
description: The Kyffhäuser Mountain Run is a traditional running event at the Kyffhäuser Monument in Thomm, attracting numerous runners each year. The route climbs uphill and offers a sporting challenge with impressive views. In addition to the main race, there is also a tower stair race, in which participants climb 306 steps inside the monument tower. The event thrives on the commitment of runners, supporters, and volunteer helpers, and promises an unforgettable running experience in a unique landscape.

name: Brauerschwender Basaltlauf
description: The Brauerschwender Basalt Run takes place in Brauerschwend and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. The courses have gentle elevation changes, are well marked, and feature kilometer markers. Drinks are available along the course, and the organizer provides refreshments at the finish. The event is aimed both at competitive runners and at anyone who enjoys being active together.

name: Göllnitz-Schmooksberglauf (LC/NLC)
description: The 2nd Göllnitz-Schmooksberg Run (LC/NLC) takes place in Diekhof (Laage) and is organized by Sportclub Laage. This athletics event is held away from the stadium and invites runners to take part in a sporting competition. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Diekhof and offers an appealing challenge for all participants. Registration is open.

name: Hohenschönhausener Gartenlauf
description: Der Hohenschönhausener Gartenlauf ist ein Laufevent im Berliner Norden, das in der Kleingartenanlage Falkenhöhe-Nord e.V. stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet Laufspaß für verschiedene Altersgruppen, inklusive eines Bambini-Laufs. Die Strecke führt durch die grüne Gartenanlage und ist Teil der Berliner Laufszene. Eine offizielle Zeitmessung und eine Siegerehrung runden das Event ab.
course_highlights: Lauf durch die Kleingartenanlage Falkenhöhe-Nord
Veranstaltung im Berliner Norden mit grüner Umgebung
Inklusive Bambini-Lauf und offizielle Zeitmessung
additional: Das Event ist Teil des Berlin-Cups und wird vom Kleingartenverein Falkenhöhe-Nord e.V. organisiert. Es gibt eine Siegerehrung und eine offizielle Laufmessung.

name: Klumpenlauf Wessum
description: Der Klumpenlauf ist ein Lauf-Event, das für Gemeinschaft, Bewegung und gute Stimmung steht. Nach einer Absage im Jahr 2026 freuen sich die Veranstalter darauf, 2027 wieder gemeinsam mit den Läufern an den Start zu gehen und besondere Momente zu erleben. Bereits gebuchte Startplätze behalten ihre Gültigkeit, was die Verbundenheit und Kontinuität des Events unterstreicht.

name: Lubaster Waldlauf
description: The 13th Lubaster Waldlauf takes place in Kemberg and offers runners two distances: 1 km and 6.3 km. The event is ideal for anyone looking to experience a short but varied run through the forest. The race promises pleasant summer weather, with an average temperature of 23 °C and mostly sunny conditions. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a well-organized event.

name: MÜRITZ-LAUF
description: The MÜRITZ-LAUF is a race around Germany’s largest inland lake, Lake Müritz, and takes place in Waren (Müritz). The route showcases the full diversity of the northern German landscape and, with its easy-to-manage profile, is ideal for runners who want to enjoy nature while also running fast. The event is organized by ESV Waren e.V., a long-established sports club that, with the support of numerous sponsors and volunteers, ensures everything runs smoothly.

name: Schöneicher Eichkaterlauf
description: The 14th Eichkaterlauf in Schöneiche offers a varied selection of races for all ages and ability levels. From short Bambini and children’s races to fun runs and the challenging 12 km signature distance, there is something for everyone. The courses run through the beautiful natural surroundings of Schöneiche and invite participants to enjoy a sporting experience together. The event is family-friendly, and registration is conveniently available online, with late registration also possible on race day.

name: Volksbank-Bever-Lauf
description: The Volksbank-Bever-Lauf takes place at Beverstadion in Ostbevern. The event offers various running competitions, including a half-marathon relay and individual races for runners born in 2012 or earlier. The course is measured by the DLV and is part of the Volksbank-Cup running series. Drinks and refreshments are available in the finish area, and changing rooms and showers are available right at Beverstadion.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 7
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk approximately 10 kilometers per stage, enjoying the unique natural surroundings, maritime atmosphere and healthy sea air. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a fair competition in a friendly, family-like atmosphere. Because capacity on the islands is limited, the number of participants is capped, ensuring an exclusive running experience.

name: XXI Dziesiątka Unisławska
description: The 21st Unisław 10K is an annual 10 km race held in Unisław as part of Unisław Days. The course follows paved roads through the scenic Chełmno Landscape Park, passing through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty. The race is part of the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running and is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The event also includes a Nordic walking event, making it appealing to a wide range of participants.
course_highlights: The course runs through Chełmno Landscape Park
Paved roads through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty
The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association
additional: The race course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association.

name: Lingewaalloop
price_range: Jeugdlopen en jongeren t/m 15 jaar gratis; 5 km €10 voorinschrijving, €13 op de dag; 10 km €12 voorinschrijving, €15 op de dag
description: The Lingewaalloop is a friendly running race organised by Stichting Lingewaalloop Herwijnen, aimed at residents of Herwijnen and the surrounding area. The race offers several distances, including children’s races and 5 km and 10 km events. The course starts and finishes on Vervoornlaan and follows the Waaldijk. The children’s race takes place on and around Vervoornlaan, while the 5 km and 10 km runners complete a loop along the dike and Achterweg. Facilities include changing rooms and showers, and there is an awards ceremony after the race.
course_highlights: Children’s race on and around Vervoornlaan
5 km loop via Achterweg, Waaldijk and Katerdam
The 10 km consists of two laps of the same 5 km loop
additional: On-the-day registration and collection of children’s race bibs are available from 09:30 at the De Kol football clubhouse. Changing rooms and showers are available at De Kol sports park. The children’s awards ceremony takes place at the finish; the 5 km and 10 km awards ceremonies are held afterwards in the football clubhouse. Parking is along Parallelweg; do not park at nearby shops. There are ten age categories for men and women, regardless of race licence. The race takes place on and around Vervoornlaan, with registration available in advance and on the day, and facilities at De Kol sports park. The 2027 edition has been cancelled due to extreme temperatures.

name: Dahlenburger Moorlauf
description: The Dahlenburg Moor Run is a popular community race with manual timekeeping, attracting around 200 participants each year. The event offers races for children, walking, and two main races over 4,600 m and 8,800 m. The course is flat and mostly paved, and the children’s races take place on the tartan track. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and picturesque setting in the Dahlenburg Moor.
course_highlights: Flat, mostly paved course
Children’s races on the tartan track
Run through the picturesque setting of the Dahlenburg Moor
additional: Race number pickup from 08:30 at the DSK sports facility/Dornweg in Dahlenburg. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for an additional fee of €3.00. Manual timekeeping. Showers are available at the swimming pool (admission required) or in the clubhouse. Refreshments include drink stations along the course, as well as coffee, cake, and soft drinks at the sports field. Parking is available in front of the swimming pool and the school. Courses, registration, community spirit, various types of running

name: Tippkötter Sommerlauf in Rheine
location: Bentlager Wald, Rheine, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Tippkötter Summer Run in Rheine takes place in Bentlage Forest and offers scenic, nature-rich routes with views of the salt works and Bentlage Monastery. The spectacular finish is in the FC Eintracht Rheine stadium, where all runners cross the finish line at the penalty spot. Music, professional commentary and surprises make the event a special running experience for participants of all ages. In addition to the main race, there is also a primary school race, making the event a family-friendly sports festival.
course_highlights: Scenic routes through Bentlage Forest
Routes passing the salt works and Bentlage Monastery
Finish in the FC Eintracht Rheine stadium at the penalty spot
additional: Electronic timing with a transponder bib. Race packets can be collected in the VIP room at FC Eintracht Rheine. Headphones are prohibited and may result in disqualification. Bambini race participants receive a participation medal. Trophies for the overall winners of the 2 km, 5 km, 5 km walking and 10 km races. Age-group awards with medals for the 2 km race only. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. Ample changing rooms and showers are available. Food and drinks, including fries, bratwurst, steaks and waffles, are available on site. Parking is available at Rheine Zoo. The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured and eligible for rankings.

name: 19. Muko-Spendenlauf Hannover
description: The 19th Muko Charity Run Hannover is an inclusive event held at the VfL Eintracht Hannover sports ground. It is open to all ages and fitness levels, whether you run, walk or stroll, with or without a disability. The goal is to raise donations for Haus Schutzengel, a parent and patient hostel for families affected by cystic fibrosis, near Hannover Medical School. Sponsors donate one euro for every lap completed on the 400-meter cinder track. The event promotes community and solidarity in the fight against cystic fibrosis.

name: 32. hella hamburg halbmarathon
description: The hella hamburg half marathon is a major running event in Hamburg, held annually on the last Sunday in June. On an officially measured, flat, paved 21.1 km course, up to 24,000 runners experience a unique running party through the Hanseatic city. The route passes around 50 sights and is accompanied by numerous event zones featuring DJ support and live music. The event is known for its great atmosphere and traffic-free course, secured by police and marshals.

name: 24-Stunden Burginsellauf
description: The 24-hour Burginsel Run in Delmenhorst is a challenging ultramarathon on a flat, approximately 1.3 km loop along Burginsel and the Graftwiesen. The event offers individual and team competitions, as well as a 6-hour run and a 3-hour schoolchildren’s run. The course is closed to traffic, illuminated and mostly shaded, making it ideal for endurance runners who want to test their limits. There is a refreshment station open around the clock during the run, as well as a tent area for rest breaks. The German 24-hour running championships are held as part of this event.

name: BikeNavy Run
description: The BikeNavy! Run is a unique running event held on the grounds of Nordholz Airfield, which is otherwise not open to the public. The course runs within the controlled airspace of the Nordholz Naval Air Base and offers participants a special atmosphere, with views of historic and modern aviation. After the race, participants can visit the AERONAUTICUM Naval Aviation and Airship Museum. The event is ideal for runners looking for an extraordinary and unforgettable running experience.

name: Halderner Volkslauf
description: The Haldern People’s Run is a long-standing event that brings young and old together and fosters a sense of community among friends and families. The event is taking place again, with the half marathon remaining a permanent part of the program due to the positive response. It offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all abilities and invites everyone to take part.

name: Ohndorfer Volkslauf
description: The Ohndorf Fun Run is a family-friendly running event held annually in Ohndorf and is part of the Schaumburg Running Series. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. Online registration is open until race day, with on-site registration available up to 30 minutes before the start. The run is attracting increasing numbers of participants and offers a great opportunity to exercise together and enjoy a sense of community.

name: Seester Sternenlauf
description: The Seester Sternenlauf is being held for the tenth time and is a charity run in support of the Kinder-Hospiz Sternenbrücke in Hamburg. The event offers various distances for runners, walkers, Nordic walkers, and Bambinis, including a special 10 km loop through the historic Lindenallee at Gut Seestermühe. Grilled sausages, coffee, and cake will be available, and the route will be lined with decorated streets and a great atmosphere. The organizing team looks forward to welcoming many participants and spectators to this fun and successful event.

name: Weiner Family Run 2026
description: It is aimed at runners, walkers, children and Bambinis, and offers various distances from approximately 500 metres to 10 kilometres. The focus is on the joy of movement and sharing the experience in a relaxed atmosphere. The start and finish area is in Sparkassenpark Weiner, and the routes lead through the Weiner farming community. Participants can also look forward to a family-friendly programme with commentary and refreshments.

name: Łabiszyński Bieg Świętojański
description: The Łabiszyn St. John’s Eve Run is an annual running event held in Łabiszyn, with the start and finish at the Municipal Stadium. The 5 km main race starts at 7:00, followed by children’s and youth races in four age categories. Main-race participants receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger runners receive a medal and a surprise. The awards ceremony for the top runners takes place after the competitions. The run is part of a running series and offers race packs to the first registrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn
5 km main-race route
Children’s and youth races in 4 age categories
additional: After the main race, participants receive a medal and a sweet snack, while children and youth receive a medal and a surprise. The awards ceremony for the top runners takes place after all races have ended. Race packs are available to the first registrants.

name: Montagslauf Rund um Mackenzell
description: The Montagslauf Rund um Mackenzell is a traditional fun run held in the idyllic surroundings of Hünfeld-Mackenzell. The event offers several distances, including a Schülerlauf, 5.3 km, 10 km, and a 14.3 km course with an additional loop. The routes pass through varied landscapes, with refreshment points along the way. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and medical support from the German Red Cross. Showers are available after the run, and Nordic walking is also offered without timekeeping.

name: Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand Beach Resort, Löttorp, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a challenging and fun race for the whole family, with distances from 500 meters to 10 kilometers. The race takes place on the beautiful, long sandy beach at Böda Sand Beach Resort on Öland, offering a unique and scenic running experience. Everyone who finishes the race receives a medal as a keepsake. The event is held annually and is part of Böda Sand’s wide range of summer activities and events.
course_highlights: Run on one of Öland’s most beautiful beaches, with almost two miles of white sand
Courses from 500 meters up to 10 kilometers
Family-friendly race with a medal for everyone who finishes
additional: The race is part of Böda Sand’s summer program, with activities for the whole family. There are several distances to choose from, making it accessible to both children and adults. Böda Sand also offers many other sports and leisure activities alongside the event. A lodging offer at Böda Sand has previously been mentioned in race information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.bodasand.se/evenemang/): 2027-06-30 — "Böda Beach Run — 30 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-23)

name: Arna 3000

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Familie: kr 600 (+ lisens og inntil fem personer). Alle med færre enn fem familiemedlemmer kan ta med en venn for å "fylle opp" maks-antallet på fem.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Gratis for barn 0-12 år! (Født 2014 og senere)

description: Arna 3000 is organised by Idrettslaget Fri in Bergen and is a traditional race with roots dating back to 1977. The race offers a varied, runner-friendly course around Haukelandsvatnet, with both short and longer distances to suit the whole family. IL Fri is known for its welcoming atmosphere and well-organised athletics and fun-run events in the Arna area. Welcome to a sociable and active running experience in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The course runs around Haukelandsvatnet
3.4 km family course, starting at 19:00
10 km course, starting at 19:30
additional: Registration is online only. Race numbers are collected at Espelandshallen before the race. There are prizes and a chance to socialise, with music and a warm-up before the start. The race has a long history, with course changes made to make it more runner-friendly. Early registration is encouraged.

name: 36. Göttinger Altstadtlauf
description: The Göttingen Old Town Run is a long-standing running event in downtown Göttingen, taking place for the 36th time in 2026. The event combines running with the special charm of the old town and attracts runners of all ages. In addition to the main race, there are various school races and a popular corporate race with team scoring. The course leads through the historic city center and offers a lively atmosphere full of excitement and activity.

name: Oslo Bergen Trail
description: Oslo Bergen Trail is a challenging trail ultramarathon that runs from Oslo to Bergen over approximately 500 km, with more than 15,000 metres of total elevation gain and loss. The race is organised by the voluntary organisation Langt og Lenge and offers a unique challenge in Norway’s natural landscape, with routes that follow marked DNT trails as well as some sections without trails. The races are held continuously, with no mandatory breaks, and participants must navigate themselves using GPS, maps and a compass. The race attracts ultrarunners seeking an intense, nature-focused experience centred on endurance and self-reliance.
course_highlights: Approximately 500 km route with more than 15,000 metres of total elevation gain and loss
The course mainly follows soft terrain on marked DNT trails and some unmarked trails
The route is not physically marked; participants must navigate themselves using GPS, maps and a compass
additional: All races are held as a single stage from start to finish, with no mandatory breaks. Private support is not permitted; only support from the organiser is allowed. The race centre at Soria Moria Hotel in Voksenkollen, Oslo, is open from 29 June to 1 July. The finish is at Meyermarken in Bergen, with associated activities. Participants must document that they have previously completed a trail ultramarathon of at least 75 km or an equivalent physically demanding activity to be approved.

name: Jotunheimen Trail Run
description: Jotunheimen Trail Run offers an unforgettable trail running experience in Norway’s stunning high-alpine landscapes. Participants can choose from several distances, including 12K, 16K, 21K, Marathon, and an epic 73K Ultra that loops around Lake Bygdin. The race features challenging elevation gains, flowing mountain trails, and breathtaking panoramic views, all in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere suitable for runners of all levels. The event includes well-organized check-ins, aid stations, and post-race activities such as sauna and swimming at Bygdin.
course_highlights: Ultra: 73 km loop around Lake Bygdin with demanding elevation and runnable high-mountain plateau sections
Marathon: 40 km trail with a scenic detour via Skjetning and a final sprint to the finish line in Bygdin
Half Marathon: 17 km trail with a major ascent to panoramic ridge views and a fast downhill finish in Beitostølen
additional: Check-in and bib collection at Beito Resort Hotel and Bygdin Høyfjellshotell. Pre-race pasta dinner at Lodge 900 (booking required). Shuttle buses provided for Ultra and Marathon runners. Award ceremony for top finishers at Bygdin Høyfjellshotell. Social shake-out run and shoe testing with La Sportiva before race day. The race is part of the Norway Trail Series. The program also includes race briefings, meals, shuttle buses, and award ceremonies; some dinners and bus tickets must be booked in advance.

name: 32. Lippesee Marathon
location: Lippesee, Paderborn-Sande, Paderborn, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 32nd Lippesee Marathon in Paderborn-Sande is a private marathon held in accordance with the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, around Lippesee, a popular recreation area and water sports center. Participants must be self-sufficient, as there are no aid stations, and time themselves manually; a photo of the watch must be submitted by email as proof. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, with a limit of 18 participants, and takes place only if at least five people register.

name: Byrundan
location: Unos park, Gamleby, Västervik Municipality, Sweden
description: Byrundan is a running race held in Gamleby, starting and finishing in Unos Park. The race offers distances for all ages, from children to adults, on a beautiful summer course through Gamleby. There are several categories and distances, including children’s and youth races, as well as a joint start for the 4 km and 8 km races. All participants receive a medal after finishing, and prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, along with sprint prizes in the 4 km and 8 km races. Byrundan is part of TOUR DE RUN and is organised by Gamleby OK.
course_highlights: The course runs through beautiful summer scenery in Gamleby
Start and finish in Unos Park
Water stations at the start/finish and at 4 km
additional: Race numbers can be collected in Unos Park from 15:00 until one hour before the start. Children are offered hamburgers/sausages after the race, sponsored by ICA Supermarket. Medals are sponsored by Metallfabriken Norden AB. Professional timing by Racetimer. The prize ceremony takes place at approximately 19:25 for children and 20:45 for everyone else. A sprint prize at 450 m for the 4 km and 8 km races is a gift card worth 3000 kr. The 8 km course record comes with a 1000 kr prize.

name: Büsumer Volkslauf
description: The Büsum Volkslauf is an annual running event suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike. Various distances are offered, from 400 metres for children to 10 kilometres for experienced runners. The new route follows the waterfront promenade, loops around the Familienlagune and returns, with the start and finish at Büsumer Hauptrand. The event promises a sporty day on the North Sea coast with a beautiful running backdrop.
course_highlights: New route along the waterfront promenade
Loop around the Familienlagune
Start and finish at Büsumer Hauptrand
additional: Three race distances: 400 m Bambini Run at 18:15, 5.5 km health run at 19:00, and 10 km race at 19:00. Registration is also possible by phone at 0176 96204634. Running event on the North Sea coast in Büsum, with routes for Bambini runners, health runners and competitive runners; finish at the swimming pool; registration online and by phone; start and finish at Büsumer Hauptrand; route along the promenade and around the Familienlagune.

name: Drevenacker Volksbank Abendlauf
description: The Drevenacker Volksbank Evening Run is a traditional running event in Hünxe-Drevenack, organized by the TUS Drevenack TL-Abteilung e.V. Various races take place on the event day, a Friday in July, including an officially measured 10 km road race, a 5 km jogging race with a youth category, a 5 km non-competitive walk, and children’s and toddlers’ races. The course runs through the scenic surrounding area, with the start and finish at the sports field on Buschweg.
