The event offers suitable competitions for all age groups and professional timing by the TAF Timing Team.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km course with age groups in five-year increments
5 km jogging race with a separate youth category and an officially measured course
Children’s and toddlers’ races for children and young people, with age-appropriate distances
additional: The start and finish are at the sports field on Buschweg. Women start at the tennis clubhouse, and men start in the gym on Buschweg. A €2.00 deposit is charged for the timing chip for each race number and refunded when it is returned. Late registrations are possible on the event day from 16:30 until 45 minutes before the respective start, subject to capacity. Every participant receives a certificate; prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each age group. Online registration is available; the event is part of the Lippe-Issel-Cup; results are available online.

name: Marburger Nachtmarathon
description: The Marburg Night Marathon is taking place for the 27th time and is the largest running event in the Central Hesse region. The event offers a classic marathon, a half marathon, and a relay marathon with up to four participants. The course runs through Marburg’s picturesque old town and along the Lahn, offering a flat, record-eligible loop with views of Landgrafenschloss and St. Elizabeth’s Church. The race starts at 7 p.m. in a festive atmosphere on the historic market square, with the finish at the university stadium. All participants receive a high-quality medal featuring a distinctive Marburg building each year.
course_highlights: Flat, record-eligible loop
The course runs through the old town and along the Lahn
Views of Landgrafenschloss and St. Elizabeth’s Church
additional: The relay marathon consists of four runners, each covering a leg of about ten kilometers. The first relay runner starts on the market square, and the exchange zone is on Frankfurter Straße. Each relay team receives a race number attached to an elastic race-number belt. Safety pins are provided at registration. The number of participants is limited to ensure safety and an enjoyable running experience. The start and finish are at the university stadium, about 1 km from the starting point.

name: Rotenburger Strandfestlauf - Rotenburg rennt
location: Rotenburg an der Fulda, Hesse, Germany
price_range: 1 Euro Startgeld für Bambini, vergünstigte Preise für Schüler- und Jugendläufe
description: The Rotenburg Strandfest Run takes place every year on the first Friday in July as part of the traditional Heimat- und Strandfest in Rotenburg an der Fulda. The flat, fast course runs through the town centre and offers various events for young runners, main-race participants, elite runners and teams, as well as walking. New features include precisely measured school and elite races, plus the Beer Mile, where having fun is the main focus. The event combines sporting ambition with a friendly, social atmosphere and is a highlight of the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Rotenburg town centre
School race: exactly 1,248 metres—a tribute to the year Rotenburg was founded
Elite race over 1.609 km (land mile), with entry requirements
additional: No on-site registration is possible; advance registration is available only through specialist portals. The 5 km and 10 km courses are no longer offered; instead, the main race covers a 1.5 km course five times. The Beer Mile has no timing and includes four alcohol-free beer breaks at 400 m intervals. Elite race entry requirements: men, 03:10 min/km; women, 03:30 min/km. Events for young runners, main-race participants, elite runners and teams, plus walking. Preparation through a running group; supported by Sparkasse.

name: Bocksten Trailrun
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Åkulla Bokskogar, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: 44 km, 24 km, 22 km, 12 km, 6.7 km, 5 km
description: Bocksten TrailRun is a nature-focused trail race with its event centre at Öströö Sheep Farm and routes through the Åkulla beech forests. The event offers four distances (5 km, 12 km, 22 km and Ultra 44 km) through beech and spruce forests, with lake views and varied trails. The races are spectator-friendly, have limited starting places and award participants a special medal. Welcome to experience the joy of running and camaraderie in a magical forest setting.
course_highlights: Running in the Åkulla beech forests and enchanting spruce forests
Varied terrain: technical trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads with lake views
Plenty of elevation gain and scenic views; also a 6.7 km loop course for Vineyard Backyard Ultra
additional: Distances: 5 km (start 10:15, 200 places), 12 km (start 10:00, 400 places), 22 km (start 10:30, 300 places) and Ultra 44 km (start 08:00, 100 places). The total number of starting places is limited (only 1000 places). GPS coordinates for the event centre: 57.06881078975495, 12.506526026672418. Only tap water is provided during the event (no plastic bottles); Tailwind and cordial are available as alternatives. For Vineyard Backyard Ultra, bringing your own cup is mandatory; a headlamp and personal medication are mandatory, and the headlamp must be worn between 20:00 and 07:00. Bib collection and registration take place in the start area (times are listed in the invitation); if you need assistance, contact the race organisers on 076-8159678. Startklar cancellation and accident insurance can be purchased (prices are listed in the invitation). The winter edition is held at Öströö Gård, with 5/12/24 km distances and 500 places; accommodation can be booked through Åkulla Resort with a discount (code bockstentrailrun). The Backyard Ultra race at Ästad Vingård has a 6.7 km course and starts every full hour.

name: Strömstadmilen
description: Strömstadmilen is a welcoming running event organized by Strömstad Running Club, featuring a runner-friendly 5-kilometer loop through the center of Strömstad. Participants can choose to run one or two laps, covering 5 km or 10 km respectively. The event also includes children’s and youth races, as well as a walking class along the Strömstad waterfront. The start and finish are at Strömsvallen, and the race has a wonderful summer atmosphere, with many spectators and activities creating a true town festival.
course_highlights: Runner-friendly 5 km loop through the center of Strömstad
Start and finish at Strömsvallen
Clearly marked course with plenty of directional signs
additional: Start times: 11:00 4 km walk, 12:10 girls aged 7, 12:30 boys aged 7, 12:50 girls aged 9 and boys aged 9, 13:20 girls aged 11 and boys aged 11, 14:00 5 km, 15:00 10 km. Bib pickup and race-day registration are available from 09:30 on race day and also the evening before. All participants who finish receive a specially designed medal. A technical T-shirt featuring the Strömstadmilen design can be purchased when registering. Timing ends at 16:45. Parking at Strömsvallen is limited; parking at Strömstad Gymnasium is recommended. The information found concerns the 2026 edition and does not confirm details for 2027.

name: Kolmårdsrundan / Kolmården Ultra Trail
description: Kolmården Ultra Trail is a challenging and scenic running experience in the deep forests of Kolmården, with distances of 45 km and 60 km. The course offers varied terrain, with forest trails, mountain ridges featuring spectacular views, sections along the shores of Bråviken, and technical running in nature reserves. The race is suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners seeking a memorable trail experience. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a light meal, included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Start in Kolmården Forest, with trails through varied terrain
Views from the mountain ridge at Kvarseboklint and running along the shores of Bråviken
Technical and challenging running through Bråviksbranten Nature Reserve
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, running vest/backpack/belt with at least 0.5 L of fluids, a pressure bandage/blood stopper, and a map with the emergency number (provided at bib collection). Aid stations: the 45K has 4 stations, and the 60K has 5 stations offering sports drink, energy products, and water. The cutoff time for the 45K is 13:30 at 44 km (pace 9:00 min/km). Participants are served a light meal at the finish. Start and finish at Klintvallen in Kvarsebo. Medical services are available on site. After finishing, participants receive a medal and are offered hot vegetarian soup. Mandatory equipment rules apply; aid stations are located along the course.

name: Mörksuggejakten TrailRun

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startavgift före 1/7 Barn och ungdom upp till 16 år 150 kr

description: Mörksuggejakten is one of Sweden’s most popular events in the long-distance race cup, offering a top-class competition since 1997. The cycling race in Rättvik features a beautiful and varied course covering 74 km, with a shorter 46 km option. The route passes through Rättvik, climbs to heights with breathtaking views over Lake Siljan, follows gravel roads and trails, and passes distinctive locations such as Dalhalla and Springkällan. Younger participants can take part in Lilla Mörksuggejakten, with several spectator-friendly courses in the Jarl area. Mörksuggejakten TrailRun also offers 10 km and 20.8 km runs starting from IK Jarl Rättvik.
course_highlights: The course offers beautiful views over Lake Siljan from the heights around Vidablick and the Hedsåsen summer pastures
The route follows gravel roads and trails, and crosses narrow suspension bridges over the Enån valley
Passes distinctive locations such as Dalhalla, Springkällan and Kungshol
additional: Mass start for all classes at 09:30. Maximum time: 5 hours. Race bibs can be collected on race day from 08:00 at IK Jarl. The courses are marked with red-and-white tape and signs. The course is 95% trail and 5% gravel road. It is permitted to switch to a shorter distance during the race. Parking is available at Rättvik Arena; camping in the parking area is prohibited.

name: Jølster Maraton
description: Jølster Marathon is a popular race that brings runners from all over the country to beautiful Jølster. The race starts and finishes at Jølstrahallen in Vassenden and offers four distances: marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km. The route follows scenic stretches in the area, and places are limited, so early registration is recommended. The event also includes extra activities for the whole family and a music and marathon quiz the evening after the race.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Jølstrahallen in Vassenden
The route follows beautiful stretches in Jølster
Refreshment stations with water, squash, cola, sports drink and bananas
additional: Maximum 1,300 participants. Prize-giving at 13:00 for all distances. 5% of the proceeds go to a good cause. A pink T-shirt can be purchased, partially sponsored by Enivest. Cars are not allowed to drive to the event office on race day. Race numbers should be collected on Friday or well before the start. Extra activities, including a cycling event and a mini race for children, are held. Great prizes from sponsors are drawn among all participants. The top three in each category and distance receive prizes.

name: Bitihorn Opp
price_range: 150 kr under 17 år; 300 kr fra 17 år
description: Bitihorn Opp is an informal, relaxed uphill race up majestic Bitihorn in Øystre Slidre. The race is suitable for everyone, whether you walk or run, fast or slow, and focuses on an enjoyable outing in stunning natural surroundings. The route follows stone steps and trails on the “front side” of Bitihorn, offering a unique nature experience with 450 metres of elevation gain over 2 kilometres. The event supports local sport, and all participants receive a prize, with additional prizes for the fastest man and woman.
course_highlights: The route follows majestic stone steps and trails on the front side of Bitihorn
450 metres of elevation gain over 2 kilometres
A stunning nature experience in mountain terrain
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 11:30 at the start of the steps. Parking is at Båtskaret, with signs on race day. Proceeds go to Øystre Slidre IL. All participants receive a prize, with extra prizes for the fastest man and woman, as well as fun draw prizes. Registration via EQ Timing. Parking is listed at Båtskaret or Båtskardstølen.

name: Oberlichtenauer Sommerlauf
description: The 44th Oberlichtenau Summer Run is taking place, inviting runners of all ages to a sporting event that has brought together the Saxon running community and guests from near and far for more than four decades. The day begins with children’s races over 800 metres and 2.2 kilometres for the U12 and U14 age groups. These are followed by the recreational run of approximately 5 kilometres and the challenging 13-kilometre main race, which tests stamina and agility with steep climbs and fast descents over the Keulenberg. The running group of Sportgemeinschaft Oberlichtenau looks forward to welcoming all participants.
course_highlights: Children’s race: 2 laps around the sports field (800 metres)
U12 and U14 children’s race: 2.2 km along Keulenberstraße
Main race: 13 km with challenging climbs and descents over the Keulenberg
additional: The event day starts with the children’s race at 09:45, followed by a new children’s race for U12 and U14 at 09:55. The awards ceremony takes place immediately after the children’s races. The recreational run starts at 10:25 and the main race at 10:30. The running group is led by Patrick Thomschke (department head) and Jens Schäfer (manager). The event usually takes place in summer temperatures of around 23°C. Registration and further details are available on the official website. The race is a great opportunity for runners to achieve personal bests and experience the beautiful Saxon countryside.

name: 10. Hochkippenlauf
description: The 10th Hochkippenlauf takes place at Stadion Profen and is organized by SV Eintracht Profen. Various races are offered for different age groups, from a Bambini run to distances for young people and 10 km races for adults. The event is part of a sports festival. The race is a great opportunity for sports enthusiasts of all ages to compete in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 400 m Bambini run (one lap of the stadium)
Distances of 2.1 km, 4.2 km and 5 km for young people
10 km race for U18, U20 and adults
additional: The Bambini runs take place over one lap of the stadium. The race takes place at Stadion Profen, with warm and sunny weather in July. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere and the chance to win prizes in various categories.

name: 46. Küstenkanallauf
description: The event offers 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km races, as well as walking and hiking routes. The scenic course runs along the Küstenkanal and is suitable for runners of all ability levels. This traditional event is organized by KC Ikenbrügge von 1971 e. V.
course_highlights: Scenic route along the Küstenkanal
A choice of distances: 5.5 km, 11 km and 22 km
Walking and hiking routes available
additional: Start times: Runners in the 5.5 km, 11 km and 22 km races start at 17:00; walking and hiking start at 16:15. Register using the online form on the website or through the contact channel, providing your name, year of birth, club and town. This is a local event with a friendly atmosphere that attracts numerous runners from the region each year. Registration, results and further details are available on the official website and in the event announcement.

name: 9. Bremer Brückenlauf
price_range: ab 8,00 € bis 45,00 € je nach Kategorie und Frühbucherstatus
description: The Bremen Bridges Run invites runners to experience Bremen from a unique perspective. The course crosses bridges spanning the Weser, the Kleine Weser and the Werdersee, offering a maritime atmosphere in the heart of the city. A range of distances is available, including a half marathon, 10 km run, 5 km run, a special 5 km underwear run, and children’s races. The event promises good spirits, a summery atmosphere and breathtaking views of Bremen and the Weser.
course_highlights: Run across several bridges in Bremen
Course crosses the Weser, Kleine Weser and Werdersee
Officially measured courses eligible for record lists
additional: Optional medal engraving (10 € for adults, 7.50 € for children). Start times vary by distance, from 16:30 (underwear run) to 18:15 (5 km and 10 km walking). All main races are measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for record lists. Children’s races are privately measured. An alphabetical finish list is provided for walkers and Nordic walkers. Conditions of participation and age categories are clearly defined. Circuit course with official measurement, age categories, competition categories, medal engraving available, including Nordic walking.

name: Benkhauser Schlosslauf
location: Schloss Benkhausen, Espelkamp, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 600 m Kinderlauf kostenlos, 2 km Schülerlauf 4,00 € (bis 14.06.), 6,5 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), 10,8 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), 20,8 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), Preise steigen nach dem 14.06.
description: The Benkhausen Castle Run is a sporting event taking place for the second time in 2026, set against the unique backdrop of Benkhausen Castle. The event offers varied routes along paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Benkhausen. The start and finish are at Benkhausen Castle Square, where race bibs are also distributed. The event is open to runners of all ages and includes several distances, including children’s and schoolchildren’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes along paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Benkhausen
Start and finish at historic Benkhausen Castle Square
Kilometre markers along the route for guidance
additional: Late entries are possible on race day from 12:30 until 60 minutes before the start, provided the participant limit has not been reached, for an additional fee of €2. The number of participants is limited to 200 runners per main race (6.5 km, 10.8 km, 20.8 km), with a maximum of 600 registrations overall. Timing uses disposable chip technology. Shower and changing facilities are available at Benkhausen Primary School. Children’s and schoolchildren’s races award medals to all participants and have no timing or awards ceremony. The well-known announcer Heino Krüger accompanies the races. Late entries are possible on site; the participant limit for the main races is 200 per distance, with a maximum of 600 registrations overall; chip timing; event held as part of a sports festival.

name: 01. Okertalsperren Ultra-Marathon
description: The course covers 47.4 km and consists of three laps of a 15.8 km, mostly flat loop around the main arm of the Okertalsperre. The route runs along the forebay, over the dam and the main dam wall, offering a scenic course with gentle climbs. The event is suitable for experienced runners; bringing your own refreshments is recommended, and runners are responsible for their own timekeeping. After the race, participants receive certificates by email, and the results are published on the website.

name: 23. Schneekopflauf
description: The Schneekopflauf is one of the most beautiful and challenging mountain races in Germany, held in the Thuringian Forest. The course runs from Schmiedefeld via Großer Finsterberg to Schneekopf and covers distances of 12.7 and 22.2 kilometers, with plenty of climbs and elevation gain. This race is especially suitable for experienced runners who want to test their limits. Since 2025, there has also been a Schneekopf hike for Nordic walkers and hikers, who are also rewarded with a medal at the summit.

name: 40. Schweriner Fünf-Seen-Lauf
description: The Schwerin Five Lakes Run is a traditional race in northern Germany, taking place for the 40th time. The event offers various race distances around Schwerin’s five lakes, including a half marathon, 15 km, 10 km and 5 km runs, as well as a one-mile lake run for children. Runners experience a scenic course with the start and finish at Bertha-Klingberg-Platz. The event is known for its excellent organization, family-friendly atmosphere and various categories, including corporate and school competitions.

name: Gocher Steintorlauf
description: The 30th Gocher Steintorlauf takes place as part of the Gocher Fußball Sommer. Organized by SV Viktoria Goch, Athletics/Running Group, the event is expected to welcome more than 800 runners of various age groups in the city center of Goch. Events range from the Bambini Run and the 2,000m hobby group and company run to open races around the Steintor. The event offers suitable distances for both competitive and recreational runners in a welcoming, healthy outdoor atmosphere.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, combining sport with charity. The 10th anniversary edition takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to make Marlena, one of the foundation’s beneficiaries, dream come true: a trip to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and every kilometer brings them closer to achieving this goal. It is not only a sporting challenge, but also an opportunity to work together to support children in need.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowo ZaDyszka is an annual road race held in Janikowo, attracting runners of different ages and ability levels. The race covers 10 km, with professional timekeeping provided using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Janikowo Sports and Recreation Centre, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, ensuring high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and welcoming to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

name: XI Krokowska 10
description: The 11th Krokowska 10 is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series, taking place on July 4 in Żarnowiec. The race offers a 10 km distance through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the region. Kaszuby Biegają is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from pieces awarded at the individual stages.

name: Kadeloop
description: The Moore DRV-Kadeloop in Schipluiden is a traditional running event held annually on the first Saturday of July since 1978. The main distance is 12 km through the green Midden-Delfland area and along the Vlaardingsekade back to Schipluiden. There is also a 5 km run and a 1 km and 2 km junior race. The event is known for its beautiful scenery and friendly atmosphere and is part of the Zomer Runcircuit.
course_highlights: 12 km route through the green Midden-Delfland area
Run along the Vlaardingsekade back to Schipluiden
Junior races of 1 km and 2 km, specially for children
additional: Race bib collection for children: 10:00–11:00; for other distances: 11:00–13:00 at the VV Schipluiden clubhouse. Parking is available at VV Schipluiden. Chip-based electronic timing for the 5 km and 12 km. Water stations along the route and at the finish. Prize-giving immediately after the children's race, for the 5 km at around 15:00, and for the 12 km at around 15:30 at the VV Schipluiden clubhouse. No on-site registration; registration is online only until 2 July 2027 at 23:59. Race bibs may be transferred until 2 July at 21:00 via the registration website. Distances: 12 km, 5 km, junior race (1 km and 2 km); activities include Nordic walking and walking; location: Schipluiden, Midden-Delfland.

name: 76e Stratenloop Tuitjenhorn
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, Maridalsvannet rundt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 475,00 kr 332,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Festivalpass SOLO Deltakere kr 1475,00 kr 1032,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

description: Maridalsvannet Rundt is one of eight races in the Oslo Running Festival, which follows the capital’s beautiful trails and roads. The race has a mass start on Sunday, July 4 at 11:00, with the start and finish at Frysja, a lovely area with good facilities and opportunities for swimming, barbecuing, and relaxing after the race. The course is 13.5 km long and offers scenic surroundings around Lake Maridalsvannet. The Oslo Running Festival gives you the flexibility to run alone or with others, and you can take part in several races with a festival pass or day tickets.
course_highlights: The 13.5 km course goes around Lake Maridalsvannet
Start and finish at Frysja, with good facilities such as a café and grocery store
Lovely start and finish area with opportunities for swimming and barbecuing
additional: Race bibs can be picked up at Löplabbet Oslo city centre from April 7. The same race bib is used throughout the series. The course is marked only for the mass start. Timing is recorded by a chip attached to the race bib, which must be visible on your chest. There are good public transport connections and several parking spaces near the start area. The race can be completed at a time that suits you during the period June 25–July 4, 2027. An early-bird price is listed; prices vary by ticket type.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a simple, fast race event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, featuring a flat, measured 2,633-metre loop. The race offers seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, and is suitable for anyone looking to chase a personal best. Participants can set out their own bottles and gels on their personal nutrition table, which they pass each lap, allowing them to keep their nutrition well under control during the race. The event has good facilities, including changing rooms, toilets and free parking at the venue.
course_highlights: Flat, measured 2,633-metre loop
Participants’ own nutrition table at every lap
Good facilities, including changing rooms and toilets inside Ås school
additional: Race bibs are collected using self-service at the school from around two hours before the start. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan split times. At selected races, ninth-graders from Feiring school staff an official water station and raise money for their school trip. Participants who set a personal best can ring the bell by the finish area. Race bibs are collected using self-service at the school from around two hours before the start.

name: Perseløpet ¤5- 2027
description: Perseløpet is a simple, fast running event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, featuring a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop. The event offers seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, giving runners the opportunity to set personal records in a well-equipped setting with a dedicated nutrition table. Race bibs are collected via self-service at the venue, which has free parking, changing rooms and toilets. The event is organised by Feiring IL and has a tradition of many personal records, with a friendly atmosphere where runners can celebrate their personal records by ringing the bell at the finish.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap
Flat road races offering the opportunity for fast times
additional: Race bibs are collected via self-service approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Runners can place their own bottles and gels on the nutrition table before the start. At selected events, ninth graders from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. A lap-time calculator is available to help plan split times. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area. Registration via RaceDays. Race bibs are collected via self-service at the school, and runners can place their own drinks and nutrition at the nutrition table.

name: VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrücker Staffelmarathon
location: Schloss- und Rosengarten, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrück Relay Marathon is a long-running relay marathon held in the castle and rose gardens in Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The flat, well-maintained course follows a two-kilometre loop through the historic castle park, which runners complete 21 times. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which has hosted this relay marathon since 2013 and brings together a committed running community. The relay marathon offers runners an attractive and varied route through beautiful parkland, with no disruptive road crossings.
course_highlights: Flat, well-maintained 2 km loop through the castle park
Start and finish in the rose garden, with a view of the historic castle
No disruptive road crossings on the course
additional: The relay marathon consists of 21 laps of 2 km each, run in Rheda Castle Park. The course is flat and has no road crossings. Registration is available online. The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which also holds other running events. Photos and videos from previous relay races are available on the website. Registration is via my.raceresult.com; the race is held as a relay marathon, and results are available on the event day.

name: ZfS-Münster City Run
description: Der ZfS Münster-City-Run wird von den Laufsportfreunden Münster e.V. veranstaltet, einem der größten Laufsportvereine Deutschlands mit über 800 Mitgliedern. Der Lauf findet in der Stadt Münster statt und bietet eine attraktive Strecke durch die Innenstadt. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Läufer aller Leistungsstufen und fördert den Breitensport sowie den Wettkampfsport. Die Laufsportfreunde Münster bieten zudem vielfältige Trainingsgruppen und Kurse zur Vorbereitung auf den Lauf an.
course_highlights: Strecke durch die Innenstadt von Münster
Attraktive 5 km und 10 km Streckenpläne verfügbar
Veranstaltung durch einen erfahrenen und großen Laufsportverein
additional: Die Laufsportfreunde Münster bieten Trainingsgruppen mit unterschiedlichen Schwerpunkten und Niveaus zur Vorbereitung auf Wettkämpfe an. Streckenpläne für 5 km und 10 km sind auf der Webseite als PDF verfügbar.

name: Dorflauf TSV Wiera
description: The 6th TSV Wiera Village Run takes place in Schwalmstadt and is officially registered with the German Athletics Association. The event offers races over 600 meters and 10 kilometers. The results are included in the official athletics rankings, making the competition especially attractive to ambitious runners. The race takes place in typical July weather, with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny conditions.

name: SVE-Steinwiesenlauf
description: The Steinwiesenlauf organised by SV Eidelstedt Hamburg is a popular running event that attracts numerous participants every year. The event offers various races for all age groups, from a kids’ run and school races to the 5 km and 10 km main races. The course includes a motorway bridge and offers exciting competitions in a family-friendly atmosphere. The race traditionally takes place on a weekend and continues to attract more participants.

name: Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 05.07.2026
description: The 7th Bieg Wilka Wilkowo 2026 is an annual running event held in Wilkowo near Świebodzin. The race attracts runners from various categories and offers the chance to compete on a route combining road and off-road sections. The organizers provide professional timing and technical support, while participants can expect efficient organization and a friendly atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to get active and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: A route combining road and off-road sections
Scenic surroundings of Wilkowo near Świebodzin
Professional electronic timing
additional: The event is organized by Super Sport, a company from Zielona Góra, which provides timing, race bib printing, and technical support. No details are available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Registration will be available at super-sport.com.pl, and the event attracts local runners and sports enthusiasts.

name: 34 Bieg po Plaży
location: Jarosławiec, Postomino, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 34th Jarosławiec Beach Run is an annual running event organized by the Culture and Sports Centre in Postomino. The race takes place on a scenic route along the beach by the Baltic Sea, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by coastal nature. The event attracts runners from various regions, combining sporting competition with recreation and socializing. The organizers provide professional event support and attractive keepsakes for participants.
course_highlights: The race route runs along a sandy beach by the Baltic Sea
Scenic views of the sea and coastal nature
Flat, fast terrain conducive to good race times
additional: The event is organized by the Culture and Sports Centre in Postomino and takes place in Jarosławiec. The website has no detailed information about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Reports and photo galleries from previous editions are available.

name: Feriespretten 2027
description: Feriespretten is the summer’s most beautiful and fun trail race, organized by Hope IL in Risør, Agder. The race offers two distances over varied, hilly terrain, with the start and finish in the same place. The long course, approximately 9 km, is suitable for those looking for a challenging workout in beautiful surroundings, while the short course, approximately 5 km, is perfect for beginners, children and families, or as an untimed recreational run. Feriespretten is a family-friendly event that brings experienced runners and beginners together for an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Two distances over varied, hilly terrain
Start and finish in the same place
The course runs through beautiful scenery on the Sandnes peninsula
additional: The short course can be run untimed as a recreational run. The organizer is Hope IL. Results and statistics from previous years are available on the website. Untimed recreational categories are offered for the 5 km and 9 km distances. Timing information is provided through the organizer’s channels.

name: 41. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a private marathon run held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.10 km each, around 42.7 km in total, and offers a quiet, self-supported running environment, with refreshments at runners’ own cars after each lap. The event is limited to 22 participants and is open to runners aged 18 and over. Marathon times are recorded with a manual stopwatch, and a voluntary donation to environmental or social projects is requested.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Czerwonak Physical Culture Development Center. Held in the evening, it combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It has become a long-standing tradition, attracting participants who want to spend time outdoors running or walking in a friendly atmosphere. The event takes place around Bolechowo and lasts approximately two and a half hours.
course_highlights: Evening runs and walks outdoors
Route around Bolechowo and Czerwonak
Bringing the local community together through physical activity
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. It is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees, or online registration.

name: Gütersloh Läuft - für den guten Zweck
description: Gütersloh Läuft is a diverse charity running event taking place for the 18th time in Gütersloh City Park. The event offers races for all age groups, from Bambini and school races to Nordic walking, corporate and individual races, as well as a 10 km summer evening run. All participants support the German Stroke Foundation with their entry fee, as €1 is donated for every registration. The routes run through the beautiful city park and offer a sporting, community atmosphere for recreational and ambitious runners.

name: City-Sport-Abendlauf
description: The City-Sport Evening Run in Rostock is a popular summer race held annually in Barnstorfer Wald. Hundreds of runners come together for an evening run that combines the joy of running with a good cause. Proceeds from the race are donated to charitable organizations, most recently to the Rostock hospice at Klinikum Südstadt. The race has become a fixture on Rostock’s running calendar and continues to attract growing numbers of participants.

name: 4. Dorstener 24-Stunden-Lauf
location: Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, Dorsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr beträgt pro Person 12,00 Euro

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Läuferinnen und Läufer unter 16 Jahren können für 6,00 Euro starten

description: The Dorsten 24-Hour Run is a charity fundraising event held in Dorsten, near the city center, in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof. The course is about 1 km long and runs through a scenic park between the Lippe and the Wesel-Datteln Canal. Participants can run, walk or stroll for any amount of time during the 24 hours and complete as many laps as they choose. 100% of the entry fee goes into the donation fund, which supports various social organizations. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, from a few short laps to a half marathon or marathon.
course_highlights: Loop course of approximately 1 km in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof
Scenic route between the Lippe and the Wesel-Datteln Canal
Central location near Dorsten city center
additional: The event is a charity run, with 100% of all entry fees going into the donation fund. Participants are not required to run for 24 hours straight; everyone can decide for themselves how many laps to run, walk or stroll. The event is organized by interevent GmbH and supported by numerous local sponsors. Functional shirts can be ordered for 27,00 EUR. Start and finish are in the park; registration is available online and on site. Parking is available on Kurt-Schumacher-Straße and in the VHS multi-storey car park. Results for performances of 50 km or more are included in the rankings.

name: Borener Meile
description: The Borener Meile is a traditional 1,609.34-meter road race, held for the 35th time as part of the Borener Dorftage in Boren. The race is organized by Borener SV, an active sports club on the Schlei with a particular commitment to running and triathlon. The event offers runners a short, fast course and is a popular competition in the region. Results and photos from previous races are available on the website.
course_highlights: Road race over exactly 1,609.34 meters (one mile)
Traditional event held as part of the Borener Dorftage
Organized by the local sports club Borener SV
additional: Road race, registration available, results and photos from previous events available

name: Roruper Abendlauf
description: The Rorup Evening Run is a long-standing running event in Rorup, a district of Dülmen in North Rhine-Westphalia, which has attracted runners every summer for more than three decades. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon as its premier event, as well as 10 km, 3 km, a schoolchildren’s race and a Pampers Run for children. The course is flat and paved, with a ten-kilometre loop that is completed once or twice depending on the distance. The finish is in the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium, where runners complete a lap of the stadium before crossing the finish line. In addition to certificates and trophies, cash prizes are awarded to the top runners in the half marathon and 10 km race.
course_highlights: Flat, paved course
Ten-kilometre loop, with a longer first lap for the half marathon
Stadium lap before the finish at the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium
additional: All races start at the Rorup sports ground. Certificates are awarded to all finishers, trophies to the winners, and special prizes to the top three runners in each age group. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three male and female finishers in the half marathon and 10 km race. Courses are officially measured; online registration is available until 30 minutes before the start; parking is available; refreshments are provided on the course; finish in the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium.

name: Böda Sandsloppet
location: Böda Sand SportCamp, Böda, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Sandsloppet is a family-friendly running race held at Böda Sand SportCamp on Öland. The race offers several distances for both children and adults, with routes through lovely forest terrain. Adults can choose between 6.5 km and 4 km, while shorter distances are available for children and young people. All participants who finish the race receive a medal as a keepsake. The event has a welcoming atmosphere and is open to runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Route through lovely forest terrain
Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp
Distances available for both children and adults
additional: Late registration is available through 8 July, followed by race-number collection on race day from 15:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Children and young people under 11 are not timed and there is no prize ceremony for them. Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp. Register by 3 July 2027; late registration is available for a higher fee. Children aged 11 and under are not timed and there is no prize ceremony.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/bodasandsloppet/): 2027-07-10 — "Tid & datum 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-02)

name: Musköloppet
description: Musköloppet is a popular running race held in the spectacular archipelago setting of Muskö. The race has a long tradition and celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2022, after being paused during the pandemic. There are several different courses and categories, including children’s races, and the event offers a wonderful nature experience, with the start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård. Late registration is available on site up to one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the beautiful archipelago setting of Muskö
Start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård
Children’s races over 1.5 km and 2.5 km for different age groups
additional: Late registration is available on site at the start and finish area up to one hour before the race begins. There are water stations along the course, and runners may arrange their own drinks. Race management may decide to restart the race if needed. Pacing assistance from non-competitors is not permitted. The children’s races start at 10:00 for 1.5 km (ages 7–10) and at 10:30 for 2.5 km (ages 11–14). The countdown on the official website indicates 10 July 2027. However, the published times and distances on the website are for 2026. The relay costs 150 kr per team, and the children’s race for ages 4–6 is free, according to the published information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.muskoloppet.se/): 2027-07-10 — "Nedräkning till Musköloppet 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: H2 Trail
distance_verbose: 80 km, 50 km, 28 km, 18 km, 11 km, 6 km
description: Umara H2 Trail 2027 is organized by OK Skogsvargarna and takes place on 10 July at Bergagården, Hunneberg. The race offers several distances, from 6 km up to 50 km, including a kids’ trail for the youngest participants. The courses traverse varied terrain on Hunneberg, with trails, gravel roads and asphalt, and feature scenic viewpoints, crofts and swimming spots. All participants in the 11 km to 50 km races receive their own Umara cup to reduce the use of disposable cups at the aid stations. The club also offers showers, a sauna and changing rooms at its clubhouse at Bergagården.
course_highlights: The 50 km distance crosses Hunneberg and passes sights such as viewpoints, crofts and swimming spots
The course is marked with arrows and ribbons and consists of 23% gravel roads, 73% trails and 4% asphalt
Kids’ trail and mini trail for children, with a medal for every participant
additional: All participants in the 11 km to 50 km races receive their own Umara cup to use at the aid stations to reduce the use of disposable cups. Aid stations are located along the course, and participants are encouraged to carry their own fluids. Support is available at a designated spot on the course when passing through Bergagården (25 km). The kids’ trail and mini trail are untimed, and every participant receives a medal. Parking is available about 300 metres from the race centre and is signposted. A mobile phone and power bank are recommended for emergencies. Previous editions have had aid stations along the course; participants have needed to bring their own fluids.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://okskogsvargarna.kanslietonline.se/arrangemang/umara-h2-trail-2027/): 2027-07-10 — "Lördag den 10 juli på Bergagården, Hunneberg" (was estimated 2027-06-26)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Lördag den 10 juli på Bergagården, Hunneberg

name: Gotland Run 511k (2026)
description: Gotland Run 511k is a unique running adventure and a journey to explore your inner landscape. It is not a traditional race, but a self-supported run around the beautiful island of Gotland, including a loop around Fårö, starting and finishing in Visby. Participants have 10 days to complete the approximately 511 km course, with support from four Angel Stations along the way. The organizer provides basic support, while runners are responsible for their own food and accommodation.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Visby, Gotland’s medieval capital
Clockwise loop around the island, including Fårö
Mixed terrain with asphalt, gravel roads, and shorter trails
additional: Participants must check in twice daily using an online tool. Accommodation on the first night is at Visby Fängelse Hostel in shared rooms. A pre-race dinner and briefing are held the evening before the start. Angel Stations offer support, water, rest, and sometimes shower facilities. The ferry to Fårö runs every 30 minutes, but requires a call between 22:00 and 05:30. The run must be completed on foot within 10 days, averaging approximately 51 km per day. Luggage storage is available at the hostel. Parking is available near the ferry terminal, with cheaper options at Visby Airport. This is a self-supported event: participants are responsible for most of their food and logistics. The entire distance must be completed on foot within ten days, with regular position reports.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://runtrip.se/race-memo-2027/): 2027-07-10 — "SATURDAY, JULY 10 — The race starts at 10:00 am outside the main entrance of Visby Fängelse" (was estimated 2027-07-03)

name: Klåveröd Backyard 2026
location: Klåveröd, Svalöv Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Klåveröd Backyard är ett trail- och backyardlopp i Klåveröd på Söderåsen, med löpning genom vacker bokskog. Loppet beskrivs som en kombination av trail och backyard och välkomnar deltagare till en naturnära löparupplevelse i Skåne. 2026 års evenemang är annonserat till lördagen den 11 juli.
course_highlights: Trail genom bokskog
Naturnära miljö i Klåveröd på Söderåsen
Kombinerar trail med backyard-format
additional: Facebook-evenemanget för 2026 anger lördagen den 11 juli. Vid 2024 års lopp sprang segraren 14 varv, över 9 mil.

name: Branäsutmaningen
description: Branäsutmaningen is a summer adventure in Branäs featuring a challenging 6-kilometre course. Branäs is known for its beautiful natural surroundings and family-friendly outdoor activities all year round. In summer, activities include mountain biking, padel and water activities by the Klarälven River. Branäs is investing in family-friendly cycling trails and scenic hiking trails, making it a perfect place for an active and fun summer experience.
course_highlights: A challenging 6-kilometre course
Family-friendly downhill trails and wide cross-country trails
A scenic location by the Klarälven River, with hiking trails and fishing
additional: Branäs offers family-friendly lift-accessed cycling, with the six-seat express lift Sjöexpressen at the heart of its cycling programme. There are barbecue and rest areas with views, miles of gravel and paved roads for training, and cycling tracks for children at Soltorget. Food and drinks are available at Ladan restaurant in the centre. The summer map includes a pump track, zipline, trampoline with a big airbag, and trails in Logläntan. Start at 14:00 at Soltorget. Family Day also includes Björnbuseloppet for children, an after-run and an evening of live music. The first prize in the race is a family ski holiday.

name: Hestane Skyrace
organizer: Lars Øvrebø og Torstein Bolstad Blikra, med Gaular IL
description: Hestane Skyrace is a demanding skyrace over the spectacular peaks of Storehesten and Lisjehesten in Bygstad. The race features technical climbing, an exposed ridge and magnificent panoramic views in dramatic natural surroundings. There are two distances: 32 km with 1,900 metres of elevation gain and 26 km with 1,400 metres of elevation gain, both across challenging mountain terrain. The event is a celebration for the whole village, with activities for participants and spectators alike.
course_highlights: Technical climbing and an exposed ridge over Storehesten and Lisjehesten
Magnificent panoramic views and challenging mountain terrain
Two distances: 32 km (~1,900 m elevation gain) and 26 km (~1,400 m elevation gain)
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, 1 L of water, emergency ration and wind jacket. Cutoff at Skaraly at 15:30; final finish at 19:00. Parking at Langeland Ski Centre costs 50 kr. Race bibs can be collected on Friday 9 July and on race day from 07:00. There are staffed stations with water and first aid along the route. After-run gathering at Tønna in Bygstad from 20:00, with food and socialising. Start and finish at Langeland Ski Centre. Start at 09:00. Registration via Racedays.

name: Kvasshovden Opp
description: Kvasshovden Opp is a traditional uphill race in Ulvik, Hardanger, running from the centre of Ulvik to the summit of Kvasshovden at 1,030 metres above sea level. The race offers a challenging climb and beautiful views over Hardanger, attracting both local and visiting runners. It has been held since 1926 and is known for its great atmosphere and beautiful scenery. Kvasshovden Opp is a perfect race for those who enjoy demanding uphill races in spectacular surroundings.
course_highlights: Uphill race from the centre of Ulvik to the summit of Kvasshovden at 1,030 metres above sea level
Beautiful views over Hardanger during the race
Challenging climb with varied terrain
additional: The race is held annually in July, with results available online. The organiser is Ulvik Idrottslag, founded in 1926, with 337 members. Contact by phone on 95938952 or by email at post@ulvikil.no.

name: Dynafit Hardangerjøkulen Ultra
description: Dynafit Hardangerjøkulen Ultra is a challenging 95 km ultramarathon that starts and finishes at Liseth Pensjonat & Hyttetun near Vøringsfossen in Eidfjord. The route circles the beautiful Hardangerjøkulen glacier, crossing mountain terrain with both easy and technically demanding sections, and may be snow-covered in places. For those looking for a shorter challenge, a 34 km route follows part of the same course. Liseth Pensjonat & Hyttetun serves as the base throughout the event, with accommodation, food and opportunities to socialise around the fire pit.
course_highlights: The route circles Hardangerjøkulen, one of Norway’s most beautiful glaciers
Mountain terrain with both easy and technically demanding sections
Parts of the route may be snow-covered
additional: Start and finish at Liseth Pensjonat & Hyttetun near Vøringsfossen. Total elevation gain: 4,980 m+ on the 95 km route and 1,330 m+ on the 34 km route. The route follows the Norwegian Trekking Association’s trail network and is not marked, so GPS navigation is required. There is no or poor mobile coverage along the way. Checkpoints on the 95 km route are at Finse (38 km), Krækkja (62 km) and Kjeldebu (75 km). In bad weather, an alternative route is available, with distances of 100 km and 35 km. A pre-race briefing and tracker distribution take place early on race day. Runners can be followed on a big screen at the event base.

name: Sommerlauf des LSV Porz
location: Gut Leidenhausen, Köln-Porz, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: Nachmeldung 2 € am Veranstaltungstag, sonst keine expliziten Angaben
description: The LSV Porz Summer Run is a popular race in the Gut Leidenhausen recreational area in Cologne-Porz. It is held as the Ingeborg Urbach Memorial Run and offers distances from 1 km to 5 km for competitive runners and recreational joggers. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists, with the 5 km loop regarded as one of the fastest running courses in Cologne. The entry fee also supports Brusthilfe Deutschland e.V. and the Leidenhausen Forest School.
course_highlights: Race in the Gut Leidenhausen recreational area
5 km and 10 km courses measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists
The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running courses in Cologne
additional: Late registration is available on the event day for a fee of €2; school students are exempt from the late registration fee. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Race numbers must be worn on the front. €1 per participant is donated to Brusthilfe Deutschland e.V. and the Leidenhausen Forest School. Terrain in the Leidenhausen recreational area; registration by SEPA direct debit; race number worn on the front; medals for all pre-registered participants; awards ceremonies for the top runners; certificates available online.

name: Wybelsumer Polderlauf
description: The Wybelsumer Polder Run is a running event for children and adults held at the Wybelsum sports ground in Emden. Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V., the event offers a sporting opportunity for the whole family in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. It is part of Emden’s diverse events calendar and promotes the local community and sport.
course_highlights: Running event for children and adults
Venue: Wybelsum sports ground, Emden
Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V.
additional: The event includes various running distances for all age groups and is a popular regional event in the Krummhörn region.

name: Bergheide-Cross 2026
description: SCB Langendamm invites you to the 4th Bergheide Cross 2026. The course starts on the access road to the shooting house of the local small-bore rifle club and runs through the “Osterberg” local recreation and nature conservation area. The event offers three distances for different competition and age categories, as well as walking on the shorter course. There is also a 1,000-meter race for children and young people. The event is approved by the DLV and starts at 16:00.

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a moderately challenging course. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, providing convenient event facilities. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.

name: 't Giet moar deur
location: Gieten, Aa en Hunze, Drenthe, Netherlands

name: Semesterhalvmaran
location: Torps herrgård, Kumla Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Semesterhalvmaran is a recurring running event organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, inviting runners to experience the beautiful open landscapes of the Närke Plain. The race starts and finishes at Torps herrgård outside Kumla and offers a lovely running experience on gravel roads among rolling grain fields. After a two-year break, the race returns on July 11, 2027, welcoming runners of all levels to take part in a community filled with the joy of running. LK Gränslöst is an inclusive club that aims to bring runners from across the country together and build a strong community around running.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Torps herrgård outside Kumla
Run on gravel roads among rolling grain fields on the Närke Plain
Beautiful, nature-rich surroundings on the Närke Plain
additional: Registration is planned to open in January. The race is organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, which also organizes other races and group training every Wednesday at 18:00 in Örebro. The club focuses on community and the joy of running for all levels.

name: Dodenauer Volkslauf
organizer: Leichtathletik Gemeinschaft Eder (LG Eder) / TSV Dodenau
description: The Dodenau Volkslauf is a recreational running event open to everyone, starting and finishing at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall in Battenberg-Dodenau. The event offers a range of distances from Bambini races to a half marathon, as well as Nordic walking. To be included in the rankings, participants must belong to an athletics club or an LG. Online registration is available until about one week before the race; late registration is possible at the start.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall
Distances for Bambini, short, middle and long races, as well as a half marathon
Nordic walking over 5 km and 10 km
additional: Late registration at the start is possible from 07:45 until 45 minutes before the respective start. To be included in the rankings, participants must provide their club or LG on the registration form. Terrain: Dodenau multi-purpose hall, online registration, various running distances, Nordic walking

tiers.description: Mitglieder der Sportvereinigung Pönitz zahlen die Hälfte.

description: The 41st Pönitz Fun Run takes place in Pönitz and invites runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers to a sporting and social event. The course runs through the charming landscape of Holstein Switzerland, with romantic hedgerows, summer fields, and peaceful meadows. At the Pönitz Sports Park, participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, show performances, and an awards ceremony. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and attractive prizes are awarded to the winners.
course_highlights: Holstein Switzerland scenery with hedgerows, fields, and meadows
Start and finish at Pönitz Sports Park in a summery atmosphere
Refreshments and show performances at the venue
additional: The awards ceremony begins at 11:15, with medals for the overall winners (places 1–3) and trophies and certificates for age-group winners and placers. Members of SVG Pönitz pay half the entry fee. The event offers refreshments, show performances, and a friendly atmosphere for athletes, companions, and spectators. Runners can choose from the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and Nordic walking; start times from 8:30; a shared experience of community and nature.

name: 27. Gläserner Mönch Lauf
description: The Gläserner Mönch Run is a traditional trail race in the Harz foothills, returning after a seven-year hiatus. The course is known for its undulating profile, with more than 100 meters of elevation gain per lap, and the legendary climb up 222 steps to the “Gläserner Mönch.” Participants can choose from a range of distances, from the Bambini Run to the 18 km Extreme Run, and enjoy unspoiled nature among rocks and forests. The event combines a sporting challenge with local pride and takes place around the Landhotel Schäferhof in Halberstadt.

name: 8. Barigauer Turmlauf
description: Der Barigauer Turmlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Laufwettbewerb in Königsee, der Läufer aller Altersklassen anspricht. Die Strecke führt durch die reizvolle Landschaft rund um den Barigauer Turm und bietet eine abwechslungsreiche Herausforderung mit naturnahen Wegen. Der Lauf ist bekannt für seine familiäre Atmosphäre und die gute Organisation durch den Laufverein Königsee.
course_highlights: Lauf durch die landschaftlich reizvolle Umgebung des Barigauer Turms
Naturnahe Wege mit abwechslungsreichem Terrain
Familienfreundliche Veranstaltung mit verschiedenen Altersklassen

name: BTG-Sommerstaffel
description: Die BTG-Sommerstaffel ist eine traditionsreiche Staffelveranstaltung, die von der Bielefelder Turngemeinde von 1848 e.V. ausgerichtet wird. Der Verein ist der älteste Sportverein in Bielefeld und bietet eine breite Palette an Sportarten an, darunter auch Leichtathletik. Die Veranstaltung findet in Bielefeld statt und richtet sich an sportbegeisterte Läuferinnen und Läufer, die gemeinsam in Teams antreten. Die BTG legt Wert auf eine familiäre Atmosphäre und sportliche Gemeinschaft.

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race taking place in Starogard Gdański. It’s an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a moderately challenging event on an asphalt surface, ideal for improving fitness and competing in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Västervik City Run
description: Västervik City Run is a city race of approximately 6.3 km that takes place in and around central Västervik, starting and finishing at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget. The race offers a scenic course along the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken, passing landmarks including the Stegeholm Castle ruins and Myntbryggan. After finishing, participants receive a medal as proof of their participation. The race is a popular summer tradition that welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A city race of approximately 6.3 km in central Västervik
The course follows the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken and passes the Stegeholm Castle ruins
Start and finish at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget
additional: A children’s race (Sparbanksloppet) of 800 m for children up to 10 years old, with a group start from Fiskaretorget at 18:30. Participants receive medals after finishing. A separate Sparbanksloppet of approximately 700 metres is offered for children up to 10 years old. Registration for the 2027 race opens on 1 May.
