pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!

name: Victorialoppet
description: Victorialoppet is a traditional running festival held every year in Borgholm on Öland. The event offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including a 9 km main race, the 4 km Victoriajoggen, the 2 km Lilla Victorialoppet, and Mini, a 1.5 km race for the youngest participants. The course is fast and easy to run, with beautiful views along the shore and an enthusiastic crowd creating a wonderful atmosphere. The event is a popular celebration, with music along the course and a strong commitment to the Crown Princess Victoria’s Fund.
course_highlights: Fast, easy-to-run 9 km course with views along the shore
Music at several locations along the course
Courses adapted for all ages and abilities
additional: Bib pickup takes place on race day from 10:00 to 18:00 at Borgholms Sporthall. Changing rooms and showers are available for men and boys at Borgholms Sporthall, and for women and girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Water is provided along the 9 km course, and there is music at several locations. Prizes are awarded in different categories, and participants receive medals, commemorative plaques, ice cream, and drinks, depending on the race. Timing uses disposable chips for most races; timing is optional for Victoriajoggen and the parasport categories. There are also parasport and youth categories. Water is available along the 9 km course, and changing rooms and showers are provided at Borgholms Sporthall and Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Fees vary depending on the race and registration date; an administration fee applies.

name: SUNSET Hamburg 2026
description: Altra Sunset Hamburg takes place in Wilhelmsburg Island Park. The event offers a scenic approx. 5 km loop course on asphalt and paths, which can be run 1 to 3 times, making distances of approx. 5 km, 10 km or 15 km possible. On the day of the event, participants can choose how many laps to run, with a checkpoint counting the laps. There is also a relay race, in which the course is run four times by teams of 2 to 4 runners. The event is open to anyone who is trained and has no medical concerns; club membership is not required.

name: Lauf um und am Gartower See
description: The run around and along Gartow Lake is a longstanding running event held on the lake’s north shore in Gartow. The course offers a natural setting with views of the lake and the surrounding Gartow pine forest, making it ideal for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the sports club SV Gartow, which has fostered sporting commitment and community in the region since 1946. The start and finish are centrally located in town, creating a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Kraftprovet
organizer: Trollhättans IF Friidrott och Trollhättans SOK
description: Kraftprovet is a classic city race in Trollhättan, offering a unique running experience along the canal area, with leafy paths, hilly terrain and beautiful views of the Göta älv, the locks and historic power stations. The race is a festival for everyone, with both elite runners and recreational runners taking part, while cheers from the crowd and music along the course add to the atmosphere. With more than 40 years of tradition, Kraftprovet brings the city, nature and people together during Fallens Dagar. There are several races to choose from, ranging from 800 metres to 11.6 kilometres, including a fun costume competition and an untimed Fun Run category.
course_highlights: The course follows the canal area, with varied and hilly terrain
Beautiful views of the Göta älv, the locks and historic power stations
Crowd support, music and a festive atmosphere along the entire course
additional: Start and finish at Hansenplatsen in Trollhättan. A race bib with your first name is available if you register by 30 June. A T-shirt can be ordered when registering by 15 May; it is included in some races and costs extra in others. Runners who finish in under 50 minutes (men) or 55 minutes (women) receive a silver medal. Pacers are available for finish times of 50, 55, 60 and 65 minutes. Costume competition with prizes before the start. Showers and changing facilities are available about 1 km from the finish at Arena Älvhögsborg. Water stations with Umara sports drink and water are available along the course.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://kraftprovet.se/deltagarinfo/): 2027-07-16 — "Datum 16 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-16)

name: Kölner Zoolauf
description: The Cologne Zoo Run is a unique running event at Cologne Zoo, taking place for the 13th time. It offers four different races for all age groups, from Bambini and children’s races to ambitious 10 km races. The course runs through the zoo and past numerous animal enclosures, making the run a special experience. Official timing and certificates are included for most races, and the event places great importance on safety and being family-friendly.
course_highlights: A 1.62 km loop through Cologne Zoo, with views of numerous animal enclosures
Option to run between 1 and 6 laps (1.6 km to 10.05 km)
Start and finish in front of the main entrance to Cologne Zoo
additional: Start times: Bambini Run 18:15, Kids Run 18:30, Top Run 19:00, Fun Run 20:15. A requested start number is available for an additional €3. Late entries are possible on site up to the day of the event, with a €5 late-entry fee. Participation with dogs, strollers, walking poles, or music devices is not permitted. Official timing is provided for all races except the Bambini Run. Certificates can be printed online. Safety and supervision of children in the start and finish area are organized. Four race types (Bambini, Kids, Top, Fun); online registration; no refunds for non-participation; participation requires a bib number and chip; participation with dogs or headphones is not permitted.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a 5-kilometer night race held on the shores of the Baltic Sea as part of IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, with city lights reflected on the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set off on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. The event has become an important and eagerly anticipated part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining athletic competition with the unique atmosphere of a night run.

name: Gårvikloppet
description: Gårvikloppet is a popular running race in Gårvik that began in 2016 and quickly became a success, with more than 100 participants of all ages. The race offers several categories and courses, from challenging tough courses to walking categories, making it accessible to everyone regardless of ability. The event is organized by the Badortsföreningen in collaboration with Dreambody gym and is known for its warm and inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Several courses and categories for different ability levels
Trail running in scenic Gårvik
Course records for 4 km and 8 km for both women and men
additional: The race has categories ranging from walking to elite level and welcomes participants of all ages. Course records are listed for 4 km and 8 km for both women and men. Previous results include 4 km and 8 km categories.

name: Lillesand Backyard Ultra
description: Lillesand Backyard Ultra is a backyard ultramarathon in Lillesand, where participants run repeated laps in a social, endurance-focused format. Previous editions have taken runners through central Lillesand, with the option to run more laps for as long as they have the strength. Join the running festival and see how long you can keep going.
course_highlights: Laps through central Lillesand
Backyard format with repeated laps
The opportunity to run for several hours and complete multiple laps
additional: Previous editions have been held in July.

name: Fiskekakeløpet
description: Fiskekakeløpet is a 12-kilometre road race in Risør, known as “the race that tastes of Risør”. The course takes participants through the town and onward towards Åmland and Viddefjell, before finishing at Holmen. It combines running with a local coastal atmosphere and the opportunity to socialise after the race.
course_highlights: 12 km on asphalt
The course passes through Solsiden, Krana, Frydendal and along Risørveien
Finish at Holmen after crossing the bridge
additional: Previous editions have started at Tollbua. After the race, participants have been able to go swimming, and a banquet has been held. Participants are responsible for buying their own fish cakes and beer.

name: OYLER Berglauf
description: The 27th Oyler Berglauf takes place as part of the sports festival week in Marklohe. Organized by Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle, this race offers a sporting challenge on Oyler Berg. The event is part of a varied sports program and is aimed at runners who want to experience a hilly course in a friendly club atmosphere. The exact course route and further details can be found on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Race on Oyler Berg
Venue: Sportplatz Oyle
Part of Sportwerbewoche 2026
additional: The organizer is Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle von 1953 e.V. No pricing or registration details have been published on the website, nor are there any start times or wave details. The event takes place as part of Sportwerbewoche 2026 at Sportplatz Oyle; no specific registration information is available.

name: 1. Stoppelfeld Ultra
description: In this special endurance format, it’s not about speed, but about completing a 6.706-kilometer lap within 60 minutes every hour and starting again promptly on the hour. The course mainly follows field and farm tracks around Blatzheim, starting and finishing at the Blatzheim sports field. The event is limited to 50 participants and promises a family atmosphere as well as a major mental and physical challenge.

name: 22. Wiesenlauf
description: The 22nd Wiesenlauf in Klein Meckelsen gives runners the opportunity to compete on officially measured and DLV-approved 5 km and 10 km courses. The event includes district championships over both distances and a regional championship over 5 km, with results counted from the M/W 14 age group. The start and finish are at the Klein Meckelsen sports field. The event is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants.

name: 4. Fachberg 100
description: The Fachberg 100 is a 100 km road race in Northeim, Germany, starting at 6:00 a.m. The course consists of 15 laps and a short out-and-back section, alternating between asphalt and dirt paths. Each lap includes about 75 meters of elevation gain, for a total elevation gain of 1,125 meters. This is a small ultrarunning event with limited entries and no entry fee; runners must bring their own refreshments.

name: Spendenlauf Recke
description: The Spendenlauf Recke is a charity event in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster. Organized by Andreas Egelkamp Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär GmbH & Co. KG and Lewe, a company from Recke, the event offers two distances: 5 kilometers for beginners and recreational runners, and 10 kilometers for experienced runners looking for a greater challenge. The focus is on joining forces for a good cause, with the entire entry fee donated. The event combines sporting commitment with social responsibility and invites everyone to take part and show their support.

name: 12. Nocny Portowy Maraton Szczeciński oraz 7. Nocny Portowy Półmaraton Szczeciński
description: The 12th Szczecin Night Port Marathon and the 7th Szczecin Night Port Half Marathon are unique night races held in Szczecin, taking runners through the city’s central streets, the port and the shipyard. The marathon course consists of two identical 42,195 m loops, while the half marathon covers 21,097 m; both courses are certified by the PZLA. The race starts at 23:00, creating a unique atmosphere in the city at night and allowing participants to admire Szczecin’s distinctive landmarks. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle and the West Pomerania region.
course_highlights: The course passes through the city centre, the port and the Szczecin Wulkan Shipyard grounds
Scenic viewpoints at Wały Chrobrego, with music and spectator support
Two identical marathon loops and distance markers every 1 km
additional: The time limit for both races is 6 hours. The start and finish are at the Florian Krygier Municipal Football Stadium. The marathon course consists of two identical loops, while the half marathon is one loop. There are refreshment stations and distance markers every 1 km along the course. Participants must follow the instructions of the event and safety personnel.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail running event held in the picturesque landscapes of the Elbląg Upland overlooking the Vistula Lagoon. The course follows wild trails with varied elevation and peaceful natural scenery, offering runners a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity in harmony with nature, and is aimed at both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support, and a generous race pack.
course_highlights: The wild natural landscapes of the Elbląg Upland, with picturesque hills
Routes through the Elbląg Upland Landscape Park and four forest nature reserves
Views of the Vistula Lagoon and historic sites, including Old Prussian hillforts and the Imperial Stone
additional: The race pack includes a waterproof race bib with a chip, medical support, course marking, aid stations, drinks and snacks at the finish, a commemorative medal, and a GPS tracker for the 81 km distance. Starts are staggered from 5:00 (81 km) to 10:30 (14 km), with separate Garmin Junior races for children. The system applies discounts when registering for more than one event in the series. The program also includes Garmin Junior races over 200 m, 500 m, and 1,000 m.

name: 2 Chojnicka Piątka
description: 1. Chojnicka Piątka is a road race held in Chojnice, attracting runners looking for sporting excitement and fun. The event takes place on Rybacka Street and offers plenty of attractions for participants. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness over a short distance and experience the atmosphere of a local sports celebration.
course_highlights: A road race in central Chojnice on Rybacka Street
A short 5 km distance, ideal for runners of all levels
The atmosphere of a local sports celebration with numerous attractions
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. It offers plenty of attractions for participants and spectators. The start and finish are on Rybacka Street in Chojnice.

name: Puchar Polski Nordic Walking - II etap
XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn
distance_verbose: Marathon, 28 km, Halve marathon, 14 km, 7.5 km
description: The Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn is a unique running event held on a summer evening through the shady forests of the Veluwe around Apeldoorn. The race offers five distances, ranging from 7.5 km to the full marathon of 42.195 km, with the start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos. The routes mostly follow wide Veluwe paths and forest trails across varied terrain with around 300 metres of elevation gain, making for a challenging and atmospheric experience. Start times are scheduled so that you run into the evening and finish well before sunset, giving the race a special summer ambience.
course_highlights: Run through the shady forests of the Veluwe
Varied terrain with around 300 metres of elevation gain and one-quarter unpaved
Start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos, with the finish in daylight
additional: All five distances start later in the day so you can run into the summer evening. The marathon has a time limit of 5 hours, and participants may bring their own cycling companion to provide support along the course. Parking is free and within walking distance of the start location. Registration includes a finisher’s medal and a Midzomer shirt. On the day, you can switch your entry to a shorter distance free of charge at the event office. The event also relies on volunteers to help with various tasks. Five distances: 7.5 km, 14 km, half marathon, 28 km and marathon; cycling companions are allowed for the half and full marathons; facilities include water and fruit stations, free parking and public transport connections.

name: Flughafenlauf Barth
description: The Barther Airport Run takes place at Stralsund-Barth Baltic Sea Airport and offers a varied program of seven events for runners and walkers of all ages. From short distances for young runners to the half-marathon, there is something for everyone. The event promises a morning full of activity, fun, and exciting races in a unique atmosphere right at the airport. Walkers are also very welcome, and refreshments are available on site.

name: Kaszubski Festiwal Biegowy VII Kaszubski Maraton o Wschodzie Słońca
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: The Kashubian Running Festival is a unique running event on a scenic course through the towns of Rozewie, Swarzewo, Jastrzębia Góra, and back to Rozewie. The festival offers a range of distances: a marathon, half marathon, and 15 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, so every runner, regardless of experience, can find a suitable course. The marathon starts at 04:35, allowing participants to experience the extraordinary atmosphere of sunrise over Kashubia. After the races, the organizers provide refreshments and a prize draw, creating a festive, social atmosphere.

name: Amsterdam Pride Run
description: The Amsterdam Pride Run is a colorful and inclusive running event held during the Pride Amsterdam festivities. Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports, it offers a sporting celebration of diversity and equality. The run takes place in the city of Amsterdam and attracts a broad range of runners and supporters who come together to support the LGBTQ+ community. The atmosphere is festive and unifying, with an emphasis on sportsmanship and inclusion.
course_highlights: Running route through central Amsterdam
Inclusive and festive atmosphere during Pride Amsterdam
Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports
additional: The Amsterdam Pride Run takes place in the afternoon during Pride Amsterdam, with an entry fee ranging from €8 to €18. The event is part of a broader program of queer sports activities organized by Pride and Sports. It has a festive and safe atmosphere, with an emphasis on inclusion and sportsmanship. Route through Flevopark and along the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal; several race options, including a walk and a business run; a colorful and inclusive event during World Pride

name: 34. Lippesee Marathon
location: Lippesee, Paderborn-Sande, Paderborn, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 34th Lippesee Marathon in Paderborn-Sande is a private marathon run held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, around Lippesee, a popular recreational area and water sports center. Participants must provide their own refreshments, as there are no aid stations, and record their time manually. A photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof. The event is designed for experienced runners aged 18 and over, with a limit of 18 participants, and takes place only if at least five people register.

name: Blefjells Beste
description: Blefjells Beste is a trail race on Blefjell that passes several of the most beautiful places on Store-Ble. The race offers distances of 92, 53, 24, 10 and 5 km, and is a social, informal event for everyone who enjoys being outdoors in the forest and mountains. The start and finish are at Bestebu, a private cabin at Klengstøl. The courses are mainly on trails and mountain terrain, with the final kilometres on gravel roads. Participants must carry all their own food, drink and equipment, as there are no food or drink stations along the way.
course_highlights: Trail race with distances of 92, 53, 24, 10 and 5 km
The courses are mainly on trails and mountain terrain, with 150 to 3,150 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the Bestebu cabin at Klengstøl, along Store-Bleveien
additional: The Storetroll course (92 km) consists of completing the other distances—53+24+10+5 km—in sequence. For the 92 km race, there are time limits for passing through the event area: after 1 lap (53 km) by Saturday at 12:00, and after 2 laps (53 + 24 km) by Saturday at 18:00. The 53 km and 24 km courses are not marked by the organiser, while the 5 km and 10 km courses are well marked. Name changes cost 150 kr for the 92, 53 and 24 km distances, and are free for the 10 and 5 km distances. The race requires participants to respect wild reindeer and leave no litter. There are no food or drink stations along the way, but clean water is normally easy to find in the mountains. Participants must carry their own food, drink and equipment; there are no food or drink stations. The event is listed for 23–24 July 2027, with registration opening on 1 December 2026.

name: Bokeler Windmühlenlauf
description: The 20th Bokeler Windmühlenlauf takes place in Bokel. This traditional anniversary race is organized by ALG-VfL Bokel. Participation is limited to 300 people, and registration is through the RaceResult platform. The race offers runners a special atmosphere in the region and is a popular event for endurance and athletics enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Various race distances (5 km, 10 km, children's race)
Local club atmosphere
Limited to 300 runners
additional: Places are limited to 300 people. The organizational fee covers provision costs and is non-refundable, including in cases of force majeure.

name: Fun-Lauf "Durch den Wewerschen Wald"
description: The 33rd Fun Run “Through the Wewerschen Forest” in Paderborn is a community run with no timing and no entry fee. The event supports children in need through many thousands of steps and asks participants to make a donation instead. The runs take place on flat circuits with little elevation gain and are suitable for everyone. Competitions for children and teenagers are also offered.
course_highlights: Flat circuit (one lap)
Little elevation gain (30 to 40 metres uphill)
Distance options: 5 km and 7 km
additional: Run with no timing and no entry fee; participants are instead asked to make a donation. Competitions for children and teenagers are available. The finish location is not publicly displayed (RUNME Premium required). Runs on flat circuits, various distances, no timing, no entry fee, donations for charitable causes.

name: 13. Heilwald Marathon
description: The Heilwald Marathon in Bad Lippspringe is a special race held in the heart of the 200-hectare Heilwald, a unique therapeutic and recreational forest in Europe with a soothing low-mountain climate. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and has been carefully measured using a measuring wheel and GPS. This is a private, self-supported race. Times are recorded manually, and a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participants take part at their own risk. There is no entry fee; instead, voluntary donations for tree planting are welcome.

name: 38. Heiligenhafen Mitternachtslauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 20,- EURO in der Online-Voranmeldung für alle Teilnehmer.

description: Der Heiligenhafen Mitternachtslauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf, der jährlich in Heiligenhafen stattfindet. Die Hauptstrecke führt über 10 km durch die Stadt und rund um den Binnensee, mit Start und Ziel auf dem Sportplatz Lütjenburger Weg. Neben dem klassischen 10-km-Lauf gibt es auch kürzere Wettbewerbe für Jugendliche, Kinder und einen Binnenseelauf über ca. 5,5 km. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine besondere Atmosphäre mit viel Unterstützung an der Strecke und einem Start spät am Abend, der den Lauf zu einem besonderen Erlebnis macht.
course_highlights: 10 km Rundkurs durch Heiligenhafen mit Blick auf den Binnensee
Strecke führt an der Uferpromenade, Ferienpark und Seebrücke vorbei
Leichte Steigungen und Gefälle, Start und Ziel auf dem Sportplatz
additional: Es gibt mehrere Wettbewerbe: Mini-Mitternachtslauf (1 km) für Kinder, Mitternachtslauf-Doppelmeile (3,2 km) für Jugendliche, Binnenseelauf (ca. 5,5 km) und den klassischen 10-km-Lauf. Nachmeldungen sind am Lauftag ab 18 Uhr auf dem Sportplatz gegen eine Nachmeldegebühr möglich. Die Zeitnahme erfolgt elektronisch mit Transponder ohne Leihgebühr, bei Verlust wird eine Gebühr von 15 Euro erhoben. Die Teilnehmerzahl ist auf 1250 Läufer begrenzt.

name: Hornsjön Runt
description: Hornsjön Runt is a traditional running race around Öland’s only inland lake, through beautiful and varied Öland nature. The race offers several distances for both young people and adults, including a walking category. Along the course, participants pass gravel roads with limestone surfaces, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: The course goes around Öland’s only inland lake
Varied terrain including gravel roads, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes
Three water stations along the course, as well as at the start/finish
additional: A walking category is available for 5.5 km and 11 km, with start times between 13:00 and 16:00 and no timing. Shower and changing facilities are available at Högby Idrottsplats. Prizes are awarded to the top three in all categories. The start and finish are at Pensionat Hornsjön. Youth categories have different start times from 15:30 to 16:00, depending on age and distance. There are distances for children and young people, as well as a walking category without timing.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/hornsjon-runt/): 2027-07-24 — "Tid & datum 24 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Bjäre Trail
price_range: 195–425 kr (2026 års ordinarie tidiga anmälningsavgifter; priser för 2027 ej bekräftade)
description: Bjäre Trail is a challenging trail race featuring varied terrain through grazing pastures, old railway embankments and dense beech forests with rushing waterfalls. Runners face steep hills, including an old ski slope, and are rewarded with spectacular views of Laholmsbukten, the northern side of the Bjäre Peninsula and the Halland coastline. The race is held at Båstad Företagsby and welcomes both experienced trail runners and nature lovers looking for a tough, scenic course.
course_highlights: Highly varied terrain with grazing pastures and an old railway embankment
Dense beech forests with rushing waterfalls
Steep hills with views of Laholmsbukten and the Bjäre Peninsula
additional: Maximum 300 starters. Late entries are accepted on site on race day for an additional fee of 100 kr, payable only in even-numbered cash amounts or by SWISH. Bibs must be collected no later than one hour before the start at the start/finish area, or at Bjäre bär’s farm shop on Friday. Toilets are available at Företagsbyn, but there are no changing rooms or showers. Everyone who finishes receives a wooden plaque; winners in each class receive raspberries sponsored by Bjäre bär. Distances are 12, 17, 34 and 51 km. The 34 km and 51 km races consist of two and three laps respectively of the 17 km loop. The race information states a maximum of 300 participants.

name: ÖTILLÖ Gothenburg
description: ÖTILLÖ Swimrun Gothenburg is a unique swimrun race held at the height of summer in Gothenburg’s beautiful archipelago. The race is rooted in a strong local swimrun tradition and features a spectacular course with numerous swims and varied running terrain across islands and rocks. The event is easy to reach by ferry from the mainland and offers a fantastic combination of nature experiences and spectator support. It is a perfect race for both experienced swimrunners and curious participants who want to experience the sport in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: A combination of fast running sections and intense swims
A course through the West Coast archipelago of Gothenburg, with many islands and islets
Magnificent coastal and archipelago scenery, with plenty of spectators along the course
additional: The race offers three distances: World Series (approx. 39.7 km with 29 running sections and 28 swims), Sprint (approx. 22.8 km with 18 running sections and 17 swims), and Experience. The start and finish are at Styrsö Bratten. Ferries run regularly from Saltholmen and Stenpiren to the event area. Mandatory equipment is available to buy at the start/finish area. A large team of volunteers helps out along the course and at the event. The awards ceremony takes place after the race. Check-in is at Styrsöskolan. The event offers the Experience, Sprint, and World Series distances.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://otilloswimrun.com/races/gothenburg-sweden/gothenburg-world-series/): 2027-07-24 — "saturday, July 24th, 2027 ... 08:11 Start World Series" (was estimated 2027-07-31)

name: Kil till Skutberget
description: Kil till Skutberget följer vandringsleden mellan Kil och Skutberget i Karlstad, en sträcka på cirka 22 kilometer. Leden går genom varierad värmländsk natur och passerar Sörmon, Högemon och Kilsravinerna. Ett naturnära lopp som tar deltagarna från Kil mot Vänerns strand vid Skutberget.
course_highlights: Cirka 22 kilometer mellan Kil och Skutberget i Karlstad.
Leden passerar naturområdena Sörmon och Högemon.
Sträckan går genom Kilsravinerna och avslutas nära Vänern.

name: Kyststien Trail Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Preliminärt pris for løpet 2027 er 500 kr pluss eventuelt 100 kr for transport.

description: Kyststien Trail Ultra is an unforgettable 50 km ultramarathon along the Coastal Trail from Helgeroa to Gon Camping. The race offers varied terrain, including idyllic sandy beaches, technical trails along cliffs and coves, and spectacular panoramic views of the sea and lush countryside. It is a challenge that requires good preparation, with demanding climbs and descents, but also offers the joy of running and a wonderful sense of community among participants. The race celebrates nature and a passion for running, and encourages respect for the surroundings.
course_highlights: 50 km along the Coastal Trail over varied terrain: sand, grass, mountains, stairs, rocks, roots and gravel
Spectacular panoramic views of the sea, cliffs and lush countryside
Technical coastal trails with demanding climbs and descents
additional: Race bibs can be collected the evening before or on race day. The finish at Gonhytta offers water, drinks, snacks and hot soup. Prizes for the top 3 women and men, plus a race-bib raffle. All finishers receive a locally made birch medal. There is an opportunity to take a free hot shower and a cold sea swim. The race has 5 staffed aid stations with first aid, toilets, drinks and snacks. The course is marked with blue blazes and additional signs; a GPX file is recommended for navigation. Maximum 180 participants; a waiting list will be available if the race fills up. The start is at Blokkebukta camping, with the finish at Gonhytta at Gon Camping. Participants are provided with refreshments and a free hot shower, and all finishers receive a medal made from local birch.

name: 10. NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf
price_range: 25 EUR für Erwachsene, 20 EUR für Kids
description: The NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf is a maritime race held annually on the North Sea island of Norderney since 2016. The event offers a unique running experience surrounded by the island’s natural scenery and a special atmosphere. The routes pass through the historic Kurplatz and by landmarks such as the Napoleonschanze, the Schwanenteich and the island windmill. The race is suitable for all age groups, with distances ranging from the Bambini Run to the half marathon.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Kurplatz, with the Conversationshaus and Badehaus
Passing the Napoleonschanze, Norderney’s oldest monument
Run through the lively shopping streets, with spectators cheering
additional: The official technical shirt can be ordered during registration and is handed out with the race materials. The shirt costs 25 EUR for adults and 20 EUR for children. Timing is provided by ChampionChip; chip rental costs between 3 and 5 EUR, depending on the race. A preferred bib number is available for an additional 3 EUR. Cut-off times: 1:15h for 10 km and 2:30h for the half marathon. Island and maritime theme, sustainable technical shirt, on-site registration, online results, ferry connections for participants, test run on the day before the race, certificates and medals for children

name: 6. GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon
description: The GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon is a 50 km trail run starting in Kaltenweide, Langenhagen, Germany. The route has a modest elevation gain of about 350 meters and must be completed within 8 hours. The course passes through forest and trail sections, by Brelinger Berg with its geological nature trail, and back along Bissendorfer Moor. The event is registered with the German Ultramarathon Association and offers online results, certificates, and finisher medals.

name: FriesenCross
description: The Friesencross in Schillig is one of Germany’s most extraordinary cross-country running events. The route runs directly along the beach and offers a unique natural experience beside the Wadden Sea UNESCO World Heritage Site. Runners cross soft sandy beaches, green meadows and even the muddy seabed, combining a sporting challenge with the unmistakable atmosphere of the North Sea. Running sports presenter Heino Krüger accompanies the event and guides participants through the day with his extensive experience. The Friesenfestival takes place alongside the race, adding entertainment, music and culinary highlights.

name: Mulsumer Speckenlauf
location: Mulsum, Wurster Nordseeküste, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: Der Mulsumer Speckenlauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die vom TSV Mulsum v. 1919 e.V. organisiert wird. Die Veranstaltung findet im Rahmen der Sportwoche statt und bietet Läufe für Kinder über 450 m und 900 m sowie für Erwachsene über 5,3 km und 10 km. Die Strecke führt über Schotter, Feldwege und Asphaltstraßen und ist bekannt als „Die Hölle von Mulsum“. Für das leibliche Wohl ist gesorgt, und jeder Teilnehmer erhält eine Urkunde.
course_highlights: Streckenführung über Schotter, Feldweg und Asphaltstraße
Kinderläufe über 450 m und 900 m
Erwachsenenläufe über 5,3 km und 10 km mit geänderter 10-km-Strecke wegen Brückensperrung
additional: Start ist vom Sportplatz in Mulsum. Die Kinderläufe starten um 14:00 Uhr, die Erwachsenenläufe um 15:00 Uhr. Für Mitglieder des TSV Mulsum ist die Teilnahme kostenfrei. Nachmeldungen sind bis 45 Minuten vor dem Start vor Ort möglich. Es gibt eine Siegerehrung mit Urkunden für alle Finisher. Die Veranstaltung ist Teil der Laufsammler Aktion.

name: 26. Bieg Dookoła Morynia i Jeziora Morzycko
description: Join us for the 26th edition of the Run Around Moryń and Lake Morzycko, a unique event combining sporting competition with the beauty of Western Pomerania. The course follows a scenic route around Lake Morzycko, offering participants unforgettable views and a sense of sporting community. It’s a great opportunity for runners and fans of an active lifestyle to meet in Moryń and enjoy exercising outdoors. Whatever your experience level, there’s something here for everyone.

name: 24 Bieg Uliczny św. Jakuba
description: The 24th Energa St. James’s Run is an annual running event held in Lębork to celebrate the city’s patron saint. The certified 10 km course runs through the city streets, with appropriate safety measures provided by the services responsible for order. The ceremonial start takes place at Peace Square, and the official start is on Armii Krajowej Street. Participants must obey traffic regulations. The first 600 finishers will receive a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course
Runs through the streets of Lębork
Ceremonial start at Peace Square; official start on Armii Krajowej Street
additional: 7:00–9:00 at the Race Office in the gymnasium of the Special Educational Centre in Lębork, at Curie-Skłodowskiej Street. Participants under 18 from Lębork County are exempt from the entry fee upon presenting a valid student ID. The first 600 finishers will receive a commemorative medal. A contest for the best cheering zone will be held, with a prize of PLN 1,000.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – summer edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of its courses, offering picturesque and attractive routes for runners. It’s a great opportunity to combine sport with the beauty of nature and enjoy an active day in Gdynia.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque routes
Routes with scenic and natural appeal
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts
additional: Botaniczna Piątka has organized races and sporting events since 2014.

name: Hel - Rysy
location: Hel, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Moore DRV Run Maasdijk
description: The Moore DRV Run Maasdijk is a friendly running race in the Westland, held during the Zomerspektakel in Maasdijk. The main distance is 10 kilometres on a traffic-free, fast asphalt course through the polder and along iconic dikes. There is also a 5 km race, the 5 van DAEL, and a youth run for children up to 12 years old. After the finish, participants receive an original running shirt and excellent refreshments at the atmospheric finish field.
course_highlights: Traffic-free course through the polder and along dikes
Entirely paved, fast asphalt course with water stations
Iconic finish location in the village of Maasdijk
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day from 10:30 at the canteen of korfbalvereniging Dijkvogels, Lange Kruisweg 44F in Maasdijk. The 5 km starts at 14:00, followed by the 10 km at 14:10. Changing and shower facilities are available at the korfbalvereniging. Results are recorded using a SAW chip, which costs €4.50 as a one-time fee and is not included in the entry fee. The youth run takes place without a chip. The race is held during the Zomerspektakel in Maasdijk and offers a friendly atmosphere for all ages, including youth activities and special keepsakes for participants.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The Volkswandertag in Bollensen is an annual event held on the last Sunday in July, open to hikers of all ages. A range of family-friendly routes takes participants along forest trails through the beautiful Solling region. The marathon and half-marathon hikes are circular routes starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports hall. All routes are marked and have refreshment stations. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with food and drinks in the finish area and a strong sense of community.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
location: Dąbki, Gmina Darłowo, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Seaside Spa Run is an annual running event held in Dąbki, promoting running as a simple form of exercise and a healthy lifestyle. The 10 km race is part of a larger sporting event that also includes races for children and young people and the Spa Nautical Mile. The event is family-friendly and recreational, and also aims to promote the Dąbki Spa and the Darłowo Municipality. It is organized by the Darłowo Municipality Office and the Seaside Spa Run Association, with support from numerous partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: 10 km course
The race takes place in the seaside town of Dąbki
Side events include the Spa Nautical Mile and races for children
additional: The event also includes the Spa Nautical Mile, covering 1,852 m, and races for children and young people over distances from 150 m to 1,100 m. The event is family-friendly and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland
organizer: Botaniczna Piątka; współorganizatorem edycji letniej jest Ogrody Przelewice
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The organizers place particular emphasis on the aesthetic appeal of the proposed routes, making the race attractive to nature lovers and those who enjoy active recreation. It’s a great opportunity to combine a passion for running with a unique green setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Dendrological Garden in Przelewice
Picturesque, aesthetically pleasing natural surroundings
A race amid unique plant life and greenery
additional: The event is organized by a group of running enthusiasts that has been active since 2014, specializing in cross-country races and paying close attention to the aesthetics of the locations. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrated its 10th anniversary. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, entry fees, or additional services. In the previous summer edition, participants received a commemorative medal.

name: V Bursztynowy Półmaraton Jantar
location: Jantar, Gmina Stegna, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: ATEA Kalmarmilen
description: ATEA Kalmarmilen är ett etablerat millopp i Kalmar för både motionärer och elitlöpare. Banan går genom stadsmiljöer och längs välkända platser i Kalmar, med start vid Teatervallen och målgång på Larmtorget. I anslutning till loppet arrangeras även Lilla ATEA Kalmarmilen för barn i olika åldersklasser.
course_highlights: Start vid Teatervallen och målgång på Larmtorget
Banan passerar Kalmar slott och Gamla stan
Sträckningen går även via hamnen, Fredrikskans, Lindö och Ängö
additional: Lilla ATEA Kalmarmilen erbjuder barnlopp i olika åldersklasser. Loppet har även DM/VDM-status för Östsvenska och ingår i I Run Kalmar-raceserien.

name: 43. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a private marathon run held under the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large loops of 6.10 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is marked with arrows or barrier tape depending on the weather. The event emphasizes self-sufficiency, as runners pass their cars after each loop. Marathon times are recorded with a handheld stopwatch, and a certificate is sent by email. Participants must be at least 18 years old. There is no entry fee, but a voluntary donation of €5 is requested.

name: 4 PolandRockowy Bieg Policz się z cukrzy...
location: Broczyno, Czaplinek, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 39e Kooyman Polderloop
description: The Kooyman Polderloop is an annual running race in De Kwakel, organized by Atletiek Vereniging Aalsmeer. This popular race takes place during a beautiful summer of sport and attracts many participants, including many AVA members. The event offers an enjoyable, sporty evening with a challenging course through the polder landscape. It is a fixture in the region and is known for its friendly, accessible atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the distinctive polder landscape
Evening race with a sporty, welcoming atmosphere
Organized by the local athletics club, AVA Aalsmeer
additional: The start is usually at AVA, Sportlaan 43, Aalsmeer. There is a sociable post-race gathering with coffee or tea in the clubhouse. The club also organizes walking groups and running courses, strengthening the sporting community. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl; the event is part of the Polderfeest, which features activities such as food festivals, performances, and family activities over several days.

name: Kvitfjell Stuttlaup
description: Kvitfjell Stuttlaup is a 13-kilometre trail race featuring technical trails and varied terrain in beautiful Kvitfjell. The race starts at Kvitfjelleggen and finishes at Tyrihanstunet, with approximately 240 metres of elevation gain. Known for its challenging and fun trails, the race is part of Lauparfestivalen, which also includes several other races and activities. Participants can look forward to a great mountain running experience, a lively atmosphere and the option to buy food in the finish area.
course_highlights: 13 km with approximately 8 km of trail and 5 km of gravel road
Technical and fun trail on the west side of Svinåa
240 metres of elevation gain over varied terrain
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 11:00 at the start. There is a drinks and food station at Svinslåvangen after 8.5 km. Parking is not available at the start. Recommended parking locations are Skitorget, by Tyrihans, along the roads towards the top (west side), or at Gudbrandsgard Hotel (east side). Carpooling is organised, with participants meeting at 10:00 in the parking area at the bottom of Vestsideløypa. Food can be purchased from Tyrihanstunet in the finish area. The race does not provide sports drinks or gels, in order to keep the event simple and affordable. The festival website lists the event as 24–25 July, which does not match the stated race date of 30 July 2027.

name: Kvitfjell Langlaup
description: Kvitfjell Running Festival offers three challenging races through varied terrain in Ringebu, Innlandet. Kvitfjell Opp is a brutal uphill race up the Olympic downhill course, climbing 838 metres over 3.2 km. Langlaupet is a 25 km long-distance race with 19 km of trail and 6.5 km of road, offering an extra challenge for those who want more after the uphill race. Stuttlaupet is a 13 km race with technical trails and gravel roads, perfect for those looking for a shorter but challenging mountain run. All races finish at Tyrihanstunet, where good food and a social atmosphere are also on offer.
course_highlights: Kvitfjell Opp: 3.2 km uphill race climbing 838 metres up the Olympic downhill course
Langlaupet: 25 km through varied terrain, with 19 km of trail and 6.5 km of gravel road; highest point approximately 1,100 metres above sea level
Stuttlaupet: 13 km with approximately 8 km of trail and 5 km of gravel road; a technical and enjoyable course
additional: Race bibs are distributed at the start of each race. Kvitfjell Opp starts by the lift at the bottom, while Langlaupet and Stuttlaupet start from Kvitfjelleggen behind the summit café. There are refreshment stations along Langlaupet and Stuttlaupet, as well as a refreshment station on Kvitfjell Opp at the mid-station. For Kvitfjell Opp, parking is recommended at the mid-station; for Langlaupet and Stuttlaupet, parking is recommended at Skitorget or Gudbrandsgard Hotel. A children’s race starts at 13:00 on Saturday during the festival, with a medal and drink at the finish. Talks and an after-run event are also part of the festival. Langlaupet is part of Kvitfjell Running Festival, which also includes Kvitfjell Opp and Stuttlaupet. Weather conditions can change in the mountains.

name: Kvitfjell Lauparfestival 2027
description: Kvitfjell Running Festival 2027 takes place in Kvitfjell from 27 to 31 July 2027. The festival offers a varied programme of sport and culture, with tickets available through EQ Timing. The event starts early in the day and continues until late in the evening, offering participants a great experience in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Kvitfjell Uphill follows the former Olympic downhill course up the mountain.
The approximately 25 km long-distance race traverses varied terrain, including trails and gravel roads.
The short race offers a shorter 13 km trail-running distance.
additional: Tickets are sold through EQ Timing. The event runs from early morning until late evening. It takes place in Kvitfjell, with a map and directions available on the website. The programme also includes an uphill race for children, talks at Tyrihanstunet, and an after-run.

name: 07. Stadtholz Marathon
description: The Stadtholz Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a run at Heideteich, with a 6.14 km trail per lap. The event is not competition-focused, but is aimed at runners who enjoy running in nature. The marathon is being held to mark Evi Köppe-Neeb’s linen wedding anniversary and offers a special atmosphere at Heideteich. The course features natural trails and a peaceful setting.

name: Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf
description: The Springe-Deister Summer Run features a measured 5 km loop at the foot of the Kleiner Deister. The course is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), so results can be included in rankings. Kilometer markers are clearly signposted, and the course is gently undulating, with an elevation difference of approximately 20 meters. The race starts at 5:45 p.m. at Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe and is aimed at runners looking for an attractive, officially sanctioned running event in the region.

name: Falkenbergs Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 450 kr fram till och med 20:e juli 2027

description: Falkenberg City Run is a 10 km city race that takes you through central Falkenberg and its beautiful summer scenery. The race is a community celebration and a running highlight in Halland, welcoming both beginners and experienced runners. The course is fast and easy to run, with fantastic crowd support along the way. The start and finish are both at Falkenberg Sports Ground, creating a smooth and enjoyable overall experience for participants.
course_highlights: 10 km through central Falkenberg and its beautiful summer scenery
Fast, easy-to-run course with two water stations along the way
Start and finish at Falkenberg Sports Ground, with good facilities and crowd support
additional: Warm-up takes place at 11:40 in the start area with Nordic Wellness. The prize ceremony takes place at 13:00 in the finish area. Race bibs can be collected at Team Sportia on the Thursday and Friday before the race, and on race day from 9:00. Changing rooms and bag drop are available on race day. Massage is available in the finish area after the race. Falkenberg City Run is the 2027 district championship and is part of Tour de Falkenberg. Start groups are marked with flags according to runners’ self-estimated kilometre times for safety. The kiosk is open 10:00–14:00. There are two water stations on the course, at 3 km and 8 km, as well as one at the finish.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.falkenbergsstadslopp.se/anmalan/): 2027-07-31 — "I år anordnas loppet den 31 juli 2027." (was estimated 2027-07-24)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: I år anordnas loppet den 31 juli 2027.

name: Bruksleden Terrängmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Sista dag för ordinarie anmälan är fredagen den 17 juli.

description: Bruksleden Trail Marathon is a trail race organised by Fagersta OK, offering two distances: 42 km (Helan) and 21 km (Halvan). The race follows the beautiful Bruksleden Trail through forests, winding paths and past lakes, across varied and technically demanding terrain. With a limited number of 200 places, the event has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. Along the course, staffed checkpoints offer refreshments, and after the finish there are showers and a light meal. This is a perfect race for experienced trail runners and curious recreational runners alike who want to enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Run through beautiful forests and along winding forest trails
Pass sparkling lakes
Varied and technically demanding terrain with steep climbs and descents
additional: Places are limited to 200 to preserve a friendly atmosphere. Previous editions have started and finished in the area around Fageråsen/Fagersta.

name: PRB (Växjö)
description: PRB is a challenging and tactical running race where participants run a 6,706-metre course, with a start every hour on the hour. To continue in the race, runners must start each lap, in accordance with last-man-standing rules and Backyard Ultra standards. The course is easy to run and varied, with asphalt and gravel/trail sections. It is located on the southern shore of Lake Trummen in Växjö, with good opportunities to rest and access services in the lap area. Participants can enjoy a scenic setting close to a playground, skatepark, swimming area and café. After completing at least one lap, runners receive a medal and a finisher beer as a reward.
course_highlights: 6,706-metre course with approximately 35 metres of elevation gain
Each lap has approximately 3 km of asphalt, with the rest on gravel/trail
Starts every hour on the hour, with all participants starting together
additional: The lap area offers an energy table with sports drink, water, Coca-Cola, coffee, sweets, crisps and fruit. A cooked meal is served every six hours, starting after four hours. There is space to set up a reclining chair and a small tent. Recommended parking costs 10 kr/day and is located at ICA Kvantum Teleborg. Littering results in immediate disqualification. The nearest bus stop is Trummenvägen by ICA, served by route 3. Backyard Ultra format, with a start every hour on the hour and last-man-standing rules. A previous edition was described as a Silver Ticket event.

name: HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf, 46. Int. Volkslauf mit HM
description: The HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf in Duisburg is a traditional fun run with a flat course along the Rhine. Events include 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km, and the half marathon (21.1 km). The flat course makes the race appealing to runners of all abilities. All events share the same finish area, and the event offers a pleasant atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Rhine
Events over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km, and the half marathon
All events finish at the same location
additional: Start times: 7.5 km walking at 15:00, 5 km run at 16:50, 10 km run at 17:40, half marathon at 17:30. All events take place on a flat course. Results will be published on the RUNME results page. Results are available shortly after the race finishes. The event is especially appealing in good weather.

name: Sechs-Std.-Lauf am Förderturm Bönen
location: Ehemaliges Zechengelände, Bönen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Six-Hour Run at the Bönen Headframe is a unique ultrarunning event held on an officially measured loop course at a former colliery site. The course is traffic-free, gently undulating, and consists of asphalt and compact gravel. The event offers comprehensive refreshments, including vegan options, and professional lap counting via race result. With a minimum age of 20, the run is aimed at experienced ultrarunners who want to test their endurance in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop course at a former colliery site, traffic-free
Lap length: 1,340 m; surface: asphalt and compact gravel
Officially measured course with gentle undulations
additional: Race bib pickup on event day from 07:00 to 08:30. Showers and changing facilities are available at the nearby Goethe Sports Hall and in the Förderturm Shaft Hall (not supervised; no liability is accepted). A variety of food and drinks, including vegan options, will be provided before and during the run. Laps are counted electronically via race result, with measurement of the remaining distance. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross local branch in Bönen (DRK-Ortsverein Bönen e.V.). Awards ceremony at approximately 16:00. Minimum age: 20. Maximum 200 participants; on-site registration is possible for a €10 fee. Loop course at a former colliery site, vegan refreshments, race bib pickup 07:00–08:30, minimum age 20.

name: Markttagelauf
description: The Markttage Run in Bredstedt is an international charity run, with entry fees donated to a good cause. There are different distances for children, beginners and experienced runners, taking them through Bredstedt town centre. The event fosters a sense of community and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups. Registration is online, and entry fees are moderate to make it possible for as many people as possible to take part.
course_highlights: Different routes for children, beginners and experienced runners
Run through Bredstedt town centre
International run for a good cause
additional: Registration online only until 30.07. at www.my.raceresult.com. Note: The event information PDF is currently not accessible.

name: 18. Ottonenlauf
description: The Ottonenlauf is a scenic race in the Harz that brings runners from three different villages to a shared finish in Quedlinburg, a UNESCO World Heritage city. The 21.1 km, 42.2 km, and 69 km routes start in Stiege, Alexisbad, and Meisdorf, respectively. The route runs mostly along forest and woodland trails through the Selke Valley, with shaded forests, rural sections, and moderate climbs that call for a good pace. Walking and Nordic walking options are also available, making the event open to a wide range of participants. Electronic timing and finisher medals round out the event.

name: 24. Hella Marathon Nacht
description: The hella marathon night rostock is an atmospheric sunset run set against the picturesque backdrop of the Haedgehalbinsel in Rostock’s city harbor. The event offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 km, and a children’s race. All start at dusk and finish in a brightly lit finish area. The route passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, and is kept traffic-free. The event combines a sporting challenge with Northern German hospitality and a holiday atmosphere.

name: adidas Runners City Night
description: Die adidas Runners City Night in Berlin ist ein sommerliches Sporthighlight, das Laufen und Inlineskating mit einer großen Party verbindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet Strecken über 5 km und 10 km Laufen sowie 10 km Inlineskating durch die belebte City West und den Kurfürstendamm. Livebands, Cheering Zones und begeisterte Zuschauer sorgen für eine einzigartige Atmosphäre, die mit einem leuchtenden Zieltor an der Kaiser-Wilhelm-Gedächtniskirche endet. Die Teilnehmer erhalten eine im Dunkeln leuchtende Medaille als Erinnerung an dieses besondere Event.
course_highlights: Strecke führt mitten durch die City West und den Kurfürstendamm
Livebands und Cheering Points entlang der Strecke, besonders am Adenauerplatz
Start und Ziel an der Kaiser-Wilhelm-Gedächtniskirche
additional: Die Zeitmessung erfolgt mit einem Transponder auf der Rückseite der Startnummer. Die 5-km-Strecke hat nur einen Wendepunkt und verläuft schnurgerade auf dem Kurfürstendamm. Der 10-km-Lauf hat ein Zeitlimit von 1:30 Stunden. Die Medaille leuchtet im Dunkeln. Eine personalisierte Medaillengravur kann bei der Anmeldung hinzugebucht werden.

name: hella marathon nacht rostock
description: The hella marathon nacht rostock is an atmospheric sunset run along the Warnow, with a maritime flair and Hanseatic hospitality. The event takes place in August in Rostock and offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 and a students’ run. The start and finish are at Rostock’s city harbor, where runners set off at dusk and finish beneath bright lights. The course passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, making for a unique running experience.

name: Hemfurth-Edersee-Abendlauf
description: The Hemfurth-Edersee Evening Run is a traditional late-summer race that brings runners of all ages together in the beautiful surroundings of Edertal-Hemfurth. In pleasant temperatures and as the sun sets, the focus is on the joy of movement and a sense of community. At the finish, participants can enjoy refreshments, good music, and a sociable get-together in a relaxed atmosphere. The race is organized by volunteers from TSV 08 Hemfurth-Edersee e.V. and is a popular event for ambitious runners, recreational joggers, and families.

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994, as an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. It is a major sporting event of the summer on the coast, attracting over 1,200 runners and tens of thousands of spectators, and offering a unique atmosphere in the city’s historic center. The course is a 1,412-meter loop along the streets of Gdańsk’s Old Town, with the start and finish by Neptune’s Fountain. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration, and also offers a rich program of accompanying events, including concerts and shows.
course_highlights: A 1,412 m course in central Gdańsk, with the start and finish by Neptune’s Fountain
A loop along Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników, Podwale Przedmiejskie and other streets
Incredible support from over 25,000 spectators along the course
additional: The event includes four races under the shared slogan “Chase St. Dominic”: the Prologue, open to all St. Dominic’s Fair participants; the 5 km Women’s Run Lotto Cup; the 5 km Men’s Run Energa Cup; and the Men’s Elite Run, the Polish 10 km Championships. The event takes place as part of the Running Festival, with a rich program of accompanying activities, including partner booths, presentations and Fair concerts.

name: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne
description: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne is a trail race offering several distances, with the start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala, Hässleholm. The races follow beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves, with a focus on minimizing asphalt and traffic exposure for a more immersive and technical running experience. TGS 60 consists of two laps (35+25 km), while TGS 35 and TGS 25 correspond to the first and second laps of the 60 km race, respectively. TGS 10 is a shorter distance that follows approximately the final 10 km of the longer races. Runners of all levels are welcome to enjoy the forest and the challenges of trail running.
course_highlights: Run on beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves
Less than 3 km on asphalt and only one major road crossing
Technical, nature-focused course with varied terrain
additional: TGS 60 has a lap point at 35.1 km, with a cutoff time of 13:30. Aid stations with food, water, cola and sports drink are located at several points along the course. The maximum time limit for TGS 60 is 9 hours and 15 minutes. The finish closes at 17:00 for TGS 35 and TGS 25. TGS 10 starts at 13:45. All distances start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala. The race offers a technical, nature-focused experience with minimal asphalt and traffic exposure. The distances are approximately 10.2 km, 26.6 km, 35.1 km and 61.7 km. For the 2026 edition, free parking near the start and finish is listed, and a post-race meal is included in the entry fee.

name: Hirschbachschleiferl
organizer: Lauftreff Kirchdorf, Abteilung des Sport Club Kirchdorf
description: Das Hirschbachschleiferl ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf in Kirchdorf im Ampertal, der Läuferinnen und Läufer aller Leistungsstufen willkommen heißt. Die Veranstaltung findet am Rathausplatz statt und verbindet sportliche Herausforderung mit einem starken Gemeinschaftsgefühl. Neben dem sportlichen Aspekt unterstützt der Lauf soziale Projekte, wie die Freisinger Krebshilfe, durch Spenden. Die Teilnahme erfolgt auf eigene Gefahr, und die Organisatoren legen Wert auf die Gesundheit und Eigenverantwortung der Teilnehmer.
course_highlights: Hauptlauf über 9,7 km
Strecke mit Abschnitten auf Asphalt und im Wald
Weitere Laufangebote über 3,9 km sowie Kinderläufe
additional: Der Lauf unterstützt soziale Einrichtungen durch Spenden, die von den Teilnehmern und lokalen Firmen getragen werden. Es gibt keinen Hinweis auf unterschiedliche Startzeiten, Preisstaffelungen oder spezielle Läuferausstattungen. Das Ziel befindet sich am Rathausplatz.

name: Nordkirchener Halbmarathon
description: The Nordkirchen Half Marathon takes place on a scenic route through Nordkirchen Castle Park and the Obsen farming community. Runners start in the stadium at Castle Park, complete two laps of the stadium, and then run a loop of just under 10 kilometers through picturesque parkland and villages. Several refreshment points along the route provide runners with supplies. The finish is back in the stadium, where spectators cheer on the runners and help create a wonderful shared experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the stadium at Nordkirchen Castle Park
Run through the expansive Castle Park with views of the castle
Loop through the Obsen farming community, with enthusiastic neighbors cheering
additional: Runners may deposit their own refreshments before the start (8:00–8:45). Water is available at refreshment points at km 4.5, 7, 9, 10.5, 14, 16.5, and 18.5. On-site late registration is possible until 8:00 for an additional fee of EUR 3. Bibs with chips for electronic timing will be issued and collected after the race, but may be kept as a souvenir. The route passes through Castle Park and Obsen, with the start and finish in the stadium at Castle Park. Registration is available online and on race day. Results are available live. Parking is available at the stadium, Nordkirchen Comprehensive School, and the Sundern parking lot.

name: 10. Charity-Lauf Koldingen
description: The Koldingen Charity Run is part of the Sparkassen Laufpass of the Hanover Region, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. Runners can explore the Hanover Region on foot and collect stamps in their running pass each time they take part. The run offers a varied course in the beautiful surroundings of Pattensen and promotes recreational sport in the region. The event is open to everyone who wants to be active while doing good.

name: 55. Volkslauf Rund um Wellen
description: The 55th Volkslauf Rund um Wellen takes place in Beverstedt-Wellen and is one of Germany’s oldest marathons, with a friendly, family atmosphere. The event offers challenging courses over four distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km and 5 km. Some courses are certified by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The route passes through varied landscapes, with forest trails and a range of surfaces. The event is organized by TSV Wellen and relies on support from many volunteers from the village.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 4
description: Voss Running Series is a running series for everyone, with 5 km races that start and finish at Idrettsplassen in Voss. The course goes through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade, and is suitable for both recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up. The races are held on Mondays, starting at 19:00, and you can sign up for individual races or all six races together. This is a friendly recreational race that welcomes everyone to take part and enjoy Voss’s running community.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Idrettsplassen
Route through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: Registration is online via EQ Timing. A discount is available when registering for all six races by the second race; otherwise, you can register for each race individually. The fifth race starts at 18:30 instead of 19:00. Search for “Voss Løpskarusell 2027” on EQ Timing to register.

name: Head Energy Sommerkarusell 2027 løp 4 (2. aug)
description: Head Energy Summer Series is a running series organised in association with the athletics community at IL Gneist. Race 4 is listed at Fana Stadium.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 4
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is a running series for everyone, with races on Mondays at 19:00. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the promenade. The event welcomes recreational runners and runners aged 9 and up to enjoyable fun runs in scenic surroundings. Registration is online, with a discount for signing up for all six races by the second race.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the promenade
additional: Registration is online only via EQ Timing. You can register for all six races together at a discounted rate if you sign up by the second race. The fifth race starts at 18:30, while the others start at 19:00. You can register for individual races or get a discount by signing up for all six races by race 2.

name: Sörörundan
description: Sörörundan är ett återkommande sommarevenemang i Gullspång, arrangerat av Gullspångs IF. Välj mellan att springa 5, 10 eller 15 kilometer, eller att promenera tillsammans med vänner. Varmt välkommen till en lättsam aktivitet för olika nivåer.
course_highlights: Tre distanser: 5, 10 och 15 km
Det går också bra att promenera
Start vid Gullmovallen
additional: Loppet har enligt lokal rapportering arrangerats första onsdagen i augusti. 2027 års datum är onsdag 4 augusti.

name: GIF-joggen
description: GIF-joggen is organized by Gresvik IF and is a local running activity held at the gravel field in Trondalen, Gressvik. The event has a tradition of bringing together children, young people, and adults in an inclusive environment. Emphasis is placed on enjoyment and a positive club culture, and it is a social meeting place for runners in the area. Information about the route and participation is available on the club’s website.
course_highlights: Run on the gravel field in Trondalen
Family-friendly and inclusive environment
Organized by Gresvik IF with an emphasis on enjoyment
additional: Contact phone for questions: 93 27 83 33. Environmental contact Linda Kristiansen is available for support and questions. No price or start-time information found. The event focuses on a positive club culture and an inclusive environment. GIF-joggen is held weekly on Fridays during the summer months, except in July.

name: Esenser Volksbanklauf - 31. Stadtlauf
description: The 31st Esens City Run, held as the 6th Esens Volksbank Run, takes place in Esens. The traditional “Around St. Magnus” race offers exciting competitions for runners of all ages in the town center. The event begins with a 670-meter Bambini run, followed by student races over 1,340 meters. Adults can compete over five and ten kilometers, with both races starting at the same time. The award ceremonies take place immediately after the races.
course_highlights: “Around St. Magnus” race in the town center of Esens
670-meter Bambini run
Adult races over 5 and 10 kilometers
additional: Start times: Bambini run at 18:10, student race at 18:30, and adult 5 km and 10 km races at 19:30. Online registration is available. Start and finish at Esens Market Square; online registration available; July weather: approx. 25°C, sunny.

name: Volksbank Baumberge Abendlauf
description: Der Volksbank Baumberge Abendlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Laufwettbewerb, der in Laer-Holthausen auf der Sportanlage Dörrhoff stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern eine attraktive Strecke mit einem Verpflegungspunkt und einem Start- und Zielbereich am Sportplatz. Der Lauf ist Teil der Aktivitäten des Sportvereins Schwarz-Weiss Beerlage-Holthausen und findet im Rahmen einer Sportwoche statt. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Laufbegeisterte aller Altersklassen und bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre.
course_highlights: Start und Ziel am Sportplatz in Laer-Holthausen
Ein Verpflegungspunkt auf der Strecke
Lauf durch die Baumberge-Region
additional: Das Ticket berechtigt zum Start um 15:00 Uhr. Ein Start in einer anderen Gruppe oder der Tausch der gebuchten Startzeit ist nicht möglich. Die Startunterlagen werden vor Ort ausgegeben. Austragungsort: Sportanlage, Dörrhoff 14, 48366 Laer-Holthausen.

name: Berglauf
description: TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. warmly invites you to the hill run in Höxter, which features a challenging course with varied terrain. The event includes a children’s hill run of approx. 1 km and a main race of approx. 3.2 km, with a steady climb and an elevation gain of about 170 meters. The course starts at the sports field and runs over grassy areas, asphalt paths, meadow trails, and narrow gravel and forest paths, finishing in the woods. This long-standing running event welcomes runners of all ages.

name: Gifhorner Friedhofslauf
description: The Gifhorn Cemetery Run is a special event held at the St. Nicolai Protestant Lutheran Cemetery in Gifhorn. Runners can choose between 4- and 8-kilometer routes. After the run, participants gather for a relaxed barbecue and drinks under the apple trees. Traditionally held in the evening, the event combines sporting activity with a relaxed atmosphere in a historic setting.

name: Stora Stöten Run
description: Stora Stöten Run is a trail race in the heart of the Falun Mine World Heritage Site, offering a historic and varied running experience. The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses, following old routes known as Vattnets Väg till Gruvan (The Water’s Way to the Mine). The race has three distances (21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km) and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants, with the option to run timed or untimed. The event is organised by the orienteering club OK Kåre, which welcomes participants to the start and finish at Falun Mine.
course_highlights: Three courses: 21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km, starting and finishing at Falun Mine
The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses along Vattnets Väg
Varied terrain: gravel, grass, trail tracks, nature paths and short paved sections; an initial climb and clearly marked downhill sections
additional: Start and finish at Falun Mine; warm-up begins at 12:10 on Falu Rödfärg’s paved area (approximately 7 minutes), led by Friskis & Svettis; all courses start at the same time, and runners are divided into two optional groups based on target pace (group 1: women ≤6 min/km, men ≤5 min/km). Runners can choose to run with or without timing; prizes go to the first three finishers on each course, with raffle prizes for other participants; teams can be registered (teams of 3), and registrations can be transferred free of charge through the registration system. The race information mentions aid stations/water stops, parking, race office, showers/changing facilities and course markings. All three courses start and finish at Falun Mine; results from previous years are available.

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is a flat, easy-to-run marathon starting and finishing in the square in Löttorp. The course consists of a 2.1 km loop in Löttorp, followed by an 11.2 km loop run three times, for a total distance of 42,195 metres, entirely on asphalt. During the race, runners have views of Blå Jungfrun and pass three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water. All finishers receive a unique medal made of Öland limestone, and the women’s and men’s winners each win dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course
100% asphalt
Three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water
additional: Bib numbers can be collected from 12:00 on race day. Personal energy supplies must be handed in at least one hour before the start. Accommodation is available in four-bed cabins at Högby IP. Prizes are awarded to all age-group winners and the top overall finishers.
