name: Svartåloppet
location: Svartå Folkets hus, Svartå, Degerfors Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Svartåloppet is a recreational race held on the second Saturday in August, starting and finishing at Svartå Folkets hus. The race offers three distances: 2.5 km on flat roads, and 5.5 km and 14 km on hilly forest roads and trails. Timing is handled by Racetimer, providing a modern and reliable system. The race is open to all ages and has a long tradition in Svartå dating back to the 20th century.
course_highlights: The 5.5 km and 14 km courses are hilly forest routes on forest roads and trails
The 2.5 km course is a flatter route on roads
Start and finish at Svartå Folkets hus
additional: Timing is handled by Racetimer, providing a modern and reliable timing system. Svartå IF is the organizer and has its own facilities, including floodlit trails and a clubhouse at Hyttvallen. Results from several past years are available via Racetimer. Timing is handled by Racetimer.

name: Bunketorp Backyard Ultra Trail
description: Bunketorp Backyard Ultra Trail is a challenging last-person-standing competition held in scenic Bunketorp in Lindome, south of Gothenburg. Participants run a 6,706-metre course on pleasant, well-trodden forest trails and exercise tracks, with a start every hour on the hour. Each lap must be completed within the hour to continue, and the runner who completes the most laps wins. The course is hilly, with around 140 metres of elevation gain per lap, and offers beautiful forest scenery and varied terrain. The event provides a welcoming atmosphere with good service and support for both runners and their companions.
course_highlights: A 6,706-metre course on soft forest exercise tracks and trails
A hilly course with around 140 metres of elevation gain per lap and three major climbs
Beautiful, varied terrain with no asphalt or gravel roads
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour, with all participants starting at the same time. Participants must be in the starting pen at the start and may not cross the start line and then go back. The venue has changing rooms with showers and a sauna, toilets, a participant tent for storage and rest, an aid station, refreshments for companions, secure storage for valuables, and first aid. There is no age limit; participation is at your own risk. Prizes are awarded to the top three women, the top three men, and the best team (3 runners).

name: Kräftivalloppet
description: Kräftivalloppet är ett familjevänligt löpevenemang i Tidaholm och en del av Kraftivalen. Här finns lopp för både barn, vuxna och seniorer, med kortare banor anpassade för de yngsta deltagarna och ett särskilt rollator- och seniorlopp. Inför loppen hålls uppvärmning i samarbete med Hälsocenter. Vuxenloppet kräver föranmälan, medan barn- och seniorloppen är utan föranmälan.
course_highlights: Barnlopp från 7 år: cirka 600 meter per varv, högst tre varv
Rollator- och seniorlopp: cirka 600 meter
Lopp för barn från 2 år: cirka 400 meter
additional: Vuxenloppet anmäls via motionsloppet.se. Barn- och seniorloppen kräver ingen föranmälan.

name: Istrun - Skaras snabba halvmara
description: Istrun is a fast, flat half marathon in Skara with approximately 70 metres of elevation gain, making it a perfect course for setting personal records. The race is organised by Istrums SK - Friidrott and welcomes both recreational and competitive runners. The distance is 21.1 km, and the course is designed to be fast and easy to run. Runners who are not members of a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Association can register through M Motion or K Motion.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Approximately 70 metres of elevation gain
Suitable for personal records
additional: The race is listed as fully booked. For questions or to join the waiting list: istrun@istrumssk.se.

name: Häv och Gräv Vikbovändan 2026
location: Vikbolandet, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a recreational race held on Vikbolandet in Östergötland during the summer. The main event is approximately 45 km long and features a scenic route with both gravel and asphalt sections. Along the way, participants can enjoy local delicacies at several aid stations. The event offers running, cycling and duo categories, as well as a children's race in the forest on illuminated trails. It is a welcoming, nature-oriented experience focused on community and local flavours.
course_highlights: Approximately 45 km, with a 50/50 mix of gravel and asphalt
Aid stations with locally produced delicacies and the opportunity to visit production facilities and a shop
Children's race in the forest on illuminated trails, with a medal and ice cream afterwards
additional: Start times: Children's race 10:30, Running + duo 11:30, Cycling 12:30. The children's race is free and does not require advance registration. Helmets are mandatory for cycling. All participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup to use at the aid stations to avoid disposable cups. On-site registration may be available if places remain, up until 30 minutes before the start. Participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup, which they should bring along during the race to reduce the use of disposable cups.

name: Augustiloppet
description: Augustiloppet är en del av Augustifesten i Smedjebacken, en vecka fylld med roliga och spännande aktiviteter för hela familjen. Loppet arrangeras i samband med festivalen och erbjuder en trevlig motionsupplevelse i en gemytlig miljö. Det är en traditionell sommarhändelse som samlar både motionärer och tävlingsinriktade löpare. Evenemanget är välkomnande för alla åldrar och nivåer.
course_highlights: Barnlopp på cirka 700 meter
5 km motionsklass
10 km tävlingsklass
additional: Tidigare upplagor har haft start och mål på torget i Smedjebacken. I en tidigare upplaga var barnloppet gratis.

name: Storå 6 timmars och 3 timmars
description: Storå 6-hour is a challenging ultra race organised by Storådalens SK at Hagabacken School in Guldsmedshyttan. The race offers two distances, 6 hours and 3 hours, with participants running on a 2,130-metre course with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain per lap. Sports drink and energy products are served at the lap point, and hot dogs in buns are available halfway through. All participants receive a T-shirt after finishing, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each category. Results are published live on race day at hug-timing.se.
course_highlights: Laps of 2,130 metres with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain
After 20 laps, runners pass the marathon distance with a total of 1,000 metres of elevation gain
During the final 30 minutes, runners complete a shorter lap
additional: The start, lap point and race centre are at Hagabacken School, which has showers, toilets, services and medical care. Parking for the 6-hour race is on the gravel football pitch behind the school. For the 3-hour race, parking is available at Guldsmedshyttebruk, 500 metres away, or at the start. Timing is done with an ankle chip, which must be returned after the race. Umara sports drink and other products are served at the lap point. All runners receive a T-shirt after completing the race. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category. The race has been cancelled due to too few participants. The planned start times were 11:00 for the 6-hour race and 14:00 for the 3-hour race. Timing was to be done with a chip.

name: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE
description:
Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is the trail-running adventure for anyone looking to combine the joy of running, a challenge and spectacular scenery. Choose between 42 km, 21 km or 10 km—and bring the whole family! Children up to 12 years old can run for free in Barnens Fjällmaraton.
The course takes you over rugged mountain trails, boardwalks and winding paths all the way to the finish and the lively After Run party at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. Fjällmaraton Sälen is a deluxe running experience. Secure your place and experience the mountains with us!

name: Møkster maraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Møkster maraton kr 1200,- ( Inkl. mat og drikke etter målgang og gratis show )

description: Møkster Marathon is held on the beautiful little island of Møkster in Austevoll municipality, on the outer edge of the ocean southwest of Bergen. The race offers a unique experience, with a course through varied terrain including asphalt, gravel and grass, and great views of islands, coves and the sea. There are three distances: marathon (42 km), half marathon (21 km) and the unique Nautical Marathon (7.8 km). After the race, participants can enjoy food, drinks and a concert in a welcoming atmosphere. All finishers receive beautiful medals, and the winners are awarded wild sheep skins and other great prizes.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt, gravel and grass
10 laps, with 69 metres of elevation gain per lap
Great views of lush natural scenery, islands, coves and the sea
additional: An early start for the marathon is available at 11:00, but early starters are not eligible for medals. A children's race for the youngest participants starts at 14:30, with no registration required. The café is open from 12:00 to 17:00, with food, cake and coffee included for marathon runners. The concert starts at 20:00; admission is free for marathon runners and half price for half-marathon runners. An extra boat departing at 22:00 for Hufthamar/Bekkjarvik can be purchased. There is a dedicated floating dock for private boats and a helicopter landing pad. Beautiful wild sheep skins are awarded to the winners of all three distances.

name: Hardanger halvmaraton
description: The Hardanger Half Marathon is organised by Øystese Sports Club and offers a peaceful race along the fjord, with views of Fonna. The fast course is entirely on asphalt, passing orchards, built-up areas and a lively town centre. The start and finish are at the beautiful Storeteigen Folk Museum. The race has become a tradition, attracting runners looking for a great half-marathon experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Fast 21.1 km asphalt course with 141 m of elevation gain
Passes orchards, cultural landscapes and the centre of Norheimsund
Start and finish at Storeteigen Folk Museum, with a refreshment station halfway
additional: Check-in starts at 10:00 at Storeteigen. The awards ceremony is at 14:00. Parking is recommended at the municipal car park near the waterworks. Members of Øystese Sports Club receive a discount when registering. The course has been officially measured by NFIF and has official records for the men's and women's categories.

name: Mjøsen Backyard 2027
description: Mjøsen Backyard is a unique and demanding trail race consisting of 12 laps with a total of 2,604 metres of elevation gain, equivalent to running from Mjøsa’s deepest point up to the water’s surface six times. The race challenges both body and willpower, offering a brutal but rewarding experience where strategy and endurance are essential. The course passes through varied terrain, including forest, open areas and technical sections, with steep climbs and beautiful views of Mjøsa. The concept is that the race starts on the hour every hour, and runners must complete each lap before the next start to continue. The first runner to finish the final lap wins the race.
course_highlights: 12 laps with a total of 2,604 metres of elevation gain
Steep climbs, including one with a 29.7% gradient after 3.4 km
Varied terrain with forest, open areas and beautiful views of Mjøsa
additional: Bib pickup is on Friday, August 7, from 16:00 to 18:00 and on race day until 30 minutes before the start. The race office opens at 07:00. Tents will be provided for Backyard runners, but you must bring your own chair and equipment. Running poles are not permitted. Participants will be provided with sports drink, gels and lefse at the venue, but are advised to bring their own food and drink. There is zero tolerance for littering along the course. A doctor and medical officer will be present at the venue. Portable toilets are available. HOKA will have demo shoes at the venue. Live results via EQ Timing. The course partly passes through Furuberget Nature Reserve, and participants are expected to show extra respect for the area.

name: Mjøsen Trail 2027
description: Mjøsen Trail is a spectacular trail race in Hamar, Innlandet, known for its steep climbs and fantastic views over Lake Mjøsa. The race offers several distances, from the challenging Backyard with 12 laps and over 2,600 metres of elevation gain to shorter distances such as the high-intensity 10 km. The courses pass through varied terrain with technical sections, and are suitable both for those seeking a tough challenge and for those who want to enjoy the running experience without competitive pressure. The event has a strong focus on nature and respect for the environment, with parts of the course in Furuberget Nature Reserve.
course_highlights: Steep climbs with gradients of up to 29.7%
Great views over Lake Mjøsa along the way
Varied terrain with technical sections and challenging climbs such as Elghufsbakken and Bratta
additional: Race bib collection is Friday 7 August from 16:00 to 18:00, and on race day until 30 minutes before the start. The race office opens at 07:00 on race day. HOKA awards the top three finishers in every distance and offers demo shoes at the race venue. There is zero tolerance for litter on the course. Participants in the 10 km, 21 km, 42 km and 80 km races receive sports drinks and some nutrition at the race venue and at the halfway point. Part of the course runs through Furuberget Nature Reserve, with extra emphasis on respecting nature. The Backyard race starts at the beginning of every hour, and runners must complete the lap before the next start to continue. Running poles are not allowed in the Backyard.

name: Kongsvinger Skogsmaraton
description: Kongsvinger Forest Marathon is a scenic forest race held on hilly, varied terrain north and west of Sæter farm. The event offers marathon, half-marathon, 10 km and 4.2 km distances. The main course is 21.1 km and follows forest roads and good trails past several lakes and wooded areas. The marathon consists of two laps of the main course, while the half-marathon is one lap. The event focuses on providing a good experience for all participants, with well-marked courses and several aid stations along the way.
course_highlights: Hilly, varied forest terrain north and west of Sæter farm
The course follows forest roads and good trails past Bogersjøen, Bogerfløyta and Trettbråten
9 aid stations per lap with water, sports drink, bananas and raisins
additional: The marathon course is run over two laps, and the half-marathon over one. There is no time limit for the race. Bringing a hydration pack, vest or belt is recommended because of the warm weather in August. Music is allowed during the race, but runners should stay aware of their surroundings. Please dispose of litter responsibly; everyone is encouraged to use the bins at the aid stations and in the start area.

name: 16. Piesauer Glasmacherlauf
description: The 16th Piesau Glassmakers’ Run takes place in Piesau, Thuringia. The event offers 2 km races for children and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a 10 km Nordic walking competition on forest trails. It is part of the Sparkassen Cup and the TLV Running and Nordic Walking Cup, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with changing and shower facilities and refreshments on site. Trophies and awards are presented to the fastest runners and age-group winners.
course_highlights: 2 km children’s race
10 km main race entirely on forest trails
10 km Nordic walking with poles; running is prohibited
additional: Changing, washing and shower facilities are available. Food, drinks and cake are sold on site. Trophies are awarded to the fastest runners in each distance (places 1–3 for each gender), with awards for the top three in each age group. A team classification is held for the 10 km race, based on the two fastest women or three fastest men from a club.

name: Frontrun - Janus Queer Games 2026
organizer: Janus Queer Games / SC Janus e.V.
description: The Frontrun is an inclusive running event held as part of the Janus Queer Games 2026 in Cologne, welcoming runners of all genders. Events include a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and a 5 km partner run. The start and finish are on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow. The course is clearly marked and supported by encouraging course marshals. The event values community, diversity, and the joy of sport in an open and supportive environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow
5 km loop for the shorter runs; 2 loops for the 10 km run
Alphabetically marked course with friendly course marshals
additional: Race bibs can be collected until 11:30 a.m.; group warm-up at 11:45 a.m. Manual timekeeping with +/- 3 seconds’ precision. Free water stations during the run; after the run, fruit and a cake buffet are available for donations benefiting Anyway e.V. There are no age-group rankings; rankings are in the female, male, and all-genders categories. The 5 km partner run is ranked in the All Gender category. Race-day registration is possible if places are available. The course is flat and runs on the Jahnwiesen. Registration is available online and on the event day, with refreshments and rankings in several categories.

name: CJ Schmidt Hafentagelauf
description: The CJ Schmidt Harbour Day Run takes place in Husum, a city on the North Sea in Schleswig-Holstein, as part of the Husum Harbour Days festival. The event offers flat road races over various distances, including children’s and youth races, a 5 km race, a 10 km race, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. There is also the Husum Corporate Cup, in which company teams of four compete. The course runs through the city centre and along the harbour, combining urban streets with waterfront paths, accompanied by the fresh North Sea breeze.
course_highlights: Flat road races through Husum’s city centre and harbour
Course along the North Sea coast with a fresh sea breeze
A range of distances for children, young people and relay teams
additional: The organiser is Husumer Sportverein seit 1875 e.V. Timing is provided by Race Result, and registration is managed by LAV Husum. Typical August weather in Husum is around 25 °C, with mostly sunny days and average precipitation of 60 mm. The event also includes team and corporate races as well as family races, with a festive atmosphere in the harbour area. August weather is usually sunny, at around 25°C.

name: Volkslauf um den Mittelpunkt Deutschlands
description: The Volkslauf around the Center of Germany is a sporting event in Krebeck, suitable for young and old alike, as well as both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers various running and walking routes with varied elevation profiles, some of which are challenging and follow paved or asphalt paths. The races start and finish at the Krebeck sports field, and all participants receive fruit and drinks during and after the competition. Medals and prizes are awarded to the top finishers, and there are age-group rankings and on-site medical support.

name: Volkslauf um den Auesee
description: The course follows paved and partly asphalted paths around Auesee and is almost flat, with no significant elevation changes. The race is part of a popular regional running series with a total of nine events. It is organized by ATSV Espelkamp, which ensures a well-organized event and a pleasant atmosphere.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
location: Śliwice, Tuchola County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny is a unique timed race held in Koszalin at Górka Piaskowa. Participants compete on a challenging, approximately 1-kilometre loop through hilly forest terrain with sandy sections. The race lasts exactly 1 hour, during which runners can complete as many laps as they wish; the winner is the runner who completes the most. At the finish, unique, very heavy medals await, along with a barbecue and bonfire, creating a friendly, sociable atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 1 km loop through challenging, hilly forest terrain
Varied surface with sandy sections
Challenging uphill sections and numerous elevation changes
additional: Start and finish at Górka Piaskowa in Koszalin. Electronic chip timing. Participants receive a race bib and safety pins. Drinks and medical support from the Polish Red Cross in Koszalin are available at the finish. After the race, refreshments include grilled sausage, sweet rolls, and a bonfire. Participant limit: 100. Entry is open to participants aged 18 and over with a current medical examination or a declaration.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a series of races that have promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate both sporting competition and the beauty of their surroundings. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the UAM Botanical Garden
Picturesque green spaces and natural surroundings
Alternative location by Lake Rusałka, 500 m from the start
additional: Race packs can be collected by an authorised representative. The organisers place particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of the proposed race locations. This summer marks the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka.

name: Kullamilen
organizer: Höganäs Friidrott tillsammans med lokala föreningar
description: Kullamilen is an annual fun run on the Kullahalvön peninsula, welcoming runners, joggers and walkers of all ages and abilities. The races start and finish at the athletics stadium in Höganäs, with distances for children and young people of 2.4 km, as well as 5 km and 10 km for recreational and competitive runners. The courses run largely along the coast, with beautiful sea views, and are sanctioned by the Skåne Athletics Federation. The event is marked by a sense of community, cheerful volunteers and a friendly atmosphere, with the joy of movement at its heart.
course_highlights: The 10 km course follows much of the Kullahalvön coastline and offers sea views
The 5 km and 10 km courses run on asphalt and gravel and are marked and staffed by volunteers
The children’s and youth races take place on the athletics track, covering 6 laps of the 400-metre track
additional: Late registration is available on race day between 09:30 and 11:30 at the race office at the athletics stadium, and no later than 30 minutes before each participant’s start. Bib numbers can be collected from 09:30 on race day. Water stations are located at approximately 3.5 km, 6.2 km and at the finish. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to the fastest runners in the 5 km and 10 km races. The 10 km is offered in both competitive and recreational categories. The veterans’ competitive categories are part of the Skåne Veterans Cup.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival, Østmarka halvmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 332,50 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%) -30%

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Dagsbillett SOLO Deltakere kr 475,00 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3%)

description: Østmarka Half Marathon is part of the Oslo Running Festival and offers an exceptional nature experience through some of the most beautiful areas of Oslomarka. The race follows scenic forest roads through varied terrain and past idyllic lakes, and is suitable both for those looking to run a good time and for those who want to enjoy a fantastic day outdoors in the forest. This is the first-ever half marathon in the Oslo Running Festival, with a mass start on August 8 at 11:00 at Rustadsaga Sportsstue in Oslo.
course_highlights: Course through beautiful areas of Oslomarka
Scenic forest roads and varied terrain
Idyllic lakes and nature experiences all the way to the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected from Löplabbet Oslo sentrum from April 7. The same race bib is used throughout the series. A new race bib can be purchased for 75 kr. Courses will only be marked for the mass start. GPX files and Strava links for the course are available to download. Registration is binding, with no refunds or transfer of race bibs. The race can be completed during the festival period from July 30 to August 8; the mass start is on August 8 at 11:00. Early-bird prices are listed and may increase on January 1.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a simple, fast race event at Ås School in Eidsvoll, featuring a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop. The event offers seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon, and helps runners achieve fast times with a dedicated nutrition table along the course. Race bibs are collected using self-service at the venue, which has free parking, changing rooms and toilets. The race is known for its great atmosphere and the many runners who set personal records; it is a tradition to ring the bell at the finish to celebrate a new PB.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Dedicated nutrition table passed on every lap
Venue at Ås School with free parking, changing rooms and toilets
additional: Race bibs are collected using self-service approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. The race has a dedicated nutrition table where runners can leave their own bottles and gels. At selected races, ninth-graders from Feiring School staff an official drinks station, which also raises money for their school trip. It is a tradition to ring the bell at the finish area to celebrate a new personal record. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. Registration is via RaceDays; half-marathon runners can arrange their own drinks and nutrition.

name: Perseløpet ¤6 - 2027
description: Perseløpet is a race in Eidsvoll, starting and finishing at Ås School in Hammerås. The event features a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop and offers seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, designed for fast times. Participants can set up their own nutrition table, which they pass on every lap, making it easy to access their own supplies without the logistics of an aid station. The event has a friendly atmosphere, where personal records are celebrated with a bell near the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km
Personal nutrition table passed on every lap
additional: Race bibs are collected by self-service at Ås School approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, 9th-grade students from Feiring School staff an official drinks station that also raises money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area around Ås School. Race bibs are collected by self-service at the school from around two hours before the start. Runners can have their own nutrition table.

name: Brunnenlauf
location: Iburg-Stadion, Bad Driburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bad Driburg Brunnenlauf is an annual running event organized by TV "Jahn" Bad Driburg e.V., welcoming runners of all ages. The challenging course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa park and the town, and finishes at Iburg Stadium. The event emphasizes fairness and sportsmanship and uses reusable-chip timing. Registration is online only; late entries are not possible.
course_highlights: Challenging out-and-back course with hills
The course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa park and the town
Finish at Iburg Stadium, Bad Driburg
additional: Timing is exclusively with the reusable chip from race result, worn on the foot with a chip strap. The chip deposit is 10€ and is refunded when the chip is returned. Participants may be disqualified for violations of fairness and good conduct. Online registration only; no late entries. Participation from age 18; children and students are free.

name: Diekseelauf
description: Der Diekseelauf ist ein beliebter Volkslauf rund um den Dieksee in Bad Malente-Gremsmühlen. Die Hauptstrecke umfasst 11,5 km und führt gegen den Uhrzeigersinn um den See herum durch malerische Orte wie Hafkamp, Timmdorf und Niederkleveez. Zusätzlich gibt es einen Jedermannlauf über 5 km sowie einen Kinderlauf über 1,5 km. Die Veranstaltung bietet auch Walking- und Wandermöglichkeiten und ist für Läufer aller Altersklassen geeignet. Für das leibliche Wohl und die Sicherheit der Teilnehmer ist mit Getränken, Sanitätsdienst und Umkleidemöglichkeiten gesorgt.
course_highlights: 11,5 km Rundkurs gegen den Uhrzeigersinn um den Dieksee
Strecke führt durch Hafkamp, Timmdorf, Niederkleveez und den Holm
Getränkeposten nach 5,5 km in Timmdorf
additional: Startunterlagenausgabe ab 8:30 Uhr. Nachmeldungen sind bis 30 Minuten vor dem Start möglich gegen eine Nachmeldegebühr von 4,00 € per Barzahlung via QR-Code. Zeitmessung erfolgt elektronisch mit Transponder in der Startnummer. Siegerehrungen ab ca. 12:00 Uhr. Toiletten, Umkleidezelt und Duschmöglichkeit im Sport- und Bildungszentrum vorhanden. Urkunden für alle Kinderläufer, Preise für die besten Teilnehmer in den verschiedenen Kategorien.

name: v-office-Europalauf
description: The 39th vOffice Europalauf is an international race connecting the Baltic seaside resorts of Neustadt, Pelzerhaken and Rettin along the half-marathon course. The route offers wonderful views across Neustädter Bucht and follows the beach promenade back to Neustadt, parallel to the beach. In addition to the half marathon, there are races over 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km, as well as a Bambini race. The event is a popular sporting event in the region and is organized by TSV Neustadt.

name: Stomperudkarusellen- løp nr 3
location: Stomperud Stadion, Lørenvegen 2, Sørum, Lillestrøm, Norway
price_range: Enkeltløp: 220 kr for voksne og 110 kr for barn, med lisens i tillegg
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a long-established series of races organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races with varying distances from 800 meters to 9 kilometers, including shorter options for children and young people. The races take place in scenic surroundings, with the start and finish at Stomperud Stadion and nearby areas. Participants use the same race number throughout the series, and the event is open to both adults and children. Children who are members of Sørum IL can take part for free when they register.
course_highlights: Race 3: Lysløypa, 6 km with a shorter option
Start and finish at Stomperud Stadion, Lørenvegen 2, Sørum
Varied terrain with gravel roads, trails, and an athletics track for shorter distances
additional: Participants use the same race number in all races in the series. Children who are members of Sørum IL can take part for free if they register no later than one week before race day. The races have shorter options for the youngest participants. Start locations vary between Sørum Skole and Stomperud Stadion depending on the race. Race no. 3 meets at Stomperud Stadion, Lørenvegen 2, Sørum. The prices listed by the organizer apply to 2026.

name: Stomperudkarusellen 2027. Bare løp 3 (Lysløypa)
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a long-running race series organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races of varying distances, including the 6 km Lysløypa, which is part of this year’s Race 3. The races are suitable for both adults and children, with shorter options for the youngest participants. Participants use the same bib number for all the races, and events take place at Stomperud Stadion and in nearby areas of Sørum.
course_highlights: Race 3 Lysløypa: 6 km, with a shorter 500 m option
Traditional routes in the local area around Stomperud Stadion
Shorter distances for children and young people
additional: Children who are members of Sørum IL can participate for free if they register no later than one week before race day. The races offer shorter options for the youngest participants. Events take place at Stomperud Stadion and in nearby areas with a well-maintained network of walking trails and running routes. The prices and race dates listed on the organizer’s website apply to 2026 and do not confirm a 2027 edition. In 2026, participants use the same bib number for all races in the series.

name: Vetlanda Citylopp

price_tiers.distance: Dam, herr och motion (5 km och 10 km)

tiers.description: Dam-, herr- och motionsklassen (10 km och 5 km)

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Vetlanda Citylopp is a welcoming urban race for all ages and ability levels. The start and finish are on Storgatan in the heart of Vetlanda, and participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a fast, spectator-friendly loop course. Younger participants can choose shorter distances from 400 metres up to 1.7 km. The event is a community celebration, with activities and food service in the square, where runners and spectators alike can enjoy a great day together.
course_highlights: Fast loop course in central Vetlanda
Start and finish on Storgatan in the heart of town
Spectator-friendly, with activities and food service in the square
additional: Race bib collection and on-the-day registration take place at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day. On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before the start of each class. Timing is provided by a chip in the race bib, and results are published live and on the OK Njudung website. Changing rooms and showers are available at Hövdingen sports hall near the start/finish. Previous editions have included children’s and youth classes as well as a Funkis class. Race-day bib collection, on-the-day registration and activities have previously been held at Stortorget.

name: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt 7. løp
description: HTB Valestrandsmarka Rundt is an annual recreational race organised by Osterøy I.L. Friidrett. The race takes place in Valestrand and covers a distance of 4.4 km. It is a social and inclusive event, with evening start times for walkers and the main field. Traditionally, sveler, cordial and prizes are served, and course records are rewarded with cash prizes from HTB.
course_highlights: A 4.4 km course in Valestrand
Start times: 18:45 for walkers and 19:00 for the main field
Course records are rewarded with NOK 3,000
additional: Start times are 18:45 for walkers and 19:00 for the main field. Times in the walking field are recorded as 30 minutes or more. Traditionally, sveler from Toro, cordial from Saftsuse and prizes from Extra Valestrand are provided. The race is part of a series of races held throughout the year, including a Christmas race and a New Year’s race. Registration takes place at Furubakken sports ground, and payment can be made via Vipps 121337 or to account 3632.54.56676. In 2026, the start times were 18:45 and 19:00, with payment via Vipps. Participants received sveler, cordial and prizes.

name: Happy 24 hours 2027
description: Happy 24 Hours 2027 is an ultrarunning event held at Lersbrygga sports facility in Sande in cooperation with IL Sandvin. The race takes place on a 400-metre tartan track and offers three distances: 24-hour, 12-hour and 6-hour races. It starts on Friday evening and finishes on Saturday evening, with the running direction reversed every six hours. Everyone who completes at least one lap receives a medal, and buckets are awarded to the winners of the women’s and men’s categories.
course_highlights: 400-metre tartan track
Running direction reversed every six hours
Race held at Lersbrygga sports facility in Sande
additional: The final distance will be measured precisely at 21:00 on Saturday, 14 August. The organizer will provide cola, crisps and chocolate. There is space for drinks and food inside the track. The race may be cancelled or postponed due to force majeure, with no refund of the entry fee.

name: Geilo Trail Run
description: Geilo Trail Run offers a spectacular mountain-running experience with distances of 16K, 30K and marathon (42K), as well as a separate children’s race. The courses feature a great combination of flowing trails, technical terrain and challenging climbs in the beautiful surroundings of Geilo. The start and finish are at Vestlia Resort, and the race includes several aid stations along the way. The event has a great atmosphere, with social activities, an awards ceremony and an after-run party, and is suitable for both experienced and new trail runners.
course_highlights: The courses start by Ustedalsfjorden, with scenic views of Hardangervidda
Varied terrain with flowing trails, technical sections and challenging climbs
Finishes with a fast descent on the ski slopes back to Vestlia Resort
additional: On Friday evening, there is check-in and race bib collection, a social warm-up run and a pre-race pasta buffet at Vestlia Resort. On Saturday, the marathon starts at 08:30, the 30K at 10:30 and the 16K at 11:30. The children’s race (1 km) starts at 14:30. The awards ceremony is held at 16:00, followed by an evening after-run buffet and dancing. Lost property can be collected at the reception at Vestlia Resort.

name: 8. Wisent-RUN
location: Wisentgehege Springe, Springe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wisent-RUN is a popular race at Wisentgehege Springe, taking place for the eighth time. The event offers various race distances, including children’s races and timed competitions, set in a natural environment. With a family-friendly atmosphere and free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00, the race is a sporting highlight for all ages. The event is organised by VfV Concordia Alvesrode e.V. and is known for its welcoming atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Köhlerhütte in Wisentgehege Springe
Race routes through the natural surroundings of Wisentgehege
Timed children’s races and an awards ceremony
additional: Free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00. The 500 m children’s race, “Frischlingsrennen”, is untimed and for children born in 2021 or later. The 1 km children’s race is timed and includes an awards ceremony, for children born from 2016 to 2021. Ample parking is available. The event is open to everyone, with free admission for visitors. It offers an opportunity to explore the wildlife at Wisentgehege while also being active.

name: 24. Dammer Stadtlauf
description: The 24th Damme City Run is an evening road race through the center of Damme, organized by OSC Damme in cooperation with the City of Damme. The program includes three starts: a schoolchildren’s race, a general race for all participants, and the main evening race. After a two-year pandemic-related break, the race returns with an expected field of over 500 runners. The event is characterized by an open, local atmosphere, with on-site registration available, as runners fill the streets of the town center.
course_highlights: Evening road race through Damme city center
Three starts: schoolchildren’s race, general race, and main race
The course stays in the city center, with a lively atmosphere
additional: On-site registration is available, encouraging open, local participation. August weather is typically sunny, with temperatures between 14 and 25 °C. The event includes several categories, including children’s races and the main race, on a route through the city, with a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere.

name: 24. Knesebecker Einhornlauf
description: The Knesebeck Unicorn Run is a long-standing running event in the Isenhagen region, held annually in August. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on varied courses. Online registration is available through the RaceResult platform, where all results and certificates can also be accessed. The run takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Wittingen and attracts numerous running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Nordic walking option
Event held on the school grounds in Knesebeck
additional: Registration is online through RaceResult. The run takes place on Friday evening. Participation is limited to 100 people; registration and results are available online; the event takes place on the school grounds in Knesebeck.

name: 17. VSB Dresdner Nachtlauf
description: The VSB Dresden Night Run offers a beautifully illuminated route with views of the Dresden skyline. Torches and glow sticks create a special atmosphere. The 11.5 km route follows the Elbe to the Blue Wonder and returns along the Neustadt side of the river, while the 6.2 km route also runs along the Elbe and crosses the Albert Bridge to the finish. Alongside the sporting experience, there are children’s races and a special team competition for clubs and organizations. The event takes place at Heinz-Steyer-Stadion and is a highlight of the region’s running calendar.

name: 35. Speller Sparkassen-Sommernachtslauf
description: The 35th Speller Sparkassen Summer Night Run is a traditional race in Spelle, organized by SC Spelle-Venhaus. The event offers runners an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of Wählehof. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels and takes place in a relaxed atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Bluesløpet
description: Bluesløpet is a running organization that arranges road races in Notodden, Telemark. The race has strong local roots and offers various distances for both children and adults. The event is known for combining the joy of running with a welcoming atmosphere in the town. It is a popular race among local runners and visitors looking for an active experience in Notodden.
course_highlights: Road races in central Notodden
Various distances, including a children’s race
Races in the scenic surroundings of Telemark
additional: Also organizes a children’s race called Teddy’s barneløp. The races are held in Notodden and nearby areas such as Heddal. Previous editions have included 5 km, 10 km, and a children’s race.

name: Bringebærløpet 2027
description: The Raspberry Run in Vollen is a family-friendly race offering distances for all ages and ability levels. The start and finish are at Vollenhallen, and the course runs through a scenic area, with only minor changes from previous years. The youngest participants run one lap of approximately 1 km on the roller-ski track, while older participants run 2.5 km or 5 km. The event focuses on participation and enjoyable sporting experiences, and you can also take part in the Raspberry Festival held alongside the race.
course_highlights: The course follows the roller-ski track at Arnestad through scenic surroundings
A children’s race of approximately 1 km for the youngest participants
A 2.5 km and 5 km race course with a mass start
additional: Schedule: 11:00 — bib pickup opens; 13:00 — mass start for 5 km; 13:30 — mass start for 2.5 km; 14:00 — start of the 1 km children’s race, with multiple starts; 15:00 — prize ceremony for competition classes aged 11 and up. The listed distances and start/finish area apply to the 2026 edition.

name: Pyttane Opp
description: Pyttane Opp is an uphill race on Sotra, running from Stølane at Ekerhovd to the radar dome at Pyttane. The race is 2.8 km long with 290 metres of elevation gain on asphalt, surrounded by beautiful scenery and offering a great view of all of Sotra from the top. There are two categories: the Recreational category for anyone who wants to reach the top without time pressure, and Paxon Elite, the competitive category with separate women’s and men’s divisions. The race is organized by the athletics group at Sotra Sportsklubb and welcomes everyone to enjoy a great running experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 2.8 km uphill race on asphalt
290 metres of elevation gain from Stølane to the radar dome at Pyttane
Great view of all of Sotra from the top
additional: Recreational category starts at 15:00; Paxon Elite starts at 16:00. Parking is limited, and if participation is high, a shuttle bus will run from Straume. Participants can leave their bags in the start area and collect them in the finish area at the top. The map and program will be published as they become available.

name: Hylja Vertikal 600
location: Lalm samfunnshus, Lalm, Vågå, Innlandet, Norway
description: Hylja Vertikal 600 is a vertical race event held in Lalm, Norway, organized by Lalm Idrettslag and Jotunfjell alpakka - Hylja Lodge. The race challenges participants with a steep ascent, offering a unique and demanding mountain running experience. It attracts local athletes and outdoor enthusiasts who enjoy testing their endurance and climbing skills in a scenic alpine environment.
course_highlights: Steep vertical climb with 600 meters elevation gain
Mountain terrain around Lalm
Organized by local sports club Lalm Idrettslag
additional: Previous editions have had a non-timed recreational class and a competitive class. The children's race, Hylja Horisontal, has had several distances for different age groups.

name: Grue Backyard 2027
description: Grue Backyard is a unique endurance race featuring 6.7 km loops through technical forest terrain. The race starts a new wave every hour, continuing until only one runner remains standing. Participants can complete one loop to earn a medal or push further for the finisher cap and the win. The event also includes the Grue Half Marathon, known as one of Norway's fastest half marathon courses, and the Gruemila 10 km race.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loops through technical forest terrain
New start every hour until one runner remains
Flat and fast 21.1 km half marathon course
additional: The race features hourly starts for the backyard loops, with medals awarded for completing one loop and a finisher cap for those who continue until the end. Previous editions have had up to 12 rounds, and participants who complete at least seven rounds have been able to receive a Grue Backyard Ultra Finisher T-shirt.

name: Ringeriksmaraton
description: Ringeriksmaraton is an annual running festival that began in 1995 and has grown to become Norway’s largest marathon relay. The race runs through the beautiful municipalities of Hole, Ringerike and Jevnaker, and offers distances and categories for everyone, including 8-person and 4-person relays, a pair marathon, half marathon and marathon. The event attracts recreational runners from all over the country and offers a sociable, active experience in beautiful surroundings. Children’s Ringeriksmaraton is also a popular part of the event, making it a family-friendly occasion.
course_highlights: The course runs through the municipalities of Hole, Ringerike and Jevnaker
Beautiful natural scenery, including Norway’s largest apple orchard
Varied terrain with asphalt, footpaths, forest roads and residential areas
additional: A mass start for all categories at Vik at 11:00, with an early start at 10:00 for runners using technical aids or with a finish time over 5 hours. Drink stations with squash and water at each relay exchange, as well as a muesli bar with salt at exchanges 3 and 6 for the half marathon and marathon. Toilets are available at several locations, but there are no shower facilities at Jevnakerhallen due to renovation. Løperbanken makes it possible to find a team if you are missing teammates. Race numbers and relay batons are handed out together. Registration is final, with no refund if you withdraw. Course maps, GPX files and practical information are available on the organizer’s website.

name: Bergen Skogsmaraton - Maratonkarusellen
description: Bergen Forest Marathon is an annual forest race held in Hordnesskogen, with the start and finish at the parking lot. The race features a loop of approximately 5.3 km, run multiple times depending on the distance: 8 laps for the marathon, 4 for the half marathon, and 2 for the 10 km. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners, offering a wonderful nature experience in the forest and good facilities, including changing rooms, water stations, and food in the finish area. The focus is on enjoyment and quality for all participants.
course_highlights: Loop course in Hordnesskogen, starting and finishing at the parking lot
Each lap is approximately 5.3 km long
Two water stations, passed three times per lap
additional: Race headquarters opens at 08:00 for race-number collection and bag drop. Start times: 10 km at 09:00, marathon at 10:00, half marathon at 11:00. Food and drink for everyone who finishes. Changing rooms and toilets are at Bjarghallen, approximately 250 metres from the start. Parking is available at Bjarghallen, but capacity is limited; public transport or carpooling is recommended. Clothing can be stored in a tent in the start area at your own risk. Late registration is possible up to the start, subject to availability. The start and finish are at the parking lot in Hordnesskogen. Bjarghallen is approximately 250 metres from the start. Registration is through EQ Timing, and late registration is possible up to the start if places are available.

name: Bekkjavatnet Opp
organizer: Ytre Hafstad Kreativ HUB og Førde IL
description: Bekkjavatnet Opp is a short, steep uphill race by Bekkjevatnet in Førde. The race follows a popular local hiking trail where participants can compete against friends. The event has attracted a large turnout and has been combined with activities and a gathering at Flatene School.
course_highlights: Short, steep uphill course by Bekkjevatnet
Local hiking trail in Førde
Winning times under ten minutes have been reported for a previous edition
additional: Previous editions have featured food sales, activities for all ages and a prize-giving ceremony, with Flatene School as the gathering place. Førde IL has handled registration and timing.

name: Trysilmila
description: Trysilmila is a trail race held in Østby in Trysil, suitable for both children and adults. The race offers varied terrain and beautiful scenery, and largely follows the Trysil Skimaraton course. It is a social and inclusive race day focused on the joy of running and a great atmosphere, with separate children’s races over suitable distances. All participants receive a finisher’s medal, and prizes are awarded in both the children’s race and the main races.
course_highlights: Varied surfaces, including gravel (approx. 3.5 km), trail and forest road (approx. 6.5 km), and some asphalt (approx. 200 m) on the 10 km course
Water stations at 3.8 and 7 km on the long course (10 km), and at 3.5 km on the short course (6.5 km)
The course largely follows the Trysil Skimaraton course near Østby
additional: Children’s race start times: 12:00 (ages 0–6, 500 m), 12:05 (ages 7–10, 800 m), 12:10 (ages 11–15, 1.8 km). The short 6.5 km course starts at 12:45 with timing; the long 10 km course starts at 13:00 with timing. The race office, parking and changing rooms are at Østby Samfunnshus near the stadium area. Bib collection and prize-giving take place at the race office on race day. Trysilmila is part of Trysildobbelen together with Trysil Skimaraton, with prizes for combined results.

name: Level-løp
description: Level Løp is a trail race for everyone, held in the beautiful surroundings of Hommersåk. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and 23 km, as well as a 1,000-metre children’s race, with varied terrain and elevation changes to suit both recreational and experienced runners. The race starts at Riska Church and features lovely trails, forest and challenging climbs. After finishing, participants can enjoy hot food and drinks, and prizes are awarded to the top men and women in all the main distances.
course_highlights: A trail race through Hommersåk’s varied and beautiful terrain
23 km with 1,100 metres of elevation gain, 10 km with 246 metres and 5 km with 87 metres
Water stations on the 10 km and 23 km courses
additional: Race bib collection is on Friday 14 August from 15:00 to 19:00 at Amboltveien 9, and on race day from 08:00 at the start area. Race-day registration is available at the start area from 08:00 to 12:45. The children’s race is divided into waves by age. Hot food and drinks are provided to all participants in the 23 km race. A kiosk sells hot food, snacks and drinks. Parking is at Riska Church, not at the start area. Toilets and changing rooms are available at the start/finish. Live results with finish times are available. Prizes are awarded on a rolling basis after runners finish. One prize is drawn at random from the race bib numbers. Scheduled start times are 09:00 for 23 km, 10:00 for 10 km, 10:20 for 5 km and 13:30 for the children’s race. The 10 km and 23 km races are for participants born in 2012 or earlier.

name: Skånevik Skyrace
description: Skånevik Skyrace is a spectacular mountain race on a challenging 24-kilometre circular course with 1,600 metres of elevation gain across varied and technical terrain. The race offers fantastic views of fjords and mountains, combining raw nature with the joy of running for both recreational runners and elite athletes. The start and finish are in Skånevik town centre, where activities create a lively atmosphere both on the course and in town. The event features official timing, several drink stations, and a wide range of participant amenities, including access to a pool, sauna and massage after the race.
course_highlights: 24 km circular course with 1,600 metres of elevation gain
Steep climbs and technical terrain with flowing trail sections
Fantastic panoramic views from Håfjellet (932 m above sea level) and Nepo (610 m above sea level)
additional: Start and finish at Skånevik Fjordhotell, with a Base Camp for race-number collection, information, music, food and a great atmosphere. Three drink stations along the course and several timing checkpoints. Free access to Sjøkanten Trivsel, including a pool, sauna and massage after the race. Minimum age: 16; runners must pass Juraskar by 3:00 p.m. Accommodation is available at Skånevik Fjordhotell and nearby Airbnb properties, camping and boat moorings. Registration for 2027 is sold out, but places may become available in May 2027. The 2027 edition is sold out; any available places may be released in May 2027. Minimum age: 16, and runners must pass Juraskar by 3:00 p.m. Participants receive food and drinks at 3–4 drink stations, a medal and a buff.

name: Kniveåsen Rundt
location: Pumpehuset ved Solumstrand renseanlegg, Drammen, Norway
description: Kniveåsen Rundt is a forest race around Kniveåsen in Drammen that welcomes everyone to participate. The race is free and suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking for an outdoor experience in forest terrain. The event has an inclusive atmosphere and is held annually, offering great opportunities to enjoy running in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Forest race around Kniveåsen in Drammen
Natural terrain with varied surfaces
Suitable for all levels
additional: The race is free to enter. Results from previous years and event videos are available on the website. The race is open to everyone. Registration is linked from the official website.

name: Budor løpefest 2027
description: Budor løpefest 2027 takes place on Saturday, 14 August, at Budor Gjestegård and offers 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon distances. The event offers an inclusive atmosphere for experienced runners and beginners alike, with the start and finish at Gjestegården. The courses run through scenic surroundings on trails and gravel roads, offering a spectacular running experience with beautiful panoramic views. The event also includes a free children’s race, Koiedalen rundt, with a medal for participants. Prizes are awarded to the three fastest finishers in each category in the 5 km, 10 km and 21 km races.
course_highlights: The courses run mainly on trails and gravel roads through scenic surroundings
Start and finish at Budor Gjestegård, with panoramic views
The half marathon has only 250 places and offers a memorable running experience
additional: Race numbers can be collected between 09:00 and 10:30 at Gjestegården. The half marathon starts at 10:00, the 10 km at 10:30 and the 5 km at 10:40. There are toilets and a few showers in the basement of Gjestegården, as well as the option to swim in Koiedalsvannet near the finish area. The children’s race, Koiedalen rundt, starts at 13:00 and is free. You can sell your race entry by contacting the organiser by email. All distances start and finish at Budor Gjestegård. Listed schedule: half marathon at 10:00, 10 km at 10:30 and 5 km at 10:40. The half marathon has 250 places, and the children’s race, Koiedalen rundt, is free.

name: Backyard ultra Golsfjellet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Backyard Deltakere kr 750,00 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3% transaksjonsgebyr)

description: Backyard Ultra Golsfjellet is a unique trail race with no asphalt, offering participants a full experience of fresh mountain air and scenic surroundings. The race is based at Oset Fjellhotell, which is exclusively booked for the event and filled with runners, supporters, and a great backyard atmosphere throughout the weekend. This is more than just a race; it is also a social weekend experience focused on food and spending time together, with all meals for runners prepared by the hotel’s renowned kitchen. The race is suitable for anyone looking for a challenging and social experience in the mountains.
course_highlights: The race takes place entirely on mountain terrain with no asphalt
Start and finish at Oset Fjellhotell, exclusively booked for the event
Delicious refreshments and food prepared by Oset Fjellhotell’s kitchen during breaks
additional: Race bibs and ankle chips can be collected at Oset Fjellhotell on Friday, August 14, from 19:00 to 21:00 and Saturday, August 15, from 07:30 to 08:30. The entire hotel is booked for the event, and a 20% discount is available for a two-night stay with discount code BYOSET. A pasta party is held on Friday evening and a gala dinner on Saturday evening, but neither is included in registration. A hotel buffet on Saturday evening is available to participants for 495 kr when reserved. Food and drink are central to the race, with easy access to refreshments during breaks. Accommodation and some meals are not included in the entry fee. The 2027 registration is listed with an Early Bird price.

name: Schierker Sommerlauf
description: The Schierker Summer Run is a traditional race in the Harz, taking place for the 24th time. The event offers varied distances from 1 km to 16 km, running through the impressive landscape around Schierke. Runners enjoy breathtaking views, a unique atmosphere, and great support in the finish area at the Schierker Feuersteinarena. The race is part of the new Harzer Laufcup 2026 and is open to runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Run on paved forest roads, with two laps for the 8 km main race
Breathtaking views of the Brocken and the Harz landscape
Start and finish at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, with a great atmosphere
additional: The start and finish are at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, which has changing rooms and showers. The course follows paved forest roads. There is a refreshment station at the newly built toboggan run. Registration is online, and early registrants receive personalized race numbers. Use of the showers is included in the entry fee. The event is part of the Harzer Laufcup 2026. Courses on paved forest roads, online registration, personalized race numbers, refreshments included, electronic timing, certificates and trophies for the winners.

name: Dülmener Wasserlauf mit 5 km Walking
location: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Dülmen Water Run with 5 km walking takes place in Dülmen. The event offers runners and walkers the opportunity to take part in 5 km and 10 km races. The race takes place at the Sportzentrum Nord and promises pleasant conditions in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny skies. Please note that the exact event details should be checked with the organizer before registering.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km and 10 km
Venue: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen
Typical August weather, around 25 °C and mostly sunny
additional: The event offers a team classification in which four runners start together, and places special emphasis on water and environmental protection. The event is family-friendly and open to runners of all ability levels.

name: Hambacher Volkslauf
description: The Hambach Volkslauf takes place in Niederzier-Hambach and offers races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. There are also 10 km walking and Nordic walking routes. The courses are measured by the DLV and are part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and looks forward to a large turnout.
course_highlights: Measured courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon
10 km walking and Nordic walking routes
Part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup
additional: Registration is now open via the website. Course maps and the event information are available as PDFs. The event is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. Courses measured, online registration, part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup

name: 100MeilenBerlin - Der Mauerweglauf
description: The 100MeilenBerlin – The Wall Trail Run is a historically significant ultramarathon that follows the route of the former Berlin Wall around western Berlin. The course of approximately 161 kilometers runs mostly on paved paths, but also includes trail-like and sometimes uneven sections. The start and finish are at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Sportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. The race commemorates the victims of the division of Germany and is held annually, with the running direction alternating.

name: 2. Backyard Ultra-Marathon Tharandter Wald
description: The 2nd Backyard Ultra Marathon in the Tharandt Forest is organized by SC Freital e.V. and takes place in one of Saxony’s most beautiful forest regions. The course is a 6.7 km loop, mostly on forest trails, run alternately clockwise and counterclockwise. The start and finish area is at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg. A total of 100 starting places are available, and registration is via RaceResult.

name: Josef Kaderhandt-Waldlauf Plus
description: The 42nd Josef Kaderhandt Forest Run in Menden is a long-established running event organized by Marathon-Club Menden e.V. The course follows paved forest trails through the scenic Sauerland and offers a sporting challenge with demanding sections. In addition to the classic 20 km forest run, runners can take part in the 20 km Plus Marathon and extend their distance to an ultramarathon of up to 50 km by completing additional laps. The race starts in Waldemei near the Kolping Memorial Stone and finishes at Bürgerbad Leitmecke. There is also a 7.8 km fun run for everyone who enjoys running.

name: WoKiMen
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: WoKiMen is a family-friendly running day at Parc de Tarbes in Altenkirchen, offering a variety of running and activity options for children, adults, teams, walkers, Nordic walkers, and even dog owners. Children can run 0.5 km or 2 km, while adults can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. The TeamChallenge is a relay race with three 1 km legs. In addition to the races, there is a varied program featuring yoga, Zumbathlon, and an adventure course. The day ends with a relaxing Chill & Grill event featuring Nepalese specialties, Italian wood-fired pizza, popcorn, coffee, and cake.

name: 303 Maraton Antoniego Fili
description: The 303 Antoni Fili Marathon is a marathon held in Sztum, Mazowieckie. Runners have access to a training plan tailored to their level, helping them prepare optimally for the race. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to runners of various experience levels. The event takes place annually, and in 2026 it will be held on August 15.
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. The race listing can be managed and marketing partnerships arranged through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz - Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and join a close-knit running community in Wielkopolska and beyond.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The beauty of the proposed locations
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts

name: XII Rozłaziński Bieg po radość z życia
Rubjerg Knude løbet 2027
distance_verbose: Halvmarathon, 20 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See
location: Kurpark am Kanal, Bad Bederkesa, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See is a running event for participants of all ages and abilities, held on the third Sunday in August in Bad Bederkesa. The course passes through a natural setting and offers a motivating challenge for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event promotes community and the joy of being active, making it a special experience for both race participants and recreational runners. The start and finish are in Kurpark am Kanal, and timing is by transponder.
course_highlights: Scenic course around Beerster See
Start and finish in Kurpark am Kanal
Free drinks on the opposite side of the lake and at the finish
additional: Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune opposite the castle. Showers are available at the Moortherme upon presentation of your race number. Timing is by transponder, which must be returned after the race. The cut-off time for the main races is 1 hour 45 minutes. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Course distances: 7.6 km; hiking, walking and Nordic walking: 1.1 km, 0.5 km and 14.6 km. Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Timing is by transponder.

name: Breitunger Pleßlauf
location: Sporthalle am Riegelsweg, Breitungen/Werra, Thuringia, Germany
description: The Breitunger Pleßlauf takes place in Breitungen/Werra and offers running distances from 1 km to 30 km, as well as 10.7 km Nordic walking. The event is organized by SV Lauftreff Breitungen e.V. and starts and finishes at the sports hall on Riegelsweg. The varied courses are suitable for both children and experienced runners. In addition to the sporting challenge, the event offers timing with a disposable chip, trophies and prizes for the fastest participants, and finisher medals for the main distances.
course_highlights: Running distances from 1 km to 30 km
10.7 km Nordic walking
Start and finish at the sports hall on Riegelsweg in Breitungen
additional: Late entries are possible until 45 minutes before each start, with a late-entry fee of €5 for the main distances and Nordic walking. Timing uses a disposable chip provided by GO timing. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the sports hall. Trophies are awarded to the three fastest finishers in the main-distance races, and the winners receive prizes and cash awards. All finishers of the main-distance races receive a laser-engraved medal. Course profiles, mountain run, online registration, results, photos, videos, dates in 2024–2026

name: Run´n Roll for Help
description: The Run´n Roll for Help is a long-standing city run in Giessen that has been delighting runners for over 28 years. Every year, the streets of the city center turn into a sporting highlight, where the charitable cause is just as important as the competition. With over 1,200 participants in 2025 and more than €19,000 raised for Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe, the event is a major charity running festival in the region. The event offers a great atmosphere and warmly welcomes everyone who loves running.

name: Wohldenberger Waldlauf
description: The 21st Wohldenberger Forest Run offers runners of all ability levels varied routes through Wohldenberger Forest. For over two decades, this event has been one of the most popular in the Hildesheim region, attracting 200 to 300 participants each year. The course follows natural forest trails with changing surfaces and hilly sections, making it a true trail-running experience. There are suitable distances for beginners, families, walkers, and ambitious runners, from short children’s races to the challenging half marathon.

name: Wolfsburg Staffellauf powered by VfL Wob e.V.
description: The Wolfsburg Relay Race, organized by VfL Wolfsburg e.V., is a special team experience that brings together runners of all ages and backgrounds. This second edition of the relay marathon gives teams from schools, clubs, and companies the chance to enjoy the spirit of sport and teamwork together. The course runs through the green Stadtforst forest, with the start and finish at VW-Bad, where music will also add to the atmosphere. Children’s relay teams are supported by Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V., making participation particularly appealing.

name: Marceliński Bieg Letni 2026
description: Marceliński Summer Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.

name: XXI Bieg Lesoków
description: The 21st Lesoków Run is an annual race held in Szemud as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event offers two routes, 5 and 10 km long, through the picturesque Kashubian countryside, encouraging participants to enjoy the outdoors. It attracts runners of different ages and experience levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.

name: Blodomloppet (Jönköping)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lilla Blodomloppet för barn upp till 12 år kostar 100 kr och kan anmälas till denna avgift ända fram tills dagen loppet går.

description: Blodomloppet in Jönköping is a recreational event that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. There is also a children’s race, Lilla Blodomloppet, for children up to 12 years old, with shorter courses. The event is a social and health-promoting activity where teams and individual participants can take part, and each team receives a picnic bag as part of the entry fee. Blodomloppet is part of Sweden’s largest recreational race series, with a strong focus on health and the importance of blood donation.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km and 10 km runs
Untimed 5 km walk
Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old, with 400/800 m courses
additional: Teams can consist of 3–5 participants, and vacant places can be filled at no extra cost until 5 August by email. Registered blood donors receive a 40 kr discount when registering. A picnic bag from ICA is included with team registration and can be ordered separately for 250 kr each. Wellness allowances can be used via Wellnet, Epassi or Benify. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to 12 years old, with shorter 400/800-metre courses. The event raises awareness of the need for blood donation. Participants can form teams, and the event usually ends with a picnic.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/jonkoping/): 2027-08-17 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 17 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-10)

name: Vestfold løpskarusell - 6. løp - Revetal

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 kr. for ikke medlemmer frem til 31.12.26.

description: Vestfold Running Series 2027 is a series of 8 great races in the Tønsberg region, offering the joy of running, a sense of community and a great atmosphere for all levels. Each race has two distances and starts at 18:00, with electronic timing via EQ Timing. Participants can choose to run individual races or buy a season pass for all the races at a discounted price. The courses pass through varied and beautiful surroundings in Vestfold, and course descriptions are shared in a Facebook group and when registering for the season.
course_highlights: Two distances at each race, typically around 3 km and a double lap
Courses pass through varied terrain, including residential areas, lit trails and gravel roads
Start and finish at central locations such as the Sport1 store in Revetal
additional: Season-pass participants collect their race bib at the first race, while participants in individual races collect theirs at the race office 10 minutes before the start. The race bib must be kept for the entire series. Course descriptions and profiles are shared in the Facebook group and when registering for the season. Start at 18:00. Season passes and registration for individual races are available.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Fløymyrløpet
description: Flømyrløpet is the seventh race in the Sørdalskarusellen and has been held since 2001. The start and finish are at Skurvbrua by Nordseterveien, 6 km above Lillehammer. The race offers a tough, wet trail run over challenging terrain, including marshy sections and trails. There are two distances: a 5.4 km long course and a 2.81 km short course. The short course follows the long course up to Flømyra and then heads downhill to the finish. The race has a mass start and a virtual option, and is a traditional part of the Sørdalskarusellen, with a prize ceremony after the race.
course_highlights: A challenging 5.4 km trail run with wet and marshy sections
Start and finish at Skurvbrua, 6 km from Lillehammer city centre
The course follows a ski trail route up to the Flømyra shooting range, then continues along trails and roads back
additional: All mass starts begin at 18:30. The virtual race takes place 15–18 August. The discounted entry deadline is 13:00 on race day; the final entry deadline is 18:00 the same day. The prize ceremony is at approximately 19:15. The under-12 category uses the short course. It is possible to run the short course without timing. The course was adjusted in 2023 to avoid the worst of the marsh. Participants must register their time on My Page under the Self Timing tab. Flømyrløpet is part of the Sørdalskarusellen, a series of ten recreational races in the Lillehammer area. There is a long course of approximately 5.4 km and a short course of approximately 2.8 km.

name: Blodomløpet 2027
organizer: Røde Kors Blodprogram, i samarbeid med Blodbanken Ahus og lokale friidrettslag
description: Blodomløpet is a fun run organized by the Norwegian Red Cross Blood Programme in cooperation with local blood banks and athletics clubs. The event focuses on raising awareness of blood donation and promoting a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog or run 500 metres, 5 km or 10 km, and proceeds from registration go to local athletics clubs that support children and young people. Inspired by Sweden’s largest fun run, the event aims to help create a healthier Norway without blood shortages.
course_highlights: Choice of 500-metre, 5 km and 10 km distances
The courses are clearly marked and include both paved and gravel surfaces
Proceeds go to local athletics clubs that support children and young people
additional: Registration is binding and entitles participants to a place in the event and a one-time licence where required. Participants may enter individually or as part of a team (maximum 5 participants). Photos and videos will be taken during the event and may be used for documentation and marketing. By registering, participants enter into an agreement with the organizing clubs and partners.

name: Hagbloms Nattloppet
description: Hagbloms Nattloppet in Kalmar is a unique running experience, inviting you to walk, jog or run 5 km in a wonderful atmosphere with music, lighting and surprises along the course. The start and finish are at Stortorget, where runners also pass through on each lap. All participants receive a special medal and, if they register in advance, a unique T-shirt, as well as a drink, fruit and a piece of chocolate. The race is open to both men and women, and there is also a walking class without timing. The event is organised by Högby IF with support from Hagbloms and other sponsors.
course_highlights: 5 km course with the start, lap point and finish at Stortorget in Kalmar
Run at your own pace with music and lighting along the way
Special medal for everyone who finishes
additional: Race bib collection and late registration take place at the Högby tent at Stortorget on Thursday 20 August from 15:00 to 17:00 and on Friday 21 August from 18:00. Payment can be made by card, cash or Swish. Everyone registered by 16 August receives the Nattloppet’s unique T-shirt. Prizes are raffled, including gift cards from Kallskänken. Open to walkers, joggers and competitive runners. Everyone who finishes receives a medal; participants who register in advance also receive the race’s unique T-shirt.

name: Bürener Volkslauf - Hochstift-Cup
description: The Bürener Volkslauf is a traditional running event in Büren. The races cover various distances, including Bambini, children’s, school and company races, on paved courses with little elevation change through the scenic Aftetal. All participants receive certificates, and the top runners are awarded trophies. The event is part of the Hochstift Cup and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 5 km out-and-back course through the scenic Aftetal
Fully paved course with little elevation change
800 m school and children’s races on the 400 m track
additional: Certificates for all participants. Trophies for places 1–3 (men/women/diverse) in the overall standings. The City of Büren Challenge Cup for first place in the team standings. Special prize for the team with the most participants (company runners only). Certificates can be printed using the “race result” running software after the event. Race numbers and transponders will be issued. Changing and shower facilities are available. Parking options and travel information will be provided. The courses are challenging, with little elevation change. Registration closes on the day of the event; registration is via MY RACERESULT.

name: Schleswiger Treppenlauf
description: The Schleswig Stair Run takes place for the 13th time in 2026 and features a new, attractive course starting and finishing at the Polierteich. Participants complete 10 laps with a total of approximately 940 steps, mostly on firm sand. The event offers both individual and duo competitions, with ample parking available at Stadtfeld. It is a sporting challenge in Schleswig, organised by the Spiridon Schleswig running club.
course_highlights: 10 laps with approximately 940 steps
