Mostly firm sand underfoot
Start and finish at the Polierteich
additional: Start and finish at the Polierteich; ample parking at Stadtfeld; event runs from 18:30 to 21:00; individual and duo competitions available; mostly firm sand underfoot. Registration is open; parking at Stadtfeld; running time from 18:30 to 21:00.

name: 11. Lichterlauf Tangermünde
description: The Tangermünde Lights Run is an atmospheric race right on the Elbe in the historic imperial town of Tangermünde. Runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in a range of distances, including a children’s run, a 5 km fun run, a 10 km main race, and a team relay. The course runs along the picturesque Elbe promenade and offers a special atmosphere, followed by an after-run party in Tangermünde. The race is a community sporting event that puts fun, exercise, and team spirit center stage.

name: 19. Barßeler Hafenfestlauf
description: The 19th Barßeler Hafenfestlauf takes place near Barßel Harbor. The event offers races for various age groups, including Bambini races, schoolchildren’s races, a 5-kilometer race, Nordic walking, and a 10-kilometer main race. The course runs along paved roads and is suitable for all age groups. The event is organized by the Sport- und Turnverein Barßel and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, a supporting program, and refreshments.

name: Buntekuhlauf
description: Der Buntekuhlauf des SC Buntekuh e.V. in Lübeck ist eine vielseitige Laufveranstaltung für alle Altersgruppen und Leistungsniveaus. Die Strecken reichen von kurzen Läufen auf dem Sportplatzgelände bis hin zu längeren Distanzen, die mehrfach über Gehwege führen. Die Veranstaltung legt Wert auf Spaß an der Bewegung und bietet verschiedene Wettbewerbe, darunter Staffelläufe und Walking. Die Teilnahmebedingungen sind klar geregelt, und die Startunterlagen werden am Veranstaltungstag sowie am Vorabend ausgegeben.
course_highlights: Strecken auf dem Sportplatzgelände für 750 m und 1,5 km Läufe
5 km Strecke auf Gehwegen, keine Straßen- oder Radwegfreigabe
10 km und 15 km Strecken durch mehrfaches Durchlaufen der 5 km Runde
additional: Startunterlagen werden am 20. August 2027 von 18 bis 20 Uhr und am Veranstaltungstag ab 15 Uhr ausgegeben. Nachmeldungen sind bis zum 16. August 2027 um 20:00 Uhr möglich, danach eventuell am Veranstaltungstag, jedoch nicht garantiert. Es gibt keine personalisierte Startnummer, aber Urkunden werden mit den üblichen Angaben ausgegeben. Ummeldungen sind frühzeitig kostenlos möglich, später mit Gebühr.

name: Volkslauf Um die Taakener Ähren
description: The “Um die Taakener Ähren” fun run is a popular, family-friendly running event in Taaken. The event offers various races for all age groups, from a Bambini run and races for schoolchildren and joggers to the competitive 10 km main race and a relay. The course runs through the village of Taaken and its idyllic fields of grain, with fun and community at its heart. All participants receive pastries at the finish, and the winners are awarded traditional winner’s loaves. The village provides refreshments and drink stands, creating a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Mottenburger Meile
description: The Mottenburger Meile is a traditional cult race on the Elbe in Hamburg, held annually on the Friday after the Hamburg school holidays. The precisely measured out-and-back course is 7.5 km, equivalent to a Prussian land mile. The race starts and finishes on the banks of the Elbe below Halbmondweg/Elbchaussee and offers a romantic atmosphere with evening lighting. In addition to the sporting competition, the race supports the Hamburger Spendenparlament and remembers the Jewish victims of the Holocaust with a Stolperstein.

name: Anholt Rundt 2027
distance_verbose: 44.5 km, Marathon, 23 km, Halvmarathon, 10 km, 5.5 km

name: Ultravasan
description: Ultravasan 90 is a trail race starting in Berga by, Sälen, offering runners the classic Vasaloppet route through scenic summer landscapes. The race starts at dawn at 05:00 and follows the historic checkpoints to the finish in Mora, with views of pine forests, waterways, trails and traditional mountain farm settings. The race is 92 km long, has Swedish Championship status in 2026 and is part of Vasaloppstrippeln; the maximum number of participants is 2,500, and the minimum age is 17.
course_highlights: Dawn start at 05:00 in Berga by—watch the sun rise over the marshes around Smågan
Seven Vasaloppet checkpoints along the course, with drinks, energy, toilets and medical care
Scenic stretches through open pine forests, winding waterways, well-trodden trails and picturesque traditional mountain farm settings
additional: Race bibs and chips can be collected in Mora or Sälen in the days before the race, or at the start venue. Start pens open at 04:30, and your time starts when you cross the start line. Baggage transport to Mora is available, and you can send a change-of-clothes bag to Evertsberg. There are refreshment stations approximately every five kilometres, as well as toilets and medical care at all checkpoints. Maximum 2,500 participants; training grants of SEK 60,000 are awarded to the winner in each of the women’s and men’s categories. Ultravasan consists of two longer ultramarathon distances: Ultravasan 90 (Sälen–Mora, approximately 92 km) and Ultravasan 45 (Oxberg–Mora, approximately 45 km). Both finish in Mora and are part of Vasaloppet’s Summer Week.

name: Vasastafetten
description: Vasastafetten is a cross-country relay race held as a festival, where hundreds of teams made up of clubs, companies, families and groups of friends share the classic route from Sälen to Mora. It is the oldest event of the summer and offers a challenging course covering a total of 92 kilometres, divided into ten legs ranging from 4.5 to 15 kilometres. The race starts in Berga by in Sälen and welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners aged 8 and over. The entry fee includes bus transport for participants on the first two legs, and the organiser sends the team captain the race pack with bib numbers and information well in advance of the race.
course_highlights: Cross-country race between Sälen and Mora
Ten legs ranging from 4.5 to 15 km
Start in Berga by, Sälen, and finish in Mora
additional: The race pack with bib numbers and an information letter is sent to the team captain approximately two weeks before the race. The timing chip must be collected on race day at the Vasaloppet start in Sälen between 06:30 and 08:00. A bus ticket to the start for leg 1 must be booked, and runners on leg 2 must take the organiser's bus to Smågan. For legs 2 to 10, teams are responsible for their own transport to and from the changeover points.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://vasaloppet.se/lopning/vasastafetten-lopning/): 2027-08-21 — "Vasastafetten 2027 Datum 21 augusti" (was estimated 2027-08-14)

name: Midnattsloppet Göteborg
description: Midnattsloppet Göteborg is a festive, high-energy night race that winds through the city’s lively streets and along Avenyn, starting and finishing at Gustaf Adolfs torg. The race offers two distances, 5.2 km and 10 km, giving participants a unique experience with music, spectators and the joy of running late into the evening. Midnattsloppet is more than just a race—it’s a celebration and a memorable experience that brings together runners of all ages and abilities. In addition to individual races, there are team and corporate competitions that encourage togetherness and the joy of being active.
course_highlights: Two-lap course through central Gothenburg and along Avenyn
Start and finish at Gustaf Adolfs torg
Festive atmosphere with music and spectators along the course
additional: Start times: the 10 km starts at 21:15, the 5.2 km starts at 22:54, the costume start for the 10 km is at 21:48 and for the 5.2 km at 23:00. The time limit for the 10 km is 90 minutes from the last start group. At the 5 km lap point, runners arriving after 22:36 will not be allowed to continue for the second lap. A race pack and T-shirt are included with registration. You can use your wellness allowance through Benifex, Epassi and Benefits. Companies can purchase value codes for team and corporate competitions. The first start for the 10 km is at 21:15 and for the 5.2 km at 22:54. The 5.2 km entry fee includes, among other things, a T-shirt, timing, water along the course, refreshments after finishing and a digital diploma. A medal can be purchased separately.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://midnattsloppet.com/midnattsloppet-goteborg/): 2027-08-21 — "Datum: 21 augusti 2027 Distans: 10 km Första start: kl. 21.15" (was estimated 2027-09-04)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Datum: 21 augusti 2027 Distans: 10 km Första start: kl. 21.15

name: Vossaton
description: Vossaton is a running event in Voss with distances for competitive runners, recreational runners and children. The programme includes a half marathon, 5 km, corporate relay and children’s race. The half-marathon course goes around Vangsvatnet, while the 5 km and children’s race start and finish at the sports ground. Welcome to a race day for the whole family!
course_highlights: Half-marathon course around Vangsvatnet
5 km and children’s race start and finish at the sports ground
The courses are officially measured
additional: In 2026, the half marathon and corporate relay started at 11:00, the children’s race at 11:10 and the 5 km at 11:30. The half marathon started at Gjernes kindergarten.

name: Vikerfjell Challenge
description: Vikerfjell Challenge is a trail race for all levels, with distances of 21 km and 11 km, plus a separate 2.5 km children’s race. The courses pass through the beautiful Vikerfjell Nature Reserve, over varied terrain including gravel roads and trails. Start and finish locations are Ringerudsetra, Tossviksetra and Skarrudsetra. The event offers fantastic scenery and a great atmosphere, and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: The courses pass through Vikerfjell Nature Reserve
Terrain includes gravel roads, trails and varied surfaces
Start and finish locations are Ringerudsetra, Tossviksetra and Skarrudsetra
additional: The race offers distances of 21 km, 11 km and a 2.5 km children’s race. Start and finish locations are at several mountain farms in the area. The courses offer varied terrain and scenic experiences. Aid stations, toilets, showers and baggage storage are available. Parking and transport information can be found on the website. The event also includes a 2.5 km children’s race. Start and finish locations vary by distance.

name: Skåbu fjellmaraton (Jotunheimvegen Ultra)
description: Jotunheimvegen Ultra is a spectacular ultra race starting at Bygdin Høifjellshotell on Valdresflya and following Jotunheimvegen, with fantastic views of the peaks of Jotunheimen. The race follows a gravel road past idyllic mountain farms along Vinstervatna, and from approximately 38 km, runners follow the marathon course to the finish in Skåbu town centre, with a tough final climb up Kamfossbakken. This race offers a challenging and scenic experience in high-mountain terrain, with several food and drink stations along the way. Skåbu Fjellmaraton also offers several distances to suit all levels, but Jotunheimvegen Ultra is the highlight for ultra runners.
course_highlights: Start at Bygdin Høifjellshotell on Valdresflya, approximately 12 km from Beitostølen
The race follows Jotunheimvegen, with views of the peaks of Jotunheimen and idyllic mountain farms along Vinstervatna
The final 3 km feature a tough climb up Kamfossbakken to the finish in Skåbu town centre
additional: Race bibs not collected in Skåbu are sent by bus in the morning and can be collected at the start. Luggage can be sent by bus to the finish and collected at the race office. Six drink and food stations along the way, offering sports drink, water, bananas and cola. Cut-off time at the Slangen food station is 14:00; runners arriving after that may continue at their own risk or get a ride to the finish. Timing by eqtiming.no, with split times at Slangen and Kamfossbakken. The “King and Queen of Kamfossen” hill-climb competition takes place at the split-time point in Kamfossbakken. Late registration is available until 1 hour before the start. Parking is at Skåbu school, not at the finish area. Toilets and showers are available at the school. There are six food and drink stations along the way, with the first after 14 km. Bus transport between Skåbu and Bygdin can be booked as an add-on when registering.

name: Øygarden backyard
description: Øygarden Backyard Ultra is the first ultra race in Øygarden, organised by Skogsvåg Idrettslag. The race takes place on a 6.7 km loop that starts and finishes at Skogsvåg Stadium, with a mix of asphalt, trail and gravel. Participants run one loop every hour and can choose to run from one to twelve loops, with the opportunity to set personal records over the half-marathon, marathon or ultra distances. The event has a social and inclusive atmosphere, with a focus on being accessible and creating a great atmosphere. Medals are also awarded to those who complete various distances, and simple food and drinks are served during the event.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with 80% asphalt, 12% trail/forest road and 8% gravel
Start and finish at Skogsvåg Stadium, with a view of Kvalvågen
The course includes a forest road, a trail down to Sangoltshopen and a gravel road back
additional: Race briefing at 09:45 with the race director. Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 to 09:45 at Skogsvåg Stadium. The race starts promptly at 10:00. Changing rooms and toilets are available near the start. Free parking is available in several areas around the stadium. Soft drinks, bread with toppings, crisps and something hot are served in the evening. A reflective vest is mandatory when running in the dark. The race takes place on an open course with traffic; runners must take care when crossing roads. Everyone who completes more than 4 loops receives a half-marathon badge; more than 7 loops earns a marathon badge. Children under 13 may take part in 1 loop (6.7 km) and receive a medal.

name: Høyjord Rundt og Rundt
description: Høyjord Rundt og Rundt is a varied race suitable for all levels, with distances from 6.1 km to 77 km. The course features technically challenging terrain with approximately 470 metres of elevation gain per lap, including trails, gravel roads and beautiful viewpoints. The event also includes a children’s race with an obstacle course and an untimed recreational run, so the whole family can take part and have fun. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and food and drinks are available in the start/finish area. The race is organised by Høyjord Idrettslag and emphasises the joy of running, community and a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Approximately 470 metres of elevation gain per 11 km lap, with technically challenging trails
Beautiful viewpoint at approximately 7 km on the course
Snack station with snacks and drinks at 2.5 km
additional: Dogs are not allowed on the technical courses, but dogs on a leash are permitted in the recreational run. Pacing is not allowed. The children’s race takes place on the artificial turf pitch and includes an obstacle course and a separate medal. The extra service offers the option to walk or run shorter distances without timing during the week before the race. Food and drinks are available in the start/finish area, including snacks, broth, coffee, cola, hot food and fruit. The race has a zero-tolerance policy for littering and requires mandatory equipment according to the equipment list. Registration is via Racetracker. The children’s race includes an obstacle course. The untimed extra service is available on Thursday or Friday of race week.

name: Haglebu Backyard Ultra
description: Haglebu Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon held in scenic Eggedal, Sigdal municipality, Buskerud. The race follows the Backyard Ultra format, with participants running a lap of approximately 6.7 km every hour until only one runner remains. The event attracts endurance runners seeking a challenging and sociable experience in beautiful Norwegian countryside. It is organized by Varde VVS Endurance Team, a local sports club focused on endurance sports.
course_highlights: The course winds through scenic surroundings in Eggedal, Buskerud
Backyard Ultra format with laps of approximately 6.7 km every hour
Challenging terrain that tests endurance and tactics
additional: The organizer is Varde VVS Endurance Team, a sports club started by three brothers and a friend from Åmot. No pricing or registration details are listed on the Facebook page.

name: Langhusløpet
organizer: Langhusløperne i samarbeid med Langhus IL Alliansen
description: Langhusløpet 2027 is an inclusive race for all ages and levels, held at Haugjordet ungdomsskole in Langhus. Participants can choose between a children’s race, 5 km and 10 km, with a medal for everyone and a bun for every child. The race combines paved roads with forest roads and trails, and has a friendly, social atmosphere focused on the joy of running and community. Bag storage is available, and race bibs can be collected both the day before and on race day.
course_highlights: 10 km course with 75% paved roads and 25% forest roads and trails
400-metre children’s race, with a medal and a bun for every child
Start and finish at Haugjordet ungdomsskole, with bag storage available
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Friday 13 August at Löplabbet in Ski Storsenter from 10:00 to 19:00, and on race day from 9:30 to 10:45 at the race office at Haugjordet ungdomsskole. Prizes are awarded to the top three men and women in the 5 km and 10 km races. All participants take part at their own risk, and parents are responsible for children taking part. The minimum age is 10 for the 5 km and 13 for the 10 km. The children’s race is open to everyone.

name: Førde Rundt
description: Førde rundt is a fun street race in the centre of Førde, taking place on Saturday 21 August 2027. The race offers three distances: half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, with the same course profile as last year, adapted for para athletes, families and spectators. The course has little elevation and very little gravel, and the start and finish are at Spenst in the south of the city centre. The event is open to all age groups and also includes special categories such as stroller and family classes.
course_highlights: A street race that spends as much time as possible in the city centre
The course has little elevation and almost no gravel
The half marathon includes a 1.1 km loop and four 5 km laps
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at Spenst and Førdehuset. Wave starts with lots of people and positive chaos. Para and stroller classes are accommodated. The family class has a prize draw. It is possible to start the 5 km without a time and to start at any point on the course.

name: Romerikes Råeste 2027
description: Romerikes Råeste is an action-packed obstacle race held in Nannestad’s unique, muddy ravine landscape. The race offers two courses of different lengths and difficulty levels, suitable for children, young people, recreational runners and competitive athletes. The main course is 6 km long with more than 60 obstacles, and there is also a family-friendly children’s course called Råtassen. The event combines challenges, a sense of achievement and community, and is a spectacular outdoor event near Gardermoen.
course_highlights: 6 km main course with more than 60 obstacles
Course through a muddy ravine landscape
Children’s course for ages 3–10 with exciting obstacles
additional: Starts are in groups of approximately 20–30 participants every 5 minutes, with 10–20 in the elite classes. Start and finish at Nannestad Idrettspark. It is possible to pick up your race pack before race day to avoid queues. There is a water station on the main course, but not on the children’s/family course. Romerikes Råeste caps in children’s and adult sizes are available to order when registering. Parking costs 100 kr and is paid via Vipps. The organiser’s website describes the 2026 edition but does not confirm race details for 2027. Råtassen is for children aged 3 to 10; guardians may accompany the children without a separate ticket.

name: Langs Åkrafjorden - 2027
location: Tjelmeland to Teigland, Åkrafjordvegen, Etne, Vestland, Norway
description: Langs Åkrafjorden is an 11-kilometre recreational race from Tjelmeland to Teigland, along the old Åkrafjord Road. The event has been held with options to run, walk or cycle, and with a children’s race near the finish area. The start and finish locations provide a lovely setting for the route along the fjord.
course_highlights: 11 kilometres from Tjelmeland to Teigland
Follows the old Åkrafjord Road along Åkrafjorden
Previous events have offered the option to run, walk or cycle
additional: In 2026, Kyrping Bensinstasjon og Kro was listed as the registration location for the walking and cycling categories.

name: Den Breiale Milen
description: Den Breiale Milen is a race held on Saturday, August 21, 2027, at Kongen Marina in Frognerkilen, Oslo. The race offers two distances, 14.5 km and 9 km, running around Bygdøy on gravel roads and asphalt with approximately 300 meters of elevation gain. This unique race includes a dedicated nose-breathing category, in which participants run with tape over their mouths and breathe through their noses. After the finish, everyone is invited to an after-run with a concert, DJ, and social gathering at Kongen Marina. The event supports Aktiv mot Kreft, and all proceeds go to this cause.
course_highlights: 14.5 km around Bygdøy, starting and finishing at Kongen Marina
The course consists of gravel roads and asphalt, with around 300 meters of elevation gain
Includes some of the most popular Strava segments within Ring 3
additional: Race headquarters opens at 12:30 on race day; bibs are collected at Kongen Marina. Starts are in waves between 14:50 and 15:05. Participants time themselves using a watch or phone and register their time at race headquarters after finishing. Bag storage is at participants' own risk. Toilet facilities at Kongen Marina have limited capacity, with an additional toilet at Paradisbukta. The after-run, with a concert, DJ, and special guests, is open to everyone, including those who did not run. There are draw prizes from event partners. The race has three categories: Dudes (men's category), Dudettes (women's category), and Nesepust (unisex, with tape over the mouth). Starts are in waves between 14:50 and 15:05. Participants time themselves and register their time after finishing. Bibs can be collected at Kongen Marina from 12:30.

name: Detmolder Residenzlauf
description: The Detmold Residenz Run is a traditional running event held in Detmold. It offers various races for children, young people and adults, including a Bambini run, school races, a 5 km fitness run and the 10 km main race. The start and finish are on the market square in Detmold, providing a central and atmospheric setting. The event is supported by Stadtwerke Detmold and AÜG NETZWERK as title sponsors and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and range of award categories.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the market square in Detmold
Various distances from 1.5 km to 10 km
Timing with the Raceresult timing system
additional: Race number collection on the day of the event from 15:30 at the Rathaus am Markt in Detmold. Timing is provided by the Raceresult timing system; personal chips are not permitted. Free admission to the Aqualip leisure pool upon presentation of the race number. Medals for all participating children and young people. Award ceremonies on the market square: school races from approximately 18:30, 10 km race from 20:00. Friedrich-Brakemeier Wanderpokal for the school with the highest participation rate. Vouchers for schools, teams and groups with the most advance registrations. The race attracts numerous participants from the region and, alongside the main distances, offers children’s races and special competitions. Results and certificates are available online.

name: Exter FlexRun! 2026
location: Sparkassen Sportpark Exter, Vlotho, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Exter FlexRun at Sparkassen Sportpark Exter offers a flexible running format for all ability levels. Participants can choose their distance and run up to four laps of 10.5 km each, covering up to the full marathon distance. Relay races, walking and Nordic walking routes, and a children’s race are also available. The event takes place in scenic surroundings and offers a great atmosphere, with refreshments and entertainment on site.
course_highlights: Loop courses along paved paths and mostly asphalt roads in and around Vlotho Exter
Refreshment stations at 4.0 km, 8.5 km, and in Sportpark Exter
Showers, changing rooms, and a wide range of refreshments at Sportpark Exter
additional: The start and finish of all races are at Sportpark Exter. Participants can choose their distance and run up to 4 laps (10.5 km each). The 4 x 10.5 km relay is for teams. Walking/Nordic walking distances are 10.5 km and 21 km. The 1.6 km children’s race is for ages 6 and up. Team and company categories are judged, with awards. Routes are marked and secured by marshals. Registration is via Race Result; the event offers showers, changing rooms, and refreshments and is suitable for families.

name: Heideköniginnenpokal
description: The Heideköniginnenpokal (HeiPo) in Amelinghausen is a traditional fun run, taking place for the 31st time in 2026 as part of the Heideblütenfest week. The challenging routes pass through scenic landscapes, including along Lopausee. The race attracts many participants and is a mainstay of regional running events.
course_highlights: Scenic stretches
Route along Lopausee
Part of the Heideblütenfest week in Amelinghausen
additional: The Amelinghausen running group meets regularly on Mondays and Wednesdays to run together. There is also a beginners’ course that gradually introduces participants to running. The event is part of a lively running-group community that takes part in many fun runs and marathons across Germany. The race takes place in August, with typical summer weather around 25°C and possible rain. There are also children’s races and other fun runs as part of the festival week.

name: Jahn-Gedenklauf
description: The Jahn Memorial Run in Lanz is a traditional running event organized by SV Jahn Lanz e.V. The event takes place at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium and offers various distances, which also count toward the Prignitz Cup. The start time is 10 a.m., and the run is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is supported by Kreissportbund Prignitz e.V. and is a fixture in the regional sports calendar.
course_highlights: Short course: 6.6 km
Long course: 12.5 km
Outside the Prignitz Cup: 3 km
additional: Courses are not suitable for spikes; on-site registration is possible; start at the stadium

name: Münsterland-Sternlauf - Benefizlauf
location: Universitätsklinikum Münster, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Münsterland Star Run is a charity run in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster e.V. at Münster University Hospital. Five routes lead in a star shape from various towns in the Münsterland region to the shared finish at Leonardo Campus in Münster. The run is designed as a stage event, allowing participants to set their own pace and run one or more stages. 100% of the proceeds are donated to Verein zur Förderung krebskranker Kinder Münster e.V. to support the treatment and care of the children affected.
course_highlights: Five routes lead in a star shape from various towns in the Münsterland region to Münster
Mostly farm tracks, footpaths and cycle paths, as well as traffic-calmed streets
Accompanied by stage leaders and a German Red Cross broom wagon; refreshments at stage points
additional: This is not a race, and participants set their own pace. They can run one or more stages, and can start and finish at any stage point. Participants are responsible for their own return transport. For the first time, donations can be made cashlessly. Donation receipts are issued for donations of €200 or more. The run is accompanied by stage leaders and a German Red Cross broom wagon. Refreshments are offered at stage points in cooperation with Kolping families. The run takes place in Münster and promotes social cohesion through sporting commitment.

name: 4. Rammelsberger Steigerlauf
description: The Rammelsberger Steigerlauf is a challenging mountain race in the northern Harz, held at the Rammelsberg UNESCO World Heritage Site in Goslar. The event offers a range of courses with gradients of up to 30%, winding through historic mining landscapes and varied forest and mountain sections. Participants can look forward to professional timing and a unique running experience with an alpine character. Courses range from a short race for children to a marathon and trail race with up to 1,110 meters of elevation gain. The event is aimed at runners, walkers, and trail runners looking to challenge their fitness and sure-footedness.

name: Osnabrücker 6-Stunden-Lauf
distance_verbose: 105 km, 82 km, 41 km, 27 km, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km
description: The Osnabrück 6-Hour Run takes place at Rubbenbruchsee in Osnabrück and celebrates its 10th edition. The run is a charity event supporting HelpAge’s “Every Grandma Counts” campaign and welcomes all runners who want to cover as many kilometres as possible within six hours. Whether you’re an ambitious runner, preparing for a marathon, or simply looking to run, walk or hike together in the beautiful scenery around the lake, everyone is welcome. The event offers individual and relay entries and places great importance on community and supporting a good cause.

name: Sieber Berg- und Panoramalauf
description: The Sieber Mountain and Panorama Run returns after a 14-year break, offering three challenging routes in the Harz with up to 900 metres of elevation gain. The event is handmade and welcoming, and challenges runners of all ability levels. From the family-friendly 4.5 km Nature Experience Route and the 12.5 km Panorama Loop to the 27.5 km queen distance with 900 metres of elevation gain, there is something for everyone. The runs pass through impressive natural scenery with panoramic views and offer a true Harz experience. Alongside the sporting challenge, there is a pasta buffet and a community village festival to round off the day.

name: THE HUMBLE CLUB Backyard Run IV
description: The Humble Club Backyard Run IV on Oker Island in Braunschweig is a unique running experience that combines an athletic challenge with social commitment. The run supports the “Boxing Against Parkinson’s” project and stands for exercise, community, and social responsibility. The event starts at 10:00, with admission from 8:30, and offers participants basic refreshments including still water and fresh fruit, as well as an exclusive finisher’s medal. Participants are asked to bring their own food and drinks so they can refuel properly.

name: Arnstädter Bach-Ultra
description: The Arnstadt Bach Ultra is a 60-kilometer ultramarathon held in Arnstadt. It was created in response to runners’ wish to complete the 60 km relay course as a standalone ultramarathon. The event is organized by SG Motor Arnstadt in cooperation with the Arnstadt municipal administration and features a challenging course through the region. The race is an interesting initiative that will hopefully attract strong support and become part of Arnstadt’s diverse running tradition.

name: Barumer Stick and Stone Run
description: The Barumer Stick and Stone Run is a challenging obstacle race held at the Barum Forest Stadium and in the surrounding wooded, hilly landscape of the Lüneburg Heath. The course follows sandy, muddy and partly overgrown trails, with water obstacles such as ditches and a village pond. The event offers runners a varied challenge in a natural setting and is suitable for both individual entrants and groups. Participants receive a medal and refreshments in the finish area.

name: Jan Schüpp Bürgerlauf Wittmund
description: The Jan Schüpp Wittmund Citizens’ Run is a running event organized by MTV Wittmund. It starts at the stadium on Breslauer Straße in Wittmund. The route runs through the town center, past the market square and Schlossplatz, and offers a challenging and varied course. In addition to the main races, there are children’s and youth races, which are free to enter. The event is well organized with support from the police, fire department, and German Red Cross (DRK), and is popular with runners and spectators.

name: middenmang-Loop 2. Emder Vielfaltslauf
description: The middenmang-Loop is an inclusive celebration of diversity in Emden, taking place for the third time. The race is open to all ages and to people with and without disabilities, bringing everyone together to enjoy running. Various competitions and distances, from the Kinner-Loop for children to the 10 km middenmang-Loop for experienced runners, offer something for everyone. The race is part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series and promotes community, exercise and inclusion.

name: Staffellauf Rund um Arnstadt
description: Der Arnstädter Staffellauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die in der Stadt Arnstadt stattfindet. Der Lauf fördert den Teamgeist und die sportliche Gemeinschaft in der Region. Die Strecke führt durch die malerische Umgebung von Arnstadt und bietet Läufern aller Altersgruppen eine attraktive Herausforderung. Die Veranstaltung ist ein beliebtes Sportereignis mit einer freundlichen Atmosphäre und engagierten Teilnehmern.
course_highlights: Staffellauf durch die Stadt Arnstadt
Malersiche Laufstrecke mit abwechslungsreichem Terrain
Förderung von Teamgeist und Gemeinschaft
additional: Die Veranstaltung wird von der Stadtverwaltung Arnstadt organisiert. Es gibt keine öffentlich zugänglichen Informationen zu Startzeiten, Preisstaffelungen oder Anmeldemöglichkeiten auf der Website. Kontakt erfolgt über die zentrale E-Mail info@stadtverwaltung.arnstadt.de. Die Veranstaltung findet jährlich statt und ist Teil des Sportkalenders der Stadt.

name: Lørenskogløpet
description: Lørenskogløpet is organized by Lørenskog Friidrettslag and is a long-standing race that brings together runners of all ages, from children to veterans. The race takes place in Lørenskog, Akershus, and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics license, which provides insurance in case of injury. The race is part of the club’s wide range of activities, which includes various training groups and events throughout the year.
additional: Participants aged 13 to 80 must have an athletics license, which can be purchased via isonen.no. Children under 13 are covered by the children’s sports insurance and do not need their own license. The race contacts are Gunnar Pedersen and Asbjørn Ringstad, with phone numbers listed on the website.

name: Forusløpet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris er 299 kr fram til og med 1. august

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: For barn født 2007 eller senere, er prisen 150 kr.

description: Forusløpet is an annual recreational race organised by Spirit Friidrett in the Stavanger region, with 5 km and 10 km distances. The race follows a loop course in Forus, known, among other things, for Jakob Ingebrigtsen’s Norwegian record in 2020, and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners. The start and finish are at Kanalsletta 4, with ample parking and easy access to race number collection. The race has a social atmosphere, with the option to collect race numbers the evening before and automatic SMS notifications of official times at the finish.
course_highlights: Loop course in Forus starting by Foruskanalen and Kanalsletta 4
The 5 km is run as 2 laps of 2.5 km; the 10 km as 4 laps of 2.5 km
The course is known for Jakob Ingebrigtsen’s Norwegian record in 2020
additional: Race numbers are sent by SMS during the final 24 hours before the start. Race numbers and safety pins can be collected at the reception at Kanalsletta 4. The 5 km and 10 km start at the same time and follow the same loop course. An automatic SMS notification with the official finish time is sent if a mobile number has been registered. Results are published live at eqtiming.no.

name: Eidsvoll Verk 6-timers
description: Eidsvoll Verk 6-hour is a long-standing ultramarathon held in scenic surroundings in Eidsvoll, Akershus. The race challenges participants to run as far as they can in six hours on a loop course. The event attracts both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners looking for a unique running experience in the summer sunshine. With a history that includes visits from legendary runners, this is a social and inspiring race for all levels.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a loop course in scenic surroundings at Eidsvoll Verk
A six-hour duration that challenges endurance and strategy
A historic race with many participants and a great atmosphere
additional: The race has a strong tradition and has had record participation in previous years. It is held during the summer season, with good weather conditions. No pricing information or start time is provided on the available pages. Practical information and an overview of registered participants can be found on the race website.

name: Sengbachtalsperrenlauf
location: Sengbachtalsperre, Leichlingen-Witzhelden, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Sengbach Reservoir Run is a traditional scenic race around the Sengbach Reservoir near Leichlingen-Witzhelden. The three main distances follow well-maintained forest trails and a paved section along the dam, on a loop of approximately 9.8 km with around 200 metres of elevation gain per lap. The course is traffic-free and runs through a protected landscape area. Families can take part in a separate race with shorter distances in the area near the event venue. The event provides refreshments along the course and showers in the nearby village of Kuhle.
course_highlights: Loop of approximately 9.8 km with 200 metres of elevation gain per lap
Well-maintained forest trails and a paved section along the dam
Traffic-free course in a protected landscape area
additional: Race numbers and other race materials can be collected in the registration tent on the day of the event from 7:30 a.m. Showers are available at a school in the neighbouring village of Kuhle and are signposted. Refreshments including bananas, water, isotonic drinks and cola are available approximately every 5 km; free tea and bananas are available at the finish. Certificates are available online. The course is traffic-free and has two refreshment stations on the loop. A fundraising campaign is being held for the Leverkusen children's hospice.

name: Gladbecker Sparkassenlauf
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a traditional running event welcoming runners of all ages. It offers various distances, from the Bambini Marathon to the half marathon, as well as a team relay. All courses are DLV-certified and eligible for official rankings. Participants receive finisher medals and personalized race bibs bearing their names, making the running experience special. There is also a district championship classification and extensive award ceremonies.
course_highlights: DLV-certified courses: 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon
Personalized race bibs bearing participants’ first names
Live timing and net times for all races
additional: Finisher medals for all participants; personalized race bibs bearing first names; live timing with net times; changing rooms and showers at the stadium; valuables can be left at storage facilities; trophies and certificates for winners and age-group winners; team and club classifications; district championships with certificates and badges; no classification for the Bambini or walking events. Courses at Gladbeck Stadium; online registration; late registration available until 1 hour before the start; medical assistance provided by the German Red Cross; various course distances and categories.

name: ews Volks- und Spendenlauf
description: The 14th ews Volks- und Spendenlauf runs through Bad Segeberg, passing scenic places such as Kalkberg and Lake Großer Segeberger See. Since 2011, the race has been a fixture in the city’s sporting calendar, combining athletic achievement with the joy of exercising together and charitable commitment. The event supports selected projects each year, with donations in 2026 divided among three projects. The race is a community initiative that brings together exercise and social engagement.
course_highlights: Through Bad Segeberg
Past Kalkberg
Along Lake Großer Segeberger See
additional: Team entries are only possible by submitting a paper form, which must be emailed to info@volkslauf-bad-segeberg.de by 02 October 2023. Registration is online and requires consent to the liability waiver and data protection terms. The focus is on enjoying exercise and charitable commitment.

name: TuS Hiltrup Halbmarathon
location: Stadion am Osttor, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The TuS Hiltrup Half Marathon is an established running event in Münster, starting and finishing at the Osttor Stadium. The course includes a lap of the stadium, runs along the canal promenade and through the Hiltrup residential area, offering a varied and attractive running environment. In addition to the classic half marathon, there is also a relay race, which is especially appealing to teams. The event is open to runners born in 2008 or earlier (individual race) and 2010 or earlier (relay), and offers a family-friendly atmosphere at a large sports club.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Osttor Stadium
Run along the canal promenade with views of the canal
Course through the Hiltrup residential area, with varied terrain
additional: Individual entries for the half marathon are sold out; only relay places are still available. The course closes at 12:00, after 3 hours of racing. The course is accessible, and detailed information is available for local residents about the route and traffic regulations on race day. Measured course, start at Osttor Stadium, individual and relay races, online registration, start times at 9:00 and 9:05, course closes after 3 hours.

name: Rotherbaum 10K Hamburg - K Rotherbaum
description: The 10K Rotherbaum is an officially measured 10-kilometer race in Hamburg, held in accordance with international competition regulations. The course is a loop registered with the German Athletics Association and AIMS, making finish times eligible for rankings. The event is open to runners of all age groups and offers a cup competition across all 10K Hamburg races, with attractive prizes. Registration is online only, and participants are asked to travel by public transport.

name: Der Alstertallauf
description: The Alstertallauf is a family-friendly race along the upper Alster hiking trail, considered Hamburg’s most beautiful running route. It welcomes running enthusiasts of all ages and recreational athletes, and offers several distances. The event takes place near the Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium in Hamburg and is known for its friendly atmosphere. In 2022, more than 200 runners took part, with distances ranging from 410 m to 10 km.

name: Gettorfer Staffelmarathon
description: The Gettorf Relay Marathon is a team marathon held at the Gettorf Sports Park. The course is an approximately 4.2 km loop, run ten times. Teams consist of 5 to 10 people, who pass the chipped relay baton in the exchange zone. Alternatively, two people can compete in the Duo Marathon, freely dividing the ten laps between them. Timing is electronic, using transponders and shoe chips, and split times are recorded for each runner.

name: Bielebohlauf
description: The Bielebohlauf Oppach is a running event in the Lusatian Highlands, offering a range of distances from 400 m to 20 km. The routes follow forest, meadow, and field paths as well as small roads around the Bieleboh. The longer distances are challenging and include steep climbs. Special Bambini and children’s races are available. Refreshments and entertainment are provided at Oppach Stadium, and finishers receive certificates and online clips.

name: 1. Laufchallenge Mellendorfer TV
description: The 2026 Sparkassen Running Pass for the Hanover Region features 43 running events, making it the largest series of its kind in Germany. Participants can collect stamps at various events across the Hanover Region and discover the region as they run. Each successful participation earns a stamp, and frequent runners can qualify for attractive gold, silver or bronze rewards. Participants register directly for the individual runs, which take place at many beautiful locations and offer a variety of activities. There is also a Running Pass app with an event calendar and digital running log.

name: Die Generalprobe
description: Die Generalprobe ist ein urbaner Straßenlauf in Berlin, der als ultimativer Test für die Marathonvorbereitung dient. Vier Wochen vor dem BMW BERLIN-MARATHON können Läuferinnen und Läufer auf einem superflachen Rundkurs durch die Berliner Bezirke Steglitz, Wilmersdorf und Zehlendorf ihre Fitness prüfen. Angeboten werden ein Viertelmarathon (10,5 km) und ein Halbmarathon (21 km), die beide durch typische Berliner Kieze führen und ein besonderes Lauferlebnis in der Stadt bieten. Für Kinder gibt es zudem Bambini-Läufe über 500 bis 1.000 Meter. Im Ziel erwartet alle Teilnehmenden eine schöne Medaille, optional mit personalisierter Gravur.
course_highlights: Superflacher Rundkurs durch die Berliner Bezirke Steglitz, Wilmersdorf und Zehlendorf
Strecke führt durch typische Berliner Wohnviertel mit urbanem Flair
Zwei Streckenlängen: Viertelmarathon (10,5 km) und Halbmarathon (2 Runden, 21 km)
additional: Zeitmessung erfolgt mit MIKA TAG Einweg-Transponder auf der Rückseite der Startnummer, keine Rückgabe erforderlich. Start und Ziel sind an der Schlossstraße in Berlin-Steglitz. Teilnahmeberechtigung ab Jahrgang 2011 (U18).

name: IV BIEG PEŁNEJ MISKI
description: The Full Bowl Run is an annual running event held in Szubin since 2023. It is a charity run and continues an initiative supporting animal shelters. The event attracts runners who want to combine sport with helping animals in need. It is organized by the "Pod Egidą" Association and the local community.

name: Biegi wokół Bursztynowej Góry
description: The Runs Around Bursztynowa Góra are an annual running event held in picturesque Bąkowo as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The races attract runners from various age categories, offering appealing routes and the unique atmosphere of Kashubia. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors amid beautiful nature and local culture. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: XVI Festiwal Biegowy Dziki Weekend
description: The 16th Dziki Weekend Running Festival is an annual running event held in Police that has gained considerable popularity in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship since 2010. The festival offers a range of trail and cross-country races, including races for children and young people, as well as extreme obstacle races. The courses run through the natural landscapes of the Wkrzańska Forest, promoting an active lifestyle and sporting competition in a unique atmosphere. The organizers welcome both recreational and experienced runners to take part in this dynamic and challenging event.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes through the Wkrzańska Forest with natural obstacles
Children’s and youth races with different distances and obstacles
Extreme trail races with military-style obstacles at the training ground
additional: The start and finish of all races are at the sports clearing at ul. Piaskowa 99 in Police. Children’s races start on 22.08 from 10:35, with waves starting every 5–10 minutes. Extreme obstacle races take place on 23.08, with waves starting every 3–5 minutes. The race office is in the sports hall at SP8, ul. Piaskowa 99. The courses feature natural obstacles such as tires, mud, walls, water obstacles, and ropes.

name: Sørkedalsløpet
location: Idrettslokalet i Sørkedalen, Sørkedalen, Oslo, Norway

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alle klasser 22 år og yngre (nedre aldersgrense 8 år) kroner 285

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Alle klasser fra 23 år og eldre kroner 435

description: Sørkedalsløpet is a true cross-country race on forest trails in Nordmarka, organised for the whole family. Choose between a challenging, hilly 11 km course or a shorter 3 km course, both starting and finishing at Idrettslokalet in Sørkedalen. The race offers fresh air, a great atmosphere, and homemade elk soup and buns served in the finish area. It’s a friendly, local weekday race for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on forest trails and gravel roads in Nordmarka
Hilly 11 km course and shorter 3 km course
Start and finish at Idrettslokalet in Sørkedalen
additional: Wave starts: 11 km at 18:00 and 3 km at 18:20. Race bibs can be picked up at Idrettslokalet from 16:00 to 18:15. Sausages, cinnamon buns, coffee and squash are also sold to spectators. Parking is not available at the venue, but there is parking about 700 m away at Sørkedalen utfartsparkering. Bus 41 stops at the venue. Previous editions have offered refreshments at the finish, including elk soup and buns.

name: B2Run Hamburg
description: B2Run Hamburg is a company run of around 5.6 km, ending with a spectacular finish in the Volksparkstadion. The course is varied and largely flat, making it ideal for beginners, walkers and experienced runners. The event promotes team spirit, motivation and a sense of community, and is perfect for companies and individual participants from Hamburg and the surrounding area. In addition to the sporting experience, the run offers a professional supporting programme with commentary and music.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Czerwonak Physical Culture Development Centre. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors, running or walking in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km distance confirmed for the 2026 edition
Evening event format in Bolechowo
Part of the Active Czerwonak at Night series
additional: The event is free and takes place in the evening, usually from 19:30 to 22:00. It is a recreational sporting event and part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees or required equipment. Previous editions took place in the evening; 82 participants took part in 2026.

name: Blodomloppet Västerås
price_range: 350–450 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100–150 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: därefter sker en höjning på 50 kr (400 kr) kallat ”Efteranmälan”

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr Lilla Blodomloppet Anmälan från 7/8 – 150 kr

description: Blodomloppet in Västerås is a recreational race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race is open to both individual participants and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, who can take part in different distances. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12, with two shorter distances. The start and finish are at the Rocklunda area, with clearly marked courses and several marshals along the way. After the race, all participants receive a medal and a finish-line goody bag, and team participants are invited to a group picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Rocklunda area, on the football pitches north of the riding arena
The courses are marked with Blodomloppet course tape, with flag marshals at strategic locations
Lilla Blodomloppet for children features two distances of approximately 1,400 m and 500 m around Rocklunda IP
additional: The race offers a warm-up in front of the stage at approximately 17:00. Lilla Blodomloppet has two start times: approximately 17:15 for 1,400 m and approximately 17:25 for 500 m. Teams can consist of 3–5 participants and include a picnic for 5 people. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out, and there are water stations along the course. Registration is binding and cancellations are not accepted. Teams consist of 3–5 participants. The team fee covers five people and includes a picnic.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/vasteras/): 2027-08-25 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 25 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-25)

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Olympiaparkløpet
description: The Olympiaparkløpet is an annual race in Lillehammer, held as part of the Sørdalskarusellen. The race features a challenging course of approximately 10 km, with a 300-metre climb over 4 km, and passes four Olympic venues. There is also a shorter route for the youngest participants and those who wish to take part without being timed. The race finishes spectacularly on the stone wall at Lysgårdsbakken and attracts both local and virtual participants.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 9.75–10.4 km, with a 300-metre climb over 4 km
Passes four Olympic venues in Lillehammer
Finishes on the stone wall at Lysgårdsbakken, with a great event venue
additional: There is a new 3.85 km short route for children aged 8–11 and those who wish to take part without being timed. Race numbers can be collected at Kleivbakken, while the start is at the barrier on VIP-veien. The route for the youngest participants has an elevation gain of 147 metres and follows part of the long course. Virtual participation is also available.

name: Norrköpings Stadslopp (Nkpg City)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis anmälan för alla barn och ungdomar.

description: NKPG City Norrköping City Race is a fast-paced and popular running race held in central Norrköping, starting and finishing on Olai Kyrkogata. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The course passes through classic surroundings, with packed spectator areas and more than ten music stations creating a fantastic atmosphere. The race welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners in a festive atmosphere, with great prizes and a large crowd. There is also a free 1 km children’s race, Lilla Lundbergsloppet, with a medal and goodie bag for every participant.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata in central Norrköping
The course passes through classic Norrköping surroundings, with packed spectator areas
More than ten music stations along the course to keep runners motivated
additional: Lilla Lundbergsloppet starts at 17:00 with four starts and is free for children. The children’s warm-up, led by Friskis & Svettis, begins at 16:40. The 10 km race starts at 18:30 and the 5 km race at 19:30, with a warm-up 15 minutes before each start. Race bibs can be collected at XXL Ingelsta on Wednesday 26 August from 11:00 to 18:00, or on race day from 15:00 at the start and finish area. There are veteran, junior and youth categories, as well as team competitions for women, men and mixed teams. Water stations are located at 2 km and 7 km (Nodra), and at 3.5 km and 8.5 km (ICA Strömmen). After finishing, participants are offered freshly drilled water from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Timing is chip-based, and results are published immediately after the finish. The ARQLY Sprint is a race within the race over the final 85 metres, with sprint prizes. 5 km and 10 km.

name: GKN-stafetten 2026 (del av Trollhättan Action Week)
description: The GKN Relay is a relay race held along the Trollhättan Canal during Trollhättan Action Week. Each team consists of four participants, each running 3 kilometres on a flat course around the canal. The event is full of team spirit and energy, with live music and an evening of fun and camaraderie. Participants can pick up their race bibs and relay baton the day before to avoid queues. After the race, there is an opportunity to enjoy a picnic and entertainment at the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat course around the Trollhättan Canal
Team relay with 4 participants, 3 km per leg
Running combined with live music and a picnic at the finish
additional: Race bibs and the relay baton can be collected the day before at Odenhuset. NearYou offers a staffing pool to cover late withdrawals from teams. After the race, there is live music and the opportunity to picnic at the finish area. Race bibs and the relay baton can be collected the day before the race.

name: Åsane løpskarusell 2027 | Løp 5
description: Åsane Running Series is a recreational running series in Bergen offering weekly 5 km races starting and finishing at IKEA in Åsane. The races are officially measured and suitable for all levels, with an inclusive atmosphere and qualified coaches. The running group was established in 2016 and has grown to offer organized training sessions and races for both beginners and experienced runners. Race numbers are collected at the venue before the races, and participants can take part in multiple races throughout the year.
course_highlights: Nationally certified, officially measured 5 km course (C level)
Start and finish at IKEA in Åsane, behind the building on the south side
Races take place in the evening, starting at 19:00
additional: Race numbers can be collected in IKEA’s garage between 18:00 and 18:45. Race numbers must be worn visibly, and the tags must not be folded or damaged. A replacement race number costs NOK 100. The races take place on Thursday evenings. The running group also offers weekly training sessions led by qualified coaches.

name: Istrun
description: Istrun Half Marathon is a flat and fast course (approx. 70 m elevation gain), officially measured and approved by SFIF, offering ideal conditions for setting a half marathon personal best.

name: HTB Ole Bull-løpet 2027
description: HTB Ole Bull Run is a traditional fun run organised by Osterøy IL Athletics. The race is part of a series of fun runs and running events in beautiful surroundings on Osterøy in Vestland. Participants can look forward to a well-organised race experience starting at Furubakken sports ground, with options for walkers and the main field. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with prizes and refreshments for participants.
course_highlights: The course is 4.4 km long
Starts at Furubakken sports ground, Valestrandsfossen
Start times: 18:45 for walkers and 19:00 for the main field
additional: Prizes are provided by local sponsors such as Extra Valestrand and Toro. Sveler (Norwegian pancakes) and squash are served to participants. The race is part of a series with several events throughout the year, including a Christmas run and a New Year’s run. Registration is available at the start at Furubakken sports ground or via Vipps 121337. The series lists start times of 18:45 for walkers and 19:00 for the main field. Previous editions have featured 4 km and 6 km courses, but distances for 2027 have not been announced.

name: Sognefjord Trail Run
description: Sognefjord Trail Run is a spectacular trail-running experience in beautiful Kaupanger, Vestland. Choose from the 17K, 27K, 45K Ultra or a 1 km Kids Race. The courses offer varied terrain, including forest trails, mountain sections and fantastic views of the Sognefjord. The event has an inclusive atmosphere, with well-marked courses, helpful volunteers and a social post-race gathering in central Sogndal.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest trails, mountains and technical sections
Fantastic views of the Sognefjord and mountain peaks such as Søre Gråbrørne
Flowing trails and challenging climbs, including up to Amlaholten and Store Haugmælen
additional: Start times: 08:00 for 45K Ultra, 11:30 for 17K, 12:00 for 27K, 15:00 for Kids Race. Bib collection and check-in Friday 16:00-21:00 in Sogndal and Saturday morning in Kaupanger. Post-race gathering with music and an awards ceremony in central Sogndal from 20:30. The courses include asphalt, gravel and trails. Kids Race for children aged 2-13 over 1 km. Food available for purchase after the finish. The 2027 edition is part of the Norge Trail Series (NTS), and registration is open.

name: 7. Ahnepark-Lauf der Laufgemeinschaft Vellmar
description: The 7th Ahnepark Run, organized by Laufgemeinschaft Vellmar, is a late-summer running event in Vellmar. This club race offers two distances, 200 meters and 17.3 kilometers, and is designed primarily as a community run. Registration and results are managed through my.raceresult.com. The race is listed in the laufen.de running calendar and features officially measured courses that are relevant for rankings.
course_highlights: Two distances: 200 m and 17.3 km
Event in Ahnepark in Vellmar
Officially measured courses for rankings
additional: Registration and results are handled through my.raceresult.com. The race takes place in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny days. It is a local club race without major branding or destination elements. Distances: 200 m, 17.3 km; registration and results through my.raceresult.com; listed in the laufen.de running calendar

name: Lemgoer Hanselauf
description: The Lemgo Hanselauf is a traditional running event held annually on the last or second-to-last Friday in August in Lemgo. The event offers 3.3 km, 6.6 km and 10 km courses along the city’s ramparts. Children and Bambinis can also take part over shorter distances, making the Hanselauf a family-friendly event. With around 1,000 participants, the Hanselauf is a sporting highlight in the region that brings together fun and community.
course_highlights: Course along Lemgo’s historic ramparts
Distances of 3.3 km, 6.6 km and 10 km
Children’s and Bambini runs over 1.5 km and 400 m
additional: Bib collection and late registration on the event day from 4 p.m. in the right-hand school wing of Engelbert-Kämpfer-Gymnasium. No timing or placings for the children’s and Bambini runs. Assemble at the start from 4:55 p.m. Participation is free. Run along the ramparts, children’s and Bambini runs, registration at Engelbert-Kämpfer-Gymnasium, late registration available on the event day.

name: 26. Verdener Stadt-Lauf
description: Der Verdener Stadt-Lauf ist ein Straßenlauf in Verden mit Start und Ziel am Lugenstein nahe dem Dom. Auf dem Programm stehen kurze Kinder- und Jugendstrecken, 5- und 10-Kilometer-Läufe sowie eine gemischte Staffel. Die Veranstaltung des LAV Verden bietet Laufangebote für verschiedene Altersklassen.
course_highlights: Start und Ziel am Lugenstein nahe dem Verdener Dom
Flache 5-km- und 10-km-Straßenläufe
Gemischte Staffel über 3 × 900 Meter
additional: Die 10-km-Strecke ist für Teilnehmende ab U16 zugleich Wertungslauf der Bezirksmeisterschaft.

name: Ibbenbürener Aaseelauf 2026
description: The Ibbenbüren Aasee Run is a long-standing running event taking place for the 41st time in 2026. The event offers races for children of kindergarten and primary-school age, as well as a 5 km fun run, a 5 km team run, and a 10 km main race for competitive and recreational runners. The course runs around Lake Aasee, with the start and finish at Stadion Ost in Ibbenbüren. The event is limited to 1,000 participants and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good on-course support.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stadion Ost, Ibbenbüren
Loop course around Lake Aasee, with three laps in the 10 km main race
Drinks stations along the course and in the finish area
additional: Late registration is available on event day from 15:00 until 1 hour before the start of each race for a fee of €2.50. Changes to entries are also possible on event day for a fee. €1 per registration is donated to a charitable organization. Free parking is available at Stadion Ost. Race bibs can be collected on event day from 15:00. Timing is recorded using transponders on the back of the race bib. Registration is online only, with a limited number of places. Late registration costs €2.50; charitable projects can be supported.

name: Sparkassen-Abendlauf
location: Hohenhorster Wald, Recklinghausen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Evening Run in Recklinghausen is a summer running event organized by Recklinghäuser Leichtathletik Club in cooperation with Sparkasse Vest Recklinghausen. Two distances are offered: 5 km (two laps) and 10 km (four laps) through Hohenhorster Forest. Both courses are officially measured and eligible for inclusion in rankings. The evening run also hosts the district championships over 10 km, for which a valid competition licence in the FLVW district of Recklinghausen is required.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses in Hohenhorster Forest
Officially measured courses eligible for inclusion in rankings
10 km district championships held as part of the evening run
additional: The 5 km course consists of two laps, and the 10 km course consists of four laps through Hohenhorster Forest. Participants in the 10 km district championships must tick the corresponding box when registering and hold a valid competition licence. Courses in Hohenhorster Forest, district championships held as part of the event

name: Straßenlauf Rund um den Holtenauer Leuchtturm
5. LSG-Waldauer-Wiesen-Lauf
description: The 5th LSG-Waldauer-Wiesen-Lauf is an evening running event held at the Waldauer Wiesen sports ground in Kassel. The event offers various distances for all age groups, from a 500 m Bambini run to an 18 km run. The shorter children’s races start first, followed by the longer races in the early evening. The routes are well marked and include sections around Bugasee and Wahlebach, with refreshment stations and childcare available on site.

name: Sparkassen-Tauchscher-Stadtlauf
description: The Sparkassen Tauchscher City Run is a long-standing running event organized by Leichtathletik Club Taucha e. V. in the town of Taucha on the Parthe. The 21st edition of this city run also incorporates the state championship in the 10 km road race. The event offers runners of all ages an appealing opportunity to compete in a lively atmosphere. Registration opens in February.

name: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon
description: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon is a welcoming city race taking place on 29 August 2026, with beautiful views along Lake Vättern and through Jönköping and Huskvarna. The course has been redesigned to reduce the total elevation gain while retaining a varied profile with sections through nature, crowd support and several power zones; the marathon course finishes with a spectacular finish line right in the middle of Munksjö Bridge. The race attracts international participants and also features shorter races and a MINI children’s race, as well as offers for businesses and tent packages in the start/finish area.
course_highlights: Spectacular finish line right in the middle of Munksjö Bridge
Beautiful views along Lake Vättern and through Jönköping and Huskvarna, on a redesigned course with less elevation gain
Marathon: 42,195 m with 12 aid stations along the course plus 1 in the start/finish area, an interactive map and power zones
additional: Practical information from the website: up to five runners can be registered at a time; race bibs are not sent out. The marathon course has an interactive map and a downloadable PDF, power zones, and 12+1 aid stations. The organizer offers tent packages for businesses in the start/finish area and the option to use a wellness allowance. Distances: 21K (21,097.5 m) and 42K (42,195 m); includes a team relay and MINI Jönköping Marathon for children. Energy and aid stations along the course, chip timing, group registration for up to 5 runners, and a business village with tents in the start/finish area.

name: Säve Trail Run
description:
Säve Trail Run 2027 

After a wonderful inaugural event in 2026, Säve Trail Run returns on 28 August 2027. We look forward to another day filled with the joy of running, community and wonderful nature experiences in Säve, north of Gothenburg. 

Säve Trail Run takes you through beautiful woodland, winding trails, soft pine-needle carpets and varied terrain. The route combines easy-running sections with technical features that give you that wonderful trail-running feel—whether you’re an experienced trail runner or trying it for the first time.

Choose the distance that suits you best: 12 km, 7 km or 2 km for children and beginners. 

The start and finish are at Säve Sportklubb, where runners, families and spectators gather for a day of exercise, joy and community.

All participants receive a medal to remember the event, and great prizes are promised for the podium finishers in each distance.

Säve Trail Run is for everyone. Whether you’re chasing a rush, want to challenge yourself or simply enjoy nature and the experience with others.

More information about Säve Trail Run 2027, including the race date, course profiles, maps and practical details, will be published on the website as it becomes available.

See you on 28 August 2027
