name: Midnattsloppet (Malmö)
description: Midnattsloppet Malmö is a festive, high-energy running experience taking place on 28 August 2027. Runners can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances. The race starts late in the evening, creating a unique nighttime atmosphere in the heart of the city. The event is all about the joy of movement and community, with a carnival atmosphere, cheers from the crowd and music along the course. There is also the option to take part in costume races and corporate competitions, making Midnattsloppet a memorable and social experience for all participants.
course_highlights: The race runs through central Malmö’s streets in a festival-like atmosphere
Late-evening start times create a unique nighttime running experience
Music and activities along the course create a carnival atmosphere
additional: Costume races start at 21:12 for 10 km and 22:36 for 5 km. Corporate and team competitions are available to strengthen community and workplace wellbeing. The time limit for the 10 km is 90 minutes, with a cutoff after 6.6 km at 22:27. Race packs, shirts and wellness allowances via Benifex, Epassi and Benefits are available. After the race, an After Run with wraps and drinks is offered at a hotel from 23:00 to 01:00. The 10 km starts from 21:00 and the 5 km from 22:30. Costume starts are available for both distances. A team competition is available for the 10 km and gives a discount of 50 kr per person. Race packs are collected at the chosen Stadium store; a medal can be purchased as an add-on.

name: Trelleborgsloppet
description: Trelleborgsloppet is a well-known city race in Sweden’s southernmost city, Trelleborg, with a measured course offering both 5 km and 10 km running, as well as a 5 km walk or Nordic walk. The race starts at Östervångsstadion and finishes in Stadsparken, providing a lovely, spectator-friendly setting. Trelleborgsloppet is a festival for everyone, with both elite runners and recreational runners taking part, and participants can enter team competitions and prize draws for an extra chance to win. The event is marked by a sense of community and fun, with a focus on making the race enjoyable for all participants.
course_highlights: Measured city course with gun time
Starts at Östervångsstadion and finishes in Stadsparken
Course through an urban setting, with cultural landmarks and parks along the way
additional: Race bibs must be collected at Östervångsstadion no later than 45 minutes before the start, or the day before in the lobby of Söderslättshallen. Changing facilities are available at Söderslättshallen, with clothing transport to the finish. Timing uses a disposable chip (Neptron), and gun time is used. Late registration is available online until 45 minutes before the start and on site for an additional fee. A team competition is available, with extra prizes for groups of at least 8 participants. There is also a 5 km distance for walking and Nordic walking. Participants can compete individually or as part of a team.

name: Festivalloppet

late_fee.price: ordinarie anmälningsavgift + 60 kr för alla över 16 år

description: Festivalloppet is an annual running race organized in Strömsnäsbruk by SK Graal. The race offers an enjoyable competition setting for runners of different ages and ability levels, with the option to register late on race day. SK Graal is an active club that also offers training and membership benefits, such as discounts on running shoes. Festivalloppet is part of the club’s wide range of events and attracts runners from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: The course runs along the River Lagan in Strömsnäsbruk.
Previous editions have offered distances of 10 km and 4.8 km.
Children’s and youth categories have been included in previous editions.
additional: Late registration is available on race day until one hour before each start. Payment can be made in cash or by Swish. There is no late registration fee for the youngest children, youth, or the walking class. Clubs registering more than 5 participants can email a registration list and will be invoiced afterward.

name: Rynningeviken Längre 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 16 augusti - 21 augusti (10.00/13.00) 695 SEK. Begränsat antal platser.

description: Rynningeviken Längre is a running race in Örebro that challenges participants to run as far as they can in three or six hours in the scenic Rynningeviken Nature Reserve. The course is a beautiful loop of approximately 2.4 km, mostly on gravel paths with a few bridges, close to the city centre. The event is a celebration of running, focusing on endurance and community, where participants can take on a unique challenge and aim for personal distance records. There is also a KidsRun for the youngest runners. The event is open to all ages and offers a wonderful day filled with the joy of running.
course_highlights: A 2,412.5-metre loop, mostly on gravel paths
Two bridges, with little elevation gain
Start/finish on cobblestones, with a shorter loop for the final 15–30 minutes
additional: Start times: 6-hour race starts at 11:00, 3-hour race starts at 14:00, KidsRun starts at 11:30. A mandatory race briefing takes place before each start. Timing is recorded using a transponder, which is loaned to participants and must be returned after the race. There is no timing for the KidsRun. At the finish, the distance is measured precisely using a measuring wheel. Water and energy supplies are available along the course, including sports drink, bars, fruit, coffee and more. Changing facilities and showers are not provided, but swimming is possible in the Svartån River. Toilets are available near the start area and after approximately 1 km on the loop. Participation is at your own risk. Group registration and discounts for young people and members of certain running clubs are available. The timed races are 3 and 6 hours long. The KidsRun is for children born in 2015 or later and covers either one full lap or a shorter 700-metre distance.

name: Sognefjord Trail Run (STR) 2027
description: Sognefjord Trail Run (STR) offers a spectacular running experience in beautiful Sogndal, Vestland, with distances of 17K, 27K, and 45K, as well as a separate children’s course. The courses offer varied terrain, with trails through forests and mountains, technical sections, and fantastic views of the Sognefjord. The event has an inclusive, positive atmosphere, with well-organized checkpoints, entertainment, and socializing after the race. STR is part of the Norway Trail Series and offers a unique combination of challenge and nature experiences for both experienced runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest trails, mountain sections, and technical sections
Fantastic views of the Sognefjord and surrounding mountains
The courses include challenging climbs and flowing sections on gravel and asphalt
additional: Start times: 45K at 08:00, 17K at 11:30, 27K at 12:00, Kids Race at 15:00. Late registration and bib pickup Friday 16:00–21:00 and Saturday morning. Post-race entertainment and awards ceremony at Meieriet in Sogndal. The courses include both technical sections and flowing trails, with an exciting finish in Kaupanger for the 17K and 27K. Kids Race is 1 km for children aged 2–12.

name: Mandalsmaraton
location: Giert Karis Plass, Bryggegata, Mandal, Norway
description: Mandalsmaraton is one of Norway’s oldest marathons, first held in 1980. The race runs through Mandal’s charming town-centre streets and scenic surroundings, including Furulunden with its idyllic beaches. The course is flat and consists of a 10 km loop run several times, depending on the distance. The event aims to be inclusive for everyone, whether you run, jog or walk, and offers a lively atmosphere with music and an enthusiastic crowd.
course_highlights: Flat 10 km loop course with a national C certificate
The course passes through the town centre and Furulunden, surrounded by beautiful scenery
Three aid stations with water, sports drink, cola and bananas
additional: The start and finish are in Bryggegata by Giert Karis Plass. Pacers are available for all distances. Bag storage is available at Kirkesenteret in Gågata, near the start area. After the finish, Hr. Redaktør invites participants to an After Run with food and drinks. Changing rooms and showers are available at Mandalshallen nearby. Free parking is available at Speidertomta and Mandal Videregående Skole. All participants must have a licence, either an annual licence or a one-day licence purchased during registration. Red Cross medical personnel are present on the course. Aid stations are located at 4.2, 7 and 9.8 km. Changing rooms and showers are available at Mandalshallen, and bag storage at Kirkesenteret. Strollers and dogs are not allowed on the course.

name: Porsgrunn Halvmaraton
description: Porsgrunn Half Marathon is an inclusive road race for all levels, with distances including a children’s race, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The start and finish are at Franklintorget, outside Down Town shopping centre, which also features entertainment, stalls and a free children’s race. The courses are officially measured, and there’s a great atmosphere along the route, with entertainment for both runners and spectators. All participants receive a medal, and the event is a community celebration focused on making participation accessible to individuals, families, friends and businesses.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Franklintorget, outside Down Town shopping centre
600-metre children’s race through the shopping centre
Officially measured courses with entertainment along the route
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Friday 27 August from 16:00 to 19:00 at Down Town shopping centre, and on race day from 09:30 at Franklintorget. The 600-metre children’s race is free, requires no registration and gives every participant a medal. Registration is binding, but entries can be resold via EQ timing. A registration fee of NOK 35 applies. Register by 8 August 2027 to have your name printed on your race bib. Distances include 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon and a free 600-metre children’s race.

name: Lyderhorn Opp
description: Lyderhorn Opp is an uphill race organized by Laksevåg Turn og Idrettslag, finishing at the summit of Lyderhorn, 396 metres above sea level. The course is approximately 3.8 km long and is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. Participants receive a race bib and T-shirt, and everyone who finishes receives a medal and a T-shirt. Prizes are awarded to the three fastest men and women, and gift prizes are drawn among participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 3.8 km course finishing at the summit of Lyderhorn (396 metres above sea level)
Uphill race over varied terrain
Race bib and T-shirt for all participants
additional: Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected at Sport1 Vestkanten on the Friday before the race. Participants receive a 10% discount on one item of their choice at Sport1 Vestkanten when collecting their race bib. There are relatively good parking options, but walking, cycling or using public transport is recommended. First-aid personnel and defibrillators are available along the course. Gift prizes are drawn using race bib numbers during the event. The organizer's website states that the event has been cancelled and welcomes participants back in 2027.

name: Fjordkraft Bergen City Milen
description: Fjordkraft Bergen City Milen is a 10 km road race through the heart of Bergen city centre, starting and finishing at Torgallmenningen. The course offers a varied route that includes city streets, walking and cycling paths, tunnels, and scenic areas such as Småpudden and Nygårdsparken. The event is a community celebration that brings together local and visiting runners and is suitable for all levels and ages. With a long tradition dating back to 2012, the race is organised by Turn og Idrettsforeningen Viking, which emphasises community, activity, and quality.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Torgallmenningen in Bergen city centre
The course passes through Kronstadtunnelen and includes a turnaround
Passes scenic areas such as Småpudden and Nygårdsparken
additional: Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected at JUICE Galleriet. Race-bib distribution closes at 14:00 on race day. Changing rooms and clothing storage are available at Vikinghallen. The children's race, Mini-Milen, starts at 15:00. The awards ceremony is at 17:00. All participants receive a medal, drinks, and light refreshments. An administration fee of NOK 25 is charged in addition to the entry fee, along with a licence fee for the athletics federation. A children's race is also held. The official race website lists 18 September 2027, which differs from the date in the race listing.

name: Ledenløpet (Fåvang–Øyer)
distance_verbose: 27 km, 17 km, 7 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 1 km
price_range: Gratis for 1 og 3 km; 250–500 kr for øvrige distanser
description: Ledenløpet is a race through the cultural landscape in the heart of Gudbrandsdalen, with six distances to suit different ages and levels. The races start at various locations and finish at Nermo Hotell in Øyer. It is an inclusive event with both timed races and free distances for children, and promotes environmental friendliness by being cup-free. Ledenløpet also offers shared transport to the start and nutrition packs tailored to runners.
course_highlights: Run through the cultural landscape of Gudbrandsdalen
All distances finish at Nermo Hotell
Several start locations, with distances ranging from 1 km to 27 km
additional: Race bibs are handed out at the start, no later than 15 minutes before the race begins. Ledenløpet is cup-free, so runners must bring their own cup or bottle to the drink stations. Shared transport to the start is available by bus from Nermo Hotell for Langleden and Mellomleden. The total number of participants is capped at 250 runners. Prizes are awarded to the top three men and women in each distance: a pair of ON running shoes of their choice from Sport 1 Hafjell. Distances: 27 km Langleden, 17 km Mellomleden, 7 km Stuttleden, 5 km Ekstrastuttleden, 3 km and 1 km Bringebærleden. Bringebærleden for the youngest participants is untimed. Race bibs are collected at the start.

name: Kolbotnvannet Rundt
location: Kolbotn Kulturhus (Kolben), Kolbotn, Nordre Follo, Norway
organizer: Kolbotn IL Allianse og Kolbotn Run
description: Kolbotnvannet Rundt is an annual race organized by Kolbotn IL Allianse, with the start and finish at Kolbotn Kulturhus (Kolben) in Nordre Follo. The race offers a scenic loop around Kolbotnvannet and attracts both recreational and competitive runners. The event has a friendly atmosphere and also includes children’s races, making it family-friendly. Results from previous years show strong performances in both the 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: A route around Kolbotnvannet in scenic surroundings
Start and finish at Kolbotn Kulturhus (Kolben)
Suitable for both recreational and competitive runners
additional: The organizer is Kolbotn IL Allianse. The start and finish are at Kolbotn Torg, Strandliveien 4, 1410 Kolbotn. Children’s races are also held as part of the event. A 1 km race is offered for participants aged 6 and up, as well as a children’s race of approximately 500 meters. The start area is near Kolbotn station.

name: Damvegen Opp
description: Damvegen Opp is a challenging uphill race in Ålvik, with a 4.5 km course and a total climb of 600 metres. The race follows a gravel road and offers a demanding test of both fitness and determination, with fantastic views as a reward. Participants can run, jog, walk or “gog” at their own pace, but must finish within the 2-hour cut-off time. Two water stations along the way help participants stay hydrated, and refreshments and a medal await everyone who finishes at the top. The Red Cross is on hand to help ensure a safe experience for everyone.
course_highlights: 4.5 km course with 600 metres of elevation gain
Gravel road throughout
Two water stations along the way and refreshments at the top
additional: The Red Cross is present throughout the race for safety. The Red Cross helps ensure safety along the course, and everyone who finishes receives a medal. Earlier information gives a limit of 50 participants.

name: Kodalmila
location: Kodal IL Stadion, Kodal, Sandefjord, Norway
price_range: 50-300 kr (+ lisens på 5 km og 10 km)
description: Kodalmila is Vestfold’s oldest fun run and is being held for the 47th time. The event offers several distances, including road and trail races, starting from Kodal centre and Kodal IL Stadium. It is family-friendly, with a children’s race and shorter trail races, and is a traditional community celebration for runners of all ages. Race bibs are collected at the clubhouse on race day, and registration is via EQ Timing.
course_highlights: 10 km road race starting at 14:00
5 km trail race starting at 14:05
2.5 km trail race and children’s race starting from Kodal IL Stadium
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Kodal IL’s clubhouse at Rismyrveien 10b on race day from 12:00. The start for the 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km trail races is at the bus stop in Kodal centre, while the children’s race starts at Kodal IL Stadium. Registration opens on 1 December 2024. Race bibs are collected at Kodal IL’s clubhouse on race day.

name: Nykirkemila
description: Nykirkemila is organized by Nykirke Sports Club in Horten, Vestfold, and is an informal running event for adults. The run takes place in scenic surroundings, with opportunities for interval training and strength training in Stasjonsparken. The event has a social focus on community and exercise, and is suitable for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Running in scenic surroundings near Nykirke
Interval training on the flat
Finishing with strength training in Stasjonsparken
additional: The running group meets every Thursday at 20:00 by the monument near the church. It is a social, informal activity with easy-paced running, intervals, and strength training. For children, a points-based cross-country skiing event is held when there is snow, with three different courses and prizes for everyone.

name: Forest Run Elverum
description: Forest Run Elverum organizes obstacle trail runs and activity days in and around Elverum, with its main base at Starmoen. The course features approximately 20 obstacles of varying difficulty and is suitable for all kinds of recreational runners, from beginners to more experienced obstacle runners. The event emphasizes teamwork, togetherness, and a sense of achievement, and aims to foster good relationships between participants. Forest Run also offers team participation and tailored activities for schools, businesses, and private groups.
course_highlights: Obstacle trail run with approximately 20 obstacles
Course through woodland at Starmoen, 10 km east of Elverum town centre
Obstacles of varying difficulty, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The course and obstacle course are rebuilt, and the facilities can be rented by schools, stag parties, birthday groups, and for team building. The focus is on teamwork and a sense of achievement, with activities for both recreational runners and more professional obstacle runners. The team also organizes group trips to other obstacle races. To register as a team, participants register individually and select the same team. Shoes with good tread are recommended; expect to get wet and muddy.

name: Dynafit Hardangervidda Marathon
description: The Dynafit Hardangervidda Marathon is a challenging mountain marathon set in spectacular surroundings on the Hardangervidda plateau. The race features varied, technically demanding terrain and two tough climbs that really challenge both runners and their heart rates. Starting at Høel and finishing at Liseth Pensjonat, participants enjoy a unique mountain experience, combined with a welcoming atmosphere and refreshments at the finish area. The race is limited to 500 participants and includes both a full marathon (43.4 km) and a half marathon (21.2 km).
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with a varied and technically demanding course
Two tough climbs with significant elevation gain
Spectacular views of Hardangerjøkulen and the mountain plateau
additional: The marathon starts at 09:30 and the half marathon at 10:00 from Høel. The first section of the course is shared by both distances. A total of 500 participants are permitted. Total elevation gain is approximately 1,630 metres for the marathon and 980 metres for the half marathon. Liseth Pensjonat serves as the base, with refreshments and finisher shirts. Runner tracking is shown on a big screen. The course includes gravel roads, trails, rough terrain and two challenging climbs.

name: Stavanger Marathon
location: Mariero Station cycle path, Stavanger, Norway
description: Stavanger Marathon is a well-organized race offering distances for everyone, from a children’s race to a full marathon. The courses combine asphalt and gravel, with scenic surroundings around lakes and fjords in Stavanger. The start and finish are in the city center by Stavanger Cathedral, with a festive community atmosphere on the last Saturday in August. The race has pacers, good facilities, and prizes for both the best times and course records.
course_highlights: The marathon course loops around three lakes and runs along Hafrsfjord and Gandsfjorden, with approximately 130 meters of elevation gain
80% asphalt and 20% gravel
Start and finish by Stavanger Cathedral; the 5 km starts at Mariero station
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Radisson Blu Atlantic Hotel on Friday 27 August and Saturday 28 August. The 5 km starts at Mariero station; the other distances start by Stavanger Cathedral. The half marathon is divided into 8 waves, starting 3 minutes apart. Bags can be left at Kongsgård School. Free showers are available at Stavanger Swimming Pool after the race. Prize ceremonies are held at different times for the various distances. Prizes are awarded for course records and the best youth and teenage runners. Sports drink and bananas are available along the course and at the finish. The start is on the cycle path by Mariero station. The marathon course has approximately 280 meters of elevation gain.

name: Nordre Follo Maraton
description: Nordre Follo Marathon is the municipality’s own marathon, starting and finishing in Ski town centre. The race takes place on Saturday, 28 August 2027 at 12:00 and offers several distances, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and children’s race. The course showcases the municipality from Oppegård to Kråkstad and serves as a natural tune-up race for the Oslo Marathon. Ski town centre is easy to reach by the Follobanen, which takes eleven minutes from Oslo S.
course_highlights: Course from Oppegård to Kråkstad
Start and finish in Ski town centre
A great showcase of Nordre Follo municipality
additional: The race is organised by Puls Samfunn and Ung300. Registration has not opened yet; check with the organiser for updates. The event is scheduled about a month before the Oslo Marathon as a natural tune-up race. Ski can be reached from Oslo S by the Follobanen in around 11 minutes.

name: 4. Backyard Ås
description: Backyard Ås is a unique endurance race based on the backyard ultra format, where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour on the hour. The race continues until only one runner remains, testing both physical endurance and mental strength. The course follows scenic trails in Ås, Norway, and offers a varied mix of asphalt, gravel, and forest trails. The event takes place in scenic surroundings just 30 minutes south of Oslo and is an official Backyard Ultra Association race, with results counting toward international rankings.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop every hour on the hour
Course with approximately 50% asphalt and the rest trails and gravel for the first 9 loops
More technically challenging course with 100 metres of elevation gain per loop from loop 10 until the end of the race
additional: Two different courses are used: Course 1 (loops 1–9) is flatter, with 64 metres of elevation gain and approximately 50% asphalt, the rest trails and gravel. Course 2 (loop 10 onward) is more technically challenging, with 100 metres of elevation gain per loop. A fully equipped aid station at the start/finish offers basic nutrition and space for personal supplies. Headlamps are required for night loops. The event offers free parking and is easily accessible by train. Registration is coming soon, and places are limited. The venue is approximately 30 minutes south of Oslo.

name: Backyard ultra RASK (Østensjøvannet)
organizer: Backyard Norge og Rustad Abildsø Sportsklubb (RASK)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Backyard Deltakere kr 750,00 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3% transaksjonsgebyr)

description: Backyard ultra RASK at Østensjøvannet in Oslo is a unique ultramarathon where participants run a 6.7 km loop at the start of every hour, for a maximum of twelve loops. The race combines tactical running with socialising: participants can choose to run fast and rest between loops, or run at a gentler pace to conserve energy. The event has a low barrier to entry and encourages community and inclusion in a welcoming running environment. Prizes are awarded to the top female and male runners based on overall time, as well as to those who complete twelve or seven loops.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop around Østensjøvannet
A maximum of 12 loops, 80.4 km in total
Run at the start of every hour, with a tactical break between loops
additional: Bringing your own cup is mandatory. A reflective vest is required on the final loop, and a headlamp is required if it is dark. Race bibs and ankle chips can be collected at the clubhouse at Abildsø Idrettspark. Light refreshments and a kiosk are available. Maximum 300 participants. Registration is binding, but race bibs may be resold. Free parking at Abildsø Idrettspark. Price and practical information is taken from the race's information page and may change before 2027.

name: 32. Zeitzer Stadtlauf
description: The Zeitz City Run takes place in Moritzburg Castle Park in Zeitz and is organized by SG Chemie Zeitz. The event begins at 9:15 a.m., with the main races starting at 10:00 a.m. The race office is located in front of the main stage in the city park, and changing and shower facilities are available at the Klinkerhallen on Albrechtstraße. The park entrance is via Stephanstraße. The run offers a great opportunity to be active and enjoy the atmosphere in the castle park.
course_highlights: Run through the historic Moritzburg Castle Park in Zeitz
Main races start at 10:00 a.m.
Changing and shower facilities at the nearby Klinkerhallen
additional: The run begins at 10:00 a.m., with changing and shower facilities at the Klinkerhallen. The park entrance is via Stephanstraße. August weather is usually sunny, ideal for an outdoor run.

name: 37. Heideblütenlauf
description: The 37th Heideblütenlauf takes place in Schneverdingen and is a traditional running event held as part of the Heideblütenfest. The event is organized by TV Jahn Schneverdingen and offers runners of all ages the opportunity to experience the beautiful heathland. The course runs through the picturesque surroundings and is supported by numerous volunteers and supporters who help ensure everything runs smoothly. Participants can look forward to a friendly, well-organized event.
course_highlights: Running routes through the heathland around Schneverdingen
Start in front of the town hall on Schulstraße
Event held as part of the Heideblütenfest
additional: The event is supported by numerous local partners and volunteers, including the City of Schneverdingen, the German Red Cross, Johanniter, the volunteer fire department, and the Heidekönigin. Certificates can be printed for all participants, including Bambini children. Registration is through TV Jahn Schneverdingen; further details are available on the website.

name: 39. Jever-Fun-Lauf
price_range: 4,00 € bis 36,00 € je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The 39th Jever-Fun-Lauf is a long-standing running event in Jever that brings together people of all ages and abilities. The course runs through the town centre, past well-known landmarks, with cheering spectators lining the route. The focus is on the joy of being active and a sense of community, rather than competition. There are various races for children, teenagers and adults, including walking, corporate and team categories, as well as a main race over 10 English miles.
course_highlights: A 2.864 km loop through Jever town centre
The route passes well-known landmarks
Cheering spectators line the course
additional: Merchandise such as sports socks, caps and multifunctional scarves is also available and can be collected in Jever on Wednesdays. Late entries are possible on the event day until one hour before the respective start. The time limit for the main race (10 English miles) is 150 minutes. Several race categories, registration deadlines, start times and further event details are available on the official website.

name: Edersee-Lauf
distance_verbose: 20 km, 10 km, 4.2 km, 2 km, 1.2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Edersee Run is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup and takes place in Vöhl-Herzhausen on Lake Edersee. The run is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, a club that promotes sport and community for all age groups. The event is very popular and offers runners an appealing opportunity to get active and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Edersee. Pre-registration opens soon, and the club extends its heartfelt thanks to its supporters and sponsors.
course_highlights: A variety of race distances for all age groups
Flat, fast courses at Lake Edersee
Family and children's runs included
additional: The event is organized by SV 1921 Herzhausen, which also offers other sports activities and training groups. Sponsors support the race bibs. Pre-registration for 2026 opens soon. Various race distances, family-friendly, event held as part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup, start and finish at the Herzhausen Grill Hut.

name: Mindener Volkslauf
description: The Mindener Volkslauf is the largest running event organized by SV 1860 Minden, attracting more than 1,000 participants each year. Alongside the anniversary, the club is celebrating the 10th anniversary of the merged SV Minden with numerous activities. The event offers a great atmosphere and an after-run party following the company run, inviting everyone to join in the celebrations.
course_highlights: Course with new highlights and varied sections
Start and finish in the stadium with a special atmosphere
After-run party following the company run
additional: The 50th Mindener Volkslauf features an after-run party following the company run. In 2025, 1,467 participants crossed the finish line. The event also celebrates the 10th anniversary of the merged SV Minden, with many individual activities through the end of the year. It is the club’s largest event, with a special focus on community and anniversary celebrations.

name: Monte Sophia XXII und 65. HAG-Lauf
description: The Monte Sophia Mountain Run and the Heinrich-Antons Memorial Run (HAGL) are traditional cross-country races in the Rhenish lignite-mining region near Niederzier. The 25 km Monte Sophia Run, with 380 metres of elevation gain, takes runners across the Sophienhöhe, a former spoil heap with varied trails, distinctive natural and cultural landmarks, and beautiful views. The HAGL offers a shorter 10 km alternative, while the 5.3 km Broisterd Loop is also suitable for beginners. The event also includes children’s races and a 10 km walking route, making it ideal for cross-country runners and marathon trainees.
course_highlights: 25 km route with 380 metres of elevation gain across the Sophienhöhe
Distinctive landmarks including the Stone Compass, Celtic Tree Circle, Golden Meadow and Roman Tower
Varied gradients, from gentle to steep, on firm gravel paths and asphalt
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available in the gymnasium. Aid stations with water, tea, fruit and cola are located along the course and at the finish. Children receive medals and certificates; the top three in each age group receive prizes. Runners entering two races receive a separate bib for each race. Bicycle escorts, jogging strollers, dogs and headphones are prohibited. A challenging cross-country event in the Rhenish lignite-mining region, with a range of race distances, including children’s races and walking.

name: RWW-Ruhrauenlauf
location: Mülheim-Saarn, Mülheim an der Ruhr, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: Der RWW-Ruhrauenlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf in Mülheim-Saarn, der jährlich stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern die Möglichkeit, die schöne Natur entlang der Ruhrauen zu erleben und sich sportlich zu betätigen. Der Lauf richtet sich an alle Altersgruppen und Leistungsniveaus und fördert Gemeinschaft und Gesundheit. Die Strecke führt durch abwechslungsreiche Landschaften und ist sowohl für Freizeitläufer als auch für ambitionierte Sportler geeignet.
course_highlights: Lauf entlang der malerischen Ruhrauen
Abwechslungsreiche Naturstrecke mit Wald- und Wiesenabschnitten
Familienfreundliche Atmosphäre

name: Bottroper Ultralauf Festival (BUF)
description: The Bottrop Ultrarunning Festival 2026 takes place on August 30 and 31 in Batenbrockpark in Bottrop, offering an unforgettable running experience for ultrarunning fans. Alongside the established 6- and 24-hour races, the Halden Backyard is once again a special highlight. The festival stands out for its great community, demanding challenges, and distinctive festival atmosphere, shaped by hourly restarts and parallel events.
course_highlights: 6- and 24-hour races in Batenbrockpark
Halden Backyard as a special highlight
Hourly restarts and parallel events
additional: The festival features hourly restarts, a parallel competition, and a simultaneous walking event, creating a distinctive festival atmosphere. Running event with 6-hour, 24-hour, relay, and Backyard events; in Batenbrockpark; online registration

name: Haineslauf
description: Der Haineslauf ist das große Finale des VR Bank HessenLand Cups und bietet Läufern jeden Alters und Leistungsniveaus eine familiäre Atmosphäre und eine tolle Organisation. Verschiedene Streckenlängen, darunter Hauptstrecke, Jedermannstrecke, Nordic-Walking, Schüler- und Bambinistrecke, machen den Lauf zu einem besonderen Erlebnis für die ganze Region. Der Lauf findet am Sportplatz in Ehringshausen statt und legt großen Wert auf Spaß an der Bewegung und Gemeinschaft. Für das leibliche Wohl ist am Start- und Zielbereich gesorgt, und es gibt Verpflegungsstationen auf den längeren Strecken.
course_highlights: Gut markierter Streckenverlauf mit Ausschilderung bei jedem Kilometer
Verpflegungsstationen bei Kilometer 4,0 und 9,5 auf den längeren Strecken
Start und Ziel am Sportheim des SV Ehringshausen
additional: Anmeldungen sind bis 30 Minuten vor Startbeginn im Sportheim möglich, eine Nachmeldegebühr entfällt. Zeitnahme erfolgt mit Computer-Auswertungsprogramm sowie digitalen und analogen Stoppuhren. Männer und Frauen werden getrennt gewertet, Schülerläufe sind nach Jahrgängen klassifiziert. Für die Walking-/Nordic-Walking-Strecke erfolgt keine Wertung, aber Zeitnahme. Urkunden werden auf Wunsch bei der Siegerehrung vergeben, Nachsendung nur gegen Kostenerstattung. Umkleiden und Duschen sind vorhanden. Der Haineslauf gehört zum VR Bank Hessenland-Cup.

name: 8. Stolberger Schloss-Lauf
description: The Stolberg Castle Run 2026 is a charity run in the southern Harz region, starting and finishing right at historic Stolberg Castle. The event offers a range of races for runners of all abilities, including a half marathon, relay, 10 km, 5 km, walking, and fun runs for all ages and children. The varied routes pass through the historic old town, along forest trails and over the heights of the southern Harz, combining a sporting challenge with scenic and cultural highlights. By taking part, every runner supports regional projects in and around Stolberg, giving the event a special charitable purpose.

name: SUNSET Wattenmeer
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is an extraordinary relay race covering approximately 250 kilometers, from Hamburg-St. Pauli to St. Peter-Ording. The route passes through the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea National Park and offers breathtaking natural scenery, idyllic towns, and marshland with a sea breeze. The event lasts more than 24 hours and challenges teams of 5 or 10 runners to complete it together. Start times are assigned based on the reported average pace, and digital map materials are provided before the race.

name: Birklauf
description: The Birklauf of MTV Gelting 08 is a long-running race event held from 3:45 p.m. at Birkhalle Gelting. The event celebrates sport, fun, and the great outdoors, and gives runners of various age groups the opportunity to compete. Times are recorded on all courses except the 750-meter Sprottenlauf, and all finishers receive a medal. Results are categorized by age group, with awards for the top three runners.

name: Elstertal-Lauf
description: The 1. SV Gera Elstertal Run is a traditional running event offering a variety of distances for runners of all ages. Individual races are held over 10 km and 15 km, along with relay races for companies and schoolchildren. There are also children’s races and a challenging stair run with around 1,300 steps. The event is part of the Thuringian and Gera running cup series and offers a varied course through the region.

name: Karlis Härtetest
description: Karlis Härtetest is a long-running race organized by Läuferteam Pretzsch. The race takes place every year in autumn near Leipzig and features a challenging cross-country course that tests runners of all ages. The club SG Grün-Weiß 90 Pretzsch e.V. has a long history in running and promotes community and sporting ambition through this event. The race is known for its special atmosphere and the opportunity to prove yourself on a varied course.

name: Lauf rund um Tiefwarensee
description: The 20th Run around Lake Tiefwarensee in Waren (Müritz) is a traditional running event organized by Müritzer LSV. The course leads around the picturesque Lake Tiefwarensee and offers runners an attractive and varied setting. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar.

name: Panorama - Run - Bad Laasphe
description: The Panorama Run in Bad Laasphe is a varied race held as part of the SummerCityGames and organized by TV Laasphe. The route leads from Wabachstadion along paved paths and forest trails to the highest point, with a challenging climb and a second half that is mostly downhill and offers beautiful views. There is a 6 km youth/recreational race and a 12 km main race, which covers the route twice and is therefore a real challenge. The event also offers changing rooms and showers right next to the sports field.

name: Salzbergener Raffinerielauf
description: Der Salzbergener Raffinerielauf ist ein vielseitiger Straßenlauf mit Angeboten für alle Altersgruppen, darunter Bambinilauf, Schülermeile, 5 km und 10 km Volkslauf. Die Veranstaltung findet am 28. August 2027 in Salzbergen statt und bietet neben spannenden Wettkämpfen auch ein buntes Rahmenprogramm für Läufer und Zuschauer. Die Läufe starten an der Oberschule Salzbergen und sind sowohl für Einzelläufer als auch für Teams mit Wertung vorgesehen. Die Veranstaltung ist eine Station des EL-CUP und zeichnet sich durch eine familiäre Atmosphäre aus.
course_highlights: Start und Ziel an der Oberschule Salzbergen
Streckenlängen: 600 m Bambinilauf, 1700 m Schülermeile, 5 km und 10 km Volkslauf
Teamwertung bei den Hauptläufen
additional: Nachmeldungen sind bis 45 Minuten vor dem jeweiligen Wettbewerb möglich gegen eine Nachmeldegebühr von 1,00 Euro. Die Ausgabe der Startunterlagen erfolgt ab ca. 13:15 Uhr im Wettkampfbüro. Walking/Nordic Walking wird ohne Zeitnahme durchgeführt. Pokale werden für die Plätze 1 bis 3 vergeben.

name: 4. S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz"
description: The 4th S-RUN Sparkassenlauf “Rund um das Dünkreuz” is a nature-focused community race in Eichsfeld, welcoming runners of all ages and fitness levels. The varied routes wind through breathtaking natural scenery around the Dünkreuz and offer exciting challenges for experienced runners and beginners alike. Alongside the competition, the event puts community spirit at the forefront, supported by an attractive program at the sports field. The race is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and is organized by SG Birkungen 07.

name: Mały Wielki Bieg
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Pruszcz Gdański
description: Mały Wielki Bieg is the largest race in the Pruszcz Gdański municipality and returns to Straszyn after a one-year break. It is organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre of the Pruszcz Gdański Municipality, which promotes sport and recreation among local residents. The event is an important sporting occasion in the region.

name: NorDan RUN
description: NorDan RUN is a race held in the picturesque town of Wolsztyn, with routes following paths through the municipal park along Lake Wolsztyńskie. Participants can choose from several distances, from shorter races for children to challenging 48 km routes with checkpoint and refreshment stations. The start and finish are located at the “Fala Park” venue, offering convenient race arrangements and beautiful views. The race is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the surrounding nature.

name: VIII Dycha nad Wisłą
description: The 8th Dycha nad Wisłą is an annual road race held in Tczew and forms part of the 9th Kociewie Running Grand Prix. The race attracts runners from various regions and offers a scenic route along the Vistula. The event combines sport and recreation, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: XVI Bałtycki Maraton Brzegiem Morza
description: The 16th Baltic Seaside Marathon is an annual running event held in the picturesque towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. Participants can choose between the marathon and half-marathon distances, both of which follow the coast, offering exceptional views and atmosphere. The event attracts runners from various age groups, including the K60+ and M65+ categories. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.

name: XI Bieg Dożynkowy
location: Kobylarnia, Gmina Nowa Wieś Wielka, Poland

name: Røykenmila 2027
price_range: 400 kr for 5 km og 10 km; gratis for deltakere under 16 år og Minimila

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Vi øker prisene med kr 100 et par uker før av hensyn til anslag på bestilling av startnummer med chip.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alle deltakere under 16 år løper gratis. Minimila er gratis.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Aktivitetsløypa som Hyggen Speidergruppe setter opp koster kr 100 per familie (Vipps ved oppmøte).

description: Røykenmila is a challenging trail race in Kjekstadmarka, taking place on Sunday, 29 August 2027. The race offers scenic surroundings with gravel roads and trails, and is suitable for the whole family, with activities and a market day. It is a social event aiming to encourage exercise and support good causes in the local community. The start and finish are at Kjekstad farm. Distances of 5 km and 10 km are offered, as well as the Mini Mile for children.
course_highlights: Trail race through scenic surroundings on gravel roads and trails
Water station on the 10 km course at Haukelia, about halfway around the route
Start and finish at Kjekstad farm, about a 15-minute walk from Røyken station
additional: The Mini Mile starts at 11:30, with prizes for all children. Family activity trail with a quiz and canoeing. Several stalls and entertainment throughout the day. Free treatment and storage of valuables for participants. Course marshals ensure the routes are clearly marked and safe. Strollers can be used on the Mini Mile and activity trail, but a child carrier backpack is recommended. Registration for the 2027 edition has not yet opened. The activity trail costs NOK 100 per family. The organiser says all proceeds will be donated to good causes.

name: Norgestesten 2027 2
description: Norgestesten is an efficient and straightforward running event held in Jessheim, with a mass start and many experienced pacers. The course is a flat 3,146-metre loop, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Distances range from an 800-metre children’s race to a half marathon, and the event focuses on community and an enjoyable running experience. Proceeds support sports for children and young people in the local community.
course_highlights: Flat 3,146-metre loop
Mass start with pacers at several paces
The race is held in Jessheim, with easy logistics and nearby parking
additional: The children’s race starts at 09:30 and is approximately 800 m. Bib pickup is self-service from 09:00 in the start area. Toilets are available at Jessheim Athletics Stadium and in the ice and multipurpose hall. Tables are provided for runners’ own drinks at the start, and water and sports drinks are available along the course. The half-marathon cut-off is 2 hours and 30 minutes. The train station and parking are approximately 300 metres from the start.

name: Burgwald Märchen Marathon
description: The Burgwald Märchen Marathon in Rauschenberg is a varied running event with distances for an ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, 3/4 marathon, fun runs and a costume run. The event offers a well-organized course with refreshments, timing and medals for all finishers. Race bibs can be collected the day before, and the races start from 8:00 a.m. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy the race in a fairytale setting.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 5 km to ultramarathon (52 km)
Start and finish close to the sports hall and outdoor swimming pool in Rauschenberg
Cutoff time for all races is 16:00
additional: A maximum of 1111 entries are available across all races. Late entries are possible on 29.08. from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 30.08. until one hour before the respective start, subject to late-entry fees (€3 for the ultra, marathon and half marathon; €2 for other races). All finishers who reach the finish by 16:00 receive a medal. Certificates can be printed online or collected in the finish area. The start and finish are close to the sports hall and outdoor swimming pool in Rauschenberg. The course runs mostly through the forest, partly on paved paths; refreshments are available every 5±2 km; dogs are allowed.

name: DO IT FAST
description: DO IT FAST in Dortmund offers runners the opportunity to run their personal best on a fully measured 2.5 km loop course. Depending on the distance, the course is completed 2 or 4 times and is eligible for official rankings. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can look forward to a finisher’s medal, refreshments, and an awards ceremony for the top runners. A photo banner near the finish area invites participants to take commemorative photos, and results are available digitally via QR code.
course_highlights: DLV-measured 2.5 km loop course
10 km race: 4 laps; 5 km race: 2 laps
Photo banner in front of the blast furnace as a spot for commemorative photos
additional: The race office opens at 07:30. Awards ceremony for men and women, places 1–3, after they finish, at the event area. Finishers receive a medal and refreshments. Results and certificates are available via the QR code on the race number. A €5 late entry fee applies for registrations after the entry deadline.

name: Kölner Halbmarathon- Die Generalprobe
location: Sportpark Müngersdorf, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 27th Cologne Half Marathon offers runners a choice of four distances: 7 km, 14 km, 21 km and 28 km. All participants start together at 10 a.m. at the NetCologne Stadium in Sportpark Müngersdorf. The route leads through Cologne and is designed as a dress rehearsal for other races. Water, bananas, muesli bars and non-alcoholic drinks are provided along the course and at the finish. The event is organised by Leichtathletik-Team Deutsche Sporthochschule Köln e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and professional organisation.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the NetCologne Stadium in Sportpark Müngersdorf
Four distance options: 7 km, 14 km, 21 km and 28 km
Refreshments along the course and at the finish, including water, bananas and Maxi Nutrition bars
additional: For safety reasons, baby joggers, dogs, walkers and music devices are not permitted. Custom race numbers can be selected for a fee of €3. Changes to registrations are only possible at race-pack collection and cost €15. Course, start/finish in Cologne, on-site late registration available, refreshments, race-pack collection, parking, showers, changing rooms

name: Lahnparklauf
price_range: 14,00 € für 21,1 km und 30 km, 9,00 € für 5 km und 10 km
description: The Lahnparklauf takes place in the heart of Hesse and is an established running event for runners of all ability levels. The proven course concept, known as the LOOP, will be retained this year. The organizing team at team-naunheim SPORT e.V. looks forward to welcoming many participants and also offers training in a variety of sports.
course_highlights: Proven LOOP course route
Running event in the heart of Hesse
Suitable for runners of all ability levels
additional: In addition to running, training is also offered in running, trail running, triathlon, fitness, dance, Zumba and yoga. Course map and elevation profile available online; online registration; parking at the REWE car park; no bag storage provided by the organizer; medical services provided by Malteser Hilfsdienst e.V.

name: Rund um Ennepetal
description: Rund um Ennepetal is an annual mass-participation sporting event held on the last Sunday in August. It combines running, hiking and walking along the 60 km Ennepetal Circular Hiking Trail, divided into five stages. The route passes through varied countryside, with magnificent views of the Bergisches Land, reservoirs and historic places. The event is suitable for all ability levels and offers guided groups for runners and walkers, as well as independent hiking. The stages are scenic and feature cultural highlights and challenging sections. After the event, participants can access their results and certificates online.
course_highlights: 60 km over 5 stages, with varied ascents and descents through forests, floodplains and horse pastures
Magnificent views of the Bergisches Land, reservoirs and historic half-timbered villages such as Beyenburg
Guided groups for runners and walkers; independent hikers receive GPX data; refreshment points at the end of each stage
additional: Late registration is available on the event day for a fee, up to 30 minutes before the start. The start and finish are at the sports grounds of Rot-Weiß Rüggeberg e.V. Bus transfers to the start points of stages 2 to 5 and back are arranged. The course closes at 20:30. Runners and walkers are accompanied in groups by guides familiar with the area; hikers receive GPX data for independent tours. Results and certificates are available online. The event comprises several stages on a challenging route, including bus transfers between start points and refreshments at the changeover points. Participation is open to everyone, with various disciplines and a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Mühlhäuser Altstadtlauf
organizer: Stadtverwaltung Mühlhausen, Kreissportbund Mühlhausen, SV 1899 Mühlhausen e. V.
description: The Mühlhausen Old Town Run is a traditional race through the historic old town of Mühlhausen, held annually since 1997. With three distances of 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km, it offers a sporting alternative to the Mühlhausen Kirmes and brings runners from the region together. The traditional start and finish are at Untermarkt in Mühlhausen. The event is organized in cooperation with the athletics club SV 1899 Mühlhausen e.V. and attracts around 800 to 1,100 participants each year.

name: 22. Eilenriederennen Hannover
description: The Eilenriederennen Hannover is an established summer running event through the green heart of Lower Saxony’s state capital. The public race offers three different distances: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course is officially measured, mostly paved and almost completely flat, making fast times possible. The event has a pleasant atmosphere, with a musical programme in the beer garden, and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass-Serie der Region Hannover.

name: 23. Windmühlenberglauf
description: The 23rd Windmühlenberglauf takes place in Fallersleben (Wolfsburg) at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg. The event is hosted by VfB Fallersleben and gives runners of various age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a traditional race. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Windmühlenberg and promises a varied running experience. Registration is open.

name: 30. Lauf um den Arendsee
description: The 30th Run around Lake Arendsee (LUDA) takes place at the Arendsee beach resort. This anniversary edition offers runners from the region and beyond a scenic natural setting for sport. There will also be a small party on the eve of the event to celebrate sport and community together. Organized by Kersten Friedrich Events, the event promises professional delivery with strong regional ties.

name: 45. Königseer Stadtwaldlauf
description: The Königsee City Forest Run is a traditional running event in Oberhain near Königsee, held annually. The event offers runners of various ability levels an attractive course through the city forest, with varied terrain. Its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings make the run a special experience for participants and spectators.

name: 6-Stunden-Sparkassenlauf
description: The 6-hour Sparkasse Run in Fleestedt takes place on a 1,200-meter loop at the Seevetal Sports Center. The course runs mainly on paved surfaces, with some sections on grass, and is easy to view from the start/finish area, keeping spectators on the edge of their seats. In addition to the individual race, there are team and relay competitions, with the marathon (42.2 km) receiving its own classification. The race is open to runners born in 2008 or earlier, and for the first time the relay is also open to young people born in 2014 or earlier. Younger participants can take part in a 5,000-meter run and have the opportunity to earn the DLV running badge.

name: Blankeneser Heldenlauf
location: Strandweg Ecke Mühlenberg, Blankenese, Hamburg, Germany
description: Der Blankeneser Heldenlauf am 29. August 2027 bietet fünf abwechslungsreiche Strecken mit unterschiedlichen Distanzen und Profilen, die durch die schönsten Ecken von Blankenese führen. Die Läufe starten am Strandweg/Ecke Mühlenberg und führen entlang der Elbe, durch das Treppenviertel und verschiedene Parks. Ob Einsteiger, Hobbyläufer oder erfahrene Halbmarathonläufer - hier findet jeder sein passendes Format. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine einzigartige Kombination aus maritimen Abschnitten und anspruchsvollen Anstiegen aus.
course_highlights: Strecken führen entlang des malerischen Elbufers und durch das berühmte Blankeneser Treppenviertel
Halbmarathon-Varianten mit unterschiedlichen Schwierigkeitsgraden: moderat („Sutsche“) und anspruchsvoll („Derbe“) mit Rampen und Anstiegen
Ziel auf dem Blankeneser Wochenmarktplatz mit Finisher-Medaille inklusive
additional: Start ist am Strandweg/Ecke Mühlenberg, ca. 15 Gehminuten vom Veranstaltungsgelände entfernt. Die Siegerehrungen finden gestaffelt ab 10:00 Uhr auf der Bühne am Blankeneser Wochenmarkt statt. Es gibt eine Kleiderbeutelabgabe ab 8 Uhr am Veranstaltungsgelände. Nachmeldungen sind online vom 19. bis 25. August 2027 möglich mit erhöhtem Startgeld. Finisher erhalten eine Medaille im Startgeld inklusive. Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird empfohlen, da Parkplätze begrenzt sind.

name: Grafschaftslauf
description: The Grafschaft Run connects the historic towns of Rietberg, Verl and Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock, offering runners a varied route rich in history and atmosphere. The race starts at Gut Rietberg, passes historic buildings and runs through the town centre, then follows the Ems to the garden show grounds. The route continues through atmospheric locations, with several relay handover points, and finishes in the Holter Wald at Jagdschloss zur Holte, which provides an impressive backdrop for the finish. The race features varied rural paths, enthusiastic spectators and a special connection between sport and regional history.

name: Altra Sunset Wattenmeer
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is a unique team relay race. The route covers around 250 kilometres through the stunning natural landscape along the Elbe and the UNESCO World Heritage Site Wadden Sea National Park. The race starts on St. Pauli Hafenstraße in Hamburg and finishes in the Bad district of St. Peter-Ording. Teams consist of 5 or 10 runners, each taking on several sections of the route, making the race a special shared experience.

name: CrossFunRun
description: Der CrossFunRun in Ahrensburg bietet abwechslungsreiche Streckenlängen von 500 Metern bis 5 Kilometern, geeignet für alle Altersklassen von den Kleinsten bis zu Erwachsenen. Die Läufe finden auf abwechslungsreichem Terrain mit Runden auf Wiesen, Wald und Trails statt, was den Lauf besonders spannend macht. Die Veranstaltung ist familienfreundlich und wird vom Verein WEcycle e.V. organisiert, der auch für eine gute Infrastruktur mit Umkleiden und Toiletten sorgt. Nachmeldungen sind vor Ort möglich, und alle Teilnehmer erhalten Medaillen, Urkunden und Preise.
course_highlights: Strecken mit 10% Asphalt, 80% Wiese/Wald und 10% Trail
Start und Ziel am Heidkoppelhof in Ahrensburg
Rundkurse mit verschiedenen Längen von 500 m bis 5 km
additional: Nachmeldungen sind vor Ort ab 10:00 Uhr möglich gegen eine Gebühr von 5 Euro. Es gibt Staffel-Varianten mit 3er oder 4er Teams. Umkleidemöglichkeiten und Toiletten sind am Start/Ziel vorhanden. Die Strecke ist gut markiert mit Pfeilen und Fähnchen.

name: Stundenlauf des TuS Fleestedt
description: Der 6h-SPARKASSEN-Lauf des TuS Fleestedt ist ein traditionsreicher Laufwettbewerb in Seevetal, der Läuferinnen und Läufer aller Altersklassen anspricht. Die Veranstaltung bietet neben dem 6-Stunden-Lauf auch verschiedene weitere Laufangebote für Kinder und Jugendliche. Die Strecke führt rund um das Sportzentrum Seevetal und bietet eine attraktive Laufumgebung mit guter Erreichbarkeit. Die Veranstaltung ist offen für alle, die ihre Ausdauer und Laufleistung testen möchten.
course_highlights: Rundkurs um das Sportzentrum Seevetal
Attraktive Laufstrecke mit guter Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel
Familienfreundliche Angebote mit Läufen für Kinder und Jugendliche
additional: Nachmeldungen sind am Wettkampftag vor Ort zwischen 8:00 und 9:00 Uhr möglich. Die Startunterlagen können ab 8:00 Uhr im Wettkampfbüro im 1. OG der Sporthalle abgeholt werden. Teilnehmer, die mit dem Fahrrad anreisen, erhalten einen Kuchengutschein. Medaillen können online bis zum 9. August gebucht werden.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The 40th Volkswandertag of TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. is a traditional hiking event held in Tiftlingerode. It is aimed at hiking enthusiasts and offers a lovely opportunity to enjoy nature and the surrounding area. This sociable sporting activity is suitable for all age groups. The event is organized by TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. and is part of the German Athletics Association’s competition calendar.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
location: Jasne Błonia im. Jana Pawła II, Szczecin, Poland
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon and 10 km race is an annual sporting event held in Szczecin, combining competition with the chance to discover the city’s most beautiful sights. The course runs through central Szczecin, including Wały Chrobrego and Wojska Polskiego Avenue, offering participants exceptional views and comfortable running conditions. The start and finish are located at John Paul II Jasne Błonia Square. Runners can choose their distance during the race: 10 km or a half marathon on a single PZLA-certified loop.
course_highlights: The course runs through central Szczecin and Wały Chrobrego
The route includes Wojska Polskiego Avenue, Szczecin’s longest street
Start and finish at John Paul II Jasne Błonia Square
additional: Runners can choose their distance (10 km or half marathon) during the race at the distance selection point, approximately 9.6 km into the course. The course is marked every 1 km. Time is recorded electronically using chips in the race bibs. Two race pack options are available: basic and extended, the latter including a Ventus technical shirt.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held on the shores of historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim and a fast, flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań. The run finishes at Enea Stadium, where a special sporting atmosphere awaits, with the finish line on the pitch at Lech Poznań Stadium. This exceptional event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.
course_highlights: Swim in the calm, warm waters of Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon
A flat, fast bike course through villages and the western part of Poznań
A run finishing at Enea Stadium, with the finish line on the pitch at Lech Poznań Stadium
additional: The race starts in a rolling-start format. The finish line and race village are located at Enea Stadium and the Poznań International Fair. The race offers qualification slots for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. Participants must be at least 18 years old on race day.

name: Blodomloppet (Borås)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 km tidtagning – 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 11 augusti)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km tidtagning – 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 11 augusti)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km promenad 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 11 augusti)

description: Blodomloppet in Borås is a fun run that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children and a sociable atmosphere with team registration and a picnic bag. The course is hilly and passes through beautiful natural surroundings in the area around Ymergården, making the event both challenging and scenic. It is a popular wellness activity for individuals and teams, with a focus on community and health.
course_highlights: 5 km run/walk on walking-friendly trails in hilly terrain
10 km run on hilly trails and roads between Ymer and Kype, with a new route
Lilla Blodomloppet — a child-friendly course where children can run, skip or walk
additional: Teams of 3–5 participants can register and receive a picnic bag. An extra picnic bag can be purchased for 250 kr. Late registration is available on site on the day of the event until one hour before the start, for an increased fee. Names for race bibs must be submitted by 10 August. Late registration at the event area opens at 16:00. Lilla Blodomloppet is approximately 700 metres for children up to 12 years old. Teams consist of 3–5 participants and receive a picnic bag. Blood donors receive a 40 kr discount.

name: Arnaløpet
price_range: 170-600 kr (+ lisens); gratis for barn 0–12 år
description: Arnaløpet is a long-standing race that was first held in 1977 on a challenging 13 km course. Since 1984, the course has gone around Haukelandsvatnet, and since 1988 there has also been a shorter 3.4 km family course. The event is a large family gathering in Arna, combining competition and socialising, with music and a warm-up before the start. The race is suitable for both children and adults, and participation is free for children under 12.
course_highlights: Course around Haukelandsvatnet
3.4 km family course
Historic course starting at Londalskrysset (previous route)
additional: The Family Run starts at 19:00, and the 10 km race starts at 19:30. The registration deadline for family and individual entries is Monday, 31 August at 18:30. Registration is online only. Race numbers can be collected at Øyrane Torg and Espelandshallen before and on race day. There will be music, mingling and a warm-up before the start. Many great gift prizes will be drawn using race numbers. Participants must use different race numbers when registering for both courses. In 2026, the family course started at 19:00 and the 10 km race at 19:30.

name: Hannerupløbet i Fredericia - 2027
distance_verbose: Halvmarathon, 15 km, 10 km, 8 km, 7 km, 5 km, 1 km

name: Blodomloppet Halmstad
location: Livräddarna i Tylösands anläggning, Tylösand, Halmstad, Sweden
organizer: Halmstad Orienteringsklubb och Blodcentralerna i Halland
price_range: 5 eller 10 km: 350 kr till och med 11 augusti, därefter 400 kr eller 450 kr på tävlingsdagen; lag upp till fem deltagare: 1 750–2 000 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet: 100 kr (preliminära priser för 2027)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr Lilla Blodomloppet Sista anmälningsdag är den 25 augusti för lag

description: Blodomloppet in Halmstad is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either on your own or together with colleagues and friends. The race is a popular workplace wellness activity that brings participants together in teams and ends with a shared picnic. It combines exercise with an important social cause and has a long tradition in Sweden.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes through scenic Tylösand
Lilla Blodomloppet for children and young people
Water stations along the course
additional: You can register individually up until race day, 1 September. Entries are sold only through the website. Tents can be rented for companies or teams at the finish area, which has sea views. Food, drinks and ice cream are available to buy at kiosks and food stalls by the start. Changing facilities, toilets and storage are available in the event area. The race is scheduled for 31 August 2027. Registration is not yet open, and the prices are preliminary.

name: Stomperudkarusellen- løp nr 4
description: Stomperudkarusellen is a traditional series of races organized by Sørum IL since 1981. The series consists of four races of varying distances, from 800 meters to 9 kilometers, and includes shorter options for the youngest participants. The races take place in scenic surroundings around Sørum, with the start and finish at Stomperud Stadion for most of the races. Participants use the same bib number throughout the series, which is open to children, young people, and adults.
course_highlights: Bingenrunden, 5 km with a shorter option
Aasgaardsrunden, 9 km with a shorter option
Lysløypa, 6 km with a shorter option
additional: Participants use the same bib number in all races in the series. Children who are members of Sørum IL can participate for free if they register no later than one week before race day. The races are held at various locations in Sørum, with Stomperud Stadion as the main venue. The meeting point is listed as Stomperud Stadion, Lørenvegen 2, 1923 Sørum.

name: Stomperudkarusellen 2027. Bare løp 4 (800 m bane)
description: Stomperudkarusellen Race 4 is a short 800-metre track race at Idrettsplassen Lørenfallet. The race takes place on 31 August 2027, starting at Stomperud stadion. A great opportunity to test your speed on the track and run with others in Stomperudkarusellen.
course_highlights: 800 metres on the track
Held at Idrettsplassen Lørenfallet
Starts at Stomperud stadion

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: IFK Växjö Friidrott och Blodcentralerna i Kronoberg
price_range: 350–400 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (uppgifter kan uppdateras inför 2027)
description: Blodomloppet in Växjö is a recreational event that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race starts and finishes in beautiful Linnéparken and offers a flat, fast course with plenty of spectator support along the way. There is also a shorter children’s and youth race, Lilla Blodomloppet, which follows a loop in the park. Blodomloppet is a social and health-promoting activity suited to both individual participants and teams, and it ends with a shared picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Linnéparken, Växjö
Flat, fast 5 km course; the 10 km covers two laps
Separate 5 km walking route and Lilla Blodomloppet in the park
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (maximum five participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. Late registration is available at Linnéparken on event day. There is a separate 5 km walking category with its own course. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out on site. You can also take part with a dog in a dedicated dog category. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the event area. There are water stations along the course. The event ends with a shared picnic for participants. You can register individually or in a team of up to five participants. The 5 km walking category follows a separate route.

description: Vestfold Running Series 2027 is a series of 8 great races in the Tønsberg region, offering the joy of running, community, and a great atmosphere for all levels. Each race has two distances, and starts at 18:00. The races take place in varied and beautiful surroundings, with electronic timing by EQ Timing. Participants can choose to enter individual races or buy a season pass for all races at a discounted price. Season-pass participants collect their race numbers at the first race, while individual entrants collect theirs from the race office before the start.
course_highlights: Start and finish right by the parking lot in Essoskogen
Two distances: 3 km (one lap) and 5.6 km (two laps)
After 200 metres, the route turns sharply right and goes down along the edge of the field
additional: Route descriptions and profiles are available in the Facebook group. Everyone can take part, regardless of level. The season pass offers a discount, and race numbers are handed out at the first race. Start at 18:00. Registration is available with a season pass or for individual races.

name: Sørdalskarusellen - Vegmuseumsløpet

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: For klassene 0-11 år, 12-15 og 16 - 19 år kr 80,-

tiers.label: tier_3
