description: Rondjes van Pijn is an endurance run organised by IJsvereniging Pijnacker and held at the Tinteltent in Pijnacker. The race consists of repeated 4.2-kilometre laps, starting every half hour, with a maximum of ten laps. Participants can set their own pace; a faster lap gives them more rest time before the next start. The event is aimed at both young people and adults and emphasises endurance over speed.

name: Maasheggenloop
description: The Maasheggenloop, organized by Atletiek Vereniging Sporting Boxmeer, takes place in the beautiful Maasheggen area, the oldest cultural landscape in the Netherlands. The event offers a suitable distance for every age and level, from the Bambinoloop for the youngest participants to the Half Marathon for experienced runners. The routes pass through a unique, nature-rich setting. A cash prize is offered for breaking the course record in the Half Marathon and 10-kilometer races. The atmosphere is sporty and welcoming, with fun keepsakes for all young participants and trophies for the podium finishers.

name: Molenbroekloop
description: On Sunday, GAC Gemert organizes the annual Bouwgroep van Schijndel Molenbroekloop. The race consists of several 2.5-kilometer laps through the Molenbroek neighborhood. Participants can choose from distances of 1.1 km (youth), 2.5 km (juniors), 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km, and 10 km. The start and finish are on the GAC Gemert athletics track. Prizes are awarded to the top men and women in the 5 km and 10 km races and to the top boys and girls in the youth races. The organizers support sustainability by using reusable race bibs, which must be returned after the event.

name: Rotterdam Half
description: The Rotterdam Half Marathon takes place and starts at 09:00 at the Maassilo in Rotterdam. The 21.1-kilometre route runs through authentic Rotterdam South, past iconic places such as Katendrecht, the SS Rotterdam and the port area, and finishes spectacularly inside Rotterdam Ahoy. The course is fast, flat and officially certified, ideal for runners aiming for a fast time. After the finish, there is a festive afterparty with a DJ and various facilities for participants and supporters.

name: Misty Lakes Trail
description: The Misty Lakes Trail is a challenging trail run held in Gerwen (Nuenen). The routes pass through beautiful forests with many small lakes and heathland, with more than 90% of the course made up of unpaved paths. The trail features short climbs, winding single tracks and a climb up the “Roof of Brabant”, the Gulbergen. The different distances offer a great challenge for every level, with a lively finish area where spectators can cheer on the runners.

name: 1 v.d. 4 loop Zuiderpark
description: The 1 van de 4 circuit is a running race organised by the Hague Road Runners in Zuiderpark in The Hague. The event is part of a circuit featuring several races and celebrates its 40th anniversary in 2026. It offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere for runners of different abilities and ages. The course runs through the beautiful Zuiderpark and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Halve en Kwart Marathon van Cranendonck
Rooise Crosslopen 1e
description: The Rooise Crosslopen 1st is a cross-country running event held in Sint-Oedenrode. The event offers several categories divided by age group, including pupils, juniors, and seniors, with distances up to 7.9 km. The race is suitable for runners of various ages and levels and takes place in a natural setting in Brabant.

name: Vooruitgangloop
description: The Vooruitgangloop is a running event held in the beautiful Oude Veerdam recreation area near Zuidland. The first edition is organised by IJsclub Vooruitgang and offers an atmospheric run through a green, natural area. The start and finish are at the ice rink, which is easily accessible by bicycle and public transport. The event is suitable for all ages, with a kids’ run and a 10 km race, and includes a warm-up and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2027, løp 5
description: Voss Running Series 2027 is an inclusive running series for everyone aged 9 and over, with five races throughout the year. The races are held on Mondays, starting at 19:00, except for the fifth race on 20 September, which starts at 18:30. The course is 5 km long, starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground, and runs through Prestegardsmoen and along the waterfront promenade. This is a friendly recreational race that welcomes both joggers and runners.
course_highlights: 5 km course starting and finishing at Voss Sports Ground
Loop through Prestegardsmoen
Run along the waterfront promenade
additional: A discount is available when registering for all six races before the second race. You can also register for individual races via eqtiming.no. The races are held on Mondays. Start time: 18:30. Registration takes place online via EQ Timing. You can register for an individual race or receive a discount by registering for all six races before the second race.

name: Tien van 't Aogje
description: De Tien van 't Aogje is a running event in Princenhage, Breda. The event offers races over 5 and 10 kilometers, with a fun family run as an additional event. Race numbers are sent by email in advance, and the awards ceremony takes place immediately after each race at Haagsemarkt. The event attracts many participants and has a maximum capacity for each distance.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races through Princenhage
Awards ceremony immediately after each race at Haagsemarkt
Fun family run as an additional event
additional: Race numbers are sent by email with additional information. There are two opportunities to collect race numbers. The awards ceremony takes place immediately after each race at Haagsemarkt. There is a maximum number of participants for each distance. Registration for 2025 is closed. The event takes place in Princenhage, Breda, and includes several race distances, with awards ceremonies after each race.

name: Stoltzekleiven Opp - dag 1
description: Stoltzekleiven Opp is known as the world’s steepest race and is held in Bergen, Vestland. The race offers an intense challenge up the steep Stoltzekleiven stairs, attracting both local and international runners. With its unique character and spectacular surroundings, it is a popular event for those seeking a demanding and exciting race experience.
course_highlights: The world’s steepest race
Run up the Stoltzekleiven stairs
An intense and demanding climb

name: 6. Oslo Trail Challenge 200km
description: Oslo Trail Challenge is a trail ultramarathon that passes through beautiful natural areas such as Nordmarka, Lillomarka and Romeriksåsen. The race offers several distances, including a challenging 200 km route, as well as 100, 55 and 21 km. The start and finish are in Oslo, and the race attracts runners seeking a challenging and scenic experience on forest trails. It is a popular event for ultrarunners who want to test their endurance on varied terrain.
course_highlights: Trail ultramarathon through Nordmarka, Lillomarka and Romeriksåsen
Several distances: 200 km, 100 km, 55 km and 21 km
Start and finish in Oslo

name: Nachtlauf über 7 Meilen und 30. Jedermannlauf über 3,1 Meilen (5 km)
description: The Zonser Night Run offers two exciting races: the 7-mile race and the 5 km fun run. The event takes place in Dormagen-Zons and is known for its unique nighttime atmosphere. The course runs through the historic old town, giving runners a special experience. The race is open to all ages and ability levels and is a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: 7 miles (approx. 11.3 km) through the historic old town of Zons
5 km fun run as a shorter option
Night run with a special atmosphere and lighting
additional: No late registration is possible. The event takes place in the historic old town of Zons. There is an accompanying program and an awards ceremony. Parking and travel information are available on the website. The race takes place at night and offers a special atmosphere. Late registration is not possible. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers a great opportunity to experience the historic surroundings.

name: Schülerlauf
description: The Rüppurr Schools’ Students’ Run is a long-standing annual running competition that brings together students from various schools in Karlsruhe. The event has separate categories for girls and boys, and all participants receive certificates and medals. Prizes are awarded for first, second and third place. Registration is through the schools, and late entries are possible on the day of the event. The run takes place around the TUS Rüppurr club grounds and encourages young athletes in the region.

name: Zombies are Coming 180km
description: Zombies are Coming is a unique 180-kilometre ultrarun from Amsterdam to Groningen, where participants must maintain a constant speed of 7.5 km/h to finish within 24 hours. Participants carry all their own gear and run without a crew, while being pursued by a ‘zombie horde’ that eliminates them if they fall behind the pace. It is not a race against other runners, but a personal challenge to reach the finish and stay ahead of the zombies.

name: Martini Marathon
description: The Martini Marathon in Groningen is a unique marathon on the athletics track, organized by Groningen Atletiek. The race takes place on Friday evening and offers both a solo marathon of 42,195 meters and a relay for teams of 3 to 5 runners. The relay consists of distances of 2,195 meters and four legs of 10,000 meters, guaranteeing a challenging and fast running experience. The atmosphere is convivial, with refreshments along the way and after the race, and all participants receive a medal. The winners receive the prestigious Martini Bokaal.

name: Nedmag Moonlightwalk
description: The Nedmag Moonlightwalk in Veendam is an atmospheric evening walk of approximately 6 kilometers held by moonlight. The event is not a race, but a relaxed walk where participants can enjoy various performances and special experiences along the route. The route is accessible to almost everyone, including wheelchair users, and offers a unique way to experience Veendam. Proceeds from the walk go to charity; this year, the beneficiary is the Margarethe Hardenberg Cultural Centre.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Lundby Krat Trail
Tour de Fredensborgs efterårsløb i Nivå 2026
Tjurruset
description: Tjurruset is an annual cross-country race in Karlstad, featuring a course of approximately 10 kilometres with both natural and constructed obstacles. The race is known for its muddy, challenging terrain, with water, steep hills and creative obstacles, creating a fun, spectator-friendly festival. In addition to the main race, there are children’s races, Kalvruset and Minikalvruset, with shorter courses and child-friendly obstacles. Tjurruset attracts both experienced cross-country runners and enthusiastic recreational runners, all of whom enjoy a memorable, muddy experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km course with natural and constructed obstacles
Terrain featuring mud, water and steep hills
Spectator-friendly spots near the muddiest and wettest obstacles
additional: Bib distribution starts at 09:00 at Norra fältet. The warm-up starts at approximately 13:45. The race bib and timing chip are handed out together; the chip is attached to the ankle and discarded after the race. Participants should change at home, as there are no changing rooms on site. Medical assistance is available at the finish and along the course. Late registration is available on site until 45 minutes before the start. Food service and Tjurruset tights are available for purchase in the event area. There is a team competition with teams of up to six people, with the five fastest times counting. Participants should be able to run 10 km on road or asphalt in under 90 minutes. The children’s races include Kalvruset, 2.5 km, and Minikalvruset, approximately 200–400 metres.

name: Birken Gateløp 10 km
description: Birken Street Run in Lillehammer is a running festival in the heart of the city, offering distances of 10 km, 5 km and the BarneBirken Street Run. The race is for everyone, whether you’re chasing a personal best, trying your first 5 km race or looking for an active experience with family and friends. Music, cheering crowds and lively support along the course create a festival atmosphere for both fast runners and those taking a more relaxed pace. The start and finish are centrally located at Sigrid Undsets plass, and the 10 km course follows parts of the historic route of the Olympic Dayrun from the 1980s and 90s.
course_highlights: The course runs through central Lillehammer on paved city streets
The 10 km course follows parts of the former Olympic Dayrun route
Music, bands and cheering crowds bring the course to life
additional: Music, bands, drums, majorettes and a DJ create a lively atmosphere along the course. The race welcomes both fast runners and those who prefer a more relaxed pace. BarneBirken Street Run supports a charitable cause by collecting donations for Right To Play. The 10 km distance is open to participants who turn at least 13 in 2027. The course returns to the finish just south of Mesna Bru.

name: Hagemanns rundbaneløp 2027
description: Hagemanns Backyard Festival 2027 is a unique race held on Svelvik Cycling Club’s loop course. The challenge is to complete a 6.7 km loop within one hour, with a start every hour on the hour from 10:00. Participants who fail to finish within the time limit are eliminated, and the aim is to be the last one standing. A children’s race is also held, and participants can choose to run a single loop at any time. The festival offers medals for all participants, changing rooms, showers and refreshments. Reflective vests and headlamps are mandatory after 21:00.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop course, with a start every hour on the hour
Children’s race of approximately 400–500 metres around the school building
Changing rooms and showers at Ebbestadhallen available all weekend
additional: Reflective vests and headlamps are mandatory from 21:00 to 06:00. Pizza is served to participants at 19:30. The kiosk opens at 08:00 and is run by Svelvik Cycling Club. Buying and selling race bibs is possible. Changing rooms and showers at Ebbestadhallen are available all weekend. Children’s races are held on both Saturday and Sunday at 15:05. A children’s race is also held at Ebbestad Primary School. Information about course distance and elevation gain is from the 2025 edition.

name: Nattland Backyard Ultra
description: Nattland Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarun held in Bergen, Vestland. The race consists of multiple laps on a set course, with participants running for as long as they can in an effort to be the last one to finish. The event takes place on Saturday, 25 September 2027, and attracts both local and international ultrarunners seeking a challenging and social running experience.
course_highlights: The race follows a set loop that is repeated every hour
A demanding ultrarun focused on endurance and tactics
Held in scenic surroundings in Bergen
additional: Registration is via Eqtiming.no. The race takes place on Saturday, 25 September 2027, in Bergen. No specific start times or price details were found on the available pages.

name: Backyard Stavanger Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Backyard Deltakere kr 750,00 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3% transaksjonsgebyr)

description: Backyard Stavanger is a unique ultrarun held at Dyrsnes Nature Centre in Stavanger. The race consists of a gently undulating loop of approximately 6.7 km, run every hour on the hour, with a maximum of 12 laps. Participants must start each lap to continue, and the last person to start wins the race. The event offers a social and inclusive atmosphere with a low barrier to entry, welcoming both beginners and experienced ultrarunners. Basic refreshments and places to rest are provided. Safety equipment, including a headlamp and reflective vest, is mandatory.
course_highlights: Gently undulating loop of approximately 6.7 km per lap
Run every hour on the hour, with a maximum of 12 laps (80.4 km in total)
Social event with places to rest in tents and a barn
additional: You must bring your own drinking cup, headlamp and reflective vest. Attaching your race bib with a race belt is recommended. Basic refreshments include snacks, coffee, tea, broth and water. Support is not permitted indoors or on the course, only in the start and finish area. Everyone who completes 12 laps receives a cup, and a wooden medal for the ultradistance (longer than a marathon). Maximum 210 participants.

name: Gruemila
description: Gruemila is a challenging 10 km race held in Kirkenær as part of the Grue Half Marathon event. The race features technically demanding forest terrain on 6.7 km loops, where participants can compete for the win or finish for a medal and finisher cap. The event also includes a fast, flat half marathon, considered one of Norway’s fastest courses. This is a great race for both competitive and recreational runners looking for a varied and exciting running experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Technically challenging forest terrain on 6.7 km loops
Medal available for completing a loop
Flat and fast half marathon
additional: The race is run on 6.7 km loops through technically challenging forest terrain, with a new start every hour until only one runner remains. Complete one loop for a medal, or compete for a finisher cap and the win.

name: Grep Grenlandsløpet
description: Grenlandsløpet is a varied race through woodland and open countryside in Porsgrunn, Telemark, suitable for everyone from children to adults, from active runners to recreational participants. The event offers several distances, including a children’s race, 5 km, 10 km, 19 km and a 46 km ultradistance. It emphasizes the enjoyment of activity, a sense of achievement and community, with a social run beforehand to get familiar with the courses. The start and finish are at Vestsiden School. Food and drink stations are provided, along with prize-giving for the top three finishers in each timed distance.
course_highlights: The courses run through woodland and open countryside on forest roads, trails, gravel roads and asphalt.
The 46 km ultradistance starts at Nisterud and follows a GPX file through the western forest, passing several peaks.
The children’s race follows safe, clearly marked routes around Vestsiden School, with medals for all participants.
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Vestsiden School on Friday 25 September from 17:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 06:30. A Social Run is held before the event for the 5 km and 10 km distances. The children’s race is free and requires no registration, and all participants receive medals. The ultradistance requires downloading a GPX file; the route is not marked. Food and drink stations are provided on all distances except the 5 km. The Red Cross has a base in the finish area, and shower facilities are available for ultrarunners. Bag storage is available in the finish area. Prizes are awarded on an ongoing basis after finishers cross the line, to the top three women and men in each timed distance. The organizer describes the race as suitable for people of different ages and activity levels.

name: Nøklevann Rundt 2027
price_range: 450–575 kr for voksne på 5 km og 10 km; paraløpet er gratis
description: Nøklevann Rundt is a traditional fun run being held for the 46th time in 2027. The race features a hilly and varied course, mainly on gravel roads around Nøklevann, with distances for the whole family, including 10 km, 5 km, a children’s race and a para race. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners looking for a wonderful autumn experience in scenic surroundings in Oslo. It is a social and inclusive race with a great atmosphere and prizes for all children and participants.
course_highlights: Hilly course, mainly on gravel roads around Nøklevann
The 5 km consists of two easy-to-run laps starting from Haraløkka
Children’s race and para race on flat asphalt and gravel sections
additional: Bib distribution takes place on Thursday 8 October from 15:00 to 21:00 at Skullerud Sport Senter. There are water stations at Bremsrud (5.3 km), after the 10 km finish, and after the 5 km finish. The children’s race is not timed, and parents may run alongside their children or have them in a stroller. There are multiple start waves for the 5 km (2 waves) and 10 km (6 waves), based on estimated finish time. The approximately 500-metre para race is free and open to para-athletes. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded to category winners and overall winners. Single-use timing chips are used for the 5 km and 10 km. Registration is via EQTiming. There is no race-day registration at Haraløkka. Administration and payment fees may apply.

name: Neusser Integrationslauf
description: The Neuss Integration Run, organized by DJK RHEINKRAFT Neuss 1914 e.V., takes place at the Ludwig-Wolker sports facility in Neuss. The event celebrates integration in practice, bringing together people of all backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities, to run or walk together. The focus is on community and promoting integration, not competition. A colorful program featuring music, activities for children and food makes the day a celebration for participants and visitors.
course_highlights: An open course for running and walking, with no time pressure
Participants of all ages and backgrounds
A colorful program featuring a bouncy castle, bull riding and music
additional: The run is open to people of all ages, backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities. There are no rankings; the focus is on having fun and coming together. The program offers a range of activities for participants and visitors, including a bouncy castle, bull riding, activities for children, music and culinary specialties. The event takes place at the Ludwig-Wolker sports facility and is part of SportWoche für Alle 2026, which features inclusive sports activities and taster sessions.

name: Schottener Stauseelauf
description: The Schotten Reservoir Run is organized by TGV Schotten, the largest sports club in the Vogelsberg region. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete on varied courses around the reservoir. The run is part of the club’s extensive sports program, which also includes numerous major running events. Participants and visitors are warmly welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Running routes around the Schotten Reservoir
Varied terrain in the Vogelsberg region
Organized by an experienced sports club with professional timing
additional: Registration, results and certificates are provided through the club’s own timing service, "TGV SportStar". TGV Schotten is a large sports club with more than 1,300 members and organizes other major events in running and other disciplines in addition to the Reservoir Run. The race is known for its fast, flat course and attracts runners from across the region. Registration is available on the official website, and the event is a popular opportunity for recreational and competitive runners to improve their personal bests.

name: Appelhülsener Landlauf
location: Appelhülsener Landlauf, Nottuln-Appelhülsen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Appelhülsener Landlauf is a family-friendly running event in the beautiful Münsterland, offering routes for all age groups. The officially measured 5 km and 10 km races are eligible for inclusion in rankings and combine Westphalian charm with rural idyll. Refreshment stations and a varied selection in the finish area ensure participants are well catered for. The event is part of the Westmünsterland Running Series and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km routes, eligible for inclusion in rankings
Water refreshment stations every 2.5 km
Changing and shower facilities at the sports centre in the start and finish area
additional: Race packs can be collected at the sports centre on race day from 13:00. Timing is provided by Race-Result using a reusable chip attached to the bib, which is collected at the finish. Changing and shower facilities are located directly in the start/finish area. The first three male and female runners in the 5 km and 10 km races receive awards. All participants in the Bambini and student races receive a medal. Nordic walking is not timed competitively and has no awards ceremony. Certificates and results are available online; certificate printing is offered at race-pack collection. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, 48301 Nottuln.

name: Bahnstreckenlauf
location: Zinhaine, Bad Marienberg, Westerwaldkreis, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Wäller Bahnstreckenlauf in Bad Marienberg is a new running event starting in 2025. From 2026, it will also count as a scoring race for the Wäller-Lauf-Cup. The course is an out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach bei Bad-Marienberg and Nistertal. The start and finish are on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company, with a nearby parking lot for participants. The event is organized by TuS Bad-Marienberg Leichtathletik and offers runners an attractive course in the region.
course_highlights: Out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach and Nistertal
Start and finish on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company
Parking available right by the start and finish
additional: The event is part of the Wäller-Lauf-Cup from 2026. Certificates and individual results are available online. The course is an out-and-back route on a cycle path, suggesting a flat, fast course. The event offers various age categories and distances.

name: Brückenlauf Wetter
description: Der Brückenlauf Wetter ist ein inklusives Laufevent in Wetter (Ruhr), bei dem Menschen mit und ohne Behinderung gemeinsam teilnehmen können. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Streckenlängen von der Bambini/FUN-Staffel über 5,6 km bis hin zu 11 km, sowohl zum Laufen als auch zum Walken. Das Event legt großen Wert auf Teamgeist, Gemeinschaft, Spaß an der Bewegung und Barrierefreiheit. Es ist eine besondere Gelegenheit, gemeinsam aktiv zu sein und die Freude am Sport zu teilen.
course_highlights: Streckenlängen von 4×400 m Staffel, 5,6 km und 11 km
Inklusive Teilnahme für Menschen mit und ohne Behinderung
Barrierefreie Strecken für alle Leistungsniveaus
additional: Urkunden können online ausgedruckt werden. Das Event wird vom Volmarsteiner Inklusionssportverein e. V. organisiert. Es gibt eine FUN-Staffel über 4×400 m für alle Altersklassen. Die FUN- und Bambini-Staffel ist für alle Altersklassen vorgesehen.

name: Halveraner Herbstlauf
location: Innenstadt von Halver, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Halver Autumn Run takes place annually on the last weekend in September in Halver town centre. Organised by SSV Halver together with LGHS, the event offers races for toddlers and schoolchildren, as well as a relay for recreational runners. The main event is a 4 x 900-metre relay with two categories (U100 and Ü100). The event has been a fixture on the local running calendar for over 20 years and takes runners right through Halver city centre.
course_highlights: Relay race with 4 x 900-metre laps
The course runs through Halver town centre
Separate races for toddlers, schoolchildren and youth
additional: Late entries are possible online or at the race office up to 45 minutes before the respective race start. A fee of €1.50 (online) or €2 (race office) applies to entries on the day of the event. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Lindenhof School. The roads will be closed for the race from 12:00. All participants receive a medal; the top three in each age group also receive medals and certificates. Relay race, 4 x 900 m, in Halver town centre, age categories U100 / Ü100

name: Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte
description: The 19th Volksbank City Run Telgte is taking place and offers runners of all ages a varied programme. The routes pass through the historic old town, along the Ems and through the surrounding countryside, vividly reflecting the motto “Town, Country and River.” In addition to the main 10,000-metre race, other events include a 5,000-metre race, walking, student and Bambini races, and an untimed Fun Run. The event is suitable for competitive runners, recreational runners and families, and is organised by TV Friesen Telgte e.V.
course_highlights: 10,000-metre main race through the old town, the Ems floodplains and the countryside
5,000-metre race with a drink station halfway along the route
Varied surfaces, including asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €2 late-entry fee (for the Bambini race, this fee is charged once per family or group). Changing facilities are available in the old double gym at the school centre, close to the start and finish. Medals, trophies and certificates are awarded in various events and age groups. The varied route includes asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails. Photos and video footage will be taken and published. The start and finish are at the school centre sports field. Registration is online. Changing facilities are in the Old Double Gym. Children’s races are not timed.

name: Weezer Staffellauf
description: The Weeze Relay Race has been held in Weeze every year in mid-September since 1985 and has become a popular relay event with up to 250 participating teams. The course follows a scenic 5 km loop along the Niers walking trail. The event offers various relay categories, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s and regular teams, and attracts runners of all ages. The athletics department of TSV Weeze organizes the event with great dedication and looks forward to welcoming many participants in 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km loop along the Niers walking trail
Relay event with Bambini, schoolchildren’s and regular teams
Held annually in mid-September since 1985
additional: Event information and registration will follow at the end of July. Up to 250 relay teams have participated. The 38th Weeze Relay Race in 2024 saw 32 Bambini, 36 schoolchildren’s teams and 55 regular teams finish. The event also includes school and community competitions, as well as on-site refreshments.

name: Herbstcross des SSV-MG-Ahlsdorf / 2. Peter Zinke Gedenklauf
Kreuzhorst Ultra
description: The Kreuzhorst Ultra (KRHU) is a friendly backyard ultra in Magdeburg-Kreuzhorst, taking place for the third time. The 6.7 km course starts again at the top of every hour, and participants run as many laps as they can or wish to. The race is a private invitation-only event focused on community, passion, and the joy of running. The course runs mainly along forest and farm tracks with no significant climbs, and there are classifications for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km.

name: 1. Basche-Cross
description: Der Basche-Cross ist ein traditionsreicher Crosslauf in Barsinghausen, der Läuferinnen und Läufer aller Leistungsstufen anspricht. Die Strecke führt durch abwechslungsreiches Gelände und bietet eine anspruchsvolle Herausforderung abseits befestigter Wege. Die Veranstaltung ist bekannt für ihre naturnahe Atmosphäre und die Möglichkeit, Crosslauf in einer landschaftlich reizvollen Umgebung zu erleben. Teilnehmer können sich auf eine gut organisierte Veranstaltung mit familiärem Flair freuen.
course_highlights: Naturnahe Crosslaufstrecke durch abwechslungsreiches Gelände
Anspruchsvolle Abschnitte abseits befestigter Wege
Landschaftlich reizvolle Umgebung in Barsinghausen

name: 10. Göttinger Lichterlauf
description: Der Göttinger Benefiz-Lichterlauf ist eine stimmungsvolle Laufveranstaltung rund um den Kiessee in Göttingen, die Menschen zusammenbringt, um gemeinsam Gutes zu tun. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine besondere Beleuchtung, ein abwechslungsreiches Musikprogramm und ein großes Engagement der Teilnehmenden und Ehrenamtlichen aus. Der Lauf unterstützt das Elternhaus Göttingen, das Familien mit schwerkranken Kindern in einer schwierigen Lebensphase ein Zuhause auf Zeit bietet. Der Benefiz-Lichterlauf ist ein Abend voller Gemeinschaft, Musik und Lichter, der jährlich viele Menschen begeistert.
course_highlights: Stimmungsvolle Beleuchtung rund um den Kiessee
Abwechslungsreiches Musikprogramm während der Veranstaltung
Gemeinschaftlicher Lauf- und Spazierabend zugunsten des Elternhauses Göttingen
additional: Die Veranstaltung ist ein Benefizlauf zugunsten des Elternhauses Göttingen, das Familien mit schwerkranken Kindern unterstützt. Es handelt sich um einen Abendlauf mit Musik und Lichterbeleuchtung, der auch Spaziergänger willkommen heißt. Die Veranstaltung wird von vielen Ehrenamtlichen, Musikern und Unterstützern getragen.

name: Bergzeitlauf Brockenheroes 2026
description: The BROCKENHEROES mountain time trial and uphill race is a challenging individual time trial in the Harz, held in Schierke. Participants compete on various routes of up to 24 km and with up to 900 metres of elevation gain, including road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing and Nordic walking. The event offers a unique challenge against the clock, the mountain and oneself, starting on Brockenstraße and finishing on the Brocken plateau. The atmosphere combines sporting ambition with the impressive natural scenery of the Harz.

name: Böckstiegellauf
description: The Böckstiegellauf is a scenic race through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills, running from Peter auf’m Berge in Bielefeld to the center of Werther. Distances include 18 km and 10 km, as well as a 2.5 km schoolchildren’s race. The course partly follows the Hermannslauf and passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum. The event is very well organized, with a shuttle bus from the finish to the start and an awards ceremony in the center of Werther.

name: Cloppenburger Citylauf
organizer: Stadt Cloppenburg, Lauftreff des SV Bethen
description: The Cloppenburg City Run is a popular running event held as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival, which takes place annually on the last weekend in September. The main race starts at the Red School on the market square and runs along Eschstraße to Rathausplatz. In addition to the main race, there is a relay competition in which teams of four each complete a course of approximately 1,000 metres four times. The event is organised by the running group of SV Bethen e. V. and overseen by the NLV district of Cloppenburg.

name: Drei-Täler-Lauf
description: The 3-Täler-Lauf, organised by TV Mettingen 1930 e.V., takes participants along varied routes through the three valleys of Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal in the Tecklenburger Land. The 14.1 km main race features challenging, hilly terrain and impressive views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg. There is also an 8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes alike. Children are welcome to take part in an 800 m schoolchildren’s race and a 400 m Bambini race, where fun is the main focus. The family-friendly event offers timing with a disposable chip, as well as showers and changing rooms at Ludgeri School.

name: Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf
description: The Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf is a long-standing running event that has been held annually on the Pohl-Boskamp grounds since 2002. With distances of 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km, the race offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is especially family-friendly, with special Bambini runs for children and a varied program featuring games, a food mile and entertainment. It promotes a sense of community and the joy of being active, and welcomes individuals, school classes, teams and companies.

name: Hotfoot Run Warstein
description: The Hotfoot Run Warstein is a spectacular obstacle race, with distances ranging from 5 km (Family Edition) to 20 km, making it suitable for all fitness levels and age groups. The course crosses the Montgolfiadengelände, the ski slope and the quarry, with plenty of muddy obstacles, water slides and foam. Since 2007, the event has offered an electrifying start show, a unique atmosphere, and a focus on team spirit and fun. Whether you’re a fitness fanatic, a fun-loving group or a family, everyone can enjoy an unforgettable adventure here in NRW.

name: Höhlerfestlauf
description: The 11th Höhlerfest Run in Gera offers a varied running event with courses for all ages and ability levels. New this year is the 22 km cross-country run with obstacles and 420 m of elevation gain, which leads through the city forest and Hofwiesenpark. In addition to classic distances from 0.8 km to 12 km, there are walking and handicap courses, as well as the popular parent-child run for preschoolers. The event stands out for its special atmosphere, with live music and a family-friendly feel, and is supported by the City of Gera.

name: Lauf Rund um den Grengel
description: The Rund um den Grengel Run is a traditional fun run in Engelskirchen, held annually by VfL Engelskirchen e.V., Athletics & Triathlon Department. The event offers various distances, including a Bambini run, schoolchildren’s races, a 5 km fun run and a 10 km main race, some of which are held as municipal championships. The course is flat and runs over a sports field, roads and forest paths; it has been measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). Its family-friendly atmosphere and inclusion of children and young people make the run a special event for all age groups.

name: Oldersumer Appel-Loop
description: The Oldersum Appel-Loop is a popular race that passes through Oldersum’s picturesque parks, along the Rorichumer Tief canal, and through the “alte Seilerei” museum. The course finishes in the apple park, where the Oldersum Apple Market is also taking place and refreshments are available. In addition to the main 5 km and 10 km races, there is a 5 km walking route and 800 m children’s races for various age groups. The race is part of the Ostfriesische 7 running series and offers a lovely atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: R5K Berlin
description: Der R5K Tour Finale ist ein spannender 5-Kilometer-Lauf für Kinder und Jugendliche im Rahmen des GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON. Das Rennen findet am 25. September 2027 zwischen Potsdamer Platz und dem Zieleinlauf am Brandenburger Tor statt. Es bietet jungen Läuferinnen und Läufern die Möglichkeit, in der Berliner Innenstadt auf einer attraktiven Strecke teilzunehmen und Teil eines großen Laufsport-Events zu sein. Die Veranstaltung fördert Bewegung und Gemeinschaft unter dem Motto, den Nachwuchs in Bewegung zu bringen.
course_highlights: Strecke zwischen Potsdamer Platz und Brandenburger Tor
Attraktive Innenstadtlage in Berlin
Teil des großen GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON Events
additional: Der R5K Tour Finale findet am Samstag, 25. September 2027 statt. Die genaue Startzeit ist nicht angegeben. Die Veranstaltung ist Teil der Kids & Youth Angebote des GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON und wird von Sponsoren wie Generali und adidas unterstützt.

name: Schelder Berglauf
description: The Schelder Berglauf is a challenging mountain run in Dillenburg, held annually by ASC Dillenburg. The course passes through varied terrain with steep climbs, offering runners an athletic challenge in a natural setting. The event attracts both competitive and recreational runners and is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar.

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Poland
description: Nocna Piątka is a unique 5-kilometer race taking place in Gdańsk, the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are on the illuminated pitch at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, where participants can enjoy a spectacular show featuring lasers, music, and light effects. The course runs through the city and features cheering points with music and fire shows, creating a one-of-a-kind nighttime atmosphere. This new version of the well-known race held alongside the half marathon has moved to Saturday evening to give runners and spectators a special experience.

name: Kołobrzeska Odyseja
description: Kołobrzeska Odyseja ’26 is a series of three exceptional races held in Kołobrzeg, combining passion, strength, and a seaside atmosphere. The event offers races over 5 km, half-marathon, marathon, and 10 km distances. The courses are certified by the PZLA, and participants can look forward to generous race packs, a finisher zone with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It’s a great opportunity to feel the energy of the seaside and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.

name: VIII Bieg Szlakiem Kolejowym
location: Czerwona Woda, Gmina Węgliniec, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 42e Halve van Katwijk
location: Duinplein, Katwijk aan Zee, Katwijk, South Holland, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The 42nd edition of the Halve van Katwijk takes place as a popular running and walking festival along the coast. The event is known for its sporty and welcoming atmosphere, with a beautiful course that starts and finishes at Duinplein, in front of the lighthouse on Katwijk Boulevard. The Halve van Katwijk offers various distances for runners, walkers and children, and attracts many participants each year who enjoy the unique surroundings and friendly atmosphere. The organisers are continually working to improve the event and give everyone an unforgettable day.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Duinplein, directly in front of the lighthouse on Katwijk Boulevard
Refreshment stations at Vriezenwei, Panbos and Wassenaarse Slag
Various courses with GPX files available, including special Kidsrun routes
additional: Start and Finish Village at Duinplein, with changing facilities, toilets, activities and massage. No on-the-day registration is possible. Parking garage on the Boulevard and alternative parking garages nearby. No supervised bicycle parking is available. Business Run with its own starting area, group photo, memento and networking drinks afterwards. GPX files for all routes are available. The event also includes a Kidsrun and Business Run; registration is popular and often closes early due to high demand.

name: Thaisner DörpsRun
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 6.4 km, 4 km, 1.2 km, 0.6 km

name: De 5 van Bavel
description: The 5 van Bavel is an annual running event in ’t Klooster, Bavel, celebrating its 10th anniversary edition in 2026. The event offers a fun and sporty day for all ages, with several distances, including a 5 km race, a 10 km recreational run and a kids’ run. The start and finish are centrally located on Kloosterstraat, by Café-zaal ’t Karrewiel. The 5 van Bavel also supports a good cause: research into neuroendocrine tumours (NETs).

name: Run for Hope
description: Run for Hope is an inspiring running race held in the Dordtse Biesbosch. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 21.1 kilometres and run to raise money for clients of De Hoop, who receive support in building a new life. The run is centred on hope and solidarity, with runners encouraged by supporters as they work together to contribute to a social cause. The event combines sporting spirit with a meaningful commitment to helping others.

name: Spanderswoud Trailrun
description: The Spanderswoud Trail Run is a relaxed trail run through the beautiful Spanderswoud and surrounding nature reserves in the Gooi region. The 10, 20 and 30 km routes take you along winding forest paths, singletracks and open heathland, with no competition or time pressure. The start and finish are at the Natuurmonumenten visitor centre on Landgoed Boekesteyn in ’s-Graveland. There are aid stations along the way, and afterwards you can enjoy food and drinks at Café-Restaurant Brambergen.

name: Crob Run
description: The Crob Run is a running event in Haaften. It offers a beautiful route along the dikes around Haaften and through the natural surroundings of the Waal, suitable for all ages. There are several distances, including kids’ runs for children aged 5 to 12, and 5 km and 10 km races for adults. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with music, food options and a bar. Part of the proceeds goes to charity.

name: Hill Repeat Madness: 4-uurs trailrunchallenge
description: Hill Repeat Madness is a challenging 4-hour trail-running challenge held at Landgoed Gulbergen in Nuenen. This trail run challenges runners to test their endurance and speed on a varied course in a natural setting. It is organised by Trailrunners Brabant, known for their passion for trail running and for creating a sporty, friendly atmosphere. The race is ideal for trail runners who enjoy an intense and dynamic running experience.

name: BEAT Running Festival
description: The BEAT Running Festival in Amsterdamse Bos is a unique knockout running event where participants run repeated 1 km laps at an increasing pace. The race is about keeping up with an official pacer; anyone who falls behind is eliminated until one man and one woman remain. Alongside the exciting race, there is a festival with food, drinks, challenges and a community zone, making the event more than just a running race. The winners receive a sports trip worth €2,000.

name: Mission Run
description: MissionRun 2026 takes place on Saturday 26 September in Scherpenzeel and offers running and walking routes of 5, 10 and 20 km, including a half marathon for participants aged 18 and over. The course runs through the nature-rich countryside around Scherpenzeel, along forest trails and quiet country roads, and is suitable for experienced runners, recreational participants and walkers alike. All proceeds from the event go to International Justice Mission, in support of Anne & Dianne’s Muskathlon. The start and finish are at Oud Willaer 74, with MyLaps timing for the running distances.

name: Zevenheuvelentrail & NK Trailrunning
distance_verbose: 56 km, Marathon, 28 km, Halve marathon, 14 km, 7 km
description: The Zevenheuvelentrail & Dutch National Trail Running Championships take place in the wooded, hilly surroundings of Nijmegen. The trails feature challenging routes with steep climbs, tough descents and unpaved paths through natural areas such as the Nijmeegse Heuvelrug and Landgoed van Jurgens. The Dutch National Trail Running Championships comprise a short 28-kilometre trail and a long 56-kilometre trail, where athletes with an Atletiekunie licence compete for the Dutch title. The organisers provide an atmospheric event with aid stations and a professional approach.

name: Roldertoren Run
description: The Roldertorenrun is a running event in and around Rolde, with three distances: a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km. The half marathon takes you through the beautiful Drenthe countryside, with heathland, burial mounds, streams and old cart tracks, and finishes at the Jacobus Church. The 10 km is suitable for experienced runners and runs partly across the Balloërveld and along the Wandelspoor. The 5 km is a fast, fully paved route with views of the Balloërveld and a single track back to the finish at the tower. The start and finish are at the Roldertoren.

name: Schoklandloop
description: The Schokland Run is a unique running race organized by AV NOP in cooperation with Het Flevo-landschap and Museum Schokland. The race takes place on the beautiful World Heritage Site of Schokland and combines nature, culture and sport on a challenging course. The 10 km route covers the entire island of Schokland, while the 5 km route runs across the southern island. The start and finish are at Middelbuurt 2, Schokland. Participants receive a souvenir, timekeeping and a refreshment at Restaurant Schokland.

name: Gelderse Poort Ultra
description: The Gelderse Poort Ultra is a challenging 50-kilometre trail that brings the Dutch Ultra Series to a fitting close. The route takes you through the beautiful floodplains around Nijmegen, the forests towards Berg en Dal, and the distinctive farmland in between. With between 700 and 1,000 metres of elevation gain, technical trails and varied scenery including clogs paths, heathland and forests, this ultra offers a special nature experience. The start is at Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken in Ooij, where participants can enjoy a delicious dinner afterwards and, if they wish, stay overnight.

name: Groot Boeschoten Trail
distance_verbose: 35 km, 23 km, 13 km, 6 km, 1.2 km, 0.6 km
description: The Groot Boeschoten Trail takes place in Voorthuizen, starting and finishing at Camping De Zanderij. The routes have been completely renewed and offer a varied course across the Veluwe, featuring forest, heathland, sandy paths and historic estates. The course passes open heathland, fields and forests towards Speuld, Huinen and Garderen, with historic sheepfolds serving as landmarks and refreshment points. The routes are approximately 99% off-road and clearly marked, with premium refreshment points along the way. There is a special Kids Trail for children, including a medal and access to the swimming pool.

name: Norgesløpet - inkl. NM 5 km
description: Norgesløpet is a road race held at Jessheim Stadium in Ullensaker, Akershus, with 5 km and 10 km distances. In 2027, the event also includes the Norwegian Championships (NM) 5 km, with the option to register in an elite start wave. The start and finish are on Kanalveien and at Jessheim Athletics Stadium. The race offers a great atmosphere, pacers, and facilities including changing rooms, bag storage, and water stations. A children’s race is also held, with several waves for different age groups, making for a family-friendly day with a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Jessheim Athletics Stadium
Course along Kanalveien marked with red and white ribbons
Water stations at 5 km and the finish
additional: The elite start wave has priority to line up at the front. Race numbers can be collected at Jessheim Ice and Multi-Use Hall. Bag storage is available with a luggage tag. Toilets and changing rooms are available in several nearby buildings. Pacers carry flags or wear T-shirts indicating popular finish times. The children’s race has waves for children of similar ages. Arriving by train is recommended. Spectators can follow the race at the stadium.

name: Loddefjordløpet
description: Loddefjordløpet is held at Alvøen Sports Park in Bergen. It is an annual race featuring distances including a 5 km and children’s races of 2 km or 600 metres. The event is popular with both children and adults, focusing on athletics and recreational running in a welcoming setting. Loddefjord IL Friidrett, which organises the race, also offers a range of training activities for children and young people in the area. For the latest information, follow the race’s Facebook page.
course_highlights: 5 km course in Alvøen Sports Park
Children’s races of 2 km and 600 metres
Held in scenic surroundings in western Bergen
additional: Loddefjordløpet includes both a 5 km race and children’s races over shorter distances. Historical results from previous years are available on the website. Previous editions have offered free children’s races for pupils in grades 1–4, with a medal for participants.

name: Norgesløpet 2027
description: Norgesløpet 2027 is held as a road race at Jessheim Stadium, with distances of 5 km (Norwegian Championships) and 10 km. The race starts on Kanalveien and finishes inside Jessheim Athletics Stadium. Participants can enter an elite wave, and pacers will run for the most popular finish times. The event also includes children’s races with several waves for different age groups, creating a fun day with a great atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Jessheim Athletics Stadium
Course along Kanalveien marked with red and white tape
Water stations at approximately 5 km and at the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Jessheim Ice and Multipurpose Hall. Bag storage is available with a bag tag. Toilets and changing rooms are located in several nearby buildings. Train travel is recommended, with several parking areas nearby. Pacers will run with visible flags or T-shirts. Children’s races take place at 11:30 and 14:00, with waves divided by age. Fantorangen and the NRK Super Bus will be there for families. Children’s races will also be held. Train travel is recommended; parking costs 50 kr via Vipps.

name: Skoppums Råeste 2027
price_range: 200–400 kr for 10–16 år; 350–550 kr for øvrige deltakere, lisens kan komme i tillegg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Earlybird ut 2026: Kr. 200,- fra 10 opp til og med 16 år

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ved påmelding fra 1. janur 2027 til 31. august 2027: Kr. 300

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Earlybird ut 2026: Kr. 350,- fra 10 opp til og med 16 år

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ved påmelding fra 1. janur 2027 til 31. august 2027: Kr. 450

description: Skoppums Råeste is a challenging and fun obstacle-course trail race suitable for everyone, from beginners to experienced OCR runners. The race takes place at Skoppum Idrettsplass and features mud obstacles, climbing over car wrecks, water crossings, muddy streams, tire obstacles, and crawling zones. Participants can choose to run 2.5 km with approximately 15–20 obstacles, or double the distance to 5 km by completing an extra lap. The race is accessible to all and includes timing, but everyone who finishes receives a medal and is considered a winner. There is also a separate MiniRåeste for children under 10, with a shorter obstacle course.
course_highlights: Obstacle-course trail featuring mud obstacles, climbing over car wrecks, and water crossings
Approximately 2.5 km course with 15–20 obstacles; participants can run 5 km by completing two laps
Accessible race with timing and a medal for all participants
additional: Race registration opens at 10:00 for bib pickup. Skoppums MiniRåeste for children under 10 starts at 11:00. Participants can choose a start group based on an expected lap time of under or over 30 minutes. Changing rooms and washing facilities are available, as is a kiosk that accepts payment via Vipps. Parking costs NOK 50 and is paid via Vipps. All participants receive a medal. The course can be walked before the start, but obstacles must not be tested. Timing and medals are provided. Start groups are divided by expected lap time: under or over 30 minutes. The prices found apply to 2027 registration on the page for the 2026 event.

name: AggerEnergie- und Sparkassenlauf Gummersbach
description: Der AggerEnergie- und Sparkassenlauf in Gummersbach ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die von der LG Gummersbach organisiert wird. Die Strecke führt durch die Stadt und bietet eine abwechslungsreiche Route, die auch durch die Fußgängerzone und verschiedene Stadtteile verläuft. Die Veranstaltung zieht zahlreiche Läufer und Zuschauer an und ist bekannt für ihre gute Organisation und das freundliche Ambiente. Neben dem sportlichen Wettkampf gibt es auch ein attraktives Rahmenprogramm für die ganze Familie.
course_highlights: Strecke führt durch die Fußgängerzone und Andienungsstraße
Abzweig bei Alte Vogtei / Zur Vogtei mit zwei unterschiedlich langen Runden
Start und Ziel am Lindenplatz mit Zuschauerbereich und Verpflegung
additional: Die Veranstaltung wird von rund 60 Helfern unterstützt. Es gibt eine Hüpfburg für Kinder und mobile Verpflegung am Lindenplatz. Die Strecke wird mit Drängelgittern vom Zuschauerbereich getrennt. Das Helferteam sorgt für Verpflegung und ein Kuchenbuffet. Angeboten werden Läufe über 450 Meter, 2 Kilometer, 4 Kilometer und 10 Kilometer. Für den 10-Kilometer-Lauf gilt ein Zeitlimit von 75 Minuten.

name: 14. Bahrs-Kartoffellauf
description: The 14th Bahrs-Kartoffel-Lauf 2026 in Jembke offers runners a varied program with three distances: the 10 km Bahrs-Lauf, the 5 km Kartoffellauf, and an 800 m children’s run. The event takes place in a family-friendly atmosphere, with culinary delights and a varied program featuring performances by the Jembke cheerleaders. Race bibs must be returned after the run, and late registration is not available. The event is part of the running cup and offers not only sporting competition but also a chance to socialize over a generous cake buffet and hearty food.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Komoot
5 km course on Komoot
800 m children’s run
additional: Start times: 10 km Bahrs-Lauf at 10:30, 5 km Kartoffellauf at 12:00, and 800 m children’s run at 13:15. Late registration is not available; registration is in advance only. Race bibs must be returned after the run. Food options include potato soup, veggie bowls, potato pancakes with apple sauce, burgers, bratwurst, shashlik, and rosemary potatoes. The Jembke cheerleaders perform at approximately 11:45 and 13:00. Award ceremonies take place after each race. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, a variety of running options for all age groups, and the opportunity to combine the run with socializing.

name: Asse-Volkslauf und Nordic Walking
description: The Asse Fun Run and Nordic Walking event organized by TSV "Vater Jahn" Wittmar is held annually and will take place for the 34th time. The event is very popular, with record participation last year. It offers a range of running and walking routes in the beautiful surroundings of Wittmar and welcomes athletes of all ages. Registration is available from the end of June. Late registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run.
course_highlights: Distances of 0.3 km and 10.6 km
Nordic Walking included
Location: Wittmar, Germany
additional: Registration opens at the end of June; detailed information is available in the official announcement; the event includes running and Nordic Walking disciplines

name: Neandertallauf
organizer: TSV Hochdahl 64 e.V., Lauftreff Alt-Erkrath e.V. und TuS Erkrath 1930 e.V.
description: Der Neandertallauf am 26. September 2027 in Erkrath-Hochdahl bietet Läufern aller Altersklassen ein vielfältiges Programm. Die Hauptstrecke ist ein Drittelmarathon von 14,065 Metern, der landschaftlich reizvoll durch das Neandertal führt, inklusive eines Besuchs am Fundort des Neandertalers und dem Erlebnisturm Höhlenblick. Zusätzlich gibt es einen 5-km-Volkslauf sowie Walking- und Nordic-Walking-Strecken. Für Kinder werden altersgerechte Läufe auf einem 900-Meter-Rundkurs angeboten, die das Event zu einer familienfreundlichen Veranstaltung machen.
course_highlights: Drittelmarathon-Strecke mit asphaltieren und unbefestigten Wald- und Feldwegen, teils mit Crosslauf-Potential
Passage am Fundort des Neandertalers und Erlebnisturm Höhlenblick
5-km-Strecke mit flachen und leicht ansteigenden Abschnitten durch Felder und Naturschutzgebiet
additional: Start und Ziel sind an der Bessemer Straße 10 bei Firma TIMOCOM. Startunterlagen werden am Veranstaltungstag ab 8:30 Uhr ausgegeben. Alle Läufe mit Zeitmessung (außer Bambini und U8) verwenden Startnummern mit Chip auf der Rückseite. Es gibt eine kostenfreie Duschmöglichkeit im nahegelegenen Neanderbad für 45 Minuten gegen Vorlage der Startnummer. Die Siegerehrungen umfassen Urkunden und Preise für verschiedene Altersklassen. Kinderläufe haben keine Zeitmessung, aber Ehrenpreise und Urkunden für die besten Läufer. Start und Ziel befinden sich an der Bessemer Straße in Erkrath-Hochdahl. Bei allen Läufen außer Bambini U6 und Kinder U8 ist Zeitmessung vorgesehen.

name: Schusterlauf
description: The Schusterlauf Preetz is a traditional running event with various distances, held in Preetz. The challenging 16 km course runs through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker, and requires good to very good fitness. In addition to the main race, there are shorter distances, including the Bambini Run for children and the Kirchsee and Wehrberg runs. The event is part of the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, where participants can earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: 16 km course through forests, meadows and along Lake Lanker
Good, firm-footed trails in the Wehrberg and along the shore of Kirchsee
Challenging course with a checkpoint at Gut Wahlstorf
additional: Bib pickup is available the day before the event (19:00–20:00) and on event day from 08:00 at the Alte Wilhelminenhalle, Schulstraße 2, 24211 Preetz. Automatic participation in the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup with points scoring. Bib transfers are not possible. New service: Bags can be dropped off in a truck at the Market Square, near the finish. GPX files for the 5 km and 16 km courses are available to download. Courses are available as GPX files; online registration; start and finish in Preetz; includes a bag-drop service and results downloads.

name: Bergkloster-Lauf
description: The Bergklosterlauf, organized by TuS Velmede-Bestwig in cooperation with Bergkloster Bestwig, takes place in the Sauerland. The 6, 10 and 21 km races follow idyllic streams, cross ridges with magnificent viewpoints and pass through small settlements before finishing at Bergkloster Bestwig. Alongside the races, there are children’s and youth races and a supporting program featuring live music, childcare, free massages and extensive catering. The event is also part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup organized by LAC Veltins Hochsauerland. The start and finish are easy to reach and offer ample parking as well as affordable overnight accommodation at the monastery.
course_highlights: Routes pass idyllic streams
Ridges with magnificent viewpoints
Finish at Bergkloster Bestwig
additional: Free massages are available after the finish. Childcare is provided for “running parents.” The start and finish are only 600 meters apart and are easy to reach by bus, train or car. There are 500 parking spaces nearby, including spaces for motorhomes. Affordable overnight accommodation is available at Bergkloster. The 10 km race is also open to walkers. The children’s and youth races start at 12 noon. The 10 km race and the children’s and youth races count toward the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup. Routes of 6, 10 and 21 km; children’s and youth races; registration via Race Result; parking and accommodation at Bergkloster; route maps on Outdooractive

name: Bertlicher Straßenläufe
location: Sportplatz an der Heinrich-Obenhaus-Straße, Herten-Bertlich, Herten, Germany
description: Die Bertlicher Straßenläufe sind ein traditionsreicher Straßenlauf in Herten-Bertlich mit Wettbewerben für unterschiedliche Alters- und Leistungsstufen. Auf flachen, asphaltierten Wirtschaftswegen rund um Bertlich werden zahlreiche Laufdistanzen angeboten. Start und Ziel befinden sich am Sportplatz an der Heinrich-Obenhaus-Straße.
course_highlights: Flache, asphaltierte Wirtschaftswege rund um Herten-Bertlich
Strecken führen durch das Naherholungsgebiet zwischen Herten und Marl
Breite Auswahl an Distanzen, von kurzen Kinderläufen bis zu Langstrecken
additional: Die Strecken sind DLV-vermessenen; Verpflegungsstellen sind entlang der längeren Distanzen eingerichtet.

name: Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf
description: The Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf is an atmospheric race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf, offering an extensive selection of different running events so there is a suitable distance for everyone. The event delights competitive runners as well as children and recreational runners. The start and finish are on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf. In addition to the sporting event, participants and visitors can enjoy a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music.
course_highlights: Race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf
Start and finish on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf
Varied program featuring food and drink and music
additional: The event grounds offer a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music. The race offers different events for all ages and ability levels. Various distances, including children’s and dog races; registration opens on February 14; a traditional neighborhood race in Cologne-Bickendorf

name: Volkslauf durch das schöne Alstertal
description: The Volkslauf through the beautiful Alstertal takes place in Hamburg and offers runners an attractive natural course along the walking trails in the upper reaches of the Alster. The event includes various distances, from a half marathon to 10 km and 4 km, as well as introductory runs for children. The course stands out for its natural setting in the heart of Hamburg, with a few small climbs and stairs. The event is part of the 27th Hamburger Laufcup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and medical support.

name: 52. BMW Berlin-Marathon
description: Der GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON ist eines der weltweit renommiertesten Marathon-Events und Teil der Abbott World Marathon Majors. Am 26. September 2027 versammeln sich Läufer aus aller Welt, um durch die Straßen Berlins zu laufen, begleitet von Millionen begeisterter Zuschauer. Das Rennen zeichnet sich durch seine einzigartige Energie, Vielfalt und die Möglichkeit aus, persönliche Bestleistungen auf einer schnellen, flachen Strecke zu erzielen. Neben dem Marathon gibt es auch attraktive Angebote für Kinder und Jugendliche, die den Laufsport fördern.
course_highlights: Flache und schnelle Strecke durch die Berliner Innenstadt
Unterstützung durch Millionen von Zuschauern entlang der Strecke
Teil der Abbott World Marathon Majors mit internationalem Prestige
additional: Für Kinder und Jugendliche gibt es spezielle Läufe wie den mini-MARATHON, Bambini-Lauf und R5K Tour Finale, die am 25. September 2027 stattfinden. Die Veranstaltung wird von starken Partnern wie Generali und adidas unterstützt.

name: Northeimer Stadtlauf
description: The Northeim City Run is a long-standing running event held in the city of Northeim. The races start and finish at Münsterplatz, a central location in the city. The run is organized by Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V. and offers a sporting event for runners of all ages. The event takes place and includes various running routes through the city.

name: Auricher Spendenlauf
description: The Aurich Charity Run is a charitable running event benefiting various organizations, including Leukin e.V. and the Sandhorst Volunteer Fire Department. The races take place around the Energy Experience Center in Aurich and offer competitions for all age groups, from a children’s race to main races over 5 and 10 kilometers. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of numerous volunteers and sponsors. Award ceremonies take place soon after the races, and certificates are available online.

name: Kienberglauf
description: The Kienberglauf is a traditional running event organized by SV 08 Oehrenstock e.V. and held annually on the last Sunday in September. The event offers various competitions for different age groups and ability levels, including Nordic walking, children’s races, and distances from 2 to 16 kilometers. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Oehrenstock near Ilmenau and is a highlight of club life. The fastest runners receive trophies, and all participants receive a certificate.

name: Kleeblattultra (100-Meilen-Lauf)
description: Der Kleeblattultra ist ein herausfordernder 100-Meilen-Ultralauf in Schwarme, Niedersachsen, der durch drei Landkreise führt. Die Veranstaltung wurde aus der Idee geboren, den ersten 100-Meilen-Lauf im Norden Deutschlands zu etablieren. Organisiert vom TSV Schwarme und einem engagierten Planungsteam, bietet der Lauf eine einzigartige Gelegenheit für erfahrene Ultraläufer, die gesamte Strecke zu absolvieren. Die Veranstaltung legt Wert auf eine umfassende Betreuung mit Zeitmessung, Live-Tracking und Verpflegung entlang der Strecke.
course_highlights: 100 Meilen durch drei Landkreise
Vier einzelne Streckenabschnitte à 25 Meilen
Start- und Zielbereich in Schwarme mit Sporthalle als Veranstaltungszentrum
additional: Check-In am 24.09.2027 von 17:00-19:00 Uhr und am 25.09.2027 von 07:00-08:30 Uhr; Briefing am 25.09.2027 um 08:30 Uhr; Zielschluss am 26.09.2027 um 12:00 Uhr; Cutoff-Zeit für den Lauf beträgt 27 Stunden; Teilnehmerlimit 50 Einzelstarter; Teilnahme ab 18 Jahren; im Start- und Zielbereich stehen kostenfreie Duschen zur Verfügung; im Startgeld enthalten sind Zeitmessung, Live-Tracking, Pastaparty, reichhaltiges Frühstück, umfangreiche Wettkampfverpflegung, Urkundendruck und hochwertiges Finisher-Shirt.

name: Marner Kohltagelauf
description: Der Marner Kohltagelauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf in Marne und offizieller Bestandteil des Dithmarschen Cups sowie des Dithmarscher Firmencups. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Streckenlängen von 400 Metern für Kinder bis hin zu 10 Kilometern für Erwachsene. Die Strecken sind für den Straßenverkehr gesperrt, gut ausgeschildert und jeder Kilometer ist markiert. Die Zeitnahme erfolgt professionell per Chip an der Startnummer, und die Veranstaltung findet bei fast jedem Wetter statt.
course_highlights: Strecken sind für den Straßenverkehr gesperrt und gut ausgeschildert
Jeder absolvierte Kilometer ist markiert
Wasserstationen alle 5 km und Verpflegung im Ziel (Mineralwasser, isotonische Getränke, Obst)
additional: Nachmeldungen sind bis 30 Minuten vor dem Start online möglich mit einer Nachmeldegebühr von 5 €. Die Zeitnahme erfolgt über einen Chip an der Startnummer ohne Leihgebühr. Umkleideräume sind vorhanden, Duschen können nach der Veranstaltung in der Schwimmhalle Marne genutzt werden.

name: Nordahl Grieg Gedenklauf
organizer: Förderverein der Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule mit gymnasialer Oberstufe Kleinmachnow
description: The Nordahl Grieg Memorial Run is a traditional running event in Kleinmachnow, held at Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule. The event offers various races for Bambini, schoolchildren, young people, and adults on circuits around the school and Lake Kleinmachnow. All participants receive drinks and refreshments in the finish area, as well as medals after crossing the finish line. The event is organized by the Friends Association of Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule and is held under the patronage of the Norwegian Ambassador and the Mayor of Kleinmachnow.

name: Bleckeder Storchenlauf
description: The 1st Bleckede Stork Run is taking place, offering runners and walkers a choice of distances in the natural surroundings of the sports field in Bleckede. The routes pass through wooded areas and open spaces with small to moderate hills, providing varied running conditions. Bib numbers and chips must be collected 30 minutes before the respective start. The event is organized by VfL Bleckede von 1862 e. V. and is open to participants of all ages, including a Bambini run for the youngest children.

name: City-Lauf Lübeck
description: Der City-Lauf Lübeck ist ein traditionsreicher Laufwettbewerb, der verschiedene Distanzen für unterschiedliche Altersgruppen und Interessen anbietet. Die Veranstaltung umfasst Bambinilauf, Schülerlauf, Einradfahren, 5 km Lauf und Walking sowie einen 10 km Hauptlauf. Die Strecken führen durch die Innenstadt von Lübeck mit abwechslungsreicher Streckenführung, die jährlich an aktuelle Gegebenheiten angepasst wird. Der Lauf ist offen für alle Läuferinnen und Läufer, auch ohne Vereinszugehörigkeit, und bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit Teamwertungen und Rahmenprogramm.
course_highlights: Streckenführung durch die historische Innenstadt von Lübeck
Rundkurs für Einradfahrer mit Pflicht zum Tragen von Schutzkleidung
Abwechslungsreiche Strecken für Bambinis, Schüler, 5 km und 10 km Läufe
additional: Nachmeldungen sind bis zum Veranstaltungstag möglich, am Tag selbst nur für den 10 km Lauf. T-Shirts bei Nachmeldungen nur solange der Vorrat reicht. Die Einradfahrer müssen Schutzkleidung tragen, und es gibt Teamwertungen für Schüler und 5 km Lauf. Die Startnummern dürfen in Form und Größe nicht verändert werden.

name: Crosslauf Friedrichsruh mit Kreismeisterschaft
description: The Friedrichsruh Cross-Country Run with District Championships is a cross-country event in Geestland, Germany, held at the Sportzentrum Nordeschweg. The event is organized by TV Langen von 1908 e.V. and offers various distances, from 0.5 km for the youngest participants up to 25 km. In addition to the district championship races for children, young people, and adults, there are also open supporting races over distances from 2.5 km to 10 km. The event is characterized by a friendly club atmosphere and a focused local running event.

name: Crosslauf und Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder
description: The Cross-Country Run & Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder takes place and is organized by SV Grün-Weiß Birkenwerder e.V. Several race distances from 400 m to 8.6 km are offered, as well as a Nordic walking event in which proper pole technique is mandatory. The event is open to various age groups, from Bambini to seniors, and all participants receive a printable certificate, with medals awarded to places 1 to 3. Registration is online and limited to 500 starting places; late registration is possible up to the day of the event.

name: Elmshorner Stadtlauf
description: Der Elmshorner Stadtlauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung für die ganze Familie, die Jung und Alt anspricht. Die Hauptstrecke führt über einen amtlich vermessenen 5-Kilometer-Rundkurs durch die überwiegend asphaltierte Innenstadt von Elmshorn. Für Kinder werden kürzere Strecken von 600 Metern und 1,5 Kilometern angeboten, wodurch der Stadtlauf ein vielseitiges Sportevent für alle Altersklassen darstellt. Die Veranstaltung ist bekannt für ihre gute Stimmung und die Integration von Landesmeisterschaften über 5 und 10 Kilometer.
course_highlights: Amtlich vermessener 5 km Rundkurs durch die Innenstadt von Elmshorn
Überwiegend asphaltierte Strecke
Kinderstrecken von 600 m und 1,5 km
additional: Der Stadtlauf umfasst neben den Hauptläufen auch SHLV-Landesmeisterschaften über 5 und 10 km. Für Kinder gibt es Medaillen. Die Veranstaltung bietet Unterhaltung für die Kleinen und eine stimmungsvolle Atmosphäre mit musikalischer Begleitung. Die Strecke wird jährlich inspiziert, um die Sicherheit zu gewährleisten.

name: Eper Michaelislauf
description: The Eper Michaelislauf is a long-standing, family-friendly race held around the town festival in Gronau-Epe. It is recognised as a DLV race and offers low entry fees and affordable refreshments. The event is known for its pleasant atmosphere, appealing to both competitive and recreational runners. Due to possible runoff elections, the race is held on Saturday in some years.

name: Herdorfer Götzelauf
description: The Herdorf Götzelauf is a local race in Herdorf, organized by DJK Herdorf and listed in the official German running calendar (laufen.de). The event offers two distances, 500 meters and 10 kilometers, and is aimed primarily at the local community and regional runners. DJK Herdorf is an active sports club with regional partnerships, making the race a down-to-earth, community-focused event. Official DLV rankings may be maintained for some races.

name: Herner St. Martini City-Lauf
description: The Herne St. Martini City Run takes place on Boulevard Bahnhofstraße in Herne. The event offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from approximately 400 m to 5 km. The courses are officially measured and the races are held under official supervision. Timing is electronic via easychip, and all participants receive a certificate. The event is organized by IG Herne City e.V. and TV Wanne 1885 e.V.

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, featuring a 21.0975 km course. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is open to a large field, with start corrals based on declared finish times, and also offers the option of taking part in four-person relay teams. The organizers provide professional timing, medical support, refreshments and water along the course. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as raising the profile of Gdańsk in Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km half-marathon course in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Start corrals based on declared finish times
additional: The start is divided into time-based corrals according to declared finish times (red, blue, green and yellow). Relay teams start from the blue corral. The race pack includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timing, medical support, water at refreshment points, refreshments after the finish and a medal. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer’s consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including a half marathon and 5 km, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration is online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or by traditional bank transfer. Races for children and young people are also available.

name: Tilburg Ten Miles
description: The Tilburg Ten Miles is the liveliest running festival in Midden-Brabant and has been held annually since 1988. The event attracts thousands of recreational runners and elite athletes, who run through Tilburg’s decorated streets, cheered on by enthusiastic spectators and live music. With distances of 16.1 km, 10 km and 5 km, there’s a suitable challenge for every runner. The atmosphere is festive, and the course offers a lovely mix of urban surroundings and distinctive local spots.
course_highlights: Run through Tilburg’s decorated streets with enthusiastic spectators
A varied course through the heart of Tilburg, with wide streets and distinctive local spots
Live music and a festive atmosphere along the course
additional: Race numbers must be collected in advance at the Koepelhal on Saturday or Sunday. There is a Run Against Cancer campaign where participants can create a fundraising page and receive a special shirt when they raise €500 or more. Several distances are available, including walking events and children’s races; registration is possible until 16 August; special race numbers and merchandise are available; the event supports charities such as KWF.

name: Rijk Zwaan Loop
price_range: twee tarieven voor alle afstanden, vroegboekkorting tot 8 september 2026
description: The Rijk Zwaan Loop is a running race and recreational run in 's-Gravenzande, celebrating its 25th edition in 2026. The day starts with the Kids Run at 13:00, followed by various distances, including a revamped 5 km and 10 km course. This year also features a new walking event with distances of 7, 14 and 21 kilometres, with proceeds going to Team Westland. The organisers invite runners of all levels to take part in this festive and sporting day.
course_highlights: Revamped 5 km and 10 km course, starting on Langestraat
Water stations along the route and post-finish refreshments including fruit, vegetables, sports drink and water
Walking event with route directions and a coffee stop; proceeds go to Team Westland
