additional: The Kids Run starts at 13:00 and is limited to 450 participants. Race numbers are distributed in advance for those who register early. SAW chips are used for timing the 5 km and 10 km. Changing facilities are available at ISW College, at your own risk. Post-finish refreshments include fruit, vegetables, sports drink and water. The Kids Run has separate categories by primary school year group and age. The walking event is at participants' own risk and includes a coffee stop along the route. The Kids Run starts at 13:00, with a maximum of 450 children; location near Sand-Ambachtstraat and ISW College; no on-site registration.

name: Geuzenloop Zoetermeer
description: The Geuzenloop Zoetermeer is an annual running event being held for the 22nd time. It is Zoetermeer’s largest running race, with distances ranging from a half mile to a half marathon. The start and finish are at Pilatusdam in the historic centre of Zoetermeer. The courses pass through both Old and New Zoetermeer, including the former Floriade site and Balijbos. Geuzen walking tours are also offered, covering distances from 6 to 25 kilometres and organised by Road Runners Zoetermeer and Sportief Wandelgroep Zoetermeer.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Pilatusdam in the old centre of Zoetermeer
Courses pass through Oud Soetermeer, Nieuw Zoetermeer, the former Floriade site and Balijbos
Walking tours of 6 to 25 kilometres through natural areas with historical significance
additional: The Geuzenloop is inclusive and accessible: guides for visually impaired runners and walkers can participate free of charge after registering. All running routes and the 6 km walking tour are wheelchair-accessible. Maximum times apply for each distance to ensure the course remains clear. Finishers receive a unique medal made from a slice of tree trunk, crafted by people who face barriers to employment. The finish closes at 15:00. The medal is made from pruned wood; changing distances is possible; there is a post-race gathering and after-party on 30 September; not all participants have the option of receiving a medal.

name: Earth Race
distance_verbose: 128.8 km, Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km
description: Earth Race Forest Edition is a multi-themed endurance event held in the beautiful Amsterdam Forest near Amstelveen. The race offers distances from 5 km up to an ultra 128.8 km, winding through woodland trails, ponds, and open meadows with scenic views of this urban nature reserve. The event combines sport with environmental impact, supporting rainforest protection and local nature projects. Participants enjoy a festival atmosphere with hydration stations, medical support, and a unique afterparty experience.

name: 42 ste Joustermerkeloop
distance_verbose: 16.2 km, 10.2 km, 7 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Jasperloop
description: The Jasperloop is a monthly running race held in the beautiful woodland near Keelven in Someren. The event is open to everyone, young and old, and features a 2.5 km loop on partly paved paths and sandy trails. Participants can decide how many laps to run, up to a maximum of six. The race starts at 10:00, and registration is available at the start location from 9:30. The Jasperloop is a friendly, accessible event that has been held for many years.

name: Sport 2000 Sparta Westvlietloop op zondag 27 september 2026
description: The event offers several distances, including 1 km and 2.5 km youth races and 5 km and 10 km adult races. The start is on the athletics track at Sportpark Westvliet. The course passes through varied surroundings, with routes along Westvlietweg, Schrepelpad, a bicycle bridge, the ADO Stadium and bicycle tunnels. The 10 km runners complete two laps. The organizers invite both members and non-members to take part and get to know the club.

name: Runway Run for KiKa - Twente Airport
organizer: Stichting Runway Run voor Run for KiKa
description: The Runway Run for KiKa at Twente Airport is a unique running event held on the runway of a former airbase. Participants experience a special combination of sport, atmosphere and meaning as they run along the tarmac, surrounded by aircraft and music. The event offers several distances, including a Kids Run, 5 km and 10 km, and is a great opportunity to take action together against childhood cancer. The flat courses are ideal for both beginner and experienced runners looking to push their limits.

name: Marathonblokken - Run Your City
description: Marathonblokken is a series of running training sessions organised by Hardloopnetwerk in collaboration with PUMA, designed to prepare runners for their marathon. The sessions take place in several cities, including Amsterdam, Soest and Utrecht, where participants run together at marathon and half-marathon pace. During the sessions, participants can test PUMA shoes and try sports nutrition. The event offers an energetic, social atmosphere, ideal for both beginner and experienced marathon runners looking to improve their performance.

name: duurlopen met hazen
description: Duurlopen met hazen is a running event in Amstelveen where participants can train in a relaxed atmosphere with pacers and enjoy water stations. The laps vary in distance and take place at scenic locations such as the Amstel area and Amsterdamse Bos, often on the Amsterdam Marathon course. The start is usually at 10:00 a.m., but in warm weather the event starts earlier to protect participants. Facilities such as ice water and sponges help runners cool down during the run.

name: Heyu VathorstRun
description: The Heyu VathorstRun takes place in Hooglanderveen. The race offers three distances: 5 kilometers for beginners, the classic 10 kilometers sponsored by MONI, and a new distance of 10 miles (16.1 km). The route takes you through Vathorst, a beautiful area for running and enjoying sport and good company together. The organizers invite everyone to take part and offer a special discount through Heyu.

name: 12e Halve van Alphen
organizer: Alphen a/d Run en CAS Alphen
description: The Halve van Alphen is an atmospheric autumn classic held in Alphen aan den Rijn. The 21.1 km half marathon takes you along green spaces, parks and nature reserves in the Groene Hart on a course that is almost entirely traffic-free. As well as running, you can take part in relay teams, skate, cycle, walk or even run with a leashed dog. The start and finish are at Sunset Beach Bar on the Zegerplas, where a welcoming atmosphere and an after-party await participants and spectators.

name: Uiterwaarden Run Nederasselt
description: On Sunday, the Uiterwaarden Run Nederasselt takes place, a running event in the beautiful floodplains of Nederasselt. Participants can choose from three distances: 1.5 km, 5 km and 10 km. The routes include sections along the Maasdijk, through nature and past the lock. The start and finish are at the Dorpshuis of Nederasselt, which has facilities including toilets and a catering venue. The atmosphere is sporty and friendly, suitable for all ages and abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. Professional timing is provided, with prizes for the fastest runners in each distance.

name: Vechtstreek in Beweging Lopen
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 20 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km
description: The Vechtstreek in Beweging Run is a friendly, well-organised running series in the Utrecht region, organised by athletics club OSM’75 Atletiek & Recreatiesport Maarssen. The races take place in the wooded recreational area of the Maarsseveense Plassen, on a fully paved, car-free course around the large lake. Participants can choose their own distance and pace, making the event suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Pacers are available at various speeds to support everyone.

name: HooilandRun
description: The HooilandRUN is a friendly running race in and around the ’t Hooiland neighbourhood in Lichtenvoorde, suitable for beginner and experienced runners, children and adults. The course combines semi-paved walking paths and paved surfaces, with rolling paths and two short climbs. The race offers several distances, including 1 km and 2 km for children, and 5 km and 10 km for adults. The organisers provide chip timing, water stations and prizes for the fastest runners.

name: MaatGarant Run Bke Marathon
description: The MaatGarant Run Bike Marathon is an accessible and sporty event where teams of 2 to 4 participants cover a marathon distance of 42.195 km together. Each team member runs about 10 kilometres while the others cycle, making it ideal for anyone with a reasonable level of fitness. Organised by AV Spirit in Oud-Beijerland, the event is all about achieving something together, having fun and team building, without an emphasis on winning. The marathon takes place and offers a friendly, personal atmosphere, similar to the RopaRun but on a smaller scale and closer to home.

name: Dobbeloop
distance_verbose: 20 km, 15 km, 12 km, 10 km, 6 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 1500 meter, 0.8 km
description: The Dobbeloop is a monthly recreational running race organized by the Nootdorp Ice Club, held in the nature area around Dobbeplas between Pijnacker and Nootdorp. The course is almost entirely traffic-free and paved with asphalt, with guidance from cyclists, arrows, and staffed checkpoints. The start is at the Nootdorp Ice Club’s clubhouse at Oudeweg 74 in Nootdorp. There are several distances for children and adults, with on-site registration and a friendly atmosphere in the clubhouse.

name: HeteRUN
description: HeteRUN is Heteren’s running event. The event offers a range of distances for all ages, including kids’ runs of 500 and 1,000 metres and challenging 5 and 10 km running routes. The routes are suitable for both trained and advanced runners and take place in the heart of Heteren. The organisers provide a friendly atmosphere and good facilities, including changing rooms and first aid on site.

name: Euromast Trappenloop
description: The Euromast Stair Climb is a unique sporting challenge in which participants climb the 589 steps of the iconic Euromast in Rotterdam. This second edition offers an unforgettable experience, with official timekeeping, an exclusive medal and spectacular views across the city. The race is suitable both for athletes aiming for a personal best and for anyone who wants to take on the challenge. Afterwards, participants can relax at the Brasserie, while friends and family can also enjoy the Euromast with a discount code.

name: Raamvallei Duomarathon
description: The Raamvallei Duo Marathon is a unique team event in which pairs of two cover the marathon course of over 42 kilometres together on one bicycle. One partner runs while the other cycles, and they can switch whenever they like. The route passes through the beautiful Land van Cuijk, alongside the Raam and by various distinctive locations, including Landgoed de Barendonk, woodlands, meadows and historic windmills. The event is all about teamwork, fun and enjoyment, with no timing or race rankings. Along the way, participants can enjoy local snacks and drinks and live music, followed by a festive finish with a red carpet and a traditional Brabant sausage roll.

name: Broekstaclerun
description: The Broekstaclerun is a challenging and fun obstacle run event in Broekland, featuring a unique mix of running, mud, and obstacles. The run has a cosy, down-to-earth character, with a varied course through nature where effort and enjoyment go hand in hand. The event is accessible and sustainably organised, and is suitable for participants of different ages and ability levels. The atmosphere is always festive, and the run is supported by enthusiastic volunteers and local landowners.

name: 100 Bruggenloop
description: The 100 Bridges Loop in Leiden is a unique walking and running event in which participants cross 100 bridges, ranging from centuries-old stone arch bridges to modern bridges in Singelpark. The route follows rivers, canals, tow canals and singels, passing some of the most beautiful places in the historic city centre, including the oldest university in the Netherlands, Hortus Botanicus and various monuments. The walk takes place and the running event takes place. Several distances are available, so recreational walkers and runners can take part.
course_highlights: Cross 100 bridges over rivers, canals, tow canals and singels
Pass historic sites such as the oldest university and Hortus Botanicus
Route through Singelpark, harbours, city gates and distinctive architecture
additional: Walkers start on Saturday between 08:00 and 11:00 from Van der Werfpark. Runners start on Sunday from 08:00 at Stadhuisplein/Vismarkt. The cut-off time is 16:15 for walkers and 11:15 for runners. There are refreshment points along the route, stamping stations, first aid and a commemorative medal. Dogs are allowed on a lead, except in Hortus Botanicus. Children under 12 may take part only when accompanied. The city is not closed to traffic; the route follows pavements and pedestrian areas. Late registration is available on the day, with a €2,00 surcharge. The event provides practical information about registration, timings and facilities. The route includes various surfaces such as gravel, shells, brick, cobblestones, wood, concrete and asphalt, and is accessible to people with reduced mobility.

name: Ehrmann Posbankloop - unieke loop door de natuur!
description: The Ehrmann Posbankloop is a unique running race through the beautiful natural landscape of the Veluwezoom, featuring challenging elevation and a breathtakingly beautiful course. The 30th edition takes place in Velp and offers several distances, including a 15 km main race, a 6 km race and a walking event. The route passes iconic landmarks such as the Posbank and the Emmapiramide, with the challenging “Muur van Aalbers” as a special competition within the competition. The Posbankloop is suitable for both recreational and dedicated runners and is known for its lively finish with plenty of spectators.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural landscape of the Veluwezoom with plenty of elevation
Climb of the Posbank and the “Muur van Aalbers” (Emmapiramide)
Start and finish in the centre of Velp, near the station
additional: Race bibs must be collected well before the start at Gezondheidscentrum Velp, Rozendaalselaan 34. The time limit is 55 minutes for the 6 km race and 120 minutes for the 15 km race. The “Muur van Aalbers” is a special segment, with watches awarded to the first man and woman to reach the top. For registrations received before 17 September, the participant’s name will be printed on the race bib. Water and fruit are available at the finish, along with a discount voucher for running shoes at Run2Day Arnhem/Nijmegen. The start/finish is close to Velp station and easily accessible by train and bicycle.

name: 7-loop Zevenhoven
location: SV Zevenhoven, Zevenhoven, Nieuwkoop, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The 7-Loop is a running event with a rich tradition spanning more than 35 years in the Municipality of Nieuwkoop. It takes place in Zevenhoven and is known as a true autumn classic, with beautiful courses through the polders of the Groene Hart. The 7-Loop is part of the Nieuwkoops Circuit and brings the circuit to a close with an exciting final ranking. There are various distances for both children and adults. Children can take part for free and receive a shiny medal.
course_highlights: Beautiful courses through the polders of the Groene Hart
Children’s distances of 400m and 800m around the football fields
The 7-Loop is the final event in the Nieuwkoops Circuit
additional: The start and finish area is at Stationsweg 23, Zevenhoven. Free parking, changing facilities, showers and catering facilities are available. The children’s distances start between 11:30 and 12:00, and the adult distances start between 12:30 and 13:00. The children’s distances are free and run around the finish area and football fields. The 7-Loop is a compulsory race in the Nieuwkoops Circuit, and participants must register online in advance to score points in the circuit.

name: City Run Nijverdal
description: CityRun Nijverdal is a fun running event for young and old. The race offers four distances: KidsRun, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, plus a G-Run for participants with disabilities. The fast course is KNAU-certified and runs right through the centre of Nijverdal, with plenty of music and encouragement from spectators. The organisers aim to make it a sporting and unifying event for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: KNAU-certified fast course through the centre of Nijverdal
Precisely measured 5 km and 10 km routes with multiple laps
Music and encouragement along the course
additional: Start times by distance: G-Run 12:45, KidsRun from 13:00 in age groups, 10 km starts at 14:30, 5 km starts at 16:00. Race bibs with transponders for timekeeping. Water, sports drink and fruit available after the finish. The Red Cross will be present with 6 staff members and 2 cyclists. No showers, but an unstaffed changing room is available. A special running shirt can be ordered for €12.95. Free ice cream for the school with the most participants.

name: Texel Halve Marathon
price_range: 45 euro (bootstart halve en kwart marathon), 42,50 euro (eilandstart halve en kwart marathon), 20 euro (achtste marathon)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: bootstart halve en kwart marathon(45 euro)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: achtste marathon vanaf Den Hoorn (20 euro)

description: The Texel Half Marathon is a unique running event with a nautical character. The start is special because it takes place from the TESO ferry, with the ship’s horn signaling the start. There are three distances: half marathon, quarter marathon and eighth marathon, all finishing in the centre of Den Burg. A Kidsrun, organised by Sportstichting Texel, takes place beforehand for younger runners. Participants receive an original T-shirt, a medal and refreshments along the way.
course_highlights: Start from the TESO ferry, with the ship’s horn signaling the start
Choose from the half marathon, quarter marathon and eighth marathon, all finishing in the centre of Den Burg
Nautical character and unique island setting
additional: All distances start at 12:25 when the TESO ferry’s ship’s horn sounds. The half marathon and quarter marathon can start either from the ferry or from the island. The eighth marathon starts in Den Hoorn. All distances finish in the centre of Den Burg. A Kidsrun takes place in the centre of Den Burg before the half marathon. Cycling on the beach and in the forest is not permitted; bike hire is available on the island. Each participant receives an original T-shirt, a medal and refreshments along the way. T-shirt changes can be submitted until 31 May. Minimum ages range from 12 to 18 years, depending on the distance; overnight stays and team registration are available. The start is at 12:25; participants can choose to start from the ferry or the island.

name: Áskorun ársins 2026 / We Challenge the Year 2026
Runfest
description: Runfest is an ambitious three-day road-running festival in Sandnes, the hometown of Olympic champion Jakob Ingebrigtsen. The festival will be held for the second time from 30 September to 2 October 2027, with race days on Friday 1 October and Saturday 2 October. Runfest combines elite competition with the joy of running and focuses on public health, physical activity and community. Participants of all ages and abilities are welcome to take part in a wide range of races and activities in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Run in Sandnes, on the edge of Norway, with start locations suited to the 1500 m, 5 km, 10 km and 21 km distances
Aid stations with sports drink and water approximately every 5 km
Pacers available for several distances to help runners reach their goals
additional: Race numbers can be collected before and on race day; collecting them the day before is recommended to avoid queues. Changing facilities and bag storage are available at Thon Senter Sandnes. The official AfterRun, with a bar, street food, live concert and DJ, will be held on Saturday 3 October. Runfest Summit takes place on 30 September as a professional gathering focused on public health. Runfest Summit takes place on 30 September 2027. All finishers receive a medal.

name: Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit 2 lopen
description: The circuit offers a platform for both beginner and experienced runners, where taking part matters more than winning. Participants can enjoy a range of distances, including 5 km, 10 km, 10 miles and a half marathon, with an original free running shirt and a beautiful finisher’s gift after 8 or 9 races. The circuit encourages a friendly, sporty atmosphere and is attracting a growing number of participants.

name: Rosa Sløyfe-Løpet Stavanger
description: The Rosa Sløyfe Run in Stavanger is an important and inclusive event held in support of the breast cancer cause. The route circles idyllic Mosvatnet, with the start and finish at Mosvangen Camping, and offers beautiful autumn colours and scenery. There are three distances: a free children’s run for the youngest participants, a short 3 km route with no timing, and a new 5 km long route with timing. The participant pack includes a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal, and the event places a strong emphasis on community and support for the Pink Ribbon campaign.
course_highlights: The route circles idyllic Mosvatnet and features beautiful autumn scenery
Start and finish at Mosvangen Camping
The route is accessible to both runners and wheelchair users
additional: The participant pack includes a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. The children’s run is approximately 400 metres and is free for children aged 3–9. The short route (3 km) is not timed, while the long route (5 km) is timed. Participants in the short and long routes are insured through a licence with the Norwegian Athletics Association. You can donate any amount to the Pink Ribbon campaign when registering. The event area opens at 10:00, with activities such as a prize wheel and glitter station. Company registration is available for groups of ten or more participants.

name: Oslo Trail Challenge
description: Oslo Trail Challenge is a trail ultramarathon that takes place in the forest areas of Lillomarka, Nordmarka and Romeriksåsen, north of central Oslo. The race offers demanding and scenic trails suited to ultrarunners looking for a challenging experience in varied Norwegian forest terrain. The organizer, Langt og Lenge, has extensive experience with ultramarathons and offers a race focused on enjoying nature and the joy of running.
course_highlights: Trail ultramarathon in the forest areas of Lillomarka, Nordmarka and Romeriksåsen
Varied and demanding forest terrain north of central Oslo
Scenic trails with challenging sections
additional: Previous editions have used GPS navigation on unmarked courses.

name: Nightrun SAV en SSV
description: The Nightrun on Friday evening, 2 October, is an atmospheric sponsored run organised by SAV and SSV to celebrate the opening of the renovated athletics track in Grootebroek. The track will be illuminated with candles, LED lights and ambient lighting, while a DJ provides music and energy. Each participant has one hour to run as many laps as possible and can seek sponsorship per lap or for a fixed amount. The Nightrun is suitable for all ages, with special starting groups and a unique mix of sport, sociability and club spirit.

name: Westenholterun
description: The Westenholterun 2026 takes place on Friday evening, October 2, at Sportpark de Weidesteen in Zwolle. The event offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere and several distances, including a Kids Run, 4 English Miles, a 10-kilometre run and a 10 km Power Walk. All registration proceeds go to Hospice Zwolle, a small-scale home for people in the final stage of life. The start and finish are at WVF, where there will also be an awards ceremony and raffle afterwards.

name: Ekerumsloppet
location: Ekerum Resort, Borgholm Municipality, Öland, Sweden
description: Välkommen till Ekerumsloppet, ett höstigt terränglopp på Öland med start och mål vid Ekerum Resort. 10-kilometersbanan går på skogsstigar runt Ekerum och Rällaskogen, och ungdomar kan springa en bana på cirka 1,3 kilometer. Ett trevligt tillfälle att uppleva Ölands natur i löparskorna.
course_highlights: Terränglöpning på skogsstigar
Bana runt Ekerum och Rällaskogen
Start och mål vid Ekerum Resort
additional: 10 km för vuxna och cirka 1,3 km för ungdom. Enligt befintlig information är starttiderna 11:00 respektive 10:00.

name: Tidaholm Marathon
description: Tidaholm Marathon är ett motionslopp som arrangeras i Tidaholm och erbjuder både motion och tävling, individuellt och som stafett. Loppet är en del av Motionsloppet.se:s serie av evenemang och inkluderar även Svenska Mästerskapen i Halvmarathon. Det är en välkomnande tävling för löpare på olika nivåer och arrangeras av Cykelklubben U6 och Grebbestad Multisport.
course_highlights: Löpning i och runt Tidaholm
Individuellt lopp och stafettmöjlighet
Inkluderar Svenska Mästerskapen Halvmarathon
additional: Leverantör av sportdryck på evenemangen är Umara.

name: Rya Åsar Trail Run 2025
location: Rya Åsar Nature Reserve, Borås, Sweden
description: Rya Åsar Trail Run is a popular trail race in Borås, offering beautiful and varied terrain in the Rya Åsar Nature Reserve. The race has several distances to suit both beginners and experienced trail runners, with challenging hills and lovely views. The start and finish area has a great atmosphere, with music, exhibitors, food and a runners’ lounge. The event has a family-friendly feel, with children’s races and a festival atmosphere in the forest that attracts many participants every year.
course_highlights: Varied trail running on beautiful paths with challenging hills
Djävulsbacken—a 300 m-long hill with 75 m of elevation gain
Beautiful views at Rya Klint, Fjällsjön and Hestrastugan
additional: Start and finish on the plateau at Rya Åsar, with music, exhibitors, a runners’ lounge and food service. Bib collection on Friday and Saturday. Chip timing, with start groups for elite, fast runners and recreational runners. Bag drop available. Toilets, changing facilities and showers at Borås Camping. Aid stations with Umara sports drink on the 24 km and 12 km courses. Children’s races of 800 m and 1.8 km are available. Children’s races and sanctioned competitions are offered.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, very hilly trail race held at the IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget in Huskvarna. The race offers several distances for both adults and children, with a varied course that follows trails and, in places, untamed terrain. Participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and challenging hills, including the famous Strutsabacken, where the Bergatrollet competition takes place. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with activities and a sense of community around the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Tough, hilly terrain with both trails and untamed sections
Passage through Ulvadalen, with abundant flora and opportunities to experience nature
Strutsabacken—a steep ski slope where the Bergatrollet competition is decided
additional: Race bibs with timing chips must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:15. Timing is done using the chip in the race bib and provides both total time and Strutsabacken hill time. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the IKHP cabin. Water stations are located at several points, depending on the distance. Late registration is available on race day between 9:00 and 11:00, if places remain. IKHP members receive half off the fee with a discount code. The event is described as family-friendly, with refreshments and activities at the start and finish, as well as changing facilities and showers at the IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala
description: Broloppet Motala is a popular running race organised by Motala AIF Friidrott, starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Motala. The race features a renewed old course that runs through central parts of Motala, offering a pleasant running experience in an urban setting. There are two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with the 10 km race having a separate lane for lapping on the first lap. Water stations are available at the bridge and at the lap point to give runners the best possible support.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, centrally located in Motala
Renewed old course through the city centre
Water stations at the bridge (approx. 3 km) and at the lap point
additional: Late registration takes place on race day, 3/10, from 10:00 to 12:30 at Team Sportia. Race bibs can be collected at Team Sportia on Friday 2/10 from 10:00 to 18:00 and Saturday 3/10 from 10:00 to 12:30. Changing facilities are available at Actic Stora Torget. Bag drop is by the stage.

name: Avesta Night Sky Run
description: Avesta Night Sky Run is an autumn event organized by Dalaportens OL in Avesta. The race offers an exciting running experience in scenic surroundings and is part of Dalaportens orienteering activities. Participants can register via MittLopp and enjoy a well-organized event with good service. Together with Backyard Ultra, it creates a unique running weekend in October.
course_highlights: Running in scenic surroundings around Avesta
Part of Dalaportens OL’s autumn event
Backyard Ultra with 6.7 km laps and a mass start every hour
additional: Backyard Ultra starts at 11:00 on October 3, on a 6.7 km course that is mostly on a shared walking and cycling path. A new lap starts every hour, with a mass start, and the competition continues until only one participant remains. A refreshment station with drinks and energy supplies is available at the lap point. Registration for Backyard Ultra is by email to AvestaUltra@outlook.com, with an entry fee of 350 kr. Maximum 80 participants. Previous editions have been held together with Avesta Backyard Ultra.

name: Hiit Out Trailrun 12 km
description: HIIT OUT Trailrun är ett traillopp som bjuder på varierad terräng med skog, stigar, höjdskillnader och tekniska partier i Mellingerum, Oskarshamn. Loppet fokuserar inte bara på tiden i mål utan på upplevelsen längs vägen, med utmaning, löparglädje och en härlig naturupplevelse. Distansen 12 km är en av flera valbara banor, lämpade för både vana traillöpare och nybörjare från 15 år och uppåt. Arrangemanget präglas av en gemytlig atmosfär med engagerade funktionärer och publik.
course_highlights: Varierad terräng med skog och stigar
Höjdskillnader och tekniska partier
Naturnära upplevelse längs trails
additional: Alla från 15 år är välkomna att delta. Loppet arrangeras med fokus på upplevelsen och löparglädjen, inte bara tävlingstid. Tidigare års resultat visar deltagande på distanserna 8 km, 12 km och 16 km. Medalj delas ut vid målgång.

name: Turufjell Trail
description: Turufjell Trail offers a varied running experience in Hallingdal, with 5 km and 13 km trail races for adults, as well as a children’s race for the youngest participants. The courses follow small, winding trails and open mountain areas with beautiful views of Vassfaret. The event is suitable for all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, with the start and finish at Turufjell Kafé. Timing is provided for all adult distances and the children’s race, and all children receive a medal and a prize at the finish.
course_highlights: 13 km course climbing Trøgadissnatten (892 m above sea level) and Veslefjell (993 m) with views of Vassfaret
5 km course via Slåtteliheisen, past Snøtjern, then down a gravel trail and gravel road towards the finish
Water stations at 2 km, Veslefjell (7.5 km) and the finish
additional: Parking at T-kroken and Turufjell Kafé. Race numbers can be collected at Tipien by Turufjell Kafé. All participants receive a medal. Prizes are awarded to the three fastest women and men in the 13 km race. Prize draws are held using adult race numbers. Toilets are available at Turufjell Kafé and T-kroken. There are no shower facilities, but you can take a dip at Øvre Vesleåtjern, approximately 1.5 km from the start/finish. Bag drop is available in the start area.

name: Sørfjorden halvmaraton
description: The Sørfjorden Half Marathon is organized by Idrettslaget Fri in Arna, Bergen, and was first held in 2020. The course has been officially measured and certified internationally since 2024 and attracts around 1,000 participants. It is a recreational race focused on a welcoming atmosphere and quality, set in scenic surroundings in Vestland. IL Fri is known for its commitment to athletics and recreational running, with Arna Idrettspark as its home venue.
course_highlights: Officially measured and internationally certified half-marathon course since 2024
Held in scenic surroundings in Arna, Bergen
Course route starting north of Londalskrysset (from related races in the area)
additional: The race is organized by IL Fri, a club with a long tradition and a welcoming athletics and recreational running community. Registration and all necessary information are available on the race’s website, sorfjordenhalvmaraton.no. The organizer’s home venue is Arna Idrettspark.

name: Austevollsløpet
description: Austevollsløpet hosts a flexible relay for businesses, with up to five participants per team and a total course of approximately 21 km. The race runs from Kalve to Austevoll Sports Ground, and participants can divide the distance as they wish, making the relay accessible to many. The event creates a festive atmosphere, with spectators cheering along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal. Proceeds from the event go towards the athletics group’s activities and training camps in Austevoll.
course_highlights: A relay course of approximately 21 km from Kalve to Austevoll Sports Ground
Up to five participants per team, with flexible leg distribution
Spectators along the course with flags and music, and changeover points at food stations approximately every 5 km
additional: A bus leaves Austevoll Secondary School at 11:45 and stops at the changeover stations for drop-off and pick-up. All participants receive a medal. The event is supported by Austevoll Kraftlag as its main sponsor. Teams may have fewer than five participants if they wish. Distance options have varied between editions. In 2026, the business relay cost NOK 1,000 per team, and the Mini-Mini Marathon was free.

name: Nesbyen Backyard 2027
description: Nesbyen Backyard takes place on the first Saturday in October, featuring 6- and 12-hour Backyard Ultra races in beautiful Nesbyen, Hallingdal. The race offers a flat, fast 6.7 km loop that runs mainly on asphalt, with some sections on gravel and trail, challenging runners to complete one loop every hour. This unique race combines endurance, tactics and community in a social and motivating atmosphere, with prizes for everyone who completes the race and door prizes from local sponsors. The race starts at Nesbyen Sports Hall at 10:00 and is suitable for both beginners and experienced ultrarunners.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with less than 30 metres of elevation gain
The course runs mainly on asphalt, with some sections on gravel and trail
Flat, fast course through Nesbyen town centre amid beautiful autumn scenery
additional: Start and finish at Nesbyen Sports Hall, with changing rooms, showers, toilets and an indoor lounge. A kiosk with food and drinks is available. The race’s Backyard area serves as a social gathering place between loops. More than 20 door prizes from local sponsors. The train station is a 20-minute walk from the start area. The course is Norway’s flattest Backyard loop, with less than 30 metres of elevation gain. Accommodation is available along the course, including at Hagaled Guesthouse. Starts at Nesbyen Sports Hall on 2 October 2027 at 10:00. Registration via EQ Timing. Prices increase in stages as the registration deadline approaches. Prizes for everyone who completes at least one loop, as well as placement prizes and door prizes.

name: Korschenbroicher Waldlauf
location: Waldstadion Korschenbroich, Korschenbroich, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 21st Korschenbroich Forest Run takes place at Waldstadion Korschenbroich. The event offers races over distances from 400 to 10,000 metres, as well as walking, and is open to all age groups. It includes a new 2,300-metre race for young people from U14 to U18. Alongside the sporting competition, there will be a cafeteria and a raffle in support of the youth department. Held on German Unity Day, the event combines sporting commitment with a good cause.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 to 10,000 metres, plus walking
New 2,300-metre race for U14 to U18
Event at Waldstadion Korschenbroich on German Unity Day
additional: There will be a cafeteria and a raffle in support of the youth department. The NEW Group is the new main sponsor. Registration opens in early 2026. The courses run over the sports field and forest trails; spikes are not permitted.

name: RheinEnergie Kinderlauf Köln
description: The RheinEnergie Children’s Run Cologne takes place at Roncalliplatz by Cologne Cathedral. The event offers several child-friendly races over distances from 500 m to 2,000 m, most of which are closed to traffic and secured by course marshals. Before the run, there is a children’s service at Cologne Cathedral, after which the children set off together in their races. Children born between 2015 and 2021 are eligible to participate. There is no timing—the focus is on having fun and taking part.
course_highlights: The course passes Cologne Cathedral
Start and finish at Roncalliplatz
Closed course with course marshals
additional: On-site registration is also available on the event day from 9:00 to 12:15. Depending on the number of participants, the children start in several waves, divided by year of birth and/or gender. There is no timing, and children should be able to complete the course without parental accompaniment. Several races with different distances; no timing; open to children born in 2015 or later; limit of 1,000 children; online registration available; race number collection on the event day.

name: Rothaarwaldlauf
location: Rothaargebirge, Bad Berleburg-Aue, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Rothaar Forest Run, organized by TSV Aue-Wingeshausen, is a popular and scenic forest race in the Rothaar Mountains. The event offers various distances, including loop courses and point-to-point races, appealing to both competitive athletes and recreational runners. The races are part of the Rothaar-Laufserie AOK-Cup, which celebrates its 25th anniversary this year. The course passes through beautiful woodland with moderate climbs, and the event offers excellent refreshments as well as bus transfers to the starting points of the longer races.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400 m to 28 km, including loop courses and point-to-point races
Start and finish at the Aue-Wingeshausen sports ground, with bus transfers to the starting points of the longer races
Scenic forest routes with moderate climbs and good refreshments
additional: Start times vary by distance; for example, the main race starts at 13:30. A bus transfer runs from the Aue-Wingeshausen gymnasium to the starting points of the longer races (15 km and 28 km). Race bibs can be collected at various locations until shortly before the start. Showers and changing facilities are available at the gymnasium. Late entries are accepted at the starting points until 30 minutes before the start. The event is part of the Rothaar-Laufserie AOK-Cup, which is celebrating its 25th anniversary. Participants benefit from a bus shuttle, refreshments including cake, waffles, and fries, and a long-established tradition on the running calendar. The event is part of the Rothaar-Laufserie AOK-Cup.

name: Saerbecker Kirmeslauf
price_range: Bambinilauf € 1,00; Schülerläufe 1,2 km und 2 km € 3,00; 5 km Jedermannlauf € 8,00; 10 km Hauptlauf € 10,00
description: The Saerbecker Kirmeslauf takes place at the Sparkassen-Stadion Saerbeck. The course is entirely paved and flat, and runs along well-maintained side roads, making fast times possible. The event offers races for different age groups, with chip timing and results determined by finish order. Children receive medals, and awards are presented for the overall and age-group rankings. Participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Well-maintained, entirely paved course
Flat side roads for fast times
Start and finish at the Sparkassen-Stadion Saerbeck
additional: Timing is provided by a chip attached to the back of the race bib. Finish order determines the results. Certificates are available online for all participants. The course is monitored by volunteers, but traffic rules must still be followed. Every child receives a medal in the children's races. Liability for theft is excluded. Participants must confirm that they are in a healthy state of training. Online registration is available; late entries are accepted on the event day for a fee; the event is held under official supervision in accordance with DLV/IWR rules.

name: 16. Köhlbrandbrückenlauf
description: Der Köhlbrandbrückenlauf ist Deutschlands größter Brückenlauf und führt über das Wahrzeichen im Hamburger Hafen. Die Strecke bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern ein einzigartiges Erlebnis mit beeindruckenden Ausblicken auf den Hafen und die Köhlbrandbrücke. Die Veranstaltung zieht jährlich zahlreiche Teilnehmer an und ist bekannt für ihre besondere Atmosphäre und die sportliche Herausforderung.
course_highlights: Lauf über die berühmte Köhlbrandbrücke im Hamburger Hafen
Beeindruckende Hafenpanoramen während des Laufs
Strecke auf dem Süd/West-Terminalgelände mit urbanem Hafenflair
additional: Die Anmeldung öffnet am 3. Dezember 2026 und ist erfahrungsgemäß schnell ausgebucht. Es gibt eine Kleideraufbewahrung am Veranstaltungstag, und jede:r Finisher:in erhält eine Medaille. Die Anreise wird empfohlen mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder Fahrrad, da Parkmöglichkeiten sehr eingeschränkt sind.

name: 26. Bismarck-Gedenklauf
description: The Bismarck Memorial Run is an annual road and forest race in Schönhausen (Elbe), Saxony-Anhalt, held on German Unity Day. Organized by SV Preussen 27 Schönhausen, it is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP and offers 6.5 km and 13 km distances, as well as shorter races for children and young people. The course starts at the club’s sports center and follows paved roads into the forest, past Kollerberg. The longer distance is run twice. The event honors Otto von Bismarck, Schönhausen’s most famous son, and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments at the sports center.

name: 28. Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The 28th Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf takes place in Alfeld, Lower Saxony. Various distances are offered for adults, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, all finishing in Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, signposted courses are ideal for running at a steady pace. There are also races for children and teenagers, making for a varied program.

name: 49. Warburger Oktoberwochen Volkslauf
description: Der Warburger Oktoberwochenlauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung in Warburg, die jährlich im Oktober stattfindet. Der Lauf bietet verschiedene Distanzen, darunter eine 5-km-Firmenwertung, und richtet sich an Jugendliche, Schüler sowie erwachsene Läufer. Die Veranstaltung findet im Sportzentrum Diemelaue statt und ist bekannt für ihre familiäre Atmosphäre und die Einbindung der lokalen Sportgemeinschaft. Der Warburger SV organisiert den Lauf und fördert damit den Breitensport in der Region.
course_highlights: Start und Ziel im Sportzentrum Diemelaue
5-km-Strecke mit Firmenwertung
Familienfreundliche Laufveranstaltung mit Jugend- und Schülerklassen
additional: Die Abbuchung der Startgebühr erfolgt per SEPA-Lastschrift über RaceResult.

name: Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The Alfelder Leinetal Run takes place in Alfeld, Germany. Races are offered over 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, all finishing at Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, marked courses are ideal for maintaining a steady pace. There are also races for children and young people, making for a varied program.

name: Burgentrail Unterfränkische Traillaufmeisterschaften
description: The Burgentrail in Ostheim is a challenging trail-running event that hosts the Lower Franconian Trail Running Championships. The course follows varied forest and meadow paths, passing historic castle ruins such as Lichtenburg and Königsburg, and features technically demanding trails with roots and steep descents. The scenic backdrop, with views across the Grabfeld, makes the race a special experience for trail-running enthusiasts of all ability levels. SC Ostheim/Rhön warmly invites all running enthusiasts to take part in this sporting highlight.

name: Cross der deutschen Einheit
description: The Cross der Deutschen Einheit in Weißensee is a traditional cross-country race organized by the sports club Blau-Weiß 1921 Weißensee e.V. This race is being held for the 35th time and offers various competitions for all age groups, including Bambini races, youth races, a 3.5 km race, a 10.5 km race, a half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking. The course runs around the Gondelteich, with varied sections including climbs and stairs, and offers a sporting challenge for runners of all ability levels. A jubilee relay race rounds off the program and requires no registration or entry fee.

name: Duvenstedter Dorflauf
description: The Duvenstedt Village Run is a traditional race around Alt Duvenstedt, held annually on German Unity Day. With several distances for children, teenagers, and adults, it offers a suitable challenge for all age groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, volunteer involvement, and wonderful village community. The course is clearly marked and offers varied running scenery in and around Alt Duvenstedt.

name: Herbstlauf TuS Ofen
location: Ofen, Bad Zwischenahn, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The TuS Ofen Autumn Run is a family-friendly event taking place for the 35th time. It offers distances for all age and ability groups, from 800 m for the youngest participants and a 3 km schoolchildren’s run to a 5 km walking event and fun run, and the 10 km EDEKA-Böse Run for ambitious runners. The start and finish are at the TuS Ofen sports field. A large cake buffet in the sports hall will provide refreshments, and all participants will receive a gingerbread heart at the finish as a special treat.

name: Krautsander Insellauf
description: The Krautsand Island Run is a long-standing running event on the Elbe island of Krautsand near Drochtersen. Organized by SV Dornbusch and TV Wischhafen, the race offers an attractive route in a natural setting. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and takes place annually on October 3. It is organized by the Kehdingen Athletics Association, which ensures everything runs smoothly.

name: Langeooger Sanddornlauf 2026
description: The Langeoog Sea Buckthorn Run takes place on the island of Langeoog and offers races for different age groups. The main races cover 5 km and 10 km on paved paths and roads, ideal for island residents and visitors. There are also dedicated races for young runners: 400 m (Bambini) and 1,000 m (youth). The event marks the end of the island running series and is supported by the island school. The awards ceremony takes place in front of the Haus der Insel, where runners gather after crossing the finish line.

name: Stimberg-Haardlauf
description: The Stimberg-Haardlauf is a long-standing race in Oer-Erkenschwick, starting and finishing at Stimbergpark. Various distances are offered for children, young people and adults, including 500 m, 4.9 km and 9.4 km. The adult courses feature elevation changes, offering a varied alternative to flat road races. The event includes individual and team competitions and is open to club runners, local teams, and young and adult athletes.

name: Strausseelauf
description: The Straussee Run in Strausberg is a traditional annual running event. It gives runners of different ability levels the opportunity to compete and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Straussee. The event is organized by Kultur- und Sportclub Strausberg e.V. and takes place at Theodor Fontane Gymnasium in Strausberg. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.

name: 4 Moore Ultratrail-Marathon
description: The 4 Moore Ultratrail Marathon is a non-commercial 53-kilometer ultratrail run through the countryside around Langenhagen. The route passes through a variety of moorland and heathland areas, including Kananoher Forst, Schwarzes Moor, Otternhagener Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Große Heide and Bissendorfer Moor. The course is unmarked and navigated by GPS; the final GPS track and a briefing are sent by email in advance. Three aid stations provide drinks and snacks. Participants must bring their own hydration containers and cups. Entry is limited to 50 runners, and the time limit is 9 hours.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
Pieken+Dalen Festival
description: On Saturday, the very first Pieken+Dalen Festival will take place at RCN het Grote Bos in Doorn, organised by Stichting DiabetesPlus. This unique event combines walking and running over various distances, from a 5-kilometre loop to a marathon, in the beautiful Utrechtse Heuvelrug. After the effort, a warm welcome awaits at the festival grounds, with opportunities to meet others, music, a Buddy Tent, a Q&A with diabetes researchers, a TechTent and various food trucks. The festival offers a special opportunity to tackle the highs and lows of blood sugar together with friends, family and fellow athletes in a welcoming and inclusive setting.

name: 11e Molenloop (Molensmooiste) Alblasserdam-Kinderdijk
description: Molensmooiste is a unique running race held in the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Kinderdijk. Participants run past all the area’s iconic windmills. The 10 English Miles covers two laps, while the 5 English Miles covers one lap. The start and finish are in the heart of the windmill area, creating a special and atmospheric experience. With a limit of 1,500 participants and organized under the auspices of AAA Atletiekvereniging Alblasserdam, it is an event for both recreational and dedicated runners.

name: Kûbaarder Hurdrindei
description: The Kûbaarder Hurdrindei is a well-known running and recreational running event in Friesland, held annually on the first Saturday in October. The route follows quiet paths and low-traffic roads, including the historic Slachtedijk and the “griene dyk” dating from 1200. There are three distances: 5 km, 11.2 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km, plus a free Kidzzrun for children over 1 and 2 km. After the race, participants can recharge with a cup of hot broth and enjoy a chat. The event attracts 120 to 140 participants each year and is open to runners of all levels, including people with disabilities.

name: Midden Drenthe Loop
description: The Midden Drenthe Loop is an annual running race organised by Loopgroep Westerbork, with its 36th edition planned. The event offers two distances, 5 and 10 kilometres, and starts and finishes at Camping Midden Drenthe in Zwiggelte. The routes pass through the beautiful natural surroundings of Midden Drenthe. The 5 km route is entirely paved, while the 10 km route includes a short section of sandy path. The race is open to participants aged 12 and over, and finishers receive a medal.

name: Molens Mooiste
description: Molensmooiste is a unique running race held at the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Kinderdijk. Participants run right through the iconic windmill area, with the start and finish set in the heart of this beautiful landscape. The race offers two distances, 5 English Miles (8 km) and 10 English Miles (16 km), with this year’s routes passing by all of Kinderdijk’s windmills. The start takes place in waves because of the narrow start path, allowing everyone to fully enjoy the windmill experience. The event is organized under the auspices of athletics club AAA Alblasserdam and attracts around 1,500 participants.

name: Rondje om de Koepel
organizer: Marijke Steenbergen, Henk van Voorst, Alwin Grubben, Gert van Dalen
description: Rondje om de Koepel is a popular running event in Lunteren and the surrounding area. It takes participants past the Centre of the Netherlands, over the Goudsberg and through the Lunterse Buurtbos, with its distinctive Koepel. The event offers three distances: a 1 km Kids Run, a 5 km run and a challenging 10 km run. The course is mainly on forest trails, with climbs and descents. The event is professionally supported with warm-up sessions and care provided by Therapeutisch Centrum Lunteren. It also supports local charities, making it both a sporting and community-minded experience.

name: Hoge Veluwe Wandeldag
organizer: Het Nationale Park De Hoge Veluwe
description: The Hoge Veluwe Walking Day takes place in the beautiful De Hoge Veluwe National Park, a green treasure trove of the Netherlands with varied landscapes, unique flora and fauna, and remarkable art and culture. During the event, walkers can enjoy the park’s many walking routes, including special anniversary routes and the historic Boundary Marker Route. The park offers a unique combination of nature and culture, with iconic sites such as the Kröller-Müller Museum and Jachthuis Sint Hubertus. The Hoge Veluwe Walking Day is an ideal opportunity to discover nature and enjoy a day of peace and inspiration.

name: Brekeld Runners Trail
location: Brekeld Runners Trail, Rijssen, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Brekeld Runners Trail is a challenging trail run in the wooded surroundings of Rijssen, organized by Atletiek Vereniging Rijssen. The 2026 edition takes place on 3 October and offers 10, 15, 20 and 30 kilometre routes, mostly off-road and with several climbs. The courses pass through forests, heathland, meadows and sandy areas, with beautiful viewpoints such as the Friezenberg. Aid stations and volunteers are on hand along the way to support the runners.

name: Hostruset

price_tiers.distance: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 50+ och Motion

description: Hostruset is a fast 5 km race and fun run held in Örebro, starting and finishing at Björkhagaskolan. The course follows cycle paths around Varbergaskogen and has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. The race is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series and offers both competitive and recreational classes. There is also a 700-metre children’s race for the youngest participants. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Due to limited parking, the organisers encourage carpooling or cycling.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on cycle paths around Varbergaskogen
Starts and finishes at Björkhagaskolan in Örebro
Officially measured by a course measurer in accordance with the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Start groups are being tested for the 5 km race: runners expecting to finish in over 25 minutes start at 12:30, and those expecting to finish in under 25 minutes start at 12:45. Race numbers are distributed on race day. Timing is done using transponders, which must be returned after the race; otherwise, a charge of 400 kr applies. The prize ceremony takes place in the start/finish area, with honorary prizes for the top 5 in Men/Women and the top 3 in PF19 and Veteran 50+. Changing rooms and showers are available at Björkhagaskolan. Parking is very limited; carpooling or cycling is recommended.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
location: Villands Vånga, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Vånga Mountain Xtreme is a challenging trail race offering three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 40 km, with climbs of 300, 600 and 1,500 metres respectively. The races take place in a wilderness setting, with winding trails, small tarns and deep quarries, and feature beautiful views and demanding hills. Participants get to experience the different sides of Vångaberget, with the longest distance involving five ascents of the mountain. FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to a memorable and tough trail-running experience in Villands Vånga.
course_highlights: Winding trails through pristine wilderness
Beautiful views of small tarns and deep quarries
Challenging climbs: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1,500 m (40 km)
additional: Late registration is available on site until approximately one hour before the start, with payment via Swish. There is also a children's race, VMX Kids, with free on-site registration. The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. Bib transfers are possible under the terms on the website. The listed distances are 8, 16 and 40 km, as well as VMX Kids. Trail-running shoes are recommended.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton, maraton
description: Perseløpet is a race at Ås School in Eidsvoll, offering a simple and efficient race setup focused on fast times. The course is a flat, measured 2,633-meter loop, with distances ranging from 3 km to 100 km. Participants can set up their own nutrition table, which they pass each lap, making nutrition management easy and personal. The event has good facilities, with bib pickup, changing rooms and toilets inside the school, as well as free parking. Perseløpet is known as a race where many runners set personal records, and participants are encouraged to celebrate by ringing the bell at the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, measured 2,633-meter loop
Your own nutrition table, passed each lap
Race starting at Ås School, with good facilities such as changing rooms and toilets
additional: Bib pickup is self-service at the school, approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, the 9th grade at Feiring School staffs an official drinks station to raise money for the school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times daily based on satellite data for the area around Ås School. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan lap times. All distances take place in the same area and use the same weather forecast. Registration is through RaceDays. The course is AIMS-approved.

name: RE-MILA 2027
description: RE-MILA is a fun run for all ages, starting and finishing in Revetal town centre. The event offers distances of 600 metres for children, 2.5 km for youth, and 5 and 10 km for adults and youth. The race has wave starts with pacers and follows Kondis’s recommended age-group categories. All participants receive a medal, with prizes for age-group winners and the top runners in each distance. Race bibs can be collected the day before or on race day in Revetal.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Revetal town centre, by the Sport1 store
Wave starts with up to 8 waves and pacers
Free parking in nearby parking garages and open-air parking spaces
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the Sport1 store in Revetal on the Saturday before the race from 12:00–15:00, or on race day from approximately 12:00. All participants in the children’s race receive a free T-shirt and a medal. The waves start 15–30 seconds apart, with the fastest wave first. The official website states that all participants receive a medal. A free T-shirt is specified for participants in the children’s race.

name: Perseløpet ¤7 - 2027
description: Perseløpet is a simple and efficient running event at Ås school in Eidsvoll, designed to help runners achieve good times. The race takes place on a flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop course, with seven distances ranging from 3 km to 100 km. Participants have their own nutrition table, which they pass each lap, giving them full control over their own nutrition without the logistics of aid stations. The event has a friendly atmosphere, where personal bests are celebrated by ringing the bell at the finish area. Perseløpet is organised by Feiring IL and attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2,633-metre loop course
Your own nutrition table by the course for personal refuelling
Seven distances from 3 km to 100 km, with the opportunity to achieve good times
additional: Race bibs are collected via self-service at Ås school approximately two hours before the start. Free parking, changing rooms and toilets are available at the venue. At selected races, ninth-grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The race has a lap-time calculator to help plan lap splits. Weather forecasts and the course elevation profile are available via the website. Race bibs can be collected via self-service at the school from approximately two hours before the start. Registration is via RaceDays.

name: 25. Benther-Berg-Lauf
location: VSV Benthe Sportplatz, Am Hammfeld, Ronnenberg-Benthe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Benther-Berg-Lauf takes place in Ronnenberg-Benthe and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover. The event offers a variety of race distances for all age groups, from Bambini and children’s races to a half marathon covering 21.8 km. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of the Benther Berg and offers a varied running experience for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. Race number and transponder pickup starts at 8:30 a.m. in the gymnasium of VSV Benthe. Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before each start.
course_highlights: 21.8 km long-distance race (half marathon) through the Benther Berg
A range of distances from the 550 m Bambini race to the 21.8 km long-distance race
Part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event up to 45 minutes before each start, with an additional late-entry fee of €5 (€2 for the Bambini and children’s races). Parking is available in a designated lot behind the sports facility; on the day of the event, access is only possible as far as the dead end. Groups of 5 or more can request a discount by email.

name: 31. Geiseltalseelauf
description: The Geiseltalsee Run is a long-standing running event in Braunsbedra that welcomes runners of all ability levels. The route passes through the scenic surroundings of Lake Geiseltal and offers a sporting challenge across varied terrain. The event is very popular and attracts numerous participants every year. Alongside the competition, the sense of community is also a central part of the event.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Geiseltal
Varied terrain with scenic views
Half marathon with a course record set the previous year
additional: Late entries are possible on race day up to 1 hour before the start. The event also includes children’s and youth races as well as walking events. It takes place in Braunsbedra at Lake Geiseltal and is part of the Landescup. The exact start and finish locations can be found on the official website.

name: Essener Seelauf 2026
description: The Essen Seelauf is a traditional running event at Lake Baldeney in Essen. The 14.2 km course follows well-marked cycle paths and passes through the bird sanctuary. There are two refreshment stations, and the race starts at 10:00 a.m. The event is held in accordance with the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is open to runners with or without a DLV competition licence. Late registrations are possible up to one hour before the start, subject to availability.
course_highlights: 14.2 km course at Lake Baldeney
The course passes through a bird sanctuary and over Lantermannsfähre
Two refreshment stations at km 5 and km 9.5
additional: Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start, with a late-entry fee of €3, payable in cash. Changes of registration are possible only until 30.09. by email to teamessen@gmx.de. Race numbers must be worn visibly on the chest. The use of technical devices such as smartphones with headphones is prohibited. The course is not measured by the DLV, but every kilometre is marked. The 14.2 km race is not measured by the DLV. There are two refreshment stations at km 5 and km 9.5, manual timekeeping, race numbers worn on the chest, parking at the Regattaturm, and changing rooms and showers in the Regattahaus.

name: NRZ Klosterlauf
location: Kloster Kamp, Kamp-Lintfort, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The NRZ Kloster Run takes place on German Unity Day around Kamp Abbey in Kamp-Lintfort. The event offers races over 5,000 meters and a half marathon, with suitable options for runners of all levels. The detailed race information and schedule will be published once planning is complete. An established event organized by SV Alemannia Kamp-Leichtathletik, the run warmly invites runners to take part on this special day.
course_highlights: Run around historic Kamp Abbey
Races over 5,000 meters and a half marathon
Event held on German Unity Day
additional: The race information and schedule will be published online once final planning is complete. The event is part of SV Alemannia Kamp-Leichtathletik and takes place annually on October 3. Distances include 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon; on-site registration is available; part of the regional running events on the Lower Rhine.

name: Ortsstraßenlauf
description: The TV Marienhagen village road race has been held annually on German Unity Day since 1990 and is the club’s largest sporting event. The courses run along roads within and outside the village, as well as paved forest and field paths. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Running Cup and offers categories for Bambini, students, youths, and seniors. Everyone is welcome to participate; club membership is not required. Advance registration is no longer available—registration is exclusively on site. Refreshments are provided during and after the event, and every participant receives a certificate.
course_highlights: Courses along roads and paved forest and field paths
10 km run and 7.5 km Nordic walking on out-and-back courses
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Running Cup
additional: Registration is available only on site, no later than 45 minutes before the start. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Children and youths may not enter more than one race. Refreshments are provided during and after the race at the village community centre by the sports ground. The course runs through the village. No advance registration is available. Refreshments are available on site, and all participants receive certificates.

name: Sparkassen-Phoenix-Halbmarathon
description: The Sparkassen-Phoenix Half Marathon in Dortmund is a popular half marathon held annually on October 3. The 21.1 km course runs through southern Dortmund, past Phoenix Lake, Phoenix-West, Westfalenpark and Rombergpark. It is officially measured, making it suitable for personal bests. In addition to the individual half marathon, there are relay races and a KNAX Fun Run for children. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments, cheer zones and a rendezvous point for relay runners shortly before the finish.
course_highlights: The course passes Phoenix Lake, Phoenix-West, Westfalenpark and Rombergpark
Officially measured 21.1 km course, eligible for rankings
Relay exchange zones at kilometers 7 and 14, with shuttle bus connections
additional: Bib pickup on October 2 from 14:00 to 17:00 and on race day from 8:30. Bibs are printed with participants’ names and sent by post. Online late registration is available until October 3 at 10:00; after that, registration is possible on site for a fee. Relay teams receive a timing baton, which can be collected on race day upon presentation of ID. Refreshments are available at kilometers 4, 11 and 17, as well as in the finish area. Changing rooms, toilets and bag drop are at the Sparkassen Academy by Phoenix Lake. Shuttle buses take relay runners to the exchange zones. A rendezvous point for relay runners is located approximately 150 m before the finish. Course through parks and industrial areas, registration, advertising opportunities, race on October 3

name: Treiser Volkslauf
description: The Treis Volkslauf is being held for the 34th time in Staufenberg-Treis. The event is for runners, walkers, and hikers of all ability levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a large cake buffet and delicious pea soup. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a popular running series in Hesse and the surrounding area. Registration is available via Race Result from [date not specified].
course_highlights: Part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a regional running series
A variety of routes for running, walking, and hiking
Large cake buffet and pea soup
additional: A large cake buffet and pea soup are available for participants. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup running series, which includes several events in the region. The club also offers regular running and walking groups, as well as beginner courses. Running, walking, and hiking event; community activities; refreshments including a cake buffet and pea soup.

name: Volks - und Feuerwehrlauf Rhede
price_range: 2,00 EUR (zusätzliche Gebühr bei Voranmeldung bis Limit)
description: The Volks- und Feuerwehrlauf Rhede is a traditional running event organized by the Rhede Fire Department. Held annually, it gives runners the opportunity to take part in a friendly and safe atmosphere. The races start at the Rhede School Center and follow a varied route through the town. Prizes are awarded to the top four finishers in each category, and certificates and live results are available on-site and online.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Rhede School Center, Büssingstraße 14
Varied route through Rhede
Live results on monitors in the finish area and online
additional: Late registration is possible for a fee of 2.00 EUR until 30 minutes before the respective start. Registration is available on October 2 from 18:00 to 19:00 and on October 3 from 09:00 at the race office. For safety reasons, MP3 players are prohibited. Baby joggers and dogs are not allowed. The event takes place at the Rhede School Center. Registration is on October 2 and 3. Participation rules include safety requirements such as not using MP3 players and not bringing strollers or dogs. Results are available live and online.

name: Bismarckturmlauf
location: Neustadt an der Orla, Thuringia, Germany
description: Der Bismarckturmlauf in Neustadt an der Orla ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die am 3. Oktober 2027 bereits zum 33. Mal stattfindet. Der Lauf richtet sich an Freizeitsportler jeden Alters und bietet verschiedene Streckenlängen, die durch abwechslungsreiche Landschaften führen. Organisiert vom Freizeitsportverein 1978 e.V. Neustadt an der Orla, steht der Lauf für Bewegung, Fitness und Gemeinschaft. Die Veranstaltung wird von zahlreichen Sponsoren, Vereinsmitgliedern und freiwilligen Helfern unterstützt und bietet eine sportliche Herausforderung in geselliger Atmosphäre.
course_highlights: Vielfältige Streckenlängen von 0,7 km bis 21,1 km
Lauf durch die landschaftlich reizvolle Umgebung von Neustadt an der Orla
Traditionelle Veranstaltung mit familiärem Charakter und breiter Teilnehmerbasis
additional: Die Anmeldung für den Bismarckturmlauf startet ab April 2027 über das Anmeldeportal auf der Webseite. Es gibt eine Kinderrunde über 0,7 km sowie weitere Strecken, deren GPX-Daten zum Download bereitstehen. Die Veranstaltung wird vom Freizeitsportverein 1978 e.V. Neustadt an der Orla organisiert und von lokalen Sponsoren unterstützt. Ergebnisse und Bilder vergangener Jahre sind auf der Webseite verfügbar.

name: 26. Generali Köln Marathon
organizer: Kölner Marathon Veranstaltungs- und Werbe GmbH
description: The Generali Cologne Marathon is a unique running experience that combines elite and recreational sport with carnival, a street festival and a running festival. The course passes through lively Cologne neighbourhoods such as Rodenkirchen, Lindenthal, Ehrenfeld and Nippes, and finishes spectacularly at Cologne Cathedral. With up to 15,000 participants, the marathon offers an exhilarating atmosphere, supported by thousands of spectators along the course. The event also places great importance on sustainability and offers a varied programme of activities.
course_highlights: Start in Deutz at Ottoplatz, with panoramic views of Cologne Cathedral and the Old Town
Pass Rudolfplatz three times, with strong spectator support
Course through diverse neighbourhoods such as Südstadt, Ehrenfeld and Nippes
additional: The marathon starts in Deutz at Ottoplatz and passes several relay and school-marathon changeover zones. There are 11 refreshment stations for the marathon and 6 for the half marathon. The marathon is limited to 15,000 participants. The course passes well-known Cologne landmarks and neighbourhoods, and the finish is at Cologne Cathedral. The event values sustainability and offers a varied programme of activities featuring carnival and a running festival. Registration is open; various race disciplines, limited entries, special competitions for students, sustainable event

name: Soester Stadtlauf
price_range: abhängig von der Distanz (Infos im Anmeldeportal)
description: Experience the traditional Soest City Run, a sporting highlight for young and old in the historic city centre of Soest. Whether you’re a recreational runner, a competitive athlete or running with your family, together you’ll make the day an unforgettable experience, with a unique atmosphere along the course. The event offers various race distances, an appealing supporting programme, and refreshments for all participants and guests.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the heart of the historic old town
Atmospheric run through Soest city centre
Commentary, music and refreshments along the course
additional: Race distances: children’s races 475m (start 12:00), school races 950m (born 2016–2018, start 12:45) and 1450m (born 2006–2015, start 14:15), main races 4km (start 15:00) and 10km (start 15:45). Parking available on the outskirts of town, with a shuttle service. Drinks and snack stands for participants and guests. An appealing family programme and on-site commentary. Various race distances, start and finish in the heart of the old town, refreshments, shuttle service, awards ceremony immediately after the races.

name: 14. Burgdorfer Spargel-Lauf
description: The Burgdorf Asparagus Run is an annual running event held as part of the Oktobermarkt town festival in Burgdorf. The routes run along the Aue and through the city center, with the start and finish at the Auebrücke Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße. The event offers 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km races, as well as Nordic walking and a children’s race.

name: 23. Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: Der Mitteldeutsche Marathon verbindet die Metropolregion Mitteldeutschland mit einer einzigartigen Strecke von Leipzig nach Halle (Saale). Der Marathon startet am Sportforum in Leipzig und führt durch zwei Bundesländer und zwei Städte, bevor er im historischen Zentrum von Halle endet. Neben dem Marathon gibt es weitere Disziplinen wie den Händellauf Halbmarathon, Halbmarathonstaffel, 10-km-Lauf, 10-km-Walking, Salzwirkerlauf und AOK Schnupperlauf. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern aller Leistungsstufen ein abwechslungsreiches und kulturell interessantes Lauferlebnis.
course_highlights: Start des Marathons am Sportforum Leipzig
Zieleinlauf im über 1.200 Jahre alten Halle (Saale)
Quer durch eine der grünsten Städte Deutschlands beim Händellauf Halbmarathon
additional: Die Strecken für Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, Salzwirkerlauf und Schnupperlauf sind Rundkurse mit Start und Ziel am Marktplatz in Halle (Saale), außer dem Marathon, der von Leipzig nach Halle führt. Alle Strecken sind vorbehaltlich behördlicher Genehmigung. Es gibt verschiedene Disziplinen und Staffeln, darunter auch eine Mitteldeutsche Hochschulmeisterschaft. Startunterlagen können abgeholt werden, Nachmeldungen und Ummeldungen sind möglich.

name: Boitzer Herbstlauf
description: The Boitzer Autumn Run is a local autumn race with walking in Walsrode, Lower Saxony, organized by the SV Kirchboitzen sports club. In 2026, the event will be held in person for the 19th time and is open to runners and walkers of all ages. Participants can get the key information directly from the organizing team on site. Further practical details are provided by SV Kirchboitzen.

name: Cottbuser Oktoberlauf
description: Der Cottbuser Oktoberlauf ist ein traditionsreicher Laufwettbewerb, der im Sportzentrum Cottbus im Leichtathletik-Stadion und vorwiegend im angrenzenden Waldgebiet mit festen Wegen und Radwegen stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Distanzen von 400 Metern bis zum Halbmarathon (21,1 km) sowie Walking- und Crossläufe für unterschiedliche Altersklassen. Die Läufe sind Teil des Sparkassen Lauf- und Walking Cups und zeichnen sich durch abwechslungsreiche Strecken mit teils befestigten und unbefestigten Wegen aus. Für alle Teilnehmer gibt es eine Erinnerungsmedaille und Online-Urkundendruck, zudem werden Pokale und Sachpreise für die besten Läufer vergeben.
course_highlights: Strecken führen durch Waldgebiet mit festen Wegen und Radwegen
Verpflegungspunkte an der Spreebrücke
Vielfältige Strecken mit teils befestigten und unbefestigten Wegen, inklusive Hindernissen im Kids Run
additional: Zeitnahme erfolgt mit Fußgelenkstransponder, der nach dem Zieleinlauf abzugeben ist. Bei Verlust oder Defekt wird eine Gebühr von 20 EUR fällig. Die Startnummer ist sichtbar auf der Brust zu tragen. Nachmeldungen sind online vom 29.09. bis 02.10.2027 sowie am Veranstaltungstag bis eine Stunde vor Start möglich. Es gibt Altersklassensiegerehrungen mit Urkunden und Pokalen. Die Veranstaltung ist Teil des Sparkassen Lauf- und Walking Cups.

name: Gaudilauf 14
organizer: Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Gaudilauf is a traditional race held in Bad Liebenwerda. The route runs from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda back to Munich and offers a scenic course along the Elster. The event is characterized by a friendly atmosphere, with the competitive aspect taking a back seat. Refreshments are provided every 5 kilometers, and participants can look forward to a relaxed celebration at the finish with drinks and grilled food. A bus transfer from the finish back to the start is available on request.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The Ovenhausen Autumn Run is a traditional race held annually on the first Sunday in October and organized by TuS Ovenhausen. The event offers various distances for different age and performance groups, including a challenging 20.8 km tour through forests and hills, as well as shorter races for young athletes. The course is varied, with sections on cycle paths, in the Grubestadion, and through the forest. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes, and usually takes place in pleasant autumn weather.

name: Luftschifflauf
description: The TURCK Airship Run at Essen/Mülheim Airport offers a unique running experience on the airport runway. The flat, fast course, with no tight turns or elevation gain, is ideal for setting personal bests. The highlight is the spectacular finish inside the impressive WDL airship hangar, making the race an unforgettable event.
