This family-friendly event offers various distances for children, teenagers, and adults and takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The Central German Marathon is a unique running experience in the heart of Germany, connecting the Central German metropolitan region on a fast course between Leipzig and Halle (Saale). The classic marathon course, which hosted the first German marathon in 1925, runs from the city of Bach, Leipzig, to Halle, the cultural capital. In addition to the marathon, other events include the Händel Run Half Marathon, the half-marathon relay, the 10K run, 10K walking, and the Salzwirker Run. The event offers a varied program and is suitable for runners of all ability levels.

name: Oktoberlauf Embsen
description: Der Oktoberlauf Embsen findet voraussichtlich am Sonntag, den 3. Oktober 2027 in 21409 Embsen statt. Angeboten werden Laufwettbewerbe über 5 km und 11 km sowie Wettbewerbe für Kinder und Jugendliche. Das Ziel aller Wettbewerbe ist an einem gemeinsamen Ort. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Läufer aller Altersgruppen und bietet eine sportliche Herausforderung in der herbstlichen Umgebung Embsens.
course_highlights: Laufstrecken über 5 km und 11 km
Gemeinsames Ziel für alle Wettbewerbe
Wettbewerbe für Kinder und Jugendliche
additional: Die genauen Zielorte werden nur mit RUNME Premium angezeigt. Es gibt keine detaillierten Informationen zu Startwellen, Teilnehmerbegrenzungen oder Nachmeldungen auf der Website.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The Poznań Marathon is the 25th-anniversary edition of the city’s premier 42.195 km marathon, held in the heart of Poznań. The route runs along the city’s most important streets, including a return to the Old Market Square after 18 years, as well as scenic locations such as Sołacki Park, Malta and Enea Stadium. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and enthusiastic spectator support. Organizers have prepared a new, attractive course and a rich accompanying program, including children’s races and shorter distances.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Old Market Square, Ratajskiego Square and Wolności Square
Runs through the scenic areas around Malta and Sołacki Park
Finish at Plac Marka, at the Poznań International Fair
additional: The start for wheelchair athletes is at 8:55, and for runners at 9:00. Start corrals are assigned according to the declared marathon finish time and marked with colored stripes on race bibs. The participant limit is 8,000. The race office is open October 2–3 at the Poznań International Fair.

name: Bieg o Puchar Wójta Mikołajki Pomorskie
[UITVERKOCHT] Rottemerenloop Bleiswijk 2026
description: The Rottemerenloop 2026 takes place on Saturday, 3 October in Bleiswijk and offers a varied programme with a Kids Run of approximately 1,600 metres, a quarter marathon of 10.5 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km. The start and finish are at ‘De Sneeuwbal’, Lange Vaart 17a. Participants receive a timing chip in their race number for electronic timekeeping and can receive a medal after the race. The course has water stations and offers a scenic running experience in a green setting.
course_highlights: Kids Run of approximately 1,600 metres for the youngest runners
Quarter marathon of 10.5 km and half marathon of 21.1 km
Water stations at 5 and 16 km for the half marathon and at 5 km for the quarter marathon
additional: Race numbers will not be sent out; details will be communicated by email on 2 October. Kieviten youth members can take part in the Kids Run and quarter marathon for free, provided they register as a Kievit. Time limits: 1 hour 30 minutes for the quarter marathon and 2 hours 40 minutes for the half marathon. Every participant who finishes will receive a medal. No late registration is possible. Water stations are available along the course. If you need extra water, bringing your own hydration belt is recommended. Terrain: route through Bleiswijk, water stations available, chip timing, medal at the finish.

name: TREK Singelloop Utrecht
price_range: €27 voor het limited edition hardloopshirt, inschrijfgeld niet expliciet vermeld
description: The TREK Singelloop Utrecht is the oldest road race in the Netherlands and an annual running celebration in the beautiful city of Utrecht. The race offers a fast, fully traffic-free route along Utrecht’s canals and through Wilhelminapark, where thousands of runners enjoy the course from start to finish. In addition to the 10 km and 5 km, there are also Kids Runs, Business Runs and a half marathon. The organisers support KWF Cancer Control and encourage participants to raise funds for this good cause.
course_highlights: Flat, paved and fully traffic-free roads
Route along Utrecht’s canals and through Wilhelminapark
Officially measured courses for the 5 km, 10 km and half marathon
additional: Start waves are used to ensure a smooth and safe start, with waves approximately 15 minutes apart for the 5 km and 20 minutes apart for the 10 km. Race bibs can be sent to your home for €4.50 if you register before 31 August; otherwise, they must be collected at the event grounds. A unique limited-edition running shirt can be ordered for €27. Refreshments are available along the course and after the finish. The organisers encourage participants to raise funds for KWF Cancer Control through their own fundraising page. Participants can register via the official website, with options to fundraise for KWF Cancer Control and take part in different distances.

name: Breda Run Fest 2026
description: Breda Run Fest 2026 is an atmospheric running event in Breda taking place on Sunday, October 4, with a varied program and a Business Run on Saturday, October 3. Participants can register for various distances, including a 5,000-meter race open to athletes aged 13 and over. The event promotes sportsmanship and camaraderie by grouping participants according to their expected finish times. A special T-shirt is also available, and a free running clinic will be held to help participants prepare.

name: Prevox Startbaan-loop
description: The Prevox Startbaanloop is a monthly running race held on the athletics track of AV Startbaan in Amstelveen. The race offers distances of 1, 3 and 5 kilometres, with the 1 kilometre distance also open to young runners. Electronic timing accurately records lap times and finish times. On Sunday, the 55th edition of this popular race takes place, with advance registration available via Inschrijven.nl.

name: Hema Volksloop 4 oktober
description: The HEMA IJzeren Man Volksloop is an accessible and relaxed running event held on the first Sunday of every month in Weert. Runners of all ages and levels run together along a beautiful route beside the water and through the green landscape of the IJzeren Man. The Volksloop focuses on being active and enjoying the experience, with everyone able to take part at their own pace. Several distances are available, including special youth distances and a time limit for seniors. The start is at the small beach in front of the Hertenkamp on Geurtsvenweg.

name: Trailrun Den Bosch
description: Trailrun Den Bosch is a running event in 's-Hertogenbosch with two distances: 8 km and 16 km. The race offers an accessible trail running experience for runners who want to enjoy a challenging course in beautiful surroundings. The organizers invite runners to share their experiences and prepare well with training plans from partners. The event is part of the WeTri platform, which supports triathletes and runners with comprehensive race information and training opportunities.

name: 0522 RUN – Urban City Run Meppel
description: The 0522 RUN - Urban City Run Meppel is a unique 5.22 km discovery run through Meppel’s city centre, organised by JCI Meppel-Reestmond. It is not a race, but an experience in which participants discover Meppel’s finest streets, businesses, squares and sights, with surprising entertainment along the way. There is no timekeeping or pressure to perform; the focus is on having fun and experiencing the city. After the finish, there is a lively afterparty in the heart of Meppel. Proceeds from the event go to Stichting De (W)arme Kant van Meppel, which provides practical support to fellow residents facing financial difficulties.

name: Bridge2Bridge Run
description: The Bridge2Bridge Run 2026 is the 19th edition of this annual running race organized by Orion Venlo. The race takes place in Blerick, Venlo, and offers distances of 5 km and 10 km, as well as children’s runs of 500 m and 1,000 m. The event has a sporty, recreational atmosphere, and race numbers can be collected on race day from 9:00 a.m. The Bridge2Bridge Run is a great opportunity for both beginner and experienced runners to test their fitness and enjoy a well-organized event.

name: Hoge Veluwe Loop
distance_verbose: 20 km, 12 km, 5.5 km, 1500 meter, 1.2 km, 0.9 km
description: The Hoge Veluwe Run is an atmospheric running race in the heart of De Hoge Veluwe National Park, with routes over unpaved paths of 5.5 km, 12.5 km and 20 km. The 20 km trail run offers a challenging course with more than 200 metres of elevation gain and natural aid stations, making it ideal for experienced runners. Beginners can take part in the 5.5 km Forest Run, which features scenic paths and an option for a more challenging alternative. Children can join the Moeffie Run in one of three age categories. The start and finish are at the Park Pavilion in the centre of the park, which also has various facilities.

name: Kanonsloop
description: The Kanonsloop Groenlo is an atmospheric running event being held for the 38th time. The race features a refreshed 10 km course passing well-known locations in and around Groenlo, such as Bommelwereld, Camping Marveld, the Groenlo canal and De Grolse Weiden city park. In addition to the 10 km, the familiar 5 km distance is also available, along with a special business run and a convivial finish at Brouwernös Proeflokaal. The start and finish are at the Muziekkoepel on Maliebaan / Wheme in Groenlo. The organizers ensure a safe and sporty atmosphere with traffic marshals and timing by Race Result.

name: Klaverblad van Noordenveld
description: Het Klaverblad van Noordenveld is a welcoming walking event held at Ronostrand in Een. The routes range from 4 to 30 kilometers and pass through natural areas on a mix of paved and unpaved paths. A unique feature is that all distances, except the Beleefroute, pass by the sand extraction site, an area that is normally closed but has been specially opened for this anniversary edition. Children can enjoy a special 4 km Beleefroute full of games and adventure. The start and finish are centrally located at Ronostrand, creating a friendly and accessible atmosphere for all walkers.

name: Coevorder Crossloop
description: The Coevorden Cross Run takes place around Klinkenvlierse Plas in Coevorden. The start and finish are at the ice rink. Participants can choose from distances of 1.5 km (youth), 3 km, 6 km and 9 km. The course consists of challenging 3 km laps and offers a great opportunity to train with other runners and enjoy the nature around the lake.

name: MSV Family loop
description: The MSV Spijkenisse Family Run is a friendly, accessible running event for all ages, with special attention to young runners. The 1-mile (1.6 km) Family Run is ideal for children up to and including 13 years old, who may be accompanied by an adult. There are also challenging distances, including the 5 km run and the quarter marathon, which pass through beautiful natural areas and by familiar landmarks such as the white church in Simonshaven. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere and support for its charity, the Goofy Team of Erasmus MC Sophia Children’s Hospital.

name: AV Spirit Wintercup
description: The AV Spirit Wintercup is an accessible recreational running and walking event in Lelystad, held on the first Sunday of every month from October through March. Everyone can take part, young or old, running or walking. The 2026–2027 season starts on 4 October with new 5 and 10 kilometre routes. There is a 5 and 10 kilometre ranking in which the best four of five results count, as well as special KidsRuns with themes and medals. The Wintercup combines sporting spirit with a friendly atmosphere and is open to everyone, including non-members.

name: Marathon sw mannen en Halve vrouwen
Rosa Sløyfe-løpet Bergen
description: The Rosa Sløyfe Run in Bergen is an annual event that brings together thousands of participants to support the breast cancer cause. The race starts and finishes at Torgallmenningen in central Bergen, and offers two distances: a short course of approximately 3 km and a long course of approximately 6.4 km. A free children’s race for children aged 3 to 9 is also held. All participants receive a race pack with a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal, and the event creates a sea of pink in the city in support of an important cause.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Torgallmenningen in central Bergen
Short course of approximately 3 km and long course of approximately 6.4 km through attractive urban areas
Free children’s race of approximately 400 metres for children aged 3–9, with activities in the start area
additional: The race pack includes a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. The short course is not timed, while the long course is timed. Participants in the short and long courses are insured through a licence provided by the Norwegian Athletics Federation, which also supports the cause. The children’s race is free and organised in collaboration with Espira Kunnskapsbarnehagen. The event area opens at 14:00, with activities including a prize wheel and glitter station.

name: Halve Marathon Oldenzaal
description: The Oldenzaal Half Marathon is a popular running race held in the rolling Twente countryside. The half-marathon route passes several highlights, including Tankenberg, Wilmersberg, Hakenberg and Paasberg. It is mostly paved, with drink stations every 5 kilometers. The race is suitable for both individual runners and corporate teams, and has a time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes. Alongside the half marathon, there are also 10-kilometer and 5-kilometer races, a corporate race and school races, making the event accessible to a wide audience.
course_highlights: Route through the rolling Twente countryside, with highlights including Tankenberg, Wilmersberg, Hakenberg and Paasberg
Mostly paved course with drink stations every 5 kilometers
Time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes for the half marathon
additional: The half marathon has a time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes. If you arrive at the Bisschopstraat/Oostwal intersection after 13:55, you will be directed off the course. Race bibs for pre-registered participants are sent to their homes; those registering later must collect theirs at Twents Carmel College. There are also several other distances and a corporate race. Young participants have separate start times for the 1 km and 2 km school races. Information about course changes, start times, registration tips and safety. The event is popular with local and recreational runners.

name: 43e Tata Steel Marquetteloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 14 km, 7 km, 3.3 km, 1.3 km
price_range: tegen verhoogd tarief op de dag van het evenement
description: The Tata Steel Marquetteloop is an annual road running event in Heemskerk, taking place for the 43rd time in 2026. The race offers several distances, including 3.3 km, 7 km, 14 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km, making it suitable for recreational and more experienced runners alike. The event takes place on Sunday and is organised by AV Dem. The atmosphere is sporty and challenging, with a playful theme that lets participants compete to become the “ruler of Heemskerk.”
course_highlights: Road race in Heemskerk, starting and finishing on Marquettelaan
Distances ranging from 3.3 km to a half marathon (21.1 km)
Includes a kids’ run for young runners
additional: There are currently no entries available. The event is organised by AV Dem. It has a playful “Speel Run Risk” theme, with participants competing for the title of “ruler of Heemskerk.” Distances for all ages, running clinics, a school championship, volunteering opportunities, family-friendly event.

name: 8 van Drachten
description: De 8 van Drachten is an annual running event in the heart of Friesland, suitable for all ages. With various distances, including an 8 km race, a KidsRun and a Business Run, the event offers a suitable challenge for every runner. The scenic course and sporting community make this a festive and professional running experience in Drachten. The 22nd edition takes place.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the heart of Drachten
Distances for all ages, including a KidsRun and Business Run
Sporting community and professional organization
additional: Late registration is not possible. Race numbers can be transferred through a resale platform. There is an awards ceremony immediately after the race events. The KidsRun starts at 14:00, and the 8 km and Business Run start at 15:00. Registration is available through the website, and the event is supported by an active online community on Instagram.

name: Rondje Bergen
price_range: early bird korting vanaf mei 2026, exacte prijzen niet vermeld
description: Rondje Bergen is a friendly running event held annually on the first Sunday of October in Bergen (NH). The event offers several distances, including a 1 km youth run and races of 5 km, 10 km and 10 English miles. It is known for its enthusiastic atmosphere and is organised entirely by volunteers. Participants receive a commemorative medal, and prizes are awarded to the top runners in various categories.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 1 km youth run to 10 English miles
The youth run starts in age groups at 1-minute intervals
Prize-giving takes place shortly after each distance, next to the finish
additional: Registration is not available on the day of the event. The youth run is for children up to and including 13 years old and starts in age groups at 1-minute intervals. All participants receive a commemorative medal. Prize-giving takes place shortly after each distance, next to the finish. Prizes for top runners; medals for all participants; volunteers wanted.

name: 57e Langs de Gouweloop
description: The 57th Langs de Gouweloop takes place in Waddinxveen, with the start and finish at Gouweplein by the shopping centre. Organised by Sportclub Antilope, this annual family running event offers something for everyone: a 1.3 km Kids Run for children up to age 12 and 5 km and 10 km race events for runners aged 12 and over. The route is a 5-kilometre loop, run twice for the 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting achievements, and welcomes both beginner and experienced runners.
course_highlights: A 5-kilometre loop, run twice for the 10 km
Start and finish at Gouweplein at Winkelcentrum Waddinxveen
Suitable for all ages, with a Kids Run and race events
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Sporthal De Dreef, opposite the shopping centre. Late registration is available until half an hour before the start. There is no electronic timing; times can be read from a clock at the start and finish. Parking is available at Sporthal De Dreef and in the car park beneath the shopping centre, with the first two hours free. Course along Gouweplein, discounted registration, family-friendly event

name: Rosa Sløyfe-løpet Haugesund
description: The Rosa Sløyfe Run in Haugesund is an annual event supporting the breast cancer cause and bringing together thousands of participants for a colorful and engaging celebration. There are three distances: a free children’s race for the youngest participants, a short course of approximately 3 km without timing, and a long course of approximately 5 km with timing. The start and finish are at the athletics stadium, and the course goes around scenic Vangen. All participants receive a race pack with a race number, neck warmer, bag, and medal. The event also includes a warm-up, prizes, and an uplifting podium ceremony.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the athletics stadium in Haugesund
Course around scenic Vangen
Children’s race for ages 3–9, with activities in the start area
additional: The race pack includes a race number, neck warmer, bag, and medal. The short course is untimed, while the long course is timed. Race numbers can be collected in advance or from 2 hours before the start in the start area. Participants can walk, jog, or run; time and pace are not the most important things. There is a warm-up before the races, followed by prizes and a podium ceremony. The children’s race includes dancing and activities in the start area.

name: Warburger Stundenlauf 2026
description: The 34th Warburg Hour Run takes place in Warburg. The competition is aimed at adults and offers both individual and team categories. The course is flat and the event lasts one hour. There are also competitions for children and young people; details can be found in the organizer’s official announcement.
course_highlights: Flat course
Duration: 1 hour
Individual and team categories available
additional: A competition for children and young people is offered. The start and finish are at Hüffertsportplatz; precise location details require RUNME Premium. The event is part of the RUNME race calendar. Participants receive certificates and trophies; registration is online; the event takes place in October in good weather.

name: Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried
description: The Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried is a short autumn cross-country race held on the grounds of the Bergfried in Saalfeld, Germany. Distances range from 800 m to 4.8 km and are designed for fast off-road running rather than long road races. The race takes place outside the stadium and is classified as both a hill race and a cross-country race. The Saalfelder Leichtathletikverein has organized the event for many years, with separate races for children and adults and various age groups.

name: Herbstcross des Saalfelder LV
distance_verbose: 13.5 km, 10 km, 9.9 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 2 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: NightRun Borne
description: On Friday, the first edition of the NightRun Borne takes place: an atmospheric evening run through the center of Borne. Participants run or walk a route of approximately 7 kilometers, with a 5-kilometer option, passing through shops and remarkable buildings that open their doors especially for the event. The NightRun Borne is not a race; there is no timing, and everyone is a winner. The event is all about the experience, having fun, and enjoying the evening together in a magical atmosphere full of light and energy.

name: Backyard Outland Edition
description: Backyard Outland Edition i Gistrup er et unikt ultraløb, hvor deltagerne løber gentagne runder på 6,7 km asfalt hver time. Løbet byder på to hoveddistancer: et 12-timersløb med start kl. 06.00 og et 7-timersløb med start kl. 11.00. Ruten er flad og foregår på asfaltveje, hvor løberne skal holde venstre side og dele ruten med øvrig trafik. Der er depot med væske og snacks, og efter løbet er der bad og omklædning til rådighed. Arrangementet foregår ved Vaarst-Fjellerad Boldklub, og overskuddet går til boldklubben.
course_highlights: 6,7 km pr. runde på asfaltveje
Ny runde starter hver hele time
Ruten deles med øvrig trafik; løberne skal holde venstre side
additional: Manuel registrering af runder. Startsted: Vaarst-Fjellerad Boldklub, Vaarstvej 173, 9260 Gistrup. Medløbere kan starte på hele timer mellem 06.00 og 17.00. Løbet slutter kl. 18.00. Der er depot med væske og snacks samt adgang til toilet, bad og omklædning.

name: Lysfald Løbet 3. oktober i Fårup Sommerland 2026
Bohusläns Bästa
location: Havstenssund to TanumStrand, Tanum Municipality, Sweden
description: Bohusläns Bästa is a 22 km trail race from Havstenssund to TanumStrand and the final race in the Outnorth Trailtour. The race offers a scenic course with cliffs, jetties, the scent of seaweed and views that soothe the mind while the body works hard. Sweden’s trail-running elite gather here for exciting races in a unique setting where mountains, forest and sea meet. Participants can also extend the experience with accommodation and a banquet at TanumStrand Spa & Resort.
course_highlights: 22 km of trail running from Havstenssund to TanumStrand
Scenic views featuring cliffs, jetties and the scent of seaweed
Part of the Outnorth Trailtour, featuring Sweden’s trail-running elite
additional: Accommodation and a banquet are offered at TanumStrand Spa & Resort to round out the weekend. Subscribers get access to a newsletter with current information and offers, including 20% off Asics trail shoes at Outnorth. The organizer’s text recommends accommodation and a banquet at TanumStrand.

name: Skrylle Challenge
location: Skryllegården, Södra Sandby, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: Skrylle Challenge is a running event held at Skryllegården in Södra Sandby. The race offers a challenging 25 km course for both women and men, where participants can experience beautiful scenery and varied terrain in the Skrylle area. The event brings together runners from different clubs and towns, creating a sense of community and competition. Skrylle Challenge is a popular race for both experienced runners and enthusiasts looking to test their endurance in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: 25 km of running on varied terrain
Scenic views in the Skrylle area
A challenging course for both women and men
additional: Participant lists show separate bib numbers and clubs for women and men in the 25 km class.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is a running race organised by Ryssbergets IK in Bromölla, with the start and finish at Sparbankshallen. The course is clearly marked with arrows, lines and tape, and marshals are on hand to show the way. Participants can expect water stations serving water and sports drink, as well as a friendly atmosphere with coffee and grilled sausages served after the race. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and medical staff are available in the start and finish area. By registering, participants consent to the publication of their names and results and to the use of photographs and videos from the event.
course_highlights: The course is marked at every kilometre with arrows, lines and tape
Water stations serving water and sports drink at the lap point and finish
Start and finish at Sparbankshallen in Bromölla
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Sparbankshallen no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn on the front of the chest. The prize ceremony begins at 12:30. Registration is primarily by advance entry, but on-site registration is also available. The event follows the Swedish Athletics Association’s rules for road races. The race information states that prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category. Race numbers must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. The published information applies to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date 9 October 2027.

name: Göteborg Marathon
description: Göteborg Marathon is a traditional race being held for the 52nd time, offering both a marathon and a half marathon. The course is flat and straight, with the start and finish at the historic Slottsskogsvallen in Göteborg. It follows an out-and-back route along the old coastal railway embankment, with beautiful views of the sea and archipelago. The race is well organised, with aid stations every four kilometres and a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all levels. It is a perfect race for anyone looking to run fast and enjoy a scenic course near the sea.
course_highlights: Flat, straight course along the old coastal railway embankment
Turnaround at the Lilla Amundön boat-storage area after approximately 10.5 km
Aid stations every four kilometres with water, sports drink, Coca-Cola, bananas and raisins
additional: The start and finish are inside Slottsskogsvallen. Marathon start group 1 starts at 10:00. Half-marathon start group 2 (target finish under 1 hour 45 minutes) starts at 10:30, and half-marathon start group 3 (target finish over 1 hour 45 minutes) starts at 10:45. After finishing, participants are offered a drink and a sandwich. Participants may have their own drinks and energy products transported to the aid stations. Race bibs must be worn visibly throughout the race. The event offers a marathon and a half marathon. The course was officially measured in 2024.

name: Running Lights Alingsås 2026
description: Running Lights is a magical running event held during the famous Lights in Alingsås festival. The race offers distances for all ages and levels, from the Knatteloppet for the youngest runners to 10 km for more experienced runners. Enjoy a running celebration amid magical lighting, through beautifully illuminated areas in central Alingsås. Running Lights is also part of the Västsvenska löparcupen, offering extra competition opportunities for club runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan)
Routes through beautifully illuminated areas during Lights in Alingsås
Distances from 300 m to 10 km, with varied loops around squares and parks
additional: Start times by distance: Maxi-Knatte 300m at 16:00, Energiloppet 600m at 16:30, Ungdomsloppet 1660m at 16:45, Stafetten 3 x 1660m at 17:05, 5 km at 18:00, 10 km at 19:00. The routes are loops around Stora torget, the river, the squares and Museiparken. The relay is for teams of 3 people, each running one lap. Bib pickup and the running expo are held at Estrad, Bryggerigatan 2. The race is part of the Västsvenska Långloppscupen and Västsvenska löparcupen.

name: Borgen Outdoor Run
description: Borgen Outdoor Run is a challenging trail race held in the Alandsryd area at Friluftsgården Borgen in Värnamo. The race offers a fun and varied course featuring a ski slope and forest trails, giving participants a wonderful experience in nature. The event is well established and attracts runners who appreciate both a challenge and a sense of community in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail race in the Alandsryd area
Route through the Alandsrydsbacken ski slope, with elevation changes
Scenic and varied course with forest trails
additional: Groundwork is underway at the Alandsrydsbacken ski slope (between 2–3 km) to increase the vertical drop, which may result in minor course adjustments in that area. According to the event information, the race is open to all ages, and participants can run individually or as part of a pre-registered team.

tiers.description: Er du under 15 år betaler du 350kr for to

tiers.description: For andre er prisen 400kr for et løp

description: Bergensløpet celebrates an anniversary with a double running festival in beautiful surroundings in Bergen. The race starts and finishes in historic Nygårdsparken and runs along Store Lungegårdsvann, Fløen and Møllendal. Two distances are offered, 5 km and 10 km, both on a fast, officially measured course. A free children's race is also held for children up to 11 years old, with a medal for every participant.
course_highlights: Start and finish in historic Nygårdsparken
The course runs along Store Lungegårdsvann, Fløen and Møllendal
Fast, officially measured 5 km course; the 10 km runners complete two laps
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:45 at Vitalitetssenteret by Møhlenpris sports ground. Toilets are available at the collection point and in the clubhouses. The children's race starts at 12:00, the 5 km at 13:00, and the 10 km at 14:00. The children's race is approximately 500 metres, free, and has no timing or rankings; all children receive a medal. The autumn edition is listed as taking place on Saturday, 10 October. The date for the 2027 edition matches the race date of 9 October in the listing.

name: Gausta Challenge
description: Gausta Challenge is an accessible race held on Saturday, 9 October in Tinn, Telemark. The race goes around Kvitåvatn and covers approximately 6 kilometres on gravel roads. It is suitable for anyone looking for an enjoyable and accessible running experience in beautiful surroundings. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is a popular autumn race in the region.
course_highlights: Race around Kvitåvatn
Approximately 6 km on gravel roads
An accessible race for all

name: Kystløpet
description: Kystløpet is a race in Egersund, featuring an 11 km distance that has been held in recent years. The course follows the old railway line and the walking trail. Previous editions have offered both timed and recreational classes, and the race welcomes runners for an active day by the coast.
course_highlights: 11 km race distance
Route along the old railway line
Also follows the walking trail in Egersund

name: Flisa Backyard
description: Flisa Backyard is a friendly autumn event held at beautiful Myrmoen in Flisa. The race welcomes everyone who wants to challenge themselves, test their fitness or simply enjoy a fantastic day in beautiful surroundings. The event is open to everyone born in 2013 or earlier and offers an inclusive, magical atmosphere. The race is organised by Flisa Allianseidrettslag, which has a long tradition as a sports club in the area.
course_highlights: The race takes place at beautiful Myrmoen in scenic surroundings
Open to everyone born in 2013 or earlier
One of the autumn’s friendliest events, with an inclusive atmosphere
additional: Everyone born in 2013 or earlier may participate. The event is organised by Flisa Allianseidrettslag, which has used Rubic as its membership system. Registration is via racetracker.no. Flisa Backyard is an inclusive, social race in the scenic surroundings of Myrmoen. The listed registration price is 450 kr, increasing to 550 kr from 18 January, 650 kr from 1 April and 750 kr from 1 August. Registration includes a choice of single-event or annual licence, and camping can be reserved.

name: Gausta Challenge
location: Gausta Fjellresort, Gausta, Tinn, Telemark, Norway
organizer: Rjukan IL – Friidrett & Triathlon og Gaustablikk Fjellresort
description: Gausta Challenge is a low-key race held on Saturday, 9 October 2027, at Gausta Fjellresort. The race follows a roughly 6 km gravel road around Kvitåvatn, starting and finishing at the paddle tennis court. It is suitable for all ages and fitness levels, with staggered starts and timing, and participants can run, walk or take it easy. The event is a collaboration between Rjukan IL - Friidrett & Triathlon and Gaustablikk Fjellresort, and aims to encourage physical activity in beautiful autumn surroundings.
course_highlights: Approx. 6 km gravel route around Kvitåvatn
Start and finish at Gausta Fjellresort, by the paddle tennis court
The route is hilly, with a long downhill section and flat stretches
additional: The children’s race for ages 0–10 starts at 14:00. The 6 km race is open to participants aged 10–99. The start and finish are at the paddle tennis court near the floating saunas. The route is run counterclockwise. Gausta Challenge 2027 takes place on Saturday, 9 October at 13:00. The children’s race starts at 14:00.

name: Hortensløpet
description: Hortensløpet is a celebration for everyone in central Horten, suitable for all levels. The event offers three distances: 5 km for everyone looking to enjoy running and a sense of community; a separate children’s race over a short distance, with a great atmosphere; and 10 km, the flagship distance for those who want to challenge themselves and experience achievement and endurance. The event emphasizes an accessible, welcoming atmosphere and offers a sporting classic in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km distance with an accessible format and a great atmosphere
A separate children’s race over a short distance, full of the joy of running
10 km flagship distance offering a sense of achievement and endurance
additional: Interactive course map with location services. Option to search for photos by face or bib number. Pace and pacer calculator based on your desired finish time. The course map is available as an interactive map.

name: BKK Walking am Baldeneysee mit Mini-Marathon
description: BKK Walking at Baldeneysee is part of the Westenergie Marathon weekend in Essen and offers a varied programme for walkers, Nordic walkers and runners. The main marathon takes runners twice around Baldeneysee, with an additional turnaround loop, and features a flat course and fast cycle paths. The marathon has been held annually since 1963, making it Germany’s oldest event of its kind. The event is organised by TUSEM Essen’s athletics department with the support of numerous volunteers. The number of participants is capped at 3,000 to avoid bottlenecks on the course.
course_highlights: Flat course around Baldeneysee
Two laps, with an additional turnaround loop on the first lap
Fast cycle paths and early autumn weather
additional: The walking programme offers distances of up to 14 km. The event takes place annually on the second Sunday in October. Distances: 1.1 km, 7 km, 42.2 km; participant numbers are capped at 3,000; October weather is around 14°C and cloudy; registering with the organiser is recommended.

name: Coesfelder DJK - Citylauf
description: The 32nd Coesfeld City Run takes place in Coesfeld. The event is organized by DJK Eintracht Coesfeld e.V. and gives runners of all age groups the opportunity to take part in sport. The City Run combines recreational, competitive, health and rehabilitation sports and is an established event in the region. Online registration is available via the official website.
course_highlights: Measured, flat city courses through the historic town center
A variety of running distances for all age and performance groups
Attractive prizes, certificates and trophies for top runners and groups
additional: The organizer’s office is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 12:00 and 14:30 to 18:00. The office is closed on December 24 and 31 and on public holidays. The website refers to photos by photobello and provides entry lists for the individual races. Road/cross-country run, registration open, various running distances, start and finish in Coesfeld city center, age groups for children, recreational runners, club members and older participants

name: Wadersloher Volkslauf
description: The Wadersloh Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Wadersloh, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses are available and are eligible for rankings until 2029. There are also shorter races for children and walking routes. The event takes place at the Sportpark on Winkelstraße and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a start-number deposit and timekeeping.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured and eligible for rankings until 31.12.2029
600 m Bambini run and 1000 m schoolchildren’s race on the synthetic track at the Sportpark
7.5 km walking and Nordic walking route available
additional: A start-number deposit of 2.00 EUR is collected by SEPA direct debit when registering online and refunded in cash on the event day when the start number with chip is returned. The 5 km and 10 km races are officially measured and have DLV approval until 2029. Photos and videos are taken and published as part of the event. Measured courses, online registration, start numbers with chips, sponsors

name: Vorlauf zum Harz-Gebirgslauf
description: The Harz Mountain Run warm-up is a free test run held one week before the main race. It gives runners the opportunity to check their fitness and get to know the Harz Mountain Run courses. The event starts together at 9:30 a.m. in Himmelpforte, Wernigerode, and offers distances of 2 km, 5 km, 11 km, and 22 km. At the finish, participants are welcomed with tea and bread with lard. No registration is required, but the courses are not yet marked.

name: 25. Volkslauf um den Altwarmbüchener See
description: The Volkslauf around Lake Altwarmbüchen is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. The race gives runners the opportunity to discover the Hannover Region on foot and take part in a varied range of running events. Each participation earns a stamp in the running pass, which is available both digitally and in a traditional format. The event is aimed at recreational athletes and promotes active movement in the region.

name: Brakelsieker Volkslauf "Am Fuße des Mörths"
description: The Brakelsiek fun run “At the Foot of the Mörth” is a classic local running, walking, and Nordic walking event in Schieder-Schwalenberg, held on a Saturday afternoon in October. Various distances are offered for adults and young people, including 5 km, 9 km, and 15 km runs, as well as 5 km and 9 km walking and Nordic walking. The start and finish are at the Brakelsiek sports field, and the route runs around the village sports field, with a gently rolling rural profile at the foot of the Mörth. The event offers a lovely opportunity to enjoy the autumn landscape in a relaxed atmosphere.

name: Parforceheide Crosslauf
description: The Parforceheide Cross-Country Run has been organized by RSV Eintracht 1949 in Stahnsdorf since 2008, giving recreational runners in the region the opportunity to discover the varied landscape of the Parforceheide. The course starts at the sports ground on Heinrich-Zille-Straße and passes the Südwestfriedhof cemetery, continuing through woods and natural surroundings with small climbs, sandy sections, and stretches of asphalt and cobblestones. Races are offered over 1 km (Bambini), 3 km (schoolchildren), 5 km, and 10 km for young people and adults. After the run, the organizer provides food and refreshments, and football matches are often held at the sports ground, making for a lovely day of sport for participants and their companions.

name: Solvay Lauf
description: The Solvay Run Bernburg is a 5 km race in Bernburg, Saxony-Anhalt. The race starts at Krumbholzallee 8 at 10:00 a.m. Part of the Solvay Cup, it combines cross-country and road running, so it is not an easy, flat city course. It is aimed primarily at local clubs and usually attracts 100 to 300 runners. The event offers professional timing, online results, certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop and refreshments at the finish.

name: Volkslauf mit Walking um den AWB See
description: The 25th Volkslauf with Walking around AWB Lake is a local running and walking event in Altwarmbüchen, a district of Isernhagen. The event offers short, flat distances around Altwarmbüchener See, with one lap measuring approximately 3.66 km. There are various running and walking routes for adults, as well as races for children and young people, making it a community running experience for the whole region. The start and finish are at Seestraße 23, and the races take place in the afternoon.

name: XIV Cross Centaura
location: Biały Bór, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Janlouterloop
description: The Janlouterloop is an annual running event in Vlaardingen’s Broekpolder, held in memory of Jan Louter, a passionate runner and coach who died of pancreatic cancer in 2024. Participants can choose from three running distances (5, 10 and 15 kilometres) or a 10-kilometre walking route. The event is organised by AV Fortuna and supports the charity ‘Support Casper’, part of the Stichting Overleven met Alvleesklierkanker. The Janlouterloop combines sport, togetherness and an experience of nature in a unique polder setting.

name: 1 MIJL IN LINE
description: The 7th edition of the Mijl in Line is organised by Atletiekvereniging Cromstrijen. It is a unique 1,609-metre race along a straight stretch of the Lange Biesakkersweg, halfway between Klaaswaal and Numansdorp. Participants can enjoy a fast, straight route, with a fun trophy for every participant and prizes for the winners. Registration is open through 9 October via inschrijven.nl, with late registration available on the day from 16:00.

name: 10e Oosterhoutse Trail
description: The Oosterhout Trail celebrates its 10th anniversary edition. For ten years, this unique trail-running event has offered beautiful routes and challenging unpaved paths in a friendly atmosphere. Participants can choose from three different distances to suit a range of ability levels. Especially for this anniversary edition, the first 100 people to register will receive an exclusive anniversary shirt. After the race, everyone will celebrate the anniversary together at a festive closing event.

name: DECAloop Utrecht
description: The DECAloop Utrecht is a challenging running race held in Utrecht. The race covers a distance of 67 kilometers and starts at 08:00. It offers long-distance runners a unique opportunity to test their endurance in an atmospheric setting. Registration is easy via an online form, and the price is very attractive for this distance.

name: Mijn City Run Ede
description: Mijn City Run Ede is a unique running event held in the center of Ede. The race features a fast and spectacular 1-kilometer course through the city center, with an inclusive program for all ages, including kids’ races, a family run, and a business run. The day concludes with a final in which the fastest recreational runners compete against national and international elite athletes. The event combines sportsmanship with a festive atmosphere and is open to everyone, including athletes with disabilities.

name: LoveLife Run Amsterdam
description: LoveLife Run Amsterdam is a special running event held on October 10 at the Olympic Stadium. Courageous current and former cancer patients run 5 or 10 kilometers alongside their loved ones and healthcare providers to raise money for groundbreaking cancer research. Everyone is welcome to take part or support the participants, even if they have never had cancer themselves. The event combines an athletic challenge with a powerful message of hope and solidarity.

name: Hernense Stratenloop
description: The Hernense Stratenloop is a small-scale, recreational running race held in the picturesque village of Hernen. The 17th edition features four distances: 600 metres, 1,200 metres, 5 kilometres and 10 kilometres. The routes pass through the village and the beautiful surrounding countryside, by the medieval castle, the grain mill, Hernense Forest and rural Leur. The event is suitable for all ages and offers a sporty, sociable afternoon with a warm atmosphere and plenty of spectators along the route.

name: Noordduinloop
description: The Duinloopcircuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, featuring varied courses that combine challenging dune trails with fast beach sections. The Noordduinloop offers a great atmosphere for both competitive runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. The races are suitable for all ages, with various distances ranging from kids’ runs to 10 km. The circuit encourages participation through a ranking based on each runner’s best four results.

name: PrattenburgRun
description: The PrattenburgRun is a running event held at Landgoed Prattenburg in Veenendaal. The 11th edition attracts a broad audience of running enthusiasts. There are three distances: marked 5 km and 10 km routes, and a challenging 15 km trail run with approximately 178 metres of elevation gain. Participants receive a GPX file for navigation. Proceeds from the registration fees go towards protecting young deciduous trees on the estate.

name: Venoseloop
description: The Venoseloop is an annual running race held on the second Saturday of October in Vollenhove. The race offers distances of 5 and 10 kilometres and starts at 11:00 from the 't Akkertien holiday park. The route passes through the beautiful countryside around Vollenhove, allowing participants to enjoy the surroundings as they run. The Venoseloop is known for its welcoming atmosphere and good organisation, with facilities including changing rooms and showers, first aid, and timekeeping using the IPICO chip system.

name: Run2Day Vlinderloop
description: The Run2Day Vlinderloop in Houten is a monthly running event held on the second Saturday of each month from September through May. The route passes through the countryside around Houten, including Kasteel Heemstede and the Amsterdam–Rhine Canal, offering a lovely mix of nature and culture. Distances range from 5.2 km to a half marathon, with events suitable for both young people and adults. The start is at Korfbal Vereniging Victum. The atmosphere is friendly and sporty, with an emphasis on running together and having fun.

name: AVW 3bossentrail
description: The AVW 3Bossentrail takes place in Wieringerwerf and passes through three forests in the Wieringermeer. The routes range from 14 to 28 kilometres and follow walking paths, singletracks and boardwalks, with as much of the course as possible on unpaved surfaces. There is also a 14 km canitrail, with dogs required to be kept on a lead. The trail run focuses on enjoying nature rather than competition, and start waves are used to ensure a calm start in the forest.

name: Eremitageløbet
description: Eremitageløbet er et cannonball løb i couperet tæren nord for København. Motionsløbet foregår altid i starten af oktober og er det eneste løb i Dyrehaven nord for København.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 LIUF Trail
Royal Aarhus City Marathon 2027
location: Vester Allé ved ARoS, Aarhus C
description: Royal Aarhus City Marathon er det første bymaraton i Aarhus siden 2008. Ruten er én runde på 42,195 km med start og mål på Vester Allé ved ARoS. Du løber gennem Marselisborgskovene, langs bugten og forbi Den Uendelige Bro, over havnen og ud på Aarhus Ø, forbi Dokk1 og Domkirken og rundt om Brabrand Sø, før du er tilbage i midtbyen. Højeste punkt på ruten er 60 meter, og cirka 20 km er bilfri stier og gågader. Tidsgrænsen er 6 timer. Startgebyret dækker chiptid (RACE RESULT), medalje, løbetrøje, depoter hver 5. km med vand og sportsdrik, bagageopbevaring og digitalt diplom. Early bird 695 kr. til og med 24. december 2026, derefter 795 kr. Arrangør er Strata Endurance Events, som også står bag Royal Copenhagen City Half og Ørestad Half Marathon.
additional: Start kl. 09.00 søndag 10. oktober 2027 på Vester Allé ved ARoS, mål samme sted. Interaktivt rutekort: https://racm-map.vercel.app · Strava-rute: https://www.strava.com/routes/3550794644934219702. Ruten er foreløbig indtil endelig godkendelse fra Aarhus Kommune og politiet.
