name: Fredrikstadmarka Rundt 2027
description: Fredrikstadmarka Rundt is a traditional forest race that has been held since 1974. The course is 20 km long and is considered one of the true classics among Norwegian forest races, with a runnable route featuring pleasant trail sections and good gravel roads. The start and finish are at FIF-huset in Fredrikstad, and the course offers both flat terrain and some steep climbs, especially in the final section towards Skihytta. A shorter distance called Markatier'n is also held, using the same start and finish area and sharing the 20 km course for the first 5.5 km.
course_highlights: 20 km forest race on a runnable route of trails and gravel roads
Three water stations along the course at approximately 5.5 km, 10 km and 14 km
Steep climbs and challenging terrain, especially between 9 and 14 km
additional: There are 3 water stations offering water and cordial along the way, as well as drinks at the finish. The start and finish are at FIF-huset, Ilaveien 132, Fredrikstad. The course has remained largely unchanged since 1974. Course records are 1:07:08 for men and 1:16:17 for women. Registration and results services are stated to be provided in cooperation with EQ Timing.

name: Büdelsdorfer Eiderlauf
description: The Büdelsdorf Eiderlauf is a traditional autumn race in Büdelsdorf, Schleswig-Holstein, organized by SG Athletico Büdelsdorf. It offers classic local road-race distances, including 5 km and 10 km, on flat, manageable courses that are ideal for recreational runners and beginners. The start and finish are often at Eiderstadion, giving the event a friendly, informal atmosphere. The race attracts children, young people, and local club runners, and is a fixture on the regional autumn running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat road-race distances
Start and finish at Eiderstadion
Family-friendly local club race
additional: The race takes place in typical October weather, with daytime temperatures around 14 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Distances range from 1.5 km to 11.1 km, including children's races. After a break during the COVID-19 pandemic, the format was adjusted to incorporate the start and finish in the stadium. Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, 5.8 km, 10.9 km, 11.1 km; flat courses; autumn event; start and finish in the stadium; open to all age groups

name: Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof-Lauf 2026
location: Schloss Erbhof, Kirchwiehe, Thedinghausen, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof-Lauf takes place in Kirchwiehe, directly opposite Schloss Erbhof in Thedinghausen, Lower Saxony. Organized by TSV Thedinghausen, this road race has welcomed children, teenagers, active adults and Masters since 2016. Distances on offer are 10 km, 5 km and an 800 m children’s race, which takes place in the Baumpark near the start and finish. The course is a measured, flat 5 km loop that is also suitable for Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Measured, flat 5 km loop
The 10 km course covers the loop twice
800 m children’s race in the Baumpark, right by Schloss Erbhof
additional: October weather is typically 14 °C, with lows around 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The children’s race, “Löwenlauf,” is designed especially for the youngest participants and takes place near the start and finish area. Start and finish in Kirchwiehe opposite Schloss Erbhof; children’s race in the Baumpark; October weather with temperatures around 14°C, lows of 6°C, 40 mm of precipitation and mostly cloudy skies.

name: Westenergie Marathon
description: The Westenergie Marathon in Essen is a traditional race around the picturesque Baldeneysee. In addition to the classic marathon, the event offers the Westenergie Seerunde, the AllbauTeamStaffel, a mini-marathon for children, and a Walking Day. The course is known for its scenic beauty and proximity to the lakeshore, making the race a special experience for runners of all ages. The event is very well organized and attracts numerous participants every year.
course_highlights: A run around the Baldeneysee with picturesque lakeside scenery
Start and finish at Seaside Beach in Essen
Sections with lake views and through the Heisinger Aue nature conservation area
additional: The start and finish are at Seaside Beach on the Baldeneysee. Late registration on the event day is paperless and uses a QR code. Children can take part in a 1.1 km mini-marathon, with a prize and medals for all participants. Photobello offers race photos. The Walking Day routes include various distances with beautiful lake views and also pass through the Heisinger Aue nature conservation area. The marathon is Germany’s oldest continuously held marathon, with a flat, fast course, several race disciplines, and support for the region. Results and certificates are available online.

name: Stadtwerke Lübeck Marathon
price_range: 45 € bis 85 € je nach Disziplin und Anmeldezeitraum
description: The Stadtwerke Lübeck Marathon offers runners a diverse range of distances in the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck. In addition to the classic marathon, the event includes a duo marathon, half marathon, relay race and other shorter races suitable for all ages and ability levels. The course winds through the picturesque city and offers a sporting challenge with regional championship scoring. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and emphasizes community and a passion for sport.
course_highlights: Marathon with Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring
Duo marathon relay point in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea
Course through the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck
additional: A preferred bib number can be selected free of charge during the early registration phases, subject to availability. Relay race with 10 x 4.2 km. Handbike half marathon on the same course as the runners’ half marathon. Duo marathon relay point in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea.

name: Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K
description: The Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K is Berlin’s fastest 10-km race, starting in front of Charlottenburg Palace. The course runs through Berlin Zoo and offers a unique running experience in the capital. In addition to the classic 10-kilometer course, there is also a 2 x 5 km relay and a 4.2 km short course from the zoo to Charlottenburg Palace. The event is suitable for all abilities and age groups and offers a large running festival for the whole family.

name: 19. Burger-Rolandlauf
description: The Burger Rolandlauf is a traditional race that normally takes place in Burg and is jointly organized by Rolandgymnasium Burg and LG Ihleläufer Burg. The course runs through the town along the Ihle, through the forest and past the Bismarckturm, finishing in the school courtyard. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program with music, activities for children and refreshments. The 2026 event in Burg was cancelled due to a lack of permits; instead, a replacement event will take place in Tangerhütte City Park.

name: Frühstückslauf
description: The breakfast run in Wernigerode is a group run without timekeeping, leading from the market square up to Wernigerode Castle. The route is about 3 kilometers long, with an elevation gain of 100 meters. The run takes place as a group and is free of charge. A light snack is served afterward, making it a sociable event.

name: H/21 Halbmarathon
description: The H/21 Hannover Half Marathon is a new running event on the national events calendar, combining urban flair, modern beats and green sections of the course. The start and finish are in the heart of Hannover, and the route passes notable hotspots throughout the state capital. The event takes place in autumn and offers a special running experience in a vibrant urban setting. Join the prologue as Hannover begins a new chapter in running history.

name: Bad Hersfelder Lollslauf
description: The Bad Hersfeld Lollslauf is a traditional running event held annually in Bad Hersfeld, attracting runners of all ages and ability levels. With distances ranging from the Bambini Run to the 10 km individual race, the Lollslauf offers a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. Alongside competition, the event also emphasizes community and the joy of running. It is a regular fixture on the running calendar and draws participants from across Germany.

name: Porta Volkslauf
description: Der Porta-Volkslauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung in Porta Westfalica, die seit über drei Jahrzehnten Teil der regionalen Mühlenkreisserie ist. Die Veranstaltung zieht Läufer aller Altersklassen an, von ambitionierten Wettkämpfern bis zu Genussläufern. Die Strecke führt rund um den Nammer Sportplatz und durch das Naturschutzgebiet Nammer Unterholz, bietet abwechslungsreiche und flache Abschnitte sowie ein herrliches Panorama auf die Porta. Die herzliche Atmosphäre entlang der Strecke macht den Lauf zu einem besonderen Gemeinschaftserlebnis.
course_highlights: Strecke über Straßen und Feldwege rund um den Nammer Sportplatz
Befestigte Wege im Naturschutzgebiet Nammer Unterholz
Herrliches Panorama auf die Porta mit flachen und abwechslungsreichen Streckenabschnitten
additional: Der Lauf ist Teil der Mühlenkreisserie und findet auf der heimischen Sportanlage in Nammen (Poggenbeeke) statt. Streckenpläne für Kurzstrecke (5.500 m), Mittelstrecke (8.800 m) und Langstrecke (17.000 m) sind als PDF verfügbar. Parkmöglichkeiten sind rund um die Sportanlage ausgewiesen, Parken in Einfahrten oder an Feldwegen wird nicht empfohlen.

name: Sebastian Fredrich Gedenklauf (LM/LC/NLC)
description: The Sebastian Fredrich Memorial Run is a long-standing running event in Lubmin, organized by the triathlon and running group of HSG Uni Greifswald. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere, supported by many volunteers. The route passes through scenic sections and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of an active running and triathlon community in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania.

name: Storkower See Lauf
description: The Storkower See Run is a traditional running event organized by Triathlonverein Fürstenwalde 1990 e.V. and approved by the Brandenburg Athletics Association. Runners of different age groups and ability levels can take part on various distances around Lake Storkow. The event offers a fair competitive atmosphere and is open to running enthusiasts of all ages. Online registration opens in January, and participants are included in an official participant list.

name: Wendlandmarathon
description: The Wendlandmarathon Kolborn is a traditional road race in Lüchow, Lower Saxony, held since 1993. The event offers a wide range of distances, from the marathon and half marathon to short children’s races, appealing to both long-distance runners and families. The course is measured to AIMS/IAAF standards and has kilometre markers and aid stations. Practical facilities for participants include parking, showers, changing rooms and certificates, as well as finisher medals for children.

name: Piwna Mila
location: Wąsowo, Kuślin, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Beer Mile is a unique race over a flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres and the main event on the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start immediately after drinking a beer, and beer stations are placed along the course approximately every 500 metres. Runners must drink the beer at each station. This sporting celebration brings together runners, spectators and families, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a special finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: Flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres
Beer stations approximately every 500 metres
The race starts after runners drink their first beer
additional: 9:30–10:30. The race bib must be pinned to the front of your clothing and must not be altered. You can order a T-shirt when paying for your race bib in the Runner’s Panel. Photos from the event will be available after the race.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
location: Skrzeszewo, Gmina Żukowo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Friendship Run is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque area around Skrzeszewo, giving participants the chance to spend time actively and discover the charms of Kashubia. The series attracts runners of different ages and abilities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque landscapes of Kashubia
The race takes place in a natural, welcoming environment
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Wąsowo, Kuślin, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bieg Październikowy
location: Łubianka, Toruń County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful wooded settings of city parks and forests. In Poznań, the course loops around Lake Rusałka, starting near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, with the finish by the municipal beach on the lake. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to more experienced runners, who can compare their results on the same course over the years. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start near Św. Wawrzyńca Street; finish by the municipal beach on Lake Rusałka
Suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event follows a consistent schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. Participants under 16 may take part with the consent of a parent or guardian. The series also includes races for children and young people.

name: Pielgrzymi Półmaraton o Memoriał Jana Pawła II
ASML Marathon Eindhoven
description: The ASML Marathon Eindhoven is the largest two-day sporting event in North Brabant and takes place annually on the second weekend of October. The event offers a wide range of running distances, including the marathon, half marathon, quarter marathon and various other runs for all ages. The course is flat, wide and atmospheric, with a finish in the center of Eindhoven, making for fast times and a unique experience. The city is entirely focused on sport, innovation and connection, with enthusiastic supporters lining the course. This makes the ASML Marathon Eindhoven a festive and internationally acclaimed running event.
course_highlights: Flat, wide course with a finish in the center of Eindhoven
Atmospheric course with enthusiastic crowd support
Route past iconic spots in the city
additional: Participants receive a unique medal. A limited-edition running shirt is available. Special “Run Against Cancer” initiatives allow participants to raise funds and receive a unique shirt. Race bibs for participants from the Netherlands are available until September 1. The finish is on the lively Vestdijk in the center of Eindhoven. This two-day event offers registration for various distances, with the start and finish in the center of Eindhoven, and includes an urban walk and children’s activities.

name: Veluwepoortloop - najaarseditie 2026
description: The Veluwepoortloop is an annual road running event in Nijkerk, with an autumn edition. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances. Organized by AV Nijkerk, the event combines a sporting challenge with a playful element, allowing participants to compete to become the “ruler of Nijkerk.” The race takes place on a Saturday and offers a great opportunity to meet fellow runners and achieve personal goals.
course_highlights: Road race in Nijkerk
Distances of 5 km and 10 km
Organized by AV Nijkerk
additional: The event includes a game element called “Run Risk,” where participants can compete to become the ruler of Nijkerk. No entry tickets are currently available. Participants can register in advance via the website, and the event takes place in the rural countryside around Nijkerk. No information is available about entry fees or the prize schedule.

name: 640e Conditio Trimloop
description: The 640th Conditio Trimloop is organised by Atletiekvereniging Generaal Michaëlis and takes place in the wooded area near the Joe Mann Nature Theatre in Best. It is a cross-country race with distances of 3 km and 6.7 km. Participation is free for AVGM members. Participants can register on the day and receive practical information about the course at the venue. The race has a long tradition and offers a challenging running experience in a natural setting.

name: Oostvaardersrun
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16 km, 10 km, 2.5 km, 1 km
description: The Oostvaardersrun is a recreational running event held amid the beautiful natural surroundings near the Oostvaardersplassen, close to Lelystad. The ninth edition features challenging courses of 10, 16 and 21 kilometres. Due to work in the area, the routes have been adjusted this year, but they still offer a unique experience through Nieuw Land National Park. The event attracts many sports enthusiasts each year who enjoy nature and the sporting challenge.

name: Kranenbroeker Bosloop
description: The Kranenbroeker Bosloop is an annual running series held in the beautiful Kranenbroek nature reserve in Echt. The races are organized by Recreatiesport Vereniging Kranenbroek and are open to everyone, from beginner runners to competitive athletes. The course follows well-maintained forest paths and country roads, giving participants the opportunity to track their performances across multiple races. The start and finish are at the same location, and several distances are available, ranging from 1 km for children to approximately 10.5 km for adults.

name: Vestingloop Edam
description: The Vestingloop Edam is a traditional running race held along Edam’s old fortifications. Since the first edition in 1954, when the race covered a distance of 5 kilometres, the route has remained a regular feature despite changes to the distances. The event offers several distances, including children’s races, a 3-mile fun run and a 10 km race. The finish is on Baandervesting near the chain bridge, while the longer distances start on Noordervesting. The Vestingloop is known for its changeable weather and friendly atmosphere for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Culture Run Woerden
description: The Culture Run Woerden is celebrating its fifth anniversary. This unique fun run brings together sport, culture and Woerden’s rich history. During this enjoyable run, you’ll discover the city centre in a surprising way—not only passing well-known places but also going right through iconic and cultural buildings. The combination of exercise, culture and Woerden’s characteristic conviviality makes this event popular with both residents and visitors. With two distances of 5 and 10 kilometres, suitable for walking and running, it’s accessible to young and old alike. The start and finish are at Technohub Woerden, and the course will be made extra festive with performances and entertainment.

name: De 15 van Wassenaar
description: De 15 van Wassenaar is a vibrant running event. Participants can choose between a 15-kilometre or 7.5-kilometre distance, both of which pass through the village centre, estates and residential areas of Wassenaar. The event combines a sporting challenge with a festive atmosphere, including refreshments along the route, a medal and an after-party to celebrate the achievement. The race supports charitable causes and draws an enthusiastic crowd along its beautiful course.

name: Rondje Bussloo
description: Rondje Bussloo is an atmospheric running event around the Bussloo recreational area, organised by the team behind Rondje Oeken. The two distances follow paved paths through a varied landscape of water, woodland and open fields, suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Strandhuys De Enk in Wilp, which also has welcoming hospitality facilities. The event is known for its sporty, friendly atmosphere and starts at 10:30.

name: Rosa Sløyfe-løpet Kristiansand
organizer: Kreftforeningen og Brystkreftforeningen, i samarbeid med Springtime Group
price_range: Mini: gratis; kort og lang løype: 500 kr + administrasjonsgebyr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kort løype - 17:00 Deltakere kr 500,00 + Adm. gebyr (30 NOK + 3%)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lang løype - 19:00 Deltakere kr 500,00 + Adm. gebyr (30 NOK + 3%)

description: The Pink Ribbon Run in Kristiansand is an annual event held to support the breast cancer cause. The run starts and finishes at Aquarama in the city centre, and the course passes through beautiful areas around Kristiansand. Participants can choose between a short course of approximately 3.4 km or a long course of approximately 5.5 km. There is also a separate children’s race for children aged 3 to 9. All participants receive a race pack with a bib, neck warmer, bag and medal, and the event brings together thousands of people in a sea of pink for a good cause.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Aquarama in central Kristiansand
Short course of approx. 3.4 km without timing
Long course of approx. 5.5 km with timing
additional: The race pack includes a bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. The Mini children’s race is free and approximately 400 metres long, with activities in the start area. The short course is untimed, while the long course is timed. Race numbers can be collected in the start area from 2 hours before the start, or in advance to avoid queues. Participants in the short and long courses are insured through a licence with the Norwegian Athletics Association, which also supports the cause. Companies can register using separate registration forms and manage participants through My Page. The race pack contains a bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. NOK 250 of the race entry fee goes in full to the Pink Ribbon campaign.

name: 90e Sloterplasloop
description: The Sloterplasloop is a traditional road running event in Amsterdam, organised for the 90th time in 2026. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km, with special kids’ runs for young runners too. The race is part of Rondje Mokum and is organised by AAC Amsterdam. The event takes place around Sloterplas and offers a scenic running experience in an urban setting.
course_highlights: Road race around Sloterplas in Amsterdam
5 km and 10 km distances available
Kids’ runs for young runners too
additional: The event is organised by AAC Amsterdam. There are currently no entry tickets available. Participants can register for prizes and records, with start times from 9:30 a.m. The event is easy to reach by public transport and takes place in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: MHB Overbetuweloop
description: The MHB Overbetuweloop is the Betuwe’s running event, held in Elst. The event offers five distances, including the challenging MHB 5 km and Rabobank 10 km, both certified by the Dutch Athletics Federation (Atletiekunie). There are special KidsRuns for children over 400 m and 800 m, as well as a new 1,300 m teen run. The course runs through Elst’s picturesque town centre and the beautiful countryside along the Linge, making it suitable for the whole family. Start times have been moved earlier to avoid running during the hottest hours of the day.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Elst town centre and the countryside along the Linge
5 km and 10 km certified by the Dutch Athletics Federation (Atletiekunie)
Safe, fast KidsRun course named after Olympic athlete Femke Bol
additional: After the finish, participants receive water and something to eat. Physiotherapists/sports masseurs will be present. The 5 km and 10 km start at the same time, with an extra-wide start area and room at the front for competitive runners. Electronic timekeeping is used. Children aged 4–7 may run with a parent or guardian in the 400 m KidsRun. Medals are included for children; adults can order a medal when registering for € 2,50. Dansstudio Kerima will lead a KidsRun warm-up. Extra cooling will be provided in extremely hot weather. The course is certified by the Dutch Athletics Federation (Atletiekunie); medals and prizes are awarded to top finishers; sustainable medal options are available. The start and finish are in Elst. Registration is open until 20 June. Volunteers are needed. Sports clinics and facilities such as first aid and physiotherapy are available.

name: Loopavond Gemzen
description: Loopavond Gemzen is a running event held in Heerde, the Netherlands. The race takes place at the Lambert Dijkslag Athletics Track and offers participants a choice of distances: 3 km and 5 km. The event takes place in typically cool, clear autumn weather, ideal for performing at your best. The organizers invite runners of all levels to take part and enjoy a sporting evening.

name: Frikarusellen løp nr.1 2027/28
description: Frikarusellen løp nr.1 2027/28 arrangeres i Espeland og er en del av en løpsserie som samler løpere i hele Norge. Løpet tilbyr en flott mulighet til å teste formen tidlig i sesongen, med et variert terreng som passer både mosjonister og mer erfarne løpere. Arrangementet er godt organisert med påmelding og tidtaking via EQ Timing, og det er en sosial arena for løpsinteresserte i regionen. Arrangøren ønsker alle velkommen til en hyggelig løpsopplevelse i naturskjønne omgivelser.
course_highlights: Løpet går i variert terreng i Espeland
Passer både mosjonister og erfarne løpere
Del av en større løpsserie med god organisering

name: 5e Duin en Bollen Vierdaagse
description: The Duin en Bollen Vierdaagse is a welcoming autumn walking event through the beautiful landscapes of South Holland. Participants can choose from five walking distances and walk for 1 to 4 days through colourful forests, dunes and villages, and along the Dutch coast. Along the way, walkers are treated to music, theatre, inviting chill-out spots and friendly rest stops with refreshments. The routes pass iconic places such as Keukenhof, the Amsterdamse Waterleidingduinen and historic villages, making it a varied and atmospheric walking adventure for everyone.

name: Geopark Hondsrug Crosscircuit
organizer: Stichting De Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark
description: The Geopark Hondsrug Crosscircuit is a challenging cross-country running series held in the beautiful Hondsrug area, a unique Ice Age landscape and UNESCO Global Geopark. The series consists of several cross-country races organised by different local running groups, where participants can exercise in a natural and varied environment. Participants of different ages and ability levels can take part, with special rules for juniors. The series encourages sportsmanship and a connection with the landscape.

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organised by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is for those who are a little adventurous and interested in fitness, and places as much emphasis on experiencing nature as on performance. The event is held and offers a memorable course in hilly terrain close to nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Växjö Marathon is a fast, flat marathon course consisting of eight laps around the beautiful Växjö Lake. The course is mostly paved, with a short section of fine gravel, and has very little elevation gain—about 3 meters per lap. The event welcomes both experienced runners and beginners, and also offers a relay race for teams. This is the 32nd edition of the race, which is known as Sweden’s fastest marathon course. The course is marked and has a lead cyclist and course marshals, but it is not closed to traffic during the race.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Växjö Lake
Flat, fast course with about 3 m of elevation gain per lap
Mostly paved surface, with about 300 meters of fine gravel
additional: The course is marked, and there is a lead cyclist and course marshals. Relay races are also available for teams. A children’s race is held as well. Sports drinks, dietary supplements, and energy and protein bars are available. The organizer is Växjö Running Club. The marathon relay has teams of four, with each runner completing two laps. The course is not closed to pedestrians, cyclists, or motor traffic.

name: Åhus TrailRun
description: Åhus TrailRun is a challenging trail race through the coastal forests and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne. Participants can choose from four distances: 2.5 km, 6 km, 11 km and 17 km, as well as an untimed children’s race. The courses feature gently rolling terrain with a mix of trails, sand dunes, hills and running on sand by the sea, providing a unique running experience. The race is part of Skåne Trailcup and also offers a team competition with great prizes. The event is open to everyone and has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Gently rolling terrain with varied surfaces
A mix of trails, sand dunes and challenging hills
Running on sand along the sea
additional: Participant limit: 1,000. The children’s race is approximately 350 m long, has individual starts and is free to enter. Start times: 2.5 km and 6 km start at 12:30, 11 km and 17 km start at 12:40, and the children’s race has individual starts between 13:00 and 15:00. The time limit for the 17 km race is 2 hours and 50 minutes. Parking is limited; follow the instructions of event staff. Valuables storage is available for a fee of 20 SEK. Toilets are 200 metres from the event venue. The venue at Strandridaregården is approximately 100 metres from the sea. The children’s race is approximately 350 metres and is untimed. Prices are reported for the 2026 edition.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a race for everyone, from elite runners to recreational runners, offering a completely flat and fast course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association and is eligible for seeding at many races in Sweden and internationally. The race offers a great atmosphere, pacers for different finishing times, and the opportunity to take part in team competitions with friends. It’s a perfect chance to set a personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run with colleagues or friends.
course_highlights: A completely flat and fast course in central Jönköping
The 5K runs one lap; the 10K runs two laps
A water station with UMARA sports drink along the course
additional: Pacers carrying flags for 40-, 45- and 50-minute times in the 10K. Team competition with a 10% discount when registering with two friends. Warm-up with Fitness24Seven at 10:40 in the start/finish area. Limited bag drop in the start area in the morning. Parking is available in nearby parking garages for a fee. Register three people as a team for a 10% discount on the entry fee and a chance to win prizes. Up to five runners can be registered at the same time.

name: Ivar Formos Minneløp 2027
description: Ivar Formos Memorial Race is a long-running trail race in Oslo, offering scenic and challenging routes in Nordmarka. There are distances for both children and adults, including a tough 17 km course that follows the terrain where Ivar Formo trained to become an Olympic champion. The start and finish are at Sognsvann Snow Park, and the routes feature beautiful trails, panoramic views of the city, and several aid stations along the way. It is a sweaty delight for anyone who enjoys running in the forest, with a new 10 km course that is rolling and challenging without steep climbs or descents.
course_highlights: 17 km course starting and finishing at Sognsvann Snow Park, with panoramic views of Oslo from Vettakollen and Frønsvollen
The course passes well-known spots such as Båntjern, Skjennungstua, Ullevålseter, and Lynhytta, with aid stations
New 10 km course on beautiful forest trails, with challenging, rolling terrain and no steep hills
additional: A timing chip is included in the race bib, except for the children's race, which is untimed. Late registration is available on race day via the EQ Timing app. Registration is binding, with no refunds in case of illness or injury. Race bibs can be resold via EQ Timing. No T-shirts will be sold in 2027 due to low interest. In 2027, the race will be held for the 15th time. A one-time license from the Norwegian Athletics Federation is required if you do not have an annual license.

name: Furumomila 2027
description: Furumomila is a traditional cross-country race, held for the 44th time at Furumo Idrettspark. The event offers several distances, including a 10 km cross-country race, MiniMil, a walking event and SpareBank1 Modum’s cross-country race. Participants can look forward to generous cash prizes, gift cards, medals and pins. This autumn adventure welcomes both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: 10 km cross-country race over varied terrain
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km, MiniMil and a walking event
Start and finish at Furumo Idrettspark
additional: Race bibs can be collected in the tent by the clubhouse before the start. Showers and changing rooms are available. Parking and a shuttle bus are offered. Prizes are awarded shortly after finishers cross the line in the different distances. A one-time licence is required for those without an annual licence, in accordance with the rules of the Norwegian Athletics Federation. Previous editions have had race bib collection at the clubhouse.

name: Hytteplanmila
description: Hytteplanmila is an annual fun run held at Svensrudmoen in October. The race features a fast, gently undulating 10-kilometre course, known as one of Norway’s fastest 10K road race routes. Participants can experience a varied course with both easy and challenging sections, including a demanding finish on Pulsbakken. The event attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes, with separate start groups for the elite field.
course_highlights: Fast, gently undulating 10-kilometre course
The race’s challenging finish on Pulsbakken
Great views over Steinssletta and historic sites such as Mo gård
additional: Registration opens in November. Entry fees are non-refundable and cannot be transferred. Those who register by the deadlines receive a buff and running socks, distributed on race day. It is possible to pre-order a race pack with energy products. Elite athletes can register by email for separate start groups. Buses to the race are arranged from Oslo and Gardermoen. The time limit is 1 hour and 40 minutes. Registration for 2027 opens in November; information about the entry fee has not yet been published.

name: Viersener Herbstwaldlauf Rund um den Bismarckturm
description: The 79th Viersen Autumn Forest Run Around the Bismarck Tower takes place in Viersen. The event offers a 5 km run for adults on a hilly course, with a time limit of one hour. There is also a 7.25 km walking and Nordic walking event. The age limits are 14 to 99 for the run and 10 to 99 for walking. This traditional event is aimed at runners and walkers looking for a challenging course through autumnal woodland.
course_highlights: Hilly course
Around the Bismarck Tower
One-hour time limit for the 5 km run
additional: There are events for children and teenagers; further information is available in the organizer’s official announcement. The start and finish are the same for all events; exact locations are shown only with RUNME Premium. Results are listed by age group, with age-group placement determined by year of birth. Multiple events with different distances, age groups, and start times; participation for teenagers aged 14 and over; results will be published on the website.

name: Falke-Rothaarsteigmarathon
location: Schmallenberger Sauerland, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 23rd FALKE Rothaarsteig Marathon takes place in the Schmallenberger Sauerland. The event offers marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking, and a 12.5 km AOK run. The course passes through the scenic Rothaargebirge region and is recognized by the DLV as an officially sanctioned public race. More than 1,000 active runners take part each year and enjoy the varied trail and woodland scenery.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the Rothaargebirge
Officially sanctioned public race recognized by the DLV
A range of events: marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking, and a 12.5 km AOK run
additional: Late entries are possible up to half an hour before the respective start. Start times are staggered: marathon at 11:00, half-marathon at 12:00, walking and Nordic walking at 12:15, and AOK run at 11:45. The event takes place at Latroper-Str. 57392 Fleckenberg in the Schmallenberger Sauerland.

name: Hachenburger Löwenlauf
description: The Hachenburger Löwenlauf is a traditional running event with a family-friendly atmosphere, held in Hachenburg. The event offers various distances, including a half marathon, a 10.5 km race, a 6.3 km fun run/team race, and children’s races. The routes pass through the varied landscapes of the Westerwald, with scenic elevation changes and wonderful views. Since 1989, proceeds from the race have been donated to social projects, giving the event special social significance.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route reaches its highest point at Gräbersberg (513 m) and features varied climbs and descents.
The 10.5 km race runs mostly on forest trails, reaching its highest point at 439 m above sea level.
Start and finish area at the Rundsporthalle in Hachenburg, with changing rooms and showers available.
additional: Electronic timing without a chip, certificates for all finishers, prizes for age-group winners, and a special prize for the largest team-race group. Late entries are possible on 16 October from 17:00 and on race day from 09:00. Refreshments along the course and at the finish include electrolyte drinks, water, tea, cola, and fruit. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Rundsporthalle. Various race distances (half marathon, 10.5 km, 6.3 km team and fun run, children’s races); start and finish area at Lohmühle, Hachenburg; electronic timing (without a chip); certificates for all finishers; prizes for age-group winners; refreshments along the course and at the finish; online registration only.

name: Herbstlauf des LSV Porz
organizer: LSV Porz / Kölner Lauf- und Nordic-Walkingteam
description: The LSV Porz Autumn Run is Cologne’s oldest road race and takes place in the picturesque Leidenhausen recreation area. The event offers distances from 1 km to 10 km, measured in accordance with the German Athletics Association (DLV) regulations and eligible for rankings. Both competitive runners and recreational joggers can enjoy the autumn scenery as they run. The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne and the surrounding area, and is often used by top runners to assess their form.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Leidenhausen recreation area amid autumn scenery
The 5 km loop is one of the fastest running routes in Cologne
Routes measured in accordance with DLV regulations and eligible for rankings
additional: Race numbers must be worn on the chest. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Late registration is possible on the day of the event for a fee of €2; school students are exempt from the fee. No liability is accepted for theft, accidents or other damage. Payment is by SEPA direct debit a few days before the event. No entry fee will be debited if the event is cancelled. Courses measured, registration until 14.10.2025, start times from 11:00, parking nearby, participation in running and Nordic walking events

name: TeutoMarsch
location: Grundschule Hohne, Lengerich-Hohne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Teutomarsch is a unique hiking and running experience through the Teutoburg Forest and its surroundings. Organized by Turnverein Hohne von 1911 e.V. in Lengerich, the Teutomarsch offers two routes designed to delight participants. The event is very popular, and places fill up quickly. The exact route is still being finalized, but promises to be a wonderful and unique course. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and dogs are allowed on a leash.
course_highlights: A unique route through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area
Two different routes for a special experience
A nature experience in the Lengerich-Hohne region
additional: Registration for the Teutomarsch 2026 sold out within 30 minutes, with 500 places available. There is a waiting list. Participants consent to being photographed and filmed and to the publication of the images and footage. Entry fees are non-refundable. Minimum age: 16. The organizer accepts no liability for personal injury or property damage, or for loss or theft. Trail running, no timing, aid stations along the route, start and finish at Grundschule Hohne, participant limit: 500

name: Panoramalauf Niedenstein
description: The 24th Niedenstein Panoramic Run takes place in Niedenstein. The event is organized by SG 1898 Chattengau e.V. and Lauftreff Niedenstein. The race offers an attractive course around the Hessenturm Stadium and the clubhouse, set amid the beautiful landscape of the region. Participants can look forward to a well-organized running event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup.

name: Prignitzer Moormeile
description: The Prignitz Moor Mile in Bad Wilsnack is a traditional race taking place for the 26th time. The event offers a range of distances from 1 km to 12.4 km, running through the Wilsnack forests and the Kurpark, and around the Karthanehalle. The races are suitable for children, teenagers, and adults, and are part of the Prignitz Cup and the Brandenburg Cup. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, good on-course refreshments, and professional timing.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
location: Luzino, Wejherowo County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and environmental protection. The races take place on forest trails around the park’s highest elevation, Dziewicza Góra. Participants can choose from 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. The event brings together runners of different ages and ability levels, creating a welcoming atmosphere of sporting competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The course follows a 5.15 km loop entirely on forest trails
The route climbs twice to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the highest point in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park
The route passes through the event center after approximately 3.7 km, where spectators can cheer on the runners
additional: The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30 in the building of the Łopuchówko Forest District Education Center. Children’s races start between 9:00 and 9:45, over distances of 200m, 500m, 1000m, and 1500m. The 5 km race starts at 10:50, the 10 km race at 11:00, and Nordic Walking at 11:02. The participant limit is 500. After leaving the forest, runners finishing the race should head to the left side of the balloon marked Finish; 10 km runners pass under the Finish balloon and continue for a second loop.

name: 35 Orla Pięść
location: Świeszyno, Koszalin County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: III Festiwal Biegowy w Nadleśnictwie Kli...
location: Sowno, Goleniów County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 50e Jan Koudstaal Dijkloop - Halve Marathon Schoonhoven
description: The 50th Jan Koudstaal Dijkloop in Schoonhoven is a running event with several distances, including 1.5 km, 6 km, 10 km and the 21.1 km half marathon. The race is affiliated with the Atletiekunie and offers a varied course for both recreational and more experienced runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Schoonhoven. Prices range from €3.00 to €15.00, depending on the distance.

name: Bierrun Groningen
description: The Bierrun Groningen is a sociable fun run of about 8 kilometres through the city of Groningen. Along the route, you’ll visit four local breweries where you can sample five delicious Groningen beers. There’s no timekeeping; it’s all about running together, enjoying beer and discovering interesting stories about it. The start and finish are at Folkingebrew The Pub, and afterwards there’s a get-together to round off the experience.

name: A. Vogelloop
description: The A.Vogelloop is a welcoming running event held in 't Harde. It is organised by the Wallenloop and Havenloop together with A.Vogel, and supports the Opkikker foundation. The route runs through the beautiful Zwaluwenburg estate, with a 5-kilometre off-road loop through woodland, starting and finishing in the attractive A.Vogel Gardens. The event welcomes both recreational and professional runners. Children can take part in special junior distances, and every participant receives a medal.

name: Boerbos cross
organizer: Stichting De Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark
description: The Boerbos Cross in Rolde is a challenging cross-country run through the unique landscape of the Boerbos, part of the UNESCO Global Geopark De Hondsrug. The route follows unpaved paths over hills, heathland and sand drifts, with distances for juniors, seniors and masters. The race is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos and is part of the Hondsrug Cross Circuit. Timing is done without a chip, and the number of participants is limited.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen—perhaps autumn’s fastest officially measured 10K, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on cycle paths and footpaths and is fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for those chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.

name: Skövdeloppet
description: Skövdeloppet makes a comeback in 2026 with a new, city-adjacent course that mainly follows walking and cycling paths through several of Skövde’s residential areas. Race day is October 18, and the races are designed as easy-to-run urban courses suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Three distances are offered (21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km), with a shared start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde.

name: Gjesdal Trailrun
location: Gjesdal IL athletics facility, Solås, Ålgård, Gjesdal, Norway

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ungdom opp til 15 år: 1. november til 31. desember: 175,-

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ungdom opp til 15 år: 1. januar til 21. juni: 200,-

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Ungdom opp til 15 år: 23. juni til 17. oktober: 275,-

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voksne 16 år og eldre: 1. november til 31. desember: 250,-

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Voksne 16 år og eldre: 1. januar til 21. juni: 325,-

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Voksne 16 år og eldre: 22. juni til 17. oktober: 375,-

description: Gjesdal Trailrun is a true trail race held amid beautiful natural surroundings in Ålgård, starting from Gjesdal IL’s athletics facility at Solås. The race mainly follows trails in the terrain northeast of the facility, climbing Kodlifjellet and Håfjellet, and is suitable both for those looking for a scenic mountain hike and for those who want to compete. Three distances are offered: 10 km, 6 km and a 1.3 km children’s race. The route follows regular hiking trails that can be challenging, with rocky and slippery sections, so good trail shoes are recommended.
course_highlights: Trail race on paths in the terrain northeast of Gjesdal IL’s athletics facility
The main course climbs Kodlifjellet and Håfjellet
Challenging sections with rocks and slippery areas
additional: Race number distribution opens at 10:00 at the Gjesdal IL clubhouse. The children’s race starts at 11:30. Both timed and untimed starts are available for the 6 km and 10 km distances. There is a time limit for the 10 km distance, with runners required to pass Kodlifjellet within approximately 35 minutes and the junction between the 6 km and 10 km routes within 40 minutes. The online registration fee of NOK 20, plus any NFIF one-time licence, is additional. Previous editions have featured 10 km, 6 km and a 1 km children’s race. Good trail shoes with good grip are recommended.

name: Neskollen Frontyard 2027

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: inkludert servering av snacks, drikke, frukt og pizza

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barneløp med inntil 5 runder rundt tjernet

description: Neskollen Frontyard 2027 is a unique race organised by Hvam IL, where participants run 3 km laps that must be completed progressively faster. The race combines competition with a family-friendly, social atmosphere, with indoor breaks at Nes Arena where snacks, drinks, fruit and pizza are served and included in the price. Frontyard challenges both running fitness and tactics, and prizes are awarded to the best woman, the best man and the fastest overall time after 15 laps. The start and finish are at Nes Arena, which has convenient facilities including toilets and parking right outside.
course_highlights: 3 km laps that must be run faster with each lap
Start and finish at Nes Arena, with indoor breaks
The course includes approximately 700 metres of gravel, with the rest on asphalt
additional: The start, finish and breaks are indoors at Nes Arena, which has 12 toilets and parking right outside. The course includes approximately 700 metres of gravel, with the rest on asphalt. Remember to wear your race bib visibly on the outside of your clothing. The children’s race starts at approximately 10:01. Previous editions have served snacks, drinks, fruit and pizza during breaks at Nes Arena.

name: Burscheider Stadtlauf
location: Burscheid, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Burscheid City Run takes place in the center of Burscheid and offers runners of all ability levels an ideal setting. There are several distances: the 10-kilometer main race, a 3-kilometer race, and an 800-meter race that serves as a qualification for the Sports Badge. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and is aimed at both competitive runners and recreational athletes. All finishers receive the traditional Kretzer City Run bread, and the top finishers are awarded special trophies.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer main race through the city center
3-kilometer race for recreational athletes
800-meter youth race as a Sports Badge qualification
additional: Late entries are possible at the registration office on race day for an additional fee of €5.00, but late entrants will not receive Kretzer City Run bread. Race packets will be available from 10:30 a.m. at the Protestant church. Changing rooms and showers are available at the “Auf dem Schulberg” sports hall. Free drinks are available along the course and at the finish. Age-group rankings follow DLO regulations. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross, Burscheid branch. Race numbers must be worn on the chest. The event also includes children’s races, race packets available from 10:30 a.m., online results, age-group rankings, medals, and trophies. October weather is usually mild, making participation pleasant.

name: Laubacher Ramsberglauf
price_range: bis 20. September vergünstigtes Startgeld, danach zzgl. Nachmeldegebühr
description: The Laubach Ramsberg Run is a traditional running event that starts and finishes in the picturesque castle park in Laubach. The event offers various distances for different age and ability groups, including a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run, and races for schoolchildren and Bambini. The races feature a varied course through the beautiful countryside around Laubach. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere, with refreshments, changing facilities, and an awards ceremony right in the castle park.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Laubach Castle Park
A varied course through the countryside around Laubach
Refreshments and changing facilities at the Sports and Cultural Hall
additional: Registration is via RACERESULT, with a reduced entry fee available until 20 September; a late registration fee applies thereafter. Changing and shower facilities are available at the Sports and Cultural Hall. The awards ceremony takes place right in the castle park. Distances: 10 km main race, 5 km fun run, children’s races over 1500 m and 300 m; registration via Raceresult; start and finish in the castle park; refreshments, changing and shower facilities on site; October weather: approx. 14°C, cloudy

name: Styrumer Straßenlauf "Rund um die Neustadtstraße"
location: Neustadtstraße, Mülheim an der Ruhr, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
distance_verbose: 25 km, Halbmarathon, 20 km, 15 km, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Styrum Road Race “Around Neustadtstraße” is a traditional road race in Mülheim an der Ruhr, centered on Neustadtstraße in Styrum. The event offers various distances from 1 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km, 25 km, a half marathon and 50 km. The courses are officially measured and listed in the laufen.de race calendar, making participation in the German rankings possible. The race is held in accordance with the rules and safety standards of the German Athletics Association (DLV).
course_highlights: Officially measured road race courses
A range of distances from 1 km to 100 km
Event on Neustadtstraße in Styrum
additional: Typical October weather: approx. 14 °C, low of 6 °C, average precipitation of 40 mm, mostly cloudy. The event also includes shorter distances such as 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km and 25 km, as well as special races for children and young people. The course runs along Neustadtstraße and through Sportpark Styrum, in cool October weather averaging 14°C. The event is listed in the official race calendar and meets the standards of the German Athletics Association.

name: Hambacher Herbstwaldlauf
description: The Hambach Autumn Forest Run is a long-standing race in Niederzier-Hambach, held annually in autumn. In autumn weather, runners enjoy the beautiful atmosphere and the forest’s vivid colors. Around 200 participants compete in various age groups and distances. The event is organized by DJK "Löwe" Hambach e.V. and offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere for recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: Run through the autumn forest, surrounded by colorful foliage
A variety of distances for children, teenagers, and adults
A traditional event with a friendly club atmosphere
additional: The event attracts around 200 runners. Results from the previous year are available online, along with certificate printing. The website provides no explicit information about start times, pricing tiers, or registration options.

name: Traditioneller Sparkassen-Herbstwaldlauf
location: Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum, Beckum, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Traditional Sparkasse Autumn Forest Run in Beckum is a popular running event held at the Harberstadion sports center in Neubeckum. The event offers various races for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a student race, a 5 km fun run, 5 km walking, and the 10 km main race. Participants receive medals, certificates, and trophies, making the event a motivating experience for recreational and competitive runners. Late entries are possible until about 30 minutes before the start, offering flexibility for last-minute entrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Harberstadion sports center in Neubeckum
Races for all age groups, from Bambini to the main race
Trophies for the fastest runners and certificates for all participants
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until approximately 30 minutes before the start, for a late-entry fee of €2. All participants in the Bambini and student races receive medals; participants in the 5 km fun run and 5 km walking receive certificates; and the top three runners in the 10 km main race receive trophies, while all participants receive certificates. Forest running event; registration and results on the website.

name: Oldenburg Marathon
price_range: 35 Euro für Sportshirt (genaue Startgebühr nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon offers runners a varied programme featuring a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, 10 km city run, 5 km run and children’s mile run. The course passes through Oldenburg and Wardenburg and is known for its excellent refreshments and friendly atmosphere. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and also offers a public race series with additional events throughout the year. Participants receive high-quality long-sleeved shirts, and extensive services are available on site.
course_highlights: Refreshment stations every 5 km on courses of 10 km or longer, offering water, sports drinks and fruit
Showers at the sports hall of Graf Anton Günther School, approximately 300 m from the start/finish area
Changing facilities and baggage drop-off on Parking Deck 1 at Schlosshöfe
additional: Race packs will be available at Schlosshöfe from 11 a.m. on 11 October. On race day, collection opens at 7 a.m. for marathon runners and at 8 a.m. for everyone else. Group registration is available. After the race, extensive refreshments will be provided, including drinks, fruit, coffee, tea, pastries and non-alcoholic wheat beer. Physiotherapy students will offer free massages. Portable toilets and changing facilities are available. Several race distances; start in Wardenburg; road closures in the city centre; medals for finishers; online registration available.

name: 20. Müggelsee-Halbmarathon
description: The Müggelsee Half Marathon is a scenic race in southeast Berlin that runs entirely around the Großer Müggelsee. The event offers three distances: a half marathon, 10 kilometers, and 5 kilometers, each set up as either an out-and-back course or a loop. The route passes through the historic Spree Tunnel and offers idyllic views of Berlin’s largest lake and the surrounding Müggelberge. The race is suitable for all runners, whether they are aiming for personal bests or simply want to enjoy the community and nature. The start and finish are at Müggelseeperle, and the race takes place.

name: Almetal-Marathon
description: The Almetal Marathon 2026 takes place on October 18 and offers runners a scenic route from Büren-Ringelstein to Ahorn-Sportpark in Paderborn. Alongside the classic marathon distance, there are two half-marathon options and a relay race covering four stages. The event is shaped by the volunteer commitment of numerous sports clubs and offers a family-friendly atmosphere and an impressive experience of nature in the Alme Valley.

name: Hubertuslauf
description: Der Hubertuslauf in Neuruppin ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die vom Kreissportbund Ostprignitz-Ruppin organisiert wird. Angeboten werden Läufe über 8 und 15 Kilometer, ein 3-km-Firmenlauf sowie ein Walking-Wettbewerb über 8 Kilometer. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Sportler:innen aller Leistungsstufen und findet jährlich statt. Die Strecke führt durch die landschaftlich reizvolle Umgebung von Neuruppin und bietet sowohl Läufern als auch Walkern ein abwechslungsreiches Erlebnis.
course_highlights: Läufe über 8 und 15 Kilometer
3-km-Firmenlauf
Walking-Wettbewerb über 8 Kilometer

name: Müngstener Brückenlauf
description: The Müngstener Brückenlauf is a traditional race in Solingen that passes through scenic landscapes. The course starts on the narrow Schäfchenweg and features one final climb before the finish, passing meadows and fields. The race is organized by Solinger Leichtathletik-Club 1951 e.V. and attracts runners from the region.

name: 52.Maraton Dębno 2026
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dębnie
description: The 52nd Dębno Marathon is the oldest and one of the fastest marathons in Poland. The 42.195 km course, certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), runs through the streets of Dębno and the surrounding area, offering ideal conditions for personal bests. The event has a rich tradition dating back to 1966 and attracts both amateur and professional runners from Poland and abroad. Participants can expect professional organization, numerous refreshment stations, and enthusiastic support from spectators. The marathon is also an opportunity for the running community to come together and a celebration of sport for the whole family.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
description: The XVII Puck Region Half Marathon is a well-known running event in Pomerania, returning in a new format under the STONE TRI & RUN banner. Held in autumn, it offers a refreshed course and a unique atmosphere, serving as the final event in the Puck Running Triad. It’s an ideal opportunity to end the running season on a high note, competing in the half marathon or shorter races and Nordic walking events. The organizers provide participants with comprehensive information and support, including the event schedule, course maps, and baggage-drop areas.
course_highlights: Refreshed half-marathon course measuring 21.097 km
Autumn atmosphere and the final event in the Puck Running Triad
Additional 5 km race and 5 km Nordic walking event
additional: Race office open 15:00–20:00 and 7:00–9:00 on race day at MOKSiR Puck. Baggage drop available 8:00–13:00. Start times: half marathon 10:00, 5 km race 10:05, 5 km Nordic walking 10:07. For children: Mini Kids Run (approx. 400 m) and Mega Kids Run (approx. 800 m) after the half marathon. Winners’ awards ceremony at 13:00.

name: TCS Amsterdam Marathon 2026
location: Olympisch Stadion, Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The TCS Amsterdam Marathon takes place on a fast, flat course with a rich historical background. The start and finish are at the iconic Olympic Stadium, and the route passes along the Amstel, stately townhouses and windmills, and through the green Vondelpark. The event attracts thousands of runners each year and offers an unforgettable experience, with enthusiastic supporters lining the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Olympic Stadium
Route along the Amstel, with beautiful views of townhouses and windmills
Through the city’s green heart: Vondelpark
additional: The marathon is a World Athletics Platinum Label race with a fast course. An official Mizuno race shirt can be ordered, and an international pasta party is available for participants. The 7.5K run takes place on Saturday and finishes at the Olympic Stadium. Special business runs and kids’ runs are also available. Globalrunning.com offers travel packages including entry, accommodation and transport. The event also includes a Kids Run, Heroes Run and charity runs; travel packages are available; registration and ticket resales are handled via the official websites.

name: Turfveld Wintercross 5, 10, en 15 km, Texel
location: De Dennen, Den Burg, Texel, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Turfveld Wintercross in Den Burg on Texel is a challenging cross-country running series held in the wooded De Dennen area near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld. The first race offers several distances, including 14.9 km, 9.8 km, 4.91 km and 0.75 km, with the start on Nattevlakweg. The route follows beautiful, winding forest trails and is suitable for both children and adults. The cross-country race is part of a five-race competition, and participants must take part in at least three races to be included in the standings. The children’s race for ages 12 and under starts at 10:30, and the other participants start at 10:50.
course_highlights: Wooded De Dennen setting with winding trails
The longest distance on 18 October is approximately 14.7 km over 3 laps
Sheltered start area near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld
additional: Registration opens at 9:45 at 't Bospaviljoen Turfveld, Nattevlakweg 2. Cash payment with the exact amount is preferred; otherwise, a payment request will be sent. Children aged 12 and under run 750 metres and start at 10:30; the other distances start at 10:50. 2026–2027 season, multiple distances, course distances from 2 km to 14.7 km, registration from 9:45, location: 't Turfveld, Den Burg.

name: Bunkercross
description: The Bunkercross in Olst is a unique and demanding cross-country race, celebrating its 17th edition as the sporting opener of the Sallands Cross Circuit. The entirely unpaved course takes you over historic command bunkers and through the forests of De Haere estate, an area rich in nature and history. The race attracts a broad field, from regional elites to enthusiastic recreational runners, and offers a challenging, atmospheric start to the cross-country season. Race numbers are handed out at the imposing De Haere Castle, where runners can also enjoy a friendly chat after the race.

name: Zeezichtloop Petten
description: The Zeezichtloop Petten starts and finishes at Plein 1945 in the heart of Petten. The event offers several distances for runners and walkers, including a relaxed 10 or 15 km walk, a challenging 5 km running route completed twice, and a festive Kidsrun for the youngest participants. The course passes through the village centre, along the dike with beautiful sea views, and through dunes and woodland. Steep climbs and loose sand have been avoided to make the course more accessible. The day concludes with award ceremonies and the presentation of the Erik ten Velden Trophy to the fastest Pettemer in the 10 km.

name: Rode Loper Run
description: The Rode Loper Run is a friendly and inclusive running event held in the beautiful Vledderbos in Stadskanaal. The route has been carefully mapped using GPS and offers an enjoyable experience for all ages, whether running fast or at an easy pace. There is no official timekeeping, but every participant receives a medal and refreshments at the finish. The focus is on the atmosphere, and the organizers welcome everyone to enjoy being active in nature together.

name: Mjitte Run
description: Participants can choose from distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, partly along beautiful country roads and paths. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for both recreational and dedicated runners and takes place between 11:30 and 18:00. The Mjitte Run is an annual event that brings the local community together.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 27-28 løp 1 (18. okt)
description: Necon Winter Series is a winter running series consisting of 8 races held at Fana Stadium in Bergen from November to April. The races have a mass start and offer two distances, 5 km and 10 km. Participants can choose their distance during the race at the turnaround point. The start and finish are at Fana Stadium, and the races follow varied terrain, with intermediate times available along the way. The series is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking for a social and challenging winter series.
course_highlights: Mass start for the 5 km and 10 km, with the option to choose a distance during the race
The course starts at Fana Stadium, with turnarounds at Sandsli and Plantasjen in Kokstad
Intermediate times are recorded at 2.5 km, 5 km and 7.5 km for the different distances
additional: Start and finish at Fana Stadium from 18:45. Start waves are based on expected finish times to avoid crossing Grimseidvegen. Wave 0 starts at 18:45 for 10 km runners expecting to finish in over 55 min. Wave 1 starts at 19:00 for 5 km runners expecting to finish in under 22:30 min and 10 km runners expecting to finish in under 45 min. Waves 2–4 start at 2-minute intervals, based on expected finish times. Participants register for the 5 km when signing up; the distance is chosen automatically during the race at the turnaround point.

name: MOLENHOEKS MAKKIE running the hills
location: Molenhoek, Rijk van Nijmegen, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: Molenhoeks Makkie is a trail run in October starting in Molenhoek, located in the Rijk van Nijmegen. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with all routes offering a hilly course rather than a flat road race. With a maximum of 1,400 participants, it offers a more intimate running experience than large city events. The organiser, Stichting Molenhoeks Makkie, provides extensive facilities such as public transport, parking, changing rooms, first aid, AEDs, a supervised cloakroom and massage services.
course_highlights: Hilly course instead of a flat road
Start and finish in Molenhoek, Rijk van Nijmegen
Distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres
additional: Maximum of 1,400 participants. No on-the-day registration is available. Facilities include public transport, parking, changing rooms, first aid, an AED, a supervised cloakroom and massage. Typical October weather is cool and crisp, with an average temperature of 14°C, a minimum of 6°C and 40mm of rainfall. Make sure to register in advance; late registrations are not possible. Facilities such as parking, changing rooms, first aid and massage are available. The event is easily accessible by public transport and offers a friendly, local atmosphere.

name: Herfstloop Twente
location: Atletiek Club TION, Enschede, Overijssel, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16 km, 8 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Herfstloop Twente is one of the oldest running events in the east of the Netherlands, organised since 1976 by Atletiek Club TION in Enschede. The race takes runners through the beautiful countryside near Rutbeek and offers a suitable distance for every runner. In 2026, the 5-mile, 10-mile and half-marathon routes return to their original courses. The 2-mile race, introduced in 2024, is a popular distance for beginner runners and young people. The atmosphere is professional yet informal, with strong involvement from volunteers and sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful natural area near Rutbeek
Original courses for the 5-mile, 10-mile and half-marathon races
The 2-mile distance is suitable for beginner and returning runners, as well as young people
additional: The start and finish are on the track at AC TION. Participation in the 2-mile race is open from age 11. The organising committee consists of 7 people, with more than 50 volunteers on the day. Participants give the Herfstloop an average score of 8. Registration is via the website. Facilities include free parking, with a medal available for €1.50. The event takes place in the natural surroundings of Enschede.

name: KNÆK CANCER LØBET AABYBRO 2026 & ØLAND AFD.
location: Aabybro, Jammerbugt Municipality, North Jutland, Danmark

name: Sydvest Crossløb 2026/27 - afd. 1 - Brørup ved Aquagain
Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is one of Östergötland’s most unique and challenging running races, held at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope in Yxbacken, Norrköping. The race challenges participants with five laps up a hill with 100 metres of elevation gain over 350 metres, for a total distance of approximately 7 kilometres. Whether you run fast or take it easy, everyone is welcome to take part, and the most important thing is to make it to the top. New this year is also a relay, adding an extra dimension to the race. Children can take part for free in the Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C, making it a family-friendly running festival.
course_highlights: Five laps up Yxbacken, with 100 metres of elevation gain over 350 metres per lap
Approximately 7 kilometres in a unique race setting in Östergötland
Start at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope
additional: Race bibs can be collected at XXL on Friday 23 October from 14:00 to 18:00, or at the start and finish area no later than one hour before the start. The bib includes a timing chip, which must be used to record your time. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal sponsored by Energi & Inneklimat. Companies can rent a partner tent at the race venue for team spirit and exposure through Rent a Tent. E2C was title partner for the fourth year in the 2024 edition.

name: VSM terräng
description: The Swedish Cross Country Championships are organised by Västerås FK and the Swedish Athletics Federation at Rocklunda IP in Västerås. The course is 2 km long and consists mostly of grass, with some other surfaces, including fast-running grass and gravel paths. The competition includes several categories, including seniors, youth, masters and para-athletes, with individual races and team competitions. The event also offers the option of pre-booked lunch and good accommodation options close to the venue.
course_highlights: 2 km course consisting mostly of grass, with some other surfaces
Fast-running grass and a 2–3-metre-wide gravel path, crossed four times per lap
Hay-bale obstacles on parts of the course
additional: Race numbers must be collected at the start/finish area at least 60 minutes before the start. Access to the start area opens 10 minutes before the start and closes 2 minutes before. Water is available at the lap point and finish, with Dextrosol at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available at Expandia Arena. Free parking and local buses are available. Clubs may set up their own tents in the designated area. Pre-booked lunch is served at Good Morning Hotels near the venue. Doping tests may be conducted during the competition weekend. The 2026 event took place at Rocklunda IP in Västerås. The organiser’s website states that Västerås FK handed over hosting duties for the 2027 Swedish Cross Country Championships to Mora.

name: Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail
description: Welcome to the second edition of Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail, a unique and exciting running event in the autumn darkness of Kråksångsskogen. The race consists of 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes allowed for each lap. After the sixth lap, runners change direction, adding an extra dimension to the competition. This is a small-scale race with a limited number of places, and a headlamp is mandatory because almost the entire race takes place in the dark. All participants who complete at least one lap receive a beautiful wooden medal, and the winners receive unique winner’s medals.
course_highlights: 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes per lap
Running direction changes after the sixth lap
The course is marked with reflective markers and trail tape; the surface is mostly trails, with approximately 700 metres of gravel
additional: Energy is served during laps 7 and 8 (pizza from a local pizzeria), along with sweets, bananas, crisps, coffee, hot broth, sports drink and water. Facilities are very limited, with self-service energy, a warm fire and approximately 25 sq m of covered shelter. Toilets are outdoors in the forest. Maximum 70 places. Each lap starts every 30 minutes, and anyone who completes a lap faster can rest for the remaining time before the next lap starts. A headlamp and mobile phone are listed as mandatory equipment. The race website lists 70 places.

name: Halloween Night Trail
location: Friluftscentrum Karlsnäs, Ronneby, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Halloween Night Trail is an exciting night trail race in the Karlsnäs area north of Ronneby, with distances of 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The race offers a unique Halloween atmosphere, with themed features such as Zombie Hill, Count Dracula’s abode and the Bat Cave along the course. The event venue is at Friluftscentrum Karlsnäs, where the finish is indoors. After the race, grilled hamburgers and drinks are served and included in the entry fee. The race is organised by Ronneby Orienteering Club, which has extensive experience organising major orienteering competitions.
course_highlights: Run along small trails and through terrain, with reflectors showing the way in the dark
Themed features such as Zombie Hill, the Cemetery, Count Dracula’s abode and the Bat Cave
The finish area is indoors at Karlsnäs outdoor recreation centre
additional: Electronic timing for 5 km and 10 km; no timing for 2 km. Race bibs and chips can be collected at the venue from 17:00. The awards ceremony is provisionally scheduled for 20:45. Shoes with good grip and a headlamp are recommended. Parents can run with children in the 2 km race without registering. All participants receive a specially designed medal. The entry fee includes a hamburger and a drink. Electronic timing is offered for the 5 km and 10 km races, but not the 2 km race. The finish area is indoors.

name: Rosa Sløyfe-løpet Oslo lørdag
organizer: Kreftforeningen og Brystkreftforeningen, i samarbeid med Springtime Group
price_range: 500 kr + 30 kr i administrasjonsgebyr og 3 % transaksjonsgebyr; Mini er gratis

description: Rosa Sløyfe-løpet Oslo is an annual race held in support of the Pink Ribbon campaign. On Saturday, the event offers a short untimed course from Nedre Foss gård to Nydalen. On Sunday, participants can choose between timed 5 km and 10 km races, starting and finishing at Rådhusplassen. The course passes through some of Oslo’s most iconic areas, including Aker Brygge, Tjuvholmen and Akershus Fortress, offering an urban and atmospheric experience. The event is for everyone, whether you want to race for a time, run with colleagues or simply be part of the sea of pink.
course_highlights: Course through Aker Brygge, Tjuvholmen and Akershus Fortress
Start and finish at Rådhusplassen in central Oslo
Urban, atmospheric course with beautiful views
additional: Saturday’s short course is untimed and suitable for anyone looking for a more relaxed experience. The race packet includes a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal. Pacers will be available for Sunday’s 5 km and 10 km races at different paces to help participants maintain a steady speed. Race bibs can be collected in advance or from two hours before the start on race day. Participants are insured through a licence provided by the Norwegian Athletics Federation, and half of the entry fee goes directly to the Pink Ribbon campaign. Timing is available for the 5 km and 10 km. The free Mini Run, approximately 400 metres, is for children aged 3 to 9. The participant package includes a race bib, neck warmer, bag and medal.

name: Bergen Maraton- Maratonkarusellen
organizer: Maratonkarusellen i samarbeid med BFG Bergen Løpeklubb

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Prisene øker med kr 50,- to uker før løpsdagen
