description: Bergen Marathon will be held for the 40th time on Saturday, October 23, 2027, starting and finishing at Fana Stadium in Bergen. The race is part of Maratonkarusellen, which offers both a full and a half marathon, and aims to ensure that all participants enjoy themselves despite the challenges of the race. Maratonkarusellen works with BFG Bergen Running Club and places great emphasis on the quality of its events. The minimum age for the marathon is 18.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Events include both a full and a half marathon
Organized in cooperation with BFG Bergen Running Club
additional: Kondis members receive a NOK 50 discount. A year-long license from the Norwegian Athletics Association can be provided to avoid the one-time license fee. Those without a license must purchase a one-time license. The event offers a half marathon and a marathon. The listed prices apply to the 2026 edition and may change before the 2027 race.

name: Backyard Sandefjord Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Backyard Deltakere kr 750,00 + Adm. gebyr (25 NOK + 3% transaksjonsgebyr)

description: Backyard Sandefjord is a unique ultrarun being held for the 14th time in 2027. The race consists of a slightly hilly loop of approximately 6.7 km, run every hour on the hour, with a maximum of 12 laps in total. Participants must start each lap to continue, and the last runner to start the final lap is declared the winner. The event has a social focus and a low participation threshold, and offers facilities such as snacks, hot drinks and places to rest in the hall. Everyone who completes 12 laps receives a cup, and those who reach the ultradistance receive a Norwegian-made wooden medal.
course_highlights: Slightly hilly loop of approx. 6.7 km
The course is marked with yellow arrow signs, red marker flags and white arrows on asphalt
Maximum of 12 laps, 80.4 km in total if completed
additional: Participants must bring their own cup, headlamp and reflective vest. Race bib collection is Friday 17:00–18:30 and Saturday 08:30–09:30. Support is only permitted outdoors. Snacks, coffee, sweet tea, broth, cold/hot water and hot dogs are available after the 7th lap. Participants must bring their own chair; there is no room for sun loungers. Enter through the large gate at the back of the hall; parking is available. Start and finish at Runarhallen, Klavenesveien 20. Maximum 350 participants.

name: Fredrikstad Multiconsult Maraton 2027
description: The Fredrikstad Multiconsult Marathon takes place in Fredrikstad and consists of three identical 14 km laps, followed by an extra 195-metre finishing section so that the kilometre markers are in the same place on each lap. The course starts and finishes at FIF-huset and includes asphalt, gravel and forest roads in Fredrikstadmarka. There are aid stations along the route with water, squash and sports drink, as well as cola and bananas on the final laps. The race has been held since 2001 and offers a varied, scenic course with marshals at important intersections.
course_highlights: The course consists of three 14 km laps, plus an extra 195 metres to ensure the kilometre markers are in the same place on each lap
The first half is on asphalt; the rest is on gravel and forest roads in Fredrikstadmarka
Three aid stations per lap with a range of drinks and food
additional: An early start at 10:00 is available for runners who expect to take more than 5 hours. The race office and bib collection open at 09:00 on race day at FIF-huset. Parking is at Stjernehallen, about a 5-minute walk from the start/finish. Changing rooms and toilets are available at FIF-huset. There are no pacers during the race. Online registration is open until 1 hour before the start. There are three aid stations per lap. The race office, changing rooms and toilets are at FIF-huset; parking is at Stjernehallen.

name: Helberhäuser HauBerg-Lauf
description: The Helberhäuser HauBerg-Lauf is a traditional race taking place for the 29th time. The event is organized by TSG Helberhausen and features an adjusted course that runs over two laps of the well-known route. The race is part of the Rothaar Laufserie and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in the Hilchenbach region. TSG Helberhausen is a versatile sports club with a wide range of activities, and organizes the race as one of its many popular events.
course_highlights: Two laps of the well-known HauBerg-Lauf course
Part of the Rothaar Laufserie
A traditional race in the Hilchenbach region
additional: The course was adjusted for 2025. The event is part of the diverse sports program offered by TSG Helberhausen, which has more than 20 departments and offers a wide range of sports. The 2026 anniversary features a special course layout, with all runners running the courses in reverse. The event offers a variety of competitions, including children's races and Nordic walking, and takes place on a challenging, hilly course.

name: Nordwalder Laufspektakel
description: The Nordwalde Running Spectacle is a popular running event with various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as children’s races. It takes place annually in Nordwalde and attracts numerous runners looking forward to a sporting challenge. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good organisation. It offers suitable running options for competitive runners, families and children alike.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon
Children’s races over 1 km and 2 km
Participant and course records for the 5 km and half marathon
additional: The event takes place annually and offers children’s races alongside the main distances. It combines a sporting challenge with a family-friendly atmosphere. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. The event takes place in Nordwalde, with more than 800 participants at the last edition, including record-breaking times and food and drink.

name: KRC Van Elderen Stadshagenrun 2026
distance_verbose: 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1.6 km, 1500 meter, 0.8 km, 0.7 km

name: Veluwse Winter Competitie

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Stuurbordje nodig à € 5,00 voor de hele competitie

description: The Veluwe Winter Competition 2026-2027 is an accessible mountain bike competition held on a variety of challenging and varied courses in the Veluwe region, including Nunspeet, Soest, Oldebroek, Apeldoorn, Deventer, Harderwijk, Ede/Lunteren and Zutphen. Races are timed and consist of multiple laps, making them suitable for experienced recreational mountain bikers. The competition comprises up to 9 races and is open to participants with a KNWU or NTFU licence, with enjoyment and sportsmanship at its heart.
course_highlights: Varied courses in and around the Veluwe
Timed races with 5 to 10 laps
An easier B-line is available on difficult sections
additional: The races begin with a draw to determine the first starting rows at Nunspeet and Soest; from Oldebroek onwards, riders are lined up according to the current standings. The starting order of categories 8 & 9 and 10 & 11 alternates from race to race. A transponder is required and is attached to the handlebar plate. Races are timed rather than distance-based and last 5 to 10 laps. The best 5 results count towards the overall standings. A day licence is no longer required; participation without a licence is at your own risk. Registration is via inschrijven.nl and is also possible on-site, with mobile payment or cash. The competition includes several events in autumn and winter at locations such as Nunspeet, Soest, Oldebroek, Apeldoorn, Deventer, Harderwijk, Ede / Lunteren and Zutphen. Registration is handled via email, and detailed route information is available. Live results are displayed on the website.

name: All4running Crosscircuit
description: The All4running Crosscircuit is a series of five challenging cross-country races held in North Holland at various locations, including Hoorn, Wieringerwerf, Den Helder and Spierdijk. The races vary in distance and are suitable for a range of age categories, from juniors to seniors. Participants can register for the entire circuit or for individual races. The circuit offers a sporty and friendly atmosphere, with a ranking and attractive prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Varied courses in wooded areas and sports park settings
A range of distances for juniors and adults, from 1,000 metres to 10,000 metres
Races at various locations in North Holland, including Risdammerhout and Dijkgatbos
additional: You can register for the entire circuit or for an individual race. Participants must return their chip after the race to avoid additional costs. A points system determines the final ranking, with the best four results counting and bonus points awarded for taking part in all five races. Found items are kept for 14 days by the organising club. Final prize categories are divided by age and gender. Cross-country races in Hoorn, Wieringermeer and Spierdijk; registration available on race day; return your chip and prizes awarded to top finishers.

name: Battle of the Zekskes
description: The Battle of the Zekskes is the very first Cornhole tournament in Velden, an accessible and sociable game in which teams of at least four people throw beanbags at a wooden board to score points. The event takes place on 18 October 2025 and is organized by Sportvereniging Velden. Alongside the sporting competition, an evening celebration is also planned, making it a fun combination of competition and socializing for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Accessible cornhole game with beanbags and wooden boards
Teams of at least 4 people
Held at Theo Lommen Sportpark in Velden
additional: The minimum age to participate is 16. An evening celebration is planned after the tournament. Teams consist of at least 4 people. Cornhole game, teams of at least 4 people, evening celebration after the tournament

name: Nacht van de Nacht wandeling
description: The Night of the Night walk in Breda is a special experience where you walk in silence through the darkness and enjoy the natural nighttime surroundings. During the walk, you can experience the peace and quiet and, weather permitting, a beautiful starry sky. The activity highlights the importance of darkness and combating light pollution, and is suitable for a broad audience who enjoy nature and quiet.
course_highlights: Walk in complete darkness
Experience silence and nature at night
Possibility of seeing stars in clear skies
additional: The Night of the Night includes various activities such as walks, boat trips, stargazing and lectures. Some activities are wheelchair-friendly and suitable for children. Participants can sign up via an online form. The campaign aims to raise awareness of light pollution and the importance of darkness for nature and health. Various activities include stargazing, walks, boat trips and lectures, focusing on darkness and the nighttime experience.

name: Sønderjysk Crossløb 2026/27 - Cup tilmelding alle løb
Yddingeloppet
description: Yddingeloppet is one of Skåne’s largest cross-country races, held in the beautiful and challenging terrain of Bokskogen, Torup, outside Malmö. The race always takes place on the last Sunday in October, with the start and finish at Torups Friluftsgård. There are recreational classes over 6 km and 12 km, as well as a 6 km walking/pole-walking event, and competitive classes for different age groups and veteran classes. All participants receive a race bib with a timing chip and a medal at the finish. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in the competitive classes, and winners in the veteran classes have their prizes mailed to them.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Bokskogen, Torup, beautiful in autumn
Two distances: 6 km and 12 km
Start and finish at Torups Friluftsgård
additional: Race bibs with timing chips are provided to all participants except those in the walking and pole-walking events. Race bibs can be collected at the office during the week before the race or on race day from 8:30 a.m. until one hour before the start. The awards ceremony for places 1–3 in the 6 km and 12 km women’s and men’s competitive classes is at approximately 12:30 p.m. The start and finish area has parking and good public transport connections via buses 150 and 148. Carpooling is recommended. The race has previously been held in late October.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is a longstanding running race celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026. The race is organized by Boxholm-Ekeby Ski Club and takes place at Boxholm’s ski stadium. It is a popular event for runners of all ages and abilities, with a beautiful and challenging course. More information and registration will be available closer to race day.
course_highlights: Scenic route around the Sjögarp area
Challenging 14 km course, with a course profile available
The race takes place at Boxholm’s ski stadium
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. Links are available to the invitation, race information, start list, and preliminary results from previous years. The course profile and a course map are available to runners. Gathering is scheduled for 09:30.

name: Hindås Trail
description: Hindås Trail is a running festival held on beautiful recreational trails in Hindås. Participants can choose between a 1 km race for children and 5 km or 15 km distances for adults. It’s a race for those who want to run fast, as well as a lovely run for those who prioritise the experience. At the finish, participants are treated to coffee and chocolate biscuits, and hot dogs and a more substantial fika are also available to buy. All proceeds go directly to Hindås’s popular cross-country skiing activities.
course_highlights: Beautiful recreational trails in Hindås
A 1 km children’s race on an easier course
Choose between 5 km and 15 km distances
additional: Hot dogs and a more substantial fika are available to buy at a good price. All proceeds from Hindås Trail go directly to the skiing activities. Coffee and chocolate biscuits are included after the finish. Hot dogs and a more substantial fika have been available for purchase. The proceeds go to Hindås Ski Club’s cross-country skiing activities.

name: Löfstad Slott Trail
description: Löfstad Castle Trail is an atmospheric trail race held in the autumn darkness around the historic Löfstad Castle. The race offers a unique running experience as participants run through the castle park, along forest trails and over unmarked terrain lit by headlamps. The event consists of two races: the Little Twilight Race for children in the park and Löfstad’s Darkest, a 7-kilometre night race for adults. Löfstad Castle Trail combines nature, history and community in a beautiful and challenging setting.
course_highlights: 7 km night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain
The course is marked with reflectors and course tape
Little Twilight Race: 1,000 metres in the park, with no timing
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 15:00 at the castle courtyard. Löfstad’s Darkest starts at 17:00 and requires a headlamp and trail shoes. The Little Twilight Race is a children’s race with no timing, and all participants receive a prize. The joint awards ceremony takes place after the races. On-site registration is available. Parking is available up to 500 metres from the castle. A headlamp is mandatory for the 7 km race, and trail shoes are recommended. The children’s race is untimed. The start and finish are at Löfstad Castle.

name: Ottestad løpsfestival
description: Ottestad Running Festival is organized by Ottestad Idrettslag and consists of three races: HOKA Ottestad Rundt over 17 kilometers, the Spenst Run over 5 kilometers, and the Sport1 Sprint for children, with distances of 400 meters, 1 km, and 1.8 km. The race starts and finishes at Ottestad Idrettspark, which has excellent facilities, including a café, refreshments, changing rooms, and showers. The course follows Ottestadstien, a scenic hiking trail through a cultural landscape of wooded areas and farmland, with beautiful views of Mjøsa. The event is family-friendly and offers both timed and recreational races.
course_highlights: The course follows Ottestadstien through a cultural landscape of wooded areas and farmland
Fantastic views of Mjøsa during the race
Start and finish at Ottestad Idrettspark, with a café and changing-room facilities
additional: The HOKA Sprint is a separate 430-meter segment on the 17 km course where participants can compete to be the fastest on Strava and win HOKA shoes. The segment has its own refreshment station, music, and spectators. A one-time race license is an additional cost for those without an annual license, and athletes up to age 12 are covered by NIF's child sports insurance. The 5 km and 17 km races can be run with or without timing. Listed prices apply to 2026, and a one-time race license is an additional cost where applicable.

name: Norgestesten 2027 3
description: Norgestesten is an efficient and inclusive running event held at Jessheim Athletics Stadium. The race offers distances ranging from an 800-metre children’s race to a half marathon, all with a mass start on a flat, fast 3,146-metre loop course. Many experienced pacers help participants find the right pace, and the event prioritises simple logistics, with parking and the train station nearby. Proceeds support sports for children and young people, and self-service bib collection is available from 09:00 on race day.
course_highlights: Flat 3,146-metre loop course
Mass start for all distances
Many experienced pacers available
additional: The children’s race starts at 09:30 and is approximately 800 metres long. Self-service bib collection is available from 09:00 in the start area. Toilets are available at Jessheim Athletics Stadium and in the ice rink and multi-purpose hall. Tables are provided for runners’ own drinks at the start, along with water and sports drinks along the course. The half-marathon cut-off time is 2 hours and 30 minutes. The race is organised by volunteers, and proceeds support sports for children and young people.

name: Glauchauer Herbstlauf
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinschaft Glauchau e.V. und Kreissportbund Zwickau
description: The Glauchau Autumn Run is a long-standing running event in Glauchau, held annually in autumn since 1986. The event offers courses for runners of all ages and ability levels, including a half marathon, 10 km, 3.2 km and 1.1 km races, as well as walking and Nordic walking. The routes pass through the scenic surrounding area on asphalt and paved paths, including by the reservoir and castle pond. The event is a sporting highlight for the region and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running to experience autumn actively.
course_highlights: 21.1 km flat scenic run with 75% asphalt and 25% paved paths
10 km route with 25% asphalt and 75% paved paths around the reservoir and castle pond
3.2 km and 1.1 km loops around the grounds of the Sachsenlandhalle Glauchau
additional: Half-marathon time limit: 2:45 h. Checkpoint at km 14.3 (reservoir pavilion) must be passed by 12 noon; otherwise, disqualification with a shortened finish route. Race bib includes a baggage tag and raffle ticket. Recommended parking: Kaufland, Grenayer Straße.

name: Ottensteiner Wottellauf
description: The Ottenstein Wottellauf is a long-standing running event held annually in Ottenstein near Ahaus. The event offers various races for children and adults, including 10 km, 5 km, and several shorter children’s races. The races start at Sportplatz 1, 48683 Ahaus-Ottenstein, and are known for their friendly atmosphere and well-organized event. All participants receive certificates, medals, and trophies, making the race especially appealing to runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportplatz 1 in Ahaus-Ottenstein
A range of distances from 200 m to 10 km
Friendly atmosphere with awards for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective start. Showers and changing rooms are available at the venue. An unattended bag drop is available. Certificates are provided online. Trophies are awarded to places 1–3 in the 5 km and 10 km races. Every child receives a medal. Prizes are awarded to the largest group. Photos and videos are taken during the event and used for press and social media. Registration until 23.10.2025, start times from 11:05, showers and changing rooms available, photos and videos during the event

name: Volkswaldlauf des MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt
description: The Volkswaldlauf of MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt takes place in Winsen-Borstel. The event offers distances ranging from short children’s races to a challenging 20.3 km course, making it ideal for families as well as runners looking for a longer distance. The start and finish are at the Am Habichtshorst sports facility on Heidlandsweg, which serves as the central meeting point. The race is part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup and promises a varied route through natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.5 km to 20.3 km
Start and finish at the Am Habichtshorst sports facility
Event held as part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup
additional: The event is aimed at families and runners of all ages. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The Am Habichtshorst sports facility is the central meeting point for runners. Distances: 0.5 km to 20.3 km, including children’s races; central meeting point at the Am Habichtshorst sports facility; October weather: approx. 14 °C, 6 °C low, 40 mm precipitation, cloudy.

name: Winterlauf-/Wanderserie TuS Jaderberg 1.Teil
description: Die Winterlauf- und Wanderserie des TuS Jaderberg ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die in der Region Jaderberg stattfindet. Sie bietet Läufern und Wanderern die Möglichkeit, in der kalten Jahreszeit aktiv zu bleiben und gemeinsam Sport zu treiben. Die Serie umfasst mehrere Läufe, die sowohl für Freizeit- als auch für ambitionierte Läufer geeignet sind. Die Veranstaltung ist fest in der Vereinsarbeit des TuS Jaderberg verankert und fördert die Gemeinschaft und den Breitensport.
course_highlights: Lauf- und Wanderstrecken in der naturnahen Umgebung von Jaderberg
Geeignet für alle Alters- und Leistungsklassen
Teil einer mehrteiligen Winterlaufserie
additional: Die Winterlaufserie sucht aktuell Nachfolger für die Organisation. Es gibt keine expliziten Angaben zu Startzeiten, Preisen oder Anmeldemöglichkeiten auf den verfügbaren Seiten.

name: 35. Ricklinger Volkslauf / Ricklinger Volkslauf
location: Meisenwinkel 9, Hannover-Ricklingen, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Ricklingen Volkslauf is a local race day in Hannover-Ricklingen, organized by TuS Ricklingen. It offers flat runs for adults over approximately 5.5 to 5.7 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking over the same distance. The main event is the 10 km Lothar-Mayer-Lauf. There is also a 400 m Bambini run for the youngest participants and a 1 km schoolchildren’s run, allowing families and club runners to take part together while being grouped by age category.
course_highlights: Flat courses in Hannover-Ricklingen
Runs for adults and children, plus walking and Nordic walking
Finish at Meisenwinkel 9 in Hannover-Ricklingen
additional: Running and walking events are organized by distance and age category. All events finish at the same location. The event takes place in Hannover-Ricklingen, with the start and finish at Meisenwinkel 9. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various running options, including walking and children’s races.

name: 44. Zerbster Rolandlauf
description: The 44th Zerbster Roland Run is a traditional fun run in Zerbst, Saxony-Anhalt, with the start and finish at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium. The event takes place on a Sunday in October and is organized by the athletics department of TSV Rot-Weiß Zerbst. Various distances are offered for all age groups, from short children’s races to 10 kilometers for adults. The course consists of a flat 5-kilometer loop on roads and mixed terrain, which also passes through the stadium. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop on roads and mixed terrain
The course passes through the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Separate categories for children, youth, adults, and seniors. Typical October weather: around 14 °C, mostly cloudy, with about 40 mm of precipitation. The race also supports Anhalt Hospice Zerbst and is organized as a community fun run, with medals and certificates.

name: Gütersloher DJK Halbmarathon
description: Der Gütersloher DJK-Halbmarathon ist eine etablierte Laufveranstaltung in Gütersloh, die neben dem Halbmarathon auch 5- und 10-km-Straßenläufe anbietet. Die Strecken sind offiziell nach IAAF/AIMS vermessen und damit bestenlistentauglich. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Läufer aller Leistungsniveaus und bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit Ehrungen für die schnellsten Teilnehmer in verschiedenen Altersklassen. Die Siegerehrung findet zeitnah nach den Läufen im Zelt statt, und Urkunden können online heruntergeladen werden.
course_highlights: Offiziell vermessene Halbmarathon-Strecke nach IAAF/AIMS
5- und 10-km-Straßenläufe als zusätzliche Wettbewerbe
Bestechend familiäre Atmosphäre mit Ehrungen für die schnellsten Läufer
additional: Parkplätze stehen an der Hauptschule Nord, Ahornallee zur Verfügung. Die Siegerehrungen erfolgen schnellstmöglich nach den Läufen im Zelt. Urkunden können auf der Website des Zeitnehmers www.timeteam-jung.de heruntergeladen werden. Für Unfälle, Diebstähle und sonstige Schadensfälle übernimmt der Veranstalter keine Haftung.

name: Porzellinerlauf
location: Sportplatz Am Dohlenstein, Kahla, Thüringen, Germany
description: The Porzellinerlauf Kahla is a traditional autumn road race starting and finishing at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground in Kahla, Thuringia. The 13 km race is the main event, alongside shorter children’s and youth races, making the day appealing to both families and regular runners. Organised by SV 1910 Kahla e.V. since 1971, the race combines a sporting challenge with the local porcelain tradition. Regional timekeepers oversee the course, which receives particularly positive feedback for its route.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground
13 km main race, with shorter children’s and youth races
Route through Kahla with a connection to its porcelain tradition
additional: The field is modest, with around 101 to 300 runners and more than one hundred finishers in recent editions. Typical November weather in Kahla is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. Timing is provided by regional timekeepers. The race has been established since 1971 and regularly attracts between 101 and 300 participants. The course is known for its good condition and attractive surroundings. The event also includes refreshments, showers and an awards ceremony.

name: VR Bank Westküsten Herbstlauf Schafstedt
description: The VR Bank Westküsten Autumn Run Schafstedt is an autumn running event in Schafstedt, Schleswig-Holstein, taking place for the 38th time in 2026. Distances include 3 km, 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 5 km walking route. The event welcomes adults and younger participants and fosters a family-friendly atmosphere with children’s and youth races. The routes pass through the autumn landscape in the fresh air and offer an alternative to city runs.
course_highlights: The 3 km route is flat
The 5 km run and 5 km walk include some hills
All races finish at the same finish line
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Typical October weather in Schafstedt is around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event also includes walking options and is aimed at families and young people. October weather is generally mild, with temperatures around 6–14 °C, creating ideal conditions for an autumn run.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: PKO Sopot Half Marathon is an annual running event held in the seaside city of Sopot, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half marathon course runs through the city’s picturesque streets, offering exceptional views and the atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city. The finish line is at ERGO Arena, adding a distinctive character and sporting spirit to the event. It is also an opportunity for families to celebrate sport together, with numerous accompanying races for different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: A seaside course through the streets of Sopot
Finish line at ERGO Arena—a unique place to cross the finish
The atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city, attracting runners and spectators
additional: The event also includes accompanying races such as the Half Marathon Relay, the 5 km Run, and races for children and juniors. The race pack includes a medal and other merchandise. The finish at ERGO Arena provides a unique atmosphere and comfort for participants. The organizer also offers the “Run, Be Ready” training plan for those preparing for the race.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja jesienna 2026
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema is a unique night road race in Koszalin, offering three distances: 7 km, a half marathon, and a marathon. The course runs through the city streets, with the start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium. The race has official PZLA certification, ensuring accurate course measurement and the possibility of setting records. The event has a one-of-a-kind atmosphere, with a laser start at 2:00 a.m. highlighting its unique nocturnal character. Participants can expect excellent organization, attractive prizes, and keepsakes.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course, confirming accurate measurement
A loop of approximately 7 km, completed multiple times depending on the distance
Start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium in Koszalin
additional: The race starts at 2:00 a.m. with a laser start. The race office for children and young people is located at the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall. The course runs through the streets of Koszalin, with views of exhibits at the aviation museum. After each distance, children receive gifts and prizes directly at the stadium. The course is undulating, and runners can rest at the stadium, which the loop passes through.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
description: The Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Dolnej Doliny Wisły is an annual running event held in Tczew County. The event features two races: a PZLA-certified marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.097 km. The routes pass through the scenic Vistula Valley, over a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces, with traffic restricted during the race. The start and finish are located in Tczew, and the event attracts runners from various regions, offering professional organization and clearly marked routes.
course_highlights: A PZLA-certified 42.195 km marathon through Tczew and nearby towns
A 21.097 km half marathon on an asphalt-and-gravel route
The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals; traffic is restricted during the race
additional: The participant limit is 400 paid entrants. The marathon starts at 09:00 at the School Complex of Construction and Clothing in Tczew; the half marathon starts at 11:00 at the Primary School in Małe Walichnowy. The start line closes 15 minutes after the start. The marathon course is PZLA-certified; the half marathon course is not. The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals.

name: II Jesienny Bieg Charytatywny Artbud Group – Biegniemy dla Rodzin Zastępczych
XIV Pętla Krosowa Grodziskiego Klubu Biegacza
Diepe Hel Holterbergloop 2026

name: Vechtstreek in Beweging Lopen
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 20 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km

name: Out of Office Coffee x Running Amsterdam x ADE
description: Out of Office Coffee x Running Amsterdam x ADE is a social running clinic held on the last Sunday of October, starting and finishing at Out Of Office Coffee in Westergas, Amsterdam. The event begins at 11:00 with running drills focusing on technique and speed, followed by a group run accompanied by music. This event celebrates the final day of 30 years of the Amsterdam Dance Event, combining sport and music in a unique and enjoyable way.
course_highlights: Starts and finishes at Out Of Office Coffee, Westergas
Includes running drills focusing on technique and speed
Group run with music accompaniment
additional: The event is a running clinic open to everyone, emphasizing social participation and enjoyment. It is part of the Amsterdam Dance Event festival program and celebrates the event's 30th anniversary. The venue Out Of Office Coffee is open Fri - Sun 10 - 17 and Tue - Thu 09 - 16. Participants can enjoy a relaxed run combined with music and a convivial atmosphere, perfect for both recreational runners and fans of the dance festival.

name: Dobbeloop
distance_verbose: 20 km, 15 km, 12 km, 10 km, 6 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 1500 meter, 0.8 km

name: Duinentrail Schoorl
description: The DYNAFIT Duinentrail Schoorl 2026 is a challenging trail run through the beautiful dune area around Schoorl, Bergen, Hargen and Camperduin, featuring the highest dune peaks in the Netherlands. The trails range from 12 km to 50 km and include a swim trail and various kids’ trails. All routes start and finish at Laguna Beach. The combination of dunes and coast makes for a unique and varied running experience, with October weather conditions adding an extra challenge. This 14th edition offers a perfect location for both runners and supporters.
course_highlights: Trail through the highest dune area in the Netherlands
Varied terrain with hills, narrow paths and mud
Start and finish at Laguna Beach, right on the beach
additional: There is a test run/course preview on 17 September. The start and finish location is ideal for runners and supporters. Participants should have experience with off-road terrain and be in good physical condition. Participation is at your own risk. Trail, Swim Trail, beach activities, two-day programme, various distances, start and finish at Laguna Beach Schoorl

name: Parkcross Hoorn
location: De Blauwe Berg, Hoorn, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Parkcross in Hoorn, organised by A.V. Hollandia, is an annual cross-country race held at the De Blauwe Berg sports complex. The race is part of the All4running Crosscircuit and attracts both youth and senior runners. The Parkcross offers a challenging course in a park-like setting, suitable for runners of different levels. The organisers are known for their hospitality and good facilities for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in a park-like setting
Challenging terrain with natural features
Suitable for youth, juniors, seniors and masters
additional: Registration is via Atletiek.nu. The event takes place at the De Blauwe Berg sports complex in Hoorn. The cross-country race is held in Risdammerhout neighbourhood park; registration is also possible on the day. The course features mud and hills, and the venue is at Sportpark de Blauwe Berg.

name: Zeemijlenloop Delfzijl
description: The Zeemijlenloop Delfzijl is a unique running event held annually in October, and in 2026 it will celebrate its fourteenth edition. The main distance is 4 nautical miles (7.408 km), taking runners past green spaces, the sea, the harbour, the beach and historic sites in Delfzijl. The race starts at the athletics track and finishes at Molen Adam in the town centre. In addition to the individual 4 Zeemijlenloop, there is a corporate run and a kids’ run, making the event suitable for a range of participants. The race has a strong regional character but attracts participants from across the Netherlands. The course is wide, varied and distinctive because its distance is measured in nautical miles.
course_highlights: 7.408 km route past the sea, harbour, beach and green spaces
Starts at the Burgemeester Boeremalaan athletics track and finishes at Molen Adam in central Delfzijl
Passes historic sites such as the statue of Maigret and the Damsterdiep
additional: Race numbers can be collected on Saturday evening and Sunday morning at the AV Fivelstreek clubhouse and in central Delfzijl. Late registration is not available for the 4 Zeemijlenloop. The prize-giving takes place after the races. There is a party tent and a post-race gathering after the corporate run. The event takes place in October, with start and registration points at the athletics track and in central Delfzijl, and includes various race categories.

name: Jan de Vos Najaarscross
location: Kralingse Bos, Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Jan de Vos Autumn Cross is a challenging cross-country race held in Kralingse Bos in Rotterdam. It is organised by PAC Rotterdam, the oldest athletics club in the Netherlands. The course runs along natural paths with hills, bushes and tree trunks, making for a varied and demanding running experience. The cross is suitable for participants of all ages and attracts many enthusiastic runners each year.
course_highlights: Start at the Beachhouse by the beach in Kralingse Bos
Includes a hill behind the petting zoo
Natural obstacles such as bushes, tree trunks and slippery paths
additional: The cross consists of two laps of approximately 4 kilometres. The race is suitable for participants aged 17 to 70 and over. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and an opportunity to chat over a drink. The aim for next year is to also offer a shorter distance of approximately 4 km for younger athletes. The event takes place in the Kralingse Bos area, a popular location for running races in Rotterdam.

name: Het Achtje van Atledo
description: Achtje van Atledo is a running event organized by Atletiek- en Trimvereniging Atledo in Dongen. Atledo is a large and active club with a modern athletics track and a wide range of training sessions for all ages and levels. The event takes place in a green sports area along the canal and offers a sporty, welcoming atmosphere for both competitive and recreational runners. The club is known for its expert guidance and focus on injury prevention.
course_highlights: Modern athletics track with good grip and cushioning
Located in a green sports area along the canal
Facilities for various athletics disciplines in addition to running
additional: Atledo offers training for all ages and levels, including a 'Run for Fun' program for beginner runners and an 'Ouderen in Beweging' program.

name: Strand TIEN cross
description: The cross-country event offers both a long distance of approximately 10 km and a short distance of approximately 5 km, as well as special youth races over shorter distances. The races are suitable for runners of all levels and ages, giving participants the chance to test themselves against others, pursue personal goals, and enjoy running in nature. Anyone who takes part in at least four races has a chance to place in the final standings.
course_highlights: Off-road courses in and around Oss
Distances of approximately 5 km and 10 km
Special youth races over shorter distances
additional: The cross-country series consists of six races. Taking part in at least four races in the same category qualifies participants for a place in the final standings. The races take place on Sunday mornings and are welcoming and small-scale. There is a youth race for younger runners. You can get in touch via WhatsApp or SMS on 06 37 30 12 02. The race is part of a series of six small-scale, accessible running events in Oss, with registration via www.inschrijven.nl.

name: Craft x Luyckx Sport Oercross
location: Former US Military Terrain, Havelterberg, Netherlands
description: The Craft x Luyckx Sport OER cross is a challenging cross-country race organised for the seventh time by AV De Sprinter. The race takes place on the wooded, hilly training grounds of the former US base in Havelterberg. The OER cross is part of the prestigious Athletics Union Cross Country Series and serves as a qualifying race for the European Cross Country Championships. Various distances are offered for young people and adults, divided by age category.
course_highlights: Wooded, hilly training grounds of the Ministry of Defence’s Havelte-West site
Located on the former US base in Havelterberg
Part of the Cross Country Series and a European Cross Country Championships qualifying race
additional: Parking is permitted only in the car park of Darper Voetbal- en Sportvereniging; parking on the Ministry of Defence training grounds is prohibited. Flying a drone during the event is strictly prohibited. Test runs are organised in collaboration with Craft and Luyckx Sport to try out the course and new shoes. The OER cross is one of four top races that count towards the national cross-country standings. The event takes place at the former US base in Havelterberg, with registration via Inschrijven.nl. The site is known for its challenging, hilly and wooded surroundings. Parking is available at Darper Voetbal- en Sportvereniging. Drone use is not permitted during the event.

name: 24. Röntgenlauf
description: Der Röntgenlauf in Remscheid ist ein traditionsreicher Landschaftslauf mit verschiedenen Streckenlängen von Crossläufen über 5 km und 10 km Läufe bis hin zu Halbmarathon, Marathon und Ultramarathon. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch ihre abwechslungsreichen Strecken aus, die teilweise den Röntgenweg abdecken, und bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit Shuttle-Service und Verpflegung. Besonders der Halbmarathon ist mit bis zu 1500 Teilnehmern einer der größten Landschaftsläufe in Deutschland. Finisher erhalten eine hochwertige Schiefermedaille, die vor Ort graviert werden kann.
course_highlights: Halbmarathon deckt ca. ein Drittel des Röntgenwegs ab mit ca. 405 m Anstieg und 560 m Gefälle
Marathon umfasst die beiden letzten Drittel des Röntgenwegs mit ca. 960 m Anstieg und 820 m Gefälle
Streckenänderung im Bereich Freibad Eschbachtal wegen Großbaustelle mit neuem Streckenverlauf
additional: Shuttlebusse bringen Läufer vom Ziel zurück zum Start bzw. zum Startbereich. Kleidertransport vom Start zum Ziel ist möglich. Umweltfreundliche Mehrwegtrinkbecher werden empfohlen, Becher an Verpflegungsstellen vorhanden. Medaillengravur vor Ort für 3,00 € möglich. Teilnahme am Halbmarathon erst ab 16 Jahren, Marathon ab 18 Jahren. Startunterlagen für Marathon bitte vorab im Sportzentrum Hackenberg abholen.

name: 41e BAX Halve Marathon van Doetinchem
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 7.5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km

name: Heemstedeloop
location: Sportparklaan and Landgoed Groenendaal, Heemstede, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Heemstede Loop takes place in Heemstede and offers an enjoyable running experience through the beautiful Groenendaalse Bos and the lively town of Heemstede. Participants are cheered on by enthusiastic spectators and entertained along the way by live music from bands and DJs, creating a festive atmosphere. There are several distances, including a 1 km FamilyRun for children, a 5 km and a 10 km route, with the 10 km route covering the 5 km loop twice. Organised by SportSupport Kennemerland, the event offers a well-run and friendly race, with timing and unique medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Course through the beautiful Groenendaalse Bos and the lively town of Heemstede
The 10 km route consists of two laps of the 5 km loop
Live music from bands and DJs along the course
additional: The Les Petits 1 km FamilyRun is suitable for children aged 4 and up, with two start groups: groups 1–4 start at 10:00 and groups 5–8 at 10:30. One parent or guardian may run for free with children in groups 1–4. Timing is provided by Chronorace. Registration includes a unique medal, refreshments along the route and after the finish, and changing facilities. Registration is via a digital module; race numbers are sent by post or handed out on the day. Facilities include changing rooms, showers and a supervised cloakroom.

name: Kullamannen by UTMB
description: Kullamannen by UTMB is an adventure race along the rocky shores of Kullaberg and the Bjäre Peninsula on Sweden’s southwest coast. The races range from 22 km to 100 miles and offer challenging terrain through rocky hills, beech forests, and coastal trails. This is a tough and scenic trail-running experience that attracts adventurous runners from around the world. The races are part of the UTMB World Series and offer a unique combination of technical trails and spectacular views.
course_highlights: Technical singletrack on Kullaberg
Passage through 15 nature reserves and two hills (Ultra 100 Miles)
Coastal trails and beech forests along the Bjäre Peninsula
additional: The start and finish for Ultra 100 Miles and Sprint Ultra are in Höganäs, with bib pickup in Båstad. Drop bags are provided and can be collected at specific aid stations and after the finish. It is possible to transfer a registration to a shorter distance up to three weeks before the race. Minimum age varies by race, and parental consent is required for minors taking part in North Shore 20K. The event also includes an extensive schedule of activities during the week before the races. The race lineup includes, among others, 20K, 50K, 100K, and 100 miles. For the 100-mile race, bib pickup takes place at the EXPO in Båstad.

name: Kullamannen 100 miles
description: Kullamannen 100 miles is an extremely challenging A+ 100-mile race that takes you through 15 scenic nature reserves and two mountains in Skåne. The race starts in Höganäs and the course includes technical singletrack on Kullaberg, one of Sweden’s most popular nature reserves. After 66 kilometres, runners can refuel with hot soup before continuing north towards Ängelholm and Torekov, with the finish in Båstad. The race is known for its high DNF rate of 40–60% and the tough weather conditions in November, with Scandinavian coastal winds and long hours of darkness.
course_highlights: Passes through 15 nature reserves and two mountains
Technical singletrack on Kullaberg Mountain
Starts in Höganäs and finishes in Båstad, with a chance to refuel after 66 km
additional: The race starts in Höganäs, with buses departing from Båstad. Race bibs must be collected in person at the Expo in Båstad. Drop bags are provided and can be collected at the Båstad Aid Station and after the finish. Drop bags must be collected within two hours after the race ends. Bib collection by proxy is not permitted. The race is part of the UTMB World Series. Bibs must be collected in person at the EXPO in Båstad, with valid ID and a QR code. Participants receive an official UTMB World Series drop bag.

name: Walking Dead Ultra 100 Miles
description: Walking Dead Ultra 100 Miles is a challenging ultramarathon held in Paradiset Nature Reserve in Huddinge. The race offers a unique terrain experience, with scenic views and technical trails that test both endurance and mental strength. It is a well-regarded event for experienced ultrarunners seeking a long-distance challenge in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: Running in Paradiset Nature Reserve with varied terrain
Technical trails and scenic views
A challenging 100-mile distance
additional: The race also offers 100 km and 65 km distances. According to the available race information, drop bags and toilets are available, along with water, tea, coffee and broth at Torpet Paradiset.

name: Bislett 3000m 2027
description: Bislett 3000m arrangeres på Bislett Stadion i Oslo, en arena kjent for sin friidrettstradisjon og gode løpsforhold. Løpet er en del av Sportsklubben Vidars arrangementer, som tilbyr friidrettsaktiviteter for alle aldre og nivåer. Dette løpet gir en flott mulighet for både erfarne og nye løpere til å konkurrere på en klassisk bane i hjertet av Oslo. Arrangementet fremmer glede og fellesskap blant deltakerne.
course_highlights: Løpet går på den ikoniske Bislett Stadion
Flott bane med gode forhold for mellomdistanseløp
Sentral beliggenhet i Oslo med historisk friidrettsarena

name: Sandflugtsløbet 2026
distance_verbose: Halvmarathon, 15 km, 14 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 2 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Frit valg på alle distancer kun 229,- kr. + betalingsgebyr

description: Sandflugtsløbet er et motionsløb, der afholdes i Sandflugtsplantagen mellem Rørvig og Nykøbing Sjælland. Løbet byder på gode, flade grusstier og en hyggelig atmosfære med over 700 deltagere. Der er fine faciliteter med toiletter, stort telt til omklædning og ophold samt forplejning under og efter løbet, inklusive varm suppe. Alle deltagere får flotte medaljer, og der er også et børneløb på 2 km. Deltagerantallet er begrænset til 750, og der er forskellige starttider for de forskellige distancer.
course_highlights: Gode flade grusstier i Sandflugtsplantagen
Ruten går mellem Rørvig og Nykøbing Sjælland
Flotte medaljer til alle gennemførende
additional: Deltagerantal er max 750. Ved udsolgt er der ingen eftertilmelding på dagen. Der er fine toiletforhold, men ikke bademulighed. Der serveres varm suppe efter løbet. Mulighed for at donere medaljer til genbrug, hvor 25 kr. pr. medalje går til julemærkehjemmene. Der er ikke mulighed for bad. Løbet har et deltagerloft, og der er ingen eftertilmelding på dagen, hvis det er udsolgt.

name: Finalloppet Göteborg
description: Finalloppet är Västsveriges största terränglopp med anor från 1968 och arrangeras av Göteborgs Skidklubb. Loppet erbjuder flera distanser från 1,9 km upp till 19 km, alla med varierande terräng och utmanande inslag som avancerade trailavsnitt. Arenan är belägen vid Skatås Motionscentrum i Göteborg, där mål och service samlas. Loppet är välorganiserat med tydlig banmarkering och vätskestationer längs banorna, och det finns klasser för både kvinnor och män i olika åldersgrupper.
course_highlights: 19 km-banan innehåller ett cirka 2500 meter avancerat trailavsnitt
Banorna markeras med orangea pilar och kilometerangivelser i olika färger per distans
Vätskestationer finns på flera platser längs de längre banorna
additional: Anmälan sker via RaceID med betalning direkt vid anmälan. Startgrupper används för att sprida ut löparna efter angiven löptid. Försäkring Startklar kan tecknas vid anmälan. Parvelbanan (ca 250 m) anmäls på plats tävlingsdagen. Efterpatrull finns på alla banor. Läkare och sjukvårdare finns vid målområdet. Vätskestationer, sjukvård och efterpatrull finns längs banorna.

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
description: Jätten Bule-löpet är ett traditionsrikt löplopp som arrangeras av IFK Österbymo och bjuder på en naturskön och trolsk skogsmiljö runt Österbymo. Loppet erbjuder tre distanser: 10 km, 5 km och 2,4 km, där deltagarna springer på stigar och grusvägar med varierande terräng och vackra vyer. Start och mål är vid Bulevallen, och loppet är sanktionerat av Östergötlands Friidrottsförbund med tidtagning via chip. Det finns omklädningsrum, servering och nummerlappsutdelning på plats, vilket skapar en trivsam och välorganiserad tävlingsdag.
course_highlights: 10 km-banan slingrar sig genom trolsk skog på stigar och grusvägar med både upp- och nedförsbackar
5 km-banan är en miniatyr av 10 km-banan med en ny bansträckning från 2024 och är blåmarkerad
2,4 km-banan går på elljusspåret och är något tuffare
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas från kl 09.00 i IFK Österbymos klubbstuga vid startplatsen. Uppvärmning med Bulis sker innan knattestarten ca kl 10.00. Tidtagning sker med chip. Omklädningsrum finns i klubbstugan. Servering med fika och hamburgare finns vid startplatsen, betalning via Swish och kontanter. Start och mål vid Idrottsplatsen, Österbymo. 10 km och 5 km erbjuds både som löpning och gång.

name: 26. Dresden-Marathon / DRESDEN-MARATHON
description: The DRESDEN-MARATHON has been held regularly at the end of October since 1999 and offers a flat, fast course through the Saxon state capital, passing its famous sights. The route takes runners through the historic old town, including Brühl's Terrace, the Semper Opera House and other Baroque buildings, as well as the lively Neustadt district. More than 300 musicians and numerous bands create a special atmosphere along the course. The second half of the marathon runs through the Blasewitz district, with views of the castles on the Loschwitz Elbe slopes and the villas along Goetheallee, before heading back to the old town along the Elbe.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Dresden's historic old town and Neustadt district
Illuminated Waldschlösschen Tunnel and bridge, and the Großer Garten
Atmosphere created by more than 300 musicians and bands along the course
additional: There is a marathon expo, race packet pickup and a SPARKASSEN pacemaker service. After the race, medal engraving, a photo service, showers, changing rooms and toilets, as well as award ceremonies, are available. The evening before the race, an anniversary party will be held in the marquee behind Heinz-Steyer-Stadion (€25 admission; limited capacity).

name: Halloween-Run-Rotenburg
location: Flugplatz Rotenburg (Wümme), Rotenburg (Wümme), Lower Saxony, Germany
description: Der Halloween-Run-Rotenburg findet am 30. Oktober 2027 auf dem Flugplatz Rotenburg (Wümme) statt und bietet ein einzigartiges Lauferlebnis in schauriger Halloween-Atmosphäre mit Dunkelheit, Lichtern und Nebel. Die Strecke ist in Runden von 2,5 km aufgeteilt und wurde für 2027 so angepasst, dass sie auch bei schwierigen Lichtverhältnissen gut zu laufen ist. Es gibt verschiedene Wettbewerbe für alle Altersklassen, vom Kids Run bis zum 15-km-Evilthon. Nach dem Lauf erwartet die Teilnehmer ein spektakuläres Feuerwerk, das den Abend gebührend abschließt.
course_highlights: Rundenkurs auf dem Flugplatz Rotenburg mit 2,5 km pro Runde
Gruselige Halloween-Dekoration mit Lichtern und Nebel
Überarbeitete Strecke für bessere Laufbarkeit bei Dunkelheit
additional: Start- und Zielbereich auf dem Flugplatz Rotenburg Wümme zwischen THW und Tower. Startunterlagenausgabe am Veranstaltungstag ab 15:00 Uhr im Schulungsraum Transall (Hinter dem Restaurant HeyLü). Kostümwettbewerb mit Anmeldung möglich, Fotos für Abstimmung ab 17:00 Uhr am Startbereich. Nach dem Lauf spektakuläres Feuerwerk um 20:15 Uhr. Teilnehmer werden gebeten, Stirnlampen oder Laufbeleuchtung mitzubringen wegen Dunkelheit und Nebel. Versand der Startunterlagen gegen Gebühr von 7,50 € möglich, Anmeldung mit Versand bis 3. Oktober 2027. Geplant sind ein Kids Run über 1.000 m, 2,5 km, 5 km, 10 km und 15 km. Der 5- und 10-km-Lauf kann auch gewalkt werden. Ein Kostümwettbewerb und ein Feuerwerk zum Abschluss sind angekündigt.

name: 34. Mündener Altstadtlauf
description: Der 34. Mündener Altstadtlauf findet am 31. Oktober 2027 statt und bietet Läufern aller Altersgruppen attraktive Strecken in der historischen Altstadt von Hann. Münden. Die Veranstaltung umfasst eine 500-m-Bambini-Strecke, einen 1000-m-Schülerlauf sowie 5-km- und 10-km-Läufe für Hobby- und Wettkampfsportler. Die 5-km-Strecke beinhaltet eine Gruppenwertung, während die 10-km-Strecke eine Mannschaftswertung mit mindestens einer Frau pro Team bietet. Die Strecke wird vom Niedersächsischen Leichtathletikverband vermessen und gilt somit als bestzeitfähig. Das Organisationsteam legt großen Wert auf eine professionelle Durchführung und die Sicherheit der Läufer.
course_highlights: Historische Altstadt von Hann. Münden als Laufkulisse
Bestzeitfähige Strecke durch Vermessung des Leichtathletikverbands
Vielfältige Streckenlängen von 500 m bis 10 km mit Einzel- und Mannschaftswertungen
additional: Die Veranstaltung wird von einem engagierten Team organisiert, unterstützt von Feuerwehr, Polizei, Stadtverwaltung und lokalen Unternehmen. Es gibt eine Bambini-Strecke für die Jüngsten und Wertungen für Gruppen und Mannschaften. Rund 40 Helfer sichern die Strecke und sorgen für einen reibungslosen Ablauf.

name: 6. Halloween Run
description: Der Halloween-Run Bremen 2027 findet am 31. Oktober statt und bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern ein schauriges Lauferlebnis in Kostümen rund um den Werdersee. Mit fünf verschiedenen Streckenlängen von 1 km bis zum Marathon ist für jede Leistungsstufe etwas dabei. Die Strecken sind nach den Regeln des Deutschen Leichtathletik-Verbandes vermessen und bestenlistentauglich, was den Wettkampfcharakter unterstreicht. Neben dem Lauf gibt es einen Kostümwettbewerb und eine Siegerehrung mit anschließendem spektakulärem Feuerwerk als Highlight des Events.
course_highlights: 8,333 km langer Rundkurs am Werdersee, DLV-vermessen und bestenlistentauglich
Strecken von 1 km bis Marathon (42,195 km) mit gruseligen Extras
Start- und Zielbereich zwischen Finnbahn und Grillwiese nahe DLRG-Rettungswache
additional: Startunterlagenausgabe am 31. Oktober von 11:00 bis 14:30 Uhr in der Sporthalle am LidiceHaus. Kostümwettbewerb mit Foto-Abstimmung vor dem Start ab 12:45 Uhr. Staffelläufe möglich, Staffelstab ist die Startnummer mit RFID-Chip, Startnummernband muss selbst mitgebracht werden. Nach dem Lauf spektakuläres Feuerwerk ab 18:00 Uhr. Anmeldung bis 31. Oktober 2027 um 12:30 Uhr oder bis Teilnehmerlimit erreicht ist.

name: Bredstedt-Cross

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgelder liegen je nach Kategorie zwischen 2,50 Euro und 3,50 Euro

description: Der Bredstedt-Cross ist ein traditionsreicher Crosslauf, der am 30. Oktober 2027 in Bredstedt stattfindet. Veranstaltet vom Bredstedter TSV, bietet das Event Wettkämpfe für zahlreiche Altersklassen von Kindern bis Senioren. Die Läufe finden auf dem Gelände der Gemeinschaftsschule Bredstedt, in der Harald-Nommensen-Halle und im Außengelände statt und sind Teil des KLVNF Cross-Cup. Die Strecken bestehen aus kleinen und großen Runden mit einer Mindestlänge von 5 km. Für alle Teilnehmenden gibt es Urkunden und eine Siegerehrung im Außenbereich.
course_highlights: Wettkämpfe auf dem Gelände der Gemeinschaftsschule Bredstedt und im Außengelände
Teil des KLVNF Cross-Cup mit kurzen und langen Crossläufen
Streckenlänge mindestens 5 km mit kleinen und großen Runden
additional: Umkleideräume und Duschen in der Harald-Nommensen-Halle sind verfügbar. Ausreichend Parkplätze vor der Halle vorhanden. Ergebnisse und personenbezogene Daten werden erfasst und veröffentlicht. Es gibt eine Siegerehrung im Außenbereich unter Einhaltung von Abstand.

name: Kreismeisterschaft und 3. Halloween-Crosslauf im Örtzetal zu Munster
location: Sportpark Osterberg, Munster, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The County Cross-Country Championships and 3rd Örtzetal Halloween Cross-Country Run in Munster is a cross-country event held at Sportpark Osterberg in Munster. The event combines the county cross-country championships with the third Halloween cross-country run and is open to children, youth, open classes and masters. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, creating a local, club-focused atmosphere rather than the feel of a large city race. The race takes place in the autumnal Örtzetal region and is a popular seasonal event organised by Eintracht Munster.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in the Örtzetal on varied terrain
Distances from 500 m to 10 km for different age and ability groups
Event at Sportpark Osterberg, Munster
additional: The event was postponed due to bad weather and incorporates the county championships into the Halloween cross-country run. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event is held in a cross-country format, has a local character, and is open to children, youth, adults and masters. It takes place on Halloween, with weather-dependent adjustments.

name: Köstritzer Parklauf
location: Köstritzer Park, Bad Köstritz, Thuringia, Germany
description: The Köstritzer Parklauf is a cross-country race held in late October in Bad Köstritz, Germany. The course runs through and around Köstritzer Park, away from the usual running tracks. The event offers short races for children and young people, as well as longer distances for adults and masters, from 500 m to the 12 km main race. It attracts numerous local and regional clubs, mainly from Thuringia, but also from Saxony and Bavaria. The 27th edition of the race is known for its strong regional turnout.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through and around Köstritzer Park
Start in the park with views of dahlias in bloom in autumn
A range of distances from 500 m to 12 km
additional: Typical October weather: around 14 °C maximum and 6 °C minimum, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event includes races for children and young people, as well as main races for adults and masters. It takes place in late October, with various race distances and categories for children, young people, active runners, and masters. Registration is possible until shortly before the event.

name: Nordhessische Crosslaufmeisterschaften
description: The North Hesse Cross-Country Championships are a regional club and regional cross-country championship held in various locations across North Hesse. The event is aimed primarily at club runners from the region competing for regional and district titles. Course distances range from short youth races of 1.2 km to longer senior races of 8 km. The races take place on cross-country terrain, not on closed roads, and are organized by various athletics districts and clubs.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain rather than a road race
Distances from 1.2 km to 8 km
Held at sports facilities in various locations across North Hesse
additional: The event is geared strongly toward club runners. Depending on the course, runners are advised to choose suitable shoes carefully, such as spikes. Results are published as web and PDF listings. Typical October weather is cool and mostly cloudy, with a daytime high of about 14°C and a low of 6°C. October weather: about 14°C, low of 6°C, 40 mm of precipitation, cloudy; races take place at sports facilities in the region, online registration is possible, and results are published as web and PDF listings.
