description: Der TEAG - LEGEND OF CROSS in Mühlberg ist Thüringens härteste Crosslauf-Serie und bietet ein anspruchsvolles Hindernislauf-Wochenende mit Schlamm, steilen Anstiegen und über 30 natürlichen und künstlichen Hindernissen. Die Veranstaltung erstreckt sich über zwei Tage und führt die Teilnehmer an drei Burgen vorbei. Verschiedene Distanzen von 1 km bis 30 km bieten für jede Leistungsstufe die passende Herausforderung, sowohl für Einzelkämpfer als auch für Teams. Die Läufe sind bekannt für ihre abwechslungsreichen Trails und die einzigartige Atmosphäre in der historischen Kulisse der Drei Gleichen.
course_highlights: Drei Burgen als markante Streckenpunkte
Bis zu 950 Höhenmeter auf der längsten Strecke
Mehr als 30 natürliche und künstliche Hindernisse
additional: Die Rennen starten in Wellen, wobei die Elite in der ersten Startwelle läuft. Es gibt eine Einzel- und Teamwertung (CLAN OF CROSS ab 5 Personen). Start und Ziel befinden sich am Sportplatz Mühlberg mit ausreichend Parkplätzen. Die Startunterlagen können an mehreren Tagen vor Ort abgeholt werden. Kinder benötigen eine Einverständniserklärung der Eltern. Nachmeldungen sind am Rennwochenende möglich, es fällt eine Gebühr von 5 Euro für Änderungen nach dem 30. Oktober an.

name: Botaniczna Piątka – Bydgoszcz, edycja jesienna
location: Botanical Garden of the Kazimierz Wielki University, Bydgoszcz, Poland

name: 11strandentocht
description: The 11strandentocht is a walking event along the Dutch coast. Participants can choose from four distances: 50 km, 25 km, 12.5 km and 5 km. Each route passes different beaches, with the sea on the left. The finish is always in the centre of Zandvoort. The event supports the Dutch Heart Foundation in the fight against cardiovascular disease, combining a sporting challenge with a good cause.
course_highlights: Routes run entirely over sand and unpaved paths along 11 beaches
The 50 km distance starts early in the morning (06:30 and 07:00), with a light for before sunrise
There are checkpoint stations, rest stops and medical assistance along the way, including first aid and AEDs
additional: Each distance has a different starting location, but the finish is always in the heart of Zandvoort. The 50 km route starts at Deltaplein, The Hague, and is a loop over the beach and boulevard. The 5 km Heroes Route is suitable for walkers going at their own pace. There are 11 checkpoint stations along the way for the long-distance route and 5 for the 12.5 km route. The number of entry tickets is limited to ensure personal attention and safety. Distances range from 5 km to 50 km; starting locations vary; the event supports a good cause; the beach route has the sea on the left.

name: Backyard Ultra de Langstraat
description: The Backyard Ultra de Langstraat takes place in Waalwijk. The race consists of a 7-kilometre distance and offers runners a challenging and unique running experience in the Brabant region. This ultrarun is ideal for runners who want to test their endurance in a friendly and sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: 7 kilometres per lap
Location in Waalwijk, Brabant
Unique Backyard Ultra format
additional: The race is held in a friendly and sporting atmosphere, with a focus on endurance and perseverance.

name: Dalli-run
description: Athletics club De Gemzen organizes the Dalli-Run every autumn, one of the most beautiful fun runs of the year. The run takes place in Heerde, in the Veluwe region, and features a wonderfully rolling course past some of the area’s most beautiful spots. The Dalli-Run is popular in the region and offers several distances, from short youth races to 15 kilometres for adults. The routes follow paved roads and cycle paths, with starts between 10:00 and 11:00.
course_highlights: A wonderfully rolling course past some of Heerde’s most beautiful spots
Paved roads and cycle paths
Several distances: 700m, 1400m, 5km, 10km and 15km
additional: Start times between 10:00 and 11:00. Youth distances: 700 and 1400 metres; adult distances: 5, 10 and 15 kilometres. The course follows paved roads and cycle paths. Organized by athletics club De Gemzen. The Dalli-Run is an event for runners of all levels, with activities for young people and adults. It is organized by a local athletics club and attracts many participants from the region each year.

name: Haarlerbergtrail
description: The Haarlerbergtrail takes place and offers challenging trail runs over distances of 11, 16, 22 and 30 kilometres. The routes pass through a large part of Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park, where runners can enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The organisers aim to make the event climate-neutral and ask participants to bring their own drinking cup. There is no prize-giving ceremony, but every participant receives a medal as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Routes through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park
Varied terrain with some trails closed during the breeding season
Beautiful nature and challenging trail distances
additional: Maximum 349 participants. Registration online only. Start times: 30 km and 22 km at 12:00, 16 km at 12:15, 11 km at 12:30. Bringing your own drinking cup is compulsory; a reusable cup is available for €4. No prize-giving ceremony, but every participant receives a medal. Start and finish at Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel. No on-the-day registration. Registration closes on 31 October at 11:30, or earlier if fully booked. The organisers may cancel the event until 30 October at 20:00. No bicycle escorts are allowed on the course. Trail through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park, organised as a climate-neutral event, own drinking cup required, maximum 349 participants, online registration, race numbers can be collected at De Veldkamp, limited shower facilities.

name: Pheidippidesloop
organizer: Utrecht Atletiek en Road Runners Zeist
description: The Pheidippides Run is a unique relay marathon held annually at Maarschalkerweerd Athletics Track in Utrecht. Teams of seven runners cover the distance of a full marathon together, inspired by the legendary run of Pheidippides. The event is ideal for companies, groups of friends and running clubs looking to enjoy a fun, active day together. The race starts at 11:00 and offers a great combination of competition and team spirit.
course_highlights: Relay marathon with 7 participants per team
Team distances of 2 × 4.1 km and 5 × 6.8 km
Start, changeover point and finish at Maarschalkerweerd Athletics Track
additional: Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available free of charge at the athletics track. The pavilion is open and serves refreshments, including coffee, hot chocolate, bitterballen and beer. The athletics track is easy to reach by bike, public transport and car, but parking is limited and parking is prohibited on Mytylweg. The team composition and running order can be changed on race day. Relay marathon with various segments, starting at Maarschalkerweerd Athletics Track. Participants can register from 1 May to 28 October. The event emphasises team spirit and social interaction.

name: Vechtdaltrail
description: The VechtdalTrail takes place in Ommen and offers challenging trail-running routes of 15, 22, 30, 42 and 60 kilometres. The trails feature little asphalt, lots of singletrack and varied terrain, including forest and sandy paths and rough grassland. The longer distances include several short climbs, especially in the ‘Beerze Bulten’ area, making the 60 km route a true ultra trail. The organisers aim to make the event sustainable, with no disposable cups and personalised chip timing via a chip in the race bib. Registration is only available in advance, and the longest distance has a time limit of 8 hours.
course_highlights: Little asphalt, lots of singletrack
Varied terrain: forest paths, sandy paths and rough grassland
Short climbs in the Beerze Bulten on the 30, 42 and 60 km routes
additional: The VechtdalTrail is a no-disposable-cup event; participants must bring their own collapsible cup or hydration bladder. The 60 km distance has an 8-hour time limit, with cut-off times at aid stations. Timing is done using a chip in the personalised race bib, which participants may keep after the event. There is no race-day registration; advance registration is required. A unique race shirt can be ordered during registration. No medals are provided. Participants must have their own insurance. Safety measures are in place at hazardous spots.

name: Veldhoven 10 Miles
description: The Veldhoven 10 Miles is a popular running event in the Veldhoven area. The event is known as one of the most enjoyable runs in the region and attracts many participants every year. The race offers a challenging 10-mile course through the beautiful landscape around Veldhoven. The atmosphere is sporty and sociable, making it suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: A 10-mile course through the Veldhoven landscape
A varied route with beautiful scenery
A popular, sociable running event in the region

name: Snertcross

price_tiers.distance: Lange cross dames en Lange cross heren 55+

description: The Snertcross is an annual running race in the Warandebos in Tilburg, organized by T.S.A.V. Parcival. The race is part of the Regio 13 Cross Circuit and the Tilburg Triple. The Snertcross offers several categories and distances, including junior races, a short cross, a women’s long cross, a men’s 55+ long cross, and a men’s long cross. The race features a challenging course with multiple laps, depending on the distance.
course_highlights: Junior cross: 2 laps
Short cross: 1 lap
Women’s and men’s 55+ long cross: 3 laps; men’s long cross: 4 laps
additional: Race-day registration is available until one hour before the start of the respective race. Payment is accepted only in cash or via a payment request using a QR code. The Snertcross is part of the Tilburg Triple, where participants who take part in three or more events receive an exclusive medal. Registration is open until a few days before the race, with race-day registration also available. The race takes place in the Warandebos, with parking available on the university campus. There are no changing facilities at the start, but facilities are available at Tilburg University’s sports centre.

name: Lage Vuursche Ultra
description: The Lage Vuursche Ultra is a challenging 50 km trail run through historic forests around Baarn, with a varied course through deciduous and coniferous forests, heathland and open stretches. The route is followed using a GPX file and offers a great mix of singletrack, forest paths and avenues. There is good support along the way, with no more than 15 km between aid stations, and participants receive a UTMB Index at the finish. This event is part of the Dutch Ultra Series 2026 and is known for its natural beauty and challenging character.
course_highlights: 50 km through historic forests of deciduous and coniferous trees
Varied course with singletrack, forest paths and heathland
No more than 15 km between aid stations; no disposable cups
additional: Start and finish at Natuurcamping De Zeven Linden, with parking available. Pick up your race number and tracker from 08:30 at race headquarters. Time limit: 8 hours; finish by 17:00 at the latest. No disposable cups at aid stations; participants must bring their own race cup or buy one at race headquarters. Participants will receive detailed information by email two days before the event. Maximum 300 participants; no cups at aid stations; start and finish at Kampeerterrein de Zeven Linden.

name: Halloween Citywalk
description: The Halloween City Walk in Veghel is a spooky walk of approximately 3 kilometres through the town centre, organised on Halloween evening. It is not a running race, but a frightening experience for the whole family, with various scary characters along the route ready to give participants a fright. The walk starts between 19:00 and 20:00 at the Markt, near Matteucci ice cream parlour. Participants must be at least 16 years old; younger participants may join only when accompanied by an adult.
course_highlights: Route of approximately 3 kilometres through Veghel town centre
Spooky, eerie atmosphere with ominous characters along the route
Start at the Markt, near Matteucci ice cream parlour
additional: Start time is between 19:00 and 20:00. The walk is not a race, but an event with a spooky atmosphere. Registration for the Krollenloop itself is sold out, but registration for the Halloween City Walk is still available. Start at 19:00; registration is via the website. Participants aged 16 and over may take part independently; younger participants must be accompanied by an adult.

name: Höstmilen
location: Sörsjön, Kolmårdsskogarna, Åby, Norrköping Municipality, Sweden
description: Höstmilen är ett terränglöpningslopp som går på stigarna mellan Sörsjön och Lillsjön utanför Åby, norr om Norrköping. Loppet erbjuder en utmanande bana i naturskön terräng och en trevlig upplevelse för alla deltagare. Du kan välja mellan en lång bana på 10,6 km, en kortare på 5,2 km samt banor för barn och ungdomar. De kortare banorna startar och slutar vid Lillsjön. Arrangör är OK Kolmården, en skid- och orienteringsklubb för alla nivåer och åldrar.
course_highlights: Terränglöpning på stigar mellan Sörsjön och Lillsjön
Naturskön terräng i Kolmårdsskogarna
Utmanande bana med både 10,6 km och 5,2 km distanser
additional: Anmälan stänger 29 oktober kl 23.00. Efter det kan man anmäla sig den 31 oktober kl 11-14 på XXL samt på startplatsen den 1 november. Det finns även barn- och ungdomsklasser. Tävlingsledare är Johan Malm. Parkering och transportinformation finns på hemsidan. Sjukdom med milda symtom innebär att man ska stanna hemma. Loppet har arrangerats sedan 1971.

name: Perseløpet 5 km, 10 km, halvmaraton
description: Perseløpet is a race focused on fast times, held at Ås school in Eidsvoll. The race takes place on a flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop, where participants can set out their own bottles and gels on their personal nutrition table. Seven distances are offered, from 3 km to 100 km, including 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. Race bibs are collected on a self-service basis at the school, and the venue has good facilities, including changing rooms, toilets and free parking. The race has a friendly atmosphere, where personal records are celebrated with the ringing of a bell near the finish area.
course_highlights: Flat, accurately measured 2,633-metre loop
Participants’ own nutrition tables along the course
Good facilities at the venue, including changing rooms, toilets and free parking
additional: Race bibs are collected on a self-service basis about two hours before the start. The race uses a lap-time calculator to plan split times. At selected races, 9th grade students from Feiring school staff an official drinks station to raise money for their school trip. The weather forecast is updated four times a day based on satellite data for the area around Ås school. Public transport by train and bus is available to the venue, with real-time departures provided. Race bibs can be collected on a self-service basis at the school from about two hours before the start. Registration is through RaceDays.

name: HA Ottestad løpsfestival 2027
description: HA Ottestad Running Festival is an annual event held at Ottestad Idrettspark, with the start and finish in the same place. The festival consists of three races: HOKA Ottestad Rundt (17 km), the Spenst Run (5 km), and the Sport1 Sprint for children, with distances of 400 metres, 1 km and 1.8 km. The route follows Ottestadstien, a scenic trail winding through the cultural landscape of woodland and farmland, with beautiful views over Lake Mjøsa. The event offers good facilities, including a café, food and refreshments, changing rooms and showers in the clubhouse.
course_highlights: The route follows Ottestadstien through a cultural landscape of woodland and farmland
Fantastic views over Lake Mjøsa
Start and finish at Ottestad Idrettspark, with good facilities
additional: HOKA Sprint is a separate 430-metre segment on the 17 km course, where participants can compete to be the fastest on Strava and win HOKA shoes. There is music, spectators and a dedicated drinks station at the sprint segment. A one-day licence is an additional cost for those without an annual licence. Athletes up to age 12 are covered by NIF's children's sports insurance. The 17 km and 5 km races can be run with or without timing. The start and finish are at Ottestad Idrettspark, which has a café, food and refreshments, and changing rooms with showers.

name: Oeventroper Volks- und Straßenlauf
location: Sportplatz 'In den Oeren', Arnsberg-Oeventrop, Arnsberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Oeventrop Volks- und Straßenlauf is a local road race in Arnsberg-Oeventrop, held at the “In den Oeren” sports ground. The main event is a flat 10 km race for adults, which starts in the morning. There is also a 5 km youth race and several 1.1 km children’s races, divided by age and gender. The start and finish are centrally located at the sports ground, making the event family-friendly and easy to navigate. The event is hosted by TuS 1896 Oeventrop e.V. and is part of the Lauf Cup standings.
course_highlights: Flat 10 km circuit
5 km youth race on a flat loop
1.1 km children’s races divided by age and gender
additional: The start and finish are at the “In den Oeren” sports ground, bringing everything together in one place for runners and families. There is a three-person team classification for the 5 km race. The children’s races have separate starts for different age and gender groups. Race in Arnsberg-Oeventrop, Lauf Cup standings, parking at REWE and ALDI Widayweg

name: Birkhahnlauf
location: Schneeren, Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Birkhahnlauf in Schneeren is a traditional race that has been held annually on the last Sunday in October for over 50 years. The event offers distances for all age groups, from short children’s races starting at 500 meters to challenging 5 km and 10 km races for adults. The courses run through the pine forest on paved forest paths with a slightly sandy surface and no significant elevation profile, making the race a special experience amid nature. New this year is a 2.3 km course for the U12 age group and up. The friendly atmosphere and prompt award ceremonies with certificates and medals round off the event.
course_highlights: Courses through the pine forest on paved forest paths
Distances from 500 m to 10.2 km for all age groups
Kilometer markers on the 5.1 km and 10.2 km courses, which have no significant elevation profile
additional: Start times: children’s 500 m race at 10:30, 1,000 m at 10:45, 2.3 km at 11:10, and 5.1 km and 10.2 km at 11:40. Award ceremonies take place promptly after the respective races. Parking is available nearby and is signposted.

name: Halloween-Run-Bremen
description: The Halloween Run Bremen 2026 takes place on October 31 and offers runners a spooky race experience around Werdersee. With five different distances, from 1 km to the 42.195 km marathon, there is something for every ability level. The courses are measured in accordance with German Athletics Association rules and are eligible for record lists, underscoring the competitive nature of the event. Alongside the sporting event, participants can look forward to a spooky atmosphere with costumes, lights and fog, as well as an awards ceremony and a closing fireworks display.
course_highlights: 8.333 km loop course, measured by the German Athletics Association and eligible for record lists
Distances from 1 km (Spuklauf) to the marathon (Splatterthon), with a spooky atmosphere
Start and finish area at Werdersee, between the Finnbahn and the barbecue area
additional: The awards ceremony for the Spuklauf takes place immediately after the finish; awards for the other distances are presented later. A spectacular fireworks display at 18:00 rounds off the event. There are also relay competitions for the marathon (5-person relay). The race bib with RFID chip serves as the relay baton and must be brought by the team. Costumes are expressly encouraged but are not compulsory. Participants can register online. There are various distances and relay options; the event takes place at night and offers a spooky atmosphere.

name: 19. Bothfelder Waldlauf
description: Der Bothfelder Waldlauf ist ein vom Deutschen Leichtathletik-Verband genehmigter Volkslauf, der vom TuS Bothfeld 04 in Hannover veranstaltet wird. Die Läufe starten und enden auf dem Bezirkssportplatz Bothfeld und führen durch den schönen Bothfelder Wald auf einem Rundkurs über Waldwege und gut ausgebaute Forststraßen. Der Lauf ist Teil des Laufpasses der Region Hannover und bietet Umkleide- und Duschmöglichkeiten am Ziel. Für das leibliche Wohl ist mit günstigen Speisen und Getränken sowie kostenlosem warmen Tee für alle Teilnehmer gesorgt.
course_highlights: Rundkurs durch den Bothfelder Wald
Lauf auf Waldwegen und gut ausgebauten Forststraßen
Start und Ziel auf dem Bezirkssportplatz Bothfeld
additional: Spontane Nachmeldungen sind bis 60 Minuten vor dem jeweiligen Laufstart online möglich, sofern noch Startplätze frei sind, mit einer Nachmeldegebühr von 2 Euro zusätzlich zum Startgeld. Die Siegerehrungen der Kinderläufe finden etwa 60 Minuten nach den Läufen im Zielbereich statt, die der längeren Strecken unmittelbar nach Zieleinlauf. Ein Urkundenausdruck vor Ort ist für alle Läufer möglich. Der 5 km Walking startet zeitgleich mit dem 10 km Hauptlauf. Gute Erreichbarkeit mit Stadtbahn Linie 13 und Parkmöglichkeiten in der Nähe sind gegeben.

name: 28. Tangerpokallauf
description: Der 28. Tangerpokallauf in Demker ist die älteste Laufveranstaltung des SC Demker '95 und bildet den Saisonabschluss des Elbe-Ohre-Cups. Die Strecke führt durch die herbstliche Tangerniederung zwischen Demker und Weißewarte, vorbei am Deutschen Eck, unterquert die Bahnlinie Stendal-Magdeburg und verläuft durch das Waldgebiet des Süpplings. Angeboten werden Strecken von 1,2 km für Kinder und Jugendliche sowie 5,4 km und 12,0 km für ältere Jugendliche und Erwachsene. Das Terrain ist durchweg flach mit den Deichen als einzigen Erhebungen, die den Ort Demker seit dem Hochwasser 2013 schützen.
course_highlights: Flache Strecke durch die herbstliche Tangerniederung
Verlauf entlang des Tangers und vorbei am Deutschen Eck
Durchquerung des Waldgebiets Süpplings
additional: Die Strecke ist durchweg flach mit Deichen als einzige Erhebungen. Es gibt drei Streckenlängen: 1,2 km für Kinder und Jugendliche, 5,4 km und 12,0 km für ältere Jugendliche und Erwachsene. Die Strecke führt unter anderem unter der Bahnlinie Stendal-Magdeburg hindurch.

name: LG Alsternord Herbstwaldlauf 2026
description: The LG Alsternord Autumn Forest Run is a local autumn race through the forest in Norderstedt, north of Hamburg. Organized by LG Alsternord Hamburg e.V., the race starts at 11:00 a.m. at the Rantzauer Forst-Thingplatz. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes, including a cross-country option. The race takes place away from city streets in the Rantzauer Forst area and also offers walking and hiking events. With a modest field of usually 101 to 300 runners, the event has more of a club-run feel than that of a major race.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal Rantzauer Forst, away from city streets
5 km, 10 km and cross-country options
Modest field with a club-run atmosphere
additional: Results are published via race result; public start lists, photos, reports and historical rankings are available. In addition to the races, there are walking and hiking events, including a 5 km walk. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with rainy days. The event takes place in typical November weather, around 7°C and with rainy conditions. It is open to runners and walkers of all ages, with a modest participant count of between 101 and 300.

name: Tiergarten-Cross
description: The Tiergarten Cross in Schleswig is a local cross-country race. The event offers two main distances, 4.4 km and 8.8 km, which start one after the other so the fields are separated. The course is undulating and challenging, with constant changes of rhythm that make the race varied. Alongside the main races, there are also children’s and youth races, making the event family-friendly and varied.
course_highlights: Finishes in Tiergarten Schleswig, the course’s most distinctive point
Undulating course with constant small changes of rhythm
Separate start times for the 4.4 km and 8.8 km distances
additional: Typical November weather in Schleswig is cool, with daytime highs of around 7 °C, and rainy on most days. The event takes place in Tiergarten Schleswig, is weather-dependent (November is usually rainy), and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various race categories.

name: Winterlaufserie 2026/2027, 1. Wertungslauf
description: The Winter Run Series in Hamm is a long-standing winter road-running series, now taking place for the 51st time. The first scoring race covers a distance of 15 km on roads outside the stadium. The event attracts many club runners from Westphalia and beyond, including teams from Dortmund, Münster and Bielefeld. The race offers a challenging course in the cool November weather and is a popular start to the winter season for runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: 15 km road race outside the stadium
A field with a strong club-running presence from Westphalia and the surrounding area
Typically cool and rainy November weather
additional: The starting location is Ahnatal. The average November temperature is around 7°C, with frequent rain (approximately 45 mm of precipitation). The event is part of the Winter Run Series, which may take place in typical weather of around 7°C with rain. It is the series’ first scoring race and appeals to runners from various regions.

name: DrechtStadLoop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.4 km

name: Boerenkoolloop
location: Atletiekbaan van AV NOVA, Warmenhuizen, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Boerenkoolloop in Warmenhuizen is a friendly race and fun run over 5 and 10 km, starting and finishing on the AV NOVA athletics track. The course passes through the villages of Tuitjenhorn, Eenigenburg and Warmenhuizen, partly along quiet polder roads and the historic Westfriese Omringdijk, where the wind can be a challenging factor. After the event, every participant receives a bag of ingredients for a delicious boerenkool mash, sponsored by Koninklijke VEZET. There is also a 1.2 km youth run and a walking tour of approximately 11 km, which follows a partly reversed route. The facilities include spacious changing rooms, hot showers and extra amenities for comfort.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the AV NOVA athletics track
Route along quiet polder roads and the historic Westfriese Omringdijk
Views of the surrounding landscape, with the wind as a challenging factor
additional: Race numbers will be mailed and should arrive around 30 October. They can also be collected from the Harenkarspelhal next to AV NOVA up to 15 minutes before the start. Spacious changing rooms and hot showers are available. After the event, everyone receives a boerenkool package with sausage, potatoes and herbs. Parking is available at AV NOVA and at Bejo Zaden BV, approximately 800 metres away. The walking tour starts between 8:30 and 9:30; participants must reach the finish before 12:30 to receive the boerenkool package. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl until 25 October; same-day registration is not available. Start times are 11:10, 11:25 and 11:35.

name: Bosloop Malden
description: The Bosloop Malden is a running race with a rich history dating back to 1978. It is a much-loved event among the smaller running races in the Netherlands, ideal for testing your form two weeks before the Zevenheuvelenloop. The race offers 5, 10 and 15 kilometre distances through the woods, as well as special races for children: the Bambinoloop for children aged 3 to 8 and a 2-kilometre race for children aged 9 to 12. Participation is free for children up to 12 years old, made possible in part by sponsor Medical Training Malden. Registration is open and closes when the maximum number of participants for each distance is reached.
course_highlights: Run through the woods of Malden
Distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres
Special distances for young runners: the Bambinoloop and 2 km Kidsrun
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 9:00 a.m. at the event site. The Bambinoloop has two starts: first for ages 3–5, then for ages 6–8. There is no timing for the Bambinoloop. The 2 km race is part of the Scholenbokaal of the MTM Kidsrun Bosloop Malden. Registration on race day is not possible. Places are limited for each distance. Distances include 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, with special races for children; participation is free for children under 12; registration on race day is not possible.

name: Haarlerbergloop
distance_verbose: 30 km, 22 km, 16 km, 11 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km
price_range: € 2 voor herinneringsmedaille, overige kosten niet gespecificeerd
description: The Haarlerbergloop is a challenging running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Sallandse Heuvelrug, with almost entirely unpaved paths across fields, sandy tracks, forest trails and heathland. The event takes place over two days: the Haarlerbergtrail features distances of 11, 16, 22 and 30 km, while the shorter distances of 1, 2.5, 5 and 10 km take place on the other day. The event is small-scale and is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit and the CrossCircuit van het Oosten. The start and finish are on Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel, where facilities including toilets and a changing area are available.
course_highlights: Almost entirely unpaved paths across fields, sandy tracks, forest trails and heathland
Beautiful routes through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park
Steep hills and expansive views
additional: Start and finish on Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel, with toilets and a changing area; no showers. Collecting your race number and leaving your bag are at your own risk. No on-the-day registration; advance registration is available until 30 minutes before the start. Participants in the 5 and 10 km races can buy a commemorative medal afterwards (€ 2). The trail is limited to 349 participants, and registration closes no later than 31 October at 11:30 or earlier if full. Participants in the trail must bring their own drinking cup; a reusable cup is available for purchase (€ 4). There is no prize-giving for the trail, but every participant receives a medal. The 5 and 10 km races donate € 1 per participant to Stichting Support for Nature. Distances: 1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 11 km, 16 km, 22 km, 30 km; cross-country event; registration opens in September; contribution to Support for Nature; races include the trail and youth distances.

name: Loop Esch Door
description: Loop Esch Door is a running event in and around the centre of Tubbergen, featuring a challenging, fast course across the Tubbergse Esch. Since 2022, the event has grown into an established race with a welcoming atmosphere and a great mix of competition and recreation. It offers various distances for runners of all levels, including special runs for children and people with disabilities. The start and finish are at Raadhuisplein in Tubbergen, where a friendly, community spirit is also central.
course_highlights: Fast course through the countryside and across the Tubbergse Esch
Start and finish at Raadhuisplein in the centre of Tubbergen
Various distances from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, including walking routes
additional: Collect race numbers on 1 November from 08:00 at Tubbergen Town Hall, up to 30 minutes before the start. Walkers can collect their race numbers from 09:00. Parking at the swimming pool on Sportlaan is recommended. There is a water station on the course, and sports nutrition is available after the event. First aid is available along the course. KinderKroon KidsRuns start from 12:45, with different age categories. Prize-giving ceremonies take place shortly after each distance finishes. The event also offers an inclusive run for people with disabilities and has a friendly, community-focused atmosphere.

name: Maasduinenloop
location: Afferden, Nationaal Park De Maasduinen, Limburg, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld per deelnemer bij voorinschrijving is € 4,00

description: The Maasduinenloop is an atmospheric running event held in De Maasduinen National Park, with the start and finish at Golfbaan Bleijenbeek in Afferden. The event offers a unique experience amid beautiful natural surroundings and combines sport with a friendly atmosphere. All proceeds go to burn care at the Radboudumc Amalia Children’s Hospital Centre of Expertise for Childhood Trauma and Burns. The Maasduinenloop welcomes runners of all ages and abilities, with special attention to young participants through the Kidsrun.
course_highlights: Run through De Maasduinen National Park
Start and finish at atmospheric Golfbaan Bleijenbeek
New routes, including a 10 km loop
additional: Kidsrun start times: 10:30 (up to and including age 7, 500 m) and 10:45 (ages 8 to 11, 1,000 m). All Kidsrun participants receive a medal and a healthy snack. The awards ceremony takes place immediately after the Kidsrun, at approximately 11:00. Teams can consist of men, women or a mix; the score is the sum of the three fastest times. Team members are automatically entered in the individual race at no extra cost. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 km. The course is marked and supervised by traffic marshals and mountain bikers, and uses electronic timing. The start and finish are at Landgoed Bleijenbeek.

name: Warnsborncross

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname aan de Warnsborncross kost 9 euro (alle afstanden)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname aan de Kidsrun kost 3 euro

description: The Warnsborncross is a traditional cross-country race held on the beautiful Warnsborn estate near Arnhem. The race follows unpaved paths past streams and ponds, with challenging elevation changes. There are three distances: 5.5 km, 11 km and 16.5 km, covering 1, 2 or 3 laps of 5.5 km respectively. There is also a 1,200-metre Kidsrun for children up to and including 12 years old. The start and race-number pickup take place at Tennisvereniging Schaarsbergen.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths through the Warnsborn estate
Running alongside streams and ponds
Challenging elevation changes
additional: Race-number pickup is available from 9:30 until 10:45 at the latest at Tennisvereniging Schaarsbergen, Kemperbergerweg 671a, 6816 RT Arnhem. The Kidsrun starts at 10:30, and the other distances start at 11:00. Start and registration at Tennisvereniging Schaarsbergen; the course follows unpaved paths with elevation changes and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit
description: The Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit consists of nine varied running races spread over six months in the Groene Hart. It is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners and offers a platform where taking part matters more than winning. Participants can choose from various distances and benefit from an affordable circuit entry, including a free running shirt and a gift at the finish for taking part in 8 or 9 races. The circuit encourages participation and promises a friendly, sporty atmosphere.
course_highlights: Nine varied races in the Groene Hart
Distances of 5 km, 10 km, 10 English miles and half marathon
Route along the picturesque Kromme Mijdrecht river and through Wickelhof Park
additional: Circuit participants can switch between the short and middle distances as often as they like via the information desk. Switching to the long distance is not possible without a separate entry. There is a 10 km walk, a Family Run and a G-Run for children up to 12 years old. Replacement race numbers can be collected from the information desk if lost. Changing rooms, showers and limited bag storage are available. Coffee, tea and soft drinks are available for takeaway in the sports hall. The prize-giving takes place in the sports hall. Nine varied races between November 2026 and April 2027, including short, middle and long distances and a half marathon, with extra rewards for taking part in multiple races.

name: LPR - Last Pirate Running
description: LPR - Last Pirate Running is a running event held in Volendam. The race offers a short distance of 1.6 kilometers, ideal for a quick and challenging running experience. Registration is closed, and participants can sign up via the specified registration website. The event is organized by ProRun and is suitable for runners looking for a unique and accessible race.
course_highlights: Short distance of 1.6 km
Organized in picturesque Volendam
Fast and challenging course
additional: A training plan for 10 miles (16.1 km) is available on the website and may help with preparation. The event is intended for runners who want to enjoy a short and fun race in North Holland.

name: Kievit Sport Twentsche Cross Competitie
organizer: AV Goor, AV Iphitos, ASV Eibergen, AAV Sisu, AC Tion, LAAC Twente
description: The Kievit Sport Twentse Cross Competition is a challenging cross-country series comprising six races in Twente’s beautiful natural areas. The competition offers a unique opportunity to test yourself against peers and enjoy the region’s winter conditions. The races vary in distance and are open to different age categories, from youth to masters. With strong local involvement and sponsors such as Kievit Sport and Wiggers Vleeswaren, this competition is a much-loved event among runners in Twente.
course_highlights: Natural cross-country courses in various natural areas of Twente
Distances range from 1 km for youth to 10 km for seniors and masters
A unique collaboration between six athletics clubs in the region
additional: Race numbers can be collected at locations such as Zwembad de Vijf Heuvels (Markelo). Changing rooms and toilets are available. For age categories, the reference date is the participant’s age at the final race for youth and at the first race for masters. The competition is made possible in part by local sponsors and six athletics clubs. A 2.5/5 km Canicross distance is also held during the Hulsbeekcross. The competition includes races such as Hessenheemcross, Wintercross, Oudejaarscross, Rutbeekcross, Hulsbeekcross and Dinkelcross, with results and standings available on the official website.

name: Maple Leaf Wintercup
organizer: GAC Hilversum en de Baarnse Atletiek Vereniging
description: The Maple Leaf Wintercup 2026, held on Sunday, November 1 at Bosbad De Vuursche in Baarn, is an atmospheric running and walking event set against a beautiful autumn backdrop. The race is organized by Gooise Atletiek Club Hilversum and Baarnse Atletiek Vereniging and offers challenging unpaved courses surrounded by autumn colors. There are various distances for both walkers and runners, including youth distances and recreational runs with and without a competition licence. The start and finish are on the atmospheric grounds around Bosbad De Vuursche, creating a fun and sporty atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Challenging unpaved course amid autumn colors
Long Cross of 9.5 km with 4 laps
Short Cross of 3.1 km with 2 laps
additional: Race numbers can be collected from October 25 through 31 at Run2Day Hilversum or on race day at race headquarters. There is no separate gender categorization for the Short and Long Cross. Pupils of the organizing athletics clubs can participate free of charge after registering via the contact form. There is a recreational run and a competition-licence run for the short and long cross. The courses consist of multiple laps depending on the distance. The course includes unpaved paths, with events such as Nordic walking, cross-country running and youth races; start and finish at Bosbad De Vuursche.

name: Spaarnwoudecross
description: The Mokum Cross Circuit is a series of four woodland cross-country races in the Amsterdam area, including the Spaarnwoude Cross, organised by Haarlem Atletiek in Spaarndam. Participants register for at least three of these races and have a chance to receive a fun keepsake. The main races have a ranking in which the best three results from the four races count. The circuit is made possible by a partnership of five Amsterdam athletics clubs and their sponsor.
course_highlights: Woodland cross-country races in the Amsterdam area
Four different locations: Spaarndam, Amsterdamse Bos, De Eenhoorn, Gaasperplas
A keepsake for participants in at least three races
additional: Participants in at least three races receive a keepsake. The fastest twenty men and women in the main races earn points for the overall ranking. The awards ceremony takes place at the first race of the season.

name: Van de Meerendonk Heidetrail
location: Gilde Sint Sebastiaan, Oirschot, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Van de Meerendonk Heath Trail is a beautiful recreational event across the expansive Oirschot heathland, suitable for runners and walkers. The routes are clearly marked with arrows, making it impossible to get lost. Water and fruit stations are available on all distances, and afterwards you can enjoy a friendly atmosphere with free coffee or tea and a treat. The event starts at Gilde Sint Sebastiaan in Oirschot, with several distances available for both running and walking.
course_highlights: Expansive woodland and heathland
Routes clearly marked with arrows
Water and fruit stations on all distances
additional: Start location: Gilde Sint Sebastiaan, Wintelresedijk 1, 5688GW Oirschot. Runners start between 8:30 and 9:30, walkers between 9:00 and 9:30. Toilet and changing facilities are limited; there are no showers. Free coffee or tea and a treat are available after the event until 13:00. Members of Atletiek Oirschot pay €5,00 for all distances when registering in advance. Registration and payment on the day are possible but discouraged. Routes are marked with arrows; water and fruit stations are available on all distances. Start time is between 8.30 and 9.30. There are no prizes. Free coffee and tea are provided after the event. Participation is at your own risk. Facilities are limited, with no showers.

name: Twiskemolenloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16.1 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 1500 meter

name: Landehof 4-Årstider Höstloppet 2026
description: Landehof 4-Årstider Höstloppet är en höstorienteringstävling som arrangeras av OK Landehof. Loppet bjuder på utmanande terräng med mörker, regn, rusk och hala rötter, vilket ger en äkta höstkänsla i skogen. Det är en traditionell tävling som lockar orienterare att testa sina färdigheter i svåra förhållanden. Deltagarna kan njuta av en spännande och naturnära upplevelse i Landehofsområdet under hösten.
course_highlights: Utmanande höstterräng med hala rötter
Löpning i mörker och ruskigt väder
Naturnära orientering i Landehofsområdet
additional: Startlista publiceras från fredag 30 oktober och uppdateras fram till sista anmälningsdag. Liveresultat och resultatlista finns tillgängliga. QR-koder finns för att enkelt dela inbjudan och anmälan med arbets- eller träningskompisar.

description: Frikarusellen is a traditional race series organised by IL Fri at Espeland sports ground in Arna. The course is 5 km long, officially measured for the first time in 2000 and again in 2018. It runs from north of the Londalskrysset junction to Gamle Haukeland station and back along the same route, finishing inside the sports ground. The series comprises several races throughout the season and is suitable for both young people and adults. Registration is available via EQ Timing, and race numbers are collected on race day.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course starting north of the Londalskrysset junction
Passes Gamle Haukeland station
Finishes inside Espeland sports ground
additional: Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. Race numbers are assigned when registering online and can be collected at Espelandshallen between 18:00 and 18:55. A licence fee applies in addition for participants over 13 without an annual licence. A fee of 50 kr applies if participants who have registered for all the races forget their race number. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no.

description: Frikarusellen is a traditional race series organized by IL Fri, starting and finishing at Espeland sports ground in Arna. The course is 5 km long, first officially measured in 2000 and remeasured in 2018. It runs from north of the Londalskrysset junction to Gamle Haukeland station and back along the same route. The series consists of several races throughout winter and spring and is suitable for both young people and adults. IL Fri offers a welcoming atmosphere and committed members, and the races are open to members and non-members alike.
course_highlights: 5 km officially measured course starting and finishing at Espeland sports ground
The route passes Gamle Haukeland station and returns along the same way
Races are held in Arna, Bergen, on several dates throughout the season
additional: Bib numbers can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A licence fee is added for participants over 13 without an annual licence. There is a 50 kr fee for forgetting your bib if you have registered for all the races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no.

name: MartinCrossen Trail Run
description: MartinCrossen Trail Run is a cross-country race starting and finishing at Voksenjordet in Oslo, inspired by the Martincrossen ski race and Martin Johnsrud Sundby. The race offers a unique course with challenging technical terrain, especially on the longest distance, which ends with a tough finish. The event takes place in the evening in November, and the darkness and use of headlamps on the 3 km and 8 km distances make for a special experience. The race is inclusive, with categories for children, young people, para-athletes, recreational runners and competitive runners. There will also be a show with pyrotechnics, flames, lights and music in the spirit of Martincrossen.
course_highlights: Trail running on challenging technical terrain
Start and finish at Voksenjordet
Evening race with headlamps required on the 3 km and 8 km distances
additional: The children’s race for ages 3–5 and the 500-metre para category are free and require no registration. Companions for para participants are free; contact mari@roail.no. Medals for all participants. A limited number of race bibs will be available for late registration, which opens on 2 November at 12:00.

description: Frikarusellen 2026/27 is held at Espeland sports ground in Arna and consists of six races on a certified 5 km course. The course starts north of the Londalskrysset junction, goes via Gamle Haukeland station and returns the same way, finishing inside the sports ground. The races are suitable for both young people and adults, with separate prices for members and age groups. The event has a long tradition and offers easy registration via EQ Timing, with race bibs distributed on race day.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course (first measured in 2000, revised in 2018)
Start north of the Londalskrysset junction, returning via Gamle Haukeland station
Finish inside Espeland sports ground
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Espelandshallen on race day between 18:00 and 18:55. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day. A licence fee applies for participants over 13 without an annual licence. There is a fee of NOK 50 for forgetting your race bib if you have registered for all the races. Results are published at www.eqtiming.no. Registration is open until 18:55 on race day; race bibs can be collected at Espelandshallen from 18:00 to 18:55.

name: Energiruset
description: Energiruset är ett familjevänligt kvällslopp som arrangeras i Mariebergsskogen i Karlstad. Deltagarna kan välja mellan två distanser, 2 km och 5 km, och springa, jogga eller promenera med pannlampa genom de nedsläckta stigarna. Loppet är en energifylld kväll där man trotsar höstmörkret och sprider gemenskap och rörelse. Efter loppet bjuds alla deltagare på korv med bröd som en trevlig avslutning.
course_highlights: Loppet går i Mariebergsskogen med delar av banan utan belysning
Möjlighet att springa eller gå med pannlampa på 5 km-distansen
Familjevänlig atmosfär med både tävlingsklass och öppna starttider
additional: Det finns en tävlingsklass på 5 km med preliminär starttid 18:00. För övriga deltagare är banan öppen under kvällen med möjlighet att starta när man vill inom angivet tidsintervall. Pannlampa kan köpas vid anmälan.

name: Ledlenser Nightrun Bergen
location: Fløysletten, Fløibanen Upper Station, Bergen, Norway
description: Ledlenser Nightrun Bergen is a unique trail race held in the dark, where all participants run with headlamps. The race offers an exciting experience along Bergen’s forest trails at night, with reflective markers along the course to help runners. Separate men’s and women’s categories are held across several age groups, and all participants receive a medal. The race has a sociable atmosphere, with luggage storage available and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Trail race through dark forest trails
The course is marked with reflective markers
Headlamps are required
additional: Ledlenser provides a limited number of headlamps for testing and loan during the race, available on a first-come, first-served basis. Self-service luggage storage is available in the start area. There are separate men’s and women’s categories for ages under 25, 25–39, 40–54, and over 55. All participants receive a medal and can enter a draw for spot prizes. A headlamp is required; reflective markers along the course help you find your way. Race numbers can be collected at Löplabbet Bergen, Strandkaien 6, November 1–3, 10:00–19:00, or at the race venue from 17:00 on race day. Self-service luggage storage is available in the start area.

name: Nightrun Oslo
description: Ledlenser Nightrun Oslo is an exciting night race held at the Norwegian School of Sport Sciences by Sognsvann. The race offers an atmospheric experience, with headlamps lighting the trail and reflective markers along the course helping participants find their way. There are separate categories for men and women in different age groups, and all participants receive a medal and the chance to win great raffle prizes. The event has a social atmosphere, with self-service baggage storage and race bib collection in advance.
course_highlights: Night race with headlamps and reflective markers
Course by the Norwegian School of Sport Sciences at Sognsvann
Separate men’s and women’s categories in several age groups
additional: Ledlenser will have a limited number of headlamps available for testing and borrowing during the race on a first-come, first-served basis. There is self-service baggage storage in the start area, and the baggage tag from your race bib must be attached to your bag. Prizes will be awarded to the top three men and women overall. Age categories are Under 25, 25–39, 40–54, and Over 55. The start is listed as 18:00. A headlamp is required, and trail shoes are recommended. A limited number of headlamps are available to borrow. Race bib collection is planned at Löplabbet Oslo from 8–10 November and at the start venue on race day.

name: 7e Pepernotenrun
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16 km, 10 km, 5.5 km, 2.1 km, 1.4 km, 0.7 km

name: NightRun Rijssen
description: The NightRun Rijssen takes place in the evening and offers a unique experience as participants run through the center of Rijssen, past beautiful buildings and businesses. It is not a race, but is all about fun and the experience, with a magical atmosphere created by the lighting and evening setting. There are several distances: a 1 km kids’ run, a 5 km walking or running route, and a 10 km route for the more dedicated participants. The start and finish are in the center of Rijssen, with a rolling start to keep participants moving smoothly.
course_highlights: Run through the center of Rijssen during late-night shopping
The route goes right through buildings and businesses
Magical, festive atmosphere with lighting and evening decorations
additional: Start and finish in the center of Rijssen at 'T Schild (next to Pearle). Rolling start in small groups to keep participants moving smoothly. The finish is at Lucky, Morsweg 8. No timekeeping and no competitive element. There is an opportunity to warm up at NightRun Borne on 9 October. The event takes place during late-night shopping in the center of Rijssen; it is not a race and focuses on fun and the experience. Participants are illuminated as they make their way through the streets and enjoy a festive atmosphere.

name: Samnanger Vinterkarusell - 1. løp
description: Samnanger Winter Series is a social and inclusive running series organised by Samnanger IL Running Group, with races held approximately every other Friday at Nesodden throughout the winter. Participants can choose between 2 km and 5 km courses, with the 5 km course officially measured by NFIF. The races suit all levels, from beginners to experienced runners, and focus on the joy of running and community. The start and finish are at Nesodden, and participants are encouraged to wear reflective gear because of the winter darkness. The Winter Series is a great opportunity to stay in shape and take part in a welcoming running community.
course_highlights: Race at Nesodden, with the start and finish at the same place
Choose between 2 km and 5 km courses; the 5 km course is officially measured by NFIF
Races are held approximately every other Friday during the winter at 19:00
additional: The running group is informal, free, and open to all levels. Wearing a reflective vest is recommended because of the winter darkness. The Winter Series is held approximately every other Friday at 19:00 at Nesodden.

name: Flutlicht-Crosslauf und OWL Crossmeisterschaften
location: Crosspark am Sportplatz Lüchtringen, Lüchtringen, Höxter, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: Der Flutlicht-Crosslauf in Lüchtringen ist eine traditionsreiche Veranstaltung, die zusammen mit den OWL-Crosslaufmeisterschaften ausgetragen wird. Der Lauf findet im Crosspark am Sportplatz Lüchtringen statt und bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern eine anspruchsvolle Crosslaufstrecke unter Flutlicht. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Athletinnen und Athleten aller Altersklassen und Leistungsniveaus und ist ein Highlight im regionalen Laufkalender.
course_highlights: Crosslaufstrecke im Crosspark am Sportplatz Lüchtringen
Lauf unter Flutlicht
Austragung der OWL-Crosslaufmeisterschaften
additional: Die Anmeldung erfolgt per E-Mail mit einer selbst erstellten Excel-Tabelle nach Vorlage an meldung@lf-luechtringen.de. Es gibt keine bearbeitbare Excel-Datei zum Download. Die Veranstaltung wird vom Verein Leichtathletikfreunde Lüchtringen 1983 e.V. organisiert. Die Veranstaltung umfasst zugleich die OWL Crossmeisterschaften.

name: Batavia Night Run
description: The Batavia Night Run is an atmospheric running event held on Friday evening in the illuminated Batavia Quarter in Lelystad. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and kids’ runs of 800 and 1,500 metres. The course runs through the historic, atmospheric area around Museum Batavialand, creating a unique nighttime running experience. The organisers also support the Stichting ALS Nederland charity.
course_highlights: Course through the atmospheric, illuminated Batavia Quarter
Distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km
Kids’ runs of 800 and 1,500 metres
additional: Registration includes participation in the atmospheric night run. A Batavia Night Run shirt and cancellation insurance can be ordered as extras. The organisers work with photographers and videographers to create promotional images. Participants must comply with the applicable traffic regulations and RIVM guidelines. Night run with registration available; charities involved; the event combines sport and entertainment in an atmospheric setting

name: 28e Nacht van OLAT / Kennedy Trail
description: The 28th Nacht van OLAT/Kennedy-Trail takes place in Oirschot, the Netherlands. Participants can choose from three distances: 110 km, 80 km and 55 km, with start times in the evening and at night. The route combines paved and unpaved paths, with extensive refreshment stations and a pasta meal for the 110 km and 80 km runners after the night stage. All participants must finish by 19:00 on Saturday. They receive a certificate, with the option to purchase a medal for an additional fee.
course_highlights: The route is partly paved and partly unpaved, with longer unpaved sections during the day
Extensive refreshment stations with food and drinks
Pasta meal for 110 km and 80 km participants after the night loop
additional: Start times: 110 km at 20:00; 80 km and 55 km at 23:00. Registration opens about an hour before the start. Dogs are not allowed. Medal optional for an additional fee.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Rebild Kildeløb
Jämjöhalvan och Jämjöhallenstafetten
location: Jämjö, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Jämjöhalvan och Jämjöhallenstafetten är ett breddlopp i Jämjö med distanser från barnlopp till halvmara. Loppet går på en lättlöpt och publikvänlig varvbana med en blandning av asfalt och grus, och är seedningslopp för Göteborgsvarvet. Jämjöhallenstafetten är en stafett där fyra personer tillsammans springer halvmara. Start och mål är nära Jämjö Kunskapscentrum, och loppet erbjuder en gemenskap för löpare i alla åldrar och nivåer.
course_highlights: Varvbana med fyra varv för halvmara, två varv för 10 km och ett varv för 5 km
Banan består av 40 % asfalt och 60 % grus med hårt underlag
Start och mål nära Jämjö Kunskapscentrum, cirka 2 mil öster om Karlskrona
additional: Starterna sker på olika platser beroende på distans. Halvmaraton och stafett startar 11:00, 10 km startar 11:10, 5 km och ungdomsklasser startar 11:15, barnloppet startar 13:15. Stafettlagen kan mixas fritt och växling sker med stafettpinne i anslutning till varvningen. Banan har högertrafik och löpare uppmanas hålla till höger om de inte springer snabbt.

name: Skanneloppet
description: Skanneloppet är ett individuellt löplopp som arrangeras i Åstorp med tre olika banor anpassade för alla åldrar och nivåer, från elit till motionär. Loppet startar med cirka 10 löpare varje minut och erbjuder distanser på 3,9 km, 7,6 km och 17,3 km. För tävlingsklasser krävs medlemskap i en förening ansluten till Svenska Friidrottsförbundet eller motsvarande. Nummerlappar hämtas på tävlingsdagen från kl 08.00 på Tingvalla nöjespalats i Åstorp. Sjukvård finns tillgänglig under loppet.
course_highlights: Tre banor: grön 3,9 km, blå 7,6 km och röd 17,3 km
Vätskekontroller längs banan
Individuella starter med ca 10 löpare per minut
additional: Nummerlappar hämtas på tävlingsdagen från kl 08.00 på Tingvalla nöjespalats, Vramsvägen 9 i Åstorp. De som anmäler sig innan 24 oktober får sitt namn tryckt på nummerlappen. Ingen efteranmälan på plats. Start sker individuellt med cirka 10 löpare varje minut.

images.alt_text: IS Skanne-logotyp från inbjudan till Skanneloppet.
Löpare vid start och mål för Skanneloppet i Åstorp.

name: Kroppefjäll Trailrun
description: Kroppefjäll Trailrun är en nattlöpning genom Kroppefjälls vilda natur i Dalsland där deltagarna springer i lag om 2-3 personer. Loppen erbjuder flera distanser för alla nivåer, från nybörjare till erfarna traillöpare, och bjuder på en unik upplevelse där samma stigar ger två helt olika intryck i dagsljus och mörker. Banorna är kuperade och markerade med reflexer för att underlätta löpning i mörkret. Efter loppet serveras mat och deltagarna kan njuta av bastu och ett kallt dopp i tjärnet.
course_highlights: 60% singeltrack och helt obanat
Banor genom kuperad terräng, skog och naturliga stigar
Banorna är markerade med reflexer för löpning i mörker
additional: Start sker i lag om 2-3 personer med bussar till respektive startplats. Överdragskläder lämnas vid start och transporteras till målområdet. Mat ingår i startavgiften och serveras vid målgången. Efter loppet finns möjlighet att bada i storbastu och ta ett kallt dopp i tjärnet.

name: Iron Backbone Ultra
description: Iron Backbone Ultra är ett utmanande trailäventyr som går längs Järnleden, ryggraden i Kristinehamns trailnät. Loppet bjuder på tekniska stigar och novembermörker, vilket skapar en tuff och spännande utmaning för både pannben och vilja. Deltagarna kan förvänta sig en gemenskap och en naturupplevelse i vacker terräng. Loppet arrangeras av Topp & Dröm, som brinner för att göra träning och tävling tillgängligt och roligt för alla nivåer.
course_highlights: Tekniska stigar längs Järnleden i Kristinehamn
Löpning i novembermörker med utmanande väderförhållanden
Naturnära trailäventyr med fokus på pannben och vilja
additional: Obligatorisk utrustning inkluderar pannlampa, mobiltelefon med nödnummer, första förband, nummerlapp, vindjacka och reflexväst (undantag för 16 km-klassen). Rekommenderad utrustning är bland annat löparryggsäck, vätska, varma kläder, extra energi och överlevnadsfilt. Loppet är begränsat till 150 deltagare och genomförs i november med krav på att deltagarna är rätt utrustade för rådande väder- och terrängförhållanden.

name: Fagerstrand Backyard Ultra Maraton
description: Fagerstrand Backyard Ultra Marathon is organized by Fagerstrand IF at Myklerud in Fagerstrand. A new 6.7-kilometer loop starts every hour, and the race follows the “last man standing” format. Runners choose their own pace and how to manage their effort between loops, while the challenge continues until one runner remains or the competition is decided after 12 loops. The race offers a social setting, with a banquet for participants and their companions.
course_highlights: 6.7-kilometer loops with a new start every hour
“Last man standing” format, with the competition decided after 12 loops if more than one runner remains
Start and event venue at Myklerud, Fagerstrand
additional: Banquet for runners and their companions; banquet tickets are sold separately. A limited number of tickets is listed for 2026.

name: Fedrelandet Backyard
price_range: 500 kr, pluss eventuell engangslisens på 50 kr
description: Fedrelandet Backyard is a backyard race in Fetsund where you can choose between 6 or 12 hours of running. A new 6.7-kilometer lap starts every hour, and you must finish it before the hour is up to continue. The flat course runs mainly on gravel roads, with some sections of asphalt. Take on an endurance challenge where you decide how long you keep going.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km lap that starts over every hour
Choice of 6- or 12-hour format
Flat course mainly on a gravel path, with some sections of asphalt
additional: Previous editions have had changing rooms, toilets and a kitchen at Fethallen, parking by the football field, and are about a 10–15-minute walk from Nerdrum station.

name: Limes- Winterlaufserie - 1. Lauf über 10 km
description: The Limes Winter Running Series is a three-part winter running series in Pohlheim. The first race, a 10 km run, forms the basis for the overall standings. The series attracts runners from the region, particularly from the Lahn-Dill district, and has a long tradition, with its 49th edition taking place in 2026. The race offers a great opportunity to compete with other runners during the colder months and kick off the winter running series.
course_highlights: 10 km run through Pohlheim, Watzenborn-Steinberg
Part of a three-race winter running series
Popular race with regional participation, particularly from the Lahn-Dill district
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, usually rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Please check the details with the organizer before registering. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge in a wintry atmosphere. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and also provides results and participant lists.

name: TSV Bayer 04 Talent- und Speed-Cross
description: The TSV Bayer 04 Talent and Speed Cross in Leverkusen is an established cross-country race, serving in particular as a talent scout event for school-age categories up to U16, as well as for the U18 and older age groups. The event is a regular fixture on the Nordrhein Cross Cup calendar and features a varied course on the grass auxiliary field at the Fritz-Jacobi-Anlage. With a tight schedule and exciting races, including cross sprints, it offers an engaging experience for both participants and spectators. The event is attracting growing numbers of participants and is accompanied by good catering and professional commentary.
course_highlights: Varied course on the grass auxiliary field at the Fritz-Jacobi-Anlage
Part of the Nordrhein Cross Cup for age groups M/W 11 to 15
Exciting cross sprints, particularly in the U18 category
additional: The event saw an increase of almost 200 participants. Good catering and professional commentary are provided. The races follow one another in a tight schedule. Dates in November 2026; cross-country race as part of the Nordrhein Cross Cup; various age groups; competition on unpaved terrain.

name: Westerwinkellauf
location: Wasserschloss Westerwinkel, Ascheberg-Herbern, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Westerwinkellauf is a traditional fun run around Westerwinkel moated castle in Ascheberg-Herbern. The course runs mainly along park paths and offers scenic surroundings. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ages and uses modern Race Result timing. The start and finish areas are at the sports and swimming hall in Herbern. Local partners provide refreshments, and professional commentary helps create a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course runs mainly along park paths around Westerwinkel moated castle
Start and finish at the sports and swimming hall in Herbern
Scenic running surroundings with good facilities
additional: Timing is provided by Race Result using a disposable chip attached to the race bib, which is collected at the finish. No refunds for non-participation. Parking is available in the schoolyard of Mariengrundschule. Commentary by Janik Broszeit from Dortmund. Refreshments for participants and spectators provided by Getränke Zimmermann. Courses, start times, site map, registration, results, certificates, running and walking categories, participation for school groups, free participation for registered pupils.

name: 14. Sollingquerung

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Preis von 45€ inklusive Duschen, Toiletten, Getränke und warme Mahlzeiten im Ziel

description: Die Sollingquerung ist ein anspruchsvoller GPS-gesteuerter Lauf von Bad Karlshafen nach Dassel, der am 6. November 2027 stattfindet. Die Strecke ist nicht ausgeschildert, sodass die Navigation per GPS erforderlich ist. Die Teilnehmerzahl ist auf 100 begrenzt, und der Start erfolgt um 9:00 Uhr nach einem gemeinsamen Bus-Transfer von Dassel nach Bad Karlshafen. Im Startpreis sind warme Duschen, Toiletten sowie Getränke und warme Mahlzeiten im Ziel enthalten.
course_highlights: Strecke von Bad Karlshafen nach Dassel
Keine Streckenausschilderung, Navigation nur per GPS
Versorgungsposten entlang der Strecke
additional: Startnummernausgabe am 6.11. zwischen 17:00 und 17:30 Uhr und am 7.11. zwischen 6:30 und 7:30 Uhr. Busabfahrt um 7:45 Uhr am Stadion an der Lehmbreite in Dassel (Navi: Lessingstraße).

name: 6. Weserbergland Backyard Ultra
description: Der Weserbergland Backyard Ultra ist ein einzigartiges Ultralaufevent in Höxter, Nordrhein-Westfalen, das nach dem Backyard-Format ausgetragen wird. Die Teilnehmenden laufen stündlich eine Runde von 6,706 Kilometern, bis nur noch ein Läufer übrig bleibt. Das Rennen zeichnet sich durch spannende Duelle, persönliche Grenzerfahrungen und eine starke Gemeinschaft aus. Die Veranstaltung zieht jährlich zahlreiche Ultraläufer an, die sich der Herausforderung stellen, immer wieder die gleiche Runde zu absolvieren.
course_highlights: Stündliche Runden von 6,706 Kilometern
Lauf durch das Weserbergland mit anspruchsvollen Passagen, z.B. am Heiligenberg
Lang andauernde Grenzerfahrung mit wechselnden Licht- und Wetterbedingungen
additional: Es gibt eine 24/7 Livekamera im Start-Zielbereich, die Start- und Zieleinläufe ohne Moderation zeigt. Für das Event werden spezielle Laufshirts angeboten. Die Veranstaltung findet im November statt, mit Dämmerung ab 17:00 Uhr und Dunkelheit ab 18:00 Uhr, was besondere Anforderungen an die Läufer stellt.

name: Dorstener Sparkassen Crosslauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 2 km, 1500 Meter, 1 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km
description: Der Dorstener Sparkassen Crosslauf ist ein traditionsreicher Crosslauf in Dorsten, der von Leichtathletik Team Dorsten e.V. veranstaltet wird. Die Strecke führt durch abwechslungsreiches Gelände mit natürlichen Hindernissen und bietet Läufern aller Altersklassen eine anspruchsvolle Herausforderung. Die Veranstaltung wird von der Sparkasse Vest Recklinghausen unterstützt und ist bekannt für ihre familiäre Atmosphäre und die Förderung des Breitensports. Der Lauf ist ein fester Bestandteil des regionalen Laufkalenders und zieht sowohl Hobby- als auch Leistungsläufer an.
course_highlights: Naturnahe Crossstrecke mit abwechslungsreichem Gelände
Herausfordernde Passagen mit Wassergraben und weiteren Hindernissen
Stimmungsvolle Atmosphäre mit familiärem Charakter
additional: Die Strecke ist als PDF-Streckenplan verfügbar. Es gibt keine auf der Website veröffentlichte Preis- oder Anmeldeinformationen für den Crosslauf 2027. Die Veranstaltung ist Teil eines umfangreichen Wettkampfkalenders des Leichtathletik Teams Dorsten.

name: Heseper Martinslauf
description: The Hesepe Martinslauf is a popular athletics competition in Groß-Hesepe, held annually in November. Organized by SV Groß Hesepe, it offers various categories for children, young people, adults and masters. The event includes races of approximately 8,870 m and 3,000 m, as well as competitions for children and young people, offering both an athletic challenge and a community experience. After the race, participants can look forward to a sociable atmosphere with refreshments and special activities.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in the natural surroundings of Groß-Hesepe
Routes of approximately 8,870 m and 3,000 m
A variety of categories for all age groups
additional: The event takes place in November, with registration by email and various competition classes for children, young people, adults and masters. After the race, there is often a sociable gathering with refreshments.

name: Pokallauf
description: Der Pokallauf "Rund um Marienberg" ist ein traditionsreicher Laufwettbewerb, der in der Region Marienberg stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Streckenlängen, darunter 5 km und 10 km, die jeweils auf einer 2,5 km Runde gelaufen werden. Die Technik variiert je nach Altersklasse, mit klassischer Technik für die Jüngsten und freier Technik ab der Altersklasse U10. Die Veranstaltung wird vom ATSV Gebirge/Gelobtland e.V. organisiert, einem generationsübergreifenden Breitensportverein.
course_highlights: 5 km und 10 km Strecken auf einer 2,5 km Runde
Klassische Technik für U6-9 mit Doppelstart
Freie Technik ab U10 mit Doppelstart
additional: Die Ausschreibung wird nicht aktualisiert. Änderungen in Technik und Streckenlänge sind aufgrund der aktuellen Schneeauflage möglich.

name: SCC Cross Country
description: The SCC Cross Country is a forest race in Berlin at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage in Westend. Two clearly defined cross-country routes are offered: 4 km for U16 through adults and 9 km for U18 through adults; both races start in the morning. The event is deliberately straightforward and is aimed at club runners, young athletes and adults who want to run short off-road loops, setting it apart from the city’s major road races. The course follows paved and unpaved forest paths, where rhythm, sure footing and a fast finish matter more than scenic views. Awards go to the top three in each age and gender category, and there is a prize for the fastest final lap for men and women.
course_highlights: Forest race on paved and unpaved forest paths
Two routes: 4 km for U16 through adults, 9 km for U18 through adults
Focus on rhythm, sure footing and a fast finish
additional: Entry is free for SCC members. Late registration is available shortly before the start for an additional fee. An archive of results is available to document the race. The event takes place at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage on Harbigstraße in Westend, Berlin-Charlottenburg. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with rainy days. Forest race on paved and unpaved forest paths, entry fee for non-members, late registration for an additional fee, November weather around 7 °C, rainy.

name: Schkölener Stadtparklauf
description: Der Schkölener Stadtparklauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die vom TSV 1885 Schkölen und dem SSV Friedrich-Schiller-Gymnasium Eisenberg organisiert wird. Der Lauf findet im Sportplatz Schkölen statt und bietet verschiedene Streckenlängen für Kinder, Jugendliche und Erwachsene. Die Veranstaltung legt Wert auf eine klare Altersklassentrennung und richtet sich an Läufer aller Altersgruppen. Der Start erfolgt am Vormittag, und die Strecken führen durch den Stadtpark mit unterschiedlichen Rundenlängen.
course_highlights: Strecken im Stadtpark Schkölen mit kleinen, mittleren und großen Runden
Altersgerechte Distanzen von 0,6 km bis 5 km
Kombination aus kleinen und großen Runden für längere Distanzen
additional: Die Altersklassentrennung erfolgt nach Kalenderjahren, z.B. gehört ein 6-jähriger Läufer (Geburtsjahr 2020) zur AK 6. Die Veranstaltung findet jährlich statt und ist Teil der regionalen Leichtathletik-Wettkampfplanung.

name: Sparkassen-LüneCross
description: Der Sparkassen-LüneCross ist ein spannendes und herausforderndes Crosslauf-Event inmitten der Natur von Lüneburg, das Läufer:innen aller Leistungsniveaus anspricht. Die abwechslungsreiche Strecke führt über sandige und wurzelbewachsene Pfade, Wiesen, Waldwege und Schotterpisten und fordert Ausdauer, Kraft und Lauftechnik heraus. Neben den Hauptläufen über 4 km und 8 km gibt es auch kürzere Strecken für Kinder und Jugendliche sowie Staffelwettbewerbe, die ein gemeinschaftliches Teamerlebnis ermöglichen. Für das leibliche Wohl ist gesorgt, und nach den Läufen findet eine Siegerehrung mit geselligem Beisammensein statt. Der Spaß am Laufen und die Gemeinschaft stehen im Vordergrund dieses besonderen Events.
course_highlights: Abwechslungsreiches Gelände mit sandigen und wurzelbewachsenen Pfaden
Streckenführung über Wiesen, Waldwege und Schotterpisten
Staffelwettbewerbe mit 3 bis 6 Läufern als Teamevent
additional: Es gibt eine Schulwertung mit Preisen für Schulen mit der höchsten Teilnehmendenquote. Nach den Läufen findet eine Siegerehrung und gesellige Runde statt.

name: Offene Kreismeisterschaft im Crosslauf des NLV Kreis Göttingen
20 Gminne Biegi z okazji Święta Niepodległości
Vestingstad Run
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10.5 km, 10.43 km, 5.2 km, 5.13 km, 2 km, 1.2 km, 0.8 km, 0.4 km

name: De Najaarsloop van Cialfo
description: The AV Cialfo Autumn Run is a running event held in Epe and organized by AV Cialfo. The run takes place on Wachtelenbergweg and offers participants a great opportunity to be active in the autumn in a sporty and welcoming atmosphere. Pre-registration is available until the end of October, with on-the-day registration open until 30 minutes before the start. The event attracts runners from the region and is part of the local sporting calendar.
course_highlights: Location on Wachtelenbergweg in Epe
Autumn running event
On-the-day registration available until 30 minutes before the start
additional: Pre-registration is open through 27 October via inschrijven.nl. On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before the start of the run. Run at Wachtelenbergweg, Epe; date has already passed; registration via online platform.

name: Dorpsrun Renswoude
description: The Dorps Run Renswoude offers a suitable distance for every runner, from beginners to experienced athletes and young participants. You can run individually or register as a team for the business competition. The event is known for its friendly, sporty atmosphere in the village of Renswoude, with routes through the surrounding area. Previous editions sold out quickly, so registering early is recommended.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon, consisting of two laps of the 10.5 km route
10.5 km route through the village and surrounding area
1 km Kids Run for young runners
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day from 11:30 until half an hour before the start. A timing chip is attached to the back of each race number. All participants receive a medal after the event. Showers and changing rooms are available at De Hokhorst sports hall. Photos of the event will be posted on the website a few days later, without names and with respect for privacy. Parking is available near De Hokhorst, a short walk away. The nearest train station is Veenendaal/De Klomp, with bus connections to Renswoude. Registration for the Kids Run is also possible on the day. Start times: half marathon at 13:45, 10 km at 14:00, Kids Run at 12:30.

name: Duifpoldertrainingsloop
description: The Duifpolder training run is a small-scale running race through the beautiful Duifpolder between Schipluiden and Maasland. Organised in spring and autumn by De Hardloper Schipluiden, the event offers three distances: 3.5 km, 7 km and 11.7 km. The race starts at 14:00 at the Trambrug in Schipluiden, close to the registration and changing venue. It’s an accessible event and ideal for training, with a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to chat afterwards in the IJsclub Vlietland clubhouse.
course_highlights: Small-scale race through the Duifpolder between Schipluiden and Maasland
Three distances to choose from: 3.5 km, 7 km and 11.7 km
Start at the Trambrug, close to the registration venue and clubhouse
additional: Registration takes place at the IJsclub Vlietland clubhouse, Zouteveenseweg 2a, Schipluiden. Registration opens at 12:45. Changing facilities and toilets are available, but there are no showers. Drinks are available in the clubhouse after the race. Start location: Trambrug, Schipluiden; no shower facilities; drinks available after the race

name: Salbam Lemelerbergloop
description: The Salbam Lemelerbergloop is a challenging cross-country race held on the Lemelerberg near Ommen. The race is part of the Vechtdal Cross Competitie and offers several distances: a 2 km youth race and approximately 6 km and 12 km races for adults. The course is entirely off-road and hilly, with significant elevation changes in the Lemelerberg nature reserve, the largest nature reserve managed by Landschap Overijssel. The race is ideal for runners who enjoy a challenging trail run in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Entirely off-road course
Hilly terrain with significant elevation changes
Lemelerberg nature reserve near Ommen
