additional: Start times: 2 km youth race at 12:30, 6 km at 13:00, 12 km at 14:00. The race is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competitie, which consists of five races in total. To be eligible for the overall win, participants must take part in and finish four of the five races. Several distances, start times for youth and adults, and part of a regional cross-country competition.

name: Schipholloop
location: Amsterdam Airport Schiphol, Haarlemmermeer, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Schipholloop returns as a unique running event around Amsterdam Airport Schiphol. With a rich history spanning more than 50 years, this 60-kilometre ultra offers a pure, partly self-supported trail experience focused on the experience and the challenge. Participants can choose from several distances, including a half marathon and the ultra, and enjoy a beautiful course through varied polder landscapes with breathtaking views. With a maximum of 100 participants, it is an exclusive and unforgettable run for long-distance runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Iconic 60 km ultra around the Haarlemmermeer polder
Beautiful, varied surroundings with unexpected and breathtaking views
Trail-style run with GPS navigation and full autonomy
additional: A maximum of 100 participants per edition. This is not a traditional race with tape and traffic marshals. The run is partly self-supported and trail-style, with GPS navigation and fixed checkpoints. A special tryout edition was held on 23 May ahead of the November edition. Limited to 100 participants, with amenities such as drop bags, aid stations with drinks and snacks, and finisher medals. The event highlights the experience and natural surroundings, and is organised as a private initiative and by AV Haarlemmermeer.

name: Waalbosrun
location: Bezoekerscentrum De IJsvogel, Rijsoord, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Waalbosrun is a fun and sporty running event organised by IJsclub Rijsoord in collaboration with De IJsvogel visitor centre. Participants follow a beautiful route through the Waalbos in Rijsoord, along green paths, waterways and wooded areas. The event is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners, with different distances for all ages. The start and finish are at the visitor centre, where supporters are welcome to cheer on the runners. Alongside sport, the event celebrates a friendly atmosphere and community spirit, and part of the proceeds go to charity.
course_highlights: A beautiful route through the Waalbos along green paths
Run alongside waterways and through wooded areas
Start and finish at De IJsvogel Visitor Centre
additional: There are three distances: the Kidsrun (approx. 1.8 km) starts at 12:00, the 10 km starts at 13:00, and the 5 km starts at 13:10. The start and finish are at De IJsvogel Visitor Centre. The event is suitable for all ages, and part of the proceeds go to charity. Participants contribute to a good cause; the event takes place in autumn, when cool and changeable weather is expected.

name: Zuidduinloop
location: Katwijk aan Zee, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Zuidduinloop is part of the Duinloopcircuit, a unique running series along the most beautiful coastal areas of the Netherlands. The race offers a varied course with challenging dune trails and fast beach sections, suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners. The atmosphere is always fantastic, and the event invites everyone to enjoy running outdoors. The Zuidduinloop takes place in Katwijk aan Zee and is part of a series of running events held throughout the year.
course_highlights: Varied course with dune trails and beach sections
Unique coastal setting in Katwijk aan Zee
Suitable for a range of ages and abilities
additional: There are rankings for all distances, separated into girls/women and boys/men, based on the four best results in the circuit. Race in Katwijk aan Zee, with various distances including short kids’ runs and longer races, plus GPX routes and results.

name: AV Passaat cross
distance_verbose: 6 km, 3000 meter, 2.5 km, 2 km, 1.6 km, 1.2 km, 1 km, 0.8 km

name: Knallende Kilometer
location: Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas, Bergschenhoek, South Holland, Netherlands
description: De Knallende Kilometer is a unique running event organized by Athletics and Walking Association De Kieviten, held at Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas in Bergschenhoek. It uses a time-trial start, with each runner setting off individually at 30-second intervals, so you can run a fast kilometer on a straight, flat course. Instead of a medal, you’ll receive a delicious pancake or a warm bowl of pea soup as a reward. The event is open to both competitive runners and recreational runners looking to enjoy a friendly run.
course_highlights: Straight, flat 1000-meter course on the cycle path above the Rottemerentunnel
Start near the ‘Zwijnenplaats’ car park and finish near the ‘Mollenplaats’ car park
Individual time-trial start at 11:00, with a new runner starting every 30 seconds
additional: Collect your race number at Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas. The best place to park is Mollenplaats. After the finish, you’ll get a pancake or a bowl of pea soup at the restaurant. Participants will receive their start time by email one week before the event. Entries on the day are not possible, and participation is limited. Flat 1000-meter course on the cycle path above the Rottemerentunnel, start at Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas, parking at Mollenplaats, advance registration required

name: Slangenburg trailrun
description: The Slangenburg Trailrun takes place at De Pokkershutte in IJzevoorde. This trail run takes you along winding forest paths and unpaved routes, surrounded by the beautiful autumn colors of Slangenburg Forest. Four distances are available, including a special Kidsrun for young trail runners aged 6 and up, and an official half marathon of 21.1 kilometers. The atmosphere is relaxed and focused on enjoying nature and outdoor exercise, with no awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Winding forest paths and unpaved routes
Autumn colors in Slangenburg Forest
Official half marathon route of more than 21 kilometers
additional: There are aid stations along the route with drinks and refreshments. First aid is available during the trail run. Parents may accompany their child during the Kidsrun, provided they are registered themselves and have a bib number. After the event, every participant receives a free bowl of pea soup with rye bread and bacon. Free parking is available at the venue. There is no awards ceremony; the focus is on having fun and enjoying nature. Drinks and refreshments are available for purchase at De Pokkershutte afterward. Trail through forests, online registration, start and finish at De Pokkershutte, free parking, parents may accompany children, no awards ceremony

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Winter Running Series 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series connected with the traditional Rund um Wellen event. It is organized by the local running club, which also runs the historic Wellen Marathon, one of the oldest marathons in Germany. The event offers a welcoming, family atmosphere, various distance options, and strong local support from volunteers, sponsors, and the local fire brigade. The organizers aim to preserve the event’s well-established challenge and familiar character.
course_highlights: Part of the long-standing Rund um Wellen event, with four distances
Rural, family-friendly atmosphere, organized by a local club
Strong local support from volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather: average 7 °C (minimum 2 °C) with frequent rain (45 mm of precipitation). Start location: Beverstedt-Wellen. Terrain: mixed. Registration: not specified. Further notes: Part of the Rund um Wellen event, with local support and volunteers involved.

name: Hohen Neuendorfer Herbstlauf
description: The Hohen Neuendorf Autumn Run is a traditional running event that has been held in Hohen Neuendorf since 1900 and is considered the birthplace of cross-country running in Germany. The run attracts numerous participants from the region and beyond each year and offers distances for all age groups, from a children’s run to longer distances. The event brings generations together and is supported by many volunteers and local partners. It traditionally takes place in November and is a fixture on the regional sporting calendar.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country run with a history dating back to 1900
Participants spanning generations, from age 3 to over 90
Support from local clubs and reservists along the course
additional: The run includes various distances, including a 400-metre children’s run and a 5.5 km course. The event is supported by many volunteers, including the Roter Adler Reservists from Lehnitz. The Autumn Run is one of the largest running events in the Oberhavel district and attracts participants from various regions. It takes place at the Rudolf Harbig sports ground and is weather-dependent. Registration is via MyRacepartner. The event is known for its historical significance in cross-country running in Germany and promotes a sense of community through sport.

name: Lop dwasch dörn Wildenloh
location: Wildenloh bei Oldenburg, Landkreis Oldenburg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: Lop dwasch dörn Wildenloh is a traditional cross-country run held in early November on the beautiful fitness trail in Wildenloh, west of Oldenburg. The name means “Run across Wildenloh” and reflects the event’s rustic character: it takes place in the forest, without showers. The event is organised by the sports club Team Laufrausch e.V., which creates a friendly, nature-oriented running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on the local fitness trail in Wildenloh
Rustic forest course without showers
Traditional event with regional character
additional: The run takes place on a rustic forest course without showers. Several distances are offered (short course: 1600m, middle course: 3200m), and results from previous years are available. The event is organised by the sports club Team Laufrausch e.V. The run is held annually in November. There are no showers on site, results are published, and categories include children and adults.

name: Martins-Crosslauf
description: Der Martins-Crosslauf in Krefeld ist eine traditionsreiche Crosslaufveranstaltung, die jährlich im November stattfindet. Die Strecke führt durch die landschaftlich reizvolle Hubert Houben Anlage und bietet Läufern aller Altersklassen eine sportliche Herausforderung in naturnaher Umgebung. Organisiert vom Verein Preussen Krefeld Leichtathletik e.V., richtet sich der Lauf an Kinder, Jugendliche und Erwachsene und fördert die Leichtathletik in der Region.
course_highlights: Lauf durch die Hubert Houben Anlage mit abwechslungsreichem Terrain
Naturnahe Strecke mit Wald- und Wiesenpassagen
Geeignet für alle Altersklassen von Bambini bis Erwachsene

name: Refrather Herbstlauf
location: Königsforst, Bergisch Gladbach-Refrath, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Refrath Autumn Run is a traditional running classic in the Königsforst near Bergisch Gladbach-Refrath, held annually since 1986. The event offers 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon races, all measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists. The routes pass through the autumn forest and feature out-and-back courses with challenging yet scenic sections. The race attracts both competitive runners and recreational participants, and awards ceremonies for all age groups follow shortly after the finish.
course_highlights: Out-and-back courses through the autumnal Königsforst
DLV-measured routes over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon
Scenic forest paths with challenging sections
additional: Start times: 5 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00, half marathon at 12:30. Awards ceremonies take place shortly after runners finish. Parking is available on Rather Weg, about 1.2 km from the Bensberg exit of the A4. Public transport: take KVB line 1 to “Refrath”. Participants can register online. The routes are gently rolling, with an elevation difference of about 6 m for the 5 km race and 20 m for the 10 km race. The event has been a fixture on the region’s running calendar for many years.

name: RWW-Herbstwaldlauf
description: The RWW Herbstwaldlauf in Bottrop is a long-standing race. It is part of the International Marathon and Ultra Cup and offers various distances for beginners and experienced runners. The event takes place at Jahnstadion, where the Herbstwaldlauf tradition has been rooted since 1973. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge amid picturesque woodland scenery, bringing together community and a passion for running.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque woodland landscape of Bottrop
Start and finish at the historic Jahnstadion
Part of the International Marathon and Ultra Cup
additional: The cutoff time for all races is 15:30. A human sweeper is on hand to provide support. T-shirts can be ordered in advance. The event takes place at Jahnstadion, where the training groups of Adler-Langlauf Bottrop are also active. The race takes place in November, with routes through woodland and nature, and offers a friendly club atmosphere for runners of all levels.

name: Süderelbe Halbmarathon durch das Alte Land
price_range: 20 Euro Halbmarathon, 18 Euro 10 km, 5 Euro Kinderlauf
description: The 50th Süderelbe Half Marathon through the Altes Land takes place. The route starts at the CU Arena by Neugraben S-Bahn station, runs through the Altes Land to Neuenfelde, and then returns. Alongside the half marathon, there are also 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km walking event, and a 1.2 km children’s race. The event is organized by Hausbruch-Neugrabener Turnerschaft von 1911 e.V. and offers a varied program for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the CU Arena, Neugraben S-Bahn station
Route through the scenic Altes Land to Neuenfelde
Return to the starting point along the same route
additional: The program includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km walking event, and a 1.2 km children’s race. The organizer is Hausbruch-Neugrabener Turnerschaft von 1911 e.V., with office hours Mon–Fri 09:00–11:00 and Mon–Thu 16:00–18:00. Route through the Altes Land, various race distances, children’s race, walking event, course closes at 12:30, parking at the P+R facility at Neugraben S-Bahn station, race numbers available on event day, refreshments along the route, medals and certificates for participants.

name: Waldkater Cross
description: The Waldkater Cross is a small but challenging cross-country race in Weyhe, Lower Saxony, held on forest trails. The event offers various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including 1.2 km, 2.4 km, 4 km and 8.4 km. The routes pass through natural terrain, making the race a special challenge. The race is organised by SV Weyhe, with support from the 2026 Cross-Country Series, and is a popular opportunity for runners of all ages to combine nature and competition.
course_highlights: Race on forest trails in natural surroundings
Various distances for all age groups
Part of the 2026 Cross-Country Series in Weyhe

name: Westfalenparklauf
location: Westfalenpark Dortmund, Dortmund, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Lauftreff Bittermark Dortmund, LT Bittermark Dortmund, Dortmunder Volksbank
description: The Dortmunder Volksbank Westfalenparklauf is a sporting event in Westfalenpark Dortmund that welcomes runners of all ages. The event offers various distances, including Bambini, children’s and main races over 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, with electronic timing. The course is measured by the DLV and runs through the beautiful Westfalenpark. All finishers receive medals, and the fastest runners are honored. The event prioritizes safe and fair race operations, with medical support and refreshments in the finish area.
course_highlights: Course through Westfalenpark Dortmund, with the start and finish at the Ruhrallee entrance
DLV-measured courses of 2.5 km (1 lap), 5 km (2 laps) and 10 km (4 laps)
Electronic timing and a lead bicycle in the main races
additional: Race-number collection is available on race day until 45 minutes before each start. There are no changing facilities, but bags can be stored at the owner’s risk. Headphones, dogs and strollers are not allowed. The Bambini race is untimed; participants receive a certificate only. Awards go to the top three men and women in the 5 km and 10 km races, as well as age-group winners. Medical support is available on the course and in the start/finish area. A lead bicycle accompanies the 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km races. This is a local event with a traditional character, including finisher medals, online registration and medical support on the course. Certain participation rules apply, including no dogs or umbrellas.

name: 3TuermeWEG TRAILRUN
location: Hagen Stadtwald, Hagen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 3TürmeWEG Trailrun is a timed trail race organized by TV Hasperbach 1898 e.V. in cooperation with Hagen.Wirtschaftsentwicklung. The course runs through Hagen City Forest and follows the well-known 3TürmeWEG Premium Hiking Trail. Along the way, runners pass three historic towers and a fallow deer enclosure and enjoy numerous scenic views. The course has been evaluated by the International Trail Running Association (ITRA) and is part of the National League 2026. A guided course preview run with historical commentary takes place every August.
course_highlights: The course runs counterclockwise past three historic towers: Kaiser-Friedrich-Turm, Bismarckturm, and Eugen-Richter-Turm
Runs through Hagen City Forest, with a fallow deer enclosure and numerous viewpoints
Evaluated by ITRA and part of the National League 2026
additional: A guided course preview run with historical commentary takes place on the third Thursday of August each year. The course is available as a GPX file for runners to follow on their own.

name: Robert-Hannemann-Volkslauf 2026
description: Der Robert-Hannemann-Volkslauf ist ein traditionsreicher Crosslauf, der jährlich im herbstlichen Glacis von Minden stattfindet. Die Strecke führt durch eine landschaftlich reizvolle Umgebung nahe der Weserpromenade und bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre am Weserstadion. Der Lauf ist bekannt für seine angenehme Stimmung und zieht Läufer aller Altersklassen an. Die Veranstaltung wird vom SV 1860 Minden e.V. organisiert, der eine große Leichtathletikabteilung mit vielfältigen Trainingsangeboten betreibt.
course_highlights: Crosslauf durch das herbstliche Glacis von Minden
Start und Ziel am Vereinsheim an der Weserpromenade
Familiäre Atmosphäre am Weserstadion
additional: Der Lauf findet traditionell im November statt und ist bekannt für gutes Wetter und eine angenehme Stimmung. Die Strecke wurde zuletzt angepasst, um durch schattige Bereiche des Glacis zu führen. Die Veranstaltung ist Teil des vielfältigen Leichtathletikprogramms des SV 1860 Minden.

name: Steinhart500 – KLIMANEUTRAL
description: Der Steinhart500 ist ein anspruchsvoller Marathonlauf in Steinfurt, der am 7. November 2027 stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung ist klimaneutral und legt großen Wert auf Umweltschutz, unter anderem durch das Pflanzen von Bäumen entlang der Strecke als CO2-Ausgleich. Neben dem klassischen Marathon gibt es auch kürzere Strecken von 28 km, 14 km und 7 km, wobei die 7 km Runde besonders für Laufeinsteiger mit 50 Höhenmetern geeignet ist. Flex-Tickets ab 28 km ermöglichen es den Teilnehmern, während des Laufs zu entscheiden, ob sie früher ins Ziel einlaufen möchten und trotzdem gewertet werden. Die Strecke führt durch abwechslungsreiches Gelände mit einem markanten Hügel zur Finnenbahn.
course_highlights: Klimaneutrale Veranstaltung mit CO2-Ausgleich durch Baumpflanzungen entlang der Strecke
Flex-Tickets ab 28 km erlauben vorzeitiges Zieleinlaufen mit Wertung
7 km Runde mit 50 Höhenmetern, ideal für Laufeinsteiger
additional: Alle Tickets ab 28 Kilometern sind Flex-Tickets, die während des Laufs eine flexible Zielentscheidung ermöglichen. Die 7 km Strecke führt über einen Hügel zur Finnenbahn und ist mit 50 Höhenmetern etwas anspruchsvoller. Die Veranstaltung findet im Rahmen des Turnerbund Burgsteinfurt e.V. statt, der vielfältige Sportangebote bietet.

name: 50. Hermann-Löns-Park-Lauf
description: Der Hermann-Löns-Park-Lauf in Hannover-Wülferode ist ein traditionsreicher Straßen- und Volkslauf, der jährlich Anfang November stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Streckenlängen von 400 m bis 10 km, die offiziell vom Deutschen Leichtathletik-Verband vermessen sind. Die Läufe führen durch den Hermann-Löns-Park und bieten eine attraktive Strecke mit Start und Ziel am Annabad-Gelände. Die Veranstaltung wird von der TKH-Laufgruppe organisiert und zeichnet sich durch eine familiäre Atmosphäre und eine professionelle Zeitnahme aus.
course_highlights: Offiziell vermessene 5 km- und 10 km-Strecken nach DLV-Standards
Start und Ziel auf dem Gelände des Annabads in Hannover-Kirchrode
Vielfältige Streckenlängen von 400 m bis 10 km für alle Altersklassen
additional: Startnummern sind mit 2€ Pfand verbunden, das nur bei unbeschädigten Nummern zurückerstattet wird. Spikes sind nicht erlaubt und können zur Disqualifikation führen. Die Veranstaltung findet bei jedem Wetter statt.

name: Braunschweiger Speed5
description: Der Braunschweiger Speed5 ist ein schneller Volkslauf in Braunschweig, der vom Polizeisportverein Braunschweig und dem Braunschweiger Laufclub veranstaltet wird. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine hohe Teilnehmerzahl und zahlreiche Rekorde aus, darunter Landes- und Deutsche Bestleistungen. Der Lauf findet auf einer schnellen Strecke statt und zieht sowohl ambitionierte Läufer als auch Laufbegeisterte aus der Region an. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit großartiger Organisation und viel Unterstützung durch Helfer und Zuschauer.
course_highlights: Schnelle 5-km-Strecke in Braunschweig
Rekordverdächtige Leistungen mit Landes- und Deutschen Bestleistungen
Veranstaltung auf dem Gelände des Polizeisportvereins Braunschweig
additional: Nachmeldungen sind bis 1 Stunde vor Start des jeweiligen Laufs möglich mit einer Nachmeldegebühr von 3 € pro Athlet. Das Stadion verfügt über einen Kunststoffbelag und darf nur mit Spikes bis 6 mm betreten werden. Es gibt Einzel- und Staffelwertungen sowie verschiedene Altersklassen.

name: Mausebergecrosslauf
description: The Mauseberge Cross-Country Run is an autumn cross-country race held in the Mauseberge Forest near Husum in northern Germany. The course follows natural forest trails over uneven terrain, with mud and several climbs. The event is organized by the athletics department of Husumer Sportverein and is a long-standing fixture on the regional race calendar.
course_highlights: Natural forest trails in the Mauseberge Forest
Uneven, muddy terrain
Several climbs
additional: The start is in Husum, and the venue can be reached by car. Typical November weather averages 7 °C (minimum 2 °C), with frequent rain (about 45 mm of precipitation). The race takes place in November in typical autumn weather, with temperatures around 2–7 °C and rain. Registration with the organizer is recommended. Places are available for various distances, including 1 km, 3.35 km, 5 km, 6.67 km, and 8.33 km.

name: Quickborn Run über 5 km und 10 km
description: Der Quickborn Run ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die 2027 bereits zum 48. Mal stattfindet. Angeboten werden Läufe über 5 km und 10 km, die am Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Gymnasium in Quickborn starten. Für Familien mit kleinen Kindern gibt es eine Kinderbetreuung, sodass Eltern entspannt teilnehmen können. Die Veranstaltung richtet sich an Läufer ab 12 bzw. 14 Jahren und bietet eine freundliche Atmosphäre mit Umkleidemöglichkeiten und kostenfreien Parkplätzen.
course_highlights: Start und Ziel am Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Gymnasium in Quickborn
Läufe über 5 km und 10 km
Kinderbetreuung während der Veranstaltung
additional: Startunterlagen werden von 8:00 bis 10:30 Uhr ausgegeben. Die Zeitmessung erfolgt mit einem kostenlosen Leihchip. Umkleidemöglichkeiten sind in der Sporthalle vorhanden. Kostenfreie Parkplätze stehen an der Sporthalle und im Parkhaus am AKN-Bahnhof zur Verfügung. Es gelten die Regeln der Deutschen Leichtathletik Ordnung.

name: Wernigeröder Armeleuteberglauf
description: The Wernigeröder Armeleuteberglauf is a challenging trail run in November, starting and finishing at Haus Blume in Wernigerode. The course takes runners to the Kaiserturm and offers a varied challenge with narrow forest trails, muddy sections, and steep climbs. Alongside the main races of 5.4 km and 10 km, there are also children’s races of 1 km and 2.1 km. The event is organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V. Wernigerode and, with around 160 participants, is a popular local tradition that also includes a pasta party on the eve of the race.
course_highlights: Trail run on narrow forest trails
Steep climbs to the Kaiserturm
Muddy and fast downhill sections
additional: The event includes four distances: 1 km and 2.1 km for children, and 5.4 km and 10 km for the main races, which start together later in the morning. Trail character with challenging climbs; registration by email; pasta party on Saturday evening at the Waldgasthaus Armeleuteberg.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Academy of Physical Education and Sport (AWFiS), Gdańsk, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide cross-country running series covering 5 km and held in seven locations, including the Tricity (Gdańsk and Gdynia). The races take place in forests and urban parks, giving participants the chance to compete outdoors in a natural setting. The series consists of four races at each location, with results combined for the overall standings. The races are open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with the appropriate permission. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests and urban parks
Tricity location: Gdańsk Forest District, Tricity Landscape Park near the Gdańsk University of Physical Education and Sport
Regular schedule and consistent race-office locations
additional: A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. The race office opens at 8:30; race numbers and timing chips can be collected on race day. Participants with a season pass can take one free start in another city after notifying the organizers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start. In the 2026/2027 season, CITY TRAIL races in the Tricity are held in Gdańsk and Gdynia.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, free running and Nordic walking league held on the scenic routes of the Międzyzdroje Municipality. In the 2026/2027 season, participants compete over distances of approximately 5 and 10 km in the running events, and 5 and 7 km in Nordic walking. The league is known for its friendly, family atmosphere and healthy competition, welcoming both returning participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete at least four events at the required distances. The events are open to people over 14, and participation is free.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 5 and 10 km for runners
Routes of approximately 5 and 7 km for Nordic walkers
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participation is free. Participants must be at least 14 years old; minors may take part with written permission from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be included in the league standings, participants must enter and complete at least four events at the required distances (two 5 km and two 10 km running events, or two 5 km and two 7 km Nordic walking events). The series includes several events during the season; participation in at least four is required for the overall standings. Registration is handled through ProTiming24. Participant age: 14 and over; minors need written permission from a parent or guardian.

name: Plantsoenloop
description: The Plantsoenloop Groningen is the oldest and most beautiful running race in Groningen, suitable for all ages, with four different distances. This atmospheric event takes place on a beautiful hilly course through the Noorderplantsoen. This 68th edition is a true running classic that should not be missed.
course_highlights: A beautiful hilly course
Run through the Noorderplantsoen
Four different distances for all ages
additional: Four different distances, course through the Noorderplantsoen, organised from Sportcentrum Kardinge

name: LoveLife Run Deventer
description: LoveLife Run Deventer is a special running event where (former) cancer patients take part alongside their loved ones and healthcare providers. Participants can choose to walk or run 1 or 5 kilometres, with the aim of reaching the finish at their own pace, without timekeeping. Special training sessions are offered by experienced running coaches from AV Daventria 1906 to help participants prepare. Proceeds from the event go to groundbreaking cancer research and local causes at Deventer Hospital, the Oncology Knowledge Centre and IPSO Centre Salland. Everyone is welcome to take part, including people who have never had cancer.
course_highlights: 1- and 5-kilometre routes around Deventer Hospital and the Brinkgreven grounds
Wheelchair-accessible routes for both 1 km and 5 km
Start and finish at Radiotherapie Groep, next to Deventer Hospital
additional: Participants receive a mandatory LLR shirt, which is handed out on the day. There is no timekeeping; the aim is to reach the finish. The event is organised by a local team of volunteers and supported by running coaches. Participants are advised to travel sustainably by bike or public transport. Participation is at your own risk. Participants are encouraged to use sustainable transport and wear an LLR shirt provided by the organisers. The event is free for participants and raises funds for cancer research and local causes.

name: AV Salland Crossloop Raalte
location: Landgoed ’t Reelaer en Raalterwoold, Raalte, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The AV Salland Crossloop in Raalte is a challenging cross-country race that has been held around Schouwburg 't Hoftheater since 2009. The route passes through the wooded estate of 't Reelaer and the rolling terrain of Raalterwoold, with approximately 90% unpaved paths. The course includes woodland sections, avenues, meadows with elevation changes and sometimes muddy stretches, making for a varied and demanding running experience. There are short youth races and more challenging 5 and 10 kilometre distances, and the race is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit.
course_highlights: Approximately 90% unpaved paths
Routes through the estate of 't Reelaer and Raalterwoold
Woodland sections, avenues, meadows with elevation changes and muddy stretches
additional: Construction activity is visible around the Hoftheater, offering an extra glimpse of the surroundings. Results and course records are kept, and past results are available through the race administration. The race offers various distances, including 5 and 10 km, as well as short youth races. The course is characterised by natural, often muddy paths and varied scenery.

name: AVW Dijkgatboscross
distance_verbose: 10 km, 6 km, 4 km, 2.5 km, 1500 meter, 1 km
description: The AVW Dijkgatboscross is a cross-country running event organized by Atletiekvereniging Wieringermeer in Wieringerwerf. The race offers a challenging course through Dijkgatbos, suitable for different ability levels and ages. The organizers are known for creating a friendly, sporting atmosphere, welcoming both young people and adults. AV Wieringermeer encourages people to exercise together at every level and offers expert guidance.
course_highlights: A course through Dijkgatbos on natural terrain
Suitable for both young people and adults
Organized in a friendly, sporting atmosphere
additional: Participants can register on race day; the venue offers a natural and challenging setting for runners; the race is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Zeijer Strubbenloop
price_range: €9,- voorinschrijving, €10,- op de dag, kinderen gratis
description: The Zeijer Strubbenloop takes place for the 15th time in Zeijen. The race offers a scenic 5-kilometre route through the area around Zeijen, while the 10-kilometre race consists of two laps of this route. The start is at the village green by Café Hingstman. The 10-kilometre race is part of the Univé Loopcircuit De Kop van Drenthe, and prizes are awarded to the fastest women and men in both the 5- and 10-kilometre races. The day begins with kids’ races for different age groups and ends with the prize ceremonies inside Café Hingstman.
course_highlights: 5-kilometre route through the scenic area around Zeijen
The 10-kilometre race consists of two laps of the 5-kilometre route
Start and finish at the village green by Café Hingstman
additional: Late registration is available on the day between 11:00 and 13:30 at Café Hingstman; cash only. Race numbers will be ready for collection at the race office and will not be sent out. The kids’ race starts at 12:30, with different age groups; the 5- and 10-kilometre races start at 14:00. The prize ceremony takes place inside Café Hingstman. Registration is available via inschrijven.nl until 8 November; start and finish at Café Hingstman.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
price_range: €4-€20 per race of voor het hele seizoen
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held annually in Zeewolde and organized by TVZ Zeewolde. The event offers several distances, including 1, 2, 5 and 10 kilometers, with the longer distances consisting of multiple laps. It attracts both recreational and dedicated runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic routes around the RCN camping area. The Flevo Fun Run is a great opportunity for athletes of all levels to enjoy running together in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Routes of 1, 2, 5 and 10 km, with multiple laps for the longer distances
Start and finish at RCN camping Zeewolde
Varied course suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The 10 km distance consists of 2 laps of 5 km. The 2 km distance consists of 2 laps of 1 km. The Flevo Fun Run is part of a club competition. Photos and results from previous editions are available via the organizer’s Facebook page and photo page. Participants receive a medal, registration is required, and there are several age categories. The event promotes enjoyment of running and community connections.

name: Klaazienaveen SportBOXX Oosterbosrun
location: near Trambrug over de Koning Willem Alexander Kanaal, Klazienaveen, Drenthe, Netherlands
description: The SportBOXX Oosterbosrun, organised by Loopgroep Klazienaveen, is an annual running race held in the autumnal Oosterbos near Klazienaveen. Participants can choose between two distances, 5 km and 10 km, which are clearly marked with arrows and ribbons. The start and finish are near the tram bridge on Meester Ovingstraat. Prizes are awarded to the top senior and veteran runners, with a bonus for breaking the course record.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal Oosterbos
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Route marked with arrows and ribbons
additional: Registration is open in advance only, until Saturday 8 November at 18:00; registration on the day is not possible. Children aged 15 and under can take part in the 5 km for free. There are no changing or shower facilities. Participants run at their own risk. Gift vouchers from SportBOXX will be raffled among participants. The start and finish are near the tram bridge at Meester Ovingstraat 87.

name: NSL Nederzandt cross
location: Nederzandt Langevelderslag, Noordwijk, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The NSL NederZandtCross is a challenging running race held at Nederzandt Langevelderslag. This first edition combines elements of a trail run and a competitive race, with a course through dunes, beach and forest. The race offers three distances: 3.8 km, 10.2 km and 16.6 km. The course consists largely of unpaved paths and features significant elevation changes. The event is organised jointly by NSL and Vrijstaat Nederzandt and focuses on challenge and performance, with timing.
course_highlights: Course through dunes, beach and forest
Mostly unpaved paths with significant elevation changes
Beach section reminiscent of a trail run
additional: Start times: 11:00 for the middle and long distances, 11:10 for the short distance. Information and emergency phone number during the event: 0613-344747.

name: Docfacross
description: The Docfacross is part of the AV Oss '78 Cross Competition, a series of six small-scale, accessible running races in and around Oss. The races take place on beautiful unpaved courses suitable for beginners and experienced runners of all ages. The competition offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere where participants can compete with others and enjoy running in nature. The Docfacross takes place and invites everyone to join this challenging cross-country race.
course_highlights: Unpaved courses in and around Oss
Suitable for young and old, beginners and experienced runners
Part of a series of six small-scale cross-country races
additional: The cross-country competition consists of six races. Taking part in at least four races gives participants a chance to be included in the final standings. The races are accessible and offer a friendly, sporting atmosphere. No specific start time or price information for the Docfacross is listed on the website.

name: 15e Scopias Klein Zwitserlandcross
description: The Scopias Klein Zwitserland Cross is an annual cross-country race held in the countryside around Tegelen, near Speelpark Klein Zwitserland. The event is part of the Limbra Cross Competition and offers challenging courses for various categories. New in 2025 is a pilot walking event through the Jammerdal nature reserve, with 6 km and 12 km routes. The organisers create a friendly atmosphere with award ceremonies and extra activities for children.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the countryside around Tegelen, near Speelpark Klein Zwitserland
Walk through the Jammerdal nature reserve, with 6 km and 12 km routes
Part of the Limbra Cross Competition
additional: The award ceremonies for the long and short cross are held separately; the long-cross award ceremony takes place immediately after the short cross starts. Participants can update their details after registering and switch between the long and short cross. No advance registration is required for the walk; participants can register on site. Children can swap toys at special exchange boxes along the route. The race is open to all levels, and on-site registration is available. The event is part of the Limbra Cross Competition and is known for its friendly atmosphere and good facilities.

name: AVH Cross
description: The AV Haarlemmermeer Cross is a challenging cross-country race held in often harsh weather conditions such as frost, mud, rain, and snow. The event is open to everyone and offers several distances, including a 1 km lap for the youngest athletes, a 2.5 km sprint cross for older juniors, and recreational races of 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km. This cross-country race is a true test of strength, combining technique, speed, and endurance, and is part of the popular RunX Haarlem Cross Circuit.
course_highlights: Cross-country course with mud, grass, and turns
1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances
Held in harsh weather conditions such as frost, rain, and snow
additional: The cross is part of the RunX Haarlem Cross Circuit. Several distances are available for different age groups and ability levels. The event is organized by AV Haarlemmermeer, an athletics club that also offers training groups and trial sessions. No explicit start time or pricing information is listed on the website. The race takes place in Haaksbergen and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. A range of distances is offered, making the event appealing to a broad audience.

name: Thorbecke / KWF run
description: The Thorbecke KWF Run in Zwolle is an annual running event where students, teachers, parents and local residents come together to raise money for cancer research. The event symbolizes cooperation, energy and involvement within the school community. The run is a festive and meaningful activity that helps support the Dutch Cancer Society (KWF Kankerbestrijding).
course_highlights: A gathering of students, teachers, parents and local residents
A running celebration at Thorbecke Scholengemeenschap in Zwolle
An initiative focused on raising money for cancer research
additional: The run is part of a broader KWF initiative in which schools and associations take action against cancer. There is a strong emphasis on creating a personal fundraising page to collect donations and involve the community. The run symbolizes a shared commitment to cancer research and building engagement within the school. The event serves as both a running celebration and a school fundraiser, with the aim of raising money for cancer research. The proceeds increase each year, with recent totals exceeding 17,500 euros.

name: Necon Vinterkarusell 26-27 løp 2 (16. nov)
description: Necon Winter Series is a winter running series with 8 races throughout the winter. Participants can choose between 5 or 10 km. The start and finish are at Fana Stadium in Bergen, and the races start at 18:45. Races are held on Mondays from October to April, with discounts available for IL Gneist members. Registration is individual through EQ-timing, and members of the athletics groups with a valid licence may participate for free.
course_highlights: 5 or 10 km race
Start and finish at Fana Stadium
Evening races starting at 18:45
additional: Discounts for IL Gneist members: free for athletics members who pay the main club membership fee and training fee (code Gneist00), 50% off for Gneist recreational members (code Gneist50), and 25% off for other Gneist members (code Gneist25). An annual licence must be selected during registration, otherwise a fee of 50 kr applies. Registration is through individual sign-up in EQ-timing. Without an annual licence, a fee of 50 kr is charged at registration.

name: Ledlenser Nightrun Sandnes
description: Ledlenser Nightrun Sandnes is a night race that starts and finishes at Gramstadtunet in Sandnes. The course offers varied terrain, with gravel and challenging trails featuring rocks, bogs and planks during the first 3 kilometres. It then continues on gravel and finishes on asphalt back to the finish line. The race has separate categories for men and women in different age groups, and all participants receive a medal. Ledlenser offers headlamps for testing and loan during the race, making for an exciting and challenging night-running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Gramstadtunet
3 km of challenging terrain with rocks, rough trails, bogs and planks
The final section is on gravel and asphalt back to the finish
additional: Ledlenser offers a limited number of headlamps for testing and loan during the race on a first-come, first-served basis. Self-service bag storage is available in the start area, using the baggage tag from your race number. There are separate men's and women's categories for the age groups under 25, 25–39, 40–54 and over 55. Prizes go to the top three men and women overall, and all participants receive a medal. Start at 19:00. Race numbers are distributed at Löplabbet Sandnes, Vågsgaten 16, and at the start venue on race day. A limited number of headlamps are available to borrow or test.

name: Olympisch Stadionloop 2026
location: Olympisch Stadion, Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
price_range: € 16,50 (voor bedrijfs- en scholierenloop, inclusief €2,50 naar UNICEF)
description: The Olympisch Stadionloop 2026 takes place on November 8 at the iconic Olympic Stadium in Amsterdam. Organized by Athletics Club Phanos in collaboration with Run2Day, this running event includes an 800-meter race for children and 5- and 10-kilometer races for individuals, school groups, and corporate teams. The routes pass through the Olympic Stadium and Amsterdamse Bos, and the race is part of Rondje Mokum 2026. The Olympisch Stadionloop combines sport with a good cause, as participants run in support of UNICEF.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Olympic Stadium in Amsterdam
5- and 10-kilometer routes through Amsterdamse Bos
800-meter children’s race inside the Olympic Stadium
additional: Start times are subject to change: 10:30 for the 800m race for children up to age 8; 10:45 for the 800m race for children aged 9–12; 11:15 for the 5 km individual race, school race, and corporate teams; 12:30 for the 10 km race and corporate teams. Participants in the 5 km and 10 km races can start in designated start pens. Race numbers are distributed before the race. Medals and water are available after the finish. AV Phanos may use photos and video footage for communications. Registration is via online forms; changing rooms and showers are available for teams. The event is part of a series of local runs and takes place in and around the Olympic Stadium in Amsterdam.

name: Dammekärr Dirt Dash
location: OK Alehof klubbstuga, Dammekärr, Nödinge, Ale Municipality, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deltagande är gratis för medlemmar i OK Alehof

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Övriga betalar 199 kr för tre deltävlingar

description: Dammekärr Dirt Dash är en terränglöpningsserie i Dammekärr, arrangerad av orienteringsklubben OK Alehof. Tävlingen består av tre deltävlingar med gemensam poängberäkning, där deltagarna kan välja att springa en, två eller alla tre lopp. Banorna går i kuperad skogsterräng och erbjuder tre distanser: 1,5 km, 3,5 km och 7,0 km. Efter målgång finns möjlighet till varm bastu och fika i klubbstugan, vilket skapar en trivsam atmosfär för löparna.
course_highlights: Kuperad skogsterräng runt Dammekärr
Kort bana (1,5 km) på elljusspåret
Längre banor (3,5 km och 7,0 km) kräver pannlampa
additional: Tidtagning sker med SportIdent-bricka, som kan lånas på plats om man inte har egen. Alla lopp avgörs på kvällstid. Efter loppet erbjuds varm bastu och fika med kaffe, saft och hembakat i klubbstugan.

name: Ledlenser Nightrun Kristiansand
description: Ledlenser Nightrun Kristiansand is a night race starting at FantOlsen. The varied course follows gravel paths and trails through Baneheia and Ravndalen and around Bånetjønn, before finishing back at the starting area. The race is suitable for all age groups, with separate men’s and women’s classes, and all participants receive a medal. Held in November, it offers an atmospheric experience. Headlamps are available to borrow so you can light your way along the course.
course_highlights: The course follows gravel paths and trails through Baneheia and Ravndalen
Scenic surroundings around Bånetjønn and 3. stampe
Start and finish at FantOlsen, with easy access to parking and buses
additional: Ledlenser offers a limited number of headlamps for testing and borrowing during the race, on a first-come, first-served basis. Race numbers are distributed at Löplabbet Kristiansand several days before the race and on race day from 17:00. There are separate men’s and women’s classes in the age groups under 25, 25–39, 40–54 and over 55. All participants receive a medal and can enter a draw for prizes. The starting area has a large car park, and bus no. 10 stops nearby. Start time: 19:00. A headlamp is required; a limited number are available to borrow. Self-service bag storage is available at the starting area. Race numbers are distributed at Löplabbet Kristiansand, Markens gate 17, and at the race venue from 17:00 on race day.

name: Refleksløpet Arendal, Fossbekk
location: Fossbekk parking, access road between Krøgenes and Longum, Arendal, Norway
description: Refleksløpet i Arendal er et stemningsfullt løp som arrangeres ved Fossbekk i Arendal. Løpet byr på to distanser, en kort løype på 4,8 km og en lang løype på 7,8 km, med starttidspunkt kl. 18:00 og 18:05. Det er også mulighet for å gå uten tidtaking med start kl. 17:00. Sekretariatet åpner kl. 16:30 for påmelding og utdeling av startnummer. Løpet oppfordrer til å bruke hodelykt, og det tilbys rabatt på lykt hos Brekke sport i forbindelse med påmelding.
course_highlights: To distanser: 4,8 km (kort løype) og 7,8 km (lang løype)
Start ved Fossbekk parkering, på tilførelsesveien mellom Krøgenes og Longum
Løpet foregår i mørket, og bruk av hodelykt anbefales
additional: De 30 første påmeldte får mulighet til å vinne en Mizuno-bag. Det er 15 kr i gebyr i tillegg til startkontingenten. Det tilbys 15% rabatt på hodelykt hos Brekke sport ved påmelding. Hodelykt anbefales.

name: Karneval-Marathon
description: The Carnival Marathon in Cologne-Pesch combines a passion for marathon running with the enthusiasm of Cologne Carnival. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and follows a flat, paved loop around Pescher See, which participants run several times. The field is limited to 50, and costumes are expressly encouraged to add to the fun.
course_highlights: 15 laps of 2.732 km each, plus a 1.215 km out-and-back section at the start for the marathon distance
Flat loop around Pescher See in a protected landscape area
Refreshment station in the start/finish area, passed every 2.7 km
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 9:30 to 10:30 at the playground by Pescher See. Changing facilities, showers, and toilets are available at the nearby clubhouse of FC Pesch 1956 e.V. Timing is manual, by punching the lap numbers on each race number. After the race, there is Kölsch beer and a unique Carnival finisher's medal. The event is non-commercial, and proceeds are donated to Cologne Carnival associations. Course on a paved 2.7 km loop; no lighting or medical station; race numbers are limited (50); no refunds for non-participation or force majeure; participation from U20.

name: Hareskovens 4 årstider (4) Efterår 2026
description: Hareskovens Fire Årstiders Trailløb arrangeres årligt af Hareskovens Triathlon Klub i Lille Hareskov ved Værløse. Løbene afholdes over fire sæsoner med distancer på 5, 10 og 15 km, og der er start kl. 10:00. Der er både enkeltstående afdelinger og en samlet konkurrence med point og præmier til de bedste på hver distance. Løbene foregår i skovterræn og byder på en udfordrende og varieret trailløbsoplevelse.
course_highlights: Trailløb i Lille Hareskov ved Værløse
Distancer på 5, 10 og 15 km i skovterræn
Gennemgående konkurrence med point og præmier
additional: Der er præmier til hurtigste mænd og kvinder på hver distance i hver afdeling. En samlet konkurrence over alle fire afdelinger med pointafregning og præmieceremoni ved efterårsudgaven. Et 6-timers ultraløb afholdes i forbindelse med forårsafdelingen, hvor man løber så mange omgange som muligt på en ca. 5 km rundstrækning. Start og mål er ved kælkebakken på Skovlystvej i Værløse. Der tilbydes tidtagning og resultater via Sportstiming.

name: Ronjaløpet
description: This race offers a great opportunity to take part in a sporting event in scenic surroundings on Austevoll. The event spans two days, and tickets are sold via EQ Timing. The race is suitable for anyone looking for an active and social experience in November.
course_highlights: Held at Austevoll Sports Facility
The race takes place in scenic surroundings on Austevoll
additional: Listings give different dates in November 2026.

name: Morothon 2027
description: Morothon is a traditional cross-country race held annually in Søgne and has become an important event for both local and visiting runners. The race offers challenging courses and an inclusive atmosphere where everyone who finishes is considered a winner. With distances including Langmoro at 20 km, Kortmoro at 10 km, and a children’s race, Morothon is suitable for both recreational runners and elite athletes. The event has a long history dating back to 1992 and is organized jointly by Søgne Friidrett and Søgne Skiklubb. Morothon is known as the toughest cross-country race in Sørlandet and a celebration of community, endurance, and joy.
course_highlights: Cross-country race with demanding courses through forests and open countryside
Langmoro 20 km and Kortmoro 10 km distances
Start and finish in central Søgne, in a historic setting
additional: The youngest participants run for free. In the past, the courses were unmarked and required creative navigation. The participant record is around 400 runners. Organized jointly by Søgne Friidrett and Søgne Skiklubb.

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 1. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event held in the Buseck/Alten-Buseck region. It comprises several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon (21.1 km). The races each start at 2:00 p.m. at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck and offer a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. The series promotes a sense of community with a series classification for participants who take part in all three races. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the fastest runners follow the finish.
course_highlights: Course profiles for 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km are available on Komoot
Start and finish at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck
Timing with a passive transponder from Raceresult
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. There is a series classification for participants who take part in all three races in the series. After finishing, runners receive a complimentary soft drink. Coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at the Harbig Hall. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, recognising the three fastest participants (men/women) in each race on the day, as well as the age-group winners at the end of the series. Winter running series, cross-country character, several race distances, community event in November 2026

name: Bokeler 6 Stundenlauf
description: The Bokeler 6-Hour Run is an established ultramarathon challenge in northern Germany, held in Bokel, Schleswig-Holstein. Participants run a loop course approximately 3.67 kilometres long, completing as many laps as possible in six hours. The event attracts endurance athletes looking to test their limits and offers a family-friendly atmosphere in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 3.67 km loop course
Flat terrain in Schleswig-Holstein
Six-hour run with individually determined distance
additional: The course is a loop that runners complete multiple times. The event is a longstanding tradition and takes place annually. Results from previous years are available on the website. The race is held on a 2,040 m loop course, with a growing number of participants and a legendary refreshment buffet. A participant record was set in 2023, and the event was already fully booked well in advance for 2024. November weather is usually cool and rainy, adding to the challenge.

name: Gudensberger Crosslauf 2026 Hermann Kilian Gedächtnislauf
description: The Gudensberg Crosslauf Hermann Kilian Memorial Run is a long-standing cross-country race in Gudensberg, offering short off-road distances. The start and finish are on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool on Schwimmbadweg. The course runs mostly on unpaved paths, and spikes are allowed, emphasizing its classic cross-country character. The event commemorates Hermann Kilian, a dedicated runner and coach with TSV Obervorschütz.
course_highlights: Start and finish on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool
Course mostly on unpaved paths; spikes allowed
Three distances: 1000m (two small laps), 2000m (two large laps), 4000m (one longer lap)
additional: Depending on the event announcement, district championships may be included. Typical November weather is expected, with temperatures around 7 °C and rainy days. November is usually rainy; the terrain has a cross-country style. The event honors Hermann Kilian for his dedication to running.

name: Neusser Erftlauf
description: The Neuss Erftlauf is a traditional running event organized annually by DJK Novesia 1919 Neuss e.V. The 53rd edition is taking place and offers runners of various ability levels an attractive course along the Erft. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and the support of numerous sponsors. The 15 km main race is especially popular and has seen a strong increase in participants in recent years.
course_highlights: 15 km main race with a construction detour; the 5 km loop is eligible for record lists
Course along the Erft with varied terrain
Refreshment stations and refreshing drinking water at Durstlöscher
additional: The Erftlauf is supported by numerous volunteers, who help ensure smooth operations along the course, in the start and finish areas, and at refreshment stations. The event is supported by sponsors including the RheinLand Versicherungsgruppe, Stadtwerke Neuss, and other partners. There is a construction detour on the 15 km course, but the 5 km loop remains eligible for record lists. An extensive photo album is available online. Courses on paved paths and roads; spikes are not allowed. Online registration opens on 01.09.2025. Start times from 11:30 a.m. Medals for children; prizes in kind for winners. Limited parking; showers available.

name: Steverlauf
location: Sportpark Senden, Senden, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Steverlauf is an established running event held annually at Sportpark Senden, welcoming runners of all ages. The courses over 5 km and 10 km, officially measured by the DLV, run along park paths and paths beside the canal, offering an attractive running setting. Children and young people have a separate entry option at a reduced entry fee. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers changing and shower facilities, as well as refreshments including coffee, cake, soup and bratwurst. The organizing team looks forward to welcoming many participants and to a successful event.
course_highlights: Courses over 5 km and 10 km, officially measured by the DLV
Routes run along park paths and paths beside the canal
Changing and shower facilities at Sportpark Senden
additional: Refreshments including coffee, tea, cake, biscuits, soup and bratwurst provided by roterkeil Senden e.V. The event takes place in all weather conditions. No liability for damages. Changing and shower facilities are available. Routes pass through Schloss Senden, along the canal and through Königspark; there is a good supply of cake, drinks and hot food; the event can take place in any weather.

name: Wuppertaler Löwenlauf
description: The Wuppertal Löwenlauf is an exciting running event held in Wuppertal. Organized by Leichtathletik-Verband Nordrhein e.V., the race offers a challenging cross-country or forest course in a natural setting. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and promises a sporting experience in a motivating atmosphere. It is a great opportunity to experience Wuppertal’s running community and enjoy nature.
course_highlights: Cross-country/forest run in a natural setting
Challenging terrain for runners of different ability levels
Outdoor event in Wuppertal in November
additional: The race is a forest and cross-country event; details about course distance and registration are not specified.

name: Martinslauf
location: Unterbacher See, Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: SFD '75 e. V., pulsschlag, SC Grün Weiß Paderborn, Friedrich-Rister-Gedächtnislauf
description: The Martinslauf is being organized for the 48th time by SFD '75 e. V. around Unterbacher See in Düsseldorf. The event offers a variety of races for all age groups, including Bambini and youth races, an inclusion run, and Nordic walking. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and varied course, offering both sporting challenges and fun for the whole family. Award ceremonies for various age groups take place after the races, and participants can purchase a personalized finisher medal.
course_highlights: Loop course around Unterbacher See
A range of distances from 150 m to 10 km
Start and finish at Strandbad Süd on Unterbacher See
additional: Race packets can be mailed (for an additional fee of 4 EUR) or collected on site. Late registration is possible for a 3 EUR fee. Timing is done with a chip integrated into the race bib; there is no rental fee. Showers are available at the neighboring campsite. Free parking is available at Strandbad Süd and Strandbad Nord. A finisher medal engraved with the participant’s name and time can be ordered for 13 EUR and will be handed out on race day. The 10 km race cutoff is 13:15; the event ends at approximately 14:00. The Martinslauf combines fun runs, family events, and evening light runs, with a focus on running for fun, community, and a special atmosphere. Participation is at the participant’s own risk, with various race distances and activities for children and adults.

name: Landesoffener Crosslauf des KLV Segeberg
description: The KLV Segeberg open cross-country race takes place every November in Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park. It offers races for children, youth, adults and Masters, with distances ranging from approximately 625 m to 7.9 km. The event is open to runners from across Schleswig-Holstein. The course runs across meadows, parks and wooded areas, offering a varied alternative to traditional road or track races. The event is organised by KLV Segeberg and Kaltenkirchener TS, which also hosts it on site.
course_highlights: Distances of approximately 625 m to 7.9 km
The course runs through Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park, across meadows, parks and wooded areas
Open event with categories for children, youth, adults and Masters
additional: Typical November weather, around 7 °C, with rainy days. The event is part of the KLV Segeberg cross-country championship series, which also includes other local club venues in the Segeberg district. Cross-country running in November in typical rainy weather, with temperatures around 2–7 °C, on an outdoor course, suitable for trail running and cross-country fans.

name: Schoonhovencross
description: The Schoonhovencross takes place in Hollandscheveld and is organised by the De Snelle Rakkers foundation. The race is held around the recreational lake, and the course is entirely off-road, making it ideal for spikes. There are various distances for youth, the G group and adults, with prizes in different categories. After the race, participants can enjoy a cup of snert or a smoked sausage when they return their race number.
course_highlights: Entirely off-road course around the recreational lake
Suitable for running in spikes
Start and changing facilities at Schoonhoven hall and party centre
additional: Parking and changing facilities are available at Schoonhoven hall and party centre. When returning their race number, participants can choose between a cup of snert and a smoked sausage. Prizes are awarded in various age categories, as well as for women and men in different age groups. Registration is open until 7 November. Prizes are awarded in different categories. The start and finish are at Schoonhoven pavilion. The course is suitable for spikes.

name: Guldfeber Aarhus — Golden Fever #1
description:
Guldfeber — Danmarks første SplitRace-turnering. Et gratis løbsspil i Aarhus' gader: 12 segmenter (0,4–1,9 km) er tegnet rundt i byen, og 7 af dem danner en skjult "gylden kæde" — ingen ved hvilke, eller i hvilken rækkefølge. Find dem. Løb dem. Jag tiderne.

Ingen fælles start og intet startgebyr: du løber når du vil, så tit du vil, i hele perioden 17. oktober – 1. november. Appen måler dine tider via GPS. Du får point for hvert gyldent segment efter hvor tæt du er på den hurtigste tid — kvinder scores mod den hurtigste kvinde, mænd mod den hurtigste mand. Ekstra point til de første, der åbner et gyldent segment — og turneringens største bonus til de første, der fuldfører hele kæden i den rigtige rækkefølge.

Det er første udgave — en pilot for max 30 løbere. Din feedback former spillet.

(EN: A free city-wide running game in Aarhus. 12 segments, 7 of them secretly form a golden chain — find them and beat the clock. No mass start: run anytime 17 Oct – 1 Nov. Free entry, GPS timing in the SplitRace app. First edition, 30 pilot spots.)
additional: No start line and no start groups — all segments are on public, lit routes around Aarhus and you run them whenever you want during the event window. Participation requires the free SplitRace app (iOS / Android) — download via splitrace.app, join the "Guldfeber Aarhus" tournament and all 12 segments appear on your map. Limited to the first 30 runners. Open streets: follow normal traffic rules. Spørgsmål? Skriv til support@splitrace.app. or instagram https://www.instagram.com/split_race/

name: Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a running event in Gränsö Nature Reserve outside Västervik, offering technical and scenic trails, coastal rocky shorelines, and some of Sweden’s finest oak pastures around Gränsö Castle. Choose between 8 km and 15 km on well-marked courses, or let the children take part in Gränsö Kids Trail (up to age 12). The race offers both timed participation and Fun Run without timing, and encourages an enjoyable experience in nature—why not combine it with a spa visit at Gränsö Castle? Welcome to experience the Västervik archipelago at its best.
course_highlights: Coastal rocky shorelines and the cliffs of Skanvik along the course
Trails through sparse pine forest and valuable oak pastures, with technically varied sections
The 15 km course has a bonus loop on Ekholmen; the 8 km and 15 km courses join at the Kroken aid station
additional: The event center opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Castle. Start times: Gränsö Kids Trail 10:15, 8 km 11:00, 15 km 11:15. The first finishers are expected at approximately 11:35, and the finish closes at 13:45. Courses are marked with hanging red-and-white tape and signs; parts of the course follow existing hiking trails. Surface: mainly trails/hiking paths, with sections of rocky terrain, natural terrain, and short road stretches. Aid stations: one on the 8 km course and two on the 15 km course. All children receive a medal and refreshments after finishing. Registration is online and remains open until one hour before the start. 8 km and 15 km courses; online registration until one hour before the start; aid and hydration stations along the course; timed participation or Fun Run without timing; start times: 11:00 (8 km) and 11:15 (15 km); first finishers at approximately 11:35; finish closes at 13:45; spa option at Gränsö Castle.

It takes place amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Christinehof Castle in Andrarum, Skåne County, and has 500 metres of elevation gain.

name: Billingen Trail
description:
We invite you to enjoy running on Billingen. This year, the start and finish will be at the Stadium in the Billingen Recreation Area.
The long course is just over 47 km with approximately 930 metres of elevation gain. It goes all the way around northern Billingen, along beautiful trails by the edge of the mountain. As a runner, you’ll experience varied terrain, including deciduous forest, mountain ravines, meadows and spruce forest, as well as beautiful views across the landscape from several places. The surface varies from easy-to-run sections and approximately 6 km of asphalt to some more challenging parts.

The middle-distance course, 21 km, follows the northern section of the Billinge Trail and has approximately 500 metres of elevation gain. The course includes a mix of trails, meadows and roads.

Our shortest distance, 12 km, has just over 200 metres of elevation gain and follows trails of varying difficulty, with some short sections on roads.

Information about the courses and markings may change.

Start:

47 km, 10:00, Stadium, Billingen Recreation Area, Skövde.
21 km, 10:45, Björnasäter, Lerdala. Bus departs from the Billingen Recreation Area at 10:05.
12 km, 11:30, Stadium, Billingen Recreation Area, Skövde.

Finish:

At the Stadium, Billingen Recreation Area, Skövde.

All finishers cross the finish line at the stadium.

name: Isaberg500
description:
Isaberg 500 is the race we love running ourselves and the foundation of the entire trail weekend. It’s a perfect mix of trails, hills, sweat and tears that brings to mind spectacular races in both the Swedish mountains and the Alps. Isaberg 500 also features switchbacks, long, enjoyable downhill stretches and fantastic views. In between, you can enjoy winding trails through enchanting forests. Isaberg 500 includes at least 500 metres of elevation gain and is perfect for anyone training for a mountain marathon or similar race.

NEW FOR 2025!
When Isaberg500 started, Jättestigen was a big talking point. A few years later, it was closed due to the risk of landslides. In 2025, Jättestigen returns as part of Isaberg500, but under a new name — Jättetrappan...

Isaberg500 is a race in the Outnorth Trail Tour 2025.
course_highlights: Trail race with varied trails and hills, with a technical character reminiscent of races in the mountains and the Alps
Multisport around the Isaberg summit: kayaking, mountain biking and trail running — Solo and Duo categories

additional: Contact GI by mobile at +46 703 815 118 or email at gimulti@gmail.com. Organisers: GI Folkestad and Martin Jepson. Guided rides for cycling groups can be booked; the organisers have ready-made routes that can be adapted to the group’s needs. Main distance: approximately 10.5 km (Distans Trailtour); Kids Trail: approximately 2 km with approximately 150 metres of elevation gain; start time: Sunday at 12:00; location: Isaberg/Anderstorp; contact: niklas@isabergtrail.se.

description: Mörkertrail is a unique 10 km trail race run in total darkness in Garphyttan National Park in Lekeberg Municipality. Participants run along a reflective-marked course featuring both technical and easy-running trails, with the light from their headlamps as the only source of illumination. The race offers an atmospheric and challenging experience, with elevation gain and the quiet of the forest as companions. After finishing, participants can enjoy a grilled sausage by the fire. The start and finish are at the car park by the national park entrance, and the race starts at 17:00 on 14 November 2026.

name: Backyard Ulötra Sölvesborg
description:
What is Backyard Ultra?
Backyard Ultra takes place on a marked 6,706-metre loop, and each participant has one hour to complete it. A new start takes place at the top of every hour, and as long as you can complete the loop within an hour, you remain in the race. You win by being the most enduring and ultimately getting to run one final lap alone! A fun race and concept with a very welcoming, community-minded atmosphere, where many participants set their distance records!

Some sections take you past cultural sites, as much of the route passes through the historic cultural heritage of Finnskogen. Enjoy a memorable trail-running experience with plenty of challenging climbs and, in some places, technical trails. Welcome to a true adventure!

name: Ultra Caballo Blanco Suecia
description:
Only the 100-mile race starts on Friday (08:00); the 100 km and 50-mile races start on Saturday (06:00).
All three races have their own routes (they have nothing in common with CBMR, which takes place on the same day). The 50-mile and 100-mile races have some staffed aid stations, which are also shared with the 100 km race, which has its own stations as well. The 100-mile race is virtually entirely unsupported, apart from a few unmanned water stations. You also pass a well-stocked country store and a church with water and toilets.
All three races offer the option of a drop bag.
The courses are completely unmarked, so you navigate using a downloaded GPX file...
additional:
We don’t have paper cups, so bring a cup!
Hot food, drinks, coffee and cake are served after the finish.

The entry fee includes 120:-, which is sent to a children’s race in Urique, Mexico!

name: Caballo Blanco Memorial Run (CBMR)
description:
This is the route that Caballo Blanco (aka Micah True) and I ran on 2011-09-26, when he was visiting Sweden at my invitation. In spring 2012, we received the news that he had died. We then organised a memorial race on 2012-09-22. It became a tradition, and eventually the race offered 1, 2 or 4 laps of the route, which is approximately 11 km and has approximately 150 metres of elevation gain.
See also Ultra Caballo Blanco Suecia — an ultra race held at the same time.
An article I wrote quite a while ago, when we introduced the 50-mile race:
https://redsports.se/CBM/TheStory.html
additional:
The 4-lap race starts at 12:00, while the 1- and 2-lap races start at 15:00.
Please note that you must bring your own cup/mug.
The entry fee includes drinks, energy products, and a hot meal with coffee and cake after the race.

name: Bräkneåns Dalgång 25 K
description:
A technical trail race through the Bräkneån valley, starting at Hoby Ekebacke. The course is partly technical but also includes sections of asphalt.
The course has a total elevation gain of approximately 400 metres.
The generous time limit is 5 hours, allowing a maximum average pace of 12 min/km.
The finish is at Hoby Eckebacke.

The course will be clearly marked, and a GPX file will also be available for you to download to your watch or phone.
An aid station with food and drink will be available halfway, as well as at the start and finish.

Everyone who completes the race within the time limit will receive a lovely medal from RawCut studio.

description:
Hoby Backyard Ultra 24H. Start and finish at Ekebacken in Bräkne-Hoby on Saturday, 26/9 at 10:00.
The course is the same as before, with varied terrain and approximately 60 metres of elevation gain.
The course has been officially measured using a measuring wheel and is 6,706 metres long.
Each lap starts on the hour. To complete the lap and continue to the next one, each lap must be completed within 1 hour.

Energy, drinks, sports drinks, and hot meals will be served to all participants throughout the race.

Everyone who completes at least 1 lap within the time limit will receive a stylish medal from RawCut Studio.

All participants can take shelter under the roof inside Rotundan at Ekebacken throughout the race.

Medically trained race staff will be on site throughout the race.

Welcome to another fantastic running festival!
additional:
Start and finish at Ekebacken in Bräkne-Hoby.

name: Vildmarksleden 100 miles
description:
The first edition of Vildmarksleden 100 Miles, with an exclusive limit of just 25 places.

An out-and-back trail race taking you from Hoby Ekebacke to Eringsboda and then back to Hoby Ekebacke.

The course follows selected sections of Vildmarksleden and includes technical trails, gravel roads and asphalt. Approximately 1,850 metres of elevation gain.

One drop box, transported by the organizer to the turnaround point (50 miles) in Eringsboda. Opportunities to refill fluids and energy supplies at several points along the course.

A GPX file on a watch or mobile phone is mandatory.

Participation is entirely at your own risk. Participants are responsible for having the knowledge and equipment required to complete the race.
additional:
Start and finish at Ekebacken, Bräkne-Hoby

The running festival offers several different races, with something for everyone!

EKO ½Maran is for experienced runners, FORMTOPPEN Milen is a wonderful challenge, and the slightly shorter Here We Go 5an is for happy recreational runners or those who prefer to run fast but short. For those who want to take it a little easier, perhaps bring walking poles or a stroller, or simply enjoy nature, there’s Here We Go 5an – Promenad!

There are also races for younger participants—Papricaloppet—for everyone up to 12 years old! We also have Rulleruset for everyone with a disability! At Rulleruset, you can choose between a shorter 1.4 km race and a slightly longer 5 km race!

As we said, there’s something for everyone!

name: Änglamilen
description: Änglamilen is a long-established fun run in the heart of Ängelholm. Participants experience the town, the sea and the forest all in the same 10 kilometres. The 5 km race begins with a lovely run through the park in the charming Hembygdsparken. After approximately 2.7 km, the course crosses the Rönne River and continues along the beautiful riverside path in Nybroskogen. Finally, the course turns back across the river, with a sprint to the finish at Tullakrok. The 10 km course starts the same way as the 5 km route, but turns north after about a kilometre. Runners are treated to beautiful views over Skälderviken and its harbour, with Kullaberg visible in the background. After approximately 7.7 km, the courses join again, and runners can enjoy the beautiful riverside path in Nybroskogen.

Previous editions have offered online registration and race-day registration. Participants aged 13–80 must have an athletics license; children under 13 are covered by the children's sports insurance.

name: BlåmansLøpene - Etappe 3
description: Blåmansløpene 2026 consists of three spectacular races from Fjellveien to Blåmanen, with the start and finish at the same location, but on different routes featuring trails, nearby mountains and varied running challenges. Stage 3, held on 14 November, follows a demanding, technical course on trails towards Blåmanen, finishing at Tindevann. The race is suited to runners who enjoy challenging terrain and technical sections, and trail shoes are recommended. Varegg IL welcomes everyone to a great running experience in beautiful surroundings in Bergen.
course_highlights: Start at Fjellveien by «Damen» and finish at Tindevann
Technically challenging trails up Blåmanen through varied terrain
The course includes trails such as Permisjonstien, Sandviksbatteriet, Rundemanen and Blåmansveien
additional: Trail shoes are recommended for the technical sections. The course includes challenging climbs and technical trails. The start and finish are at the same location for all three races. Entry fees are paid by bank transfer or VIPPS to Varegg Fleridrett. The organizer recommends trail shoes; the course is technical, and runners accustomed to trail terrain may have an advantage.

name: Sognefjord Backyard
